title.rendered: UP Free Tablet Yojana 2026: e-KYC Process, Eligibility, Status Check and Latest Update

content.rendered:
UP Free Tablet Yojana 2026 is an important scheme for students studying in Uttar Pradesh. Under the Swami Vivekanand Yuva Sashaktikaran Yojana, eligible students are provided digital devices to support online education and digital learning.

Many students are searching for UP Free Smartphone Tablet Yojana, DigiShakti e-KYC, free tablet status and the process to complete Aadhaar verification. However, students should be careful with older information because the device distribution policy has changed.

In July 2025, the Uttar Pradesh government approved a proposal to distribute tablets instead of smartphones to future beneficiaries under the scheme. Therefore, students should check the latest information through official government sources before completing any application or verification process.

UP Free Tablet Yojana 2026 Latest Update

The Swami Vivekanand Yuva Sashaktikaran Yojana is implemented through the DigiShakti Portal. The scheme is intended to provide digital devices to eligible students enrolled in various educational and skill-development programs.

The Uttar Pradesh government’s July 2025 cabinet decision approved the distribution of tablets instead of smartphones for future beneficiaries. The earlier approval related to the purchase of 25 lakh smartphones was also cancelled.

This means students should not rely on older articles or videos that describe smartphone distribution as the current process.

The exact eligibility and distribution schedule can depend on the student’s institution and the latest government instructions.

What Is the DigiShakti Portal?

DigiShakti is the online portal associated with Uttar Pradesh’s student device distribution scheme.

The portal is used for activities related to:

  • Student information
  • Beneficiary records
  • Student verification
  • e-KYC
  • Device distribution
  • Distribution monitoring

Students may need to search for their university, college and enrollment details to check whether their information is available in the system.

Who Can Get a Free Tablet Under the Scheme?

The scheme covers eligible students enrolled in various educational and training programs in Uttar Pradesh.

Government information has included students pursuing courses such as:

  • Undergraduate programs
  • Postgraduate programs
  • Diploma courses
  • Skill-development programs
  • Paramedical courses
  • Other eligible educational programs

Eligibility is ultimately determined according to the applicable government rules and the information submitted by the student’s institution.

Therefore, simply being a student in Uttar Pradesh does not automatically mean that a student will receive a tablet.

UP Free Tablet Yojana e-KYC Process

Students whose records are available on the DigiShakti Portal may need to complete the applicable verification process.

Here is the general process.

Step 1: Open the DigiShakti Portal

Visit the official DigiShakti Portal and look for the student-related verification option.

Official Portal:
DigiShakti Portal

Before entering personal information, make sure you are using the official government website.

Step 2: Select Your University or Board

Select the university or board under which you are currently studying.

Choose the correct institution because selecting the wrong university may prevent your student record from appearing.

Step 3: Select Your College or Institute

Next, select your college or institute.

If the portal provides a search option, enter your college name and select the correct result from the list.

Step 4: Enter Your Enrollment Number

Enter your enrollment number carefully.

Your enrollment number should match the details available in your official academic records.

Step 5: Enter the Captcha

Enter the captcha displayed on the screen and click the Search button.

If your college has uploaded your information correctly, your student record may appear.

What Details Should Students Check?

After searching for your record, carefully check all the information displayed on the screen.

If the information is correct, proceed with the available e-KYC option.

How to Complete Aadhaar e-KYC?

The verification process can involve Aadhaar-based authentication through the applicable authentication service.

Depending on the portal flow, students may be redirected to e-Pramaan or Meri Pehchan.

If you do not have an account, use the available New User or Sign Up option.

You may be asked to provide:

  • Mobile number
  • Name
  • Gender
  • Date of birth
  • Username
  • Password
  • Captcha

Enter your information according to your official documents.

Meri Pehchan Account Registration

If the portal requires a new Meri Pehchan account, students can follow the registration process displayed on the screen.

The general process includes:

  1. Enter your mobile number.
  2. Request an OTP.
  3. Enter the OTP.
  4. Verify your mobile number.
  5. Enter your personal information.
  6. Create a unique username.
  7. Set a password.
  8. Enter the captcha.
  9. Accept the applicable terms.
  10. Complete registration.

Keep your username and password safe because they may be required for future access.

Aadhaar Verification Through OTP

After account registration, Aadhaar authentication may be required.

Enter your Aadhaar number only on the official authentication page.

Depending on the available options, an OTP may be sent to the mobile number linked with your Aadhaar.

Enter the OTP and complete the verification process.

Never share your Aadhaar OTP or account password with another person.

How to Check DigiShakti e-KYC Status?

After completing the verification process, students should check their status again.

Return to the DigiShakti Portal and enter the required details, such as:

  • University or board
  • College or institute
  • Enrollment number
  • Captcha

Click Search.

If the verification status shows “Verified”, it indicates that the verification recorded on the portal has been completed.

However, e-KYC verification does not necessarily mean that the tablet will be delivered immediately.

What Happens After e-KYC?

After e-KYC, students generally need to wait for the beneficiary and distribution process.

The educational institution and concerned authorities play a role in updating student information and distributing devices.

Students should therefore stay connected with their college for information about:

  • Beneficiary confirmation
  • Distribution dates
  • Distribution location
  • Required documents
  • Device collection instructions

The distribution schedule may vary between institutions.

What If DigiShakti Shows Details Mismatch?

A details mismatch is one of the common issues students can face during verification.

The mismatch may involve:

  • Student name
  • Father’s name
  • Date of birth
  • Enrollment number
  • Aadhaar details
  • College information

If your details do not match, contact your college or institute instead of entering incorrect information.

Carry your relevant documents, such as:

  • Aadhaar Card
  • College ID
  • Marksheet
  • Enrollment details
  • Admission documents

Ask the concerned college department to check whether your student information has been entered correctly.

If the problem is related to Aadhaar information, follow the official Aadhaar correction process.

What If My Record Is Not Found?

If your record does not appear on DigiShakti, check your information again.

Make sure that:

  1. Your enrollment number is correct.
  2. You selected the correct university.
  3. You selected the correct college.
  4. Your college has submitted your information.
  5. Your student information is updated.
  6. Your institution is covered under the applicable scheme.

If your details are correct but the record is still unavailable, contact your college’s concerned department or nodal officer.

Is There Any Application Fee?

Eligible students are not required to purchase the government-provided device.

The scheme is designed to provide eligible beneficiaries with digital devices free of cost.

Students should be cautious if someone asks for money in exchange for:

  • e-KYC
  • Government approval
  • Beneficiary selection
  • Guaranteed tablet delivery
  • Faster distribution

Do not pay unknown individuals claiming to provide guaranteed approval.

Does e-KYC Guarantee a Free Tablet?

No.

Completing e-KYC verifies the student’s identity and record. It does not by itself guarantee immediate device distribution.

The student’s eligibility, institutional data and applicable government rules also matter.

The distribution process is handled through the concerned institutions and authorities.

Smartphone or Tablet: What Will Students Receive?

This is an important point for students in 2026.

Older videos and articles may refer to both smartphones and tablets. However, the Uttar Pradesh government’s July 2025 decision approved tablet distribution for future beneficiaries.

Therefore, students should check the latest official notification rather than relying on old social media posts.

Previous Device Distribution Data

According to the Uttar Pradesh government’s July 2025 document, by April 9, 2025, 22.80 lakh tablets and 37.25 lakh smartphones had been supplied under the scheme.

The document stated that 16.75 lakh tablets and 36.75 lakh smartphones had been distributed by that date.

These are historical figures. They should not be treated as the current 2026 distribution target.

UP Free Tablet Yojana 2026: Important Details

Important Things Students Should Remember

Before completing the verification process, keep the following points in mind:

  • Use the official DigiShakti Portal.
  • Enter your enrollment number carefully.
  • Make sure your college details are correct.
  • Check your name and date of birth.
  • Complete the applicable e-KYC process.
  • Check your verification status after e-KYC.
  • Contact your college if your details do not match.
  • Do not share your Aadhaar OTP.
  • Do not share your password with anyone.
  • Do not pay an unknown person for government approval.
  • Check official updates for the latest distribution schedule.

Frequently Asked Questions

What is the UP Free Tablet Yojana 2026?

It refers to the digital device distribution initiative under the Swami Vivekanand Yuva Sashaktikaran Yojana for eligible students in Uttar Pradesh.

Which portal is used for the scheme?

The DigiShakti Portal is associated with student records, verification and device distribution under the scheme.

Is e-KYC necessary?

Eligible students may need to complete the applicable e-KYC or authentication process to verify their identity and student record.

Can I apply directly without my college?

The student’s academic information is generally connected with the institution’s records. If your information is missing or incorrect, you may need to contact your college.

What should I do if my details do not match?

Contact your college or institute and ask them to verify and correct the information in their records. Carry your Aadhaar, marksheet, college ID and other relevant documents.

Will every student receive a tablet?

No. Distribution depends on the applicable eligibility rules, student records, institutional data and government process.

Is the tablet free?

The scheme provides devices free of cost to eligible beneficiaries. Students should not pay unauthorized individuals for approval or delivery.

Can I complete Aadhaar verification using an OTP?

Where Aadhaar OTP authentication is provided, the verification process can use the mobile number linked with Aadhaar.

Final Update for Students

The UP Free Tablet Yojana remains a widely searched topic among college students, especially those looking for information about DigiShakti e-KYC and device distribution.

The most important update is that the Uttar Pradesh government approved a shift toward tablet distribution for future beneficiaries in July 2025. Students should therefore avoid relying solely on older videos that describe the scheme as a smartphone distribution program.

If your student record is available on DigiShakti, check your details carefully and complete the applicable verification process. After that, stay in contact with your college for information about beneficiary status and tablet distribution.

Always use official government portals for Aadhaar authentication and OTP verification.

BCS701 Artificial Intelligence Main Subject
BCS070 Internet of Things Departmental Elective-IV

BCS073 Design & Development of Applications Departmental Elective-IV

Students should study the Departmental Elective-IV subject allotted or selected according to their college and curriculum.

BCS701 Artificial Intelligence Notes

Artificial Intelligence is an important subject for CSE students because it introduces the concepts and techniques used to create systems capable of performing tasks that normally require intelligent decision-making.

Artificial Intelligence broadly deals with developing computer systems capable of:

  • problem-solving
  • reasoning
  • learning
  • decision-making
  • knowledge representation
  • intelligent search

AI concepts are used in many modern applications such as:

  • recommendation systems
  • virtual assistants
  • robotics
  • intelligent search
  • automation
  • healthcare systems
  • business analytics

Meaning of Artificial Intelligence

Artificial Intelligence (AI) refers to the development of computer systems that can perform tasks involving aspects of human-like intelligence.

These tasks may include:

  • recognising patterns
  • solving problems
  • making decisions
  • understanding information
  • learning from experience

Artificial Intelligence is one of the most important areas of modern Computer Science.

Goals of Artificial Intelligence

The broad goals of AI may include:

  • developing intelligent systems
  • automating complex tasks
  • improving decision-making
  • solving difficult computational problems
  • enabling machines to learn from data

Applications of Artificial Intelligence

AI can be applied in areas such as:

  • education
  • healthcare
  • finance
  • manufacturing
  • transportation
  • cybersecurity
  • e-commerce
  • robotics

For CSE students, Artificial Intelligence provides a strong foundation for advanced technologies such as Machine Learning and intelligent software systems.

BCS070 Internet of Things Notes

Internet of Things (IoT) is a Departmental Elective-IV subject that focuses on connected physical devices capable of collecting and exchanging data.

IoT combines:

  • sensors
  • devices
  • communication networks
  • software
  • cloud systems

A basic IoT system may be represented as:

Physical Device → Sensor → Network → Processing System → Application

Meaning of Internet of Things

The Internet of Things refers to a network of physical objects connected through communication technologies so that they can collect, exchange, and sometimes act upon data.

Examples may include:

  • smart home devices
  • industrial sensors
  • wearable devices
  • connected vehicles
  • smart agriculture systems

Components of IoT

Important IoT components may include:

  • sensors
  • actuators
  • processors
  • communication networks
  • cloud platforms
  • applications

Sensors

Sensors collect information from the physical environment.

Examples may include:

  • temperature sensors
  • motion sensors
  • humidity sensors
  • pressure sensors

Actuators

Actuators perform physical actions based on control signals.

For example, an actuator may:

  • open a valve
  • switch a device
  • move a motor

IoT Architecture

A general IoT architecture may involve:

  1. Device or sensing layer
  2. Communication layer
  3. Processing layer
  4. Application layer

The exact architecture may vary according to the system.

Applications of IoT

IoT is used in:

  • smart homes
  • smart cities
  • healthcare
  • agriculture
  • manufacturing
  • transportation
  • environmental monitoring

IoT in Smart Homes

Connected devices can be used to control:

  • lighting
  • temperature
  • security
  • appliances

IoT in Healthcare

IoT devices may support:

  • patient monitoring
  • wearable health devices
  • remote healthcare systems

IoT in Industry

Industrial IoT can support:

  • equipment monitoring
  • predictive maintenance
  • automation
  • production tracking

Advantages of IoT

Potential advantages include:

  • automation
  • real-time monitoring
  • improved efficiency
  • better data collection
  • remote control

Challenges of IoT

Common challenges include:

  • cybersecurity
  • privacy
  • device management
  • interoperability
  • connectivity

BCS071 Cloud Computing Notes

Cloud Computing is another Departmental Elective-IV option in AKTU B.Tech 7th Semester CSE.

Cloud Computing allows users and organisations to access computing resources through network-based services instead of maintaining all infrastructure locally.

These resources may include:

  • servers
  • storage
  • databases
  • applications
  • computing power

Meaning of Cloud Computing

Cloud Computing refers to delivering computing resources and services over a network, commonly through internet-based infrastructure.

It allows businesses and users to access technology resources when required.

Characteristics of Cloud Computing

Important characteristics may include:

  • on-demand access
  • scalability
  • resource sharing
  • network accessibility
  • flexible resource allocation

Benefits of Cloud Computing

Cloud Computing may provide:

  • lower initial infrastructure cost
  • scalability
  • remote access
  • easier collaboration
  • faster deployment
  • flexible storage

Cloud Service Models

Common cloud service models include:

  • IaaS
  • PaaS
  • SaaS

Infrastructure as a Service

Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS) provides computing infrastructure such as:

  • servers
  • storage
  • networking

The customer manages more of the software environment.

Platform as a Service

Platform as a Service (PaaS) provides an environment for developing and deploying applications.

It helps developers focus more on application development and less on underlying infrastructure.

Software as a Service

Software as a Service (SaaS) provides ready-to-use applications through network-based access.

Users generally access the software without managing the complete underlying infrastructure.

IaaS vs PaaS vs SaaS

Service Model Main Purpose
IaaS Provides computing infrastructure
PaaS Provides application development platform
SaaS Provides ready-to-use software

Cloud Deployment Models

Cloud deployment models may include:

  • Public Cloud
  • Private Cloud
  • Hybrid Cloud

Public Cloud

Public Cloud services are offered through shared provider infrastructure.

Private Cloud

Private Cloud infrastructure is dedicated to a particular organisation or controlled environment.

Hybrid Cloud

Hybrid Cloud combines elements of public and private cloud systems.

Cloud Computing Applications

Cloud Computing can support:

  • web applications
  • data storage
  • software development
  • online collaboration
  • business systems
  • analytics

Challenges of Cloud Computing

Potential challenges may include:

  • cybersecurity
  • privacy
  • vendor dependency
  • service availability
  • regulatory requirements

BCS072 Cryptography and Network Security Notes

Cryptography and Network Security focuses on protecting information, computer systems, and communication networks against unauthorised access and attacks.

The subject is important because modern organisations depend heavily on secure digital communication.

Meaning of Cryptography

Cryptography deals with techniques used to protect information by transforming it into a secure form.

A simple concept is:

Plaintext → Encryption → Ciphertext

The authorised receiver can use an appropriate process to recover the original information.

Encryption

Encryption converts readable information into protected form.

It helps prevent unauthorised users from understanding sensitive data.

Decryption

Decryption converts encrypted information back into readable form using an appropriate key or mechanism.

Symmetric Key Cryptography

In Symmetric Key Cryptography, the same or closely related secret key is used for encryption and decryption.

Potential advantages include:

  • speed
  • efficiency

The major challenge is secure key sharing.

Asymmetric Key Cryptography

Asymmetric Cryptography uses a pair of mathematically related keys, generally referred to as:

  • public key
  • private key

It can support secure communication and digital signatures.

Symmetric vs Asymmetric Cryptography

Symmetric Cryptography Asymmetric Cryptography
Uses shared secret key Uses public-private key pair
Generally faster Generally more computationally intensive
Key distribution can be difficult Supports easier public-key distribution
Useful for bulk encryption Useful for key exchange and digital signatures

Hashing

A Hash Function converts input data into a fixed-size output.

Hashing can be used for:

  • integrity verification
  • password-related security mechanisms
  • digital signatures

Hashing is different from encryption because it is generally designed as a one-way transformation.

Digital Signature

A Digital Signature helps verify:

  • authenticity
  • integrity
  • origin of digital information

It is commonly associated with public-key cryptographic techniques.

Network Security

Network Security focuses on protecting communication systems and network resources.

It may involve:

  • access control
  • firewalls
  • authentication
  • encryption
  • monitoring

Common Network Threats

Threats may include:

  • malware
  • phishing
  • unauthorised access
  • denial-of-service attacks
  • password attacks

Firewall

A Firewall controls network traffic according to defined security rules.

It can help separate trusted and untrusted network environments.

Authentication

Authentication verifies the identity of a user or system.

Examples may include:

  • passwords
  • security tokens
  • multi-factor authentication

Authorization

Authorization determines what an authenticated user is permitted to access.

Authentication vs Authorization

Authentication Authorization
Verifies identity Determines permissions
Answers “Who are you?” Answers “What can you access?”
Happens first Follows successful authentication

Importance of Network Security

Network Security helps protect:

  • confidential data
  • organisational systems
  • user accounts
  • financial information
  • online services

BCS073 Design & Development of Applications Notes

Design & Development of Applications is a Departmental Elective-IV subject focused on the systematic creation of software applications.

Application development typically involves understanding user requirements and converting them into usable software.

A basic application development process may include:

Requirements → Design → Development → Testing → Deployment → Maintenance

Requirement Analysis

Requirement Analysis determines what users expect from the application.

Requirements may include:

  • functional requirements
  • non-functional requirements

Clear requirements help reduce development errors.

Functional Requirements

Functional requirements describe what the application should do.

Examples may include:

  • user registration
  • login
  • search
  • payment processing
  • report generation

Non-Functional Requirements

Non-functional requirements describe how the system should perform.

Examples may include:

  • speed
  • security
  • usability
  • reliability
  • scalability

Application Design

Application design determines how the system will be structured before development begins.

It may include:

  • user interface
  • system architecture
  • database structure
  • application flow

User Interface Design

The user interface determines how users interact with an application.

A good interface should generally be:

  • clear
  • consistent
  • easy to navigate
  • responsive
  • user-friendly

Application Architecture

Application architecture describes how different components of an application work together.

Components may include:

  • frontend
  • backend
  • database
  • APIs

Frontend Development

Frontend Development focuses on the part of an application visible to users.

It may include:

  • layouts
  • forms
  • buttons
  • navigation
  • user interactions

Backend Development

Backend Development manages server-side processes such as:

  • business logic
  • authentication
  • data processing
  • database interaction

Database Integration

Applications often require databases for storing information such as:

  • user accounts
  • products
  • orders
  • transactions

Database integration allows applications to store and retrieve information efficiently.

Application Programming Interface

An Application Programming Interface (API) allows software systems or components to communicate with each other.

APIs may be used to:

  • retrieve data
  • submit information
  • integrate external services
  • connect frontend and backend systems

Application Testing

Testing helps identify defects before an application is released.

Common testing levels may include:

  • Unit Testing
  • Integration Testing
  • System Testing
  • Acceptance Testing

Unit Testing

Unit Testing evaluates individual components.

Integration Testing

Integration Testing checks whether different components work correctly together.

System Testing

System Testing evaluates the complete application.

Acceptance Testing

Acceptance Testing checks whether the application satisfies expected user requirements.

Application Deployment

Deployment makes the developed application available to users.

It may involve:

  • configuring infrastructure
  • publishing application files
  • connecting databases
  • testing production environment

Application Maintenance

Applications often require maintenance after deployment.

Maintenance may involve:

  • fixing errors
  • improving performance
  • adding features
  • updating security
  • adapting to new requirements

Application Security

Security should be considered throughout application development.

Important areas may include:

  • authentication
  • authorization
  • data protection
  • secure communication
  • input validation

Importance of Design & Development of Applications

The subject can help CSE students understand how software ideas are converted into usable applications.

It is relevant for:

  • web development
  • mobile applications
  • software engineering
  • startup development
  • enterprise applications

Importance of CSE Notes for AKTU Students

Well-organised CSE Notes can help students:

  • understand difficult subjects
  • revise unit-wise topics
  • prepare important definitions
  • study important diagrams
  • prepare theoretical questions
  • save time during revision

7th Semester CSE subjects are closely related to modern technology and therefore require both conceptual understanding and application-based preparation.

How to Prepare AKTU B.Tech 7th Semester CSE Notes

Start With the Syllabus

Before beginning preparation, check the complete syllabus of each selected subject.

Divide it into:

  • units
  • important definitions
  • numerical topics
  • theory topics
  • diagrams
  • applications

Study Unit-Wise

Complete one unit before moving to the next.

This helps maintain a clear study structure.

Prepare Short Revision Notes

Create short notes containing:

  • definitions
  • differences
  • formulas
  • processes
  • diagrams
  • important points

Understand Applications

For technical subjects, do not prepare only definitions.

Understand how concepts are applied in real systems.

For example:

  • AI in intelligent applications
  • IoT in smart devices
  • Cloud Computing in online applications
  • Cryptography in secure communication
  • Application Development in software systems

Practice Diagrams

Diagrams can improve answers related to:

  • IoT architecture
  • Cloud Computing
  • cryptographic systems
  • application architecture
  • Artificial Intelligence processes

Solve Previous-Year Questions

PYQs can help students understand:

  • question pattern
  • frequently tested concepts
  • answer format
  • important areas

Students should still prepare the complete prescribed syllabus rather than depending only on PYQs.

Quick Revision Strategy for CSE Notes

For final exam revision, students can divide preparation according to their subjects.

Artificial Intelligence

Revise:

  • AI fundamentals
  • intelligent systems
  • search and reasoning concepts
  • applications of AI

Internet of Things

Revise:

  • IoT architecture
  • sensors
  • actuators
  • communication
  • applications
  • security

Cloud Computing

Revise:

  • cloud fundamentals
  • IaaS
  • PaaS
  • SaaS
  • deployment models
  • security concerns

Cryptography and Network Security

Revise:

  • encryption
  • symmetric cryptography
  • asymmetric cryptography
  • hashing
  • digital signatures
  • authentication
  • network security

Design & Development of Applications

Revise:

  • requirements
  • design
  • frontend
  • backend
  • APIs
  • testing
  • deployment
  • maintenance

title.rendered: Honeywell Intern (Bachelor’s) in Bengaluru: Eligibility, Responsibilities & Apply

content.rendered:
Honeywell has opened applications for the Intern (Bachelor’s) position in Bengaluru, Karnataka. The role is listed as an on-site, full-time opportunity under the Procurement category.

The internship offers students practical exposure to business projects, data analysis, research, reporting, and collaboration with experienced professionals. Candidates with a bachelor’s degree in a relevant field, including Engineering, Business, or Computer Science, are among those Honeywell says it values for this role.

Honeywell Intern (Bachelor’s) Overview

About Honeywell Technologies

Honeywell Technologies is a global automation company serving the building, industrial, and process sectors. The company provides services, solutions, and products aimed at addressing industrial challenges.

According to the job listing, Honeywell combines domain expertise with data from its global installed base and operates with a focus on the transition from automation to autonomy.

Honeywell Intern (Bachelor’s) Role Details

The Honeywell Intern (Bachelor’s) role provides hands-on exposure to real projects and day-to-day business activities.

Interns will work with experienced professionals and contribute to team objectives while developing practical experience in areas such as research, data analysis, reporting, and project support.

The position is part of the Procurement function and requires collaboration with cross-functional teams.

Key Responsibilities

The selected candidate will be expected to support activities such as:

  • Supporting the team with day-to-day activities and projects
  • Assisting with data analysis and reporting
  • Conducting research and gathering information for projects
  • Collaborating with cross-functional teams
  • Participating in team meetings
  • Contributing ideas and suggestions
  • Supporting project-related activities

title.rendered: TCS CodeVita Season 14 2026: Registration, Eligibility & Apply

content.rendered:
TCS CodeVita Season 14 2026 registration is now open for students pursuing undergraduate or postgraduate programs in Science or Engineering. Students graduating in 2027, 2028, 2029, or 2030 can participate in the global programming competition.

TCS CodeVita gives students an opportunity to compete in programming challenges and test their problem-solving skills against participants from different countries. The competition offers a total prize pool of USD 20,000 for the top three coders, along with an opportunity for finalists to attend the Grand Finale in India, subject to applicable terms and conditions.

TCS CodeVita Season 14 2026 Overview

About TCS CodeVita

Tata Consultancy Services (TCS) launched CodeVita as a global programming competition to encourage competitive programming and provide students with an international platform to demonstrate their coding and problem-solving abilities.

The competition brings together students from different academic backgrounds and countries. Participants solve programming problems under contest conditions, with performance determining progression through the competition stages.

TCS CodeVita has also received Guinness World Records recognition as the world’s largest programming competition, according to the information provided for Season 14.

Who Can Apply for TCS CodeVita Season 14 2026?

TCS CodeVita Season 14 2026 is open to students currently pursuing graduation or post-graduation programs.

Candidates must belong to a recognized institute or university and should meet the competition’s academic and passing-year requirements.

Eligible Streams

Students pursuing programs in the following broad areas can participate:

  • Science
  • Engineering

Eligible Passing Batches

The competition is open to students expected to complete their academic course in:

  • 2027
  • 2028
  • 2029
  • 2030

Students should verify the complete eligibility requirements on the official CodeVita portal before registering.

Contest Format

The TCS CodeVita competition follows multiple stages, beginning with registration and practice contests before the official competition rounds.

The broad structure is:

Registration → MockVitas → Official Rounds → Grand Finale

Registration

Students first register through the official TCS CodeVita portal. Candidates should provide accurate information during registration and follow the instructions provided by TCS.

MockVitas

MockVitas are practice contests that help participants become familiar with the CodeVita platform, contest environment, and problem format.

Official Contest Rounds

Participants compete in official coding rounds and solve programming challenges within the specified time limit. Performance determines which participants progress to later stages.

Grand Finale

The highest-ranked participants can progress to the Grand Finale. The Season 14 Grand Finale is planned in India, with travel arrangements for finalists subject to applicable terms and conditions.

Programming Languages Allowed

Participants can use the following programming languages in the competition:

  • C
  • C++
  • Java
  • Python

Students preparing for the competition should choose a language they are comfortable using for implementing algorithms efficiently.

TCS CodeVita Season 14 2026 Prize Details

The total prize pool for the competition is USD 20,000.

The prize money is intended for the top three global coders. The competition also provides recognition through global rankings and certificates for eligible top performers.

The source does not specify an exact INR value or the individual prize distribution for each of the top three positions. Candidates should refer to the official CodeVita portal for the latest prize-related terms.

What Should Students Prepare for CodeVita?

Students preparing for the competition should focus on programming fundamentals, algorithms, and efficient problem-solving.

Important topics include:

  • Arrays and Strings
  • Sorting and Searching
  • Hashing
  • Two Pointers
  • Sliding Window
  • Prefix Sum
  • Recursion and Backtracking
  • Linked Lists
  • Stacks and Queues
  • Trees
  • Graphs
  • BFS and DFS
  • Greedy Algorithms
  • Dynamic Programming
  • Bit Manipulation
  • Number Theory
  • Mathematical Problem Solving
  • Time and Space Complexity

CodeVita-style programming problems can require participants to find an efficient solution within a limited amount of time. Practicing problems with different difficulty levels can help students become familiar with competitive programming.

Sample Problem: On A Cube

One of the sample problem themes associated with CodeVita involves a beetle moving across the surface of a cube to visit specific points.

In the example, a cube measures 10 cm × 10 cm × 10 cm and rests on the ground. The beetle must travel between specified points without crawling on the bottom face.

When two points are on the same face, the movement can involve a circular arc. When the points are on different faces, the shortest possible surface path is considered.

For example, an input containing three points can produce a total distance of 4.05 after calculating each movement according to the stated rules and rounding individual distances to two decimal places.

Other sample problem themes mentioned in the source include:

  • Sorting Boxes
  • Sport Stadium
  • Water Cistern
  • Square Free Numbers
  • Codu and Sum Love
  • Obstacle Game

These examples demonstrate the type of logical and algorithmic problem-solving that participants may encounter while preparing for the competition.

Important Points for Candidates

Students planning to participate should keep the following points in mind:

  • Check your passing year before registering.
  • Make sure your academic information is accurate.
  • Select a programming language you can use comfortably.
  • Practice data structures and algorithms regularly.
  • Use MockVitas to become familiar with the contest environment.
  • Read the official contest rules carefully.
  • Check the official portal for the latest schedule and instructions.

The exact contest schedule and applicable rules should be confirmed directly through the official CodeVita website because competition information can be updated by TCS.

How to Apply for TCS CodeVita Season 14 2026

Eligible students can register online through the official TCS CodeVita portal.

To apply, visit the official website and follow the registration instructions provided by TCS. Candidates should review the eligibility requirements and contest terms before completing their registration.

Official Application Link: Apply Here

Students looking for more career opportunities, internships, placement updates, and educational resources can also explore NotesGallery.

TCS CodeVita Season 14 2026 FAQs

What is TCS CodeVita Season 14 2026?

TCS CodeVita Season 14 2026 is a global programming competition organized by Tata Consultancy Services for eligible Science and Engineering students pursuing graduation or post-graduation.

Who is eligible for TCS CodeVita Season 14 2026?

Students pursuing graduation or post-graduation in Science or Engineering and graduating in 2027, 2028, 2029, or 2030 can participate, subject to the official eligibility requirements.

What is the prize money for TCS CodeVita Season 14 2026?

The total prize pool is USD 20,000 for the top three global coders.

Which programming languages are allowed in CodeVita Season 14?

The listed programming languages are C, C++, Java, and Python.

How long is the CodeVita contest?

The contest duration specified for Season 14 is 3 hours.

Where will the CodeVita Season 14 Grand Finale take place?

The Grand Finale is planned to take place in India. Travel support for finalists is subject to applicable terms and conditions.

Which passing years are eligible for CodeVita Season 14?

Students graduating in 2027, 2028, 2029, or 2030 are listed as eligible passing batches.

Where can I apply for TCS CodeVita Season 14?

Candidates can register through the official TCS CodeVita website at https://codevita.tcsapps.com/.

Final Update

TCS CodeVita Season 14 2026 is currently open for eligible students from Science and Engineering backgrounds. The competition covers students graduating in 2027, 2028, 2029, and 2030 and allows participants to compete using C, C++, Java, or Python.

With a USD 20,000 prize pool for the top three coders and the opportunity to progress to a Grand Finale in India, the competition provides students with an international platform to demonstrate their programming skills.

Candidates should check the official CodeVita portal for the latest registration information, rules, contest schedule, and eligibility conditions before applying.

The 7th semester of CSE Artificial Intelligence generally focuses on advanced computing topics and specialization-oriented learning. For CSE AI students, Deep Learning is a core subject that supports higher-level AI understanding and practical development skills.

BCS070 Internet of Things Notes

This subject is useful for students who want to work in intelligent connected systems and automation-based technologies.

This subject may include major areas such as:

For CSE AI students, this subject is important because AI systems also depend heavily on secure data handling and safe computing environments.

BAI070 Principles of Generative AI Notes

This subject may help students understand:

The subject can also help students understand the business and technical impact of generative systems in fields such as:

  • education
  • content creation
  • software development
  • customer support
  • research assistance
  • media and communication

For CSE AI students, this subject is especially important because it reflects the current direction of Artificial Intelligence and real-world innovation.

Students may study topics such as:

This subject helps students understand how decentralized systems are designed and how trust can be maintained without a central authority.

title.rendered: Amazon Associate, ML Data Operations Recruitment 2026: Apply Online

content.rendered:
Amazon has announced an opening for the position of Associate, ML Data Operations, GO-AI Operations. The role is part of Amazon’s Data Auditing Operations team, which supports fulfillment centers and robotics technologies through image and video auditing.

The position is suitable for candidates who have completed a bachelor’s degree and are interested in an operational role involving video and image analysis. The job requires strong attention to detail, accuracy, productivity, and the ability to work in rotational shifts.

Amazon Associate, ML Data Operations Recruitment 2026

About the Role

The Associate, ML Data Operations role supports Amazon’s internal fulfillment technologies and robotics teams.

Amazon uses image and video data from fulfillment centers to improve automation and maintain inventory accuracy. Associates review short videos of stowing activities and use dedicated tools to identify and verify the location of products.

The videos are generally around 15 to 20 seconds long. Associates are expected to carefully review each video and provide the correct response based on the activity shown.

This is an operational position rather than a software development or machine learning engineering role.

Key Responsibilities

Selected candidates will be responsible for:

  • Watching and auditing several hundred videos during a shift.
  • Reviewing image and video-based tasks accurately.
  • Identifying product locations and stowing activities.
  • Using internal tools to verify or mark product locations.
  • Maintaining high accuracy while meeting productivity targets.
  • Identifying details in blurry or less-sharp videos.
  • Following defined quality and operational guidelines.
  • Meeting incremental quality and productivity goals.
  • Maintaining consistent performance.
  • Working effectively with remote and distributed teams.
  • Taking breaks according to predefined schedules.
  • Spending approximately 6.8 to 7 hours per day answering video tasks.

Work From Home Requirements

Candidates working from home are expected to maintain a suitable dedicated workspace.

The workspace should have:

  • A dedicated table and chair.
  • Sufficient lighting.
  • A suitable environment for focused work.
  • Restricted access to work-related information and data.

Work-related data should not be accessed by anyone other than the employee.

Candidates may also be required to visit an Amazon office for a few days when business requirements call for it.

Working Hours and Shifts

Amazon’s Data Auditing Operations team works in a 24×7 environment.

Associates generally work a 9-hour shift that includes scheduled breaks. Shift timings can change every 3 to 4 months or according to business requirements.

Candidates should be comfortable working:

  • Day shifts
  • Evening shifts
  • Night shifts
  • Rotational shifts
  • Weekends and holidays when required

Amazon states that night-shift allowance will be provided according to the applicable company policy.

The position generally follows a 5-day working week with 2 consecutive days off. The weekly offs may be rotational and are not necessarily Saturday and Sunday.

Candidate Requirements

Amazon expects candidates to demonstrate the following abilities:

  • Strong attention to detail.
  • Ability to review image and video-based tasks.
  • Ability to identify information from blurry or low-quality videos.
  • Good concentration while working on a screen.
  • Ability to maintain accuracy at high speed.
  • Willingness to work toward quality and productivity targets.
  • Ability to work in rotational shifts.
  • Ability to work as part of a remote team.
  • Good teamwork and communication.
  • Willingness to work in a non-technical operational role for the 6-month contract period.
  • Willingness to switch on the laptop camera during virtual meetings when required.

Educational Qualification

The basic qualification mentioned by Amazon is:

  • Bachelor’s degree from a recognized institution.

The job description does not require a specific technical degree or programming language for this position.

Is This a Technical ML Job?

Despite the “ML Data Operations” title, this position is primarily an operational data auditing role.

The work involves reviewing videos and images that support Amazon’s machine learning and automation systems. Associates provide human-verified information that can help improve automated fulfillment processes.

Candidates should therefore understand that this is different from roles such as:

  • Machine Learning Engineer
  • Data Scientist
  • Software Development Engineer
  • AI Engineer

Programming or advanced machine learning skills are not listed as basic requirements in the provided job description.

Who Can Apply?

Candidates who have completed a bachelor’s degree can consider applying if they are comfortable with the operational requirements of the role.

This opportunity may be suitable for candidates who:

  • Want to start their career with Amazon.
  • Are comfortable working with computers for extended periods.
  • Have good attention to detail.
  • Can work with repetitive video/image auditing tasks.
  • Are comfortable with rotational shifts.
  • Can meet accuracy and productivity targets.
  • Are looking for a short-term contract opportunity.

Selection and Work Expectations

The role places significant importance on three areas:

  1. Quality
    Associates must provide accurate responses while reviewing videos.
  2. Productivity
    Associates are expected to process a high volume of video tasks during their shift.
  3. Process Compliance
    Associates must follow Amazon’s defined procedures and acceptable work practices.

Performance may be evaluated over time, and associates may receive coaching to improve quality and productivity.

Important Points Before Applying

Before applying, candidates should consider the following:

  • This is a 6-month contract role.
  • It is primarily an operational position.
  • The work involves reviewing a large number of short videos.
  • Strong screen focus and attention to detail are important.
  • Rotational shifts are part of the role.
  • Night shifts may be required.
  • Weekly offs can be rotational.
  • Work-from-home employees need a dedicated workspace.
  • Candidates may need to visit an office when required.
  • The role requires consistent quality and productivity.

How to Apply for Amazon Associate, ML Data Operations

Interested and eligible candidates can apply through Amazon’s official careers website.

Application link:

Apply Online at Amazon Jobs

Candidates should carefully review the official job description and eligibility requirements before submitting their application.

Amazon Associate, ML Data Operations Recruitment 2026: FAQs

What is the job title?

The position is Associate, ML Data Operations, GO-AI Operations.

What is the Amazon Job ID?

The Job ID is 3134253.

What is the educational qualification?

A bachelor’s degree is required.

Is this a technical job?

The position is primarily an operational data auditing role. It involves reviewing videos and images to support Amazon’s fulfillment automation and machine learning systems.

Is this a permanent position?

The job description states that candidates should be willing to work in a non-tech role for a contract duration of 6 months.

Are night shifts required?

Candidates should be comfortable working rotational shifts, including night shifts.

How many days do employees work?

The position follows a 5-day working week with 2 consecutive days off, subject to business requirements.

Can work-from-home candidates apply?

The job description includes requirements for associates working from home. Such employees must maintain a dedicated workspace and protect work-related data.

Where can I apply?

You can apply through the official Amazon Jobs listing linked above.

title.rendered: Microsoft Software Engineering Intern 2026: Eligibility, Qualifications, Job Details and How to Apply

content.rendered:
Microsoft has opened a Software Engineering Intern opportunity in India for students pursuing a bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. The internship is listed across multiple locations in India and is a fully on-site role.

The position focuses on software development, problem-solving, testing, engineering fundamentals, and collaboration with product and technical teams.

The Microsoft Software Engineering Intern position was posted on September 18, 2026, under job number 200041085. Applications are being accepted on an ongoing basis while the position remains open.

Microsoft Software Engineering Intern 2026: Overview

Microsoft’s official internship information says its university interns work on real projects, collaborate with teams, receive mentorship and participate in career development and community activities.

What Does a Microsoft Software Engineering Intern Do?

Selected interns will work with engineering teams on software development and technical problem-solving.

According to the job description, responsibilities include:

  • Applying engineering principles to solve complex problems.
  • Working with stakeholders to understand user requirements.
  • Learning new engineering methods, tools and processes.
  • Improving technical solutions based on feedback and best practices.
  • Managing time and completing software projects in a collaborative environment.
  • Working on software availability, reliability, efficiency and performance.
  • Improving observability and monitoring for products operating at scale.
  • Developing and testing software solutions.

The role can involve collaboration with Technical Program Managers and Product Managers while working on software used by customers.

Microsoft Software Engineering Intern Eligibility

Candidates must meet the required qualifications listed for the position.

Educational Qualification

Applicants must currently be pursuing:

  • A Bachelor’s degree, or
  • A Master’s degree

The degree should be in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.

Programming Experience

Candidates must have at least one year of programming experience in an object-oriented programming language.

Examples of relevant languages include:

  • C++
  • Java
  • C#
  • Python, where object-oriented programming experience can be demonstrated

Candidates should be able to explain their programming experience through coursework, projects, internships or other practical work.

Remaining Academic Term

The job posting requires candidates to have at least one semester or term remaining after completing the internship.

For Microsoft university internships in India, Microsoft currently states that university interns are generally expected to be in their pre-final year and have one additional calendar year remaining after the internship.

Students should therefore check their expected graduation date and the internship timeline before applying.

Preferred Qualification

Microsoft lists knowledge of Computer Science fundamentals as a preferred qualification.

Data Structures and Algorithms are specifically mentioned.

Students preparing for this role should therefore be comfortable with topics such as:

  • Arrays
  • Strings
  • Linked Lists
  • Stacks
  • Queues
  • Hash Tables
  • Trees
  • Graphs
  • Sorting
  • Searching
  • Recursion
  • Basic Dynamic Programming
  • Time and Space Complexity

Understanding how to choose an appropriate data structure and explain the complexity of a solution can be useful during technical interviews.

Skills to Prepare for Microsoft Software Engineering Internship

Students planning to apply should focus on both programming and Computer Science fundamentals.

1. Data Structures and Algorithms

Practice solving coding problems using an object-oriented language.

Important areas include:

  • Array and string manipulation
  • Hashing
  • Two pointers
  • Sliding window
  • Binary search
  • Linked lists
  • Trees
  • Graph traversal
  • Heaps
  • Sorting
  • Recursion
  • Backtracking
  • Basic dynamic programming

2. Object-Oriented Programming

Revise:

  • Classes and objects
  • Constructors
  • Encapsulation
  • Inheritance
  • Polymorphism
  • Abstraction
  • Interfaces
  • Method overloading
  • Method overriding

You should also be able to write small programs using these concepts.

3. Computer Science Fundamentals

A strong foundation in core subjects can help during technical interviews.

Focus on:

  • Operating Systems
  • DBMS
  • Computer Networks
  • Software Engineering
  • Computer Architecture
  • SQL
  • Basic system design concepts

4. Software Development

Candidates should also understand common development practices, including:

  • Git and GitHub
  • Debugging
  • Testing
  • Version control
  • API basics
  • Clean code
  • Code review
  • Basic software development lifecycle

Microsoft Internship Selection Preparation

Microsoft’s university internship FAQ says candidates can demonstrate their technology interest through internships, student groups, hackathons, projects and other activities. Microsoft also recommends reviewing the job description and using relevant keywords when preparing a resume.

A practical preparation plan can include:

Step 1: Strengthen DSA

Solve coding problems consistently instead of only memorizing solutions.

For every problem, understand:

  • The approach
  • Why it works
  • Time complexity
  • Space complexity
  • Edge cases

Step 2: Revise OOP

Be prepared to explain OOP concepts with simple examples.

Step 3: Build Projects

Projects can demonstrate that you can apply programming concepts outside classroom assignments.

Include:

  • GitHub repository
  • Clear README
  • Technologies used
  • Your contribution
  • Key features
  • Screenshots or demo link where relevant

Step 4: Improve Your Resume

Keep the resume focused on skills relevant to the role.

Useful sections include:

  • Education
  • Technical Skills
  • Projects
  • Experience
  • Certifications
  • Achievements
  • Competitive programming, if applicable

Avoid listing technologies without evidence. Connect important skills to projects or experience wherever possible.

Who Can Apply?

The position is intended for students pursuing a bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field.

The job also requires:

  • At least one year of programming experience in an object-oriented language.
  • At least one semester or term remaining after the internship.
  • Understanding of Computer Science fundamentals is preferred.
  • Data Structures and Algorithms knowledge is preferred.

Microsoft’s India internship eligibility page currently describes university interns as students in the pre-final year of graduation, including third-year bachelor’s students and first-year master’s students, with one additional calendar year remaining after the internship.

Microsoft Software Engineering Intern 2026 Application Process

Interested candidates can apply through Microsoft’s official careers portal.

The application generally requires candidates to provide information such as:

  • Personal details
  • Educational background
  • Resume
  • Technical experience
  • Projects
  • Relevant skills

Applicants should make sure their resume accurately reflects their programming experience and academic status.

Microsoft also recommends applying only to locations where you are interested in working and checking the specific requirements listed on the job posting.

How to Apply for Microsoft Software Engineering Intern 2026

Candidates can apply online through the official Microsoft Careers application page.

Application link:

Apply for Microsoft Software Engineering Intern

Job page:

View Microsoft Software Engineering Intern Job

Candidates should verify the current status, location and eligibility requirements on the official listing before submitting an application.

Microsoft Internship Experience

Microsoft describes its university internships as opportunities to work on real-world projects with teams across the company. The broader internship program includes mentorship, career development, community events and opportunities to collaborate with other interns.

Microsoft also says interns can participate in innovation activities such as hackathons and connect with employees through community and career-development programs.

Resume Tips for This Internship

Your resume should make the required qualifications easy to find.

For example, instead of writing:

“Knowledge of programming languages.”

Use specific information such as:

“Developed projects using Java and Python with object-oriented programming principles.”

For DSA, you can mention:

“Practiced Data Structures and Algorithms including arrays, trees, graphs, hashing and binary search.”

For projects, focus on what you built and what you contributed.

A good project entry can include:

  • Project name
  • Technology stack
  • Problem solved
  • Major features
  • Your contribution
  • GitHub or live demo

Important Things to Check Before Applying

Before submitting your application, verify:

  • You are currently enrolled in an eligible degree program.
  • Your degree is related to Computer Science, Engineering or another relevant field.
  • You have at least one year of programming experience in an object-oriented language.
  • You meet Microsoft’s academic-year requirement.
  • You will have the required academic time remaining after the internship.
  • Your resume accurately represents your skills.
  • You can work at the listed on-site location.
  • Your application information is complete.

Frequently Asked Questions

Is the Microsoft Software Engineering Intern position open in India?

Yes. The job listing identifies India as the location and mentions multiple locations.

What degree is required?

Candidates must currently pursue a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field.

Is DSA required?

The job description lists Computer Science fundamentals, including Data Structures and Algorithms, as a preferred qualification.

Is previous internship experience mandatory?

The listed required qualifications do not specifically require previous internship experience. However, candidates must have at least one year of programming experience in an object-oriented language.

Is the role remote?

The job listing identifies the work site as fully on-site.

How much travel is required?

The listing states that travel is less than 25%.

What programming language should I learn?

The job description does not specify one mandatory programming language. Candidates should be comfortable with at least one object-oriented language and be able to demonstrate programming experience.

When was the job posted?

The job listing shows September 18, 2026, as the posting date.

What is the Microsoft job number?

The job number is 200041085.

Final Takeaway

The Microsoft Software Engineering Intern opening is aimed at students who can demonstrate programming ability, engineering problem-solving and Computer Science fundamentals.

The key requirements are a relevant bachelor’s or master’s degree, at least one year of object-oriented programming experience and the required academic time remaining after the internship. DSA and Computer Science fundamentals are also important preparation areas.

Students should check their academic eligibility carefully and submit their application through Microsoft’s official careers portal while the position remains open.

Apply for the Microsoft Software Engineering Intern role

3. App Builders

title.rendered: AKTU AI Course 2026: IIT Madras Designed Free AI & Machine Learning Course, Registration Link

content.rendered:
Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University (AKTU), Uttar Pradesh, has announced a national AI skilling initiative for students of its affiliated colleges. The initiative offers a 30-hour, self-paced and free online course focused on the fundamentals of Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning and Python.

According to the AKTU notice dated September 22, 2026, the programme is being promoted under the Confederation of Indian Industry (CII) initiative, “Dreams Unlocked: Building an AI-Ready India – Skilling the Youth on AI.” AKTU is participating in the programme through an MoU with CII.

The course has been curated by experts from IIT Madras and is being offered by the CII Centre for AI India in collaboration with HP. The programme is supported by the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY) and the India AI Impact Summit 2026.

AKTU AI Course 2026: Overview

The above details are based on the official AKTU circular issued on September 22, 2026.

What Is the AKTU AI and Machine Learning Course?

The programme is a foundational AI and Machine Learning course designed to give students practical exposure to important areas of AI, ML, Python and data analysis.

AKTU has asked its affiliated institutions to circulate information about the initiative among students and encourage participation. The university has also requested institutions to facilitate student registration at the earliest.

The course is delivered through an LMS platform and has a duration of 30 hours. Students can complete it in a self-paced format. The official notice states that the course is free of cost.

Topics Covered in the AKTU AI Course

The programme covers several foundational and practical areas related to Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning.

1. Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning Foundations

Students will learn the fundamentals of:

  • Artificial Intelligence
  • Machine Learning
  • Python Programming

These topics provide the foundation for further study in AI and Machine Learning.

2. Data Analysis Using NumPy and Pandas

The course also includes data analysis using:

  • NumPy
  • Pandas

These Python libraries are widely used for working with and analysing datasets. The inclusion of these topics gives students practical exposure to basic data-handling workflows.

3. Exploratory Data Analysis and Data Visualisation

Students will also study Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA) and data visualisation.

The course outline specifically lists EDA and Data Visualisation as part of the programme.

4. Machine Learning Techniques

The programme covers several important Machine Learning techniques, including:

  • Regression
  • Classification
  • Clustering

These topics introduce students to different approaches used in Machine Learning.

5. Generative AI and Prompt Engineering

The course also includes newer AI topics such as:

  • Generative AI
  • Prompt Engineering
  • AI-assisted Coding

This gives the programme coverage across both foundational Machine Learning and newer generative AI applications.

6. Practical Exercises and Assessments

The programme includes practical exercises, case studies and assessments. This means the course is not limited to theoretical concepts and includes practical learning activities.

AKTU AI Course 2026 Credit Details

Is the AKTU AI Course Free?

How to Register for AKTU AI Course 2026?

Why AKTU Students Should Know About This Course

The course covers a combination of Python, data analysis, Machine Learning and Generative AI. The official curriculum includes both foundational concepts and practical exercises.

title.rendered: JioStar Software Development Engineer I: Frontend Job, Eligibility, Skills and Application

content.rendered:
JioStar has opened a Software Development Engineer I opportunity for frontend developers in Bengaluru. The position is designed for candidates with 0–2 years of professional frontend development experience and focuses on building user-facing experiences for JioHotstar across web and TV applications.

The role is part of JioStar’s Viewer Experience organization, where engineering teams work on areas such as search, personalization, watch experience, and interactive features.

Candidates with a Computer Science or related degree, strong JavaScript skills, frontend framework knowledge, browser fundamentals, and Git experience can consider this opportunity.

JioStar Software Development Engineer I Job Details

About JioStar

JioStar is a media and entertainment company that operates across content, television, streaming, and technology.

The Software Development Engineer I position is part of the Viewer Experience organization. According to the provided job description, the organization works on products and features that influence how users discover and consume content on JioHotstar.

The engineering teams work across areas including:

  • Search
  • Personalization
  • Watch Experience
  • Interactivity
  • User-facing platform experiences

The role provides an opportunity for an early-career frontend developer to work on products used at large scale.

JioStar Software Development Engineer I Role

The Software Development Engineer I position focuses on frontend engineering for JioHotstar’s website and TV applications.

The selected candidate will be involved in developing user-facing features, implementing UI/UX designs, improving application performance, and building reusable frontend components.

The role also requires collaboration with product and other technical teams to convert product requirements and designs into working features.

The position reports to an Engineering Manager.

JioStar SDE I Eligibility Criteria

Candidates should meet the following requirements mentioned in the job description:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science or a related field.
  • 0–2 years of professional experience as a frontend developer.
  • Hands-on experience with JavaScript.
  • Understanding of browser fundamentals.
  • Knowledge of at least one frontend framework such as React or AngularJS.
  • Understanding of design and architecture patterns.
  • Familiarity with Git and version control.
  • Knowledge of frontend development and build tools.

The provided job description does not mention a specific graduation year, minimum CGPA, percentage requirement, or eligible batch.

Skills Required for JioStar SDE I

1. JavaScript

JavaScript is one of the main technical requirements for this position.

Candidates should be comfortable with JavaScript fundamentals and practical frontend development. Preparation should include topics such as functions, objects, arrays, asynchronous JavaScript, DOM concepts, events, promises, and modern JavaScript features.

2. Browser Fundamentals

The role expects a strong understanding of how browsers work.

Candidates should understand concepts related to rendering, browser execution, performance, compatibility, and the interaction between frontend code and the browser.

3. React or AngularJS

The job description mentions frontend frameworks such as React and AngularJS.

Candidates should understand why frontend frameworks are used and how they help developers build maintainable and reusable user interfaces.

For React-focused preparation, candidates can revise:

  • Components
  • Props and state
  • Hooks
  • Event handling
  • Conditional rendering
  • Component reusability
  • API integration
  • Performance basics

4. Design and Architecture

The position requires an understanding of design and architecture patterns.

Developers should be able to structure frontend applications in a way that keeps the code reusable, maintainable, and easier to extend.

The role also involves contributing to reusable libraries and an in-house design system.

5. Git and Version Control

Git proficiency is mentioned in the requirements.

Candidates should be familiar with common Git workflows, including:

  • Creating branches
  • Committing changes
  • Pulling and pushing code
  • Merging branches
  • Resolving conflicts
  • Reviewing code changes

6. Frontend Build Tools

The job description also mentions frontend build tools such as Grunt and Gulp.

Candidates should have a basic understanding of how frontend build processes automate tasks and prepare applications for development and production environments.

Responsibilities

The selected Software Development Engineer I will work on frontend features and technical solutions for JioHotstar.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Developing end-to-end frontend features.
  • Building user-facing experiences for web and TV applications.
  • Implementing UI/UX designs.
  • Evaluating the technical feasibility of designs.
  • Maintaining application performance.
  • Supporting accessibility requirements.
  • Ensuring cross-browser compatibility.
  • Building reusable frontend components.
  • Developing cross-functional libraries.
  • Contributing to the in-house design system.
  • Writing clean and maintainable code.
  • Following frontend development best practices.
  • Participating in code reviews.
  • Creating technical documentation and DFDs.
  • Adding meaningful code comments where required.
  • Working with product stakeholders and other teams.

What Should You Prepare for This JioStar Job?

If you are preparing for the Software Development Engineer I position, focus your preparation on the technologies and concepts mentioned in the job description.

JavaScript

Revise:

  • Variables and data types
  • Functions
  • Scope and closures
  • Arrays and objects
  • ES6+ features
  • Promises
  • Async/await
  • Event loop
  • DOM manipulation
  • Event handling

Browser Concepts

Prepare:

  • Browser rendering
  • DOM and CSSOM
  • HTTP basics
  • Caching
  • Web performance
  • Browser storage
  • Cross-browser compatibility

Frontend Framework

Revise the fundamentals of the framework you know, particularly React or AngularJS.

Focus on building reusable components and understanding how data flows through a frontend application.

Git

Be comfortable with everyday Git commands and collaborative development workflows.

Frontend Architecture

Understand:

  • Component-based architecture
  • Reusable components
  • Design patterns
  • Code organization
  • Separation of concerns
  • Maintainability
  • Frontend performance

Accessibility and Compatibility

You should also understand basic accessibility practices and how frontend applications can behave consistently across different browsers and devices.

JioStar Software Development Engineer I Work Location

The position is based in Bengaluru, with the provided listing specifying We Work as the work location.

The provided job description does not specify whether the position is remote, hybrid, or fully office-based.

JioStar SDE I Job Requisition ID

The job requisition ID for this position is:

JR12321

Candidates should use the official JioStar job listing when checking the current status of the position and submitting an application.

How to Apply for JioStar Software Development Engineer I?

Interested candidates can apply through the official JioStar careers application page for the Software Development Engineer I position.

Apply for JioStar Software Development Engineer I

Before applying, candidates should review the job requirements and ensure that their resume clearly highlights relevant JavaScript, frontend development, framework, Git, and project experience.

Resume Tips for JioStar SDE I

For an entry-level frontend position, your resume should make your technical skills easy to identify.

Consider highlighting:

  • JavaScript projects
  • React or Angular projects
  • Frontend development experience
  • Git and GitHub projects
  • Responsive web applications
  • API integration
  • Performance optimization
  • Reusable components
  • Relevant Computer Science coursework

If you have completed frontend projects, describe what you built and the technical problems you solved rather than only listing the technologies.

Frequently Asked Questions

What is the JioStar Software Development Engineer I role?

It is a frontend engineering position focused on developing user-facing experiences for JioHotstar’s website and TV applications.

Who can apply for the JioStar SDE I position?

The provided job description specifies candidates with 0–2 years of professional frontend development experience and a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science or a related field.

What programming language is required?

JavaScript is specifically mentioned as a key requirement.

Does JioStar require React experience?

The job description mentions frontend frameworks such as React and AngularJS. Candidates should have knowledge of a suitable frontend framework.

Is Git required?

Yes. Proficiency with version control tools such as Git is included in the listed requirements.

What is the JioStar SDE I location?

The position is based at We Work in Bengaluru.

Does the job listing mention a specific CGPA requirement?

No. The provided job description does not mention a minimum CGPA or percentage requirement.

Does the listing mention a specific graduation year?

No. A specific graduation year or eligible batch is not mentioned in the provided job details.

What is the JioStar job requisition ID?

The requisition ID is JR12321.

How can I apply for this job?

You can apply through the official JioStar application page linked above.

Final Details

JioStar Software Development Engineer I is a frontend development opportunity for early-career engineers interested in JavaScript, browser technologies, frontend frameworks, and large-scale user-facing applications.

Candidates preparing for the role should focus on JavaScript fundamentals, browser concepts, React or AngularJS, Git, frontend architecture, accessibility, performance, and cross-browser compatibility.
