title.rendered: Ghaziabad Colleges & Schools Closed from August 4 to August 12, 2026: Universities & Technical Institutes Holiday Announced | Official DIOS Order

content.rendered:
Students studying in colleges, universities, and technical institutions across Ghaziabad have an important update. The District Inspector of Schools (DIOS), Ghaziabad, has officially announced that all higher educational institutions in the district will remain closed from August 4, 2026, to August 12, 2026 due to the Kanwar Yatra and Shravan Shivratri.

The order has been issued following directions from the District Magistrate, Ghaziabad, to ensure the safety of students and facilitate smooth traffic management during one of North India’s largest religious pilgrimages.

However, the notification also includes an important clarification for students appearing in examinations. Colleges and universities where examinations had already been officially scheduled before the issuance of the order will continue to conduct those exams as per the existing timetable.

If you are a college or university student in Ghaziabad, here is everything you need to know about the latest holiday announcement.

sources :

Ghaziabad College Holiday 2026: What Does the Official Order Say?

According to the office order issued on August 3, 2026, all higher educational institutions operating within Ghaziabad district will remain closed for nine days.

The administration has taken this decision because thousands of Kanwariyas are expected to travel through Ghaziabad during the holy month of Shravan. Large-scale traffic diversions, security arrangements, and public gatherings make normal academic operations difficult during this period.

The administration believes that temporarily suspending classes is the best way to ensure student safety and reduce travel-related inconvenience.

Holiday Dates

Students are advised to check with their respective institutions regarding reopening after the holiday period.

Which Institutions Will Remain Closed?

The official notification applies to almost every category of higher educational institution operating within Ghaziabad district.

These include:

  • Government Colleges
  • Private Colleges
  • State Universities
  • Private Universities
  • Engineering Colleges
  • Polytechnic Colleges
  • Government Technical Institutes
  • Private Technical Institutes
  • Professional Educational Institutions

All regular academic activities, including classroom lectures, practical sessions, seminars, workshops, and campus events, will remain suspended during the notified period.

Examination Exception: Important Relief for Students

One of the most important points mentioned in the official order concerns university and college examinations.

The notification clearly states that institutions where examination schedules had already been announced before the holiday order will not cancel those examinations.

Instead, such institutions are permitted to conduct examinations according to the previously published timetable.

This means students should not assume that every examination has been postponed.

If your university has already released its examination schedule, you should continue preparing and regularly check official announcements issued by your institution.

Why Has the District Administration Declared This Holiday?

The annual Kanwar Yatra witnesses lakhs of devotees travelling across Uttar Pradesh carrying holy water from sacred rivers to Lord Shiva temples.

Ghaziabad is one of the major districts through which Kanwariyas pass every year. As a result, authorities implement extensive security and traffic management measures.

During this period:

  • Major roads witness heavy traffic congestion.
  • Several routes remain diverted.
  • Public gatherings increase significantly.
  • Police and administrative officials remain deployed across the district.

Considering these circumstances, the administration has decided to suspend regular academic activities for a limited period.

Student Safety Is the Top Priority

The primary objective behind the closure is student safety.

Thousands of students commute daily from different parts of Ghaziabad and nearby districts. Due to traffic diversions and heavy pedestrian movement during the Kanwar Yatra, reaching educational institutions becomes difficult.

By temporarily closing colleges and universities, the administration aims to:

  • Ensure student safety.
  • Prevent unnecessary travel.
  • Reduce traffic congestion.
  • Support smooth religious processions.
  • Assist law enforcement agencies in maintaining public order.

What Should College Students Do Now?

Students should avoid depending on unofficial social media posts and instead follow verified updates issued by their institutions.

Here are a few important suggestions:

  • Visit your university’s official website regularly.
  • Check examination notifications daily.
  • Stay connected with your college administration.
  • Follow official student portals.
  • Confirm reopening dates before visiting campus.
  • Continue preparing if examinations are scheduled.

Being informed through official channels will help avoid confusion during the holiday period.

also read : UP Scholarship 2026-27 Time Table Released: Government Issues Official Schedule for Post Matric Scholarship & Fee Reimbursement | AKTU Issues Important Notice

Will Online Classes Continue?

The office order specifically mentions the closure of educational institutions but does not provide any instruction regarding online classes.

Individual colleges and universities may decide independently whether online lectures or virtual academic sessions will continue.

Students should wait for official communication from their institutions before making any assumptions.

When Will Colleges Reopen?

As per the current notification, colleges, universities, and technical institutions are expected to resume normal academic activities after August 12, 2026.

If the district administration issues any fresh notification regarding an extension of holidays or revised schedules, institutions will inform students through official communication channels.

Highlights of the Official Order

  • Colleges, universities, and technical institutes closed from August 4 to August 12, 2026
  • Applicable to both government and private institutions
  • Holiday announced due to Kanwar Yatra and Shravan Shivratri
  • Student safety cited as the primary reason
  • Previously scheduled examinations will continue as per timetable
  • Order issued by the District Inspector of Schools (DIOS), Ghaziabad

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

Are colleges closed in Ghaziabad from August 4 to August 12, 2026?

Yes. The DIOS Ghaziabad has officially announced that colleges, universities, and technical institutions will remain closed during this period.

Will university examinations be postponed?

Not necessarily. If examinations were officially scheduled before the order was issued, they will continue according to the previously announced timetable.

Does the order apply to private colleges?

Yes. The notification applies to both government and private colleges, universities, and technical institutions located in Ghaziabad.

Can students visit campus during the holiday?

Students should visit campus only if they have an officially scheduled examination or receive specific instructions from their institution.

Why has this holiday been announced?

The holiday has been declared due to the Kanwar Yatra and Shravan Shivratri celebrations, considering heavy traffic movement and public safety arrangements across the district.

Final Words

The Ghaziabad district administration has taken a precautionary step by announcing the closure of colleges, universities, and technical institutions from August 4 to August 12, 2026. The decision aims to ensure student safety and support the smooth management of the Kanwar Yatra.

Students should remember that the holiday does not automatically cancel examinations. If your university or college has already issued an examination schedule, the exams are expected to be conducted as planned unless a separate notification is released.

For the latest updates, students are advised to follow the official website and notice board of their respective college or university.

title.rendered: UP Scholarship 2026-27 Time Table Released: Government Issues Official Schedule for Post Matric Scholarship & Fee Reimbursement | AKTU Issues Important Notice

content.rendered:
The Government of Uttar Pradesh has officially released the Post Matric Scholarship 2026-27 Government Order, announcing the complete timeline for the implementation of the scholarship and fee reimbursement process for the academic session 2026-27. The notification covers students belonging to Scheduled Castes (SC), Scheduled Tribes (ST), Other Backward Classes (OBC), General Category, and Minority Communities who are pursuing higher education in recognized institutions across Uttar Pradesh.

Following the state government’s decision, Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University (AKTU), Lucknow, has also issued an official circular directing all affiliated colleges and institutions to complete the Master Data preparation, verification, and digital locking process within the prescribed schedule. The university has instructed institutions to submit all necessary documents on time to avoid delays in scholarship processing.

This notification is particularly important for students enrolled in B.Tech, B.Pharm, MBA, MCA, BBA, BCA, B.Arch, M.Tech, Polytechnic, Pharmacy, Management, Medical, and other higher education courses. Every year, lakhs of students depend on the Post Matric Scholarship Scheme to receive financial assistance in the form of Educational Allowance (Scholarship) and Fee Reimbursement, making this Government Order one of the most significant announcements of the academic session.

also read :

Government Releases Official Scholarship Schedule for 2026-27

To ensure that the scholarship process is completed in a transparent and time-bound manner, the Uttar Pradesh Government has published a detailed activity-wise schedule covering every stage of implementation. Unlike previous years, the Government Order clearly defines the responsibilities of educational institutions, universities, district welfare departments, and other authorities involved in the scholarship process.

The schedule begins with the preparation of the Master Database of educational institutions, followed by verification at multiple levels, online scholarship applications by students, document verification, PFMS validation, approval of eligible applications, and finally the transfer of scholarship and fee reimbursement through the Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) system.

AKTU Issues Instructions to All Affiliated Institutions

After the Government Order was issued, AKTU circulated the notification to all affiliated colleges and instructed them to begin the Master Data process immediately.

According to the University’s circular, every affiliated institution must update its Master Data by entering accurate information related to:

  • Approved courses
  • Course type
  • Number of sanctioned seats
  • Approved fee structure
  • Affiliated university details

Once the information has been updated, institutions must verify the data through a Digital Signature and complete the digital locking process within the prescribed timeline.

AKTU has also instructed colleges to submit supporting documents such as the University Affiliation Letter and the Fee Regulatory Committee Approval Letter. If an institution fails to submit the approved fee documents, the University has clarified that the general fee prescribed by the Fee Regulatory Committee will be locked automatically, and any responsibility arising from incorrect fee details will rest with the concerned institution.

Course-wise Documents Required by AKTU

Educational institutions have been instructed to submit affiliation and fee approval documents for the following courses:

The University has advised institutions to submit these documents on time so that the Master Data verification and locking process can be completed without interruption.

Master Data Schedule for UP Scholarship 2026-27

The first phase of the scholarship process is the preparation and verification of the Master Database.

1. Master Data Preparation

Schedule: 22 July 2026 to 15 August 2026

During this period, educational institutions are required to prepare and update their Master Data.

This includes:

  • Registration of newly established institutions.
  • Updating existing institutional information.
  • Adding course details.
  • Updating course categories.
  • Entering the number of approved seats.
  • Updating the approved fee structure.
  • Mentioning the affiliated university.
  • Digitally certifying all information.

New institutions located within Uttar Pradesh must complete the registration process through the concerned University or Affiliated Agency, while eligible institutions located outside the state must follow the procedure prescribed by the designated nodal authority.

2. University Verification

Schedule: 23 July 2026 to 30 August 2026

The concerned University or Affiliated Agency will verify the information submitted by educational institutions.

The verification process includes:

  • Institution details
  • Course information
  • Course category
  • Seat capacity
  • Fee structure

All details will be verified online using Digital Signature before the Master Data proceeds to the next stage.

3. District Welfare Verification

Schedule: 25 July 2026 to 14 September 2026

District Social Welfare Officers will verify:

  • Institution information
  • Course details
  • Course category
  • Seat availability
  • Approved fees

After verification, the Master Data will be digitally locked.

For Government, Government-aided, and private institutions where fees are regulated by the competent authority, fee locking will be completed within the limits approved by the University.

4. NSP Marking for Minority Institutions

The Government Order also includes a separate activity for Minority educational institutions.

Private institutions already registered on the National Scholarship Portal (NSP) will be marked on the State Scholarship Portal by the District Minority Welfare Officer, enabling eligible Minority students to apply through the correct scholarship channel.

Scholarship Process After Master Data

After the completion of Master Data verification, the scholarship process will continue through the following stages:

  • Fresh Student Registration
  • Renewal Registration
  • Online Scholarship Application
  • Institution Verification
  • Aadhaar Authentication
  • PFMS Validation
  • Correction Window
  • District Level Verification
  • Final Approval
  • Scholarship Sanction
  • Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT)

Each activity has been assigned a separate timeline to ensure that scholarship payments reach eligible students without unnecessary delays.

Who Can Apply?

The Post Matric Scholarship Scheme is applicable to eligible students belonging to:

  • Scheduled Castes (SC)
  • Scheduled Tribes (ST)
  • Other Backward Classes (OBC)
  • General Category
  • Minority Communities

The scheme covers students studying in Government institutions, Government-aided colleges, private colleges, and eligible recognized institutions outside Uttar Pradesh under the applicable scholarship rules.

Why This Government Order Is Important

The release of the official schedule ensures that every stage of the scholarship process is completed within a fixed timeline. In previous years, delays in Master Data preparation, incorrect fee entries, and pending institutional verification affected the timely release of scholarships. By assigning clear responsibilities to universities, educational institutions, and district welfare departments, the Government aims to improve transparency, reduce processing delays, and ensure that eligible students receive their scholarship and fee reimbursement on time.

Important Advice for Students

Although the current notification mainly outlines the responsibilities of educational institutions and government authorities, students should also remain prepared.

Students should:

  • Stay in regular contact with their college scholarship cell.
  • Confirm that their institution has completed the Master Data process.
  • Ensure their Aadhaar is linked to their bank account.
  • Keep income certificate, caste certificate, domicile certificate, previous marksheets, and fee receipts ready.
  • Submit scholarship applications within the official schedule once registrations begin.
  • Regularly check the scholarship portal for updates and correction notices.

Being proactive during the application process can help avoid delays in scholarship approval and payment.

Conclusion

The UP Post Matric Scholarship 2026-27 Government Order marks the official beginning of the scholarship process for the new academic session. The notification provides a well-defined timeline for Master Data preparation, university verification, district-level scrutiny, and the subsequent stages leading to scholarship disbursement. AKTU has also instructed all affiliated institutions to complete the required formalities within the stipulated period and submit all necessary documents to facilitate smooth implementation of the scheme.

Educational institutions should strictly follow the official directions, while students should remain updated through their colleges and the scholarship portal. Timely completion of each stage will play a crucial role in ensuring that eligible students receive their Educational Allowance and Fee Reimbursement without unnecessary delays.

title.rendered: Amazon Recruitment 2026 for Freshers: Software Development Engineer I (SDE I) | Apply Online

content.rendered:
Amazon has officially opened applications for its Software Development Engineer I (SDE I) role under the University Talent Acquisition Program. This recruitment drive is specially designed for 2025 and 2026 graduates who are passionate about software development and want to kick-start their careers with one of the world’s most innovative technology companies.

If you have strong programming skills, excellent problem-solving abilities, and a solid understanding of computer science fundamentals, this is a golden opportunity to join Amazon and work on products used by millions of customers worldwide.

Amazon Recruitment 2026 – Overview

About Amazon

Amazon is one of the world’s largest technology companies, known for its customer-centric culture and continuous innovation. Every day, Amazon engineers solve complex technical problems, build scalable cloud applications, and create products that serve millions of users across the globe.

As a Software Development Engineer, you’ll work alongside experienced Amazonians, contribute to large-scale distributed systems, and develop innovative solutions that make a real impact.

Eligibility Criteria

To apply for the Amazon Software Development Engineer I role, candidates must:

  • Be a 2025 or 2026 graduate.
  • Hold a Bachelor’s degree in:
    • Computer Science
    • Computer Engineering
    • Information Technology
    • Or a related technical discipline.
  • Have a strong understanding of:
    • Data Structures
    • Algorithms
    • Object-Oriented Programming (OOP)
    • Complexity Analysis
    • Problem Solving
  • Be proficient in at least one programming language such as:
    • Java
    • Python
    • C++
    • Perl

Preferred Qualifications

Although not mandatory, the following qualifications will strengthen your profile:

  • Previous internship experience.
  • Knowledge of distributed systems.
  • Experience with relational databases.
  • Understanding of scalable software architecture.
  • Familiarity with optimization techniques.
  • Excellent communication and analytical skills.
  • Ability to solve ambiguous and complex technical challenges.

Roles and Responsibilities

As an Amazon Software Development Engineer, your responsibilities will include:

  • Collaborating with experienced engineers to build innovative products and services.
  • Designing scalable and distributed software systems.
  • Developing high-performance cloud-based applications.
  • Building fault-tolerant storage, indexing, and query-processing systems.
  • Writing clean, efficient, and maintainable code.
  • Participating in Agile software development practices.
  • Solving challenging technical problems using innovative approaches.
  • Delivering reliable software that impacts millions of Amazon customers.

Required Technical Skills

Candidates should have knowledge of:

  • Data Structures & Algorithms
  • Java / Python / C++ / Perl
  • Object-Oriented Programming
  • Database Management Systems
  • Operating Systems
  • Computer Networks
  • Software Development Life Cycle
  • Problem Solving & Logical Thinking

Why Join Amazon?

Joining Amazon offers numerous career advantages, including:

  • Work on products used by millions of customers worldwide.
  • Learn from some of the best software engineers in the industry.
  • Exposure to cloud computing and distributed systems.
  • Competitive salary and attractive employee benefits.
  • Continuous learning and career development opportunities.
  • Inclusive and innovation-driven workplace.
  • Opportunity to work with cutting-edge technologies.

Amazon Selection Process

The recruitment process generally includes the following stages:

  1. Online Application
  2. Online Assessment
  3. Technical Coding Interview(s)
  4. System Design/Technical Discussion (where applicable)
  5. HR Interview
  6. Final Offer

The exact hiring process may vary depending on the business team’s requirements.

How to Apply for Amazon Recruitment 2026?

Interested and eligible candidates can apply online through the official Amazon Jobs portal.

Apply Link: CLICK HERE

Since Amazon reviews applications on a rolling basis, candidates are strongly advised to submit their applications as early as possible.

Preparation Tips

To improve your chances of getting selected:

  • Practice Data Structures and Algorithms regularly.
  • Solve coding problems on platforms like LeetCode and HackerRank.
  • Strengthen Object-Oriented Programming concepts.

Why This Opportunity is Worth Applying For

Amazon’s Software Development Engineer I program provides fresh graduates with an excellent platform to learn, innovate, and grow. Whether you’re passionate about backend systems, distributed computing, cloud technologies, or software engineering, this role offers unmatched learning opportunities and long-term career growth.

Conclusion

The Amazon Recruitment 2026 for Freshers is one of the most sought-after off-campus hiring opportunities for engineering graduates. If you’re graduating in 2025 or 2026 and have a strong foundation in programming and computer science fundamentals, don’t miss this chance to join Amazon.

Apply today and take the first step toward building an exciting software engineering career with one of the world’s leading technology companies.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

1. Who can apply for Amazon Recruitment 2026?

IBM SkillsBuild Academic Internship 2026 Overview

About IBM SkillsBuild Academic Internship 2026

The IBM SkillsBuild Academic Internship – Data Analytics with AI is a structured experiential learning program that introduces students to the practical applications of Artificial Intelligence in Data Analytics.

Unlike traditional online courses, this internship combines expert guidance, self-paced learning, and project-based training to provide a complete industry learning experience. Students will learn how organizations collect, analyze, and interpret data to make strategic business decisions while exploring AI-powered analytical techniques used in modern workplaces.

The internship focuses on developing practical skills that are directly relevant to today’s technology and business environments.

What You Will Learn

  • Fundamentals of Data Analytics
  • Artificial Intelligence Applications
  • Business Intelligence Concepts
  • Data-Driven Decision Making
  • Analytics Workflows
  • AI Strategy Frameworks
  • Real-World Problem Solving
  • Business Case Analysis
  • Project Development and Presentation

The curriculum is designed to help students confidently apply AI and analytics concepts in real business scenarios.

IBM Internship Program Structure

The internship consists of 60 hours of structured learning divided into three major components.

1. Expert-Led Masterclasses (16 Hours)

Students will participate in live sessions conducted by industry professionals covering:

  • AI Strategy
  • Data Analytics Tools
  • Business Intelligence
  • Decision-Making Frameworks
  • Industry Use Cases

These sessions provide practical insights into how organizations use AI and analytics in everyday operations.

2. IBM SkillsBuild Self-Paced Learning (14 Hours)

Participants will complete carefully curated IBM SkillsBuild learning modules at their own pace.

The self-learning courses cover:

  • Artificial Intelligence Fundamentals
  • Data Analytics Basics
  • AI Applications
  • Business Analytics
  • Modern Analytics Techniques

Students can complete these modules anytime during the internship period.

3. Real-World Capstone Project (30 Hours)

The capstone project is the most important component of the internship.

Students will work on business scenarios where they will:

  • Analyze real datasets
  • Develop AI-powered business solutions
  • Apply analytical thinking
  • Present strategic recommendations

This practical experience helps students build industry-ready skills and strengthens their project portfolio.

Internship Highlights

Participants will receive access to multiple learning activities throughout the internship.

Highlights include:

  • Orientation Session
  • Four Live Expert Masterclasses
  • IBM SkillsBuild Learning Platform
  • One Doubt-Clearing Session
  • One Project QA Session
  • Dedicated Mentorship Session
  • AI-Based Business Strategy Project
  • Capstone Project
  • Certificate of Completion

The internship emphasizes practical learning rather than only theoretical concepts.

Benefits of IBM SkillsBuild Academic Internship

Students selected for the internship will receive several valuable benefits.

These include:

  • Free registration
  • No application fee
  • Industry-led live sessions
  • IBM SkillsBuild access
  • Mentor support
  • Practical project experience
  • AI-focused learning
  • Resume enhancement
  • Professional certificate
  • 6 academic credits
  • Industry exposure

Eligibility Criteria

  • Belong to any academic stream

Students from Engineering, Science, Commerce, Management, Arts, Diploma, and other disciplines are eligible.

Terms of Engagement

title.rendered: AKTU Launches Online Student Grievance Portal 2026: Students Can Now Submit Exam-Related Complaints Online from August 4

content.rendered:
Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University (AKTU), Lucknow, has announced the launch of the AKTU Online Student Grievance Portal 2026, a new digital platform designed to simplify the process of submitting examination-related complaints. According to the official notification, the portal will become operational from 4 August 2026, allowing students and alumni to register grievances online through the university’s ERP Student Services portal.

The introduction of this portal is an important step towards improving transparency and efficiency in student services. Earlier, students often had to submit offline applications or visit university offices to resolve issues related to examination results, marksheets, degree certificates, or mark updates. With this new online system, eligible users can now submit complaints from anywhere and track their progress digitally.

If you are searching for AKTU Online Student Grievance Portal 2026, AKTU Grievance Portal, AKTU Result Correction, or AKTU Latest Notification, this article provides all the essential details based on the official university notification.

AKTU Online Student Grievance Portal 2026 Highlights

What is the AKTU Online Student Grievance Portal?

The AKTU Online Student Grievance Portal is a centralized online platform developed by the university for handling examination-related complaints. The portal allows eligible students and alumni to submit grievances digitally instead of using traditional offline methods.

According to the notification, the university intends to provide a transparent and time-bound grievance redressal mechanism by forwarding complaints directly to the concerned department through the portal. Students will also be able to track the status of their complaints online using a unique Grievance ID generated after submission.

AKTU Grievance Portal Launch Date

AKTU has officially announced that the Online Student Grievance Portal will become operational from 4 August 2026.

Students are advised to use the portal for eligible examination-related grievances after the portal becomes active.

Official AKTU Student Grievance Portal

The official notification provides the following ERP Student Services portal for submitting grievances:

CLICK HERE

Students should always use the official university portal mentioned in the notification.

Who Can Use the AKTU Online Student Grievance Portal?

The portal is available for:

  • Students currently studying in AKTU-affiliated colleges.
  • Former students (Alumni) of AKTU-affiliated institutions.

This ensures that both current and former students can access examination-related grievance services through a single online platform.

Types of Complaints Accepted

According to the official notification, students can submit complaints related to:

  • Examination Result
  • Result Correction
  • Marks Update
  • Marksheet Issues
  • Degree Related Problems
  • Other Examination-Related Grievances

These categories cover the most common examination issues faced by students during or after their academic programs.

Key Features of the AKTU Online Student Grievance Portal

Online Complaint Submission

Students can submit examination-related complaints online without visiting university offices.

Unique Grievance ID

Every successful complaint submission generates a Unique Grievance ID, which should be preserved for future reference and tracking.

Online Complaint Tracking

Applicants can monitor the status of their grievance through the portal using their Grievance ID.

Automatic Forwarding

The portal automatically forwards each complaint to the concerned university department for necessary action.

Transparent Process

Students can view updates regarding the progress and resolution of their grievance through the online system.

How to Submit a Complaint

Students can follow these general steps:

  1. Visit the official AKTU ERP Student Grievance Portal.
  2. Fill in the required details correctly.
  3. Select the appropriate grievance category.
  4. Upload the necessary supporting documents.
  5. Submit the complaint.
  6. Save the generated Grievance ID for tracking.

Important Instructions for Students

The university has issued the following important instructions:

  • Enter accurate information while submitting the grievance.
  • Upload clear and readable supporting documents.
  • Submit complaints only through the Online Student Grievance Portal.
  • Ensure that the registered mobile number and email ID on the ERP portal remain active to receive OTPs, passwords, login credentials, and important university notifications.

Benefits of the AKTU Online Student Grievance Portal

The portal offers several advantages to students:

  • Online complaint submission from any location.
  • No need for repeated visits to the university.
  • Faster and more transparent grievance registration.
  • Easy complaint tracking through Grievance ID.
  • Better coordination with the concerned departments.
  • Reduced paperwork.
  • Improved digital student services.

Why This Initiative is Important

The launch of the Online Student Grievance Portal is part of AKTU’s ongoing efforts to strengthen digital governance and improve student-centric services. By moving examination grievance handling to an online platform, the university aims to provide a more organized and transparent system for students and alumni.

While the notification explains the functionality of the portal, it does not specify separate processing times for different grievance categories. Students should therefore refer to updates available on the portal after submitting their complaints.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

When will the AKTU Online Student Grievance Portal start?

The portal will become operational from 4 August 2026.

Who can use the grievance portal?

Current students and alumni of AKTU-affiliated institutions are eligible to use the portal.

What complaints can be submitted?

Students can submit grievances related to examination results, result correction, marks updates, marksheets, degree issues, and other examination-related matters.

Will I receive a tracking number?

Yes. Every complaint receives a Unique Grievance ID that can be used to track the status of the grievance.

Is it necessary to keep my ERP mobile number active?

Yes. The university advises students to keep their registered mobile number and email ID active for OTP verification, login credentials, and important notifications.

Conclusion

The AKTU Online Student Grievance Portal 2026 is an important digital initiative that will make examination-related grievance submission easier for students and alumni. From 4 August 2026, eligible users can submit complaints related to examination results, marksheets, mark updates, degree issues, and other examination matters through the official ERP portal.

Students should carefully fill in all required information, upload clear supporting documents, and preserve their Grievance ID after submission for future tracking. They should also ensure that their ERP-registered mobile number and email ID remain active to receive important university communications.

title.rendered: CodeQuezt #33 Registration Open: Join Naukri Campus’s Free Coding Contest and Earn a Certificate

content.rendered:
If you’re an engineering or undergraduate student preparing for placements, internships, or software engineering roles, here’s an opportunity you shouldn’t miss. Naukri Campus has officially opened registrations for CodeQuezt #33, a free online coding contest designed to help students sharpen their programming skills while competing with peers from across India.

The contest will be held on 22 August and gives participants two hours to solve real-world coding problems similar to those asked in technical hiring rounds. Besides gaining valuable coding experience, every eligible participant will receive a Participation Certificate from Naukri Campus, making it a worthwhile addition to your resume and LinkedIn profile.

With campus recruitment becoming increasingly competitive, coding contests like CodeQuezt provide practical exposure to online assessments used by top IT companies. Whether you’re just beginning your DSA journey or already practicing competitive programming, this challenge offers an excellent platform to test your skills.

What is CodeQuezt #33?

CodeQuezt is Naukri Campus’s flagship coding competition that brings together college students from across India on a single platform. The contest focuses on improving problem-solving ability, logical reasoning, and programming knowledge through carefully designed coding questions.

Unlike traditional academic exams, CodeQuezt emphasizes practical coding skills. Participants solve algorithm-based challenges within a fixed time limit, giving them a real interview-like experience.

The contest is completely online, allowing students to participate from home using their own computers and internet connection.

CodeQuezt #33: Important Dates

Why Every Student Should Participate

Today’s recruiters don’t just look at academic scores—they also evaluate problem-solving ability and coding efficiency. Participating in contests like CodeQuezt helps students prepare for this reality.

Some of the key benefits include:

  • Practice coding under real-time conditions
  • Improve logical thinking and analytical skills
  • Solve placement-oriented programming questions
  • Learn effective time management during coding assessments
  • Build confidence for internship and placement tests
  • Receive a participation certificate from Naukri Campus
  • Gain recognition through the national leaderboard

Whether you’re targeting service-based companies like TCS, Infosys, Wipro, Capgemini, and Accenture or aiming for product-based companies, regular coding practice through contests can significantly improve your performance.

What Type of Questions Can You Expect?

The contest generally includes programming problems that test your understanding of fundamental computer science concepts.

Topics may include:

  • Arrays
  • Strings
  • Searching
  • Sorting
  • Binary Search
  • Hashing
  • Recursion
  • Dynamic Programming
  • Trees
  • Graphs
  • Greedy Algorithms
  • Mathematical Logic

Questions are designed to evaluate both correctness and optimization, encouraging participants to write efficient code.

Contest Evaluation Process

Participants are evaluated based on several factors, including:

  • Correctness of the solution
  • Number of hidden test cases passed
  • Execution speed
  • Time complexity
  • Total time taken to solve the problems

Submitting optimized and accurate solutions within the allotted time is essential for achieving a higher rank.

Eligibility Criteria

The contest is open to:

  • Undergraduate students studying in India
  • Students enrolled in any recognized college or university
  • Candidates from any engineering or degree stream
  • Students interested in improving their coding skills

There is no registration fee, making it accessible to all eligible students.

Rewards and Benefits

Although CodeQuezt primarily focuses on learning and skill development, participants also receive recognition for their efforts.

Benefits include:

  • Participation Certificate from Naukri Campus
  • National-level coding contest experience
  • Improved placement readiness
  • Opportunity to appear on the contest leaderboard
  • Stronger resume and LinkedIn profile

For students applying to internships or fresher roles, participation in coding competitions demonstrates initiative and technical interest.

About Naukri Campus

Naukri Campus is a career-focused initiative by Naukri.com, one of India’s leading employment platforms. It helps students and recent graduates prepare for the job market by offering placement resources, internships, career guidance, skill assessments, and coding competitions.

The platform bridges the gap between students and recruiters by providing opportunities to develop industry-relevant skills before entering the workforce.

How to Register for CodeQuezt #33

Students can register online through the official Naukri Campus contest page.

Official Registration Link

👉 APPLY NOW

Registration Steps

  1. Visit the official contest page.
  2. Sign in or create your Naukri Campus account.
  3. Complete your profile if required.
  4. Click on the Enroll button.
  5. Join the contest before the registration deadline.

Students should log in a few minutes before the contest begins to avoid last-minute technical issues.

Tips to Perform Well in the Contest

Success in coding contests depends on preparation and strategy. Here are a few practical tips:

  • Revise important DSA concepts before the contest.
  • Practice coding problems on platforms like LeetCode, CodeChef, or HackerRank.
  • Solve easier questions first to secure quick points.
  • Carefully read the problem statement before coding.
  • Test your solution with multiple inputs.
  • Avoid unnecessary complexity in your code.
  • Keep track of time throughout the contest.

Even if you are a beginner, participating regularly will improve your coding confidence over time.

Why Coding Competitions Matter for Placements

Most software companies conduct online coding assessments as the first stage of recruitment. These assessments test how efficiently candidates can solve programming problems under time pressure.

Participating in contests like CodeQuezt helps students become familiar with this environment. It also highlights areas where additional practice is needed, making preparation more focused and effective.

Moreover, coding contests reflect your willingness to learn and improve—qualities that recruiters value highly.

Final Thoughts

CodeQuezt #33 is more than just a coding competition. It is a learning opportunity that allows students to evaluate their programming skills, experience real interview-style coding assessments, and prepare for future placement opportunities.

With free registration, a national-level platform, and a participation certificate from Naukri Campus, there is little reason to miss this event. If you’re serious about building a career in software development or simply want to challenge yourself, register before 22 August, 6:55 PM, and get ready to code.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

Is CodeQuezt #33 free to join?

Yes. Participation is completely free for eligible undergraduate students.

Who can participate in the contest?

Any undergraduate student currently enrolled in a recognized college or university in India.

What is the duration of the coding contest?

The contest will run for 2 hours, from 7:00 PM to 9:00 PM on 22 August.

Will participants receive a certificate?

Yes. Eligible participants will receive a Participation Certificate from Naukri Campus.

Is the contest conducted online?

Yes. CodeQuezt #33 is an online coding challenge that students can attend remotely.

When does registration close?

Registrations close on 22 August at 6:55 PM.

title.rendered: AKTU Degree Certificate 2026: Final-Year Students Must Update ERP Address Before 02 August | Official Notice

content.rendered:
Students graduating from Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University (AKTU) during the 2025–26 academic session have been advised to complete an important task before receiving their degree certificate. The university has issued an official notification directing final-year students to verify and update their address details through the Student ERP Portal before 02 August 2026.

The latest advisory has been issued because AKTU has found that many degree certificates sent in previous years could not be delivered successfully due to incorrect or outdated addresses available in the university’s records. To prevent such issues this year, students have been given a limited time to review and update their address details online.

The notification has been issued by the Controller of Examinations and circulated to all Directors and Principals of AKTU-affiliated colleges with instructions to inform eligible students immediately.

AKTU Official Notice: Key Details

Why Has AKTU Issued This Notice?

According to the official notification, AKTU dispatches degree certificates through India Post Speed Post. However, every year a number of certificates are returned because students either shift to a new residence or fail to update their address in the Student ERP database.

To reduce the number of undelivered certificates, the university has activated the address update facility for eligible students. Colleges have also been instructed to ensure that every final-year student is informed about this process before the deadline.

The university believes that maintaining updated student records will help streamline the degree dispatch process and reduce unnecessary delays caused by incorrect postal information.

Who Needs to Update Their Address?

The notification is specifically applicable to students who are completing their programme during the 2025–26 academic session from AKTU-affiliated institutions.

If you are a final-year student and expect to receive your degree certificate from AKTU, you should verify your address details through the Student ERP Portal.

Last Date to Update Address

Students can update or verify their address details until 02 August 2026.

The official notice does not mention any extension. Therefore, students should complete the process well before the deadline to avoid last-minute technical issues.

How to Update Address on the AKTU Student ERP Portal

AKTU has provided an online facility for address verification through the Student ERP Portal.

Students need to:

  1. Log in to the Student ERP Portal.
  2. Open the My Profile section.
  3. Select the Address tab.
  4. Verify both the permanent and correspondence/current address.
  5. Update incorrect or outdated information.
  6. Save the updated details before the deadline.

The university has advised students to carefully check every address field before submitting the changes.

Degree Certificates Will Be Sent Through Speed Post

One of the most important points mentioned in the notification is that degree certificates are dispatched through India Post Speed Post.

If the address available in the ERP system is incorrect or incomplete, there is a possibility that the certificate may not reach the student successfully. This is one of the primary reasons why AKTU has asked students to verify their address before the dispatch process.

Name Correction Is Not Included in This Facility

The address update facility is limited only to address-related information.

Students who notice any error in their English name or father’s name have been instructed to contact the Admission or Enrollment Section of their respective college. Such corrections cannot be made through the ERP address update option.

Colleges Have Also Been Given Instructions

The university has not only informed students but has also directed all affiliated colleges to circulate the notification among eligible candidates.

Directors and Principals have been requested to ensure that final-year students complete the address verification process within the prescribed timeline.

Why This Update Matters

Students often relocate after completing their course for higher studies, competitive examinations, internships, or employment opportunities. If the address stored in the university records is outdated, official documents may be delivered to the wrong location.

Updating your address ensures that the university has the latest information available in its records before dispatching degree certificates.

Although the process requires only a few minutes, it can help avoid delivery-related problems later.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

Who should update their address?

Students completing their final year during the 2025–26 academic session in AKTU-affiliated colleges should verify and update their address.

What is the last date to update the address?

The last date mentioned in the official notification is 02 August 2026.

How will AKTU send the degree certificate?

According to the notification, degree certificates are dispatched through India Post Speed Post.

Can I change my name through the ERP portal?

No. Name-related corrections must be processed through the respective college.

Is this notice applicable to all students?

No. It specifically applies to students completing their programme during the 2025–26 academic session.

Conclusion

AKTU’s latest notification is an important reminder for graduating students to verify their address details before the university begins dispatching degree certificates. Students should log in to the Student ERP Portal, review their permanent and correspondence addresses, and make corrections wherever necessary before 02 August 2026.

As the university has clearly stated, maintaining accurate address records will help ensure smoother delivery of degree certificates through India Post Speed Post. Students are also advised to contact their respective college for any corrections related to their name or other academic records.

title.rendered: Recruit CRM Trainee Software Engineer 2027 Hiring 2026: Remote Opportunity for Freshers | ₹9 LPA Package

content.rendered:
If you’re a computer science student graduating in 2027 and searching for a software engineering opportunity that offers real learning instead of just routine work, Recruit CRM has opened applications for its Trainee Software Engineer – 2027 Hiring Program. The company is inviting fresh graduates to join a structured training journey that begins with an internship and can eventually lead to a full-time Associate Software Engineer role with an annual package of ₹9,00,000.

What makes this opportunity attractive is that it is completely remote, allowing students to work from home while collaborating with experienced engineers on a globally used SaaS product. During the training period, candidates will gain practical exposure to software development, product engineering, artificial intelligence, and machine learning technologies.

For students who want to build a long-term career in software development, this hiring program provides an excellent opportunity to learn from industry professionals while working on real-world products.

About Recruit CRM

Recruit CRM is one of the world’s leading recruitment software companies. Unlike many startups that depend on external funding, Recruit CRM has grown as a fully bootstrapped and consistently profitable SaaS company. The company currently generates more than $11 million in Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) and continues to grow by over 40% every year.

Its recruitment platform is used by more than 2,000 executive search and recruitment firms across over 100 countries. Recruit CRM also has corporate offices in India, the United States, Ireland, and Dubai. Because of its product quality and customer satisfaction, the company has earned top rankings from Gartner along with excellent ratings on platforms like G2 and Capterra.

Joining a company with this level of stability gives fresh graduates an opportunity to learn in a fast-growing environment while contributing to products used by businesses worldwide.

Recruit CRM Trainee Software Engineer 2027 Overview

Training Journey

Recruit CRM has designed this hiring program in three stages so that fresh graduates gradually gain confidence before moving into a permanent engineering role.

The journey begins with a three-month internship, where selected candidates work for around 21 hours every week. During this phase, trainees receive a monthly stipend of ₹7,500 while learning the company’s development process and software architecture.

Candidates who perform well during the internship move to a six-month traineeship, which is a full-time program requiring approximately 8.5 working hours per day. The monthly stipend increases to ₹20,000, and trainees become actively involved in product development.

After successfully completing the entire nine-month learning journey, high-performing candidates may receive a full-time offer as an Associate Software Engineer with a package of ₹9 LPA.

Job Responsibilities

As a Trainee Software Engineer, you won’t spend your time only observing senior developers. Instead, you’ll actively participate in software development projects.

Your daily responsibilities may include designing new product features, developing reusable software modules, improving existing functionality, fixing bugs, writing clean and efficient code, and collaborating with experienced engineers during code reviews.

Since Recruit CRM builds recruitment software for global customers, trainees also get an opportunity to understand how scalable SaaS applications are designed and maintained.

The company is particularly interested in candidates who enjoy solving problems and continuously learning new technologies.

Skills Required

Recruit CRM is looking for students who possess a strong programming foundation and are willing to learn quickly.

The preferred technical skills include:

  • Java
  • Python
  • Artificial Intelligence
  • Machine Learning
  • Data Structures and Algorithms
  • Object-Oriented Programming
  • Logical Thinking
  • Problem Solving

Even if you are still improving your skills, having a good understanding of programming fundamentals will significantly improve your chances during the selection process.

Eligibility Criteria

Applications are invited only from students graduating in 2027.

Eligible qualifications include:

  • BE
  • B.Tech
  • BCA
  • B.Sc. (Computer Science)
  • MCA
  • M.Tech
  • M.Sc. (Computer Science)

Since this opportunity is designed specifically for freshers, experienced professionals are not the target audience for this hiring program.

Selection Process

Recruit CRM follows a completely virtual recruitment process.

Candidates first appear for an online assessment consisting of multiple-choice questions and coding challenges. Those who qualify move on to technical interviews, where interviewers evaluate programming knowledge, analytical thinking, problem-solving ability, and communication skills.

The complete process is conducted online, allowing students from across India to participate without travelling.

The company also mentions that only shortlisted candidates will receive email communication regarding further interview rounds.

Important Instructions

Applicants should carefully read the requirements before appearing for the online assessment.

A stable internet connection is essential throughout the examination. Since the test is web-proctored, candidates must keep their webcam switched on during the entire assessment. A laptop with a properly functioning camera is mandatory for all interview rounds.

Recruit CRM has also requested candidates not to send follow-up emails or social media messages regarding their application status. The recruitment team will contact shortlisted candidates whenever required.

Benefits of Joining Recruit CRM

One of the biggest advantages of joining Recruit CRM is its remote-first work culture. Employees enjoy flexible working hours while working with talented engineers from different locations.

The company also invests in employee learning through sponsored training and development programs. Health insurance coverage, company-sponsored team outings, and competitive compensation further enhance the overall employee experience.

After completing one year as a full-time employee, eligible team members may also receive an ARR-linked annual performance bonus, depending on company performance and management decisions.

Why This Opportunity Stands Out

Many fresher hiring programs focus only on classroom-style training. Recruit CRM follows a different approach by allowing trainees to contribute directly to real software products from the beginning.

The structured internship, practical software engineering experience, exposure to AI technologies, remote work flexibility, and the possibility of securing a ₹9 LPA software engineering role make this hiring drive one of the better opportunities available for the 2027 graduating batch.

Students who are passionate about programming and want to build a long-term career in software development should seriously consider applying.

How to Apply

Interested candidates can submit their application through the official Recruit CRM Careers Portal. Before applying, ensure that your resume is updated, your academic details are accurate, and your programming fundamentals are well prepared. Since the selection process includes coding assessments and technical interviews, spending time practising data structures, algorithms, Java, and Python can improve your chances of success.

Important Dates

Important Links

Final Words

Recruit CRM’s Trainee Software Engineer 2027 Hiring offers much more than just a job opportunity. It provides fresh graduates with structured industry training, practical software development experience, exposure to modern technologies like AI and Machine Learning, and a clear path toward a high-paying engineering role. If you are graduating in 2027 and want to begin your software development career with a globally recognized SaaS company, this recruitment drive is definitely worth considering.

title.rendered: AKTU Makes ABC ID Mandatory for Newly Admitted Students of 2026–27 Session: Complete Details, Deadline, Registration Process & Official Notice

content.rendered:
Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University (AKTU), Lucknow, has released an important notification for students studying in affiliated colleges across Uttar Pradesh. According to the latest circular, the university has instructed all affiliated institutions to ensure that every newly admitted student of the 2026–27 academic session creates an Academic Bank of Credits (ABC ID). The instruction also applies to students from previous academic sessions who are currently studying but have not yet generated an ABC ID.

This decision has been taken in line with the guidelines issued by the Ministry of Education, Government of India, under the implementation of the National Education Policy (NEP) 2020. The university has clearly stated that generating an ABC ID is now an essential academic requirement, and colleges have been directed to complete the process within the prescribed timeline.

If you are an AKTU student or have recently taken admission for the 2026–27 session, this update directly concerns you. In this article, we explain what the notification means, why the ABC ID is important, who needs to register, the deadline, and how you can create your ABC ID without any confusion.

What is the Academic Bank of Credits (ABC)?

The Academic Bank of Credits (ABC) is a digital platform introduced by the Government of India as part of the National Education Policy (NEP) 2020. Think of it as a secure digital repository that stores the academic credits earned by students during their higher education.

Instead of maintaining credits only on paper or within a single university, the ABC system keeps them digitally linked to a student’s unique ABC ID. This allows students to carry their academic achievements throughout their educational journey.

The concept has been introduced to make higher education more flexible and student-friendly. It supports credit transfer, multiple entry and exit options, and easier movement between recognized higher education institutions.

Why Has AKTU Issued This Notification?

AKTU has issued this notification to ensure that every eligible student is registered under the Academic Bank of Credits system.

The circular directs all affiliated colleges to verify and update the ABC ID details of eligible students. The university has also emphasized that the process should not be delayed because it has now become an important requirement for academic activities.

This initiative is part of the nationwide implementation of digital academic records and is expected to improve transparency, portability, and accessibility of students’ educational achievements.

Who Needs to Generate an ABC ID?

According to the official AKTU notification, the following students are required to create an ABC ID:

  • Students taking admission in the 2026–27 academic session
  • Students admitted in previous academic sessions who are still pursuing their courses but have not yet generated an ABC ID

If you already have a valid ABC ID linked with your academic records, you do not need to generate another one. However, students who have never registered must complete the process as soon as possible.

ABC ID is Mandatory for Examination Form Submission

One of the most important announcements mentioned in the notification is that students without an ABC ID will not be able to fill their examination forms.

This means that even if you are otherwise eligible to appear for examinations, the absence of a valid ABC ID may prevent you from completing the examination registration process.

Students should therefore avoid waiting until the last moment and complete the registration well before the deadline.

AKTU Deadline

The university has instructed all affiliated colleges to update the required information through the prescribed Google Form by 31 July 2026.

Colleges have been made responsible for ensuring that eligible students complete the ABC ID registration process before this deadline.

Responsibilities of Affiliated Colleges

The official circular places several responsibilities on affiliated institutions. Colleges are expected to:

  • Ensure every eligible student has an ABC ID
  • Verify the accuracy of student details
  • Upload the required information through the Google Form shared by AKTU
  • Complete the entire process before the specified deadline
  • Follow the User Manual attached with the notification for proper implementation

Why is an ABC ID Important?

Although many students see it as another registration process, the Academic Bank of Credits has several long-term benefits.

An ABC ID helps students maintain a permanent digital record of their academic credits. If a student changes institutions or continues higher education elsewhere, the earned credits can be accessed and transferred more efficiently.

Some of the major advantages include:

  • Secure digital storage of academic credits
  • Easy access through DigiLocker
  • Better implementation of NEP 2020 reforms
  • Support for multiple entry and exit options
  • Simplified credit transfer between recognized institutions
  • Reduced paperwork during academic verification
  • Lifelong academic identity linked to higher education

As the education system becomes more digital, the ABC ID is expected to play an increasingly important role.

How to Create an ABC ID

Students can generate their ABC ID online in just a few minutes.

Step 1: Visit the official Academic Bank of Credits portal.

Step 2: Sign in using your DigiLocker account. If you do not have one, create a DigiLocker account using your Aadhaar-linked mobile number.

Step 3: Complete the Aadhaar verification process.

Step 4: Verify your personal and educational information carefully.

Step 5: Generate your unique ABC ID.

Step 6: Submit the generated ABC ID to your college so that it can be updated in the university records.

Before submitting, ensure that your name, date of birth, Aadhaar details, and educational information match your university records to avoid verification issues.

Common Mistakes Students Should Avoid

Many students face problems during registration because of small mistakes. Here are a few things to keep in mind:

  • Do not create multiple ABC IDs
  • Use the same details that are available in your academic records
  • Verify your Aadhaar-linked mobile number before registration
  • Keep your DigiLocker account active
  • Save your ABC ID after generation
  • Submit the correct ID to your college

Taking these precautions can help you avoid delays during examination registration.

Official Notification Summary

Key Highlights

  • AKTU has issued an official circular regarding ABC ID creation.
  • Applicable to all affiliated colleges across Uttar Pradesh.
  • Mandatory for newly admitted students of the 2026–27 session.
  • Existing students without an ABC ID must also complete registration.
  • Examination forms cannot be submitted without a valid ABC ID.
  • Colleges have been instructed to complete the verification process before 31 July 2026.

Important Links

Final Words

The latest AKTU notification makes it clear that the Academic Bank of Credits (ABC ID) is no longer just a digital initiative—it has become an essential requirement for students studying under the university. Whether you have recently taken admission for the 2026–27 academic session or are already pursuing your course without an ABC ID, completing the registration should be your priority.

Instead of waiting until examination forms are released, students should create their ABC ID immediately and submit the details to their respective colleges. Doing so will not only ensure compliance with the university’s instructions but also help them benefit from the Government of India’s digital academic credit system in the future.

title.rendered: UP Scholarship 2026-27 Schedule Released: Fresh & Renewal Registration Dates, Verification Timeline and Payment Details

content.rendered:
The Uttar Pradesh Government has officially released the UP Scholarship 2026-27 Schedule for students applying under the Post Matric (Dashmottar) Scholarship Scheme. The notification provides the complete timeline for Fresh Registration, Renewal Applications, institute and university verification, PFMS scrutiny, and scholarship payment.

Every year, the UP Scholarship scheme supports lakhs of students by providing financial assistance for higher education. Students pursuing undergraduate, postgraduate, diploma, engineering, management, medical, polytechnic, and other approved courses can apply if they meet the eligibility criteria.

This year’s schedule also includes important deadlines for educational institutions and universities. Colleges must complete the verification process on time so that eligible students receive their scholarship without unnecessary delays.

If you are planning to apply for the UP Scholarship 2026-27, this guide explains everything you need to know, including important dates, application steps, verification process, payment schedule, and required documents.

What is UP Post Matric Scholarship?

The UP Post Matric Scholarship is a financial assistance scheme run by the Government of Uttar Pradesh to help students continue their higher education. The scholarship covers tuition fee reimbursement and maintenance allowance for eligible students studying after Class 12.

The scheme is available for students belonging to the following categories:

  • Scheduled Caste (SC)
  • Scheduled Tribe (ST)
  • Other Backward Class (OBC)
  • General Category (Economically Eligible)
  • Minority Community

The scholarship amount is transferred directly to the student’s Aadhaar-linked bank account through the Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) system after successful verification.

Master Data Process Begins Before Student Registration

Before students can submit their scholarship applications, colleges and universities must update their institutional details on the scholarship portal. This process is known as Master Data Preparation.

During this stage, institutions upload information such as approved courses, fee structure, university affiliation, seat availability, and other academic details. The government verifies this information to ensure that only students enrolled in recognised institutions receive scholarship benefits.

According to the official notification, the Master Data schedule is as follows:

Students are not required to take any action during this stage. The responsibility lies with educational institutions and the concerned authorities.

Renewal Scholarship Registration Schedule

Students who received the scholarship during the previous academic year and are continuing the same course should apply through the Renewal category.

The online Renewal application process will begin on 15 September 2026 and continue until 15 October 2026. After the application is submitted, it will go through multiple verification stages before the scholarship is approved.

Renewal Scholarship Timeline

Students should complete their application well before the last date to avoid any last-minute technical issues.

Fresh Registration Schedule

Students applying for the scholarship for the first time must register under the Fresh category.

Fresh registration will start on 15 September 2026, while the last date to submit the online application is 31 October 2026. After completing the online form, students must download the final application and submit it to their institution along with the required documents.

Verification and Scholarship Payment

After the application is submitted, it is verified at multiple levels. The educational institution checks the student’s admission, course details, and fee records. The university then verifies the student’s enrollment. Finally, the application is reviewed through the Public Financial Management System (PFMS) to validate Aadhaar details, bank account information, and beneficiary records.

Once all verification stages are completed successfully, the scholarship amount is transferred directly to the student’s Aadhaar-linked bank account through the DBT system.

Documents Required

Before applying, students should keep the following documents ready:

  • Aadhaar Card
  • Aadhaar-linked Bank Account
  • Passport-size Photograph
  • Income Certificate
  • Caste Certificate (if applicable)
  • Domicile Certificate
  • Previous Examination Marksheet
  • Admission Letter
  • Fee Receipt
  • Bank Passbook
  • Active Mobile Number

Final Words

The release of the UP Scholarship 2026-27 Schedule marks the beginning of the scholarship process for the new academic session. Students should carefully follow the official timeline, keep their documents ready, and complete every stage of the application before the deadline. Submitting accurate information and completing verification on time will help ensure that the scholarship amount is credited without delays.

title.rendered: AKTU Issues AICTE Scholarship 2026-27 Notification: Apply Online for Pragati, Saksham & Swanath Schemes Before 31 October

content.rendered:
Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University (AKTU), Lucknow has released an important notification regarding the AICTE Scholarship 2026-27 for students studying in affiliated colleges across Uttar Pradesh. The University has directed all affiliated institutions to ensure that eligible students register under the AICTE Pragati Scholarship Scheme, AICTE Saksham Scholarship Scheme, and AICTE Swanath Scholarship Scheme for the academic session 2026-27.

According to the official circular, the online application portal is now open for both Fresh and Renewal applications through the National Scholarship Portal (NSP). Students who meet the eligibility criteria must submit their applications before 31 October 2026. Colleges have also been instructed to verify applications within the prescribed timeline and provide complete assistance to eligible students during the registration process.

The latest notification is significant for thousands of Degree and Diploma students enrolled in AICTE-approved institutions under AKTU. Scholarships offered by AICTE help students reduce the financial burden of technical education while encouraging academic excellence. Students are therefore advised not to wait until the last date and should complete their applications well in advance.

AICTE Scholarship 2026-27: Highlights

Why Has AKTU Issued This Notification?

The notification, issued by Prof. Jai Prakash Pandey, Vice Chancellor of AKTU, directs all affiliated colleges to actively identify eligible students and ensure that they receive proper guidance while applying for AICTE scholarships.

The University has specifically instructed institutions to verify scholarship applications within the prescribed timeline and submit details of eligible students to AKTU through the designated Google Form for monitoring and record purposes. The objective is to ensure that every deserving student receives an equal opportunity to benefit from these scholarship schemes.

Further, all institutions shall submit the details of eligible students through the Google Form below for monitoring and record purposes.
Google Form Link: https://forms.gle/fo7UcQCWSHch84Qm6
The Directors/Principals shall personally ensure timely registration of eligible students and submission of complete and accurate data to the University.

AICTE Scholarship Schemes Covered

The AICTE notification includes three scholarship schemes for eligible students pursuing technical education.

AICTE Pragati Scholarship Scheme

The Pragati Scholarship Scheme has been introduced to encourage girl students to pursue higher technical education. Eligible female students studying in AICTE-approved institutions can apply for financial assistance under this scheme. Both Fresh and Renewal applications are being accepted for the academic session 2026-27.

Submitting the application early is recommended because colleges require sufficient time to verify student records before forwarding applications to the next level.

Who Can Apply?

Students enrolled in AICTE-approved Degree and Diploma programmes can apply if they satisfy the eligibility conditions prescribed for the respective scholarship scheme.

Generally, the notification covers:

  • Eligible girl students under the Pragati Scholarship.
  • Specially-abled (Divyang) students under the Saksham Scholarship.
  • Eligible students under the Swanath Scholarship category.

Applicants should carefully read the official AICTE guidelines before completing the online application.

How to Apply for AICTE Scholarship 2026-27

The application process is completely online through the National Scholarship Portal.

Step 1: Visit the National Scholarship Portal.
https://scholarships.gov.in

Step 2: Complete the One-Time Registration (OTR) if you are a new applicant.

Step 3: Log in and select the appropriate AICTE Scholarship Scheme.

Step 4: Fill in your academic, personal and bank account details carefully.

Step 5: Upload the required documents.

Step 6: Review all details and submit the application.

Step 7: Contact your college scholarship cell to ensure timely verification of your application.

Documents Required

Before starting the application process, students should keep the following documents ready:

  • Aadhaar Card
  • Admission Letter
  • Institute Identity Card
  • Income Certificate (if applicable)
  • Category Certificate
  • Disability Certificate (for Saksham applicants)
  • Bank Account Details
  • Passport-size Photograph
  • Previous Scholarship Details (Renewal applicants)

Official Links

National Scholarship Portal (NSP)
https://scholarships.gov.in

Students are advised to use only these official portals for scholarship registration and information.

Why Students Should Apply Early

Many scholarship applications are delayed every year because students wait until the last week to apply. Since every application must also be verified by the institution, applying early gives students enough time to correct mistakes, upload missing documents and complete verification without unnecessary delays.

Students should regularly check the status of their application on the National Scholarship Portal after submission and stay in touch with their college scholarship cell until the verification process is completed.

Official Instructions for Colleges

AKTU has directed affiliated colleges to:

  • Identify all eligible students.
  • Guide students during the application process.
  • Verify applications within the prescribed timeline.
  • Submit eligible student details to the University through the official Google Form.
  • Ensure that no deserving student misses the scholarship opportunity.

Conclusion

The AICTE Scholarship 2026-27 is an excellent opportunity for eligible students pursuing technical education in AKTU-affiliated colleges. The latest notification clearly highlights the responsibility of institutions to support students during the application and verification process.

Students who meet the eligibility criteria should complete their applications through the National Scholarship Portal as early as possible instead of waiting until the deadline. Before submitting the application, read the official AICTE guidelines carefully, keep all required documents ready and stay in touch with your college scholarship cell for timely verification.

With the application deadline set for 31 October 2026, early registration can help students avoid last-minute technical issues and improve the chances of successful scholarship processing.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

What is the last date to apply for AICTE Scholarship 2026-27?
The last date to submit online applications is 31 October 2026.

Which scholarship schemes are included in the notification?
The notification covers the AICTE Pragati, AICTE Saksham and AICTE Swanath Scholarship Schemes.

Can Diploma students apply?
Yes. Eligible Degree and Diploma students can apply according to the guidelines of the respective scholarship scheme.

Where should students apply?
Applications must be submitted through the National Scholarship Portal (NSP).

Where can I download the official scholarship guidelines?
