title.rendered: IBM Z Datathon 2026 Registration Open: Free Global AI Challenge with $50,000+ Prize Pool for Students

content.rendered:
Artificial Intelligence is no longer limited to research labs or large technology companies. Today, students have countless opportunities to contribute innovative ideas that solve real-world challenges. If you’re looking for an international platform to showcase your creativity, technical knowledge, and problem-solving skills, IBM Z Datathon 2026 is an opportunity you shouldn’t miss.

The IBM Z Datathon 2026 is a prestigious global virtual innovation competition organized by the Shooting Stars Foundation in collaboration with IBM ecos/ystem partners. The event brings together talented students from around the world to develop AI-powered solutions that address meaningful societal and business challenges.

Recognizing the value of this initiative, Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University (AKTU) has officially informed its affiliated colleges and encouraged eligible students to participate in this global competition. According to the official notification, participation is completely free, open to undergraduate and postgraduate students from all academic streams, and offers an impressive prize pool worth more than USD 50,000.

Whether you’re an engineering student, management student, science graduate, or pursuing any other course, IBM Z Datathon 2026 offers an excellent opportunity to learn from industry experts, collaborate with global participants, and gain valuable practical experience that can strengthen your academic and professional profile.

What is IBM Z Datathon 2026?

IBM Z Datathon 2026 is an international online innovation competition designed to encourage students to use Artificial Intelligence and modern technologies to solve practical challenges. Unlike traditional coding contests, this datathon focuses on creativity, teamwork, innovation, and the ability to develop impactful solutions.

Participants will work on projects inspired by real-world problems while receiving mentorship from IBM professionals and industry experts. Throughout the event, students will gain exposure to enterprise technologies, modern AI tools, and collaborative problem-solving techniques that are widely used in the technology industry.

One of the most attractive aspects of the competition is that no prior coding experience is required. This makes the event accessible to students from diverse educational backgrounds who are eager to learn and contribute innovative ideas.

IBM Z Datathon 2026 Overview

Theme of IBM Z Datathon 2026

This year’s competition revolves around the theme “AI for Good”, encouraging participants to build technology-driven solutions that create a positive impact on society.

The challenge includes three exciting innovation tracks:

Real-Time AI for Critical Decisions

Develop AI-powered systems capable of supporting fast and accurate decision-making in situations where timing is critical.

AI-Secured: Innovation Without Exposure

Focus on creating secure AI solutions that protect sensitive information while delivering reliable performance.

Wildcard: Beyond the Obvious

An open innovation category that encourages participants to think creatively and present unique ideas beyond conventional approaches.

Who Can Participate?

One of the biggest strengths of IBM Z Datathon 2026 is its inclusive eligibility criteria.

Students eligible to participate include:

  • Undergraduate students
  • Postgraduate students
  • Students from any stream or discipline
  • Participants from colleges and universities worldwide

Unlike many technical competitions, students are not expected to have advanced programming knowledge before joining. The organizers have clearly stated that prior coding experience is not mandatory, allowing beginners to learn throughout the event.

Why Should Students Participate?

International competitions like IBM Z Datathon provide much more than prize money. They offer practical learning experiences that cannot always be gained through classroom education.

Participants will have the opportunity to interact with IBM experts, industry mentors, and fellow innovators from more than 50 countries. Working alongside students from diverse backgrounds helps improve communication skills, teamwork, leadership abilities, and technical confidence.

Students will also gain practical exposure to enterprise computing technologies and Artificial Intelligence platforms used by global organizations. Such experiences make resumes more competitive and demonstrate initiative, innovation, and real-world problem-solving abilities during internship and placement interviews.

Key Benefits of IBM Z Datathon 2026

Students participating in the competition can expect several valuable learning opportunities, including:

  • Learn directly from IBM professionals and experienced mentors
  • Develop AI-powered solutions for real-world challenges
  • Gain hands-on exposure to IBM Z enterprise technologies
  • Improve analytical thinking and innovation skills
  • Collaborate with students from more than 50 countries
  • Build an internationally recognized project portfolio
  • Earn certificates and global recognition
  • Compete for prizes worth over USD 50,000
  • Participate online without any travel expenses

These benefits make the event valuable even for students who are participating in an international competition for the first time.

Why IBM Z Datathon Can Boost Your Career

Employers today increasingly value candidates who possess practical problem-solving skills alongside academic qualifications. Participation in globally recognized competitions demonstrates a student’s willingness to learn, collaborate, and tackle complex challenges.

Whether your career goal is software development, data science, Artificial Intelligence, cybersecurity, cloud computing, consulting, or higher education, IBM Z Datathon provides experience that can help distinguish your profile from other applicants.

Projects developed during the competition can also be added to resumes, LinkedIn profiles, GitHub portfolios, and placement interviews as evidence of practical experience.

Event Schedule

The IBM Z Datathon 2026 will be conducted completely online on 17–18 October 2026. Since the competition is virtual, students can participate from their homes or college campuses without requiring any special infrastructure.

How to Register for IBM Z Datathon 2026

Students interested in participating should complete the online registration process through the official registration portal mentioned in the notification.

Registration Link:
https://www.starhacks.org/ibm-z-datathon-2026

Before registering, keep the following information ready:

  • Full Name
  • College Name
  • Academic Details
  • Valid Email Address
  • Mobile Number

After successful registration, participants should regularly monitor their registered email for updates regarding team formation, mentoring sessions, competition guidelines, and event schedules.

Why AKTU Students Should Not Miss This Opportunity

Since AKTU has officially circulated this opportunity among affiliated institutions, students across the university can confidently participate in the competition.

The event aligns well with current industry requirements by promoting Artificial Intelligence, innovation, teamwork, and practical learning. Students interested in internships, placements, research opportunities, or international exposure should consider participating to strengthen their academic profile.

Final Thoughts

IBM Z Datathon 2026 is more than just another student competition. It is a platform where innovation meets opportunity, allowing participants to transform ideas into impactful AI-powered solutions while learning from some of the industry’s leading experts.

With free registration, no coding experience requirement, global participation, and a USD 50,000+ prize pool, the competition offers tremendous value for students across all disciplines. Even if winning is not your primary goal, the experience, mentorship, networking opportunities, and practical knowledge gained during the event can play an important role in your academic and professional journey.

If you are eager to challenge yourself, collaborate with talented students worldwide, and build solutions that make a real difference, IBM Z Datathon 2026 is an opportunity worth exploring.

title.rendered: AKTU Offers Free Adobe Creative Cloud Pro Worth ₹8,000 to Students with Industry Certification

content.rendered:
Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University (AKTU), Lucknow, has announced an exciting opportunity for students by partnering with Adobe and FutureSkills Prime (NASSCOM). Under this initiative, eligible students will receive Adobe Creative Cloud Pro worth approximately ₹8,000 completely free, along with access to structured online learning and an industry-recognized Adobe certification.

The initiative is aimed at helping students develop practical digital creativity skills that are increasingly required across industries. Whether students are interested in graphic design, video editing, UI/UX, digital marketing, content creation, or software development, Adobe Creative Cloud provides access to professional tools used worldwide.

According to the official circular issued on 9 July 2026 by Prof. Arunima Verma, Dean – Training & Placement, AKTU, all affiliated colleges have been requested to encourage eligible students to participate in this learning initiative.

AKTU Adobe Learning Initiative 2026: Highlights

What Will Students Receive?

Students selected under this initiative will receive several benefits without paying any fee.

The biggest advantage is free access to Adobe Creative Cloud Pro, which includes around 20 professional Adobe applications such as Photoshop, Illustrator, Premiere Pro, After Effects, Acrobat Pro, InDesign, Lightroom, Adobe Express, and more. These tools are widely used by professionals in creative industries and are valuable for building practical skills.

Participants will also be enrolled in Adobe learning pathways on the FutureSkills Prime platform. These courses are designed to help students learn through hands-on projects and guided training. In addition, students will receive one free attempt at the Adobe & NASSCOM assessment, normally worth around ₹600. Those who successfully complete the program will earn an industry-recognized Adobe certification.

The University requests all affiliated colleges to encourage eligible students to show their interest and
actively participate in this initiative through the below given Google form link:- https://forms.gle/63wGA9GcQ61VJJSL6

Who Can Apply?

The program is open to students studying in AKTU-affiliated colleges. Eligible candidates include:

  • B.Tech (All Branches) – 2nd Year
  • B.Tech (All Branches) – 3rd Year

  • MBA Students
  • MCA Students

Only students meeting these eligibility requirements can participate in the initiative.

Students must first submit their interest through the Google Form shared by AKTU. The university has stated that the official FutureSkills Prime registration link will be released separately. During registration, students should keep the following details ready:

  • Full Name
  • Official Institute Email ID
  • APAAR ID
  • Institute Details

After successful registration, students will be onboarded to the FutureSkills Prime platform, enrolled in Adobe learning pathways, and invited to orientation sessions and practical workshops conducted by Adobe experts.

Why This Initiative Matters

Digital and creative skills have become essential across almost every industry. Employers increasingly prefer candidates who can demonstrate practical experience with professional software rather than relying only on academic knowledge.

Adobe Creative Cloud is the industry standard for graphic design, video production, animation, digital publishing, photography, branding, and content creation. By providing free access to these premium tools, AKTU is helping students improve their technical skills without the financial burden of purchasing expensive software.

The Adobe certification earned through this initiative can strengthen resumes, improve LinkedIn profiles, and enhance placement opportunities. Students will also gain experience through project-based learning, enabling them to build a professional portfolio that showcases their abilities.

Conclusion

The Adobe & FutureSkills Prime Learning Initiative is one of the most valuable skill development opportunities introduced by AKTU in recent years. Free access to Adobe Creative Cloud Pro, expert-led online learning, practical projects, and an industry-recognized certification can give students a significant advantage in today’s competitive job market.

Eligible B.Tech, MBA, and MCA students should take advantage of this opportunity and complete the registration process once the official registration link is released. Students are also advised to stay in touch with their college’s Training and Placement Cell for the latest updates regarding enrollment and orientation sessions.

content.rendered:
Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University (AKTU), Lucknow has officially declared the Even Semester Examination Result 2026 for several undergraduate and postgraduate programmes. The university released an official notification on 08 July 2026, informing all affiliated institutions that the results of Regular students enrolled in selected courses have been uploaded to the AKTU One View Result Portal.

Students who appeared in the Even Semester examinations conducted between 07 May 2026 and 11 June 2026 can now access their results online using their roll number through the university’s official result portal. The announcement marks another phase in AKTU’s ongoing result declaration process for the academic session 2025–26.

If you were waiting for the AKTU Even Semester Result 2026, this article provides complete details, including the official notification, list of courses whose results have been announced, steps to check the result, important instructions, and frequently asked questions.

AKTU Even Semester Result 2026 Officially Announced

AKTU issued an official circular under Letter No. AKTU/Pariksha Niyantrak/2026/3039, dated 08 July 2026, signed by Prof. Deepak Nagariya, Controller of Examination.

According to the notification, the university has completed the evaluation process for the listed programmes and received approval from the competent authority. Following this approval, the results have been published on the One View Result Portal for regular students.

The notification has also been circulated to all AKTU-affiliated colleges with instructions to inform students and complete any necessary academic formalities.

AKTU Result 2026 Highlights

Courses Whose Results Have Been Declared

According to the official notification, AKTU has released results for the following programmes and semesters.

Students studying in the above-mentioned programmes can now check their semester results online.

Examination Details

The Even Semester examinations for the academic session 2025–26 were conducted successfully from 07 May 2026 to 11 June 2026 at various AKTU-affiliated colleges across Uttar Pradesh.

After the completion of examinations, answer sheets underwent evaluation by university-appointed examiners. Once the evaluation process was completed and approved by the competent authority, AKTU officially declared the results.

The university generally releases semester results in multiple phases depending on the completion of evaluation for different courses. Therefore, students whose programmes are not included in the current notification should continue checking the official website for future announcements.

How to Check AKTU One View Result 2026

Students can follow the simple steps below to check their semester results.

Step 1

Visit the official AKTU One View Result portal.

Step 2

Enter your University Roll Number in the required field.

Step 3

Complete the verification process if prompted.

Step 4

Click on the View Result or Submit button.

Step 5

Your semester result will appear on the screen.

Step 6

Download the result and take a printout for future academic use.

AKTU RESULT WITHOUT DOB

Details Mentioned on the AKTU Result

After downloading the result, students should carefully verify all the information printed on the scorecard.

The result generally contains:

  • Student Name
  • Father’s Name
  • University Roll Number
  • Course Name
  • Semester
  • Subject-wise Marks
  • Internal Marks
  • External Marks
  • Total Marks
  • Result Status
  • SGPA/CGPA (if applicable)

If any information appears incorrect, students should immediately contact their college administration.

What Should Students Do After Checking the Result?

Once the result has been downloaded, students are advised to carefully review their marks and academic performance.

If students believe there is any discrepancy in the published result, they should immediately contact their college authorities for guidance regarding correction or further university procedures.

Students who have successfully passed the semester should keep both digital and printed copies of the result for future admission, internship, scholarship, placement, and document verification purposes.

Official Notification Summary

The notification clearly states that the results have been declared only for the programmes listed in the official table.

The Controller of Examination has directed all affiliated colleges to inform students and complete the required academic formalities.

The result is available through the university’s One View portal.

Why AKTU Releases Results in Phases

Many students often wonder why all semester results are not announced together.

AKTU conducts examinations for hundreds of affiliated colleges and thousands of students across multiple undergraduate and postgraduate programmes. Since answer sheet evaluation is completed separately for different courses, the university publishes results in phases after receiving approval from the competent authority.

This phased approach helps ensure greater accuracy before releasing the results.

Students should keep the following points in mind while checking their results:

  • Only Regular students are covered under this announcement.
  • Download the result immediately after checking it.

  • Contact your college in case of any discrepancy.
  • Keep multiple copies of the result for future academic purposes.

The result has been declared for MBA, MCA, M.Tech, M.Pharm, BBA, BHMCT, and BFA.

MBA, MCA, M.Tech, M.Pharm and BBA results have been released for the 2nd Semester, while BHMCT and BFA results have been announced for the 2nd, 4th and 6th Semesters.

Who can check this result?

Only Regular students belonging to the courses mentioned in the notification.

When were the examinations conducted?

The Even Semester examinations were held from 07 May 2026 to 11 June 2026.

Where can students check the result?

Students can check their results through the AKTU One View Result Portal using their University Roll Number.

Students are advised to download their results as soon as possible and carefully verify all the details mentioned on the scorecard. Those facing any issue regarding marks or personal information should immediately contact their respective colleges for further assistance.

AKTU Academic Calendar 2026-27

title.rendered: AKTU 24th Convocation 2026: Registered Students Must Confirm Attendance by 2 July, Degree to Be Sent by Speed Post if Absent

content.rendered:
Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University (AKTU), Lucknow has released an important notice for students who have successfully registered and paid the convocation fee for the 24th Convocation Ceremony 2026. The university has asked all registered students to confirm whether they will attend the ceremony. Students who are unable to participate must submit their Consent for Non-Attendance by 2 July 2026 (2:00 PM) through the official link sent to their registered email.

The notification has been issued to help the university make proper seating and event arrangements while ensuring eligible students receive their degree cetificates without unnecessary delays.

AKTU 24th Convocation 2026: Highlights

Why Has AKTU Issued This Notice?

According to the university, many students complete the online registration process and pay the convocation fee but later fail to attend the ceremony due to personal or unavoidable reasons.

As a result:

  • Reserved seats remain vacant.
  • University resources and arrangements are affected.
  • Other registered participants cannot benefit from the unused arrangements.

To avoid this situation, AKTU has requested every registered student to confirm whether they will attend the ceremony.

Who Needs to Take Action?

This notice is applicable only to students who have:

  • Successfully completed the online convocation registration.
  • Paid the prescribed registration fee.
  • Received confirmation from the university.

If you are planning to attend the convocation, no additional action is required.

However, if you are unable to attend, you must submit your non-attendance consent before the deadline.

Last Date to Submit Non-Attendance Consent

Students who cannot attend the convocation must submit their consent by:

Date: 2 July 2026
Time: 2:00 PM

The consent form can be accessed through the link sent by AKTU to the registered email ID used during convocation registration. The email has been sent from:

convocation2026@aktu.ac.in

Students are advised to check their Inbox, Spam, and Promotions folders if they have not yet found the email.

Will the Registration Fee Be Refunded?

Yes.

AKTU has clearly mentioned that students who officially submit their Consent for Non-Attendance through the prescribed process will receive a refund of their registration fee as per university rules.

The refund will be transferred to the bank account details provided during the registration process.

What About the Degree Certificate?

Students who do not attend the convocation will still receive their original degree.

The university has informed that:

  • Original degree certificates will be dispatched approximately one week after the convocation.
  • The degree will be sent through Speed Post/Registered Post.
  • It will be delivered to the address registered on the university ERP portal.

Therefore, students who cannot attend the ceremony do not need to worry about collecting their degree in person.

Important Instructions for Students

AKTU has advised students to attend the convocation only if they genuinely intend to participate.

This will help the university:

  • Finalize seating arrangements.
  • Manage security and event logistics.
  • Ensure smooth conduct of the ceremony.

Students who are unable to attend should complete the online consent process instead of remaining absent without informing the university.

Gold Medal Distribution

The notice also mentions that during the convocation:

  • Gold Medal recipients selected by the university will receive their medals and degrees on the stage from the Hon’ble Governor (Chancellor).
  • Other medal recipients will receive their medals and degrees while seated in the hall.
  • A group photograph with the Hon’ble Governor will be taken after the ceremony.

What Should Colleges Do?

AKTU has instructed all affiliated institutions to immediately inform eligible registered students about this notification so that:

  • Students submit their attendance confirmation on time.
  • Necessary arrangements can be updated before the ceremony.
  • The convocation is conducted smoothly.

Final Words

The AKTU 24th Convocation is scheduled for 7 July 2026, and this latest notice is extremely important for every registered student. If you are attending, simply be present on the ceremony day. If you cannot attend, make sure to submit your Consent for Non-Attendance through the official email link before 2 July 2026 (2:00 PM).

Completing this process will help the university manage the event efficiently while ensuring that your registration fee is refunded according to university rules and your original degree reaches your registered address without delay.

The university released the results on 30 June 2026 through the One View portal, allowing students to download their provisional marksheet using their Roll Number. The announcement was made through official notification number 2992, signed by Controller of Examinations Prof. Deepak Nagariya.

AKTU One View Result 2026 Highlights

AKTU Declares B.Tech & B.Pharm Results

AKTU has officially started releasing the Even Semester Examination 2025–26 results. In the first phase, the university has declared the results for B.Tech 4th Semester, B.Tech 6th Semester, and B.Pharm 6th Semester regular students.

According to the official notification, these examinations were conducted between 7 May and 11 June 2026. After completing the evaluation process and receiving approval from the competent authority, the university uploaded the results on the One View portal, making them available online for students.

The university has also instructed all affiliated colleges and institutions to inform students about the result declaration and complete the necessary academic formalities.

How to Check AKTU One View Result 2026

Students can check their results by following these steps:

  1. Visit the official AKTU website.
  2. Click on the One View result link.
  3. Enter your University Roll Number.
  4. Complete the security verification, if required.
  5. Click on Submit.
  6. Your result will appear on the screen.
  7. Download and save the provisional marksheet.

Details Available on the Result

After downloading the scorecard, students should carefully verify the following information:

  • Student Name
  • Roll Number
  • Enrollment Number
  • Course & Semester
  • Subject-wise Marks
  • Total Marks
  • SGPA/CGPA
  • Result Status

If any information is incorrect, students should immediately contact their college for further assistance.

Why These Semester Results Matter

The declaration of these semester results is significant for students planning their next academic and career milestones.

For B.Tech 6th Semester students, the result plays an important role in campus placements, as many companies consider the CGPA up to the sixth semester during recruitment.

For B.Tech 4th Semester students, the updated result is often required while applying for summer internships, industrial training, and certification programs.

Similarly, B.Pharm 6th Semester students can use their latest marks for internship applications, GPAT preparation, higher education admissions, and scholarship opportunities.

What to Do If the Website Is Slow?

Since thousands of students access the portal immediately after the announcement, the website may become temporarily slow.

If you face any issue:

  • Wait for a few minutes and try again.
  • Use Incognito Mode.
  • Clear your browser cache.
  • Try checking the result during non-peak hours.

What Should Students Do After Checking Their Result?

After downloading the provisional marksheet, students should:

  • Verify all personal and academic details.
  • Save a PDF copy for future reference.
  • Take a printout if required.
  • Contact the college in case of any discrepancy.
  • Keep checking the official website for scrutiny or re-evaluation notifications.

Other AKTU Results Expected Soon

With the declaration of B.Tech 4th Semester, B.Tech 6th Semester, and B.Pharm 6th Semester results, AKTU is expected to release results for other programmes and several postgraduate courses in the coming days.

Students are advised to rely only on the official AKTU website for authentic updates.

Final Words

The release of the AKTU One View Result 2026 brings an end to the wait for thousands of B.Tech and B.Pharm students across Uttar Pradesh. Students should download their provisional marksheet, verify every detail carefully, and contact their respective colleges if any corrections are required.

For the latest AKTU results, notifications, examination updates, and academic news, keep visiting Notes Gallery.

Frequently Asked Questions

Is the AKTU One View Result 2026 released?

Yes. AKTU has released the One View Result 2026 for B.Tech 4th Semester, B.Tech 6th Semester, and B.Pharm 6th Semester regular students.

Which courses are included in this result?

The result has been announced for:

  • B.Tech 4th Semester
  • B.Tech 6th Semester
  • B.Pharm 6th Semester

What details are required to check the result?

Students need their University Roll Number to access the result through the One View portal.

What should I do if my result shows an error?

Students should immediately contact their respective college or the university examination department for correction.

title.rendered: Lenskart Graphic Design Internship 2026: Eligibility, Skills, Roles, Selection Process, Salary, Benefits & Apply Online

content.rendered:
Are you passionate about graphic design and looking for an internship that can help you build real industry experience? The Lenskart Graphic Design Internship 2026 is an excellent opportunity for students and fresh graduates who want to work with one of India’s leading eyewear brands. This internship allows aspiring designers to gain hands-on experience in branding, digital marketing, social media creatives, packaging design, and visual communication while working alongside experienced professionals.

Unlike classroom projects, this internship provides exposure to live business campaigns and real client requirements. Interns get the chance to improve their creativity, understand corporate design workflows, and develop a professional portfolio that can significantly strengthen future job applications.

If you’re planning to begin your career in graphic design, branding, or digital marketing, here’s everything you need to know about the Lenskart Graphic Design Internship 2026, including eligibility, required skills, roles, benefits, selection process, and how to apply online.

Lenskart Graphic Design Internship 2026: Overview

About Lenskart

Founded in 2010, Lenskart has become one of India’s largest eyewear companies, serving millions of customers across the country. The company is known for combining technology with fashion to provide high-quality eyewear products at affordable prices.

Apart from its retail business, Lenskart has built a strong digital presence through creative branding, social media campaigns, product marketing, and innovative customer experiences. This is where graphic designers play an important role.

The Graphic Design Internship allows students to understand how large brands create visually appealing marketing campaigns while maintaining a consistent brand identity across digital and offline platforms.

About the Graphic Design Internship

The internship is designed for candidates who have a passion for creativity and visual storytelling. During the internship, selected candidates work closely with the creative, branding, and marketing teams on various design projects.

Interns receive practical exposure to professional design software, campaign planning, social media marketing, packaging design, digital advertisements, and branding activities.

Instead of only observing professionals, interns actively contribute to ongoing projects and gain valuable experience that can make their resumes stand out in future placements.

Internship Highlights

Some of the major highlights of the internship include:

  • Opportunity to work with one of India’s leading consumer brands.
  • Exposure to real-world graphic design projects.
  • Learn directly from experienced designers and creative professionals.
  • Build an industry-ready design portfolio.
  • Gain practical knowledge of branding and marketing.
  • Work on social media campaigns and promotional materials.
  • Understand corporate design workflows.
  • Improve communication and teamwork skills.
  • Experience working in a fast-paced professional environment.

Eligibility Criteria

Candidates interested in applying should generally meet the following requirements:

  • Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree in Graphic Design, Fine Arts, Multimedia, Animation, Visual Communication, or a related discipline.
  • Students from any recognized college or university may apply.
  • Fresh graduates are also eligible.
  • Good understanding of graphic design principles.
  • Strong creativity and attention to detail.
  • Ability to work collaboratively with marketing and creative teams.
  • Availability to work from the Gurgaon office during the internship.

Although prior work experience is not mandatory, having personal design projects or freelance work can strengthen your application.

Skills Required

Candidates are expected to possess basic knowledge of industry-standard graphic design tools.

Essential Skills

  • Adobe Photoshop
  • Adobe Illustrator
  • Adobe Creative Suite
  • Figma

Additional Skills Preferred

  • Typography
  • Brand Identity Design
  • Logo Design
  • Social Media Post Design
  • Poster and Banner Design
  • Layout Design
  • UI Design Basics
  • Color Theory
  • Illustration
  • Creativity
  • Time Management
  • Communication Skills

Applicants who showcase creative thinking and problem-solving abilities often have an advantage during the selection process.

Roles and Responsibilities

Selected interns may work on multiple creative assignments throughout the internship.

Typical responsibilities include:

  • Designing social media creatives for Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, and other platforms.
  • Creating digital banners for marketing campaigns.
  • Designing promotional posters and advertisements.
  • Assisting in brand identity projects.
  • Preparing website graphics and landing page visuals.
  • Designing email marketing creatives.
  • Supporting packaging and merchandising design.
  • Editing existing graphics according to campaign requirements.
  • Collaborating with marketing and content teams.
  • Participating in brainstorming sessions for upcoming campaigns.
  • Ensuring all creatives follow Lenskart’s branding guidelines.
  • Delivering projects within assigned deadlines.

The exact responsibilities may vary depending on the department and ongoing projects.

Internship Duration

The duration of the internship depends on the business requirements and project assignments. Candidates are advised to check the official internship page for the latest duration, joining timeline, and internship schedule before applying.

Stipend and Benefits

The stipend may differ depending on the internship role and company policies.

Apart from financial compensation, interns receive several valuable benefits, including:

  • Practical corporate experience
  • Mentorship from experienced professionals
  • Exposure to live commercial projects
  • Better understanding of branding strategies
  • Professional portfolio development
  • Opportunity to improve software skills
  • Networking with industry experts
  • Experience working in a collaborative environment
  • Better placement opportunities after graduation

For many students, the industry exposure and portfolio created during the internship are often more valuable than the stipend itself.

Selection Process

The recruitment process generally consists of multiple stages.

Step 1: Online Application

Candidates submit their applications through the official internship portal.

Step 2: Resume Screening

Recruiters review resumes to shortlist candidates whose educational background and skills match the internship requirements.

Step 3: Portfolio Review

Applicants are evaluated based on their portfolio, creativity, design quality, originality, and presentation.

Step 4: Interview

Shortlisted candidates may be invited for an online or offline interview where recruiters assess creativity, communication skills, and understanding of design principles.

Step 5: Final Selection

Candidates who successfully complete all stages receive an internship offer.

Documents Required

Applicants should keep the following documents ready:

  • Updated Resume
  • Design Portfolio
  • Educational Certificates
  • Government Identity Proof
  • Passport-size Photograph
  • College ID Card (if applicable)

How to Apply Online

Follow these simple steps to apply for the internship:

Step 1: Visit the official internship application page.

Step 2: Read the complete internship description carefully.

Step 3: Check whether you meet the eligibility criteria.

Step 4: Update your resume with your latest academic achievements and projects.

Step 5: Prepare a professional design portfolio showcasing your best work.

Step 6: Complete the online application form.

Step 7: Upload all required documents.

Step 8: Submit your application before the closing date.

After submission, regularly check your email for updates regarding the recruitment process.

Tips to Get Selected

Competition for design internships is usually high. Following these tips can improve your chances of selection:

  • Create a professional portfolio showcasing your best work.
  • Include branding, logo design, UI, posters, banners, and social media projects.
  • Focus on originality rather than copying online designs.
  • Learn Adobe Photoshop and Illustrator thoroughly.
  • Gain basic knowledge of Figma and UI design.
  • Keep your resume limited to one page.
  • Mention internships, freelance work, and personal projects.
  • Practice explaining your design decisions during interviews.
  • Learn the basics of typography, color theory, and branding.
  • Stay updated with modern design trends.

Career Opportunities After the Internship

Completing the Lenskart Graphic Design Internship can open doors to various career opportunities.

Possible job roles include:

  • Graphic Designer
  • Visual Designer
  • Brand Designer
  • Marketing Designer
  • UI Designer
  • Creative Associate
  • Digital Content Designer
  • Packaging Designer
  • Motion Graphics Designer
  • Product Designer

The experience gained during the internship can also help candidates secure positions in advertising agencies, startups, e-commerce companies, technology firms, and digital marketing agencies.

Why Should You Apply?

This internship offers much more than classroom learning.

You’ll gain:

  • Real corporate experience
  • Exposure to live marketing campaigns
  • Portfolio-worthy projects
  • Professional mentorship
  • Better understanding of branding
  • Industry networking opportunities
  • Improved employability after graduation

For aspiring graphic designers, internships like these can become the foundation of a successful creative career.

Important Links

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

Who can apply for the Lenskart Graphic Design Internship 2026?

Students pursuing relevant courses and fresh graduates with graphic design skills can apply.

Is the internship work-from-home?

No. The internship is conducted on-site at the Gurgaon office.

Which software should applicants know?

Knowledge of Adobe Photoshop, Adobe Illustrator, Adobe Creative Suite, and Figma is highly preferred.

Is a portfolio compulsory?

While not always mandatory, a strong portfolio significantly improves your chances of getting shortlisted.

Do freshers have a chance of selection?

Yes. Freshers with good design skills, creativity, and an impressive portfolio are encouraged to apply.

Will interns receive a certificate?

Most corporate internships provide an internship completion certificate after successfully completing the internship. Candidates should verify this on the official internship listing.

Conclusion

The Lenskart Graphic Design Internship 2026 is an excellent opportunity for students and fresh graduates who want to gain practical experience in graphic design, branding, and digital marketing. Working with one of India’s leading consumer brands enables interns to develop professional skills, contribute to live projects, and build a portfolio that can significantly improve future career opportunities.

If you’re passionate about design, enjoy creating visually engaging content, and want to work in a professional environment, this internship deserves your attention. Before applying, make sure your resume is updated, your portfolio showcases your best work, and your application is submitted as early as possible. A well-prepared application can greatly increase your chances of securing this valuable internship and taking the first step toward a successful career in graphic design.

title.rendered: AKTU Asks Affiliated Colleges to Register Students on Rojgar Sangam Portal 2026: Official Notice Released

content.rendered:
Students of Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University (AKTU) have received an important update that could benefit them during campus placements and future job opportunities. The university has issued an official notification directing all affiliated colleges and institutions to ensure the registration of eligible students on the Uttar Pradesh Rojgar Sangam Portal, the state’s official employment platform.

The circular has been issued in compliance with instructions from the Technical Education Department, Government of Uttar Pradesh. Through this initiative, AKTU aims to connect students with employment opportunities, job fairs, career guidance programmes and recruitment drives organized by the Employment Department.

For students preparing for placements after graduation, completing this registration could prove to be an important step in accessing future employment opportunities.

AKTU Releases Official Circular

According to the official notice issued on 17 June 2026, all AKTU-affiliated colleges have been instructed to complete the registration process for eligible students on the Rojgar Sangam Portal. Institutions have also been directed to submit the required student registration details through the Google Form shared by the university.

The university has requested colleges to complete this process at the earliest so that students can benefit from the employment services offered by the Uttar Pradesh Government.

What is the Rojgar Sangam Portal?

Rojgar Sangam is the official employment portal developed by the Uttar Pradesh Government to connect educated youth with government departments and private employers.

The portal serves as a centralized platform where registered candidates can receive information related to:

  • Government job vacancies
  • Private company recruitment
  • Apprenticeship opportunities
  • Campus placement drives
  • Employment fairs
  • Career counselling
  • Skill development programmes

By maintaining a verified employment profile, students can improve their visibility to employers looking for qualified candidates.

Why Has AKTU Issued This Notice?

Every year, thousands of technical graduates enter the job market. To simplify the recruitment process and improve employment opportunities, the Uttar Pradesh Government has instructed technical institutions to register their students on the Rojgar Sangam Portal.

The latest AKTU circular follows these government instructions and asks affiliated colleges to facilitate student registration without delay.

The objective is to create a centralized database of technically qualified students, making it easier for employers and government agencies to identify eligible candidates.

Who Should Register?

The notification is applicable to students studying in AKTU-affiliated institutions, including:

  • B.Tech
  • M.Tech
  • MBA
  • MCA
  • B.Pharm
  • M.Pharm
  • B.Arch
  • Diploma Courses
  • Other technical programmes under AKTU

Students should also follow any additional instructions issued by their respective colleges.

Benefits of Rojgar Sangam Registration

Students registered on the portal can receive several employment-related benefits.

Better Job Opportunities

Registered candidates become eligible to receive information about job openings from government departments and private companies.

Campus Recruitment Support

Companies participating in placement drives can identify eligible candidates through the portal.

Job Fairs

Students may receive invitations to employment fairs organized by the Employment Department.

Career Guidance

The portal also supports career counselling, training programmes and skill enhancement initiatives for registered candidates.

Single Employment Profile

Instead of creating profiles on multiple platforms, students can maintain one verified employment profile on the official government portal.

How to Register on the Rojgar Sangam Portal

Students can generally complete the registration process by following these steps:

Step 1: Visit the official Rojgar Sangam Portal.

Step 2: Click on New Registration.

Step 3: Enter your mobile number and personal details.

Step 4: Fill in your educational qualifications.

Step 5: Upload the required documents.

Step 6: Verify all information carefully.

Step 7: Submit your application.

Step 8: Share the registration details with your college if instructed.

Some institutions may complete the registration process through their placement cell or administration office.

Documents Required

Students may need the following documents while registering:

  • Aadhaar Card
  • Mobile Number
  • Email ID
  • Passport-size Photograph
  • Educational Qualification Details
  • Address Proof
  • Identity Proof

AKTU Notice Highlights

Important Links

Frequently Asked Questions

Is Rojgar Sangam registration mandatory for AKTU students?

AKTU has instructed affiliated colleges to register eligible students as per the directions issued by the Government of Uttar Pradesh. Students should follow the instructions provided by their respective institutions.

Who issued this notification?

The official notification has been issued by Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University (AKTU) based on directions received from the Technical Education Department, Government of Uttar Pradesh.

What is the purpose of the Rojgar Sangam Portal?

The portal connects job seekers with government departments, private employers, employment fairs, apprenticeship opportunities and career guidance services.

Can students register themselves?

Yes. Students can create their profile through the official Rojgar Sangam Portal unless their college follows a centralized registration process.

Final Words

The latest AKTU circular highlights the university’s commitment to improving employment opportunities for students graduating from affiliated technical institutions. By ensuring registration on the Uttar Pradesh Rojgar Sangam Portal, students can stay informed about recruitment drives, government vacancies, apprenticeships and other career opportunities offered through the state’s employment ecosystem.

Students are advised to stay in touch with their college administration or placement cell and complete the registration process as soon as instructed. Keeping an updated profile on the Rojgar Sangam Portal can significantly improve visibility among recruiters and help students access future employment opportunities.

title.rendered: AKTU URISE Placement Portal Registration 2026 Begins: Complete Registration Before June 30 to Access Placements and Internships

content.rendered:
Students of Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University (AKTU) have an important update regarding placements and internships. The university has officially launched the registration process for the URISE Placement Portal, a centralized platform designed to connect students with placement drives, internship opportunities, career guidance, and recruitment services.

According to the latest notification issued on 25 June 2026, all students studying in affiliated and constituent colleges of AKTU are required to complete their registration on the URISE Placement Portal on or before 30 June 2026. The university has also instructed every affiliated institution to ensure maximum student participation within the given timeline.

If you are pursuing B.Tech, MBA, MCA, Pharmacy, Architecture, or any other course under AKTU, this registration is an important step towards receiving placement and internship opportunities directly from the university.

What is the AKTU URISE Placement Portal?

The URISE Placement Portal is an online platform developed to strengthen the connection between AKTU students and employment opportunities. Through this portal, students will receive updates related to campus placements, internships, recruitment drives, skill development initiatives, and various career-related services.

Instead of relying on individual college notifications, registered students will have access to a centralized platform where upcoming opportunities can be shared more efficiently.

The university has encouraged every eligible student to complete the registration process without waiting for the deadline.

AKTU URISE Placement Portal Registration 2026: Highlights

Why Has AKTU Introduced the URISE Placement Portal?

Every year, thousands of AKTU students participate in placement drives conducted by leading companies. However, many students miss opportunities because they are unaware of ongoing recruitment activities or internship openings.

To solve this problem, AKTU has introduced a unified digital platform where students can stay informed about career opportunities throughout their academic journey.

The portal aims to provide students with easier access to:

  • Campus placement drives
  • Internship opportunities
  • Recruitment notifications
  • Career counselling initiatives
  • Industry interaction programmes
  • Skill development opportunities
  • Placement-related announcements

The initiative is expected to improve communication between students, colleges, recruiters, and the university.

Who Should Register?

The registration is meant for students studying in:

  • AKTU affiliated colleges
  • AKTU constituent institutions

The university has specifically requested Directors and Principals of all affiliated institutions to spread awareness among students and ensure that registrations are completed before the prescribed deadline.

Last Date for Registration

Students must complete their registration by 30 June 2026.

Since the registration window is limited, candidates are advised not to wait until the final day to avoid technical issues or heavy website traffic.

How to Register on the AKTU URISE Placement Portal

The registration process is simple and can be completed within a few minutes.

Step 1

Visit the official URISE student registration portal.

Registration Link: https://urise.up.gov.in/student/register

Step 2

Choose AKTU from the list of universities.

Step 3

Enter your AKTU Roll Number.

Step 4

Fill in your Date of Birth.

Step 5

Click on the Register button to complete the registration process.

These steps have been officially mentioned in the university notification.

Details Required During Registration

Students should keep the following information ready before beginning the registration process:

  • AKTU Roll Number
  • Date of Birth
  • Stable internet connection
  • Mobile phone or laptop

Benefits of Registering on the URISE Placement Portal

Students who complete their registration can stay updated with university-level placement activities and internship opportunities.

Some of the major advantages include:

  • Direct information about placement drives
  • Internship opportunities from various organizations
  • Career-related updates
  • Recruitment notifications
  • Better visibility for employment opportunities
  • Centralized student profile for placement activities

The portal is intended to streamline communication between students and recruiters while improving overall placement participation.

Instructions Issued to Colleges

The official circular also directs every affiliated and constituent institution to actively promote student registration.

College administrations have been requested to:

  • Inform all eligible students about the portal.
  • Ensure maximum registration before 30 June 2026.
  • Encourage students to complete registration as early as possible.

This reflects the university’s emphasis on increasing student participation in placement-related activities.

Why Students Should Register Immediately

Placement opportunities often have limited application windows. Students who are already registered are more likely to receive timely updates about recruitment drives and internship openings.

Completing the registration now ensures that your profile is available on the university’s centralized placement platform, helping you stay informed whenever new opportunities are announced.

Considering the approaching deadline, completing the registration today is the best way to avoid last-minute issues.

Official Notification Details

The notification has been issued by the Office of the Deputy Controller of Examination, Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University, Lucknow.

Reference Number: AKTU/CTPC/2026/1372

Notification Date: 25 June 2026

Important Links

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

What is the last date for AKTU URISE Placement Portal Registration 2026?

Students must complete their registration on or before 30 June 2026.

Who can register on the URISE Placement Portal?

Students studying in AKTU affiliated and constituent institutions are eligible to register.

Is there any registration fee?

The official notification only mentions the registration procedure and does not specify any registration fee.

What information is required for registration?

Students need their AKTU Roll Number and Date of Birth to complete the registration process.

Why is the URISE Placement Portal important?

The portal provides access to placement drives, internships, recruitment updates, and career-related services offered through the university.

Final Words

AKTU’s decision to introduce the URISE Placement Portal marks an important step towards improving career opportunities for students across affiliated colleges. By creating a centralized platform for placements and internships, the university aims to ensure that students receive timely information about recruitment drives and employment-related activities.

Students are strongly advised to complete their registration before 30 June 2026 and regularly monitor the portal for future placement and internship announcements. Registering now will help you stay connected with opportunities that could shape your professional career after graduation.

title.rendered: SBI PO Recruitment 2026 Notification Out for 1,500 Vacancies; Check Eligibility, Salary, Exam Dates and Apply Online Before July 8

content.rendered:
Every year, thousands of graduates across India dream of beginning their careers with the State Bank of India (SBI). The reason is simple—SBI is not only India’s largest public sector bank but also one of the country’s most trusted employers, offering excellent salary packages, structured career growth, and long-term job security.

That opportunity has arrived once again.

The State Bank of India has officially released the SBI PO Recruitment 2026 Notification, inviting online applications for 1,500 Probationary Officer (PO) vacancies. The recruitment drive is expected to attract lakhs of candidates from different educational backgrounds, making it one of the most competitive banking examinations of the year.

The online application process began on 18 June 2026 and will continue until 8 July 2026. Eligible graduates can submit their applications through the official SBI Careers portal after verifying their eligibility and completing the registration process.

Unlike many government jobs, the SBI PO role is known for combining financial stability with professional development. Selected officers receive extensive training, opportunities to work across different banking domains, exposure to digital banking technologies, and a clearly defined promotion pathway that can eventually lead to senior management positions.

Whether you are preparing for banking examinations for the first time or are an experienced aspirant, the SBI PO Recruitment 2026 presents an excellent opportunity to build a rewarding career in India’s banking sector.

SBI PO Recruitment 2026 Highlights

Why SBI PO Recruitment 2026 Matters

The banking sector remains one of the most preferred career choices for graduates due to its stability, competitive salary, and work-life balance. Among all banking recruitments, the SBI Probationary Officer examination enjoys a special reputation because of the career opportunities it offers.

A Probationary Officer is recruited as a Scale-I Officer and is trained to handle key banking operations, customer relationship management, credit processing, financial services, business development, and branch administration. Over time, officers gain exposure to corporate banking, treasury operations, digital banking, foreign exchange, risk management, and several specialized departments.

SBI also provides opportunities for international assignments through its overseas offices, making the career significantly more dynamic than many other public sector jobs.

Important Dates

Candidates planning to apply should keep track of all important events related to the recruitment process.

Candidates are advised not to wait until the final day to submit their applications, as heavy traffic on the portal often causes delays during the last few days of registration.

Important Links

SBI PO Vacancy 2026

This year’s recruitment includes 1,500 vacancies, including both regular and backlog positions. The vacancies have been distributed across different reservation categories as per Government of India guidelines.

Category-wise Vacancy Details

The notification also includes reservation for Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD), ensuring equal opportunities for eligible candidates under applicable government rules.

Who Can Apply?

One of the biggest advantages of SBI PO Recruitment is its broad eligibility criteria. Candidates from almost every educational background are eligible to apply.

Graduates from Arts, Science, Commerce, Engineering, Agriculture, Law, Management, Medical, Chartered Accountancy, Cost Accountancy, and other recognized disciplines can participate in the recruitment process.

Candidates who are currently in the final year or final semester of their graduation are also eligible to apply provisionally. However, they must produce proof of passing the qualifying examination on or before the date specified in the official notification.

This wide eligibility makes SBI PO one of the most inclusive officer-level recruitments conducted in India.

Educational Qualification

Applicants must possess a Bachelor’s Degree in any discipline from a recognized university or an equivalent qualification recognized by the Government of India.

Candidates with Integrated Dual Degree qualifications are also eligible, provided they meet the prescribed educational requirements.

Professional qualifications such as Engineering, Medical, Chartered Accountancy, and Cost Accountancy are also accepted.

SBI PO Age Limit

As per the official notification, the candidate’s age will be calculated as on 1 April 2026.

Applicants must be:

  • Minimum Age: 21 Years
  • Maximum Age: 30 Years

Reserved category candidates are eligible for age relaxation as per Government of India norms.

Age Relaxation

Candidates claiming reservation benefits should ensure that all supporting certificates are valid and available during the document verification process.

Application Fee

The application fee varies according to the candidate’s category.

The fee can be paid through online banking, debit card, credit card, or UPI. Once paid, the fee is non-refundable.

What Makes This Recruitment Different?

Unlike many recruitment notifications that simply announce vacancies, the SBI PO Recruitment is designed to identify future banking leaders. Selected candidates receive structured training, managerial responsibilities from the beginning of their careers, and access to one of India’s strongest professional development ecosystems.

Apart from financial benefits, SBI officers enjoy social recognition, excellent retirement benefits, opportunities to work in different parts of the country, and the chance to contribute directly to India’s growing financial system.

For graduates looking for a long-term, stable, and prestigious government career, SBI PO continues to be one of the best opportunities available today.

SBI PO Selection Process 2026

The State Bank of India follows a comprehensive three-stage selection process to identify candidates with strong analytical skills, decision-making ability, communication skills, and leadership potential. Unlike many other banking examinations, the SBI PO recruitment process evaluates candidates not only through written examinations but also through personality assessment and interviews.

Candidates must qualify each stage separately to move forward in the recruitment process.

Phase I: Preliminary Examination

The Preliminary Examination is the first stage of recruitment and acts as a screening test.

It consists of three objective sections:

The Preliminary Examination carries 100 marks. Candidates approximately ten times the number of vacancies in each category are shortlisted for the Main Examination based on merit.

One important feature of SBI PO is that there is no sectional cut-off in the Preliminary Examination. However, candidates should perform well in all three sections to secure a competitive overall score.

There is a penalty of 0.25 marks for every incorrect answer, while unanswered questions do not attract any negative marking.

Phase II: Main Examination

The Main Examination is the most important stage of the recruitment process because its marks contribute directly to the final merit list.

The examination consists of both Objective and Descriptive Tests.

Objective Test

Descriptive Test

Immediately after the Objective Test, candidates are required to appear for a descriptive examination.

The descriptive paper evaluates communication skills through:

  • Email Writing
  • Situation Analysis
  • Report Writing
  • Precis Writing

The descriptive section plays a significant role in assessing candidates’ written communication skills, which are essential for managerial responsibilities in banking.

Phase III: Psychometric Test, Group Exercise and Interview

Candidates shortlisted after the Main Examination are invited for the final stage.

This phase includes:

  • Psychometric Test
  • Group Exercise
  • Personal Interview

The Psychometric Test helps assess behavioural traits, leadership qualities, decision-making ability, and personality. The report generated from this assessment is considered by the interview panel during the selection process.

Marks Distribution

The final merit list is prepared after combining the normalized marks obtained in the Main Examination and the Interview stage. Marks secured in the Preliminary Examination are not considered for final selection.

SBI PO Exam Pattern at a Glance

Candidates should prepare according to the latest syllabus.

The examination mainly focuses on:

  • Quantitative Aptitude
  • Reasoning Ability
  • English Language
  • Computer Aptitude
  • Data Interpretation
  • Banking Awareness
  • Current Affairs
  • Economy
  • Business Awareness
  • Writing Skills

Developing speed, accuracy, and conceptual clarity is essential because the examination follows sectional timings and includes negative marking.

SBI PO Salary 2026

One of the biggest attractions of the SBI Probationary Officer recruitment is its excellent salary package.

The starting Basic Pay is ₹48,480, including four advance increments.

In addition to the basic salary, officers receive several allowances and benefits, making the overall compensation highly competitive.

Salary Structure

The salary package is revised periodically according to banking industry settlements, making SBI PO one of the highest-paying entry-level officer positions in the country.

Job Profile of an SBI Probationary Officer

An SBI Probationary Officer is trained to handle various responsibilities during the probation period.

Some of the major responsibilities include:

  • Managing daily banking operations
  • Customer relationship management
  • Loan processing and verification
  • Branch administration
  • Sales of banking products
  • Financial advisory services
  • Digital banking support
  • Team management
  • Compliance with banking regulations

The probation period provides practical exposure to different banking functions, helping officers develop managerial and operational expertise.

Career Growth After Joining SBI

The career progression available to an SBI PO is among the best in the banking sector.

Based on performance, departmental examinations, and experience, officers can rise through several senior positions.

Typical career progression includes:

  • Probationary Officer
  • Deputy Manager
  • Manager
  • Chief Manager
  • Assistant General Manager
  • Deputy General Manager
  • General Manager
  • Chief General Manager
  • Executive Director
  • Managing Director (through internal promotions and appointments)

Apart from promotions, officers also get opportunities to work in specialized verticals such as Corporate Banking, Treasury, International Banking, Digital Banking, Retail Banking, Risk Management, and Wealth Management.

Outstanding performers may also receive overseas postings in SBI’s international offices.

Service Bond

Candidates selected as Probationary Officers are required to execute a service bond of ₹2 lakh at the time of joining.

The bond requires the officer to serve the bank for a minimum period of three years. If an officer resigns before completing the prescribed period, the bond amount becomes payable according to the applicable terms.

Documents Required During Application

Candidates should keep the following documents ready before beginning the online application process:

  • Graduation Degree or Mark Sheets
  • Passport-size Photograph
  • Signature
  • Left Thumb Impression
  • Handwritten Declaration
  • Aadhaar Card or Government-issued Identity Proof
  • Category Certificate (if applicable)
  • Disability Certificate (if applicable)
  • Active Mobile Number
  • Valid Email Address

Ensuring that scanned documents meet the prescribed specifications can help avoid rejection during the online application process.

How to Apply for SBI PO Recruitment 2026

Candidates can complete their application in a few simple steps.

  1. Visit the official SBI Careers website.
  2. Open the Current Openings section.
  3. Click on Recruitment of Probationary Officers 2026.
  4. Register using your mobile number and email ID.
  5. Fill in the online application form carefully.
  6. Upload the required photograph, signature, thumb impression, and handwritten declaration.
  7. Pay the application fee using Debit Card, Credit Card, Internet Banking, or UPI.
  8. Verify all details before final submission.
  9. Download and save the confirmation page for future reference.

Expert Preparation Tips

Competition for SBI PO is expected to remain extremely high this year. Candidates should focus on building strong fundamentals instead of relying only on short-term preparation.

Some useful preparation strategies include:

  • Solve previous years’ SBI PO question papers.
  • Practice sectional mock tests regularly.
  • Read daily current affairs and banking news.
  • Improve reading comprehension and vocabulary.
  • Focus on Data Interpretation and Reasoning puzzles.
  • Develop typing speed for the descriptive examination.
  • Attempt full-length mock tests under exam conditions.
  • Revise regularly and analyze mistakes after every mock test.

A disciplined study plan combined with consistent practice can significantly improve the chances of clearing all three stages of the recruitment process.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

1. What is the last date to apply for SBI PO Recruitment 2026?

The online application process for SBI PO Recruitment 2026 started on 18 June 2026 and will close on 8 July 2026. Candidates are advised to complete their registration well before the deadline to avoid last-minute technical issues.

2. How many vacancies have been announced under SBI PO Recruitment 2026?

The State Bank of India has announced 1,500 Probationary Officer (PO) vacancies, including regular and backlog positions.

3. Who is eligible to apply for SBI PO Recruitment 2026?

Candidates who have completed graduation in any discipline from a recognized university are eligible to apply. Final-year students can also apply provisionally, subject to fulfilling the eligibility conditions mentioned in the official notification.

4. What is the age limit for SBI PO 2026?

Applicants must be between 21 and 30 years of age as on 1 April 2026. Age relaxation is available for reserved categories as per Government of India rules.

5. What is the application fee?

General, OBC, and EWS candidates are required to pay ₹750 as the application fee. Candidates belonging to SC, ST, and PwBD categories are exempted from paying the application fee.

6. What is the selection process for SBI PO Recruitment 2026?

The recruitment process consists of:

  • Preliminary Examination
  • Main Examination
  • Psychometric Test
  • Group Exercise
  • Personal Interview

Candidates must qualify each stage to be considered for final selection.

7. Is there negative marking in SBI PO Exam?

Yes. There is a negative marking of 0.25 marks for every incorrect answer in both the Preliminary and Main objective examinations.

8. What is the salary of an SBI Probationary Officer?

The starting basic pay is ₹48,480, while the approximate annual Cost to Company (CTC) at the Mumbai centre is ₹21.97 lakh, including allowances and benefits.

9. Can engineering graduates apply for SBI PO?

Yes. Engineering graduates, along with graduates from Arts, Commerce, Science, Law, Agriculture, Medical, Management, and other recognized disciplines, are eligible to apply.

10. Is SBI PO a permanent government job?

Yes. SBI PO is a permanent officer-level position in the State Bank of India, offering job security, attractive salary, regular promotions, pension benefits, and long-term career growth.

Common Mistakes Candidates Should Avoid

Every year, many applications are rejected due to avoidable mistakes. Candidates should carefully review their application before final submission.

Some common mistakes include:

  • Uploading photographs or signatures in the wrong format.
  • Entering incorrect personal or educational details.
  • Waiting until the last day to apply.
  • Using an inactive email address or mobile number.
  • Failing to verify uploaded documents.
  • Ignoring eligibility conditions mentioned in the notification.

Taking a few extra minutes to review the application can help avoid unnecessary complications during the recruitment process.

Why You Should Apply Early

Although the application window remains open until 8 July 2026, candidates should not wait until the final date.

Applying early offers several advantages:

  • Better chances of avoiding website congestion.
  • More time to correct any document-related issues.
  • Sufficient time to begin focused preparation.
  • Peace of mind before the examination schedule begins.

Early registration also ensures candidates receive updates regarding admit cards, examination centres, and important announcements without delay.

Expert Analysis

The SBI PO Recruitment 2026 is expected to witness intense competition because it combines three major advantages—career stability, attractive compensation, and exceptional growth opportunities.

Unlike many government jobs where promotions may take several years, SBI follows a structured promotion policy that rewards performance and professional development. Officers receive regular training, exposure to modern banking technologies, and opportunities to work across different banking verticals.

With India’s banking sector undergoing rapid digital transformation, SBI officers are increasingly involved in digital banking, financial inclusion, technology-driven services, and customer-centric innovations. This makes the role far more dynamic than traditional banking positions.

Candidates who begin preparation early, maintain consistency, and regularly practice mock tests are likely to have a significant advantage over last-minute aspirants.

Final Verdict

The SBI PO Recruitment 2026 presents one of the best career opportunities for graduates seeking a prestigious government job in the banking sector. With 1,500 vacancies, an excellent salary package, structured promotions, comprehensive training, and nationwide recognition, the Probationary Officer role continues to be a dream career for millions of aspirants.

The recruitment process is designed to identify future banking leaders who possess analytical ability, communication skills, leadership qualities, and a customer-centric approach. Therefore, candidates should not only focus on clearing the written examinations but also work on personality development, communication skills, and current affairs.

If you meet the eligibility criteria, complete your online application before 8 July 2026, gather all required documents in advance, and begin your preparation with a clear strategy. Consistent practice, effective time management, and regular revision will play a crucial role in securing a place in the final merit list.

As competition is expected to remain high this year, every day of preparation matters. Start early, stay focused, and aim for success in one of India’s most prestigious banking recruitment examinations.
