title.rendered: AKTU Draft AI Policy 2026: New Guidelines May Change How Students Use ChatGPT and AI Tools

content.rendered:
Artificial Intelligence has become a part of everyday student life. From solving coding errors and understanding difficult concepts to improving assignments and generating study notes, AI-powered tools like ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, and Copilot are increasingly being used by college students across India.

Recognizing this rapid shift, Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University (AKTU) has released a draft Artificial Intelligence Policy and invited suggestions from stakeholders before final implementation. The proposed framework aims to establish clear rules for how AI can be used in academics, research, examinations, and administrative work across the university and its affiliated colleges.

The move is being seen as one of the most significant steps taken by an Indian state university to address the growing role of artificial intelligence in higher education.

AKTU Releases Draft AI Policy for Students and Faculty

According to the university notification, AKTU is seeking feedback on its proposed Artificial Intelligence Policy before giving it final approval. The policy has been designed to create a balanced approach that encourages innovation while protecting academic integrity and student data.

The university’s draft framework aligns with several national initiatives, including the National Education Policy (NEP) 2020, IndiaAI Mission, UGC recommendations, AICTE guidelines, and India’s Digital Personal Data Protection Act (DPDPA).

As AI adoption continues to expand across educational institutions, AKTU’s initiative reflects a broader effort to prepare students for a technology-driven future while ensuring responsible use of emerging tools.

Why AKTU Felt the Need for an AI Policy

Over the past two years, generative AI tools have transformed how students learn and complete academic tasks. A few simple prompts can now generate essays, programming code, summaries, presentations, and even research assistance.

While these technologies offer clear benefits, they also raise important concerns.

Universities worldwide are facing challenges related to plagiarism, misinformation, fabricated citations, examination integrity, and misuse of confidential data. Without clear guidelines, students often remain unsure about what is acceptable and what could be considered academic misconduct.

AKTU’s proposed policy attempts to remove this confusion by defining how AI tools should be used responsibly within an academic environment.

Students May Continue Using AI for Learning

One of the most student-friendly aspects of the draft policy is that it does not seek to ban AI tools.

Instead, it recognizes that artificial intelligence can support learning when used appropriately.

Students may use AI-powered platforms for activities such as brainstorming ideas, improving language quality, understanding difficult concepts, debugging code, translating educational content, and generating practice questions for self-study.

This approach acknowledges a reality already visible across classrooms: AI has become an educational assistant for many learners.

However, the university emphasizes that students remain responsible for verifying the accuracy of information generated by these tools.

Transparency Could Become a Key Requirement

The draft policy places strong emphasis on transparency.

If AI tools contribute significantly to assignments, projects, reports, coding work, or research-related activities, students may be expected to disclose how the technology was used.

The university believes that transparency helps maintain trust in academic work while allowing students to benefit from modern technology.

Rather than hiding AI usage, students may need to acknowledge it openly whenever required.

This reflects a growing trend seen in universities around the world, where disclosure is becoming an important part of responsible AI usage.

Activities That Could Lead to Disciplinary Action

While the policy supports educational use of AI, it also identifies several practices that are considered unacceptable.

Students are prohibited from using AI during closed-book examinations, generating fake research findings, fabricating references, uploading confidential university content, or using AI to bypass plagiarism checks.

The draft policy makes it clear that academic integrity remains a non-negotiable principle.

AI may assist learning, but it cannot replace genuine effort, critical thinking, or original academic work.

Violations could attract penalties ranging from warnings and assessment penalties to more serious disciplinary action depending on the severity of the offence.

AKTU Wants Students to Become AI-Literate

Beyond regulation, the policy also highlights the importance of AI literacy.

AKTU envisions a future in which students graduate with a strong understanding of how artificial intelligence works, where it can be useful, and what risks it may create.

The proposed framework encourages awareness of topics such as:

  • AI ethics and responsible usage
  • Privacy and data protection
  • Algorithmic bias
  • AI hallucinations and misinformation
  • Intellectual property concerns
  • Critical evaluation of AI-generated content

These skills are increasingly becoming valuable in the modern job market, where employers expect graduates to understand emerging technologies.

Data Privacy Receives Special Attention

A major concern addressed in the draft policy is the protection of personal and institutional information.

The university advises against entering sensitive information into public AI systems.

This includes student records, examination papers, unpublished research data, financial documents, legal records, and other confidential information.

As AI platforms continue to collect and process large volumes of data, privacy awareness is becoming an essential digital skill for students and educators alike.

AI Could Open New Opportunities for Research and Innovation

The policy is not only about restrictions.

AKTU also outlines a vision for strengthening AI research, industry collaboration, and innovation ecosystems.

The university proposes initiatives that could support artificial intelligence research, machine learning projects, advanced computing infrastructure, and industry-academic partnerships.

For students interested in AI, data science, robotics, and emerging technologies, this could create new opportunities for skill development and research participation in the coming years.

What This Means for AKTU Students

The release of the Draft AI Policy 2026 signals that artificial intelligence is becoming a permanent part of higher education.

Instead of resisting technological change, AKTU appears to be focusing on responsible adoption. The university wants students to take advantage of AI’s benefits while maintaining honesty, transparency, and accountability.

For students, the message is straightforward: AI can be used as a powerful learning tool, but academic responsibility still belongs to the individual.

As the university reviews feedback and moves toward final implementation, the policy could shape how AI is used in classrooms, projects, research activities, and examinations across AKTU and affiliated colleges.

also read : AKTU Infosys Makers Lab Internship 2026: Shortlisted Students Asked to Report on June 22

Final Thoughts

Artificial Intelligence is reshaping education faster than most people expected. Universities now face the challenge of encouraging innovation while protecting academic standards.

AKTU’s Draft AI Policy 2026 represents an important step in that direction.

By allowing responsible AI use, promoting digital literacy, protecting data privacy, and reinforcing academic integrity, the university is attempting to create a framework that prepares students for an AI-driven future without compromising educational values.

The policy may still be in draft form, but its impact could influence thousands of students across Uttar Pradesh for years to come.

title.rendered: HBCSE–TIFR Recruitment 2026: A Rare Opportunity for Science Graduates and Researchers to Build a Career in Education

content.rendered:
For many students and young professionals, finding a job that combines science, education, and meaningful impact is not easy. Most opportunities are either limited to teaching roles or research positions with highly specialized requirements. However, a new recruitment announcement from the Homi Bhabha Centre for Science Education (HBCSE) may be worth paying attention to.

HBCSE, a constituent unit of the Tata Institute of Fundamental Research (TIFR), has invited applications for several permanent positions at its Mumbai campus. The recruitment includes vacancies for Scientific Officer, Scientific Assistant, Assistant Security Officer, and Work Assistant. The highest monthly emolument offered under this recruitment is ₹96,200.

What makes this recruitment stand out is not just the salary or the permanent nature of the jobs, but the institution behind it. HBCSE has played a major role in strengthening science and mathematics education in India and is widely known for its involvement in Olympiad programs, teacher training initiatives, and educational research.

Why HBCSE Matters

Ask any student who has participated in a Science Olympiad, and there is a good chance they have come across HBCSE in some form. The institution has been involved in nurturing young scientific talent for decades.

Apart from Olympiads, HBCSE works on curriculum development, science outreach, teacher education, astronomy programs, and research related to how students learn science. Its work directly influences classrooms, educators, and students across the country.

Joining such an institution offers a different kind of career experience. Employees are not just working for an organization—they are contributing to projects that can shape science education for future generations.

Vacancies Announced

According to the official notification, five vacancies have been announced under Advertisement No. 02/2026.

Although the number of vacancies is limited, positions at institutions like HBCSE often attract applicants who are genuinely interested in research, education, and public engagement rather than simply seeking a government job.

A Position for Those Interested in Astronomy and Science Outreach

One of the most interesting openings is the Scientific Officer position.

The selected candidate is expected to contribute to astronomy-related initiatives being conducted by HBCSE. These include programs linked to astronomy education, national and international outreach activities, Olympiad training, and undergraduate science development programs.

For candidates who have always enjoyed explaining science, conducting outreach activities, or working on educational projects, this role offers a chance to turn those interests into a profession.

Knowledge of scientific computing tools, Linux, Python, and a strong academic background in science or engineering would be useful for the role.

Good News for Fresh Graduates

Many recruitment notifications ask for several years of experience, which can be discouraging for recent graduates.

This recruitment is different.

For one of the Scientific Assistant positions, fresh graduates with a background in Physics are eligible to apply. The work includes supporting Physics Olympiad activities, educational content development, workshops, and training programs for students.

For someone who recently completed a B.Sc. in Physics and is unsure whether to pursue higher studies or begin working, this could be an excellent opportunity to gain experience in a respected academic environment.

More Than a Traditional Workplace

People often associate research institutions with laboratories and technical projects. While those aspects certainly exist, HBCSE’s work goes much further.

The organization regularly interacts with teachers, schools, colleges, and students. It develops educational materials, conducts workshops, organizes training programs, and works on innovative ways to improve science learning.

As a result, employees often find themselves involved in a variety of activities rather than being restricted to a single routine task.

Application Deadline

Candidates interested in applying should not delay the process. The institute has stated that online applications will be accepted until 11 July 2026.

Since applications are accepted only through the online mode, applicants should complete the process well before the closing date to avoid last-minute issues.

Who Should Consider Applying?

This recruitment may be particularly suitable for:

  • Physics graduates looking for meaningful academic work.
  • Engineering graduates interested in science education.
  • Candidates preparing for careers in research and outreach.
  • Individuals passionate about teaching and learning.
  • Professionals seeking a long-term position in a reputed institution.

Even candidates who are not actively searching for jobs may find the nature of the work appealing because of the institution’s reputation and impact.

Final Thoughts

Every year, thousands of job notifications are released across the country. Most of them focus primarily on vacancies, salaries, and eligibility criteria. The HBCSE–TIFR Recruitment 2026 feels different because it offers an opportunity to be part of an institution that has influenced science education in India for decades.

For candidates who believe education and research can create lasting change, this recruitment may be more than just another application—it could be the beginning of a meaningful career journey.

title.rendered: Fully Funded PhD Opportunities in Germany 2026: Apply for DAAD and University of Freiburg Research Positions

content.rendered:
Fully Funded PhD Opportunities in Germany 2026: Germany has long been one of the most preferred destinations for higher education and research. With world-class universities, advanced research facilities, and attractive funding opportunities, the country continues to welcome talented students from around the globe. If you are planning to pursue a PhD abroad in 2026, several fully funded doctoral positions are currently open across Germany in fields ranging from Artificial Intelligence and Engineering to Social Sciences and History.

These opportunities not only provide financial support but also allow students to work on impactful research projects under the guidance of experienced professors and researchers. Here is a look at some of the latest fully funded PhD openings available through the DAAD PhDGermany platform and the University of Freiburg.

PhD Student – Automated Mineralogy and Mineral Processing

The Helmholtz Institute Freiberg for Resource Technology (HIF) is inviting applications for a fully funded PhD position focused on automated mineralogy and mineral processing. The project aims to develop advanced particle-based mineral characterization methods and improve mineral processing models using modern data-driven approaches.

This opportunity is ideal for candidates with academic backgrounds in Mineral Engineering, Resource Technology, Process Engineering, Data Science, and related disciplines. Researchers will gain hands-on experience working with innovative technologies and advanced analytical tools used in the mining and resource sectors.

Application Deadline: 04 July 2026

Research Associate / PhD Student in AI and Agentic Software Engineering

Artificial Intelligence is transforming the future of technology, and Germany is investing heavily in AI research. Clausthal University of Technology has announced a Research Associate and PhD Student position focusing on Artificial Intelligence, Agentic AI Systems, and Model-Based Software Engineering.

This research opportunity is particularly attractive for students interested in next-generation AI systems capable of autonomous decision-making and intelligent software development. Candidates with qualifications in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Software Engineering, Data Science, or Information Technology are encouraged to apply.

The position offers the chance to work on cutting-edge AI research while pursuing a fully funded doctoral degree in Germany.

PhD Position in Computational Tribology

The University of Freiburg, in collaboration with Fraunhofer IWM, is offering a fully funded PhD position in Computational Tribology. The project focuses on continuum modeling of boundary lubrication and molecular dynamics simulations to better understand friction and wear in engineering systems.

Students with backgrounds in Physics, Mechanical Engineering, Materials Science, Chemistry, and Computational Modeling will find this position particularly relevant. The research has practical applications in industries such as automotive engineering, manufacturing, and advanced materials development.

Application Deadline: 15 July 2026

University of Freiburg Opens Four Fully Funded PhD Positions

In addition to the opportunities mentioned above, the prestigious Albert-Ludwigs University of Freiburg has announced four fully funded doctoral positions under its Graduate Research Training Group (GRK 2571) titled “Empires: Dynamic Transformation, Temporality and Post-Imperial Orders.”

This interdisciplinary program brings together scholars from various fields to study the transformation of empires, their institutions, economies, and the development of post-imperial societies. The positions are fully funded and offer excellent research support for selected candidates.

Key Details

Research Fields Available

Applications are invited from candidates specializing in:

  • Political Science
  • Sociology
  • Islamic Studies
  • East Asian History
  • North American and Transatlantic History
  • Modern European History
  • Medieval History
  • Roman History

The program welcomes applications from international students and encourages diversity among its research community.

Benefits of These PhD Positions

One of the biggest advantages of pursuing a PhD in Germany is that many doctoral candidates are employed as research staff and receive a monthly salary rather than relying solely on scholarships.

Selected candidates can benefit from:

  • Fully funded doctoral studies
  • Competitive salary under German pay scales
  • International research opportunities
  • Funding for conferences and academic travel
  • Access to world-class research facilities
  • Supervision by experienced professors
  • Strong academic and professional networking opportunities

The University of Freiburg program also offers funding for research stays of up to six months at partner institutions abroad, allowing students to expand their international research experience.

Documents Required

Applicants are generally required to submit:

  • Motivation Letter
  • Updated CV
  • Academic Certificates
  • Transcripts
  • Research Proposal
  • Academic References

For the University of Freiburg positions, applicants must also submit a detailed research proposal explaining their planned doctoral project, research questions, methodology, and expected outcomes.

Important Apply Links

Why Consider Germany for a PhD?

Germany offers an excellent combination of academic excellence, research funding, innovation, and career opportunities. Most universities maintain strong collaborations with industries and research institutes, allowing doctoral students to work on real-world challenges while developing advanced research skills.

Additionally, Germany’s international environment, affordable living costs compared to many Western countries, and globally recognized degrees make it one of the best destinations for doctoral studies.

title.rendered: ISRO URSC Internship 2026 Applications Reopen on 3 August: Check Eligibility, Duration, Documents & Apply Process

content.rendered:
ISRO URSC Internship 2026: If you are an engineering, science, or technology student dreaming of gaining practical experience at ISRO, here’s some exciting news. The U R Rao Satellite Centre (URSC), one of the most important centers of the Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO), has announced that the next application window for its student internship program will open on 3 August 2026 at 10:00 AM.

The internship program is designed to give students real-world exposure to research and development activities carried out at URSC. With limited seats available and selection being made on a first-come, first-served basis, interested students should be ready to apply as soon as the application portal opens.

About URSC Internship Program

The U R Rao Satellite Centre, located in Bengaluru, plays a crucial role in the design, development, and testing of satellites used in various ISRO missions. As part of the National Education Policy (NEP) 2020 and its commitment to promoting experiential learning, URSC offers internship opportunities to students from recognized universities and institutions.

Through this internship, students get an opportunity to understand how advanced technologies are used in India’s space missions and satellite programs. While the internship does not offer any stipend, the exposure and learning experience make it one of the most sought-after internship opportunities in the country.

ISRO URSC Internship 2026 Highlights

Who Can Apply?

Students from undergraduate, postgraduate, and doctoral programs can apply for the internship, provided they meet the eligibility conditions specified by URSC.

To be eligible, applicants must be Indian citizens and should be pursuing a UG, PG, or PhD program from a recognized university or institution in India or abroad.

Students who have recently completed their UG or PG degree can also apply, provided they seek the internship opportunity within six months of completing their course.

Applicants must be enrolled in a regular on-campus academic program. Additionally, students who have completed their degree through regular on-campus mode are also eligible.

One important requirement is academic performance. Candidates should have secured at least 60% aggregate marks or a CGPA of 6.32 on a 10-point scale.

For undergraduate students, applications are accepted only from those studying in the 5th semester or third year onwards.

Internship Duration

The internship duration at URSC is flexible depending on the assigned work and project requirements.

  • Minimum Duration: 15 Days
  • Maximum Duration: 45 Days

Students will be assigned internship work based on project availability, facility availability, and the relevance of their academic background to the work being carried out at URSC.

Important Things Students Should Know

Before applying, students should carefully understand a few important points.

The allotment of internships is strictly based on the availability of projects and infrastructure. Even if a student meets all eligibility criteria, selection depends on whether a suitable project is available.

URSC has also clarified that internships are allotted on a first-come, first-served basis. Since the number of available slots is limited, applying early significantly improves the chances of securing a position.

Students should also note that no financial assistance will be provided during the internship. This means there will be:

  • No stipend
  • No accommodation facility
  • No transport facility
  • No canteen facility

Candidates must arrange their own stay and daily expenses during the internship period.

Documents Required for Application

Students need to upload the following documents while submitting the online application:

Marksheets

Applicants must upload marksheets of all previous semesters completed at the time of application.

Updated Resume

A professional resume containing educational qualifications, projects, technical skills, certifications, and achievements should be submitted.

Permission Letter from College

Students must obtain a request or permission letter from their Principal or Head of Department (HOD).

The letter should:

  • Clearly mention the internship duration.
  • Be signed by the authorized college official.
  • Carry the official seal of the institution.

Applications submitted without a valid permission letter may not be considered.

Current Application Status

URSC has informed that the previous internship application window for the period from 01 July 2026 to 30 September 2026 has already been closed because the number of applications exceeded the processing capacity.

The next application window will reopen on:

Date: 3 August 2026
Time: 10:00 AM

Selected candidates under this cycle will be considered for internships scheduled between 01 October 2026 and 31 December 2026.

Student Project Trainee Scheme

Apart from internships, URSC also offers opportunities for students to carry out final-year project work as part of their academic curriculum.

The eligibility requirements are different for various courses.

Just like the internship program, project allotment depends on project availability, infrastructure, and suitability of the student’s academic background.

Students selected under this scheme will also not receive any stipend or accommodation support.

Important Links

Why This Internship Matters

For many students, an internship at ISRO is more than just a training program. It offers an opportunity to observe how one of the world’s leading space agencies operates and develops technologies that contribute to India’s space missions.

Students interested in satellite systems, electronics, computer science, artificial intelligence, data science, aerospace engineering, mechanical engineering, and related disciplines can benefit immensely from the practical exposure provided by URSC.

The experience gained during the internship can strengthen a student’s resume, improve technical understanding, and provide valuable insights into research and development careers.

Final Words

The ISRO URSC Internship 2026 is an excellent opportunity for students who want to gain exposure to India’s space technology ecosystem. With applications reopening on 3 August 2026 and seats being allocated on a first-come, first-served basis, students should prepare their documents in advance and be ready to apply as soon as the portal opens.

Although the internship does not provide a stipend or accommodation, the chance to learn within one of ISRO’s most prestigious centers makes it a highly valuable experience for aspiring engineers, researchers, and technology professionals.

The advisory follows recommendations from AICTE and highlights the importance of internships in preparing students for the professional world.

For many students, internships are often the first step toward understanding how the industry actually works. Through PMIS, the Government of India aims to make that journey easier by connecting students with organizations where they can gain practical experience, build skills, and improve their employability.

A Step Beyond Classroom Learning

College education provides theoretical knowledge, but employers today also look for practical skills and real-world exposure. Recognizing this need, the Prime Minister Internship Scheme has been designed to help students experience professional work environments before they graduate.

According to the advisory, the scheme offers internship opportunities in leading organizations across different sectors, allowing students to learn directly from industry professionals and understand workplace expectations.

For students who often wonder how their classroom concepts are applied in actual projects, such internships can provide valuable answers.

Why AKTU Is Promoting PMIS

AKTU has emphasized that internships are no longer just an optional activity; they have become an important part of career preparation. The university has therefore asked affiliated institutions to create awareness about PMIS and ensure that eligible students do not miss out on available opportunities.

The advisory also aligns with AICTE’s Internship Policy, which recognizes industry internships as an important component of technical and professional education.

Colleges Asked to Take Active Responsibility

Rather than simply sharing a notification, AKTU has instructed colleges to actively support students throughout the process.

Institutions have been asked to publicize the scheme through their websites, notice boards, social media channels, departmental groups, and other communication platforms. Awareness sessions and guidance programs are also encouraged so that students clearly understand the benefits and application process.

This is particularly important because many students miss internship opportunities simply due to a lack of information.

Placement Cells Will Play a Key Role

Training and Placement Officers (TPOs) have been assigned a major responsibility under this initiative. They will act as coordinators and help students with registration, participation, and guidance related to PMIS.

For students who are unsure about internship procedures or documentation requirements, placement cells will serve as the primary point of support.

Internship Work May Receive Academic Recognition

One of the most encouraging aspects of the advisory is that internships completed under PMIS may be considered under the AICTE Internship Policy and relevant academic regulations.

This means students may receive academic recognition or credits wherever applicable under institutional norms.

Such recognition ensures that students are rewarded not only with experience but also with academic value for the time they invest in internships.

No Delays in NOC Approval

Students often face difficulties when internship opportunities require a No Objection Certificate (NOC) from their college. To address this issue, AKTU has instructed institutions to process NOC requests in a transparent and timely manner.

The university has specifically asked colleges to avoid unnecessary delays that could prevent students from participating in internship programs.

Special Focus on Final-Year Students

The advisory places particular emphasis on final-year undergraduate and postgraduate students. Colleges have been encouraged to identify eligible students and motivate them to apply for PMIS opportunities.

For final-year students preparing to enter the job market, internship experience can often make the difference between being shortlisted for an interview and being overlooked.

How Students Can Benefit

The value of internships extends far beyond a certificate. Students participating in PMIS can gain:

  • Real industry exposure
  • Practical knowledge and workplace experience
  • Better communication and professional skills
  • Stronger resumes
  • Improved job readiness
  • Networking opportunities with professionals
  • Greater confidence before entering full-time employment

Many recruiters today consider internship experience as a sign that a candidate can adapt quickly to workplace environments.

What Students Should Do Now

Students interested in taking advantage of this opportunity should stay connected with their college placement cell and regularly check official notices issued by their institutions.

They should also keep important documents ready and remain alert for internship announcements and application deadlines.

also read : DRDO Scientist Recruitment 2026 Notification Out for 33 Vacancies – Apply Online

Final Thoughts

The Prime Minister Internship Scheme represents a valuable opportunity for students to move beyond textbooks and gain practical exposure in professional environments. By issuing this advisory, AKTU has made it clear that internships are becoming an increasingly important part of higher education and career development.

For students looking to strengthen their skills, improve employability, and gain real-world experience before graduation, PMIS could be a significant stepping stone toward a successful future.

title.rendered: Coal India MT Recruitment 2026: Apply Online for 660 Management Trainee Posts, Salary Up to ₹1.80 Lakh

content.rendered:
Coal India Limited (CIL), a Maharatna Public Sector Undertaking under the Ministry of Coal, Government of India, has released the official notification for Coal India MT Recruitment 2026. The recruitment drive aims to fill 660 Management Trainee (MT) vacancies across multiple engineering and non-engineering disciplines.

Candidates who are looking for a prestigious PSU job with excellent salary, job security, and career growth can apply online through the official recruitment portal. The online application process is currently active and interested candidates should submit their applications before the deadline.

In this article, we have covered all the important details including eligibility criteria, vacancy distribution, age limit, salary, selection process, application fee, and direct apply link.

Coal India MT Recruitment 2026 Overview

About Coal India Limited

Coal India Limited is the world’s largest coal-producing company and one of India’s largest employers. The company operates under the Ministry of Coal and contributes approximately 75% of India’s coal production. Working at Coal India provides candidates with excellent opportunities for professional growth, attractive compensation, and long-term career stability.

Coal India MT Vacancy 2026

A total of 660 vacancies have been announced for various disciplines.

The number of vacancies is tentative and may increase or decrease depending on organizational requirements.

Eligibility Criteria

Before applying, candidates should carefully check the educational qualifications required for their respective disciplines.

Civil Engineering

Degree in Civil Engineering with minimum 60% marks.

Electrical Engineering

Degree in Electrical Engineering with minimum 60% marks.

Mechanical Engineering

Degree in Mechanical Engineering with minimum 60% marks.

System

First Class BE/B.Tech/B.Sc (Engineering) in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, or First Class Degree with MCA.

Electronics & Telecommunication

BE/B.Tech/B.Sc (Engineering) in relevant discipline with minimum 60% marks.

Geology

M.Sc. or M.Tech. in Geology, Applied Geology, Geophysics, or Applied Geophysics with minimum 60% marks.

Industrial Engineering

Degree in Industrial Engineering with minimum 60% marks.

Rajbhasha (Hindi)

MA in Hindi with minimum 60% marks and Graduation with Hindi and English as main subjects.

Company Secretary

Graduate in any discipline with Associate/Fellow Membership of ICSI.

Candidates appearing in the final semester or final year of the academic session 2025-26 can also apply, subject to fulfilling the eligibility conditions.

Coal India MT Recruitment 2026 Age Limit

The upper age limit is 30 years as on 30 April 2026.

Age Relaxation

There is no age limit for regular employees of Coal India and its subsidiaries.

Application Fee

Candidates belonging to General, OBC, and EWS categories are required to pay the prescribed application fee.

The fee must be paid online through the payment gateway available during the application process.

Selection Process

One of the biggest advantages of this recruitment is that there is no interview stage.

The selection process consists of:

  1. Computer Based Test (CBT)
  2. Document Verification
  3. Initial Medical Examination

The final merit list will be prepared solely on the basis of marks obtained in the Computer Based Test.

Coal India MT Exam Pattern 2026

The Computer Based Test will be conducted in online mode.

Key Features

  • Duration: 3 Hours
  • Total Questions: 200
  • 100 Questions in each Paper
  • 1 Mark for each Correct Answer
  • No Negative Marking
  • Questions available in Hindi and English

Minimum Qualifying Marks

Coal India MT Salary 2026

Selected candidates will be appointed as Management Trainees in E-1 Grade.

Pay Scale

₹60,000 – ₹1,80,000

The starting basic pay during training will be ₹60,000 per month.

Apart from the basic salary, candidates will receive:

  • Dearness Allowance (DA)
  • House Rent Allowance (HRA)
  • Performance Related Pay (PRP)
  • Medical Benefits
  • Leave Benefits
  • Gratuity
  • Pension Benefits
  • CMPF Benefits
  • Other Company Perks

After successful completion of one year of training and probation, candidates will be confirmed as Officers in their respective disciplines.

Service Bond Details

Candidates selected through Coal India MT Recruitment 2026 will be required to execute a service bond of ₹3 lakh.

The minimum service period is 60 months (5 years) from the date of joining. The bond amount will be refunded after successful completion of the bond period as per company policy.

Documents Required

Candidates should keep the following documents ready before filling out the application form:

  • Passport Size Photograph
  • Signature
  • Class 10th Certificate
  • Degree Certificate
  • Semester Mark Sheets
  • Category Certificate (if applicable)
  • EWS Certificate (if applicable)
  • PwBD Certificate (if applicable)
  • NOC from Employer (for Government Employees)
  • Experience Certificate (if applicable)

How to Apply for Coal India MT Recruitment 2026

Step 1

Visit the official application portal.

Step 2

Complete the registration process using your mobile number and email ID.

Step 3

Verify the OTP sent to your registered mobile number and email address.

Step 4

Fill in personal, educational, and communication details.

Step 5

Upload photograph, signature, and required documents.

Step 6

Pay the application fee, if applicable.

Step 7

Submit the application form and download a copy for future reference.

Candidates are advised to apply well before the last date to avoid server congestion and technical issues.

Important Links

Why You Should Apply?

Coal India Limited is among the most sought-after Public Sector Undertakings in India. The company offers attractive salary packages, excellent work-life balance, job security, medical benefits, pension benefits, and opportunities to work across different regions of the country.

With 660 vacancies available and no interview stage, this recruitment presents a golden opportunity for engineering graduates and other eligible candidates to secure a prestigious government job.

also read : DRDO Scientist Recruitment 2026 Notification Out for 33 Vacancies – Apply Online

Conclusion

The Coal India MT Recruitment 2026 notification has opened the door to one of the biggest PSU recruitment drives of the year. Candidates meeting the eligibility criteria should complete their application process before 11 June 2026 and begin preparing for the Computer Based Test.

A career with Coal India not only offers financial stability but also provides a platform to contribute to India’s energy sector while building a successful professional future.

title.rendered: DRDO Scientist Recruitment 2026: 33 Scientist Vacancies Announced by RAC, Check Eligibility & Apply Online

content.rendered:
The Defence Research and Development Organisation (DRDO) has officially invited applications for the recruitment of Scientists under the Defence Research & Development Service (DRDS). Through Advertisement No. 157, the Recruitment & Assessment Centre (RAC) has announced 33 vacancies for Scientist ‘C’, Scientist ‘D’, and Scientist ‘E’ positions across multiple engineering and scientific disciplines. Candidates with relevant qualifications and professional experience can submit their applications online through the RAC portal before 19 June 2026 (4:00 PM).

This recruitment presents an excellent opportunity for professionals who wish to work on advanced defence technologies, strategic research programs, aerospace systems, artificial intelligence applications, communication technologies, weapon systems, and other critical national projects.

DRDO Scientist Recruitment 2026 Highlights

DRDO Scientist Vacancy 2026

The vacancies are distributed among different scientist grades as follows:

Selected candidates will also receive Dearness Allowance (DA), House Rent Allowance (HRA), Transport Allowance, Medical Facilities, Leave Benefits, Pension Benefits, and other Central Government perks as applicable.

Disciplines Available Under DRDO Recruitment 2026

DRDO is recruiting experienced professionals from a wide range of engineering and science backgrounds.

Why This Recruitment Matters

DRDO is one of India’s most prestigious research organizations and plays a crucial role in developing indigenous defence technologies. Scientists recruited through this notification will contribute to projects involving:

  • Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning
  • Aerospace and Missile Systems
  • Advanced Communication Technologies
  • Radar and Electronic Warfare Systems
  • Naval Defence Technologies
  • Remote Sensing and Geospatial Intelligence
  • Optical and Photonics Technologies
  • High-Performance Computing
  • Defence Electronics
  • Strategic Weapon Systems

Working with DRDO provides an opportunity to directly contribute to India’s technological self-reliance and national security objectives.

Educational Qualification

The educational requirements vary according to the post and discipline. Candidates must possess a First Division degree from a recognized university.

Equivalent disciplines mentioned in the official notification are also eligible for consideration.

Experience Requirement

Since the recruitment is being conducted under the lateral entry scheme, relevant work experience is mandatory.

The experience should be related to research, design, development, testing, software engineering, production, scientific investigation, or technology development in the respective discipline.

Opportunities for AI, ML and Software Professionals

One of the most attractive aspects of this notification is the inclusion of positions related to emerging technologies.

Several Scientist C positions specifically require expertise in:

  • Artificial Intelligence (AI)
  • Machine Learning (ML)
  • Deep Learning
  • Data Processing
  • Scientific Computing
  • Python Programming
  • TensorFlow
  • PyTorch
  • Software Engineering
  • High Performance Computing
  • Embedded Systems

Professionals working in these domains can leverage their expertise in defence applications and advanced research environments.

Career Growth at DRDO

DRDO follows the Flexible Complementing Scheme (FCS), which provides a unique career progression mechanism. Unlike traditional government services where promotions depend largely on vacancies, FCS allows scientists to advance based on performance, achievements, and professional assessments.

This system ensures faster growth opportunities for deserving candidates and encourages innovation, research excellence, and continuous learning.

Selection Process

The selection process is designed to identify highly qualified and experienced professionals.

Candidates with higher qualifications, patents, publications, project experience, and specialized technical expertise may have an advantage during shortlisting.

How to Apply for DRDO Scientist Recruitment 2026

Interested candidates can submit their applications online by following the steps below:

Candidates are advised not to wait until the last day because heavy traffic may affect the application process.

Important Dates

Documents Required

Before starting the application process, candidates should keep the following documents ready:

  • Educational Certificates and Mark Sheets
  • Experience Certificates
  • Valid Photo Identity Proof
  • Passport Size Photograph
  • Signature
  • Category Certificate (if applicable)
  • Research Publications (if applicable)
  • Professional Certifications

Why Candidates Prefer DRDO Careers

Apart from competitive salaries and government benefits, DRDO offers exposure to cutting-edge technologies and national-level projects. Scientists get opportunities to collaborate with leading researchers, defence experts, academic institutions, and strategic organizations.

The combination of research, innovation, job security, and national service makes DRDO one of the most sought-after organizations among engineers and scientists in India.

Final Words

The DRDO Scientist Recruitment 2026 notification is a significant opportunity for experienced engineers, researchers, and technology professionals who aspire to work on advanced defence and strategic research projects. With 33 vacancies across multiple disciplines, attractive pay scales, excellent career progression, and the prestige of serving in India’s premier defence research organization, this recruitment is expected to attract top talent from across the country.

Eligible candidates should review the official notification carefully and complete the online application process before 19 June 2026.

title.rendered: TalentBrainy Software Developer Intern 2026: ₹7,000/Month Stipend Internship Open for Students

content.rendered:
Students looking for a software development internship can now apply for the TalentBrainy Software Developer Intern 2026 program. Listed on the AICTE Internship Portal, this opportunity offers students a chance to work on real-world software projects while earning a monthly stipend of ₹7,000.

The internship is open to candidates from any specialization, making it a good opportunity for students who want to gain practical experience in software development and strengthen their technical skills.

Internship Highlights

About the Internship

Getting hands-on experience is one of the best ways to learn software development. Through this internship, selected candidates will work on software solutions and gain exposure to real project environments.

According to the internship description, interns will be involved in designing, developing, and maintaining software applications. They will also work with different teams to improve application performance and user experience.

For students who have mainly learned programming through classroom assignments or online courses, this internship can provide valuable industry exposure.

Roles and Responsibilities

As a Software Developer Intern, you may be expected to:

  • Assist in developing software applications.
  • Work on implementing new features.
  • Help optimize application performance.
  • Participate in testing and maintenance activities.
  • Collaborate with development, design, and content teams.
  • Learn industry-standard software development practices.
  • Contribute to ongoing live projects.

The internship focuses on practical learning and project-based experience, which can be useful for future placements and job opportunities.

Perks and Benefits

TalentBrainy is offering several benefits to selected interns, including:

  • Verified Internship Certificate
  • QR-Verified Certificate
  • Offer Letter
  • LinkedIn Mastering Guide
  • Opportunity to work on real-time projects
  • Potential Job Offer based on performance

These benefits can help students build a stronger professional profile and improve their chances during future recruitment drives.

Who Can Apply?

The internship is open to candidates from any academic background and specialization.

You can apply if:

  • You are interested in software development and technology.
  • You are available for the complete 2-month internship period.
  • You want to gain practical experience by working on projects.
  • You are willing to learn and improve your technical skills.

Both students and freshers can consider applying for this opportunity.

Stipend and Performance-Based Rewards

Selected interns will receive a stipend of ₹7,000 per month during the internship period.

Additionally, TalentBrainy has mentioned that the top-performing interns may receive a stipend of up to ₹10,000 based on their performance. The organization also offers an opportunity to continue working on live projects through an extended internship program of up to six months.

Why This Internship Matters

Many students struggle to find opportunities that provide practical learning along with mentorship and project exposure. This internship aims to bridge that gap by allowing interns to work on real development tasks rather than only theoretical assignments.

Whether you are preparing for campus placements, building your portfolio, or simply trying to gain industry experience, internships like this can play an important role in career development.

How to Apply

Interested candidates can apply through the AICTE Internship Portal before the deadline.

Important Links

Final Thoughts

The TalentBrainy Software Developer Intern 2026 program is a good opportunity for students who want to gain practical software development experience while earning a stipend. With 30 openings, industry exposure, certificates, and performance-based rewards, interested candidates should consider applying before 17 July 2026.

If you are looking to strengthen your resume and gain hands-on experience in software development, this internship could be worth exploring.

title.rendered: IIT Madras BS in Data Science and Applications 2026: Admissions Open for India’s Leading Online Data Science Degree

content.rendered:
IIT Madras BS in Data Science and Applications 2026: The Indian Institute of Technology Madras (IIT Madras) has opened applications for its highly sought-after BS in Data Science and Applications programme. Recognized as one of the most innovative higher education initiatives in India, the programme offers students and working professionals an opportunity to earn an IIT degree while studying online from anywhere in the world.

With more than 36,000 learners currently enrolled, the programme has become a preferred choice for students interested in Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Programming, and Business Analytics.

About the Programme

The BS in Data Science and Applications is a four-year undergraduate degree designed and delivered by IIT Madras. The programme combines academic rigor with flexibility, allowing learners to study at their own pace while gaining industry-relevant skills.

A unique feature of the programme is its multiple exit options. Depending on their academic progress and career goals, learners can exit with a Foundation Certificate, Diploma, BSc Degree, or complete the full BS Degree.

Why IIT Madras BS Degree Stands Out

Over the last few years, the programme has attracted learners from diverse educational and professional backgrounds.

  • More than 36,000 students are currently enrolled.
  • Over 20,000 learners are pursuing the BS programme alongside another degree.
  • More than 3,000 working professionals are studying while continuing their careers.
  • Over 850 learners have secured admission to Master’s and PhD programmes in India and abroad.
  • More than 20 students achieved Top 100 ranks in the GATE 2024 examination.

The programme has also received international recognition, earning the Best Online Program award from QS Reimagine Education and The Wharton School, University of Pennsylvania.

Eligibility Criteria

One of the biggest advantages of the IIT Madras BS Degree is its accessibility.

Anyone who has successfully completed Class 12 or an equivalent qualification can apply. There is no upper age limit, making the programme suitable for students, professionals, entrepreneurs, and lifelong learners.

Currently, the age of enrolled learners ranges from 17 years to 81 years.

Flexible Learning Experience

The programme is designed to accommodate different learning needs and schedules.

Students receive access to:

  • High-quality recorded lectures
  • Live interactive sessions
  • Weekly online assignments
  • Discussion forums and peer learning groups
  • Regular assessments and in-person quizzes

This blended learning model allows learners to balance education with college studies, jobs, or other commitments.

Curriculum Designed for Industry Requirements

The curriculum has been developed to meet the growing demand for skilled professionals in Data Science and Technology.

Data Science and Artificial Intelligence

Students learn key concepts including:

  • Machine Learning Foundations
  • Deep Learning
  • Reinforcement Learning
  • Computer Vision
  • Large Language Models (LLMs)
  • Big Data Analytics

Programming and Software Development

The programme provides strong technical foundations through courses in:

  • Python Programming
  • Java Programming
  • C Programming
  • PostgreSQL
  • Linux Systems
  • Full Stack Application Development

Industry Tools and Frameworks

Learners gain practical exposure to technologies widely used across the industry, including:

  • NumPy
  • Scikit-Learn
  • PyTorch
  • OpenCV
  • Flask
  • Vue.js
  • Kafka

Business and Analytics

To help learners understand how data drives decision-making, the programme also includes:

  • Business Data Management
  • Business Analytics
  • Market Research
  • Managerial Economics
  • Financial Forensics
  • Tools in Data Science

Scholarship Support

IIT Madras offers substantial financial assistance to eligible learners.

Students from families with annual incomes below ₹5 lakh may receive fee waivers of up to 75%. More than 2,000 learners are currently benefiting from scholarship support under the programme.

This initiative ensures that quality education remains accessible to deserving students irrespective of their financial background.

Career Opportunities

The demand for Data Science and Artificial Intelligence professionals continues to grow across industries.

Graduates of the programme can explore opportunities in roles such as:

  • Data Scientist
  • Machine Learning Engineer
  • Data Analyst
  • AI Engineer
  • Business Analyst
  • Software Developer
  • Data Engineer
  • Research Associate

The skills acquired through the programme are relevant across sectors including technology, finance, healthcare, e-commerce, consulting, manufacturing, and public services.

Application Process

Interested candidates can apply online through the official IIT Madras BS Degree portal.

Important Link

Apply Online: https://study.iitm.ac.in/ds/

Applicants can sign in using their Google account and complete the registration process by following the instructions available on the admission portal.

also read : RBI Young Professionals Recruitment 2026: Earn ₹1.5 Lakh Per Month While Working with RBI

Conclusion

The IIT Madras BS in Data Science and Applications programme offers a rare combination of academic excellence, flexibility, affordability, and industry relevance. Whether you are a school graduate planning your future, a college student looking to enhance your qualifications, or a working professional aiming to upgrade your skills, this programme provides a strong foundation for a career in the data-driven world.

With IIT Madras’ academic reputation, a comprehensive curriculum, scholarship opportunities, and a growing community of learners, the BS Degree continues to set a benchmark for online higher education in India.

title.rendered: RBI Young Professionals Recruitment 2026: Earn ₹1.5 Lakh Per Month While Working with RBI

content.rendered:
If you’ve ever dreamed of working with the Reserve Bank of India and contributing to important policy decisions that shape the country’s financial system, here’s an opportunity worth paying attention to.

The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) has invited applications for its Young Professionals (YP) Recruitment 2026 programme. Through this initiative, RBI is looking for talented young professionals from fields such as Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Economics, Finance, Cyber Security, Climate Studies, Public Policy, and Financial Markets.

What makes this opportunity stand out is not just the exposure to India’s central banking system but also the attractive monthly stipend of ₹1.5 lakh. Selected candidates will work on real policy projects, research assignments, regulatory frameworks, and emerging technology initiatives at RBI’s Central Office in Mumbai.

RBI Young Professionals Recruitment 2026: Key Highlights

Important Links

What is the RBI Young Professionals Programme?

The Young Professionals Programme is designed to bring skilled and academically strong candidates into RBI for specialized assignments. Unlike regular internships, participants work on meaningful projects that directly support the bank’s policy-making and regulatory functions.

Young Professionals will collaborate with experts across departments dealing with financial markets, artificial intelligence, cybersecurity, payment systems, climate finance, data analytics, and economic research. This makes the programme an excellent learning opportunity for students and professionals who want to build a career in finance, technology, public policy, or research.

RBI Young Professionals Vacancy 2026

RBI has announced 12 positions across different specialized domains. Each role has been created to support a specific department within the central bank.

Eligibility Criteria

Before applying, candidates should carefully check whether they meet the eligibility requirements.

Age Limit

Applicants must be Indian citizens and should be between 21 and 30 years of age as on July 6, 2026.

Educational Qualification

The required qualification depends on the post. RBI is inviting applications from candidates with educational backgrounds in:

  • Artificial Intelligence
  • Data Science
  • Computer Science
  • Information Technology
  • Economics
  • Statistics
  • Finance
  • Mathematics
  • Public Policy
  • Cyber Security
  • Environmental Science
  • Climate Finance
  • Financial Engineering
  • Quantum Computing

Candidates with research publications, programming skills, industry certifications, or relevant work experience may have an advantage during shortlisting.

Great Opportunity for AI and Data Science Students

One of the most talked-about positions this year is the Young Professional – Artificial Intelligence role under RBI’s FinTech Department.

The selected candidate will work on topics such as AI governance, ethical AI, data privacy, responsible AI adoption, and technology policy. RBI is looking for candidates with qualifications in AI, Data Science, Computer Science, Public Policy, or related disciplines.

For students pursuing AIML, Data Science, or Computer Science, this role offers a rare opportunity to understand how AI is being integrated into India’s financial and regulatory ecosystem.

Salary and Benefits

A major attraction of this programme is the impressive compensation package.

Selected candidates will receive a fixed monthly stipend of ₹1,50,000 throughout the engagement period. The amount is subject to applicable tax deductions. RBI has clarified that no additional allowances will be provided.

In addition, Young Professionals will be entitled to 15 days of leave in a calendar year along with applicable statutory benefits.

Contract Duration

The initial contract period will be three years. Depending on performance and mutual agreement, RBI may extend the engagement. However, the total duration cannot exceed five years.

Selection Process

The recruitment process will be conducted in multiple stages.

First, applications will be screened by RBI’s selection committee. Candidates who meet the requirements and demonstrate strong academic or professional credentials will be shortlisted.

Shortlisted applicants will then be invited for document verification and a personal interview. Final selection will be based on overall performance and suitability for the role.

Documents Required

Candidates must submit the following documents while applying:

  • Updated CV or Resume
  • Academic Certificates
  • Academic Transcripts
  • Statement of Interest
  • Academic or Policy Writing Sample
  • Reference or Recommendation Letter

How to Apply?

Applications have to be submitted through email.

Email ID

yphrmdco@rbi.org.in

Subject Format

YP Application – Post Code – Candidate Name

Candidates applying for more than one position must submit separate emails for each post. RBI has also specified that the total attachment size should not exceed 5 MB.

Why This Opportunity Matters

Every year, thousands of students and professionals aspire to work with institutions like RBI, but very few opportunities offer direct exposure to policy formulation and regulatory decision-making.

Whether your interest lies in artificial intelligence, economic research, financial regulation, cybersecurity, climate finance, or payment systems, this programme provides a chance to learn from some of the brightest minds in the country while contributing to projects that have a national impact.

The combination of high-quality work experience, exposure to policymaking, and a monthly stipend of ₹1.5 lakh makes the RBI Young Professionals Programme one of the most attractive opportunities available in 2026.

Final Words

The RBI Young Professionals Recruitment 2026 is more than just a job opportunity—it is a chance to work at the heart of India’s financial system. With only 12 positions available, competition is expected to be intense. Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria should start preparing their application documents early and submit them well before the deadline.

If you are passionate about research, technology, finance, economics, or public policy, this could be the opportunity that gives your career a significant boost.

What is the salary of RBI Young Professionals in 2026?
Selected candidates will receive a monthly stipend of ₹1,50,000.

How many vacancies are available?
A total of 12 Young Professional positions have been announced.

Is this a permanent RBI job?
No. The engagement is contractual and does not guarantee permanent employment with RBI.

Where will selected candidates be posted?
All positions are based at RBI’s Central Office in Mumbai.

What is the age limit for RBI Young Professionals Recruitment 2026?
Candidates must be between 21 and 30 years of age as on July 6, 2026.

title.rendered: Google Summer Internship 2026 Applications Open for Software Engineering Intern (Summer 2027) – Apply Before June 28

content.rendered:
Google has officially opened applications for its highly anticipated Software Engineering Intern, Summer 2027 program in India. This internship offers students the opportunity to work alongside some of the world’s best engineers, contribute to cutting-edge technologies, and gain hands-on experience building products used by billions of users globally.

Students pursuing Bachelor’s, Master’s, or Dual Degree programs in Computer Science and related technical fields can now submit their applications through the official Google Careers portal. The application window will remain open until June 28, 2026.

Google Summer Internship 2026 Overview

The Google Summer Internship Program is a structured 10–12 week internship designed to help students accelerate their technical and professional growth. Selected interns will join engineering teams working on large-scale applications, artificial intelligence solutions, distributed systems, and next-generation technologies.

The internship is scheduled to begin in May or June 2027 and will be conducted at Google’s major engineering offices in India.

Internship Highlights

About the Google Software Engineering Internship

Google’s Software Engineering Internship provides students with the opportunity to work on real-world engineering challenges at a global scale. Interns become part of dynamic teams responsible for developing and maintaining products such as Android, Chrome, YouTube, Google Ads, Google Search, and many other platforms.

The program focuses on practical learning, collaboration, innovation, and problem-solving while allowing interns to gain exposure to Google’s engineering culture and development practices.

Eligibility Criteria

Candidates must satisfy the following requirements to apply for the internship.

Minimum Qualifications

Applicants should:

  • Be currently pursuing a Bachelor’s, Master’s, or Dual Degree program in Computer Science or a related technical field.
  • Have experience in one or more of the following:
    • Distributed Systems
    • Concurrency
    • Multi-threading
    • Synchronization
  • Possess knowledge of at least one programming language such as:
    • Java
    • C++
    • Python
    • JavaScript
    • Go
    • Other similar languages
  • Have a solid understanding of:
    • Data Structures
    • Algorithms
    • Software Design Principles

Preferred Qualifications

Google may give preference to candidates who:

  • Are currently in their penultimate year of study.
  • Have exposure to:
    • Artificial Intelligence
    • Machine Learning
    • Database Systems
    • Data Mining
    • Networking
    • Distributed Systems
    • Compilers
  • Have experience designing and implementing complex software systems.
  • Possess knowledge of debugging, performance optimization, and system analysis.
  • Demonstrate strong engineering and analytical skills.

Roles and Responsibilities

Selected interns will work closely with Google engineers and contribute to real projects. Key responsibilities include:

Build Scalable Engineering Solutions

Develop software solutions that support Google’s products and services while ensuring performance, scalability, and reliability.

Work on AI-Powered Systems

Collaborate with teams working on artificial intelligence and machine learning technologies that drive Google’s products.

Solve Complex Technical Challenges

Analyze data, evaluate potential solutions, and implement efficient approaches to solve engineering problems.

Collaborate Across Teams

Work with engineers, managers, and product teams to deliver innovative solutions and improve existing systems.

Apply Academic Knowledge

Utilize concepts learned through coursework and projects to solve real-world software engineering challenges.

Internship Locations

Applicants will have the opportunity to indicate their preferred work location during the application process.

Available locations include:

  • Bengaluru, Karnataka
  • Hyderabad, Telangana
  • Pune, Maharashtra

Documents Required

Before beginning the application process, candidates should prepare the following documents:

Resume/CV

Upload your most recent and updated resume highlighting:

  • Technical skills
  • Programming languages
  • Academic achievements
  • Projects
  • Internships
  • Open-source contributions

Academic Transcript

Candidates must upload a current official or unofficial transcript in English.

Important: While filling out the application form, select “Now Attending” under Degree Status to enable transcript submission.

Skills That Can Improve Your Chances

Given the competitive nature of Google internships, candidates should focus on strengthening:

Data Structures and Algorithms

Topics include:

  • Arrays
  • Strings
  • Linked Lists
  • Trees
  • Graphs
  • Heaps
  • Dynamic Programming
  • Greedy Algorithms

Programming Skills

Strong proficiency in one or more programming languages is highly beneficial.

Software Development Projects

Candidates with impactful personal, academic, or open-source projects often stand out during the screening process.

Problem-Solving Ability

Google values candidates who can approach challenges logically and develop efficient solutions.

Benefits of the Internship

The Google Summer Internship offers several benefits, including:

  • Real-world software engineering experience
  • Mentorship from experienced Google engineers
  • Exposure to large-scale systems and infrastructure
  • Professional networking opportunities
  • Industry-recognized internship certification
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge technologies
  • Enhanced career prospects in the technology industry

How to Apply for Google Summer Internship 2026

Eligible candidates can submit their applications online through the official Google Careers website.

Application Process

  1. Visit the official application page.
  2. Review all eligibility requirements.
  3. Click on the “Apply” button.
  4. Upload your Resume/CV.
  5. Upload your academic transcript.
  6. Complete the application form.
  7. Select your preferred internship location.
  8. Submit the application before the deadline.

Official Apply Link

apply now

Important Dates

Final Thoughts

The Google Software Engineering Intern Program (Summer 2027) is one of the most prestigious internship opportunities available to students in India. It provides an excellent platform to gain practical experience, learn from industry experts, and contribute to technologies that impact billions of users worldwide.

Students interested in software engineering, artificial intelligence, distributed systems, and large-scale application development should not miss this opportunity. Ensure your resume showcases your technical strengths, coding experience, and projects before submitting your application.

Since competition is expected to be extremely high, candidates are encouraged to apply well before the June 28, 2026 deadline.

title.rendered: Fulbright-Nehru Academic & Professional Excellence Fellowships 2027-28: Study, Teach & Conduct Research in the USA | Apply by July 1

content.rendered:
Fulbright-Nehru Academic & Professional Excellence Fellowships 2027-28 applications are now open for Indian faculty members, researchers, and experienced professionals. The prestigious fellowship offers an opportunity to undertake teaching, research, or a combination of both at leading universities and research institutions in the United States for a period of 4 to 9 months.

The fellowship is administered by the United States-India Educational Foundation (USIEF) and aims to strengthen academic collaboration between India and the United States while promoting innovation, research excellence, and global knowledge exchange.

If you are a faculty member, scientist, researcher, or working professional looking for an international academic experience, this fellowship could be a career-defining opportunity.

Fellowship Overview

About the Fellowship

The Fulbright-Nehru Academic & Professional Excellence Fellowship provides Indian scholars and professionals with the opportunity to collaborate with leading U.S. institutions. Fellows may engage in advanced research, teach specialized courses, conduct seminars, participate in curriculum development, and establish long-term academic partnerships.

The program encourages proposals that are innovative, future-focused, and technology-driven. Selected fellows gain access to world-class research facilities, academic networks, and interdisciplinary collaborations.

Fields of Study

Applications are invited in the following priority areas:

Critical Minerals and Supply Chains

  • Geology
  • Materials Science
  • Mining Engineering

Defense and Security

  • Cybersecurity
  • Aerospace Engineering
  • Robotics and Autonomous Systems

Energy Security

  • Energy Engineering
  • Petroleum Engineering
  • Energy Innovation and Technology Commercialization

Science and Research Collaboration

  • Bioengineering
  • Artificial Intelligence
  • Semiconductor Engineering

Space Cooperation

  • Astrophysics
  • Planetary Science
  • Space Systems Engineering
  • Satellite Communications

Technology and Innovation

  • Data Science
  • Quantum Computing
  • Electrical and Electronics Engineering

Fellowship Categories

Applicants can choose one of the following categories:

Research

Researchers must demonstrate the significance of their proposed research for India and/or the United States. The project should be feasible within the fellowship duration and clearly justify why it needs to be conducted in the U.S.

Teaching

Applicants proposing teaching activities should explain the courses they plan to teach, their teaching methodology, curriculum development experience, academic leadership roles, and expected impact on students and institutions.

Research and Teaching

This category combines both activities. Applicants must clearly indicate the percentage of time dedicated to research and teaching. For example, 60% research and 40% teaching.

Grant Benefits

Selected fellows receive comprehensive support, including:

  • Monthly fellowship stipend
  • J-1 Visa support
  • Round-trip economy class airfare
  • Accident and Sickness Program for Exchanges (ASPE)
  • Settling-in allowance
  • Professional allowance
  • Access to leading U.S. universities and research facilities

Dependent Benefits

Subject to availability of funds, fellows awarded 8 or 9-month grants may receive:

  • Dependent allowance
  • International travel support for one eligible dependent

The dependent must remain in the U.S. with the fellow for at least 80% of the fellowship period.

Affiliation with U.S. Host Institutions

Applicants will be affiliated with one U.S. host institution during the fellowship period.

USIEF strongly recommends that candidates:

  • Identify potential host institutions before applying.
  • Contact faculty members and departments in advance.
  • Discuss research collaborations and project feasibility.
  • Obtain a Letter of Invitation if possible.

If a Letter of Invitation has been secured, it should be uploaded as part of the online application.

Eligibility Criteria

For Faculty Members and Researchers

Applicants must:

  • Hold a Ph.D. degree.
  • Have at least five years of teaching, research, or professional experience.
  • Demonstrate a strong academic and publication record.

For Professionals

Applicants must:

  • Hold a master’s degree.
  • Have a minimum of five years of relevant professional experience.

Publication Requirement

Applicants are required to upload a recent significant publication such as a research paper or journal article. The document must not exceed 30 pages.

Employer Endorsement

If employed, candidates must obtain:

  • Letter of Support from Home Institution.
  • Official approval confirming leave for the fellowship period.

Who Is Not Eligible?

The following categories are not eligible:

  • IAS Officers
  • IPS Officers
  • IRS Officers
  • IFS Officers
  • Central and State Government bureaucratic staff

However, researchers and academicians from institutions such as DRDO, ISRO, IITs, IISc, CSIR, ICMR, ICAR, BARC, DBT institutions, and DST laboratories are eligible to apply.

Application Process

Applicants must submit their applications online through the official portal:

Application Portal:
https://apply.iie.org/fvsp2027

Before applying, candidates should carefully review:

  • FNAPE Applicant Instructions
  • FNAPE Applicant Checklist

Applicants must also upload:

  • FNAPE Applicant Annexure
  • Letter of Support from Home Institution
  • Research/Teaching Proposal
  • Significant Publication
  • Supporting Academic Documents

Selection Timeline

Important Instructions

  • Only one Fulbright-Nehru fellowship category can be applied for in a competition cycle.
  • Plagiarism will result in disqualification.
  • Applications containing copied AI-generated content may face rejection by some institutions.
  • Incomplete applications will not be considered.
  • Visa sponsorship extensions or transfers are not permitted.

Why You Should Apply

The Fulbright-Nehru Academic & Professional Excellence Fellowship is among the most prestigious international academic exchange programs available to Indian scholars. It offers unparalleled access to global research networks, advanced laboratories, distinguished faculty, and collaborative opportunities that can significantly enhance your academic and professional career.

Whether your expertise lies in Artificial Intelligence, Quantum Computing, Aerospace Engineering, Robotics, Cybersecurity, Semiconductor Technology, Energy Research, or Space Science, this fellowship provides a unique platform to contribute to global innovation while strengthening India-U.S. academic partnerships.

Final Thoughts

For Indian researchers, faculty members, and professionals seeking international exposure and world-class research opportunities, the Fulbright-Nehru Academic & Professional Excellence Fellowships 2027-28 represent an exceptional opportunity. With generous funding, prestigious institutional affiliations, and access to leading U.S. universities, the fellowship can play a transformative role in advancing your academic and professional journey.

Application Deadline: July 1, 2026

Interested candidates should begin preparing their proposals, publications, and supporting documents as early as possible to maximize their chances of selection.
