title.rendered: ISRO JRF Recruitment 2026: Apply for Junior Research Fellow Posts at URSC Bengaluru | Salary ₹37,000 Per Month

content.rendered:
ISRO JRF Recruitment 2026 notification has been officially released by the Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO) through the U R Rao Satellite Centre (URSC), Bengaluru. This recruitment offers an excellent opportunity for postgraduate students and research enthusiasts who want to contribute to India’s future space missions and advanced technology projects.

Candidates with M.Tech, M.E., M.Sc (Engineering), Aerospace, Electronics, Computer Science, Mechanical Engineering, Physics, Mathematics, Optical Engineering, and related disciplines can apply for these prestigious Junior Research Fellow (JRF) positions. The online application process has already started, and interested candidates can submit their applications before 11 July 2026.

ISRO JRF Recruitment 2026 Highlights

About ISRO URSC Bengaluru

The U R Rao Satellite Centre (URSC) is the lead satellite technology center of ISRO and plays a vital role in the development of spacecraft and satellite systems. Over the years, URSC has contributed significantly to some of India’s most successful missions, including Chandrayaan, Mars Orbiter Mission, Aditya-L1, Astrosat, INSAT, IRS, and NAVIC.

The center is actively involved in the design, development, fabrication, testing, launch, and in-orbit management of satellites. Researchers selected under this fellowship program will get an opportunity to work on advanced technologies that support India’s ambitious space exploration missions.

ISRO JRF Vacancy Details 2026

A total of 18 Junior Research Fellow positions have been announced across various engineering and science disciplines.

Electronics, VLSI & Computer Science

  • Microelectronics
  • Computer Science & Information Technology
  • Spacecraft Software Development
  • Power Electronics
  • Digital Electronics
  • Embedded Systems
  • VLSI Design
  • Signal Processing
  • Avionics
  • Instrumentation

Physics & Optical Engineering

  • Optical Engineering
  • Applied Physics
  • Material Science
  • Opto-Electronics
  • Optical Communication Systems
  • Mathematics
  • Aerospace Applications

Mechanical Engineering

  • Thermal Engineering
  • Aerospace Engineering
  • Mechanical Engineering
  • Machine Design

Eligibility Criteria

To apply for ISRO JRF Recruitment 2026, candidates must fulfill the educational and eligibility requirements specified in the official notification.

Educational Qualification

Candidates should possess:

  • M.E. / M.Tech. / M.Sc (Engineering) or equivalent postgraduate degree.
  • Minimum 60% aggregate marks or 6.5 CGPA on a 10-point scale.
  • For JRF-E13 (M.Sc route), candidates must have 65% marks or 6.84 CGPA.

The degree should be recognized by AICTE, UGC, or any other authorized government body.

National Eligibility Test Requirement

Applicants must have qualified at least one of the following examinations:

  • GATE
  • CSIR-UGC NET
  • JAM
  • JEST
  • DRDO Entrance Examinations
  • DST, DBT, DAE, ICAR, ICMR, IISc, IISER, IITs, NISER, and other approved national-level examinations

Age Limit

The maximum age limit for Junior Research Fellow positions is:

28 Years as on 11 July 2026

Age relaxation is available as per Government of India rules:

  • SC/ST Candidates – 5 Years
  • OBC Candidates – 3 Years
  • PwBD Candidates – As per norms
  • Ex-Servicemen – As per Government Rules

ISRO JRF Salary 2026

Selected candidates will receive an attractive fellowship package.

Fellowship Benefits

  • ₹37,000 per month as Junior Research Fellow
  • Upgradation to ₹42,000 per month as Senior Research Fellow (SRF)
  • House Rent Allowance (HRA)
  • Medical Benefits
  • Subsidized Canteen Facility
  • Opportunity to pursue Ph.D.
  • Exposure to cutting-edge space research projects

The fellowship is initially offered for two years and may be extended based on project requirements and performance. The total tenure can extend up to five years.

Selection Process

The recruitment process consists of two stages:

Screening of Applications

Applications will be screened based on:

  • Academic performance
  • Research credentials
  • Relevant qualifications
  • National-level examination scores

Personal Interview

Shortlisted candidates will be invited for an interview at Bengaluru. Final selection will be based on interview performance and overall suitability for the research position.

Documents Required

Candidates should keep the following documents ready before applying:

  • Passport-size Photograph
  • Signature
  • Semester-wise Mark Sheets
  • Degree Certificate
  • Final Passing Certificate
  • GATE/NET/JAM/JEST Score Card
  • Category Certificate (if applicable)
  • No Objection Certificate for Government Employees

How to Apply for ISRO JRF Recruitment 2026

Interested candidates can follow the steps below:

  1. Visit the official ISRO JRF application portal.
  2. Complete the registration process using a valid email ID.
  3. Fill in personal, academic, and research details carefully.
  4. Upload all required documents in the prescribed format.
  5. Verify all information before submission.
  6. Submit the application form before the deadline.
  7. Download and save the application form for future reference.

Important Dates

Apply Online

Application Link:
Apply for ISRO JRF Recruitment 2026

Why This Opportunity Is Special

Working as a Junior Research Fellow at ISRO is more than just a fellowship opportunity. It provides direct exposure to India’s advanced space programs, satellite development projects, artificial intelligence applications, spacecraft operations, optical communication systems, and next-generation engineering technologies.

For candidates planning a long-term career in research, aerospace, defense, advanced engineering, or higher studies, this fellowship can serve as a strong foundation for future growth.

What is the last date to apply for ISRO JRF Recruitment 2026?

The last date to submit the online application is 11 July 2026.

How many vacancies are available?

A total of 18 Junior Research Fellow vacancies have been announced.

What is the monthly stipend offered?

Selected candidates will receive ₹37,000 per month, along with HRA and other benefits.

Is GATE mandatory for ISRO JRF Recruitment 2026?

Candidates must qualify GATE, NET, JAM, JEST, or another approved national-level examination.

Can final-year students apply?

No. Only candidates who have already completed the required qualification are eligible to apply.

Where will the selected candidates be posted?

Initially at URSC Bengaluru, with the possibility of deployment to other ISRO centers depending on project requirements.

title.rendered: DRDO Paid Internship 2026: ₹30,000 Stipend, 45 Vacancies for Engineering Students, Apply Before June 30

content.rendered:
The Defence Research and Development Organisation (DRDO) has officially invited applications for the DRDO Paid Internship 2026 under the Defence Electronics Applications Laboratory (DEAL), Dehradun. This internship provides a unique opportunity for engineering students to gain hands-on experience in advanced defence technologies while receiving a stipend of ₹30,000.

Students from Electronics & Communication Engineering, Computer Science Engineering, and Mechanical Engineering disciplines can apply for this prestigious internship program. The internship will be conducted for a period of six months and offers direct exposure to real-world defence research projects. According to the official notification, applications must reach DEAL, Dehradun on or before 30 June 2026.

DRDO Paid Internship 2026 Highlights

Apply Link for DRDO Paid Internship 2026

Candidates can download the official application form and notification from the DRDO Careers Portal.

Official Website: https://www.drdo.gov.in

Apply Link: https://www.drdo.gov.in/drdo/careers

Application Mode: Offline (Speed Post Only)

Last Date: 30 June 2026

Students are advised to download the application form as early as possible and complete the submission process before the deadline.

About DEAL, DRDO

Defence Electronics Applications Laboratory (DEAL) is one of DRDO’s premier research laboratories located in Dehradun, Uttarakhand. The laboratory works in various cutting-edge technology domains including:

  • Software Defined Radio (SDR)
  • Satellite Communication Systems
  • Tactical Data Links
  • Defence Communication Networks
  • Surveillance Technologies
  • Secure Wireless Communication

The internship offers students a chance to work alongside experienced scientists and engineers involved in the development of critical defence technologies for India.

DRDO Internship 2026 Vacancy Details

A total of 45 internship positions have been announced across three engineering disciplines.

Among all disciplines, Electronics and Computer Science students have the highest number of available seats.

Eligibility Criteria

Before applying, candidates must ensure that they fulfill all eligibility conditions specified by DRDO.

For B.Tech/B.E. Students

Candidates must:

  • Be pursuing a full-time B.Tech or B.E. degree.
  • Have completed the 6th semester (3rd year) or be completing it by July 2026.
  • Be studying in an AICTE-approved institution.

For M.Tech/M.Sc. (Electronics) Students

Candidates must:

  • Be pursuing a full-time M.Tech or M.Sc. (Electronics).
  • Have completed the 2nd semester or be completing it by July 2026.

Academic Requirements

Applicants must also meet the following criteria:

  • Minimum CGPA of 7.0 on a 10-point scale.
  • No backlog in any subject during the first five semesters.
  • Must be an Indian citizen.

Only eligible candidates will be considered during the selection process.

DRDO Internship Stipend 2026

Selected candidates will receive a total stipend of ₹30,000 during the internship period.

Stipend Distribution

To receive the stipend, interns must maintain a minimum attendance of 15 working days per month throughout the internship.

Internship Duration

The DRDO Paid Internship 2026 will be conducted for a fixed duration of six months.

Students who fail to complete the full internship period will not be eligible for:

  • Internship Certificate
  • Stipend Payment

Therefore, candidates should apply only if they can commit to the complete internship duration.

Selection Process

The selection process for DRDO Paid Internship 2026 is entirely merit-based.

Selection will be made based on:

  • Academic Performance
  • CGPA Score
  • Eligibility Verification
  • Document Screening

DRDO has clearly mentioned that no communication will be entertained regarding rejected applications. The decision of the laboratory management will be final.

Documents Required

Candidates must attach the following documents with the application form:

  • Recommendation Letter from Principal/HOD/Dean
  • Updated Resume or Biodata
  • Mark Sheets Showing CGPA
  • Aadhaar Card Copy
  • College Identity Card Copy
  • Passport Size Photograph

Applications without the required documents may be rejected during the screening stage.

How to Apply for DRDO Paid Internship 2026

Interested students can apply by following the steps below.

Step 1: Download the Application Form

title.rendered: ISRO Free Certification Course 2026: Free Online Course with Certificate | Apply Now

content.rendered:
The Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO), through its educational arm, the Indian Institute of Remote Sensing (IIRS), has announced a free online certification course for students, researchers, faculty members, and professionals. Titled “Advances in Remote Sensing Techniques for Geological Applications,” this program offers participants an opportunity to learn directly from ISRO experts and gain valuable knowledge in remote sensing, geospatial technologies, geological investigations, and planetary exploration.

The course is completely free of cost and includes a participation certificate for eligible candidates who meet the attendance requirements. With growing demand for geospatial and Earth observation technologies across industries, this certification can be a valuable addition to your academic and professional profile.

ISRO Free Certification Course 2026 Overview

About the ISRO Free Certification Course 2026

The ISRO Free Certification Course 2026 has been designed to provide participants with a strong foundation in remote sensing technologies and their applications in geological studies. The program focuses on the use of satellite-based observations, geospatial data, and modern Earth observation techniques to address real-world challenges related to geology, environmental monitoring, natural resources, and disaster management.

Participants will gain practical insights into advanced remote sensing systems, geological mapping techniques, mineral exploration methods, and planetary science applications. The course is conducted through the IIRS online learning platform, enabling participants from across India to attend sessions remotely.

Why You Should Join This ISRO Course

ISRO training programs are widely recognized for their quality and relevance. This course offers several benefits for students and professionals looking to build expertise in geospatial technologies.

Key Benefits

  • Learn directly from ISRO and IIRS experts
  • Understand real-world applications of remote sensing technologies
  • Gain exposure to GIS and geospatial data analysis
  • Explore geological mapping and mineral exploration techniques
  • Receive a free certificate from IIRS-ISRO
  • Strengthen your resume and academic profile
  • Improve career prospects in geosciences and remote sensing industries
  • Access learning materials and recorded sessions

Course Modules and Learning Topics

The curriculum has been carefully designed to cover both theoretical and practical aspects of remote sensing applications in geology.

1. Geoscience Applications

This module introduces participants to the use of Remote Sensing (RS) and Geographic Information Systems (GIS) in:

  • Geological investigations
  • Environmental monitoring
  • Cryosphere studies
  • Natural resource management
  • Geo-engineering applications

2. Advanced Remote Sensing Sensors

Participants will learn about various remote sensing technologies, including:

  • Optical Sensors
  • Thermal Sensors
  • Microwave Sensors
  • Hyperspectral Sensors

The sessions will explain how these sensors collect and process Earth observation data for scientific and industrial applications.

3. Mineral Exploration and Geological Mapping

This section focuses on:

  • Mineral prospecting techniques
  • Geological mapping methods
  • Lithological analysis
  • Structural deformation studies
  • Resource exploration strategies

4. Integrated Geophysical Approaches

Participants will gain insights into the integration of multiple technologies, including:

  • GNSS (Global Navigation Satellite Systems)
  • Geodesy
  • Geophysical surveys
  • Spatial data integration

These techniques play a crucial role in modern geological investigations.

5. Planetary Exploration

One of the most exciting aspects of the course is the introduction to planetary science.

Topics include:

  • Planetary surface studies
  • Lunar exploration
  • Planetary remote sensing
  • Data analysis techniques used in ISRO missions
  • Scientific contributions of India’s space exploration programs

Eligibility Criteria

The course is open to a wide range of students and professionals.

Eligible Students

Applications are invited from students pursuing:

  • Earth Sciences
  • Geology
  • Applied Geology
  • Geophysics
  • Geography
  • Geo-exploration
  • Geo-engineering

Final-year postgraduate students from the above disciplines are also eligible.

Engineering Students

Students from the following engineering branches can apply:

  • Civil Engineering
  • Mining Engineering
  • Geoscience-related disciplines

Researchers and Professionals

The following candidates are also eligible:

  • Research Scholars
  • Faculty Members
  • Academic Professionals
  • Scientists
  • Technical Staff
  • Government Department Employees

Technical Requirements

The course is delivered entirely online through the IIRS e-learning platform.

Participants require:

  • Computer, laptop, tablet, or smartphone
  • Stable internet connection
  • Web browser access

No specialized software or paid tools are required.

Learning Resources Provided

Participants will receive access to:

  • Lecture presentations
  • Recorded video sessions
  • Practical demonstrations
  • Open-source software tools
  • Additional study materials
  • Online learning resources

Certificate Requirements

Participants who successfully complete the course and fulfill attendance requirements will receive an official participation certificate.

Attendance Requirement

  • Minimum 70% attendance is mandatory.
  • Attendance will be monitored digitally during live sessions.

Certificate Download

After successful verification, participants can download their certificate directly from the IIRS Learning Management System (LMS) portal.

How to Apply for ISRO Free Certification Course 2026

Interested candidates can register online through the official IIRS registration portal.

Application Process

Step 1: Visit the official registration portal.

Step 2: Complete the online registration form.

Step 3: Enter your academic and personal details.

Step 4: Submit the application.

Step 5: Receive confirmation and course access details.

Official Registration Link

👉 Apply Here

Important Note

Admissions are offered on a first-come, first-served basis. Candidates are encouraged to register as early as possible to secure their seat.

Career Opportunities After Completing the Course

Remote sensing and geospatial technologies are rapidly expanding fields with applications across multiple industries.

After completing this course, participants can explore opportunities in:

  • GIS and Geospatial Technology
  • Geological Survey Organizations
  • Environmental Consulting
  • Mining and Exploration Industries
  • Disaster Management Agencies
  • Research Institutions
  • Space Technology Organizations
  • Government Departments

The knowledge gained through this program can also support higher education, research projects, and competitive examinations related to Earth sciences and geospatial technologies.

Why This Certification Matters

As industries increasingly rely on satellite imagery, geospatial intelligence, and remote sensing data, professionals with knowledge of these technologies are in high demand. This course provides exposure to industry-relevant tools and methodologies used by experts in geology, environmental sciences, and space technology.

A certification from ISRO’s educational wing demonstrates your commitment to continuous learning and can strengthen both academic and professional credentials.

With no registration fee, a comprehensive curriculum, practical learning resources, and a free participation certificate, this program is one of the most valuable online learning opportunities currently available in the geospatial and Earth sciences domain.

Students, research scholars, faculty members, scientists, technical staff, and professionals from eligible disciplines can apply.

title.rendered: Deloitte Hiring Quality Assurance Engineer I in Hyderabad 2026: Apply Online, Eligibility, Skills & Selection Process

content.rendered:
Deloitte has announced a new recruitment opportunity for the position of Quality Assurance Engineer I (GESTC – QA) in Hyderabad, Telangana. This hiring drive is aimed at candidates with 1–2 years of software testing experience who are looking to build a career in quality assurance, automation testing, and software quality engineering.

The role is part of Deloitte’s Global Employer Services Technology Center (GESTC), where professionals work on enterprise-level applications used by Deloitte member firms and clients worldwide. Candidates selected for this position will gain exposure to modern testing practices, Agile methodologies, automation tools, and global technology projects.

Deloitte Recruitment 2026 Overview

Apply Online

Candidates can submit their applications through Deloitte’s official careers portal.

Official Apply Link:

APPLY NOW

About Deloitte

Deloitte is one of the world’s leading professional services organizations, providing consulting, tax, audit, risk advisory, and technology services to clients across various industries. The company operates in more than 150 countries and is recognized for innovation, employee development, and digital transformation initiatives.

Deloitte Tax Services India Private Limited commenced operations in 2004 and supports several global Deloitte service lines. Through its technology centers, Deloitte helps organizations modernize business processes and implement advanced technology solutions.

The Global Employer Services Technology Center (GESTC) focuses on delivering innovative software solutions and technology-driven services that support Deloitte’s global clients.

Job Description

As a Quality Assurance Engineer I, candidates will be responsible for ensuring that software applications meet quality standards before deployment. The role involves manual testing, automation testing support, defect identification, test case creation, and quality assurance activities throughout the software development lifecycle.

Professionals joining this position will work closely with QA Leads, Developers, Product Owners, and Business Analysts to ensure high-quality software releases.

The selected candidates will also receive training on existing and next-generation testing tools used within Deloitte’s technology ecosystem.

Key Responsibilities

The primary responsibilities of the Quality Assurance Engineer include:

  • Understanding business requirements and application functionality.
  • Becoming a subject matter expert in assigned applications and domains.
  • Reviewing software requirements for completeness and accuracy.
  • Designing test scenarios and preparing test cases.
  • Executing test cases and documenting defects.
  • Collaborating with QA Leads and development teams.
  • Performing software validation activities.
  • Participating in quality engineering initiatives.
  • Retesting applications after bug fixes.
  • Maintaining testing documentation and reports.
  • Generating testing metrics using Microsoft Excel.
  • Following quality, security, and testing best practices.

Types of Testing Involved

Candidates will gain hands-on experience across multiple testing methodologies.

Functional Testing

Functional testing ensures that software features perform according to business requirements and expected user behavior.

Smoke Testing

Smoke testing validates that the application’s core functionality is working correctly after each software build.

Regression Testing

Regression testing ensures that new updates or changes do not negatively impact existing functionality.

Non-Functional Testing

The role may involve various non-functional testing activities such as:

  • Performance Testing
  • Accessibility Testing
  • Usability Testing
  • User Experience Validation

These testing methods help improve software reliability and overall customer satisfaction.

Educational Qualification

Candidates applying for this position should possess a Bachelor’s Degree in:

  • Computer Science
  • Information Technology
  • Software Engineering
  • Related Technical Disciplines

Equivalent qualifications and relevant industry experience may also be considered.

Experience Required

Applicants should have:

  • 1–2 years of software testing experience.
  • Understanding of software quality assurance methodologies.
  • Knowledge of software development processes.
  • Experience working in Agile environments.
  • Familiarity with testing tools and defect management systems.

Experience with enterprise-level applications will be an added advantage.

Required Skills

Deloitte is seeking candidates who possess a strong combination of technical expertise and professional skills.

Software Testing Knowledge

Candidates should understand:

  • Test Planning
  • Test Case Design
  • Defect Lifecycle
  • Test Execution
  • Quality Assurance Processes

SDLC Knowledge

A solid understanding of the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) is required, including development, testing, deployment, and maintenance phases.

Agile Methodology

Experience working in Agile or Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) environments is highly preferred.

Azure DevOps (ADO)

Candidates should have experience using Azure DevOps for:

  • Test Management
  • Defect Tracking
  • Team Collaboration

Communication Skills

Strong written and verbal communication skills are necessary to work effectively with stakeholders and global teams.

Preferred Skills

The following skills are considered advantageous:

  • ISTQB Certification
  • Automation Testing Experience
  • TOSCA Knowledge
  • Low-Code Automation Tools
  • Analytical Thinking
  • Problem-Solving Skills
  • Attention to Detail
  • Documentation Skills

Candidates possessing these skills may have an edge during the selection process.

Why Join Deloitte?

Deloitte offers one of the most rewarding work environments in the technology and consulting industry.

Global Exposure

Employees collaborate with professionals and clients across different countries and industries.

Learning Opportunities

The company provides access to:

  • Technical Certifications
  • Leadership Programs
  • Online Learning Platforms
  • Professional Development Workshops

Career Growth

Deloitte offers structured career progression and opportunities to work on innovative projects that accelerate professional growth.

Inclusive Culture

The organization promotes diversity, inclusion, collaboration, and equal opportunities for all employees.

Candidates submit their applications through the official careers portal.

  • SDLC Concepts
  • Azure DevOps

HR Interview

The HR round evaluates communication skills, career aspirations, and organizational fit.

Offer Letter

Successful candidates receive a formal employment offer from Deloitte.

Expected Salary

Deloitte has not officially disclosed the salary package for this position. However, based on industry standards, Quality Assurance Engineers with 1–2 years of experience in Hyderabad generally receive competitive compensation packages along with additional employee benefits and career growth opportunities.

Actual salary may depend on experience, technical skills, certifications, and interview performance.

title.rendered: INDIA.RUNS Hackathon 2026 Registration Open: ₹50 Lakh+ Prize Pool Announced for Students, Developers and Innovators

content.rendered:
India’s growing artificial intelligence ecosystem has received a major boost with the launch of INDIA.RUNS Hackathon 2026, a nationwide innovation challenge jointly organized by Redrob AI and Hack2skill. The competition offers a prize pool exceeding ₹50 lakh and is open to students, developers, business strategists, designers, content creators, and first-time participants from across the country. According to the organizers, the initiative aims to identify emerging AI talent and encourage innovation focused on solving real-world Indian challenges.

The hackathon is positioned as one of the country’s most inclusive innovation competitions, removing traditional eligibility barriers often associated with technology contests. Participants from any academic background, city, or professional field can register and compete through three separate tracks.

INDIA.RUNS Hackathon 2026: Key Highlights

The event follows the theme “Build What Next India Runs On”, encouraging participants to create solutions tailored specifically for Indian users and businesses. Organizers say the challenge is designed to bring together technical builders, product thinkers, and creators on a common platform.

What Is INDIA.RUNS Hackathon?

According to information released by Redrob AI, the competition was created to address the growing demand for AI-driven innovation in India. The organizers argue that many existing AI products are developed primarily for international markets, while India’s unique workforce, language diversity, and economic landscape require localized solutions.

The hackathon seeks ideas and projects that can contribute to India’s future in areas such as artificial intelligence, hiring technology, digital innovation, product strategy, and community engagement. Unlike many coding-focused competitions, INDIA.RUNS also provides opportunities for non-technical participants.

Three Competition Tracks Announced

Participants can choose from three independent tracks depending on their expertise and interests.

1. Data & AI Challenge

The Data & AI Challenge is designed for developers, machine learning engineers, AI practitioners, and data scientists. Participants are expected to build intelligent systems capable of solving talent discovery and recruitment-related challenges using advanced AI technologies. The challenge focuses on identifying potential candidates beyond traditional keyword-based recruitment systems.

The track carries a dedicated prize pool and includes awards for champions, elite builders, and strong performers.

2. Ideathon

The Ideathon track targets MBA students, entrepreneurs, product managers, strategists, and first-time innovators. Instead of building software, participants can submit business models, AI product concepts, market strategies, and innovative ideas aimed at solving future challenges.

Organizers describe this track as an opportunity for participants to contribute ideas that may influence future AI products and services.

3. Social Media Challenge

The third track is focused on creators and digital storytellers. Participants can create content around artificial intelligence, innovation, technology trends, and the future of work. The goal is to encourage broader conversations about AI adoption and innovation across India’s online communities.

Who Can Participate?

One of the biggest attractions of the competition is its open eligibility model.

The organizers have stated that participation is open to:

  • Engineering students
  • MBA students
  • Commerce and Arts students
  • Software developers
  • Designers
  • Startup founders
  • Working professionals
  • Content creators
  • First-time hackathon participants

No specific degree, coding background, or institutional affiliation is required for registration.

₹50 Lakh+ Prize Pool

The combined reward pool for all three tracks exceeds ₹50 lakh. Apart from cash prizes, winners may receive recognition, visibility within the innovation ecosystem, and opportunities to showcase their work before industry professionals. According to organizers, hundreds of participants could receive awards across various categories.

The prize distribution includes awards for:

  • Grand Champions
  • Track Winners
  • Runner-Ups
  • Merit Winners
  • Community Winners
  • High-Engagement Participants
  • Special Category Awards

Important Dates

Candidates interested in participating should note the following schedule:

How to Apply

Interested candidates can submit their applications through the official registration portal.

Official Registration Link:

title.rendered: NPR AI Research Ethics and Readiness Internship 2026: Remote Paid Internship with $20/Hour Stipend

content.rendered:
Artificial Intelligence is transforming industries worldwide, and journalism is rapidly embracing AI-powered tools to improve reporting, content discovery, and audience engagement. As media organizations explore the potential of AI, the need for professionals who understand both technological innovation and ethical responsibility has never been greater.

To help develop the next generation of AI and media professionals, NPR (National Public Radio) has opened applications for the NPR AI Research Ethics and Readiness Internship 2026. This highly sought-after internship provides students and recent graduates with the opportunity to work on real-world AI projects while contributing to the future of responsible artificial intelligence in journalism.

The internship is fully remote, offers a competitive $20/hour stipend, and provides hands-on experience with NPR’s AI Labs and Research, Archives & Data Strategy (RAD) teams.

If you’re interested in Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Data Science, Journalism, Digital Archives, or AI Ethics, this opportunity could be the perfect addition to your career journey.

About the NPR AI Research Ethics and Readiness Internship 2026

The NPR AI Research Ethics and Readiness Internship 2026 is a unique program designed to explore how artificial intelligence can be responsibly integrated into journalism and archival research.

The internship will run from October 5, 2026, to April 16, 2027, giving selected candidates several months of practical experience working alongside researchers, technologists, archivists, and product teams.

Interns will collaborate with NPR professionals to build AI-powered solutions, improve access to historical media archives, and establish ethical frameworks for AI implementation in journalism.

Internship Highlights

Internship Structure

One of the most attractive aspects of the NPR AI Research Ethics and Readiness Internship 2026 is its two-phase structure, allowing interns to gain experience across multiple disciplines.

Phase 1: AI Labs (October 2026 – January 2027)

During the first phase, interns will work with NPR’s AI Labs team to develop innovative AI-powered solutions for journalists.

The primary goal is to make NPR’s extensive archive of audio content easier to search, discover, and use for modern reporting.

Interns will help:

  • Build AI-powered newsroom prototypes
  • Develop workflows for archival content discovery
  • Transform unstructured historical media into searchable assets
  • Improve access to NPR’s rich content archives
  • Support newsroom innovation through generative AI

This phase offers valuable exposure to practical AI applications in media and content management.

Phase 2: Research, Archives & Data Strategy (January – April 2027)

The second phase focuses on responsible AI adoption and archival research.

Interns will contribute to projects that establish ethical standards for AI use while ensuring that machine learning systems align with journalistic values and public trust.

Responsibilities may include:

  • Developing ethical AI frameworks
  • Preparing archival collections for machine learning
  • Supporting metadata management initiatives
  • Researching responsible AI applications
  • Evaluating AI-assisted discovery tools

This phase provides a deeper understanding of the challenges and opportunities involved in deploying AI responsibly within media organizations.

Key Responsibilities

The NPR AI Research Ethics and Readiness Internship 2026 provides interns with the opportunity to work on meaningful projects that have real-world impact.

AI Prototyping and Workflow Development

Selected interns will:

  • Identify opportunities for AI-powered newsroom innovation
  • Build prototypes that help reporters access historical content
  • Create automated workflows for archival media processing
  • Support AI-driven content discovery initiatives
  • Develop systems that transform legacy content into searchable libraries

Data Analysis and Research

Interns will also work with historical data collections and research initiatives.

Responsibilities include:

  • Analyzing archival content for reporting opportunities
  • Extracting insights from historical media collections
  • Evaluating AI-generated outputs
  • Assessing AI systems for bias and accuracy
  • Supporting AI ethics research

Archival Data Preparation

Participants will help prepare digital archives for machine learning applications.

Tasks may include:

  • Organizing datasets
  • Managing metadata
  • Supporting digital preservation efforts
  • Developing AI-ready data structures
  • Creating documentation and standards

These experiences provide valuable practical skills that are highly sought after in today’s technology and media industries.

Eligibility Criteria

The NPR AI Research Ethics and Readiness Internship 2026 is open to both students and recent graduates.

To qualify, applicants must meet one of the following conditions:

Students

Candidates must currently be enrolled in an accredited degree program.

Work Authorization Requirement

Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States during the internship period.

Preferred Academic Backgrounds

NPR encourages applications from candidates with experience or academic interests in:

  • Artificial Intelligence

NVIDIA has officially opened applications for the Formal Verification Engineer – New College Graduate role for fresh graduates in India. The position is available in Gurugram and Bengaluru, offering candidates the chance to work on cutting-edge GPU, AI, autonomous vehicle, and high-performance computing technologies that power some of the world’s most advanced computing platforms.

Students looking to start their careers in the semiconductor industry with one of the world’s leading technology companies should consider applying for this opportunity.

About NVIDIA

NVIDIA is a global leader in accelerated computing, artificial intelligence, graphics processing units (GPUs), autonomous vehicles, robotics, and data center technologies. The company is known for developing revolutionary technologies that drive innovation across gaming, AI, cloud computing, healthcare, and scientific research.

Today, NVIDIA’s hardware and software platforms are helping organizations build next-generation AI systems, self-driving cars, digital twins, and advanced robotics solutions.

Job Role: Formal Verification Engineer

As a Formal Verification Engineer, you will work with NVIDIA’s hardware engineering teams to verify complex digital designs, IP blocks, and System-on-Chip (SoC) architectures using industry-leading formal verification methodologies.

The role provides exposure to advanced verification techniques used in developing next-generation GPUs, AI accelerators, and high-performance computing products.

This is a highly technical position where engineers collaborate with design and verification teams to ensure hardware correctness and reliability before silicon fabrication.

Key Responsibilities

Selected candidates will be responsible for:

  • Learning and applying state-of-the-art formal verification methodologies.
  • Verifying complex digital designs, IPs, and SoCs.
  • Creating comprehensive verification strategies and test plans.
  • Working closely with design engineers to understand RTL implementations.
  • Identifying and debugging design issues.
  • Executing verification plans to achieve complete coverage.
  • Collaborating with verification teams to ensure project closure.
  • Contributing to the development of high-quality hardware products.

Required Qualifications

Candidates must possess:

  • B.Tech or M.Tech in:
    • Electrical Engineering
    • Computer Science Engineering
    • Electronics Engineering
    • Related Engineering Disciplines

Fresh graduates and final-year students meeting the eligibility criteria are encouraged to apply.

Skills Required

NVIDIA is looking for candidates with strong technical foundations in hardware verification and digital design.

Desired skills include:

Technical Skills

  • Verilog
  • SystemVerilog
  • RTL Design Understanding
  • Formal Verification
  • Digital Logic Design
  • SoC Architecture
  • Temporal Logic Assertions
  • Hardware Description Languages (HDLs)

Core Competencies

  • Problem-solving ability
  • Debugging skills
  • Team collaboration
  • Quick learning capability
  • Attention to detail

NVIDIA consistently ranks among the world’s most innovative technology companies and is recognized for its employee-friendly culture and technical excellence.

  2. Resume Screening

  4. Interview Rounds
  5. Final Selection

Interview discussions may cover:

  • Digital Electronics
  • Verilog/SystemVerilog
  • Computer Architecture
  • Data Structures
  • Problem Solving
  • RTL Design Concepts
  • Formal Verification Fundamentals

Preparation Tips

To improve your chances of selection:

  • Revise Digital Electronics thoroughly.
  • Practice Verilog and SystemVerilog coding.
  • Understand RTL design concepts.
  • Learn assertion-based verification.
  • Study finite state machines (FSMs).
  • Strengthen problem-solving skills.
  • Prepare projects related to VLSI or Digital Design.

How to Apply?

With exposure to world-class engineering projects, mentorship from industry experts, and the chance to work on products powering AI and next-generation computing, this role offers immense learning and growth potential.

  • Ensuring compliance with company standards and customer requirements.
  • Supporting communication between cross-functional teams.

The internship provides exposure to both business and engineering functions, making it highly valuable for future career growth.

Eligibility Criteria

Educational Qualification

Skills Required

Technical Knowledge

Why Join Rolls-Royce?

Skills That Can Help You Get Selected

Internship Benefits

  • Experience working with global teams
  • Skill development in project management and sales engineering
  • Enhanced resume value

Important Dates

How to Apply for Rolls-Royce Internship 2026?

Interested candidates can apply for the Rolls-Royce Sales & Project Coordinator Internship 2026 through the official careers portal before the deadline of 12 June 2026.

Final Words

The Rolls-Royce Sales & Project Coordinator Internship 2026 offers engineering students a unique opportunity to work with a globally renowned organization. The internship provides valuable experience in technical sales, project coordination, stakeholder management, and engineering operations.

Students pursuing Electrical or Electronics Engineering who want to build careers in project management, engineering sales, or industrial operations should strongly consider applying before the deadline.

With world-class mentorship, real business exposure, and a globally recognized brand on your resume, this internship can become an important stepping stone toward a successful engineering career.

title.rendered: Shell Recruitment 2026: Freshers Can Apply for Graduate Programme | Salary, Eligibility & Direct Apply Link

content.rendered:
Shell Recruitment 2026: Shell, one of the world’s leading energy companies, has officially started hiring for its Graduate Programme 2026 in India. This is a golden opportunity for fresh graduates and early-career professionals who want to build their careers with a globally recognized organization known for innovation, sustainability, and employee growth.

Candidates holding a Bachelor’s, Master’s, or PhD degree can apply for multiple opportunities across Bangalore, Gurgaon, Chennai, and Mumbai. If you’re looking for a high-paying job, global exposure, structured learning, and career advancement opportunities, Shell’s Graduate Programme 2026 could be the perfect start to your professional journey.

Shell Recruitment 2026 Overview

About Shell Graduate Programme 2026

The Shell Graduate Programme is specially designed for talented graduates who are eager to learn, innovate, and contribute to solving some of the world’s biggest energy challenges. The programme combines real-world work experience, professional training, mentorship, and leadership development, helping graduates transition smoothly into successful careers.

As a participant, you’ll work on meaningful projects, collaborate with industry experts, and gain exposure to advanced technologies that are shaping the future of energy.

Eligibility Criteria

To apply for Shell Recruitment 2026, candidates must meet the following requirements:

  • Bachelor’s, Master’s, or PhD degree holders are eligible.
  • Candidates must complete their degree before joining Shell.
  • Freshers can apply.
  • Applicants should have less than three years of professional work experience.
  • Good communication and interpersonal skills are required.
  • Candidates must have authorization to work in India.

Salary and Benefits

Shell is known for offering highly competitive compensation packages and employee-friendly benefits. Selected candidates can expect:

  • Attractive salary package
  • Performance-based bonuses
  • Annual salary reviews
  • Health insurance coverage
  • Retirement and financial planning benefits
  • Learning and development programs
  • Global career opportunities
  • Paid leaves and work-life balance support
  • Employee wellness and mental health programs

The final salary package will depend on the role, qualifications, and location.

What Makes Shell a Great Place to Work?

Global Career Opportunities

Shell operates in more than 70 countries, giving employees access to international projects and diverse career paths.

Learning and Development

Graduates receive continuous training, mentoring, leadership coaching, and skill development opportunities.

Innovation-Driven Culture

Employees work on cutting-edge technologies and solutions that support the global energy transition.

Inclusive Workplace

Shell promotes diversity, equality, and inclusion, ensuring every employee feels respected and valued.

Career Growth

The Graduate Programme is designed to accelerate career progression and help participants become future leaders within the organization.

Skills Shell Looks For

Shell seeks candidates who are passionate, curious, and capable of working in dynamic environments.

Preferred skills include:

  • Problem-solving ability
  • Analytical thinking
  • Leadership potential
  • Creativity and innovation
  • Teamwork and collaboration
  • Strong communication skills
  • Adaptability and resilience
  • Decision-making capability

Selection Process

The recruitment process may include:

  1. Online Application
  2. Online Assessments
  3. Video Interview
  4. Assessment Centre Activities
  5. Final Interview

Candidates should prepare well for aptitude tests, behavioral assessments, and competency-based interviews.

Job Locations

Selected candidates may be placed at Shell offices in:

  • Bangalore
  • Gurgaon
  • Chennai
  • Mumbai

The final location depends on business requirements and role availability.

Why Freshers Should Apply?

The Shell Graduate Programme offers fresh graduates an excellent opportunity to gain practical industry experience while working with one of the world’s most respected organizations.

Benefits for freshers include:

  • Fast-track career growth
  • Exposure to global projects
  • Industry-leading training
  • Competitive compensation
  • Networking with experts
  • Long-term career stability
  • Access to modern technologies

How to Apply for Shell Recruitment 2026?

Interested and eligible candidates can submit their applications through Shell’s official careers portal.

Direct Apply Link

Apply Here:
https://shell.wd3.myworkdayjobs.com/ShellCareers/job/Bangalore-RMZ-ECO-WORLD/Shell-Graduate-Programme-2026—India_R182105-1/

Application Steps

  • Visit the official application page.
  • Register or log in to your account.
  • Fill in the required details.
  • Upload your updated resume.
  • Review the application carefully.
  • Submit the form.

Since applications are reviewed on a rolling basis, candidates are advised to apply as early as possible.

Important Documents Required

Before applying, keep the following documents ready:

  • Updated Resume
  • Academic Mark Sheets
  • Degree Certificates
  • Government ID Proof
  • Passport-size Photograph
  • Internship Certificates (if applicable)

also read : Hitachi Internship 2026: Graduate Engineer Trainee Hiring for B.Tech, B.E & MCA Freshers | Apply Online

Final Words

Shell Recruitment 2026 is one of the best opportunities currently available for fresh graduates looking to begin their careers with a globally recognized company. With world-class training, excellent compensation, mentorship support, and opportunities to work on impactful projects, the Shell Graduate Programme can serve as a strong foundation for long-term professional success.

If you meet the eligibility criteria, don’t miss this opportunity. Submit your application today and take the first step toward an exciting future with Shell.

Frequently Asked Questions

Is Shell Recruitment 2026 open for freshers?

Yes, fresh graduates and candidates with limited professional experience are eligible to apply.

What qualifications are required?

Bachelor’s, Master’s, and PhD degree holders can apply.

What is the salary offered?

Shell offers a competitive salary package along with several additional benefits and rewards.

What are the job locations?

Bangalore, Gurgaon, Chennai, and Mumbai.

Is there any application fee?

No, Shell does not charge any fee during the recruitment process.

What is the last date to apply?

Applications are currently open. Candidates should apply as soon as possible.

content.rendered:
AKTU Exam Postponed 2026: डॉ. ए.पी.जे. अब्दुल कलाम प्राविधिक विश्वविद्यालय (AKTU), लखनऊ ने सम सेमेस्टर परीक्षा 2025-26 को लेकर एक महत्वपूर्ण नोटिस जारी किया है। विश्वविद्यालय ने 8 जून 2026 को आयोजित होने वाली कुछ विषयों की परीक्षाओं को स्थगित करते हुए नई परीक्षा तिथि 11 जून 2026 निर्धारित की है। यह फैसला उत्तर प्रदेश पुलिस कांस्टेबल भर्ती परीक्षा को ध्यान में रखते हुए लिया गया है ताकि छात्रों को किसी प्रकार की परेशानी का सामना न करना पड़े।

यदि आप AKTU के छात्र हैं और आपकी परीक्षा 8 जून 2026 को निर्धारित थी, तो यह अपडेट आपके लिए बेहद महत्वपूर्ण है। विश्वविद्यालय ने छात्रों को संशोधित परीक्षा कार्यक्रम के अनुसार परीक्षा में शामिल होने और नया Admit Card डाउनलोड करने के निर्देश दिए हैं।

AKTU Exam Postponed 2026: क्या है पूरा मामला?

AKTU द्वारा 5 जून 2026 को जारी आधिकारिक नोटिस के अनुसार, सम सेमेस्टर परीक्षा 2025-26 के अंतर्गत 8 जून 2026 को दोनों पालियों में आयोजित होने वाली कुछ विषयों की परीक्षाओं को स्थगित कर दिया गया है। विश्वविद्यालय ने बताया कि विभिन्न संस्थानों से प्राप्त अनुरोधों और 8 जून से 10 जून 2026 तक आयोजित होने वाली उत्तर प्रदेश पुलिस कांस्टेबल भर्ती परीक्षा को देखते हुए यह निर्णय लिया गया है।

इस बदलाव का उद्देश्य छात्रों को परीक्षा केंद्र तक पहुंचने में होने वाली संभावित समस्याओं से बचाना और परीक्षा प्रक्रिया को सुचारु रूप से संचालित करना है।

AKTU Revised Exam Schedule 2026

विश्वविद्यालय द्वारा जारी संशोधित परीक्षा कार्यक्रम के अनुसार निम्नलिखित विषयों की परीक्षाएं अब 11 जून 2026 को आयोजित की जाएंगी।

ध्यान देने वाली बात यह है कि केवल परीक्षा तिथि में बदलाव किया गया है। परीक्षा का समय पहले जैसा ही रहेगा।

AKTU New Admit Card 2026 कब जारी होगा?

AKTU ने अपने नोटिस में स्पष्ट किया है कि जिन छात्रों की परीक्षा तिथि बदली गई है, वे 9 जून 2026 से ERP Portal के माध्यम से अपना नया Admit Card डाउनलोड कर सकेंगे।

छात्रों को सलाह दी जाती है कि वे परीक्षा में शामिल होने से पहले संशोधित Admit Card अवश्य डाउनलोड करें क्योंकि उसमें नई परीक्षा तिथि और अन्य महत्वपूर्ण जानकारी अपडेट की जाएगी।

AKTU Admit Card Download Process

यदि आपकी परीक्षा स्थगित हुई है तो नया Admit Card डाउनलोड करने के लिए नीचे दिए गए स्टेप्स को फॉलो करें:

Step 1

AKTU ERP Portal पर जाएं।

Step 2

अपना User ID और Password दर्ज करके Login करें।

Step 3

Examination Section पर क्लिक करें।

Step 4

Revised Admit Card Download लिंक को खोलें।

Step 5

Admit Card डाउनलोड करके उसकी जानकारी ध्यान से जांच लें।

Step 6

भविष्य के उपयोग के लिए इसका प्रिंटआउट सुरक्षित रखें।

परीक्षा स्थगित होने से छात्रों को क्या फायदा होगा?

कई छात्र परीक्षा स्थगित होने को नुकसान मानते हैं, लेकिन वास्तव में यह अतिरिक्त समय उनकी तैयारी को और बेहतर बनाने का अवसर देता है।

Revision के लिए अतिरिक्त समय

छात्र अब उन विषयों पर अधिक ध्यान दे सकते हैं जिनमें उनकी तैयारी कमजोर है।

Previous Year Papers का अभ्यास

अतिरिक्त दिनों का उपयोग पिछले वर्षों के प्रश्नपत्र हल करने में किया जा सकता है।

Important Topics की तैयारी

AKTU परीक्षा में बार-बार पूछे जाने वाले टॉपिक्स को दोबारा पढ़ने का मौका मिलेगा।

Better Time Management

छात्र अब अपनी परीक्षा रणनीति को और बेहतर बना सकते हैं।

छात्रों के लिए महत्वपूर्ण निर्देश

AKTU ने छात्रों और संस्थानों के लिए कुछ महत्वपूर्ण निर्देश भी जारी किए हैं।

  • केवल नोटिस में शामिल विषयों की परीक्षा तिथि बदली गई है।
  • परीक्षा समय में कोई बदलाव नहीं किया गया है।
  • सभी छात्र नया Admit Card डाउनलोड करें।
  • परीक्षा केंद्र पर निर्धारित समय से पहले पहुंचें।
  • विश्वविद्यालय की आधिकारिक वेबसाइट और ERP Portal पर नियमित रूप से अपडेट देखते रहें।
  • किसी भी अफवाह या अनधिकृत सूचना पर विश्वास न करें।

क्या अन्य AKTU परीक्षाएं भी स्थगित हुई हैं?

फिलहाल विश्वविद्यालय द्वारा जारी नोटिस में केवल 8 जून 2026 को आयोजित होने वाली कुछ विशेष विषयों की परीक्षाओं का उल्लेख किया गया है। अन्य सभी परीक्षाएं अपने निर्धारित कार्यक्रम के अनुसार आयोजित की जाएंगी।

यदि भविष्य में किसी अन्य परीक्षा कार्यक्रम में बदलाव किया जाता है, तो विश्वविद्यालय द्वारा अलग से आधिकारिक सूचना जारी की जाएगी।

AKTU Students को अभी क्या करना चाहिए?

यदि आपका Subject Code सूची में शामिल है तो घबराने की जरूरत नहीं है। आपको केवल नई परीक्षा तिथि के अनुसार अपनी तैयारी जारी रखनी है और 9 जून से नया Admit Card डाउनलोड करना है।

छात्रों को सलाह दी जाती है कि वे इस अतिरिक्त समय का उपयोग Revision, Mock Tests और Important Questions की तैयारी में करें ताकि परीक्षा में बेहतर प्रदर्शन किया जा सके।

AKTU Exam Postponed 2026 Latest Update

AKTU के इस फैसले से हजारों छात्रों को राहत मिली है। उत्तर प्रदेश पुलिस कांस्टेबल भर्ती परीक्षा और विश्वविद्यालय परीक्षाओं के बीच संभावित टकराव को देखते हुए यह निर्णय छात्रों के हित में लिया गया है। अब संबंधित विषयों की परीक्षाएं 11 जून 2026 को निर्धारित समय पर आयोजित की जाएंगी।

जो छात्र प्रभावित विषयों में शामिल हैं, उन्हें 9 जून 2026 से अपना Revised Admit Card डाउनलोड करना होगा और नई परीक्षा तिथि के अनुसार परीक्षा में शामिल होना होगा।

Conclusion

AKTU Exam Postponed 2026 को लेकर जारी नोटिस छात्रों के लिए एक महत्वपूर्ण अपडेट है। विश्वविद्यालय ने 8 जून 2026 की 12 विषयों की परीक्षाओं को स्थगित कर 11 जून 2026 को आयोजित करने का निर्णय लिया है। परीक्षा समय में कोई बदलाव नहीं किया गया है, जबकि नया Admit Card 9 जून 2026 से ERP Portal पर उपलब्ध होगा।

यदि आपका Subject Code प्रभावित सूची में शामिल है, तो तुरंत नई परीक्षा तिथि नोट करें और संशोधित Admit Card डाउनलोड करके अपनी तैयारी जारी रखें।

FAQs

Q1. AKTU की 8 जून 2026 की परीक्षा कब होगी?

8 जून 2026 की स्थगित परीक्षाएं अब 11 जून 2026 को आयोजित की जाएंगी।

Q2. क्या परीक्षा का समय बदला गया है?

नहीं, केवल परीक्षा तिथि बदली गई है। परीक्षा का समय पहले जैसा ही रहेगा।

Q3. नया Admit Card कब जारी होगा?

AKTU ERP Portal पर 9 जून 2026 से नया Admit Card उपलब्ध होगा।

Q4. परीक्षा स्थगित होने का कारण क्या है?

उत्तर प्रदेश पुलिस कांस्टेबल भर्ती परीक्षा और विभिन्न संस्थानों के अनुरोध को ध्यान में रखते हुए यह निर्णय लिया गया है।

title.rendered: Shriram Finance Recruitment 2026: Management Trainee Hiring for B.Tech & MBA Students | Salary Up to ₹3.18 LPA, Apply Online

content.rendered:
The Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University (AKTU) has officially announced a new placement opportunity for students of its affiliated colleges. Shriram Finance Limited, one of India’s largest Non-Banking Financial Companies (NBFCs), has opened applications for the position of Management Trainee for B.Tech and MBA students from the 2025 and 2026 batches. The company is offering a permanent role with a salary package ranging from ₹2.98 LPA to ₹3.18 LPA and plans to hire more than 75 candidates through this recruitment drive.

This opportunity is particularly beneficial for students looking to build a long-term career in the finance and lending sector. Interested candidates must complete their registration before the prescribed deadline to participate in the online selection process.

Shriram Finance Recruitment 2026 Overview

About Shriram Finance Limited

Shriram Finance Limited is one of India’s most trusted financial institutions and a leading player in the NBFC sector. The company provides a wide range of financial services, including commercial vehicle loans, two-wheeler loans, car loans, home loans, gold loans, personal loans, MSME financing, and digital lending solutions.

The company is part of the 50-year-old Shriram Group and has built a strong reputation in the financial services industry. In November 2022, Shriram Transport Finance Company Limited, Shriram City Union Finance Limited, and Shriram Capital Limited merged to form Shriram Finance Limited. As of March 2026, the company operates through more than 3,225 branches across India with over 76,000 employees and assets under management worth more than ₹3 lakh crore.

Job Profile: Management Trainee

Selected candidates will gain hands-on exposure to multiple business functions and financial products offered by the organization.

Key Responsibilities

  • Learning various finance and lending operations
  • Understanding Commercial Vehicle, MSME, Personal Loan, Gold Loan, Digital Business, and Deposit verticals
  • Preparing and analyzing MIS reports
  • Working on business forecasts and financial analysis
  • Customer interaction and relationship management
  • Identifying new business opportunities
  • Supporting sales and customer acquisition activities
  • Developing customer servicing skills

The role is ideal for fresh graduates who wish to build a career in finance, sales, operations, and business development.

Salary Package, Stipend & Benefits

Shriram Finance is offering an attractive compensation package for fresh graduates.

One of the biggest advantages of this opportunity is that there is no service bond. Candidates will also receive structured training and industry exposure during their probation period, helping them develop practical business and financial skills.

Eligibility Criteria

Students interested in applying must fulfill the following eligibility conditions.

Eligible Programs

MBA

  • All Specializations

B.Tech

  • Mechanical Engineering
  • Civil Engineering
  • Electrical Engineering
  • Automobile Engineering

Eligible Batch

  • 2025 Passed-Out Batch
  • 2026 Passing-Out Batch

Additional Eligibility

  • Maximum Age: 25 Years
  • Date of Birth should be on or after 01 January 2001
  • Only Male Candidates are eligible

Selection Process

The recruitment process consists of the following stages:

1. Resume Shortlisting

Candidates will be shortlisted based on their academic profile and resume.

2. Aptitude Test

Shortlisted candidates will appear for an online aptitude test.

3. Personal Interview

Candidates who clear the aptitude round will be invited for the interview process.

There will be no Group Discussion round in this recruitment drive.

Job Locations

Selected candidates may be posted at:

  • Lucknow
  • Agra
  • Prayagraj
  • Gorakhpur

Final allocation will depend on company requirements and candidate suitability.

Important Dates

Apply Online

AKTU ERP Registration Link:
https://erp.aktu.ac.in

Official Company Website:
https://www.shriramfinance.in/

Students are advised to complete their registration before the deadline and keep their resumes updated for the shortlisting process.

Preparation Tips

To improve your chances of selection, focus on the following areas:

Aptitude Preparation

Practice topics such as:

  • Quantitative Aptitude
  • Logical Reasoning
  • Data Interpretation
  • Percentage and Profit & Loss
  • Time and Work

Interview Preparation

  • Improve communication skills
  • Learn basic finance concepts
  • Understand NBFC operations
  • Prepare answers about career goals and strengths

Resume Building

Ensure your resume includes:

  • Academic achievements
  • Internships
  • Technical projects
  • Certifications
  • Leadership activities

Why You Should Apply?

  • Permanent job opportunity
  • Salary up to ₹3.18 LPA
  • No service bond
  • 75+ expected vacancies
  • Career growth in the finance sector
  • Opportunity to work with a leading NBFC
  • Professional training and development
  • Online recruitment process

For MBA and core engineering students, this recruitment drive offers a strong entry point into India’s growing financial services industry.

Shriram Finance Recruitment 2026 is an excellent opportunity for MBA and B.Tech students seeking placement opportunities through AKTU. With a salary package of up to ₹3.18 LPA, no bond requirement, 75+ openings, and a permanent Management Trainee role, eligible candidates should apply at the earliest. Candidates are advised to register through the AKTU ERP portal and begin preparing for the aptitude test and interview rounds.

title.rendered: Future Gurukuls Recruitment 2026: ₹3.6 LPA Salary + ₹15,000 Monthly Stipend for AKTU B.Tech Students

content.rendered:
Future Gurukuls Recruitment 2026: AKTU has officially announced a new placement opportunity for engineering students through Future Gurukuls Edutech Pvt. Ltd. The company is inviting applications from B.Tech students of the 2025 and 2026 pass-out/passing-out batches for the position of AI & Coding / Robotics Trainer. With a salary package of ₹3.6 LPA and a monthly training stipend of ₹15,000, this recruitment drive offers an excellent career opportunity for students interested in Artificial Intelligence, Robotics, Coding, and STEM education.

According to the official notification released by AKTU’s Training and Placement Cell, eligible students from affiliated colleges can register through the university ERP portal and participate in the selection process.

Future Gurukuls Recruitment 2026: Highlights

About Future Gurukuls Edutech Pvt. Ltd.

Future Gurukuls is a leading STEM education company focused on equipping students with future-ready skills. The organization works with schools across India and establishes Innovation Labs where students learn technologies such as Artificial Intelligence, Robotics, Internet of Things (IoT), Coding, Drone Technology, and 3D Printing through practical experiences.

The company aims to bridge the gap between theoretical education and industry-relevant skills by providing hands-on learning opportunities to school students.

Job Role: AI & Coding / Robotics Trainer

Selected candidates will be responsible for conducting technology training sessions in schools where Future Gurukuls has established Innovation Labs.

The trainer will teach students from Classes 3 to 12 and guide them in understanding emerging technologies through practical projects and interactive sessions.

Key Responsibilities

  • Conduct training sessions on Coding, AI, Robotics, and IoT.
  • Deliver hands-on learning experiences.
  • Guide students in project-based learning activities.
  • Manage Innovation Lab resources and equipment.
  • Collaborate with teachers and school administration.
  • Monitor student performance and provide feedback.
  • Stay updated with the latest STEM technologies and teaching methods.

Salary Package and Stipend Details

One of the major attractions of this recruitment drive is the compensation package offered to fresh graduates.

Compensation Structure

  • Annual CTC: ₹3.6 Lakhs Per Annum
  • Training Duration: 2 Months
  • Training Stipend: ₹15,000 Per Month
  • Employment Type: Full-Time On-Site Job

Students looking for a stable career in the EdTech and STEM education sector can consider this opportunity as a strong entry point into the industry.

Service Agreement Details

Candidates selected for the role will be required to sign a one-year academic service agreement. This agreement is intended to ensure continuity in training delivery and student mentorship throughout the academic session.

Eligibility Criteria

Eligible Branches

Students from the following branches can apply:

  • Computer Science Engineering (CSE)
  • Electronics & Communication Engineering (ECE)
  • Information Technology (IT)
  • Electrical Engineering (EE)
  • Electrical & Electronics Engineering (EEE)
  • Other related engineering disciplines

Required Skills

Applicants should possess:

  • Strong knowledge of C Programming
  • Understanding of Arduino hardware and programming
  • Good communication and presentation skills
  • Quick learning and adaptability
  • Passion for teaching and mentoring
  • Interest in emerging technologies and STEM education

Selection Process

The hiring process will consist of the following stages:

1. Resume Shortlisting

Eligible applications will be reviewed and shortlisted.

2. Online Assessment Test

Shortlisted candidates will appear for a technical and aptitude assessment.

3. Personal Interview

Candidates who clear the assessment round will be invited for an interview.

There is no Group Discussion round in this recruitment process. The company plans to hire approximately 50 candidates through this drive.

Important Dates

Students should keep track of the following deadlines:

Interview Venue

The interview may be conducted at:

Innovation Hub, 4th Floor, CAS Building, AKTU New Campus, Jankipuram Extension, Lucknow

The company may also conduct interviews through online mode depending on operational requirements.

How to Apply?

Interested candidates can register through the AKTU ERP Portal.

Apply Link (AKTU ERP Portal):

Apply Now – AKTU ERP Portal

Students must log in to the AKTU ERP portal and register for the Future Gurukuls Edutech Pvt. Ltd. Recruitment 2026 drive before the application deadline.

Application Steps

  1. Visit the AKTU ERP Portal.
  2. Login using your student credentials.
  3. Open the Placement Opportunities section.
  4. Select Future Gurukuls Recruitment 2026.
  5. Complete the registration process.
  6. Submit your application before the deadline.

Students are advised to update their resumes and prepare for technical questions related to C Programming, Arduino, and STEM technologies before appearing for the assessment.

Why This Opportunity Matters?

The demand for professionals skilled in AI, Robotics, and STEM education is increasing rapidly across India. This role not only provides industry exposure but also allows candidates to work on emerging technologies while helping young students develop future-ready skills.

For engineering graduates who enjoy teaching, innovation, and technology, Future Gurukuls offers a unique career path that combines technical expertise with educational impact.

Conclusion

The Future Gurukuls Recruitment 2026 drive presents a valuable opportunity for AKTU B.Tech students seeking careers in Artificial Intelligence, Robotics, Coding, and STEM education. With a package of ₹3.6 LPA, a ₹15,000 monthly training stipend, and long-term career growth opportunities, interested students should complete their registration as soon as possible.

Candidates are encouraged to review the eligibility criteria carefully and prepare for the assessment and interview process to maximize their chances of selection.

title.rendered: Hitachi Internship 2026: Graduate Engineer Trainee Hiring for B.Tech, B.E & MCA Freshers | Apply Online

content.rendered:
Hitachi Internship 2026: Looking for an exciting opportunity to start your engineering career with a global technology company? Hitachi has officially announced its Graduate Engineer Trainee (GET) Recruitment 2026 for B.Tech, B.E, and MCA students. This is an excellent opportunity for freshers who want to gain hands-on experience in C++, Embedded Systems, Linux, and System Integration while working on real-world projects.

If you’re a 2025 or 2026 pass-out and searching for a high-quality engineering internship or trainee program, this opportunity from Hitachi could be the perfect start to your professional journey.

About Hitachi Graduate Engineer Trainee Program 2026

The Graduate Engineer Trainee (GET) Program is designed to identify and train talented engineering graduates for technical roles within Hitachi’s Urban & Mainlines Division. The program focuses on software development, embedded systems, hardware integration, and real-time applications.

Trainees will work alongside experienced engineers and gain exposure to large-scale infrastructure projects such as Automated Fare Collection (AFC) systems used in metro and smart transportation networks.

Hitachi Internship 2026 Overview

Roles and Responsibilities

As a Graduate Engineer Trainee, selected candidates will be involved in various technical activities including software development, testing, hardware integration, and system validation.

1. Software Development

  • Develop and maintain C++ based software modules.
  • Apply Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) concepts.
  • Write scalable and reusable code.
  • Work with multithreading and inter-process communication techniques.

2. Hardware Integration

  • Integrate device drivers with hardware systems.
  • Work with smart card readers, printers, QR scanners, and related devices.
  • Learn hardware-software interfacing techniques.
  • Collaborate with hardware engineering teams.

3. System Testing & Validation

  • Perform unit testing and debugging.
  • Support system integration activities.
  • Assist in field testing and deployment.
  • Manage source code using Git version control.

Candidates must fulfill the following requirements:

Educational Qualification

  • Bachelor of Technology (B.Tech)
  • Bachelor of Engineering (B.E)
  • Master of Computer Applications (MCA)

Eligible Branches

  • Electronics & Communication Engineering (ECE)
  • Electronics Engineering
  • Related Technical Streams

Eligible Batches

  • 2026 Graduating Students

Required Skills

Candidates should have knowledge of:

  • C++ Programming
  • Object-Oriented Programming (OOP)
  • Linux Operating System
  • Git Version Control
  • Software Debugging Techniques
  • Embedded Systems Fundamentals
  • Real-Time Operating Systems (Basic Understanding)

No previous work experience is required.

Why Join Hitachi?

Joining Hitachi provides numerous benefits for fresh graduates:

  • Work with a globally recognized technology company.
  • Exposure to large-scale engineering projects.
  • Structured training and mentorship.
  • Opportunity to learn embedded systems and real-time applications.
  • Career growth in software engineering and system integration.
  • Industry-recognized experience certificate.

Career Growth Opportunities

After successfully completing the Graduate Engineer Trainee program, candidates may transition into various technical roles such as:

Software Engineer

Work on enterprise applications, cloud technologies, and software development projects.

AFC Device Developer

Develop smart transportation solutions and Automated Fare Collection systems.

System Integration Engineer

Handle deployment, integration, and validation of large-scale engineering systems.

Selection Process

The recruitment process generally includes:

  1. Online Application
  2. Resume Shortlisting
  3. Technical Assessment
  4. Technical Interview
  5. HR Discussion
  6. Final Selection

  • Onsite Roles में Full-Time Office Presence आवश्यक हो सकती है।
  • Team Collaboration और In-Person Interaction को प्राथमिकता दी जाती है।

Selection Process

आमतौर पर चयन प्रक्रिया में निम्न चरण शामिल हो सकते हैं:

  1. Online Application
  2. Resume Screening
  3. Technical Assessment (यदि लागू हो)
  4. Interview Round
  5. Final Selection

How to Apply for Philips Internship 2026?

Philips Internship 2026 के लिए आवेदन करने हेतु:

  1. Philips Careers Portal पर जाएं।
  2. Software Development Engineer – Intern Vacancy खोजें।
  3. Eligibility Criteria को ध्यानपूर्वक पढ़ें।
  4. Resume और आवश्यक जानकारी भरें।
  5. Application Submit करें।
  6. भविष्य के अपडेट के लिए Email नियमित रूप से चेक करते रहें।
Direct Links

नोट: आवेदन जल्द से जल्द करना बेहतर रहेगा क्योंकि भर्ती प्रक्रिया पद भरने तक जारी रह सकती है।

Documents Required

  • Updated Resume
  • Educational Details
  • Identity Proof
  • Academic Certificates (यदि आवश्यक हो)
  • Contact Information

Philips Internship 2026 Salary

कंपनी द्वारा Salary का सटीक विवरण सार्वजनिक नहीं किया गया है। हालांकि Internship Stipend Best in Industry बताया गया है, जो उम्मीदवार की भूमिका और स्थान के अनुसार निर्धारित किया जा सकता है।

Conclusion

Philips Internship 2026 Freshers और Students के लिए एक शानदार अवसर है, जहां वे Software Development के क्षेत्र में Practical Experience प्राप्त कर सकते हैं। यदि आप Technology, Programming और Innovation में रुचि रखते हैं, तो इस Internship के लिए जल्द आवेदन करना चाहिए। Philips जैसी विश्वस्तरीय कंपनी में Internship आपके Career की मजबूत शुरुआत साबित हो सकती है।

FAQs

Q1. Philips Internship 2026 के लिए कौन आवेदन कर सकता है?

B.E/B.Tech और Any Degree के विद्यार्थी आवेदन कर सकते हैं।

Q2. क्या Freshers Eligible हैं?

हाँ, यह Internship विशेष रूप से Freshers के लिए खुली है।

Q3. Job Location क्या है?

Job Location Bengaluru, Karnataka है।

Q4. क्या किसी Experience की आवश्यकता है?

नहीं, किसी पूर्व अनुभव की आवश्यकता नहीं है।

Q5. Philips Internship 2026 के लिए आवेदन कैसे करें?

उम्मीदवार Philips Careers Portal के माध्यम से Online आवेदन कर सकते हैं।

title.rendered: Def-Space Summer Internship 2026 Registration Begins: Apply for AI, Cyber Security, Drone & Space Technology Training

content.rendered:
Def-Space Summer Internship 2026 registrations have officially started for students, faculty members, and research scholars interested in emerging technologies such as Artificial Intelligence, Cyber Security, Robotics, Drone Technology, Rocketry, and Space Research.

The internship is being organized by the Bharat Space Education Research Centre (BSERC) as part of its efforts to promote innovation, research, and skill development in the rapidly growing Defence and Space Technology sectors. The program aligns with India’s vision of strengthening scientific education and supporting the goals of Viksit Bharat @2047.

Students looking to gain practical exposure to future technologies and industry-oriented projects can now submit their applications before the registration deadline.

Def-Space Summer Internship 2026: Key Highlights

Why This Internship Matters

India has witnessed remarkable growth in the fields of space exploration, defence technology, and artificial intelligence over the last few years. Following major achievements in the space sector and the celebration of National Space Day on 23 August, initiatives like the Def-Space Summer Internship aim to encourage students to explore advanced technologies and contribute to future innovations.

The program has been designed to provide foundational as well as practical knowledge through expert-led training sessions, project-based learning, and exposure to real-world applications of emerging technologies.

Training Domains Offered

Participants can choose from multiple high-demand technology domains based on their interests and career goals.

Generative Artificial Intelligence (AI)

Students will explore modern AI technologies, machine learning concepts, prompt engineering, and practical applications of generative AI tools.

Cyber Security & Digital Forensics

The program covers cybersecurity practices relevant to defence systems, UAV networks, artificial intelligence ecosystems, and space infrastructure.

AI-Based Space Object Detection

Participants will learn how artificial intelligence can be used to detect space objects and predict potential collision risks.

Satellite Communication Security

This domain focuses on securing satellite communication networks and understanding modern cyber threats in space communication systems.

Quantum-Secure Satellite Communication

Students will gain insights into next-generation quantum-secure communication frameworks for future space networks.

Autonomous UAV Systems

Training includes drone intelligence systems, AI-powered navigation, environmental monitoring, and terrain mapping technologies.

Space Exploration Rover Design

Participants will understand how artificial intelligence and IoT technologies are integrated into autonomous space exploration vehicles.

Advanced Drone Technology

The course introduces students to defence drones, air taxi concepts, and emerging UAV innovations.

Aircraft Design Technology

Students interested in aerospace engineering can learn aircraft design principles, structures, and engineering fundamentals.

Rocketry Design Technology

The internship provides exposure to rocket design, propulsion concepts, launch systems, and orbital mechanics.

EV Technology & Charging Infrastructure

Participants can also explore electric vehicle technologies and the future of sustainable transportation systems.

Robotics Design Technology

The robotics module focuses on intelligent automation, robotic systems, and practical engineering applications.

AI-Based Military Intelligence Dashboard

Students will learn how machine learning and data analytics can be used for threat assessment and defence intelligence systems.

Rocket Launch and Orbital Velocities

This module introduces the scientific principles behind rocket launches, orbital motion, and space missions.

Program Structure

The internship follows a structured learning model combining live training sessions and independent project work.

Live Expert Sessions

  • Friday to Sunday
  • 3–4 hours per session
  • Interactive online learning environment

Self-Project Development

  • Monday to Friday
  • 1–2 hours daily
  • Practical implementation of concepts learned during training

This approach ensures that participants gain both theoretical knowledge and hands-on experience.

Eligibility Criteria

The internship is open to:

  • B.Tech Students
  • Polytechnic Students
  • B.Sc and M.Sc Students
  • M.Tech Students
  • Faculty Members
  • Research Scholars
  • Technology Enthusiasts
  • Beginners interested in AI, Defence, and Space Technologies

No advanced technical background is mandatory for several beginner-friendly domains.

Benefits of Joining Def-Space Summer Internship 2026

Participants can expect several learning and career-development advantages, including:

  • Exposure to cutting-edge technologies
  • Industry-relevant project experience
  • Online learning flexibility
  • Guidance from experienced mentors
  • Understanding of defence and space ecosystems
  • Practical AI and cybersecurity skills
  • Research-oriented learning opportunities
  • Internship certification upon successful completion

For students planning careers in Artificial Intelligence, Aerospace Engineering, Robotics, Cyber Security, or Defence Technology, the internship can serve as a valuable learning opportunity.

Registration Details

Interested candidates can apply through the official registration portal before the deadline.

Last Date for Registration: 16 June 2026 (5:00 PM)

Internship Registration

https://bserc.org/bsercinternship/registration-lateral

Mentor Registration

https://bserc.org/bsercinternship/mentor-registration

Cyber Security Workshop Registration

https://forms.gle/PznGwmPzEy7vnmQ46

Important Information for Applicants

  • All internship activities will be conducted online unless otherwise announced.
  • Registration fees may be applicable depending on the selected program.
  • Candidates who have already registered for the Defence-Space Summer School or Defence-Space Summer Internship are not required to submit the Cyber Security Workshop form separately.
  • Seats may be limited depending on the selected technology domain.
