Final Thoughts

The Def-Space Summer Internship 2026 presents an excellent opportunity for students and researchers to gain exposure to some of the most transformative technologies shaping the future. From Artificial Intelligence and Cyber Security to Drone Technology, Robotics, and Space Research, the program offers a diverse range of learning pathways designed to enhance technical skills and industry readiness.

Students interested in building expertise in next-generation technologies should consider applying before the registration deadline to secure their participation in this unique learning initiative.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

What is the last date to apply for Def-Space Summer Internship 2026?

The registration deadline is 16 June 2026, up to 5:00 PM.

Is the internship conducted online?

Yes, the entire internship program is conducted online.

What is the duration of the internship?

The internship runs for 45 days, from 19 June to 30 July 2026.

Who can apply?

UG and PG students, faculty members, research scholars, and technology enthusiasts are eligible to apply.

Will participants receive a certificate?

Participants who successfully complete the internship requirements are expected to receive certification as per program guidelines.

title.rendered: AKTU Notice 2026: Answer Copy में Mobile Number या पहचान संबंधी जानकारी लिखने पर होगा UFM Case, विश्वविद्यालय ने जारी किए सख्त निर्देश

content.rendered:
Lucknow, June 2026: डॉ. ए.पी.जे. अब्दुल कलाम प्राविधिक विश्वविद्यालय (AKTU) ने सम सेमेस्टर परीक्षा 2025-26 की उत्तर पुस्तिकाओं के डिजिटल मूल्यांकन (Digital Evaluation) को लेकर एक महत्वपूर्ण आदेश जारी किया है। विश्वविद्यालय ने स्पष्ट रूप से कहा है कि यदि किसी छात्र की उत्तर पुस्तिका में मोबाइल नंबर, अनुक्रमांक (Roll Number) या अन्य किसी प्रकार की पहचान संबंधी जानकारी लिखी हुई पाई जाती है, तो ऐसे मामले को अनुचित साधन (UFM – Unfair Means) के रूप में माना जाएगा।

यह निर्देश 02 जून 2026 को परीक्षा नियंत्रक प्रो. दीपक नगरिया द्वारा सभी मूल्यांकन केंद्रों, निदेशकों, प्राचार्यों एवं मूल्यांकन समन्वयकों को जारी किया गया है।

क्या है पूरा मामला?

AKTU द्वारा जारी निर्देश के अनुसार सम सेमेस्टर परीक्षाओं की उत्तर पुस्तिकाओं का डिजिटल मूल्यांकन विभिन्न मूल्यांकन केंद्रों पर किया जा रहा है। मूल्यांकन प्रक्रिया की निगरानी के दौरान विश्वविद्यालय के संज्ञान में यह बात आई कि कुछ छात्र अपनी उत्तर पुस्तिकाओं में मोबाइल नंबर, रोल नंबर अथवा अन्य पहचान संबंधी विवरण लिख रहे हैं।

विश्वविद्यालय ने इसे परीक्षा प्रणाली की गोपनीयता, निष्पक्षता और पारदर्शिता के विरुद्ध बताया है। इसी को देखते हुए मूल्यांकन प्रक्रिया को पूरी तरह निष्पक्ष बनाए रखने के लिए नए दिशा-निर्देश जारी किए गए हैं।

पहचान संबंधी जानकारी मिलने पर होगी तत्काल कार्रवाई

जारी आदेश में सभी मूल्यांकनकर्ताओं को निर्देशित किया गया है कि यदि किसी उत्तर पुस्तिका में छात्र द्वारा मोबाइल नंबर, अनुक्रमांक या अन्य पहचान संबंधी जानकारी लिखी हुई पाई जाती है, तो उस उत्तर पुस्तिका को तुरंत UFM Case के रूप में चिह्नित किया जाए।

इसके बाद संबंधित मामले को विश्वविद्यालय की अनुचित साधन समिति (Unfair Means Committee) को नियमानुसार भेजा जाएगा, जहां आगे की कार्रवाई की जाएगी।

मूल्यांकनकर्ताओं के लिए भी जारी हुए विशेष निर्देश

विश्वविद्यालय ने केवल छात्रों के लिए ही नहीं बल्कि मूल्यांकनकर्ताओं और मूल्यांकन केंद्रों के लिए भी स्पष्ट दिशा-निर्देश जारी किए हैं।

आदेश के अनुसार यदि किसी उत्तर पुस्तिका का स्कैन अस्पष्ट हो, पृष्ठ अधूरे दिखाई दे रहे हों या तकनीकी कारणों से उत्तर स्पष्ट रूप से पढ़े न जा सकें, तो ऐसी स्थिति में मूल्यांकन नहीं किया जाएगा। इसके बजाय संबंधित सूचना तत्काल विश्वविद्यालय को उपलब्ध कराई जाएगी।

इसके अलावा विश्वविद्यालय ने यह भी स्पष्ट किया है कि किसी भी परिस्थिति में मूल्यांकनकर्ता, केंद्राध्यक्ष अथवा मूल्यांकन कार्य से जुड़े अधिकारी उत्तर पुस्तिका में उपलब्ध किसी भी जानकारी के आधार पर परीक्षार्थी से प्रत्यक्ष या अप्रत्यक्ष संपर्क स्थापित नहीं करेंगे।

AKTU ने क्यों उठाया यह कदम?

शिक्षा विशेषज्ञों के अनुसार उत्तर पुस्तिकाओं का मूल्यांकन पूरी तरह निष्पक्ष और पहचान-रहित (Anonymous Evaluation) होना चाहिए। यदि किसी उत्तर पुस्तिका में छात्र की पहचान उजागर हो जाती है, तो मूल्यांकन प्रक्रिया की निष्पक्षता प्रभावित हो सकती है।

AKTU का यह कदम डिजिटल मूल्यांकन प्रणाली की विश्वसनीयता और पारदर्शिता को मजबूत करने की दिशा में एक महत्वपूर्ण पहल माना जा रहा है। विश्वविद्यालय का उद्देश्य यह सुनिश्चित करना है कि प्रत्येक छात्र का मूल्यांकन केवल उसके उत्तरों के आधार पर हो, न कि उसकी पहचान के आधार पर।

छात्रों को किन बातों का रखना होगा ध्यान?

विश्वविद्यालय के इस नए निर्देश के बाद छात्रों को उत्तर पुस्तिका भरते समय विशेष सावधानी बरतनी होगी। छात्रों को सलाह दी गई है कि वे:

  • उत्तर पुस्तिका में केवल प्रश्नों के उत्तर लिखें।
  • अपना नाम, मोबाइल नंबर या अन्य व्यक्तिगत जानकारी न लिखें।
  • किसी प्रकार का विशेष चिन्ह, संदेश या पहचान संबंधी संकेत न बनाएं।
  • परीक्षा से संबंधित सभी निर्देशों का पालन करें।
  • उत्तर पुस्तिका जमा करने से पहले उसे एक बार अवश्य जांच लें।

UFM Case होने पर क्या हो सकते हैं परिणाम?

यदि किसी छात्र के खिलाफ UFM मामला दर्ज होता है, तो विश्वविद्यालय के नियमों के अनुसार विभिन्न प्रकार की कार्रवाई की जा सकती है। मामले की गंभीरता और जांच रिपोर्ट के आधार पर परिणाम रोका जा सकता है, संबंधित विषय का परिणाम निरस्त किया जा सकता है या अन्य अनुशासनात्मक कार्रवाई भी की जा सकती है।

हालांकि अंतिम निर्णय विश्वविद्यालय की अनुचित साधन समिति द्वारा मामले की समीक्षा के बाद लिया जाता है।

AKTU Students के लिए महत्वपूर्ण संदेश

AKTU का यह निर्देश सभी B.Tech, B.Pharm, MBA, MCA, M.Tech, B.Arch और अन्य पाठ्यक्रमों के छात्रों के लिए समान रूप से लागू होगा। विश्वविद्यालय ने स्पष्ट किया है कि परीक्षा प्रणाली की निष्पक्षता बनाए रखना सभी छात्रों और संबंधित अधिकारियों की साझा जिम्मेदारी है।

ऐसे में छात्रों को सलाह दी जाती है कि वे उत्तर पुस्तिका में किसी भी प्रकार की व्यक्तिगत या पहचान संबंधी जानकारी लिखने से बचें और केवल निर्धारित नियमों के अनुसार ही उत्तर पुस्तिका भरें।

निष्कर्ष

AKTU द्वारा जारी यह नया निर्देश परीक्षा मूल्यांकन प्रक्रिया को अधिक पारदर्शी, निष्पक्ष और विश्वसनीय बनाने की दिशा में एक महत्वपूर्ण कदम है। विश्वविद्यालय ने साफ संदेश दिया है कि उत्तर पुस्तिका में मोबाइल नंबर, रोल नंबर या अन्य पहचान संबंधी जानकारी लिखना गंभीर नियम उल्लंघन माना जाएगा और ऐसे मामलों में UFM कार्रवाई की जाएगी।

परीक्षा में बेहतर प्रदर्शन का सबसे अच्छा तरीका केवल अपने उत्तरों की गुणवत्ता है, न कि उत्तर पुस्तिका में पहचान संबंधी जानकारी लिखना। इसलिए सभी छात्रों को विश्वविद्यालय के निर्देशों का पालन करते हुए सावधानीपूर्वक परीक्षा नियमों का अनुपालन करना चाहिए।

title.rendered: Principal Software Engineer Recruitment 2026: Apply for RPA Developer Role in Pune

The company offers a hybrid work model, a collaborative engineering culture, and the opportunity to work on enterprise-level automation projects that impact business operations globally.

Robotic Process Automation (RPA)

  • Microsoft Power Automate

Software Development Skills

  • Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC)
  • Testing methodologies
  • Debugging and troubleshooting
  • Agile development practices

DevOps & Automation

  • Continuous Integration and Continuous Deployment (CI/CD)
  • Automation frameworks
  • Monitoring and support practices

title.rendered: Amazon Associate ML Data Operations Recruitment 2026: Freshers Can Apply for Bengaluru Opportunity

content.rendered:
Amazon has officially opened applications for the position of Associate, ML Data Operations (GO-AI Operations) in Bengaluru, Karnataka. This is an excellent opportunity for fresh graduates looking to start their careers with one of the world’s most innovative technology companies.

The role is part of Amazon’s Data Auditing Operations team, which supports automation and inventory accuracy in Amazon Robotics Fulfillment Centers. Candidates with a Bachelor’s degree can apply for this exciting opportunity.

Amazon Recruitment 2026 Overview

About the Role

Amazon’s GO-AI Operations team plays a critical role in supporting fulfillment center automation. The team helps maintain inventory accuracy by auditing images and videos captured during warehouse operations.

As an Associate, you will review short videos of stowing activities in fulfillment centers and use specialized tools to identify product locations accurately. Your work will directly contribute to improving Amazon’s automated inventory management systems.

This is a non-technical operational role that requires strong observation skills, attention to detail, and the ability to maintain high levels of accuracy.

Key Responsibilities

Selected candidates will be responsible for:

  • Auditing hundreds of videos during each shift.
  • Reviewing image, video, and text-based tasks.
  • Identifying products and their storage locations.
  • Maintaining quality and productivity targets.
  • Following Amazon’s operational guidelines.
  • Supporting fulfillment center inventory accuracy.
  • Making accurate decisions using human judgment and auditing tools.
  • Contributing to defect reduction and process improvement.

What Will You Do Daily?

A typical day in this role involves:

  • Watching short warehouse operation videos.
  • Auditing visual data with high accuracy.
  • Using internal tools to verify product placement.
  • Meeting productivity and quality benchmarks.
  • Collaborating with remote teams.
  • Participating in virtual meetings when required.

Since the role involves continuous video auditing, candidates must be comfortable working on screens for extended periods while maintaining concentration.

Skills Required

Amazon is looking for candidates who possess:

Attention to Detail

The ability to identify even small details in videos and images.

Analytical Thinking

Strong observation skills and logical decision-making abilities.

Focus and Accuracy

Capability to work with blurry or less clear videos while maintaining accuracy.

Teamwork

Ability to collaborate effectively with remote and global teams.

Adaptability

Willingness to work in changing schedules and dynamic work environments.

Eligibility Criteria

Basic Qualification

  • Bachelor’s Degree from a recognized university.

Preferred Qualification

  • Ability to work flexible schedules.
  • Willingness to work weekends and holidays.
  • Readiness to work rotational shifts, including night shifts.

Work Schedule and Shift Details

Amazon operates in a 24×7 environment, and Associates are expected to work rotational shifts.

Shift Information

  • 9-hour work shift including breaks.
  • Rotational day and night shifts.
  • Shift timing may change based on business requirements.
  • Night shift allowance provided as per company policy.

Weekly Offs

Employees receive:

  • 5 working days per week.
  • 2 consecutive rotational weekly offs.
  • Weekends are not guaranteed as holidays.

Work From Home Requirements

For associates working remotely, Amazon requires:

  • A dedicated workspace.
  • Proper table and chair setup.
  • Adequate lighting conditions.
  • Secure handling of work-related information.
  • No unauthorized access to company devices or data.

Candidates may also be required to visit the office when business needs arise.

Why Join Amazon?

Working at Amazon offers several advantages:

Global Brand Exposure

Gain experience with one of the world’s leading technology companies.

AI and Automation Environment

Work closely with systems that support machine learning and robotics operations.

Career Growth

Build skills that can lead to future opportunities in:

  • Data Operations
  • AI Operations
  • Process Excellence
  • Quality Analysis
  • Machine Learning Support Functions

Inclusive Work Culture

Amazon promotes diversity, inclusion, and continuous learning.

Job Location

The position is based in Bengaluru, Karnataka, India’s leading technology and innovation hub.

Interested candidates can apply online through Amazon’s official careers portal.

https://www.amazon.jobs/en/jobs/10408673/associate-ml-data-operations-go-ai-operations

Candidates are advised to apply as early as possible because applications may close once the required number of candidates have been shortlisted.

Selection Process

The selection process generally includes:

  1. Application Screening
  2. Online Assessment (if applicable)
  3. Interview Round(s)
  4. Final Selection and Offer

The exact process may vary based on business requirements.

If you have strong attention to detail, enjoy analytical tasks, and are comfortable working with image and video auditing processes, this role can be a great stepping stone toward a successful career in AI-enabled operations and data management.

title.rendered: DRDO Paid Internship 2026: ₹30,000 Stipend, Eligibility, Vacancies, Last Date & Complete Application Process

content.rendered:
If you are a final-year engineering student looking for a prestigious internship opportunity in India’s defense research sector, then the DRDO Paid Internship 2026 could be the perfect opportunity for you. The Defence Electronics Applications Laboratory (DEAL), Dehradun, a premier laboratory under the Defence Research and Development Organisation (DRDO), has officially invited applications from eligible students for its six-month paid internship program. Selected candidates will not only gain hands-on experience in advanced defense technologies but will also receive a stipend of ₹30,000 during the internship period.

This internship offers engineering students a unique opportunity to work on cutting-edge technologies such as software-defined radios, satellite communication systems, surveillance technologies, and data link systems used in modern defense applications.

DRDO Paid Internship 2026 Highlights

About DEAL, DRDO

The Defence Electronics Applications Laboratory (DEAL) is one of DRDO’s leading research laboratories. It focuses on developing advanced communication and surveillance technologies for the Indian Armed Forces. The laboratory is actively involved in research areas such as:

  • Software Defined Radios (SDR)
  • Satellite Communication Systems
  • Tactical Data Links
  • Communication Networks
  • Surveillance Technologies
  • Secure Defence Communication Systems

Students selected for this internship will get exposure to real-world defense projects and research environments that are rarely accessible through traditional academic programs.

DRDO Internship 2026 Vacancies

DEAL has announced internship opportunities for students from the following engineering disciplines:

Total Vacancies: 45

Since the number of seats is limited, students are advised to submit their applications as early as possible.

DRDO Paid Internship 2026 Eligibility Criteria

Before applying, candidates must carefully check the eligibility requirements.

For B.Tech/B.E. Students

Applicants must:

  • Be pursuing a full-time B.Tech or B.E. degree.
  • Have completed their 3rd year (6th semester) or be completing it by July 2026.

For M.Tech/M.Sc. Students

Candidates pursuing:

  • Full-time M.Tech
  • M.Sc. (Electronics)

must have completed their 1st year (2nd semester) or be completing it by July 2026.

Academic Requirements

To be eligible, students must also satisfy the following conditions:

  • Minimum CGPA of 7.0 on a scale of 10
  • Must be studying in an AICTE-approved college or university
  • No backlog or failed subjects in the first five semesters of the degree program

Students who do not meet these academic requirements will not be considered for the internship.

Internship Duration

The internship duration is fixed for six months. Selected candidates will undergo training and project work at DEAL, DRDO, Dehradun.

The organization has clearly stated that students who fail to complete the entire internship period will not be eligible to receive the stipend or internship certificate.

DRDO Internship Stipend 2026

One of the biggest attractions of this internship is the paid stipend.

Selected interns will receive a total amount of ₹30,000, which will be paid in two installments:

First Installment

  • ₹15,000 after successful completion of three months

Second Installment

  • ₹15,000 after successful completion of six months

However, students must maintain a minimum attendance of 15 working days per month to remain eligible for the stipend payment.

Selection Process

The selection process for the DRDO Paid Internship 2026 is entirely merit-based.

Selection Criteria

  • Academic performance
  • CGPA/Percentage
  • Eligibility fulfillment
  • Recommendation from college authorities

Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted regarding further joining formalities and documentation requirements. The organization has also clarified that no communication regarding rejected applications will be entertained.

Documents Required

Students must attach the following documents along with the application form:

Mandatory Documents

  • Recommendation Letter from Principal/HOD/Dean
  • Updated Resume or Bio-data
  • CGPA/Marksheet Copies
  • Aadhaar Card Copy
  • College Identity Card Copy
  • Recent Passport Size Photograph

Applications submitted without the required documents may be rejected during scrutiny.

How to Apply for DRDO Paid Internship 2026

The application process is completely offline.

Step 1: Download the Application Form

Candidates need to download the prescribed application format from the DRDO Careers section.

Step 2: Fill the Form Carefully

Enter all required details including:

  • Name
  • Date of Birth
  • Aadhaar Number
  • Address
  • Branch/Discipline
  • College Details
  • CGPA
  • Contact Information

The application format is provided in the official notification.

Step 3: Attach Required Documents

Attach all mandatory documents listed above.

Step 4: Prepare the Envelope

Clearly write:

“Application for DRDO Paid Internship”

Also mention your branch or discipline on the envelope for easy segregation of applications.

Step 5: Send Through Speed Post

Applications should be sent to:

Director
Defence Electronics Applications Laboratory (DEAL)
Defence Research & Development Organisation (DRDO)
Ministry of Defence, Government of India
Post Box No. 54
Raipur Road, Dehradun
Uttarakhand – 248001

Important Note

Applications submitted through email will not be accepted under any circumstances. Only applications received through Speed Post or submitted physically will be considered.

Important Dates

Students should keep track of the following dates:

Documents Required at the Time of Joining

Selected students will be required to produce original documents at the time of joining, including:

  • No Objection Certificate (NOC) from College
  • Police Verification Certificate
  • Undertaking regarding the Official Secrets Act, 1923
  • IT Rules and Regulations Undertaking
  • Bank Account Details
  • Aadhaar Card
  • College Identity Card
  • Passport Size Photographs
  • Original Semester Mark Sheets

Benefits of DRDO Internship

Participating in a DRDO internship offers numerous advantages:

1. Exposure to Defence Research

Students get the opportunity to work in one of India’s most prestigious defense research organizations.

2. Industry-Level Learning

Interns learn practical implementation of communication and surveillance technologies.

3. Strong Resume Value

Having DRDO on your resume significantly enhances career prospects for placements, higher studies, and government opportunities.

4. Networking Opportunities

Students interact with experienced scientists, engineers, and researchers.

5. Internship Certificate

Successful completion of the internship leads to an official DRDO internship certificate.

6. Paid Learning Opportunity

Unlike many internships, DRDO provides financial support through a ₹30,000 stipend.

Can AKTU Students Apply?

Yes. Students from AKTU-affiliated colleges can apply if:

  • Their college is AICTE approved.
  • They have a CGPA of 7.0 or above.
  • They are in the eligible semester/year.
  • They have no active backlogs.

For AKTU engineering students, this internship can be a valuable opportunity to gain practical research experience before graduation.

Final Thoughts

The DRDO Paid Internship 2026 at DEAL, Dehradun, is one of the most prestigious internship opportunities available for engineering students in India. With a six-month training period, exposure to advanced defense technologies, a stipend of ₹30,000, and the chance to work alongside DRDO scientists, this internship can significantly strengthen a student’s career profile.

Interested candidates should ensure they meet all eligibility criteria and submit their applications before 30 June 2026. Since selection is based on merit and the number of seats is limited, early application is highly recommended.

title.rendered: DRDO Internship 2026: ₹30,000 Stipend, FREE Certificate & Paid Opportunity for BE/BTech Students

content.rendered:
DRDO Internship 2026: Good news for engineering and MSc students! Defence Research and Development Organisation has officially released the notification for the DRDO NMRL Internship 2026. This internship gives students a chance to work on real defence research projects while also receiving a stipend and internship certificate.

The internship is being offered by Naval Materials Research Laboratory (NMRL), one of DRDO’s top laboratories working on advanced naval technologies and defence materials.

Students selected for this internship will receive:

  • ₹5,000 stipend every month
  • Total ₹30,000 financial support
  • Free DRDO internship certificate
  • Hands-on practical experience

If you are looking for a government internship in 2026, this is one of the best opportunities available right now.

DRDO NMRL Internship 2026 Overview

About DRDO NMRL

Naval Materials Research Laboratory is a research laboratory under DRDO that works on:

  • Defence materials
  • Energy technologies
  • Naval research projects
  • Advanced engineering systems

Students selected for this internship will work with scientists and researchers on live technical projects.

Who Can Apply?

According to the official notification, the internship is open for final-year engineering students and second-year MSc students.

Eligible Engineering Branches

  • Chemical Engineering
  • Mechanical Engineering
  • Electrical Engineering
  • Electronics & Telecommunication
  • Computer Science Engineering
  • Information Technology

Eligible MSc Branches

  • MSc Chemistry
  • MSc Biotechnology
  • MSc Physics

DRDO has clearly mentioned that equivalent qualifications will not be accepted.

Minimum Marks Required

Students must have:

The student must also study in an AICTE or UGC-approved institution.

Age Limit

Applicants should be:

  • Below 25 years of age

DRDO Internship 2026 Stipend Details

Selected students will receive a monthly stipend from DRDO.

Total Stipend

₹5{,}000 \times 6 = ₹30{,}000

This means students can receive up to ₹30,000 during the complete internship period.

Important Stipend Rules

Students should know these important points:

  • Minimum 15 working days attendance every month is compulsory
  • Stipend will not come monthly
  • Payment will be released in two installments
  • First installment after 3 months
  • Second installment after completion of internship

Internship Duration

The duration of the internship is:

📅 06 Months

The internship is expected to start from:
📅 01 July 2026

Will Students Get a Certificate?

Yes, students who successfully complete the internship will receive a DRDO internship completion certificate.

However:

  • Students leaving internship midway will not get certificate
  • Pending stipend may also be cancelled

How to Apply for DRDO Internship 2026? (Step-by-Step)

The application process is fully online through email. No offline form submission is allowed.

Step 1: Fill the Application Form

Students need to fill the official DRDO internship application form available in the notification PDF.

The form asks for:

  • Personal details
  • Aadhaar number
  • College details
  • Branch code
  • Marks/CGPA
  • Contact information

Students also need to attach a passport-size photo.

Step 2: Get Reference Letter From College

Students must get a reference/request letter from:

  • Principal
    OR
  • HOD

The letter should be on official college letterhead.

Step 3: Prepare Required Documents

Students need these documents:

Step 4: Write a Short Bio-data

Prepare a short bio-data under 300 words mentioning:

  • Skills
  • Projects
  • Achievements
  • Certifications

This helps during shortlisting.

Step 5: Send Email Application

Send your application to:

📧 mmg.nmrl@gov.in

Email Subject Format

Application for paid internship with [Branch Code]

Example:

  • Application for paid internship with CS
  • Application for paid internship with ME

Step 6: Submit Before Deadline

📅 Last Date: 10 June 2026
⏰ Time: Before 5 PM

Late applications will not be accepted.

Selection Process

The selection process includes:

  1. Shortlisting based on marks/CGPA
  2. Online interview or interaction
  3. Final selection through email

Only selected students will receive joining instructions.

Documents Required During Joining

Selected candidates must carry original documents during joining:

  • Original Mark Sheets
  • Bonafide Certificate
  • College NOC
  • Police Verification Certificate
  • Aadhaar Card
  • College ID Card
  • Passport-size photos
  • Bank account details

Important Dates

Why You Should Apply?

This internship offers many benefits:

✅ Government internship experience
✅ Work with DRDO scientists
✅ ₹30,000 stipend support
✅ Free internship certificate
✅ Defence research exposure
✅ Better resume value
✅ Useful for placements and higher studies

Students interested in research, core engineering, and government sector careers should definitely apply.

ALSO READ : Deloitte Internship 2026: QA Intern Opportunity Announced – Check Eligibility, Stipend & Apply Process

Official DRDO Notification PDF

Read the official notification here:

DRDO NMRL Internship 2026 Official PDF Notification

FAQs

Is DRDO Internship 2026 paid?

Yes, selected students will receive ₹5,000 per month.

What is the total stipend amount?

The total stipend is ₹30,000 for 6 months.

Can third-year students apply?

No, only final-year BE/BTech and second-year MSc students can apply.

Will DRDO provide accommodation?

No, accommodation and lodging are not provided.

Will students get a certificate?

Yes, students who complete the internship successfully will receive a certificate.

What is the last date to apply?

The last date is 10 June 2026 before 5 PM.

Deloitte Internship 2026: Looking for a top internship opportunity in 2026? Deloitte has officially opened applications for its QA Intern Internship 2026 program in Bengaluru. The internship offers hands-on learning, exposure to software testing environments, collaboration with professional teams, and a paid stipend opportunity.

About Deloitte

Deloitte Official Website

Deloitte is one of the largest professional services companies in the world. The company provides services in consulting, audit, tax, risk advisory, and technology solutions across multiple industries.

The Deloitte network operates in over 150 countries and serves major global corporations, governments, and fast-growing businesses. It is known for innovation, workplace culture, and career growth opportunities for students and professionals.

Candidates selected for the Deloitte QA Internship 2026 will work closely with development and testing teams. The key responsibilities include:

title.rendered: AKTU Hindi Name Update 2026: Final Year Students के लिए Degree Address Correction जरूरी, विश्वविद्यालय ने जारी किया बड़ा नोटिस

content.rendered:
डॉ. ए.पी.जे. अब्दुल कलाम प्राविधिक विश्वविद्यालय (AKTU), लखनऊ ने सत्र 2025-26 के Final Year Students के लिए एक महत्वपूर्ण नोटिस जारी किया है। विश्वविद्यालय ने स्पष्ट किया है कि Degree वितरण प्रक्रिया को सुचारु बनाने के लिए सभी छात्रों को AKTU Hindi Name Update 2026 प्रक्रिया पूरी करनी होगी। इसके तहत छात्रों को ERP Portal पर जाकर अपना Hindi Name, Permanent Address और Degree प्राप्त करने हेतु सही Address अपडेट करना अनिवार्य होगा।

यह आधिकारिक सूचना 26 मई 2026 को परीक्षा नियंत्रक प्रो. दीपक नगाइच द्वारा जारी की गई है। विश्वविद्यालय के अनुसार हर वर्ष बड़ी संख्या में डिग्रियां गलत नाम या गलत पते के कारण वापस लौट आती हैं, जिससे छात्रों को काफी परेशानी का सामना करना पड़ता है। इसी समस्या को दूर करने के लिए यह विशेष अपडेट प्रक्रिया शुरू की गई है।

AKTU Hindi Name Update 2026 क्यों है महत्वपूर्ण?

AKTU ने अपने नोटिस में बताया कि विश्वविद्यालय छात्रों की डिग्रियां भारतीय स्पीड पोस्ट के माध्यम से उनके पते पर भेजता है। लेकिन कई बार छात्रों द्वारा ERP Portal में गलत Hindi Name, अधूरा पता या पुराने Address दर्ज होने के कारण डिग्री वापस विश्वविद्यालय पहुंच जाती है।

इसके अलावा कई छात्रों के Hindi Name में Spelling Mistake होने के कारण बाद में Degree Correction के लिए आवेदन करना पड़ता है। यह प्रक्रिया लंबी और समय लेने वाली होती है। इसलिए विश्वविद्यालय ने छात्रों को पहले से ही जानकारी सही करने का मौका दिया है।

AKTU Hindi Name Update 2026 प्रक्रिया का मुख्य उद्देश्य यह सुनिश्चित करना है कि प्रत्येक छात्र को उसकी डिग्री सही नाम और सही पते पर समय से प्राप्त हो सके।

किन छात्रों को करना होगा AKTU Hindi Name Update 2026?

यह नोटिस सत्र 2025-26 में अंतिम वर्ष (Final Year) में उत्तीर्ण होने वाले सभी छात्रों के लिए जारी किया गया है। इसमें AKTU से संबद्ध सभी संस्थानों एवं कॉलेजों के छात्र शामिल हैं।

इन Courses के छात्रों को विशेष रूप से अपनी जानकारी अपडेट करनी होगी:

  • B.Tech
  • B.Pharm
  • MBA
  • MCA
  • M.Tech
  • B.Arch
  • Polytechnic Integrated Courses
  • अन्य AKTU Affiliated Programs

यदि आप Final Year Student हैं और 2026 में Degree प्राप्त करने वाले हैं, तो आपके लिए AKTU Hindi Name Update 2026 प्रक्रिया पूरी करना बेहद जरूरी है।

AKTU ERP Portal पर क्या-क्या Update करना होगा?

विश्वविद्यालय ने छात्रों को ERP Portal पर जाकर अपनी निम्न जानकारी Verify एवं Update करने के निर्देश दिए हैं:

1. Hindi Name

छात्रों को अपना नाम हिंदी में सही तरीके से दर्ज करना होगा। यही नाम Degree पर Print होगा।

2. Current Address

वर्तमान पता सही होना चाहिए ताकि भविष्य में संपर्क करने में कोई समस्या न हो।

3. Permanent Address

स्थायी पता भी सही और पूर्ण रूप से दर्ज करना आवश्यक है।

4. Degree Delivery Address

जिस Address पर छात्र अपनी डिग्री प्राप्त करना चाहते हैं, उसे सही तरीके से भरना होगा।

5. Other Student Details

अन्य जरूरी छात्र विवरण भी Verify करना होगा।

AKTU Hindi Name Update 2026 कैसे करें?

यदि आप AKTU Student हैं और अपना Hindi Name एवं Address Update करना चाहते हैं, तो नीचे दिए गए आसान Steps Follow करें।

Step 1: AKTU ERP Portal Login करें

सबसे पहले AKTU ERP Student Portal पर जाएं और अपने Login ID एवं Password की सहायता से Login करें।

Step 2: “My Profile” सेक्शन Open करें

Dashboard पर Login करने के बाद “My Profile” विकल्प दिखाई देगा। उस पर क्लिक करें।

Step 3: Address Tab पर जाएं

अब आपको “Address Tab” दिखाई देगा। इसी सेक्शन में जाकर आप अपनी जानकारी अपडेट कर सकते हैं।

Step 4: Hindi Name एवं Address सही करें

अब यहां अपना:

  • Hindi Name
  • Current Address
  • Permanent Address
  • Degree प्राप्त करने का Address

सही तरीके से भरें।

Step 5: जानकारी Save करें

सभी Details Update करने के बाद Save Button पर क्लिक करें।

Step 6: Final Verification करें

Save करने के बाद एक बार पूरी जानकारी दोबारा Verify जरूर करें ताकि किसी प्रकार की गलती न रह जाए।

AKTU Hindi Name Update 2026 Last Date

विश्वविद्यालय द्वारा जारी नोटिस के अनुसार छात्र 10 जून 2026 तक अपना Hindi Name एवं Address सही/अपडेट कर सकते हैं।

इसके बाद यदि किसी प्रकार की त्रुटि पाई जाती है, तो उसकी जिम्मेदारी स्वयं छात्र की होगी। इसलिए छात्रों को सलाह दी जाती है कि वे अंतिम तिथि का इंतजार न करें और जल्द से जल्द अपनी जानकारी सही करें।

कॉलेजों एवं संस्थानों को भी जारी हुए निर्देश

AKTU ने अपने सभी संबद्ध कॉलेजों एवं संस्थानों को भी निर्देश जारी किए हैं कि वे छात्रों को AKTU Hindi Name Update 2026 नोटिस की जानकारी दें।

विश्वविद्यालय ने कहा है कि संस्थान यह सुनिश्चित करें कि सभी Final Year Students समय पर अपनी जानकारी अपडेट कर लें।

साथ ही यदि किसी छात्र के English Name या Father’s Name में गलती है, तो संबंधित कॉलेज के परीक्षा विभाग से संपर्क करने को कहा गया है।

गलत जानकारी होने पर छात्रों को क्या समस्याएं हो सकती हैं?

यदि छात्र समय रहते अपनी जानकारी अपडेट नहीं करते हैं, तो उन्हें भविष्य में कई समस्याओं का सामना करना पड़ सकता है।

Degree Delivery में देरी

गलत Address होने पर डिग्री समय पर नहीं पहुंच पाएगी।

Degree वापस विश्वविद्यालय लौट सकती है

यदि Address गलत या अधूरा हुआ, तो Speed Post वापस लौट सकता है।

Degree Correction Process लंबा हो सकता है

Hindi Name गलत होने पर बाद में Correction के लिए अलग प्रक्रिया अपनानी पड़ सकती है।

Official Documents में Name Mismatch

गलत नाम होने पर भविष्य में Job, Higher Education और Government Verification में समस्या आ सकती है।

AKTU Students के लिए महत्वपूर्ण सलाह

Final Year Students को सलाह दी जाती है कि वे:

  • ERP Portal पर तुरंत Login करें
  • Hindi Name सही तरीके से दर्ज करें
  • अपना Current एवं Permanent Address Verify करें
  • Degree Delivery Address ध्यानपूर्वक भरें
  • अंतिम तिथि से पहले सभी जानकारी Save करें

छोटी सी गलती भविष्य में बड़ी परेशानी का कारण बन सकती है। इसलिए AKTU Hindi Name Update 2026 प्रक्रिया को गंभीरता से पूरा करें।

Important Highlights

AKTU Hindi Name Update 2026 से जुड़े FAQs

Q1. AKTU Hindi Name Update 2026 क्या है?

यह AKTU द्वारा शुरू की गई प्रक्रिया है जिसमें Final Year Students को अपनी Degree के लिए Hindi Name एवं Address Update करना होगा।

Q2. AKTU Hindi Name Update 2026 की Last Date क्या है?

छात्र 10 जून 2026 तक अपनी जानकारी अपडेट कर सकते हैं।

Q3. Hindi Name गलत होने पर क्या होगा?

गलत Hindi Name होने पर Degree में नाम गलत प्रिंट हो सकता है और बाद में Correction Process करनी पड़ सकती है।

Q4. Address गलत होने पर क्या समस्या होगी?

गलत Address होने पर Degree वापस विश्वविद्यालय लौट सकती है।

Q5. English Name में गलती होने पर क्या करें?

ऐसी स्थिति में अपने कॉलेज के परीक्षा विभाग से संपर्क करें।

Q6. क्या सभी Final Year Students को यह प्रक्रिया पूरी करनी होगी?

हाँ, सत्र 2025-26 के सभी Final Year Students के लिए यह जरूरी है।

title.rendered: AKTU Releases Revised Exam Schedule After Postponement of 28 May Papers

content.rendered:
Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University (AKTU), Lucknow has officially announced the postponement of all subject examinations scheduled in both shifts on 28 May 2026 under the Even Semester Examinations for the Academic Session 2025–26.

The university has released a revised examination timetable for all affected papers and instructed students to appear according to the updated schedule.

AKTU Releases Official Examination Postponement Notice

The notification was issued by the Office of the Controller of Examinations on 26 May 2026. According to the official circular, the examinations originally planned for Thursday, 28 May 2026 have been rescheduled due to administrative and public holiday-related adjustments.

AKTU clarified that the postponed examinations will now be conducted on revised dates without affecting the overall examination process.

Revised Examination Dates Announced

As per the revised examination programme issued by the university:

  • Some papers have been shifted to Friday, 29 May 2026
  • Several examinations are rescheduled for Saturday, 30 May 2026
  • Certain professional course papers will now be conducted on Monday, 08 June 2026

Students are advised to carefully verify their subject codes, examination dates, and shift timings from the revised timetable attached with the official notification.

Courses and Subjects Affected

The postponement applies to multiple undergraduate and postgraduate programmes including:

  • B.Tech
  • MBA
  • MCA
  • Professional and Technical Courses

Several subject codes across different branches have been included in the revised schedule released by AKTU.

Examination Shift Timings

The revised examinations will continue to be conducted in the following university-approved shifts:

  • 09:30 AM to 12:30 PM
  • 09:30 AM to 04:30 PM
  • 02:00 PM to 05:00 PM

Candidates must report to their examination centres according to the updated schedule and reporting guidelines.

Updated Admit Cards Available on ERP Portal

AKTU has informed students that revised admit cards can be downloaded through the ERP Portal from 27 May 2026 onwards.

Students are advised to:

  • Download the updated admit card
  • Verify examination details carefully
  • Follow university examination guidelines strictly

Important Instructions for Students

Follow Only Official Updates

Students should rely only on official AKTU notifications and avoid misinformation circulating on social media platforms.

Continue Preparation

The revised schedule provides additional preparation time for students. Candidates should utilise this opportunity for revision and practice.

Stay Connected With College Notices

All affiliated institutions have been directed to circulate the revised examination schedule among students immediately.

Official Statement by AKTU

The university has stated that all postponed examinations will be conducted smoothly according to the revised examination programme enclosed with the official notice.

Students are requested to remain calm and continue preparing for their examinations as per the updated dates.

Conclusion

AKTU has officially postponed all subject examinations scheduled for both shifts on 28-05-2026 under the Even Semester Examinations of Academic Session 2025–26. The revised examination timetable has also been released for affected papers.

Candidates should immediately check the updated schedule, download revised admit cards from the ERP portal, and follow all university instructions carefully.

title.rendered: AKTU BCS603 Computer Networks Exam Postponed 2026 – New Exam Date, Admit Card & Official Notice Details

content.rendered:
Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University (AKTU), Lucknow has officially released an important notice regarding the B.Tech 6th Semester Computer Networks (BCS603) examination. The university has announced that the examination scheduled earlier in May 2026 has been postponed due to unavoidable reasons. This update is extremely important for all Computer Science students preparing for the Even Semester examinations.

Thousands of AKTU students were waiting for clarity regarding the exam schedule, and now the university has released the revised examination date along with instructions related to the admit card and examination timing.

AKTU Computer Networks (BCS603) Exam Postponed 2026

According to the official notice issued by AKTU, the BCS603 – Computer Networks examination of B.Tech Computer Science & allied branches under the Even Semester Examination 2025-26 has been cancelled/postponed at the university level.

The exam was originally scheduled to be conducted on 21 May 2026 (Thursday) in the second shift. However, due to unavoidable administrative reasons, AKTU decided to postpone the examination and release a new schedule for students.

This announcement has brought relief to many students who were facing preparation pressure due to multiple semester examinations.

Revised Exam Date for BCS603 Computer Networks

AKTU has officially announced the new examination date for the postponed Computer Networks paper.

New Schedule

The university confirmed that the examination will be conducted in the second shift from 2 PM to 5 PM on 05 June 2026 (Friday).

Students are advised to note this revised date carefully and avoid confusion regarding the old schedule.

AKTU Official Notice Highlights

Here are the major points mentioned in the official AKTU circular:

  • BCS603 Computer Networks exam has been postponed.
  • Revised exam date is 05 June 2026.
  • Exam timing will remain 2 PM to 5 PM.
  • Students must download a new admit card from the ERP portal.
  • Institutes have been directed to inform students immediately.
  • The new admit card will be available from 27 May 2026 onwards.

The notice has been signed by the AKTU Examination Controller.

New Admit Card Update for Students

One of the most important updates in the notice is related to the admit card. Since the examination date has changed, students will need to download an updated admit card from the university ERP portal.

Admit Card Download Date

Students can download the revised admit card from:

27 May 2026 onwards

The admit card will contain:

  • Updated examination date
  • Revised exam schedule
  • Exam center details
  • Student information
  • Subject code and timing

Students should carefully verify all details after downloading the admit card.

Why Did AKTU Postpone the Exam?

In the official notification, AKTU mentioned that the examination was postponed due to “unavoidable reasons” at the university level.

Although the university has not shared detailed reasons publicly, exam postponements generally happen because of:

  • Administrative issues
  • Technical examination problems
  • Scheduling conflicts
  • University-level adjustments
  • Center management issues

Students should avoid believing unofficial rumors circulating on social media and follow only official AKTU notifications.

Relief for Students

For many students, the postponement can actually be beneficial because it provides additional preparation time. Computer Networks is considered one of the important technical subjects in the B.Tech Computer Science curriculum.

Students now have extra days to:

  • Revise important concepts
  • Solve previous year papers
  • Practice numerical questions
  • Strengthen weak topics
  • Prepare short notes

This extra preparation time can help students improve their semester scores significantly.

Important Topics to Prepare for BCS603 Computer Networks

Students appearing for the revised examination should focus on high-weightage units and frequently asked topics.

Important Topics

1. OSI Model & TCP/IP Model

  • Seven layers of OSI
  • Functions of each layer
  • Difference between OSI and TCP/IP

2. IP Addressing

  • IPv4 and IPv6
  • Subnetting
  • CIDR

3. Routing Algorithms

  • Distance Vector Routing
  • Link State Routing
  • Routing protocols

4. Transport Layer

  • TCP vs UDP
  • Flow control
  • Error control

5. Congestion Control

  • Congestion techniques
  • Traffic shaping
  • Leaky bucket algorithm

6. Network Security Basics

  • Firewall
  • Encryption
  • Authentication

7. Data Link Layer

  • Error detection
  • CRC
  • Framing

These topics are commonly asked in AKTU semester examinations and are very important from the exam perspective.

Preparation Tips for AKTU Students

Here are some useful preparation tips for students appearing in the rescheduled Computer Networks exam:

Make a Short Revision Plan

Use the additional days wisely by creating a structured timetable.

Solve Previous Year Papers

AKTU often repeats question patterns, so PYQs are extremely useful.

Focus on Numerical Questions

Subnetting and routing numericals carry good marks.

Study Important Units First

Prepare Units 2, 3, and 4 thoroughly as they are usually high scoring.

Revise Definitions & Protocols

Short theoretical questions are frequently asked in semester exams.

Avoid Last-Minute Stress

Since students now have more time, revision should be done systematically.

Instructions for Colleges and Institutes

AKTU has also instructed all affiliated colleges and institute directors/principals to ensure that students receive this information on time.

Institutions are expected to:

  • Inform students immediately
  • Share the revised schedule
  • Help students download admit cards
  • Ensure smooth examination arrangements

Where to Check Official AKTU Updates?

Students can regularly check:

  • AKTU official website
  • ERP portal
  • College notice boards
  • Official university circulars

Avoid relying on unofficial WhatsApp forwards or fake notices.

Final Conclusion

The postponement of the AKTU BCS603 Computer Networks examination has become one of the major updates for B.Tech 6th semester students in 2026. The revised examination will now be conducted on 05 June 2026 in the second shift from 2 PM to 5 PM.

Students should use this additional preparation time effectively and make sure to download their updated admit cards from the ERP portal starting from 27 May 2026.

  • Semester Exams
  • Admit Cards
  • Results

title.rendered: AKTU Mehar Baba Competition 3 (MBC-3) 2026 Registration Open for Students & Startups

content.rendered:
Mehar Baba Competition: India’s defence sector is rapidly moving towards advanced technologies like Artificial Intelligence, autonomous systems, and drone-based surveillance. In line with this transformation, the Indian Air Force (IAF) has officially launched the third edition of the prestigious Mehar Baba Competition (MBC-3) to promote indigenous defence innovation in the country.

Launched during Aero India 2025, the competition aims to encourage startups, engineering students, innovators, researchers, and academic institutions to develop advanced surveillance technologies under the Government of India’s Atmanirbhar Bharat initiative.

This year’s competition theme focuses on developing Collaborative Drone Based Surveillance Radars using swarm drone technology capable of operating in complex and contested environments.

According to the official AKTU circular issued by Innovation Hub UP Foundation, affiliated institutions have been requested to spread awareness among students, researchers, innovation centers, startups, and faculty members for wider participation in the competition.

What is Mehar Baba Competition?

Mehar Baba Competition is an innovation initiative launched by the Indian Air Force in 2018 with the objective of promoting indigenous technological solutions for modern defence challenges. The competition provides a dedicated platform where Indian technical talent can contribute directly to the country’s aerospace and defence ecosystem.

The initiative supports:

  • Defence startups
  • Engineering colleges
  • Universities
  • Researchers
  • Entrepreneurs
  • Innovation hubs
  • Drone technology companies

The core objective of the competition is to reduce dependence on imported defence technologies and strengthen India’s self-reliance in advanced aerospace systems.

Theme of Mehar Baba Competition 3

The official theme of MBC-3 is:

Collaborative Drone Based Surveillance Radars

Under this challenge, participants are expected to develop a collaborative surveillance system using multiple drones functioning together as an airborne radar network.

The proposed solution should be capable of:

  • Detecting and tracking targets
  • Operating in contested environments
  • Sharing surveillance data in real time
  • Providing accurate target locations
  • Sending information to centralized monitoring systems

The competition highlights the growing importance of swarm drones and autonomous surveillance technologies in modern warfare.

Why MBC-3 is Important

Mehar Baba Competition 3 is not just a technical contest. It is a major national-level innovation initiative that gives Indian students and startups the opportunity to work on real-world defence challenges.

Supports Atmanirbhar Bharat

The competition promotes indigenous research and development in defence technologies, aligning with India’s vision of self-reliance.

Encourages Defence Innovation

Participants get exposure to advanced technologies such as:

  • Artificial Intelligence
  • Drone Systems
  • Robotics
  • Autonomous Navigation
  • Radar Technology
  • Secure Communication Systems

Opportunity for Students and Startups

Engineering students and startups can gain practical experience while showcasing their ideas before defence organizations and technical experts.

Strengthens Industry-Academia Collaboration

The competition encourages collaboration between academic institutions, researchers, and industry innovators to build next-generation defence technologies.

AKTU Circular Highlights

Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University (AKTU) has officially informed all affiliated institutes about the competition and requested them to encourage participation among:

  • Students
  • Faculty members
  • Researchers
  • Incubation centers
  • Startups
  • Innovation hubs

The university stated that promoting this initiative will help strengthen indigenous aerospace and defence technologies in India.

Registration Dates for Mehar Baba Competition 3

The registration process for MBC-3 has already started.

Interested participants should complete the registration process before the deadline.

Official Website & Registration Link

Participants can access the official registration form, detailed guidelines, and vision document through the Indian Air Force official portal:

https://indianairforce.nic.in/mehar_baba

Who Can Participate?

The competition is open for:

  • Indian startups
  • Engineering colleges
  • Universities
  • MSMEs
  • Innovators
  • Researchers
  • Entrepreneurs
  • Drone technology companies

Students from Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Electronics, Robotics, Aerospace Engineering, Electrical Engineering, and related technical branches may especially benefit from participating.

Technologies Expected in MBC-3

Participants may work on advanced technologies including:

These technologies are becoming increasingly important in future defence and surveillance systems.

Future of Drone Warfare in India

Drone-based surveillance and autonomous systems are rapidly becoming essential components of modern military operations worldwide. Countries are investing heavily in intelligent surveillance systems, swarm drones, and AI-enabled battlefield technologies.

India is also expanding its defence innovation ecosystem through:

  • Startup support initiatives
  • Defence modernization programs
  • Indigenous manufacturing schemes
  • Research and innovation competitions

Competitions like Mehar Baba Competition 3 provide a strong platform for young innovators to contribute to India’s future defence capabilities.

Final Thoughts

Mehar Baba Competition 3 (MBC-3) 2026 is a valuable opportunity for Indian students, startups, and innovators to become part of the country’s growing defence technology ecosystem.

With the increasing importance of AI-powered surveillance, swarm drone systems, and autonomous defence technologies, MBC-3 can become a major platform for innovation and research in India.

Students interested in Artificial Intelligence, Drone Technology, Robotics, Aerospace, and Defence Innovation should definitely explore this opportunity and participate in one of India’s most exciting defence innovation competitions.

title.rendered: AKTU Announces Strict Exam Entry Rules for 2026 Semester Exams; Students Arriving Late Will Not Get Entry

content.rendered:
Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University (AKTU), Lucknow has issued a major update for students appearing in the ongoing semester examinations for the academic session 2025-26. In a recently released official notification, the university has clearly stated that students arriving late at examination centers will not be permitted to enter the examination hall after the prescribed reporting time.

The latest AKTU circular has become an important topic among lakhs of students across Uttar Pradesh, especially those appearing in B.Tech, MBA, MCA, B.Pharm, and other semester examinations conducted by the university.

With semester exams currently underway, the university has adopted a strict no-late-entry policy to ensure transparency, discipline, and smooth examination management across all affiliated colleges and centers.

also read : The Souled Store Internship 2026: ₹10,000/Month Stipend, Apply Before 18 June

No Entry After 9:30 AM & 2:00 PM in AKTU Exams

According to the official notice issued by the Examination Controller, students must reach their allotted examination center before the closing time mentioned by the university.

AKTU has fixed the following final entry timings for semester examinations:

The university has clarified that once the gate closes, no student will be allowed to enter the examination campus or examination hall under any circumstances.

AKTU also mentioned that requests, appeals, or complaints regarding late entry will not be entertained at the university level.

Why AKTU Implemented Strict Entry Guidelines

In recent semesters, several incidents were reported where students reached examination centers late due to traffic jams, transportation delays, confusion regarding reporting time, or last-minute travel planning.

Such situations often created arguments and disturbances outside examination centers.

To avoid these issues and maintain equal rules for every candidate, AKTU has now enforced a strict punctuality policy for semester examinations.

The university aims to improve:

  • Examination transparency
  • Security arrangements
  • Fair conduct of examinations
  • Discipline at exam centers
  • Smooth examination management

The decision is also being viewed as an effort to reduce malpractice and unnecessary disturbances during examinations.

Official Instructions Issued to Colleges & Examination Centers

AKTU has instructed all affiliated colleges and examination centers to widely circulate these guidelines among students so that no candidate faces inconvenience on the day of examination.

The university has specifically asked institutions to inform students about:

  • Mandatory reporting timings
  • Admit card instructions
  • Examination discipline
  • Entry restrictions after gate closure

Students are also advised to carefully read all instructions printed on their Admit Card before appearing for the examination.

Important Advisory for AKTU Students

Students appearing in AKTU semester exams should follow these important precautions to avoid missing their examination:

Reach the Center Early

Students should try to arrive at least 30-45 minutes before the reporting time.

Carry Required Documents

Candidates must bring:

  • Printed Admit Card
  • Valid College ID Card
  • Necessary stationery items

Check Exam Center Location in Advance

Many students face problems due to confusion regarding examination center locations. Students should verify the exact location one day before the exam.

Avoid Last-Minute Travel Planning

Depending completely on last-minute transportation may lead to delays, especially in cities with heavy traffic.

Students React to AKTU’s New Exam Rule

The notification has sparked discussions among AKTU students on social media platforms, Telegram groups, and WhatsApp communities.

While some students feel the rule is extremely strict, many students have supported the university’s decision, saying it will help maintain discipline and reduce unnecessary disruptions during examinations.

Several students are also advising juniors and classmates to leave for the exam center early to avoid risking their semester examinations.

What Happens if You Reach Late?

AKTU has made its position completely clear:

  • Students arriving after 9:30 AM in the morning shift
  • Students arriving after 2:00 PM in the afternoon shift

will not be allowed to enter the examination hall.

No special permission or relaxation will be granted even if the delay is only a few minutes.

Final Words

The latest AKTU notification highlights the importance of punctuality during university examinations. Since semester exams play a crucial role in students’ academic performance and future opportunities, candidates should avoid taking any risks regarding reporting time.

Students are strongly advised to prepare their travel schedule in advance, keep all required documents ready, and reach the examination center well before the gate closing time.

Sharing this update with classmates and friends can also help students avoid unnecessary problems during examinations.

title.rendered: AKTU B.Tech 6th Semester Exam Paper Viral News 2026: University Launches Investigation Amid Student Concerns

content.rendered:
Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University (AKTU) has once again come into the spotlight after reports emerged regarding a question paper allegedly being circulated on social media during the ongoing B.Tech 6th Semester examinations. The incident has sparked concern among students across Uttar Pradesh, especially those appearing for technical semester exams under AKTU.

According to multiple media reports, a question paper related to the B.Tech 6th Semester examination reportedly appeared in WhatsApp groups during the exam hours. Following the circulation of these reports, the university administration initiated an investigation into the matter. However, it is important to note that AKTU has not officially confirmed any paper leak at the time of writing.

The incident has created a major discussion among engineering students, educational communities, and social media platforms, with many demanding transparency and stronger examination security measures.

What Happened in the AKTU Exam Viral Paper Case?

As per media reports, the controversy began when screenshots and PDFs claiming to be the B.Tech 6th Semester question paper started circulating on WhatsApp and Telegram groups during the examination hours. Students alleged that the paper was being shared while the examination was still ongoing.

The reports mainly referred to the Computer Networks subject paper, which is an important subject for Computer Science and Information Technology students in AKTU-affiliated colleges.

After receiving information about the viral content, university officials reportedly started checking CCTV footage and computer systems at the concerned examination centers. According to reports, an inquiry committee has also been formed to investigate the matter thoroughly.

However, no official statement has yet confirmed that the circulated document was authentic or that a paper leak actually took place. This distinction is extremely important because many unverified claims and edited screenshots often spread rapidly on social media during examination periods.

AKTU’s Official Response

AKTU administration has reportedly taken the matter seriously and started a formal investigation into the viral paper reports. According to media coverage:

  • CCTV footage from examination centers is being reviewed
  • Computer systems and printing logs are under examination
  • Authorities are identifying the source of the viral material
  • Appropriate action may be taken if any irregularities are found

At present, the university has not announced cancellation or re-examination for the concerned subject. Students are therefore advised not to rely on rumors or unofficial social media posts.

The university is expected to release official updates only after completing its investigation process.

Why the Issue Is Important for Students

Examinations play a crucial role in the academic and professional future of engineering students. Any report related to paper circulation or examination irregularities naturally creates stress and uncertainty among students.

Many students have expressed concerns over:

  • Fairness of the examination process
  • Equal opportunity for all candidates
  • Security of examination systems
  • Transparency in university investigations

For hardworking students, even rumors of question paper circulation can create frustration and anxiety. That is why students are requesting the university to ensure a transparent and impartial inquiry.

Social Media Reaction

The incident quickly became a trending topic among AKTU students on social media platforms including Telegram, WhatsApp, Instagram, and X (formerly Twitter).

Students shared mixed reactions online:

  • Some demanded strict action if any misconduct is confirmed
  • Others appealed to avoid spreading unverified screenshots
  • Several students requested the university to improve exam security systems
  • Some educational pages advised students to wait for official clarification before drawing conclusions

This situation once again highlights how quickly unverified information can spread during examination periods.

Importance of Verification in Viral News

One major concern in such cases is misinformation. In many instances across India, old question papers, model papers, or edited PDFs are falsely shared as “leaked papers” during exams.

Therefore, students must understand the difference between:

  • Verified official announcements
  • Social media speculation
  • Fake or edited documents
  • Unconfirmed screenshots

As of now, AKTU has only initiated an investigation into the reports. The university has not officially declared that the examination paper was leaked.

This is why students should avoid panic and follow only official university notifications.

About the Computer Networks Subject

The subject mentioned in media reports, Computer Networks, is one of the core subjects in B.Tech Computer Science and IT programs.

The subject generally covers topics such as:

  • OSI Model
  • TCP/IP Protocol
  • Network Topologies
  • Routing Algorithms
  • DNS and HTTP
  • IPv4 and IPv6
  • Error Detection
  • Data Communication

Computer Networks is considered an important technical subject because it forms the foundation of internet communication and cybersecurity concepts.

AKTU students often consider this paper moderately difficult because it contains both theoretical and technical concepts.

Examination Security Challenges in Universities

The AKTU viral paper news has once again started discussions about examination security systems in Indian universities.

Educational experts believe that universities need stronger digital security mechanisms such as:

1. Encrypted Question Paper Systems

Digital encryption can reduce unauthorized access before examinations.

2. AI-Based Monitoring

Artificial intelligence can help monitor suspicious activities during exams.

3. Biometric Verification

Biometric attendance systems can improve examination integrity.

4. Secure Printing Mechanisms

Restricted printing access and live monitoring can prevent paper misuse.

5. Stronger Cybersecurity Measures

Since many exams now involve digital systems, cybersecurity is becoming increasingly important.

Many universities across India are gradually adopting these technologies to reduce risks related to examination irregularities.

What Should AKTU Students Do Now?

Students appearing in AKTU examinations should remain calm and follow these important guidelines:

Follow Official Updates Only

Students should regularly check AKTU’s official website and notices instead of relying on WhatsApp forwards or YouTube rumors.

Official Website: https://aktu.ac.in

Avoid Sharing Unverified Content

Forwarding unverified screenshots or PDFs may create panic and spread misinformation.

Continue Exam Preparation

Until any official notification is released, students should continue preparing for upcoming examinations normally.

Ignore Fake News

Many fake “paper leak” claims circulate during exams only to attract attention on social media.

Could Re-Examination Happen?

At present, there is no official announcement regarding cancellation or re-examination. Any future decision will depend entirely on the findings of the university investigation.

If authorities find evidence of serious irregularities, the university may take necessary academic or administrative action according to examination rules.

However, students should avoid assumptions until official confirmation is released.

Growing Need for Transparent Examination Systems

The AKTU paper viral reports also highlight a broader issue in higher education — the need for trust and transparency in examination systems.

Students today expect:

  • Fair examinations
  • Timely results
  • Transparent investigations
  • Better communication from universities
  • Strong digital security

Universities across India are increasingly under pressure to modernize examination management systems and maintain student confidence.

Final Thoughts

The AKTU B.Tech 6th Semester viral paper reports have become a major topic of discussion among students and educational communities. While media reports suggest that the university has launched an investigation, there is currently no official confirmation of a paper leak.

Students are strongly advised to avoid rumors, rely only on verified university announcements, and continue focusing on their academic preparation.

As the investigation progresses, AKTU is expected to provide further clarification regarding the situation. Until then, responsible sharing of information and patience remain important for students and educational communities alike.

title.rendered: Indian Army TGC 144 Recruitment 2026: Salary ₹56,100/Month, Apply Online for 30 Vacancies

content.rendered:
Indian Army TGC 144 Recruitment 2026: The Indian Army has officially released the notification for the 144th Technical Graduate Course (TGC-144) for the January 2027 batch. This recruitment offers a prestigious opportunity for unmarried male engineering graduates to join the Indian Army as commissioned officers through the Technical Graduate Course entry.

Every year, thousands of engineering students dream of wearing the Indian Army uniform and serving the nation with pride. The TGC entry is one of the best opportunities for technical graduates because it provides a Permanent Commission, excellent salary package, top-class training, and a respected government career.

According to the official notification, selected candidates will undergo training at the Indian Military Academy (IMA), Dehradun, and during training they will receive a stipend of ₹56,100 per month. After commissioning, officers can receive an annual CTC of approximately ₹17–18 lakh per year.

Candidates who are eligible should apply online before the last date through the official Indian Army website.

Indian Army TGC 144 Recruitment 2026 Overview

Indian Army TGC 144 Vacancy Details

The Indian Army has announced a total of 30 tentative vacancies for various engineering streams. The number of vacancies may increase or decrease according to organizational requirements.

Stream Wise Vacancy Distribution

The Computer Science stream includes branches such as:

  • Computer Science Engineering
  • Information Technology
  • Artificial Intelligence
  • Machine Learning
  • Data Science
  • Cyber Security
  • Software Engineering

Similarly, Mechanical, Civil, Electronics, Electrical, and other AICTE-approved equivalent streams are also eligible.

Eligibility Criteria for Indian Army TGC 144

Candidates must fulfill all eligibility conditions before applying for this recruitment.

Nationality

The candidate must be:

  • A citizen of India
  • A subject of Nepal
  • A person of Indian origin who migrated from specified countries with the intention of permanently settling in India

Age Limit

Candidates should be between 20 to 27 years as on 01 January 2027.

This means candidates must be born between:

  • 01 January 2000
  • 01 January 2007

Only unmarried male candidates are eligible for this course.

Educational Qualification

Applicants must possess a BE/B.Tech degree in the notified engineering streams.

Candidates who are studying in the final year of engineering can also apply, but their final semester result must be declared before 01 January 2027.

Important Conditions for Final Year Students

Final year students must:

  • Submit proof of passing the engineering degree before the deadline
  • Ensure their final cumulative percentage is above the cutoff marks
  • Produce original degree certificates during the joining process

If the final result is declared after 01 January 2027, candidates will not be eligible.

Indian Army TGC 144 Salary Structure

One of the biggest reasons why engineering graduates prefer TGC entry is the attractive salary and facilities provided by the Indian Army.

Stipend During Training

During training at IMA Dehradun, candidates will receive:

  • ₹56,100 per month

Salary After Commissioning

After successful completion of training, candidates will be commissioned as Lieutenant in the Indian Army.

Rank Wise Salary

The Indian Army also provides multiple allowances and facilities, making the overall package extremely attractive.

Additional Allowances and Benefits

Selected officers are entitled to several benefits and allowances, including:

  • Military Service Pay (MSP)
  • Dearness Allowance (DA)
  • Technical Allowance
  • Dress Allowance
  • Field Area Allowance
  • Transport Allowance
  • High Altitude Allowance
  • Children Education Allowance
  • Medical Facilities
  • Army Group Insurance

The overall annual CTC after commissioning is estimated to be around ₹17–18 lakh per annum.

Physical Fitness Standards

Candidates must maintain good physical fitness before joining the academy.

Minimum Physical Standards

Candidates preparing for SSB should start physical training early to meet these standards comfortably.

Selection Process of Indian Army TGC 144

The selection process includes multiple stages.

1. Online Application

Candidates need to submit the online application form through the official website.

2. Shortlisting

Applications are shortlisted based on engineering marks and cutoff percentage.

3. SSB Interview

Shortlisted candidates are called for the 5-day SSB Interview at selection centers like:

  • Prayagraj
  • Bhopal
  • Bengaluru
  • Jalandhar

4. Medical Examination

Candidates recommended by the SSB undergo medical tests.

5. Merit List

Final merit is prepared based on SSB performance and medical fitness.

6. Joining Letter

Selected candidates receive joining instructions for IMA Dehradun.

Training at Indian Military Academy (IMA)

Candidates selected through TGC-144 will undergo approximately 12 months of military training at the Indian Military Academy, Dehradun.

IMA is one of the most prestigious military training institutions in India. During training, candidates develop:

  • Leadership skills
  • Military discipline
  • Physical fitness
  • Tactical knowledge
  • Officer-like qualities

After successful completion of training, candidates are granted Permanent Commission in the Indian Army.

How to Apply for Indian Army TGC 144 Recruitment 2026

Candidates can apply online by following these steps:

Step 1:

Visit the official Indian Army website.

Step 2:

Click on “Officer Entry Apply/Login”.

Step 3:

Complete registration using Aadhaar and educational details.

Step 4:

Fill personal, educational, and communication information carefully.

Step 5:

Upload required documents and verify all details.

Step 6:

Submit the application form.

Step 7:

Take a printout of the final submitted form.

Documents Required

Candidates must carry original documents during the SSB interview.

Important Documents

  • 10th Marksheet & Certificate
  • 12th Marksheet
  • Engineering Degree Certificate
  • Provisional Degree
  • All Semester Mark Sheets
  • CGPA Conversion Certificate
  • Passport Size Photographs
  • Government ID Proof

Why Choose Indian Army TGC Entry?

The TGC entry is one of the best career opportunities for engineering graduates because it offers:

  • Permanent Government Job
  • Officer Rank in Indian Army
  • Excellent Salary
  • Job Security
  • Respect and Prestige
  • Free Medical Facilities
  • Adventure and Leadership
  • Pension and Retirement Benefits

Apart from financial benefits, serving in the Indian Army gives immense pride and honor.

Important Dates

Final Words

The Indian Army TGC 144 Recruitment 2026 is an outstanding opportunity for engineering graduates who want to build a prestigious career in the defence sector. With attractive salary packages, permanent commission, excellent facilities, and leadership opportunities, this recruitment can completely transform your future.

Candidates should not wait for the last date and should complete the application process as early as possible. Along with academic preparation, candidates should also start preparing for physical fitness and SSB interviews.

If you are passionate about serving the nation and want a challenging yet rewarding career, then Indian Army TGC 144 is the perfect opportunity for you.

The last date to apply online is 11 June 2026.

Candidates receive ₹56,100 per month during training at IMA Dehradun.

Yes, final year engineering students can apply if their results are declared before 01 January 2027.

The approximate annual CTC is around ₹17–18 lakh per annum.

content.rendered:
Coal India Limited (CIL) has officially released the much-awaited Coal India MT Recruitment 2026 Notification for the post of Management Trainee (MT) in multiple disciplines. Candidates selected through this recruitment will be appointed in the prestigious E-1 Grade under Coal India Limited, one of the largest Maharatna Public Sector Undertakings (PSUs) in India.

Candidates can apply online through the official website of Coal India Limited before the last date.

Coal India MT Recruitment 2026 Overview

Coal India Limited is a Maharatna PSU under the Ministry of Coal, Government of India. It is the largest coal-producing company in the world and contributes nearly 75% of India’s coal production. The company employs more than 2 lakh employees across India.

Coal India has announced vacancies across several disciplines.

Among all branches, Electrical Engineering has the highest number of vacancies.

Educational Qualification

Candidates must possess the required educational qualification from a recognized university or institute.

For Engineering Disciplines

  • BE/B.Tech in the relevant engineering branch with minimum 60% marks.

For System Discipline

  • BE/B.Tech/B.Sc Engineering in Computer Science/IT
    OR
  • MCA with first-class marks.

For Geology

  • M.Sc/M.Tech in Geology or Applied Geology.

For Rajbhasha (Hindi)

  • MA in Hindi with Hindi and English as main subjects in graduation.

For Company Secretary

  • Graduate with Associate/Fellow Membership of ICSI.

Minimum Marks Required

Final-year students can also apply if their result is expected before 31 August 2026.

Age Limit

The upper age limit is:

  • 30 Years for General and EWS candidates as on 30 April 2026.

Age Relaxation

Coal India MT Salary 2026

One of the main reasons behind the popularity of this recruitment is the excellent salary package.

Selected candidates will be appointed in the E-1 Grade with a pay scale of:

₹60,000 – ₹1,80,000

Apart from the basic salary, candidates will also receive:

  • Dearness Allowance (DA)

  • Medical Facilities
  • Provident Fund
  • Pension Benefits
  • Performance Related Pay (PRP)
  • Leave Benefits

The overall annual package becomes very attractive after adding all allowances.

Selection Process

Coal India will conduct recruitment through a Computer Based Test (CBT) only.

There will be:

  • No Interview
  • No Group Discussion

This makes the selection process simpler for candidates.

CBT Exam Pattern

The exam duration will be 3 hours.

The CBT will consist of two papers:

Important details:

  • 100 Questions in each paper
  • 1 mark for each question
  • No negative marking

Qualifying Marks in CBT

Application Fee

The application fee must be paid online only.

Service Bond Details

Candidates selected as Management Trainees must sign a service bond.

  • Bond Amount: ₹3 Lakhs
  • Minimum Service Period: 60 Months

Coal India will deduct ₹5000 per month during the training period towards bond money, which will later be refunded after successful completion of service.

Posting Location

Selected candidates can be posted anywhere in India, including coalfield areas and subsidiary companies of Coal India Limited.

Candidates must be ready for all-India service.

Candidates can apply online by following these steps:

  • No interview process
  • Large number of vacancies
