Amazon has officially launched HackOn With Amazon 6.0, one of India’s biggest coding hackathons for engineering and MCA students. This national-level competition gives students an opportunity to solve real-world technology problems, showcase innovation skills, and win prizes worth ₹2.25 Lakhs along with Pre-Placement Interview (PPI) opportunities at Amazon.

The hackathon focuses on Software Development, AI Engineering, and scalable technology solutions. Students who are passionate about coding, AI, cloud computing, and problem-solving should definitely not miss this opportunity.

also read : Angel One Internship 2026: Earn Up to ₹20,000/Month Stipend – Apply Before 10 June

What is HackOn With Amazon 6.0?

HackOn With Amazon is Amazon India’s flagship annual coding competition designed for undergraduate and postgraduate engineering students. The competition allows students to build innovative solutions that can impact millions of Amazon customers worldwide.

Amazon’s tech teams work on large-scale systems involving:

  • Artificial Intelligence
  • Cloud Computing
  • Scalable Services
  • Customer-Focused Technology
  • Generative AI Solutions

The company is looking for students who can think creatively, solve challenging problems, and build impactful products.

Amazon HackOn 6.0 Important Dates

Students should remember these important dates carefully to avoid missing any stage of the competition.

Eligibility Criteria for Amazon HackOn 6.0

Amazon has defined clear eligibility requirements for students participating in the hackathon.

Eligible Graduation Years

  • 2027
  • 2028

Eligible Courses

  • B.Tech
  • M.Tech
  • MCA
  • Integrated Dual Degree

Eligible Branches

  • Computer Science
  • Information Technology
  • Artificial Intelligence
  • Data Science
  • Cyber Security
  • Electronics
  • Electrical Engineering
  • Circuital Branches

Minimum CGPA

  • 6.5 CGPA or above

Team Rules

  • Team size must be 2–3 members
  • Cross-college teams are allowed
  • Students from different branches can participate together
  • One participant can join only one team

Rewards and Benefits

HackOn With Amazon 6.0 offers much more than just prize money. Students can gain industry exposure, mentorship, networking opportunities, and career growth.

Cash Prizes

Additional Benefits

  • Pre-Placement Interviews (PPI)
  • Free Certificates
  • Mentorship from Amazon Leaders
  • Amazon SWAG Kits
  • Recognition Among Top Coders

Special Rewards

  • Top 75 Coders
  • Top 50 Female Coders
  • Top 25 Fastest Coders

These categories will receive exciting rewards and recognition from Amazon.

Competition Structure

The competition includes multiple rounds designed to test coding skills, teamwork, creativity, and innovation.

Round 1: Coding Challenge

All eligible teams must appear for an online coding assessment.

Key Details

  • Duration: 100 Minutes
  • Coding Questions
  • GenAI-Based MCQs
  • Proctored Environment

Each team member must individually clear this round.

Amazon will strictly monitor the assessment to prevent unfair practices.

Round 2: 48-Hour Virtual Hackathon

This is the core phase where teams build innovative projects.

Kick-Off Webinar (12 June)

Amazon leaders will:

  • Reveal problem statements
  • Explain evaluation criteria
  • Conduct live Q&A sessions

Build Phase (13–14 June)

Teams will:

  • Develop solutions
  • Improve prototypes
  • Create project documentation
  • Record demo videos

Final Submission (15 June)

Teams must submit:

  • Project Document
  • Demo Video
  • Working Prototype
  • Active Live Link

Round 3: Grand Finale

Shortlisted teams will enter the final stage of the competition.

Grand Finale Highlights

  • Mentorship from Amazon Tech Leaders
  • Live Presentation Before Jury
  • Interaction with AWS & Amazon Teams
  • In-Person Finale Event

The jury panel will include experts from:

  • AWS
  • Amazon Devices
  • Amazon Pay
  • Other Amazon Business Units

Why Students Should Participate?

Participating in Amazon HackOn can significantly improve a student’s career profile.

Major Advantages

  • Real-world project experience
  • Exposure to AI & cloud technologies
  • Resume enhancement
  • Networking with Amazon engineers
  • Better internship and placement opportunities
  • Learning teamwork and product-building

For students aiming for top tech companies, hackathons like this provide valuable industry exposure.

Pro Tips to Crack Amazon HackOn 6.0

1. Prepare DSA Thoroughly

Focus on:

  • Arrays
  • Trees
  • Graphs
  • Recursion
  • Dynamic Programming

2. Learn Basics of Generative AI

Understand:

  • LLMs
  • Prompt Engineering
  • AI APIs
  • Chatbot Development

3. Build a Strong Team

Try to include:

  • Frontend Developer
  • Backend Developer
  • AI/ML Enthusiast

4. Focus on Scalability

Amazon values solutions that can impact millions of users.

5. Improve Presentation Skills

Your demo video and explanation matter as much as your code.

How to Apply for Amazon HackOn With Amazon 6.0?

Students can register through the official platform before the deadline.

Official Website

Amazon India Official Website

Hackathon Registration Platform

Unstop Registration Page

Conclusion

HackOn With Amazon 6.0 is one of the best opportunities for engineering students in India to showcase their coding and innovation skills. With cash prizes worth ₹2.25 Lakhs, mentorship from Amazon experts, free certificates, and PPI opportunities, this hackathon can become a major turning point for your tech career.

Students who are interested in AI, software development, cloud computing, and scalable technologies should register before 28 May 2026 and start preparing immediately.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

Q1. Is Amazon HackOn 6.0 free?

Yes, participation is completely free for eligible students.

Q2. Can students from different colleges form a team?

Yes, cross-college teams are allowed.

Q3. Is MCA eligible for the hackathon?

Yes, MCA students can participate.

Q4. What is the minimum CGPA required?

Students must have at least 6.5 CGPA.

Q5. What are the major rewards?

Cash prizes, certificates, mentorship, SWAG kits, and Pre-Placement Interviews.

title.rendered: AKTU New Office Order 2026: 5-Day Working Week, New Class Timings & No-Vehicle Friday Initiative

content.rendered:
Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University has officially released a new office order that brings significant changes to university working hours and campus operations. The notice, issued on 13 May 2026, introduces a revised class and office schedule under a 5-day working system along with an eco-friendly “No-Vehicle Friday” initiative.

The decision has been taken in line with the energy conservation message promoted by the Hon’ble Prime Minister of India and the Hon’ble Chief Minister of Uttar Pradesh. According to the university, the new system aims to improve energy efficiency, reduce fuel consumption, and encourage environmentally responsible campus practices.

This latest update is extremely important for AKTU students, faculty members, university staff, and all affiliated colleges across Uttar Pradesh.

also read : Angel One Internship 2026: Earn Up to ₹20,000/Month Stipend – Apply Before 10 June

What Is Mentioned in the Official AKTU Notice?

According to the official office order, university offices and academic classes will now function from:

New Working Timing

09:30 AM to 06:00 PM

Working Days

Monday to Friday (5-Day Week)

The order has been implemented with immediate effect and will remain applicable until further instructions are issued by the university administration.

The university administration has also instructed all departments, institutes, faculty members, and employees to ensure proper compliance with the revised schedule.

Why Did AKTU Introduce This Change?

The main purpose behind this decision is energy conservation and sustainable campus management. In recent years, educational institutions across India have started focusing more on environmentally friendly operations and efficient resource management.

AKTU’s latest move reflects the same approach.

The university aims to:

  • Reduce unnecessary electricity consumption
  • Save fuel and energy resources
  • Promote eco-friendly campus culture
  • Improve operational efficiency
  • Encourage environmental awareness among students

This initiative also aligns with broader national sustainability goals being promoted by both the central and state governments.

AKTU Introduces 5-Day Working Week

One of the biggest highlights of this notice is the implementation of a 5-day working system.

Under this arrangement:

  • University offices will function from Monday to Friday
  • Classes and administrative work will follow the same schedule
  • Saturday and Sunday may remain non-working days depending on institutional guidelines

For many students and faculty members, this could provide better academic planning and improved work-life balance.

The 5-day week model is already being followed in several professional institutions and corporate organizations. AKTU’s decision indicates a shift toward a more structured academic environment.

New Class Timing: 09:30 AM to 06:00 PM

The revised schedule changes the daily operational hours of the university and affiliated institutions.

Updated Schedule

Students should note that colleges may now redesign:

  • Lecture timings
  • Lab schedules
  • Tutorial sessions
  • Internal assessment timings
  • Faculty working hours

It is expected that affiliated colleges will soon release their own detailed schedules based on the university’s order.

Friday to Become “No-Vehicle Zone”

Another major announcement in the office order is the development of the university and institutional campuses as a No-Vehicle Zone every Friday.

This initiative has attracted significant attention among students.

Purpose of No-Vehicle Friday

The university aims to:

  • Reduce campus pollution
  • Minimize fuel usage
  • Encourage walking and cycling
  • Create greener campus environments
  • Promote healthy habits among students and staff

Although detailed implementation guidelines may vary from one institution to another, students may need to avoid bringing personal vehicles on Fridays.

How Will Students Be Affected?

The new office order will directly impact daily student life in multiple ways.

1. Revised Daily Routine

Students will now need to adjust their daily schedules according to the new 09:30 AM to 06:00 PM timing.

This means:

  • Earlier preparation for commuting
  • Longer academic presence on campus
  • Possible changes in coaching or internship timing

Students living in hostels or PG accommodations may also need to adapt their routines accordingly.

2. Transportation Changes on Fridays

If colleges strictly implement the No-Vehicle Friday policy, students may need alternative transportation methods such as:

  • Public buses
  • E-rickshaws
  • Carpooling
  • Bicycles
  • Walking

This could especially affect students who travel daily from nearby cities or towns.

3. Better Weekend Flexibility

The 5-day week system could provide students with:

  • More self-study time
  • Better internship opportunities
  • Additional preparation time for competitive exams
  • Improved mental balance and productivity

Many students may consider this one of the positive outcomes of the new order.

Will AKTU Exams Change?

No. The university has clearly stated that all previously scheduled examinations will continue normally.

This means:

  • Semester exams will not be postponed because of this notice
  • Practical examinations will continue as scheduled
  • Existing exam timetables remain valid

Students should continue their preparation without confusion regarding examination schedules.

Important Instructions Issued by the University

The office order also emphasizes discipline and punctuality.

Students and employees have been instructed to:

  • Arrive on time
  • Follow institutional guidelines
  • Ensure smooth implementation of the revised system
  • Cooperate with administrative instructions

The university has also warned that failure to comply with instructions may result in disciplinary action where applicable.

Environmental Impact of This Decision

AKTU’s move reflects the growing importance of sustainability in higher education institutions.

Educational campuses consume large amounts of:

  • Electricity
  • Fuel
  • Paper resources
  • Water and infrastructure energy

By adopting energy-saving policies, universities can significantly reduce operational costs while contributing positively to environmental protection.

The No-Vehicle Friday initiative is particularly important because transportation-related pollution remains a major issue in urban educational campuses.

Student Reactions on Social Media

Many AKTU students have already started discussing the new office order online.

Some students appreciate:

  • The 5-day week system
  • Environmental awareness initiatives
  • Structured working hours

While others are concerned about:

  • Extended campus hours
  • Transportation difficulties
  • Friday commuting restrictions

Overall, the notice has generated widespread discussion across AKTU-affiliated colleges.

What Should AKTU Students Do Now?

Students are advised to stay updated and prepare accordingly.

Recommended Steps

  • Regularly check official college notices
  • Confirm revised class schedules
  • Plan Friday transportation in advance
  • Follow instructions issued by departments
  • Avoid relying on unofficial social media rumors

Since implementation may differ across institutions, students should remain connected with their college administration.

Official Notice Summary

Conclusion

The latest AKTU office order marks a major administrative and environmental initiative by the university. The implementation of a 5-day working week, revised class timings, and No-Vehicle Fridays shows the university’s growing focus on sustainable campus management and energy conservation.

While students may initially need time to adjust to the new routine, the long-term benefits could include improved academic structure, reduced pollution, and better resource management.

Students are strongly advised to follow official updates from their colleges and continue monitoring future notifications issued by AKTU.

FAQs

Q1. What is the new AKTU timing for classes and offices?

The new timing is 09:30 AM to 06:00 PM.

Q2. Is AKTU following a 5-day week now?

Yes, the university has introduced a Monday-to-Friday working system until further notice.

Q3. Will exams be postponed because of this order?

No, existing examinations will continue according to their original schedule.

Q4. What is No-Vehicle Friday in AKTU?

It is an initiative to reduce pollution and promote eco-friendly transportation inside university campuses.

Q5. From when is this order applicable?

The order became effective immediately after being issued on 13 May 2026.

title.rendered: AKTU Internal Marks Upload 2026: Theory & Practical Sessional Marks Upload Started, Check Full Official Notice

content.rendered:
Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University (AKTU), Lucknow has officially released an important notification regarding the upload of internal sessional marks for the academic session 2025-26. The notice is applicable for students enrolled in undergraduate and postgraduate courses under AKTU, including both regular and carry-over subjects.

According to the official circular issued by the university, affiliated colleges and institutions are required to upload Theory Sessional and Practical Sessional marks through the ERP portal within the given deadline. This announcement is extremely important because internal marks play a crucial role in the final semester result and grade calculation.

Students studying in AKTU-affiliated colleges are advised to stay updated with this notice and ensure that their internal marks are uploaded correctly by their institutions.

also read : AKTU Practical Exam Date 2026 Released: B.Tech, B.Pharm, MBA, MCA Practical Schedule Out for Even Semester

AKTU Internal Marks Upload Dates 2026

As per the official notice released by AKTU, the ERP portal has been activated for uploading internal assessment marks from:

  • Starting Date: 11 May 2026
  • Last Date for Upload: 18 May 2026

The upload process includes:

  • Theory Sessional Marks
  • Practical Sessional Marks
  • Internal Assessment Marks
  • Marks for Regular Students
  • Marks for Carry Over Subjects

The university has clearly instructed all institutions to complete the upload process within the specified dates to avoid any issues later.

What Is Included in the AKTU Notice?

The official circular mentions that all affiliated colleges must upload internal marks online through the ERP portal. Along with the online submission, institutions are also required to submit hard copies of the uploaded marks.

The hard copies should contain:

  • Signature of Internal Examiner
  • Signature of Director/Principal
  • Proper Date Mentioned
  • Spiral Binding of Documents

These signed documents must be submitted compulsorily to the university office by 25 May 2026.

AKTU has also instructed colleges to safely preserve all documents related to internal examinations and assessments for future verification purposes.

Why Internal Marks Are Important in AKTU?

Internal marks are one of the most important components of AKTU semester examinations. These marks directly impact a student’s final SGPA and overall academic performance.

Generally, internal marks include:

  • Class tests
  • Attendance
  • Assignments
  • Viva
  • Practical performance
  • Lab work
  • Project submissions

If internal marks are not uploaded properly, students may face multiple problems such as:

  • Result showing incomplete
  • Missing marks in marksheet
  • Result withheld
  • Back paper issues
  • Delay in final result declaration

This is why students should stay connected with their departments and verify whether their marks have been uploaded correctly.

AKTU ERP Portal Activated for Internal Marks Upload

The university has activated the ERP portal specifically for the internal marks uploading process. Since the portal remains open only for a limited time, AKTU has advised institutions not to wait until the last date.

Many times, colleges face technical problems on the ERP portal near the deadline due to heavy traffic. Therefore, early submission has been recommended by the university.

Students should also keep checking:

  • Official AKTU Website
  • ERP Notifications
  • College Notice Boards
  • Department WhatsApp Groups
  • Official Circulars

This will help them stay informed about any further updates related to sessional marks.

Instructions Issued by AKTU for Colleges

The university has provided several important instructions for colleges and institutions. These instructions are mandatory and need to be followed carefully.

Key Instructions Include:

1. Timely Upload of Marks

All internal marks must be uploaded within the prescribed deadline, i.e., before 18 May 2026.

2. Hard Copy Submission

Institutions must submit signed hard copies of uploaded marks by 25 May 2026.

3. Proper Verification

All uploaded marks should be verified carefully before final submission.

4. Safe Record Maintenance

Colleges must maintain proper records of:

  • Attendance sheets
  • Practical files
  • Internal evaluation sheets
  • Viva records
  • Sessionals documents

5. Student Notification

Institutions are requested to inform students regarding internal marks upload and related procedures.

What Should Students Do After This Notice?

After the release of this official AKTU notification, students should take some important steps to avoid future problems.

Students Should:

  • Contact their class coordinators
  • Verify attendance records
  • Confirm practical marks
  • Ask faculty about sessional marks upload
  • Check ERP status regularly
  • Report discrepancies immediately

If any student notices incorrect marks or missing entries, they should immediately contact their college administration before the portal closes.

AKTU Carry Over Students Also Included

One important point mentioned in the notice is that the upload process is applicable not only for regular students but also for carry-over students.

This means students having back papers or carry-over subjects must also ensure that their internal marks are uploaded correctly.

Carry-over students often ignore sessional marks verification, which later creates issues during result processing. Therefore, such students should remain extra careful.

Common Problems Students Face Related to Internal Marks

Every semester, many AKTU students face issues related to internal marks. Some of the most common problems include:

Missing Internal Marks

Sometimes colleges fail to upload marks before the deadline.

Incorrect Marks Uploaded

Wrong marks may get entered accidentally.

Attendance Issues

Low attendance may affect sessional marks.

Practical Marks Not Updated

Lab marks sometimes remain pending on the ERP portal.

Result Withheld

Incomplete marks can lead to withheld results.

To avoid these issues, students should regularly communicate with faculty members and check updates.

Official Statement by AKTU Examination Controller

The circular has been officially issued under the signature of:

Prof. Deepak Nagar
Controller of Examination
Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University, Lucknow

The notice has also been forwarded to various university departments and officials for necessary action and implementation.

Important Dates Students Must Remember

Students should note these dates carefully because missing any update related to internal marks may create issues in semester results.

How to Check AKTU ERP Updates?

Students can follow these methods to stay updated:

Official Website

Visit the official AKTU website regularly for notifications.

College ERP Portal

Some colleges provide ERP login access to students.

Department Groups

Most departments share updates through WhatsApp or Telegram groups.

Faculty Communication

Students should stay connected with teachers and class coordinators.

Importance of Practical and Theory Sessionals

Theory and practical sessional marks are essential because they reflect a student’s continuous academic performance throughout the semester.

Theory Sessionals Usually Include:

  • Mid-sem exams
  • Class tests
  • Assignments
  • Quiz performance

Practical Sessionals Include:

  • Lab performance
  • Viva voce
  • Experiment files
  • Attendance in labs

Good internal marks can significantly improve overall SGPA.

Can Students Change Internal Marks Later?

Usually, after the ERP portal closes and marks are finalized, it becomes difficult to make corrections. Therefore, students should immediately report any mistake before the deadline.

In some cases, colleges may request corrections from the university, but the process can take time. Hence, early verification is always recommended.

AKTU Students Advised to Stay Alert

AKTU students are advised not to ignore this notification. Internal marks are extremely important and directly affect academic records.

Students should:

  • Stay active in department groups
  • Check official notices daily
  • Verify all subject marks
  • Contact faculty if needed

title.rendered: NEET UG 2026 Cancelled: NTA Announces Re-Exam After CBI Investigation Concerns

content.rendered:
The National Testing Agency (NTA) has officially cancelled the NEET UG 2026 examination conducted on 3 May 2026. The decision was announced after inputs from central agencies and findings shared by law enforcement authorities regarding alleged irregularities in the examination process.

This announcement has shocked lakhs of medical aspirants across India. Along with cancelling the examination, the Government of India has also ordered a comprehensive CBI inquiry into the matter.

For students preparing for MBBS, BDS, AYUSH, and other medical courses, this is one of the biggest education updates of 2026.

In this detailed article, we explain:

  • Why NEET UG 2026 was cancelled
  • What NTA said officially
  • Re-exam date expectations
  • Refund details
  • Admit card update
  • CBI investigation
  • What students should do next

also read : Bluemutulfund Data Analyst Internship 2026: Work From Home Opportunity for Students

NEET UG 2026 Officially Cancelled

The NTA confirmed that the NEET UG examination held on 3 May 2026 has been cancelled nationwide.

According to the official statement, the agency reviewed multiple inputs received from central investigative agencies and law enforcement departments. After examining the evidence, NTA concluded that the integrity of the examination process had been compromised.

As a result, the Government of India approved the cancellation of the examination in order to protect transparency and trust in the national testing system.

This means all candidates who appeared for the exam will now have to appear again in the re-conducted NEET UG 2026 examination.

Why Did NTA Cancel NEET UG 2026?

NTA stated that on 8 May 2026, the agency referred the matter to central agencies for independent verification and investigation.

After reviewing the findings, the agency said:

“The present examination process could not be allowed to stand.”

The decision was reportedly taken after concerns related to:

  • Examination security
  • Paper leak allegations
  • Unfair practices
  • Credibility of the exam process
  • Trust in the national examination system

Although the agency has not publicly shared complete investigation details yet, the seriousness of the issue led to the cancellation of India’s largest medical entrance examination.

Government Orders CBI Inquiry

One of the most important developments is that the Government of India has referred the matter to the Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI).

The CBI will conduct a comprehensive investigation into the allegations and findings linked to NEET UG 2026.

NTA has confirmed that it will fully cooperate with the investigation and provide:

  • Examination records
  • Candidate data
  • Internal documents
  • Investigation-related materials

The involvement of the CBI indicates the high level of seriousness attached to the issue.

NEET UG 2026 Re-Exam Date

At present, NTA has not announced the new NEET UG 2026 re-exam date.

However, the agency stated that:

  • Fresh exam dates will be announced soon
  • New admit cards will be issued
  • Official notifications will be released through NTA channels only

Students are advised not to trust unofficial reports or viral social media posts regarding re-exam dates.

The official schedule is expected in the coming days.

No Fresh Registration Required

NTA has provided major relief for candidates by confirming that students do not need to register again.

The following details from the previous application will remain valid:

  • Registration data
  • Candidate details
  • Exam city preference
  • Selected examination centres

This means students only need to wait for the revised examination schedule and fresh admit cards.

NEET UG 2026 Fees Refund Update

Another important announcement is related to examination fees.

According to NTA:

  • No additional fee will be charged for the re-exam
  • Fees already paid by students will be refunded
  • The re-conducted exam will be organized using NTA’s internal resources

This decision is expected to reduce the financial burden on students and parents.

NTA Admits Re-Exam Will Cause Inconvenience

The agency acknowledged that conducting the examination again will create serious inconvenience for students and families.

However, NTA said maintaining fairness and trust in the examination system was more important than continuing with a compromised process.

In its statement, the agency explained that allowing the current examination process to stand would have caused “greater and more lasting damage” to public trust.

What Should NEET Aspirants Do Now?

The cancellation has created stress and uncertainty among students. However, experts are advising candidates to stay focused and continue preparation.

Continue Revision

Students should continue preparing:

  • Biology NCERT
  • Physics formulas
  • Chemistry reactions
  • Mock tests
  • Previous year questions

The syllabus is expected to remain unchanged.

Avoid Fake News and Rumours

Many fake notices are circulating on social media regarding:

  • Re-exam dates
  • Result announcements
  • Court decisions
  • Cancellation rumors

Students should only trust official updates from NTA and government sources.

Keep Important Documents Ready

Candidates should safely keep:

  • Application number
  • Registered mobile number
  • Email ID
  • Previous admit card
  • Identity proof

These documents may be required when the revised admit cards are released.

Expected Impact on MBBS Admissions 2026

The NEET UG 2026 cancellation is likely to delay:

  • Result declaration
  • NEET counseling
  • Medical college admissions
  • Academic session start dates

However, education authorities are expected to fast-track the revised process once the fresh examination is conducted.

Medical aspirants are now waiting for clarity regarding:

  • New exam date
  • Result timeline
  • Counseling schedule
  • Academic calendar

Students React on Social Media

Soon after the announcement, social media platforms witnessed massive reactions from NEET aspirants.

Some students supported the decision because they believed fairness should come first. Others expressed frustration due to:

  • Mental pressure
  • Long preparation periods
  • Delayed admissions
  • Increased uncertainty
  • Financial stress

Despite mixed reactions, many education experts believe the decision was necessary to protect the credibility of India’s medical entrance examination system.

Official NTA Helpline

Students and parents can contact NTA through the official helpline:

  • Email: neet-ug@nta.ac.in
  • Phone: 011-40759000
  • Phone: 011-69227700

Candidates should rely only on official communication channels for updates.

Final Verdict

The cancellation of NEET UG 2026 is one of the biggest education developments in India this year. While the decision may temporarily affect students and the admission process, the Government and NTA believe it was necessary to maintain transparency, fairness, and trust in the examination system.

For now, students should remain calm, avoid misinformation, and continue preparing seriously for the re-examination.

The official re-exam dates and admit card schedule are expected soon.

FAQs

Is NEET UG 2026 cancelled officially?

Yes, NTA has officially cancelled the NEET UG 2026 exam conducted on 3 May 2026.

Will NEET UG 2026 be conducted again?

Yes, NTA will re-conduct the examination on fresh dates that will be announced separately.

Do students need to apply again?

No. Existing registrations and exam centre preferences will remain valid.

Will students have to pay the examination fee again?

No additional fee will be charged for the re-examination.

Who is investigating the NEET UG 2026 issue?

The Government of India has referred the matter to the CBI for a detailed investigation.

When will the NEET UG 2026 re-exam date be announced?

NTA has said the revised examination schedule will be released soon through official channels.

रिपोर्ट्स के अनुसार, परीक्षा शुरू होने के केवल दो दिनों के अंदर 160 से ज्यादा छात्र नकल करते हुए पकड़े गए हैं। विश्वविद्यालय प्रशासन का कहना है कि इस बार AI आधारित मॉनिटरिंग, CCTV कैमरे और लाइव कंट्रोल रूम सिस्टम की वजह से परीक्षा केंद्रों की हर गतिविधि पर नजर रखी जा रही है।

AKTU Exam 2026 में क्यों बढ़ी सख्ती?

पिछले कुछ वर्षों में विश्वविद्यालय परीक्षाओं में नकल के मामलों को लेकर लगातार सवाल उठते रहे हैं। इसी को देखते हुए AKTU ने इस बार परीक्षा प्रक्रिया को पूरी तरह टेक्नोलॉजी आधारित बनाने का फैसला किया।

विश्वविद्यालय प्रशासन ने कई जिलों के परीक्षा केंद्रों को लाइव निगरानी सिस्टम से जोड़ा है। लखनऊ में बनाए गए आधुनिक कंट्रोल रूम में बड़ी स्क्रीन के जरिए प्रदेशभर के परीक्षा केंद्रों की लाइव मॉनिटरिंग की जा रही है।

इसका सबसे बड़ा फायदा यह हुआ कि कई ऐसे छात्र भी पकड़ में आ गए जिन्हें परीक्षा केंद्र पर मौजूद कक्ष निरीक्षक नहीं पकड़ पाए थे।

गाजियाबाद में कैसे पकड़ी गई नकल?

गाजियाबाद के एक परीक्षा केंद्र का वीडियो जब कंट्रोल रूम में देखा जा रहा था, तब एक छात्र की गतिविधियां संदिग्ध लगीं। पहली नजर में छात्र सामान्य तरीके से परीक्षा देता हुआ दिखाई दे रहा था।

लेकिन कंट्रोल रूम में मौजूद टीम को बार-बार उसके एडमिट कार्ड को देखने का तरीका अजीब लगा। इसके बाद संबंधित परीक्षा केंद्र को अलर्ट भेजा गया।

जांच में पता चला कि छात्र ने अपने एडमिट कार्ड के पीछे कई महत्वपूर्ण फार्मूले लिख रखे थे। यह तरीका काफी चालाकी भरा था क्योंकि सामान्य जांच में इसे पकड़ना आसान नहीं था।

हालांकि कैमरा मॉनिटरिंग और लाइव निगरानी के कारण छात्र की पूरी कोशिश नाकाम हो गई।

सिर्फ दो दिनों में 160 से ज्यादा नकलची

AKTU की सम सेमेस्टर परीक्षाएं 7 मई 2026 से शुरू हुई हैं और 7 जून 2026 तक चलेंगी। परीक्षा के शुरुआती दो दिनों में ही 160 से ज्यादा छात्र नकल करते हुए पकड़े गए।

इन छात्रों में इंजीनियरिंग, फार्मेसी, मैनेजमेंट और अन्य प्रोफेशनल कोर्स के छात्र शामिल हैं।

विश्वविद्यालय प्रशासन के अनुसार, कुछ छात्र पारंपरिक तरीके से नकल करते मिले जबकि कुछ ने नए और तकनीकी तरीके अपनाने की कोशिश की। लेकिन इस बार कंट्रोल रूम की निगरानी ने अधिकांश मामलों को पकड़ लिया।

AI और CCTV तकनीक बनी सबसे बड़ी ताकत

AKTU द्वारा इस बार इस्तेमाल की जा रही तकनीक छात्रों के बीच चर्चा का विषय बन चुकी है।

विश्वविद्यालय ने परीक्षा केंद्रों पर CCTV कैमरे लगाए हैं जिनकी लाइव फीड सीधे कंट्रोल रूम तक पहुंचती है। इसके अलावा AI आधारित मॉनिटरिंग सिस्टम संदिग्ध गतिविधियों को पहचानने में मदद कर रहा है।

अगर कोई छात्र बार-बार नीचे देखता है, किसी कागज को छिपाने की कोशिश करता है या असामान्य गतिविधि करता है, तो कंट्रोल रूम टीम तुरंत अलर्ट हो जाती है।

इसी तकनीक के कारण गाजियाबाद का मामला सामने आया।

छात्रों में बढ़ा डर और तनाव

इस सख्त निगरानी के बाद कई छात्रों में डर का माहौल भी देखने को मिल रहा है।

कुछ students का कहना है कि अब परीक्षा के दौरान हर समय कैमरों की निगरानी होने से काफी दबाव महसूस होता है। वहीं दूसरी तरफ कई छात्र इस फैसले का समर्थन भी कर रहे हैं।

ईमानदारी से परीक्षा देने वाले छात्रों का कहना है कि इससे परीक्षा व्यवस्था अधिक पारदर्शी बनेगी और मेहनत करने वाले छात्रों को फायदा मिलेगा।

विश्वविद्यालय प्रशासन ने क्या कहा?

AKTU प्रशासन ने स्पष्ट किया है कि परीक्षा में किसी भी प्रकार की अनुचित गतिविधि को बर्दाश्त नहीं किया जाएगा।

विश्वविद्यालय के अधिकारियों के अनुसार, नकल करते पकड़े गए छात्रों पर विश्वविद्यालय नियमों के अनुसार कार्रवाई की जाएगी। ऐसे छात्रों की कॉपियां निरस्त की जा सकती हैं और भविष्य की परीक्षाओं पर भी असर पड़ सकता है।

प्रशासन का कहना है कि आने वाले दिनों में निगरानी और अधिक सख्त की जा सकती है।

सोशल मीडिया पर वायरल हुई खबर

जैसे ही यह खबर सामने आई, सोशल media प्लेटफॉर्म्स पर तेजी से वायरल होने लगी।

कई छात्रों ने इस घटना पर मजेदार मीम्स और प्रतिक्रियाएं शेयर कीं। वहीं कुछ लोगों ने इसे शिक्षा व्यवस्था के लिए अच्छा कदम बताया।

विशेष रूप से “एडमिट कार्ड के पीछे फार्मूले लिखने” वाला मामला सोशल मीडिया पर काफी ट्रेंड कर रहा है।

AKTU छात्रों के लिए जरूरी सलाह

अगर आप भी AKTU की परीक्षाएं दे रहे हैं, तो यह खबर आपके लिए महत्वपूर्ण है।

अब विश्वविद्यालय पूरी तरह डिजिटल निगरानी पर काम कर रहा है। ऐसे में किसी भी प्रकार की नकल करने की कोशिश भविष्य के लिए नुकसानदायक साबित हो सकती है।

छात्रों को चाहिए कि वे परीक्षा की तैयारी सही तरीके से करें और किसी भी अनुचित साधन का उपयोग न करें।

क्या भविष्य में और सख्त होगी परीक्षा व्यवस्था?

विशेषज्ञों का मानना है कि आने वाले समय में अधिकतर विश्वविद्यालय AI आधारित निगरानी सिस्टम अपनाएंगे।

ऑनलाइन और ऑफलाइन दोनों प्रकार की परीक्षाओं में अब टेक्नोलॉजी का उपयोग तेजी से बढ़ रहा है। AKTU का यह मॉडल दूसरे विश्वविद्यालयों के लिए भी उदाहरण बन सकता है।

अगर यह सिस्टम सफल रहता है, तो भविष्य में और ज्यादा कैमरे, फेस रिकग्निशन सिस्टम और AI ट्रैकिंग तकनीकें इस्तेमाल की जा सकती हैं।

निष्कर्ष

AKTU Exam 2026 में सामने आया यह मामला साफ दिखाता है कि अब परीक्षा व्यवस्था पूरी तरह बदल रही है।

गाजियाबाद में हो रही नकल को लखनऊ कंट्रोल रूम से पकड़ना इस बात का संकेत है कि तकनीक के दौर में नकल करना आसान नहीं रह गया है।

विश्वविद्यालय प्रशासन की सख्ती और AI आधारित निगरानी आने वाले समय में परीक्षाओं को अधिक निष्पक्ष और पारदर्शी बना सकती है।

छात्रों के लिए यही सबसे बड़ी सीख है कि मेहनत और सही तैयारी ही सफलता का असली रास्ता है।

FAQ – AKTU Exam Cheating News 2026

Q1. AKTU में कितने छात्र नकल करते पकड़े गए?

सम सेमेस्टर परीक्षा 2026 के शुरुआती दो दिनों में 160 से ज्यादा छात्र नकल करते हुए पकड़े गए।

Q2. गाजियाबाद वाला मामला क्या था?

एक छात्र ने अपने एडमिट कार्ड के पीछे फार्मूले लिख रखे थे, जिसे लखनऊ कंट्रोल रूम की निगरानी में पकड़ा गया।

Q3. AKTU परीक्षा कब तक चलेगी?

सम सेमेस्टर परीक्षाएं 7 मई 2026 से शुरू होकर 7 जून 2026 तक चलेंगी।

Q4. क्या AI तकनीक का इस्तेमाल हो रहा है?

हां, AKTU इस बार AI आधारित मॉनिटरिंग और CCTV कैमरों का उपयोग कर रहा है।

Q5. नकल करते पकड़े जाने पर क्या कार्रवाई होगी?

विश्वविद्यालय नियमों के अनुसार कॉपी निरस्त करने सहित अन्य अनुशासनात्मक कार्रवाई की जा सकती है।

content.rendered:
AKTU UFM Notice 2026: Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University (AKTU), Lucknow, has issued an important update for students appearing in the Even Semester Examination 2025-26. According to the latest AKTU UFM Notice 2025, students must not write their mobile number, address, phone number, or any identification mark inside the answer sheet.

The university warned that violating this instruction may result in action under the Unfair Means (UFM) rules.

AKTU UFM Notice 2026 Released for Even Semester Exams

As per the official notification, AKTU conducted the Even Semester written examinations from 07 May 2026 to 06 June 2026. The university has instructed all affiliated colleges, examination centers, principals, and students to strictly follow examination guidelines.

Under the latest AKTU UFM Notice 2025, students are only allowed to fill information in the designated area provided on the cover page of the answer booklet.

Writing personal details anywhere else in the answer sheet is strictly prohibited.

What Students Should Not Write in the Answer Sheet

AKTU clearly mentioned that students must avoid writing:

  • Mobile Number
  • Phone Number
  • Address
  • Contact Details
  • Identification Symbols
  • Special Marks or Hidden Signs

inside the answer booklet.

According to the AKTU UFM Notice 2025, such actions may be treated as attempts to influence the examiner.

AKTU UFM Rule B (05) Explained

The university referred to UFM Rule B (05) in the official notice, which states:

“Attempts to bribe the examiner by mentioning address, contact detail, Mobile No. etc.”

This means that if any student writes personal contact information in the answer sheet, the university may initiate UFM proceedings against the candidate.

The AKTU UFM Notice 2025 also clarifies that the student will be personally responsible for any violation of examination rules.

Why AKTU Issued This Notice

The purpose of the AKTU UFM Notice 2025 is to ensure transparency and fairness in the answer sheet evaluation process.

Universities generally maintain anonymous checking systems to avoid unfair influence during copy evaluation. Writing contact details or identification marks may compromise the fairness of the examination process.

To prevent such incidents, AKTU has issued strict instructions for all students and examination centers.

Following the AKTU UFM Notice 2026 carefully can help students avoid unnecessary disciplinary action.

What Happens If a Student Violates the Rule?

If a student violates the instructions mentioned in the AKTU UFM Notice 2025, the university may take disciplinary action under UFM regulations.

Start by identifying important topics from each subject. Focus on concepts that carry higher weightage.

Practice previous year question papers regularly. This helps in understanding the exam pattern and improves confidence.

Make short notes for quick revision. Include formulas, definitions, and key points.

Create a daily study plan and follow it strictly. Avoid random study patterns.

Common Mistakes Students Should Avoid

Many students lose marks due to avoidable mistakes. Some common mistakes include:

  • Ignoring important topics
  • Not practicing previous year questions
  • Lack of revision
  • Poor time management

Avoiding these mistakes can significantly improve your score.

Last 7 Days Preparation Strategy

The last week before exams is very important.

Students should focus on revision instead of starting new topics. Revise important concepts and formulas.

Practice writing answers to improve speed and presentation.

Focus more on weak subjects and avoid distractions.

Benefits of Early Preparation

Students who start early preparation enjoy several benefits such as better understanding, reduced stress, and higher confidence.

They also perform better in exams due to consistent revision and practice.

The final exam will end on 06 June 2026

The exam will be conducted in offline mode

Yes, both regular and carry over students are included

You can get it from your college or official AKTU sources

Final Conclusion

AKTU has officially released the final exam schedule for Even Semester 2025-26. This announcement provides clarity and allows students to plan their preparation effectively.

With exams scheduled from 07 May to 06 June 2026, students now have a clear timeline. Proper planning, revision, and practice will help you score better marks.

Stay focused, stay consistent, and keep checking official updates.

title.rendered: AKTU Dissertation 2026: New Guidelines, Plagiarism Rules & Submission Process (Full Details)

content.rendered:
Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University (AKTU), Lucknow ne session 2025-26 ke liye ek important circular release kiya hai jisme M.Tech, M.Pharm, MBA, MCA aur other PG courses ke dissertation (thesis) submission aur evaluation ke rules clear kiye gaye hain.

Is baar university ne specially plagiarism rules ko strict kar diya hai aur Turnitin report mandatory kar di gayi hai.

Agar aap AKTU ke student hain, to ye blog aapke liye bahut important hai.

also read : AKTU Free Summer Internship 2026: NIELIT AI Training Program Registration Open | Full Details, Eligibility, Courses

Important Dates (Very Important ⚠️)

  • Application Start Date: 01 May 2026
  • Last Date: 10 May 2026
  • Mode: Online (ERP Login through Institute)

👉 Is duration ke andar hi students ko apna complete dissertation upload karna hoga.

Dissertation Submission Guidelines (Step-by-Step)

AKTU ke according, students ko submission ke time kuch important points follow karne honge:

1. Single File Submission

  • Full thesis cover page + annexure + signed documents ke saath ek single PDF/Word file me upload karna hoga.

2. Proper Formatting

  • Thesis ka format strictly AKTU guidelines ke according hona chahiye.
  • MS Word format me submission required hai.

3. Supervisor Approval

  • Dissertation ko submit karne se pehle guide/supervisor ke signature mandatory hain.

Plagiarism Rule (Most Important Section 🔥)

AKTU ne plagiarism ko lekar strict rules define kiye hain jo UGC guidelines (2018) par based hain.

What is Plagiarism?

Plagiarism ka matlab hai:

Kisi aur ke work, idea, content ko apna batana bina proper credit diye.

Types of Plagiarism

AKTU guidelines ke according plagiarism ke common types:

  • Copying (direct content copy)
  • Paraphrasing without credit
  • Internet se copy-paste
  • Unauthorized collaboration
  • Without citation ideas use karna

Plagiarism Checking Tools

University ne following tools mention kiye hain:

  • Turnitin
  • Grammarly
  • Plagscan
  • Plagium

👉 But Turnitin is mandatory for most colleges.

Plagiarism Limit (VERY IMPORTANT FOR EXAM)

Important Rule ⚠️

  • Maximum allowed similarity: 20%
  • Individual sources se similarity: 5% se kam honi chahiye

What is Excluded from Plagiarism Check?

Good news for students 👇

In cheezon ko plagiarism check me include nahi kiya jata:

  • References
  • Bibliography
  • Table of contents
  • Preface
  • Standard formulas
  • Keywords

How to Avoid Plagiarism (Practical Tips)

Agar aap safe rehna chahte ho to ye follow karo:

1. Always Give Citation

Har external content ka source mention karo

2. Use Your Own Words

Direct copy na karo, rewrite karo

3. Use Quotation Marks

Agar exact line use kar rahe ho to

4. Use Plagiarism Checker

Submission se pehle check zarur karo

Dissertation Evaluation Process

AKTU ke circular ke according:

  • Evaluation online mode me hoga
  • Dissertation + Viva (Moukhik Pariksha) dono conduct honge
  • Internal marks bhi institute upload karega

Required Documents

Students ko submission ke time ye attach karna hoga:

  • Dissertation file
  • Turnitin plagiarism report
  • Certificate of Non-Plagiarism
  • Supervisor signed approval

Certificate of Thesis Submission

AKTU ne ek standard format diya hai jisme student ko declare karna hota hai:

  • Thesis original hai
  • Plagiarism nahi hai
  • Proper citation use hua hai
  • Thesis kahin aur submit nahi ki gayi

Serious Warning ⚠️

Agar aap plagiarism rules follow nahi karte:

  • Thesis reject ho sakta hai
  • Marks nahi milenge
  • Degree delay ho sakti hai
  • Severe case me registration cancel ho sakta hai

Important Instructions for Colleges

AKTU ne institutes ko bhi instruction diya hai:

  • Students ko plagiarism rules ke bare me inform karein
  • Proper verification ke baad hi thesis forward karein
  • Soft copy database maintain karein

Pro Tips for AKTU Students (2026)

  • Last date ka wait mat karo
  • Turnitin report pehle generate karo
  • Similarity < 15% rakhne ki koshish karo
  • Proper formatting follow karo
  • Guide se final approval lo

Conclusion

AKTU ne 2026 ke liye dissertation process ko kaafi strict aur transparent bana diya hai. Sabse important cheez hai:

👉 Plagiarism control + Proper documentation

Agar aap guidelines follow karte ho to aapka submission smoothly ho jayega.

FAQs (Frequently Asked Questions)

Q1. AKTU me maximum plagiarism kitna allowed hai?

👉 20% tak allowed hai

Q2. Turnitin report mandatory hai?

👉 Yes, almost all institutes me mandatory hai

Q3. Agar plagiarism 40% se zyada ho jaye to?

👉 1 year ban lag sakta hai

Q4. Submission offline hoga ya online?

👉 Fully online via ERP login

title.rendered: AKTU Free Summer Internship 2026: NIELIT AI Training Program Registration Open | Full Details, Eligibility, Courses

content.rendered:
AKTU (Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University) ने 2026 के लिए students के लिए एक बहुत बड़ी opportunity announce की है। NIELIT Gorakhpur (National Institute of Electronics and Information Technology) के collaboration में यह Free Summer Internship Training Program 2026 शुरू किया गया है।

यह program खासतौर पर AI, Data Science, Programming और Electronics skills को enhance करने के लिए design किया गया है। सबसे बड़ी बात यह है कि यह internship पूरी तरह FREE OF COST है और Government of India के India AI Mission (MeitY) के तहत संचालित की जा रही है।

also read : AKTU Internship 2026: AI, Data Science, Python Internship Opportunity (Full Details, Eligibility, Apply Link)

AKTU Summer Internship 2026: Overview

यह internship program students को industry-ready skills देने के लिए बनाया गया है। इसमें online और offline दोनों modes available हैं।

Key Details:

  • Program Name: Summer Internship Training Program 2026

  • Initiative: India AI Mission (MeitY, Govt. of India)
  • Mode: Online / Offline
  • Duration: 2, 3, 4, or 6 Weeks
  • Course Fee: Completely Free
  • Start Month: May / June / July 2026

यह internship mainly skill development और employability को improve करने पर focus करता है।

Courses Offered in AKTU Internship 2026

इस internship में multiple trending domains cover किए गए हैं जो current industry demand के अनुसार हैं।

IT and AI Based Courses

  • Python Programming
  • Data Science and Analytics
  • Machine Learning using Python
  • Artificial Intelligence
  • Deep Learning
  • Digital Marketing
  • Ethical Hacking and Cyber Security
  • Web Designing
  • Full Stack Development (MERN)
  • Java Programming
  • Programming in C and C++

ये सभी courses practical based हैं और real-world applications पर focus करते हैं।

Electronics Based Courses

Electronics और core branch students के लिए भी कई important courses available हैं:

  • PCB Design using OrCAD
  • VLSI Design
  • Embedded System Design
  • Internet of Things (IoT)
  • Solar Power System
  • Electronics Circuits and Drone Technology

यह courses especially ECE और Electrical students के लिए काफी useful हैं।

Special AI Training Programs (Offline Mode)

India AI Mission के तहत NIELIT Gorakhpur कुछ special offline courses भी offer कर रहा है:

  • Fundamentals of Data Annotation using Python (120 Hours)
  • Fundamentals of Data Curation using Python (120 Hours)

ये courses AI industry में entry करने के लिए बहुत helpful हैं क्योंकि इसमें real-world datasets पर काम कराया जाता है।

Key Features of AKTU Internship Program

यह internship program कई reasons की वजह से unique और beneficial है:

  • Fully Sponsored by Government of India (MeitY)
  • No Course Fee (100% Free Training)
  • Industry-relevant and NSQF aligned curriculum
  • Hands-on practical learning approach
  • Training through modern AI laboratories
  • Flexible timing (after college hours or vacations)
  • Certification after successful completion

यह features ensure करते हैं कि students को quality training मिले।

Eligibility Criteria

इस internship के लिए eligibility काफी broad रखी गई है ताकि maximum students benefit ले सकें।

Eligible Candidates:

  • B.Tech (All Streams)

  • MBA Students
  • Diploma / Polytechnic Students (for specific courses)
  • 10th / 12th pass students (selected AI programs)

इसका मतलब है कि almost हर technical background का student apply कर सकता है।

Duration and Schedule

Internship की duration flexible रखी गई है ताकि students अपनी availability के अनुसार select कर सकें।

  • Duration Options: 2 Weeks, 3 Weeks, 4 Weeks, 6 Weeks
  • Classes: 5 Days per Week
  • Batch Start: May, June, July 2026

यह flexibility students के लिए बहुत helpful होती है, especially exam और vacation period में।

Mode of Training

इस program में दो modes available हैं:

Online Mode

  • Live instructor-led classes
  • Anywhere learning सुविधा
  • Recorded sessions भी मिल सकते हैं

Offline Mode

  • NIELIT Gorakhpur campus में training
  • Real lab exposure
  • बेहतर practical learning

Students अपने convenience के अनुसार mode choose कर सकते हैं।

Admission Process

इस internship का admission process बहुत simple है:

  • First Come, First Serve basis
  • Limited seats available
  • Early registration recommended

इसलिए delay करना risk हो सकता है क्योंकि seats जल्दी fill हो सकती हैं।

Certification and Career Benefits

इस internship को complete करने के बाद students को कई advantages मिलते हैं:

  • Government recognized certificate from NIELIT
  • Resume strengthening
  • Internship experience
  • Better placement opportunities
  • Freelancing opportunities
  • Industry exposure

आज के competitive environment में यह certification काफी valuable है।

Why You Should Not Miss This Internship

आज के time में सिर्फ degree enough नहीं है। Companies practical skills और real-world knowledge को ज्यादा importance देती हैं।

इस internship से आपको:

  • Latest AI and technology exposure
  • Hands-on project experience
  • Industry-ready skills
  • Career growth opportunities

मिलेंगे, जो आपको बाकी students से अलग बनाते हैं।

Important Highlights

  • Registration Open Now
  • Completely Free Training Program
  • Government Initiative under India AI Mission
  • Limited Seats Available
  • Best for 2nd, 3rd, and Final Year Students

Registration Details

Interested students official website के माध्यम से registration कर सकते हैं:

  • https://nielit.gov.in/gorakhpur/index.php
  • https://regn.nielitvte.edu.in

Students को सलाह दी जाती है कि official sources से ही apply करें।

Pro Tips for Students

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

Yes, यह पूरी तरह free of cost है।

Q2. क्या certificate मिलेगा?

Yes, NIELIT द्वारा certificate दिया जाएगा।

Q3. क्या first year students apply कर सकते हैं?

कुछ programs में possible है, लेकिन mostly higher year students preferred हैं।

Q4. क्या placement मिलेगा?

Direct placement guarantee नहीं है, लेकिन skills और certificate placement में help करते हैं।

Conclusion

AKTU Summer Internship 2026 एक शानदार initiative है जो students को free में industry-relevant skills provide करता है। यह program खासतौर पर उन students के लिए beneficial है जो AI, programming और emerging technologies में career बनाना चाहते हैं।

अगर आप अपने career को serious level पर improve करना चाहते हैं, तो यह internship आपके लिए एक perfect opportunity है। Limited seats होने की वजह से जल्दी apply करना जरूरी है।

AKTU has informed all affiliated colleges that the Even Semester Exams 2025–26 will be conducted in offline mode.

At the same time, the university has emphasized that colleges must submit the list of students who are detained (not eligible to appear in exams) due to reasons defined under university rules.

These detained students must be updated on the AKTU ERP portal within the given deadline.

What Does “Detained Students” Mean?

In simple terms, detained students are those who are not allowed to appear in the semester exams due to academic or attendance-related issues.

Common Reasons for Detention

  • Low attendance (below required percentage)
  • Internal marks not submitted or insufficient
  • Academic misconduct
  • Not fulfilling university criteria

Important Deadline You Should Not Miss

    30 April 2026
  • Time:
    Till 5:00 PM

This is the most critical part of the notice.

If a college fails to upload the detained students list before the deadline:

  • The university will assume that no student is detained
  • All students will be treated as eligible
  • Admit cards will be generated automatically

This means colleges cannot later claim that any student was detained.

For Regular Students

If you are attending classes regularly and meeting academic criteria:

  • Your admit card will be generated normally
  • You can appear in exams without concern

For Detained Students

  • Take necessary actions quickly

  • Detained students must be listed properly

  • Deadline must be strictly followed

This circular is important because:

  2. It defines final authority on detained status
  3. It removes confusion after admit card generation
  4. It ensures transparency in exam process

What Students Should Do Now

Here is a quick action plan for students:

Step-by-Step Guide

  1. Check your attendance percentage
  2. Verify internal marks status
  3. Contact faculty or administration
  4. Confirm your exam eligibility
  5. Keep checking official updates

Common Mistakes Students Make

Avoid these mistakes:

  • Ignoring attendance requirements
  • Not checking internal marks
  • Assuming eligibility without confirmation
  • Waiting till last moment

FAQs (Frequently Asked Questions)

The last date is 30 April 2026 till 5:00 PM.

Q2. What if my college does not upload my name?

If your name is not uploaded as detained:

  • You will be considered eligible
  • Your admit card will be issued

Q3. Will exams be online or offline?

Exams will be conducted in offline mode.

Q4. Can colleges update the list after deadline?

No, after the deadline, changes will not be accepted.

Q5. How can I check if I am detained?

Contact your college administration or check ERP/notice board.

Final Words

The AKTU 2026 notice regarding detained students is a critical update for all students and colleges. The university has taken a strict stance to ensure that all data is submitted on time and no confusion arises during admit card generation.

Students are advised to stay alert, verify their eligibility, and stay in touch with their college authorities.

The AKTU Practical Exams 2026 play a vital role in a student’s final academic performance. content.rendered:

The circular focuses on organizing special activities under the theme “Nari Shakti Vandan” to promote women empowerment, awareness, and participation in higher education and society.

This update is crucial for students, colleges, and institutions affiliated with AKTU, as it mandates multiple awareness programs, events, and reporting requirements within a fixed timeline.

In this detailed blog post, you will find complete information about the AKTU circular, event guidelines, objectives, and what students should expect.

Overview of the AKTU Circular 2026

Why This Circular is Important

The Government of Uttar Pradesh has emphasized the role of universities in building a developed India. Women empowerment is a key pillar of this vision.

Some key highlights mentioned in the circular:

  • Increasing participation of women in higher education
  • Growth in Ph.D. enrollments among women
  • Women’s participation in STEM fields reaching around 43%
  • Promoting gender equality and leadership

This initiative is aligned with national development goals and aims to strengthen women’s role in education, innovation, and society.

Key Instructions for Universities and Colleges

AKTU has directed all affiliated institutions to organize programs between April 16 to April 18, 2026.

These activities are not optional — institutions are required to:

  • Conduct events as per guidelines
  • Ensure maximum student participation
  • Submit reports with photos and videos
  • Share documentation with university and authorities

Complete List of Activities to be Organized

Below is the detailed breakdown of activities mentioned in the circular:

1. Live Streaming of Parliamentary Session

  • Universities must arrange live telecast of the special parliamentary session
  • Focus on the “Nari Shakti Vandan” bill discussions
  • Students should be encouraged to attend and understand the importance

2. Seminars and Awareness Programs

  • Organize seminars on women empowerment
  • Discuss upcoming policies and their impact
  • Encourage student participation and interaction

3. Women Leadership Development Sessions

  • Topic: Women-led Development
  • Focus on replacing the traditional “Women Development” approach
  • Encourage leadership roles among female students

4. STEM Awareness and Promotion

  • Promote participation of women in:
    • Science
    • Technology
    • Engineering
    • Mathematics
  • Conduct workshops, innovation sessions, and project-based activities

5. Skill Development and Vocational Training

  • Inspired by initiatives like “Drone Didi”
  • Provide training in:
    • Technical skills
    • Agriculture technology
    • Modern tools and innovations

6. Social Justice and Constitutional Awareness

  • Conduct sessions on:
    • Women’s rights
    • Reservation policies
    • Legal protections
  • Focus on democratic participation and awareness

7. Women Safety Awareness Programs

  • Inform students about:
    • Legal protections under Indian laws
    • Safety frameworks and helplines
  • Promote awareness of security measures and rights

8. Success Stories and Role Models

  • Showcase achievements of successful women
  • Include examples from:
    • Education
    • Politics
    • Sports
    • Science
  • Inspire students through real-life case studies

9. Awareness Rallies

  • Organize rallies within campus or nearby areas
  • Spread awareness about women empowerment

10. Minimum 3 KM Walkathon / March

  • Conduct a walkathon promoting gender equality
  • Encourage participation from students and faculty

11. Street Plays (Nukkad Natak)

  • Perform short plays on:
    • Women rights
    • Social issues
    • Gender equality

12. Debates and Discussions

  • Topics can include:
    • Role of women in modern India
    • Gender equality
    • Women in leadership

Reporting Requirements (Very Important)

AKTU has clearly instructed that all institutions must:

Key Message of the Initiative

The main goal behind this circular is to promote:

  • Gender equality
  • Women leadership
  • Skill development
  • Awareness and participation

It reflects the government’s vision of inclusive growth and empowered women in India.

Conclusion

The AKTU Circular 2026 regarding “Nari Shakti Vandan” is a significant step towards promoting women empowerment at the university level. By mandating structured programs, seminars, and activities, the university ensures that students not only learn about gender equality but actively participate in it.

For students, this is an opportunity to engage, learn, and grow beyond academics. For institutions, it is a responsibility to implement these directives effectively and contribute to national development goals.

FAQs

The program is scheduled from April 16 to April 18, 2026.

Q2. Is participation mandatory for students?

While not strictly mandatory, institutions are instructed to ensure maximum participation.

Seminars, rallies, debates, walkathons, street plays, and STEM workshops.

Q4. Do colleges need to submit reports?

Yes, reports with photos and videos are compulsory.

To promote women empowerment, leadership, and awareness in society.

What is the 100 Days Free Live Yoga Sessions Program?

The “100 Days Free Live Yoga Sessions” is a structured wellness program introduced under the Yoga 365 Initiative. It is designed to help students develop a daily yoga habit through guided sessions conducted by experts.

The program includes:

  • 100 consecutive days of yoga practice
  • Live sessions conducted by certified yoga trainers
  • Structured 14-day yoga practice challenges
  • Multiple participation time slots for flexibility
  • Online access via live sessions and YouTube streaming

This initiative is not just about physical fitness. It focuses on improving mental clarity, emotional stability, and overall productivity.

Official Highlights from AKTU Notice

AKTU has instructed all affiliated institutions to actively promote and support this initiative. Colleges are expected to encourage participation among students, faculty members, and staff.

Registration Process and Direct Link

Steps to Register

Why This Program Matters for Students

In today’s academic environment, students face several challenges such as stress, lack of focus, and unhealthy routines. This initiative directly addresses these issues.

Regular yoga practice helps improve cognitive function and concentration, which is essential for academic success.

2. Reduces Stress and Anxiety

Yoga techniques such as breathing exercises and meditation help in managing exam stress and mental pressure.

3. Enhances Physical Health

Daily sessions improve flexibility, posture, and overall energy levels.

4. Builds a Disciplined Routine

Following a structured yoga schedule helps students develop consistency and better time management skills.

5. Supports Academic Performance

Improved focus and mental clarity indirectly lead to better performance in exams and assignments.

From an academic and personal development perspective, joining this program can be highly beneficial.

Not recommended for:

However, considering that the program is free and flexible, there is very little downside to participating.

Yoga is increasingly recognized as an effective tool for improving both mental and physical health. For students, it plays a critical role in:

No, it is not mandatory, but it is strongly recommended by the university.

Can sessions be attended on mobile devices?

Yes, sessions are fully accessible on mobile phones, laptops, and tablets.

Is the program suitable for beginners?

Yes, the program is designed to accommodate beginners as well as experienced participants.

Final Conclusion

The “100 Days Free Live Yoga Sessions” initiative launched by AKTU, in coordination with UGC and the Ministry of Ayush, is a valuable opportunity for students to improve their overall well-being.

In a highly competitive academic environment, maintaining mental clarity, physical health, and focus is essential. This program provides a structured and accessible way to achieve all three without any financial cost.

Students are encouraged to take advantage of this initiative and incorporate yoga into their daily routine for long-term benefits.

Conclusion

The AKTU Student Welfare Fund 2026 is a highly beneficial scheme that provides much-needed support to students facing personal loss. Every eligible student should take advantage of this opportunity and continue their education without financial stress.

Colleges should also play an active role in spreading awareness so that no deserving student misses out.

Students studying in AKTU-affiliated colleges who have lost a parent.

title.rendered: AKTU Nari Shakti Vandan Abhiyan 2026: Complete Details, Schedule, and Student Participation Guide

content.rendered:
AKTU Nari Shakti Vandan Abhiyan 2026: Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University (AKTU), Lucknow has issued an important notification regarding the Nari Shakti Vandan Abhiyan 2026, which will be conducted across all affiliated colleges from 10 April to 20 April 2026. This initiative is part of a broader campaign launched by the Uttar Pradesh Government to promote awareness about women empowerment under the “Nari Shakti Vandan Adhiniyam 2023.”

The campaign is not just a formal instruction for colleges but an opportunity for students to participate in meaningful social activities. Through this initiative, institutions are expected to organize awareness programs, rallies, and creative events that highlight the importance of women’s rights and equality in society.

also read : AKTU Signs MoU with Siemens India: A Major Boost for Technical Education and Student Employability

Background and Purpose of the Campaign

The campaign gains additional importance as it aligns with the national-level discussions on women empowerment, especially during the special parliamentary session held between 16 and 18 April 2026. This reflects a larger vision to strengthen the role of women in society and ensure equal participation in all sectors.

The main objective of the AKTU Nari Shakti Vandan Abhiyan 2026 is to create awareness among students and the general public. It encourages educational institutions to act as platforms for social change by involving young minds in discussions and activities related to gender equality.

Campaign Duration and Implementation

The campaign will run for a total of ten days, starting from 10 April and ending on 20 April 2026. During this period, all AKTU-affiliated colleges are required to actively organize and participate in various activities as instructed in the official notice.

Colleges are expected to coordinate with departments such as NSS and NCC to ensure proper execution. The university has also directed institutions to submit reports of the activities conducted, including proper documentation.

Key Activities Under the Campaign

Several structured activities have been planned to ensure maximum participation and awareness. These activities are designed to engage students both creatively and socially.

Nari Shakti Padayatra

The Padayatra will be conducted on 15 and 16 April 2026. It will involve students, volunteers, and local community members. The purpose of this rally is to spread awareness at the grassroots level and encourage public participation. Banners, placards, and awareness messages will be used to communicate the importance of women empowerment.

Nari Shakti Diwar and Human Chain

On 11 April 2026, colleges will set up “Nari Shakti Walls” where students can write their thoughts and messages supporting women empowerment. Alongside this, human chains will be formed to symbolize unity and collective responsibility toward gender equality.

This activity is expected to create a strong visual impact and encourage student engagement.

Missed Call Campaign and Sticker Initiative

content.rendered:
Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University (AKTU) has officially released a new notification regarding the challenge evaluation process for Odd Semester Examination 2025–26. This update is particularly important for students who are dissatisfied with their marks and are considering applying for re-evaluation.

According to the latest notice, the university has extended the dates for Stage-2 challenge evaluation, providing another opportunity for students to submit their applications. This move is expected to benefit a large number of students who either missed the earlier deadline or want to improve their academic performance.

In this detailed blog post, we will cover everything you need to know about AKTU Challenge Evaluation 2026, including important dates, eligibility criteria, fees, application process, evaluation method, refund policy, and expert tips.

AKTU Challenge Evaluation 2026: Important Dates

The challenge evaluation process is linked to the Odd Semester Exams conducted earlier this year. Here is a clear breakdown of the important dates:

Students must ensure that they apply within the extended deadline, as no further extension is usually granted by the university.

What is AKTU Challenge Evaluation?

The AKTU Challenge Evaluation 2026 is a re-evaluation process that allows students to request a fresh checking of their answer sheets. This is not just a simple rechecking but a complete reassessment done by different examiners.

The purpose of this process is to ensure transparency and fairness in evaluation. Students who believe that their marks do not reflect their performance can use this opportunity to get their answer copies re-evaluated.

Key Features of Challenge Evaluation

The challenge evaluation process has several important features that every student must understand before applying:

  • The evaluation is done by two independent examiners
  • The final marks are calculated based on the average of both evaluations
  • The revised marks are considered final and binding
  • Marks may increase, decrease, or remain unchanged
  • The process is conducted entirely in online mode

This means that students must carefully decide before applying, as there is a risk involved.

AKTU Challenge Evaluation Fees

To apply for challenge evaluation, students need to pay a fixed fee per subject. The fee structure is as follows:

The fee must be paid online at the time of application. Without successful payment, the application will not be considered.

Refund Policy Explained

One of the most important aspects of the AKTU Challenge Evaluation 2026 is the refund policy. The university has clearly stated the conditions under which a refund will be provided.

If the difference between the original marks and the revised marks is more than 20 percent, then:

  • ₹1000 will be deducted as processing charges
  • ₹1500 will be refunded to the student

However, if the difference is less than 20 percent, no refund will be given.

Students must also ensure that their bank details are entered correctly while applying. Any error in bank information may result in failure of refund, and the university will not be responsible for such issues.

Evaluation Criteria

The evaluation method used by AKTU is very specific and must be clearly understood:

  1. The answer sheet is evaluated by two different examiners
  2. Marks given by both examiners are recorded separately
  3. The average of the two marks is calculated
  4. This average becomes the final score

This final score is then updated in the official records, even if it is lower than the original marks.

How to Apply for AKTU Challenge Evaluation 2026

The application process is simple but must be followed carefully. Here is a step-by-step guide:

  1. Visit the official AKTU website
  2. Navigate to the challenge evaluation section
  3. Log in using your credentials (Roll Number and Password)
  4. Select the subject(s) you want to apply for
  5. Pay the required fee of ₹2500 per subject
  6. Submit the application form
  7. Download and save the payment receipt

Students are advised to keep a copy of the receipt for future reference.

Who Should Apply for Challenge Evaluation?

Applying for challenge evaluation is a strategic decision. You should consider applying if:

  • You are confident that your answers were correct
  • You expected significantly higher marks
  • Your result is affecting your academic progress
  • You are close to passing marks or distinction

This process can help improve your academic performance if used wisely.

Who Should Avoid Applying?

There are certain situations where applying for challenge evaluation may not be beneficial:

  • If you are unsure about your answers
  • If your marks are already satisfactory
  • If you are applying without proper analysis
  • If you are not willing to take the risk of marks decreasing

Since the final result is based on an average, there is always uncertainty involved.

Challenge evaluation is more detailed and has a higher chance of changing marks compared to scrutiny.

Following these instructions will help avoid unnecessary issues during the process.

A smart approach can increase your chances of benefiting from this process.

FAQs

What is the last date to apply for Stage-2?

The last date is 16 April 2026.

What is the fee per subject?

The fee is ₹2500 per subject.

Can my marks decrease after evaluation?

Yes, marks can increase, decrease, or remain the same.

Is the refund guaranteed?

No, refund is only provided if the marks difference exceeds 20 percent.

Is offline application allowed?

No, the application process is completely online.

Conclusion

The AKTU Challenge Evaluation 2026 Stage-2 extension provides a valuable second chance for students to improve their results. However, it is important to approach this opportunity with a clear understanding of the process, risks, and benefits.

Since the final marks are based on the average of two evaluations, students must apply only when they are confident about their performance. With proper planning and careful decision-making, this process can help you achieve better academic outcomes and move closer to your goals.

content.rendered:
If you are a student exploring opportunities in Artificial Intelligence, then the IIT Guwahati Internship 2026 is something you should not miss. In recent years, the demand for skills like Machine Learning, Deep Learning, and Computer Vision has increased rapidly, and internships like this provide a strong starting point.

The Computer Vision Internship offered by IIT Guwahati gives students a chance to step into a real research environment and work on practical problems instead of just theoretical concepts. For many students, this kind of exposure can be the turning point in their career.
