Why IIT Guwahati Internship 2026 Matters

When students look for internships, they often focus only on stipend or location. However, what truly matters is the quality of learning and the kind of work you get to do. The IIT Guwahati Internship 2026 stands out because it offers hands-on experience in a field that is shaping the future.

Working at an IIT not only adds value to your resume but also exposes you to a professional research culture. You get to interact with experienced researchers, students, and mentors who are actively working on innovative technologies.

A Quick Overview of the Internship

The internship is for the role of a Computer Vision Intern and will be conducted in Guwahati. It is a full-time, in-office internship with a duration of six months. The stipend ranges between ₹5,000 and ₹10,000 per month, depending on performance and contribution.

The last date to apply for the IIT Guwahati Internship 2026 is 8 May 2026, so interested candidates should plan to apply as early as possible.

About the Lab and Work Environment

This internship is offered through the Embedded Interaction Lab (EILab) at IIT Guwahati. The lab focuses on applied research, especially in areas like human-computer interaction, virtual reality, and emerging technologies.

One of the key highlights of this lab is its collaboration with major global companies such as Samsung, Microsoft, IBM, Nokia, and Procter & Gamble. This means that the work done here is closely connected to real-world applications.

As an intern, you will be part of a diverse team that includes researchers, PhD scholars, and students from different engineering backgrounds. This collaborative environment helps in learning faster and understanding how real projects are developed.

What You Will Be Working On

In the IIT Guwahati Internship 2026, your role will revolve around developing and testing computer vision models. This is not just a basic internship where you observe others; you will actively contribute to projects.

Your work may include training machine learning models using image datasets, improving their accuracy, and testing them in real-world scenarios. You might also work on tasks such as object detection, image classification, or video analysis.

This kind of practical experience is extremely valuable because it helps you understand how theoretical concepts are applied in real situations.

Skills You Should Have

To apply for the IIT Guwahati Internship 2026, you should have a basic understanding of Python programming. Knowledge of machine learning and computer vision is also important.

Familiarity with tools like OpenCV and frameworks like TensorFlow or PyTorch will give you an advantage. Additionally, understanding concepts like Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) can make your profile stronger.

However, you do not need to be an expert. Even if you are a beginner, having a couple of well-made projects can significantly improve your chances.

Benefits of This Internship

One of the biggest advantages of the IIT Guwahati Internship 2026 is the exposure it provides. While the stipend may seem modest, the experience you gain is far more valuable.

You will receive a certificate after completing the internship, and based on your performance, you may also get a letter of recommendation. These can be very helpful during placements or when applying for higher studies.

Additionally, the IIT tag itself adds credibility to your resume, which can open doors to better opportunities in the future.

Challenges You Should Consider

Before applying, it is also important to understand the challenges. The internship is in-office, so you will need to relocate to Guwahati for six months. This may not be convenient for everyone.

The stipend is also relatively low compared to some corporate internships. Moreover, since this is an IIT internship, the selection process is competitive, and only a limited number of candidates will be selected.

However, if your goal is to learn and grow, these challenges are often worth it.

How to Apply for IIT Guwahati Internship 2026

To apply for the IIT Guwahati internship, click here.

Tips to Improve Your Chances

If you are serious about getting selected for the IIT Guwahati Internship 2026, focus on building practical skills.

Start by working on small projects like image classifiers or face detection systems. These projects do not have to be complex, but they should demonstrate your understanding of concepts.

Keep your resume simple and focused. Highlight your skills, projects, and any relevant coursework. Avoid unnecessary information and make sure everything is clearly presented.

It is also helpful to revise basic concepts of machine learning and computer vision, as you may be asked questions related to them during the selection process.

Final Thoughts

The IIT Guwahati Internship 2026 is a great opportunity for students who want to build a career in Artificial Intelligence and Computer Vision. It offers a combination of learning, practical experience, and credibility that is hard to find in many internships.

While the stipend may not be very high and relocation is required, the long-term benefits make it a worthwhile choice. If you are genuinely interested in AI and willing to put in the effort, this internship can be a valuable step in your journey.

Make sure to apply before 8 May 2026 and prepare your profile carefully. Opportunities like this can make a significant difference in your career path.

AKTU Challenge Evaluation Date Extended 2026: Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University (AKTU) ne session 2025-26 odd semester exams ke challenge evaluation (rechecking) ki last date extend kar di hai. Yeh update un sabhi students ke liye bahut important hai jo apne exam marks se satisfied nahi hain aur answer copy re-evaluation karwana chahte hain.

Agar aap AKTU ke student hain aur aapko lagta hai ki aapke marks kam aaye hain, toh ab aapke paas ek aur chance hai apni answer sheet ka challenge evaluation karwane ka.

also read : Software Engineer Internship at Friday Media Group – Work From Home Opportunity for Freshers (2026)

Official Notice Summary (Simple Language)

University ke official notice ke according:

  • Odd semester exams conduct hue the:
    • 23 December 2025 se 31 January 2026
    • 10 February 2026 se 19 February 2026
  • Results already declare ho chuke hain
  • Ab students ko challenge evaluation ka option diya gaya hai

👉 Pehle jo last date thi, usko extend karke 07 April 2026 se 09 April 2026 kar diya gaya hai

AKTU Challenge Evaluation 2026 – Important Dates

Challenge Evaluation Kya Hota Hai?

Challenge evaluation ek process hai jisme:

  • Student apni answer sheet dubara check karwane ke liye apply karta hai
  • University answer copy ko re-evaluate karti hai
  • Agar mistake milti hai, toh marks update ho jate hain

👉 Simple words me:
“Apne marks se doubt ho toh copy dobara check karwana = Challenge Evaluation”

Kaun Apply Kar Sakta Hai?

Aap apply kar sakte hain agar:

  • Aap AKTU ke student hain
  • Aapka result aa chuka hai
  • Aap apne marks se satisfied nahi hain
  • Aapko lagta hai evaluation me mistake hui hai

Challenge Evaluation Fees 2026

Step-by-Step Process – Kaise Apply Kare?

Step 1: ERP Login

  • AKTU ERP portal par login kare

Step 2: Apply for Challenge Evaluation

  • Subject select kare jisme doubt hai
  • ₹300 per subject pay kare

Step 3: Answer Sheet Dekhna

  • Aapko digital evaluated copy milegi

Step 4: If Not Satisfied

  • ₹2500 pay karke full re-evaluation apply kare

Stage 1 vs Stage 2 – Difference Samjho

Important Rules Jo Aapko Pata Hone Chahiye

AKTU ke notice ke according kuch important rules:

1. Average Marks Rule

  • Do examiners ke marks ka average nikala jayega

2. Final Marks Rule

  • Average marks hi final honge
  • Chahe original se kam ho ya zyada

3. Refund Rule

  • Agar marks me 20% se zyada difference hota hai:
    • ₹2500 me se ₹1000 cut hoga
    • Baaki amount refund ho jayega

Students Ke Liye Important Advice

👉 Apply karne se pehle ye soch le:

  • Kya aapko genuinely lagta hai marking galat hui hai?
  • Kya aapka expected score zyada tha?
  • Kya aapne answers sahi likhe the?

⚠️ Risk bhi hota hai:

  • Marks kam bhi ho sakte hain

Common Mistakes Jo Students Karte Hain

  • Without checking copy directly ₹2500 pay kar dena
  • Sab subjects me apply kar dena
  • Deadline miss kar dena
  • ERP portal properly check na karna

👉 Smart approach:

  • Pehle ₹300 me copy dekho
  • Phir decision lo

AKTU Challenge Evaluation Ka Importance

Yeh process important hai kyunki:

  • Fair evaluation ensure karta hai
  • Student ko transparency milti hai
  • Galti hone par marks improve ho sakte hain

FAQs – AKTU Challenge Evaluation 2026

Q1. Last date kya hai apply karne ki?

👉 07 April 2026 se 09 April 2026

Q2. Kya marks kam bhi ho sakte hain?

👉 Haan, re-evaluation ke baad marks kam bhi ho sakte hain

Q3. Copy dekhna compulsory hai?

👉 Haan, Stage 1 (₹300) ke baad hi Stage 2 kar sakte ho

Q4. Refund kab milega?

👉 Agar marks me 20% se zyada difference hota hai

Q5. Apply kaha kare?

👉 AKTU ERP portal par

Final Conclusion

AKTU ne students ko ek aur chance diya hai apne marks improve karne ka. Agar aapko lagta hai ki aapke marks expected se kam aaye hain, toh AKTU Challenge Evaluation 2026 aapke liye ek golden opportunity hai.

👉 Lekin apply karne se pehle:

  • Properly soch le
  • Copy check kare
  • Risk samjhe

title.rendered: AKTU AI Awareness Program 2026: Free Certificate, 2 Credits, Registration Link and Full Details

content.rendered:
AKTU AI Awareness Program 2026: Artificial Intelligence is rapidly becoming one of the most important technologies in today’s world. To help students understand its importance, Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University (AKTU) has released an official notice regarding the Online Artificial Intelligence (AI) Awareness Program 2026.

This initiative is a major opportunity for students to learn AI fundamentals, gain certification, and earn academic credit points without any cost.

The program is being conducted in collaboration with Mahayogi Gorakhnath University Gorakhpur, along with support from Tata Consultancy Services (TCS).

In this article, you will get complete details including eligibility, benefits, registration process, important dates, and why this program is important for your career.

also read : India Space Lab Internship 2026: Registration Open for Online Technical Training Program

What is AKTU AI Awareness Program 2026

The AI Awareness Program is a free online course titled “AI for All” designed to introduce students to the fundamentals of Artificial Intelligence and its real-world applications.

The course aims to build awareness among students about AI technologies and future career opportunities in this domain.

This program is especially beneficial for students who are new to AI and want to start learning from scratch.

Key Features of the Program

  • The course is completely free of cost
  • Total duration is 20 hours
  • Students will receive a certificate after completion
  • 2 academic credit points will be awarded
  • The course is self-paced and flexible
  • Accessible anytime and from anywhere

Objective of the Program

The main objective of this initiative is to promote awareness of Artificial Intelligence among students across Uttar Pradesh.

The program focuses on helping students understand how AI is used in industries and how it can shape future careers. The authorities are aiming to achieve more than 5 lakh registrations before the official launch.

This initiative also encourages students to become industry-ready by gaining basic AI knowledge.

Organizing Institutions

The program is organized by the Centre of Excellence at Maharana Pratap Institute of Technology, Gorakhpur.

It is supported by:

  • TCS Foundation
  • Mahayogi Gorakhnath University
  • Facilitated by AKTU Lucknow

This collaboration ensures high-quality content and industry relevance.

Important Dates

  • Program Launch Date: 15 April 2026
  • Last Date for Registration: 7 April 2026
  • Course Duration: 20 Hours
  • Completion Window: 60 Days from launch

Students must complete the course within 60 days after it begins.

Registration Process

Students can register through the official platform:

https://www.tcsion.com/courses/ai-awareness-programme

Make sure to complete registration before the deadline to secure your participation.

Course Content Overview

The course is designed in a beginner-friendly manner and includes:

  • Introduction to Artificial Intelligence
  • Basics of Machine Learning
  • AI applications in daily life
  • Industry use cases
  • Career opportunities in AI

The content is structured to ensure easy understanding even for students without any technical background.

Benefits of the AI Awareness Program

One of the biggest advantages of this program is that it provides both academic and career benefits.

Students will receive a certificate that can be added to their resume. The program also offers 2 credit points, which can be useful in academic evaluation.

Since the course is supported by TCS, students get exposure to industry-level knowledge and practical insights.

The flexible learning structure allows students to complete the course at their own pace without affecting their regular studies.

This program is open to:

  • Students from any stream
  • Anyone who has completed at least matriculation

There is no requirement for prior coding or AI knowledge.

Instructions for Colleges

AKTU has directed all affiliated institutions to actively promote this program among students.

Colleges are expected to ensure maximum participation and may appoint nodal officers to monitor registration and participation.

Proper data accuracy and coordination are also emphasized in the official notice.

Importance for Students

This program is highly valuable, especially for B.Tech students.

Artificial Intelligence is becoming a core skill in many industries. Even basic knowledge of AI can significantly improve your chances in placements, internships, and competitive exams.

Students from non-technical branches can also benefit as AI is being used in fields like management, healthcare, finance, and marketing.

Career Advantages

Completing this program can help students in multiple ways.

It strengthens your resume with a certified AI course. It prepares you for technical discussions during interviews. It also helps in understanding future technologies that companies are actively adopting.

Students who start learning AI early often have an advantage in higher studies and job opportunities.

Official Notice Summary

AKTU issued the notice on 25 March 2026 regarding the AI Awareness Program.

The program is free, offers certification, and provides academic credit points. It is supported by major institutions and aims to reach a large number of students across the state.

Frequently Asked Questions

Q.1. Is the program free
Yes, the course is completely free.

Q.2. Will I receive a certificate
Yes, students will receive a certificate after completing the course.

Q.3. How many credits are provided
The program offers 2 academic credit points.

Q.4. Is prior knowledge required
No, the course is designed for beginners.

Q.5. Can non-technical students apply
Yes, students from any background can join.

Conclusion

The AKTU AI Awareness Program 2026 is an excellent opportunity for students to gain knowledge in Artificial Intelligence without any financial burden.

With benefits like certification, credit points, and industry collaboration, this program can play an important role in shaping your career.

Students are strongly advised to register before the deadline and take full advantage of this initiative.

title.rendered: AKTU Notice 2026: Kanya Sumangala Yojana ke liye Income Certificate Mandatory | Students ke liye Important Update

content.rendered:
AKTU Notice 2026: Agar aap AKTU (Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University) ke student hain, to yeh update aapke liye kaafi important hai. University ne recently ek official notice release kiya hai jo directly students aur colleges dono ko impact karta hai.

Is notice me ek major change announce kiya gaya hai — ab Mukhyamantri Kanya Sumangala Yojana ke liye Income Certificate mandatory kar diya gaya hai.

Is article me hum aapko simple language me pura notice explain karenge, taaki aapko har point clearly samajh aaye aur aap koi mistake na karein.

AKTU Notice 2026 – Basic Details

  • University Name: Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University (AKTU)
  • Notice Date: 25 March 2026
  • Subject: Mukhyamantri Kanya Sumangala Yojana ke liye Income Certificate Mandatory
  • Issued For: All affiliated colleges and students

Yeh Notice Kyun Important Hai?

Generally students AKTU ke notices ko ignore kar dete hain, lekin yeh notice directly ek government scheme se related hai. Agar aap ya aapke family me koi Mukhyamantri Kanya Sumangala Yojana ka benefit lena chahta hai, to yeh update jaana bahut zaruri hai.

Simple language me samjhein to agar aap income certificate properly submit nahi karte, to aapka application reject ho sakta hai.

Mukhyamantri Kanya Sumangala Yojana Kya Hai?

Yeh Uttar Pradesh Government ki ek important scheme hai jiska main aim ladkiyon ka overall development hai.

Is scheme ke objectives hain:

  • Ladkiyon ki education ko promote karna
  • Gender equality ko improve karna
  • Child marriage ko rokna
  • Financial support provide karna
  • Girls ko self-dependent banana

Government is scheme ke through ladkiyon ko different stages par financial assistance deti hai.

Income Limit Kya Hai?

Notice ke according family ki annual income 3 lakh rupees se jyada nahi honi chahiye. Agar income is limit se zyada hai, to applicant scheme ke liye eligible nahi hoga.

Sabse Important Update

Is notice ka sabse important part hai income certificate ko mandatory banana.

Pehle system me income certificate utna strict nahi tha. Kai cases me sirf declaration par bhi kaam chal jata tha. Lekin ab system completely change kar diya gaya hai.

Ab income certificate mandatory ho gaya hai. Application me certificate number dena zaruri hoga aur data ka online verification kiya jayega. Agar koi galat ya fake information deta hai, to uska application reject ho jayega.

New Guidelines Jo Aapko Samajhni Chahiye

Sabse pehla rule yeh hai ki income certificate ab zaruri hai. Bina iske application valid nahi mana jayega.

Dusra important point yeh hai ki certificate upload karna compulsory nahi hai, lekin certificate number dena mandatory hai.

Teesra point yeh hai ki verification system ab strong ho gaya hai. Government database ke through details verify ki jayengi, jisse fraud cases kam honge.

Is change ka main purpose transparency lana hai, taaki sirf deserving students ko hi scheme ka benefit mile.

Colleges ke liye Instructions

Yeh notice sirf students ke liye nahi balki colleges ke liye bhi important hai.

Colleges ko ensure karna hoga ki students guidelines follow kar rahe hain. Unhe students ko proper information deni hogi aur government ke instructions ka strictly implementation karna hoga.

Agar colleges isme negligence dikhate hain, to unke khilaf bhi action liya ja sakta hai.

Students ko Ab Kya Karna Chahiye?

Sabse pehle aapko apna income certificate banwana chahiye agar abhi tak nahi bana hai. Yeh certificate valid aur updated hona chahiye.

Application form fill karte waqt aapko saari details carefully fill karni chahiye. Koi bhi galat information dene se aapka application reject ho sakta hai.

Aapko apne documents ready rakhne chahiye jaise Aadhaar card, income certificate aur dusre required documents.

Yeh bhi zaruri hai ki aap last moment ka wait na karein. Time se pehle application complete kar lena better hota hai.

Agar Rules Follow Nahi Kare To Kya Hoga?

Agar aap guidelines follow nahi karte hain to aapka application reject ho sakta hai. Iske alawa aap scheme ka benefit nahi le paayenge.

Future me verification ke time bhi problem aa sakti hai. Isliye sahi tarike se process follow karna hi best option hai.

Government ka Objective Kya Hai?

Is update ka main purpose system ko transparent banana hai. Government chahti hai ki sirf genuine aur eligible students ko hi scheme ka benefit mile.

Isse fake applicants ko remove kiya ja sakega aur scheme ka misuse kam hoga.

Real Life Example

Maan lijiye pehle koi student galat income show karke apply kar deta tha. Ab system us data ko verify karega.

Isse genuine students ko fayda milega aur jo log galat information dete hain unhe automatically reject kar diya jayega.

Important Summary

  • Income certificate ab mandatory hai
  • Annual income limit 3 lakh hai
  • Certificate number dena zaruri hai
  • Online verification hoga
  • Transparency improve hogi

Conclusion

AKTU ka yeh latest notice students ke liye kaafi important hai. Agar aap Mukhyamantri Kanya Sumangala Yojana ka benefit lena chahte hain, to aapko guidelines ko strictly follow karna hoga.

Aapke paas valid income certificate hona chahiye aur application me correct details fill karni chahiye. Yeh chhota sa step aapko future me bada benefit de sakta hai.

FAQs

Q1. Kya income certificate ab compulsory hai?
Haan, ab yeh mandatory kar diya gaya hai.

Q2. Income limit kitni hai?
3 lakh rupees per year.

Q3. Kya certificate upload karna zaruri hai?
Upload optional hai, lekin certificate number dena mandatory hai.

Q4. Verification kaise hoga?
Online system ke through verification kiya jayega.

title.rendered: India Space Lab Internship 2026: Registration Open for Online Technical Training Program

content.rendered:
India Space Lab Internship 2026: If you are an engineering or science student looking to build a career in space technology, drones, or satellite systems, then this opportunity is worth your attention. The India Space Lab Summer Internship & Technical Training Program 2026 has officially opened registrations, offering students a chance to gain hands-on experience in emerging space-related technologies.

This internship program is designed to provide practical exposure, industry-relevant knowledge, and technical skills that can help students stand out in today’s competitive job market.

also read : AKTU Notice 2026: Kanya Sumangala Yojana ke liye Income Certificate Mandatory | Students ke liye Important Update

Official Update by AKTU

According to the official notification released by Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University (AKTU), all affiliated colleges have been instructed to circulate this internship information among students. The university has encouraged students to actively participate in this program to enhance their technical knowledge and practical skills.

This adds credibility to the internship, making it a reliable and recognized opportunity for students across India.

What is India Space Lab Internship 2026?

The India Space Lab Summer Internship 2026 is a 45-day online technical training program focused on space science and emerging technologies.

Unlike traditional internships, this program focuses on practical learning through live sessions, project-based training, and exposure to real-world applications in the space sector.

Key Highlights of the Internship

  • Duration: 45 Days
  • Mode: Online
  • Certification: Yes (Internship Completion Certificate)
  • Registration Fee: ₹950 (Non-refundable)
  • Stipend: Not Provided
  • Learning Type: Practical + Theory Based

Who Can Apply for This Internship?

This internship is open to a wide range of students, making it accessible for both beginners and advanced learners.

Eligible Candidates

  • Undergraduate students (B.Tech, B.Sc, etc.)
  • Postgraduate students (M.Tech, M.Sc, etc.)
  • Research scholars
  • Students from recognized institutions in India and abroad

Even if you are in the early stages of your technical education, you can still apply and benefit from this internship.

Internship Domains and Topics Covered

The internship focuses on some of the most in-demand and future-oriented technologies in the space sector.

Major Topics Include:

  1. Advanced Drone Technology
    Learn about drone design, working principles, and real-world applications.
  2. CanSat and CubeSat (Student Satellites)
    Understand how small satellites are designed, developed, and launched.
  3. Rocketry Training Program
    Get insights into rocket propulsion, structure, and launch mechanisms.
  4. Remote Sensing (GIS)
    Learn how satellite data is used for mapping, environmental analysis, and monitoring.
  5. Disaster Management Using Technology
    Explore how modern technologies help in disaster prediction and management.

Registration Details (Batch-wise Information)

The internship is divided into two batches, allowing flexibility for students.

Batch 1

  • Registration Start Date: 19 March 2026
  • Last Date to Apply: 27 April 2026
  • Internship Duration: 1 May to 15 June 2026
  • Total Seats: 1270

Batch 2

  • Registration Start Date: 19 March 2026
  • Last Date to Apply: 10 June 2026
  • Internship Duration: 17 June to 4 July 2026
  • Total Seats: 1045

👉 Selection is based on a first come, first serve basis, so early registration is highly recommended.

Internship Schedule Overview

The program follows a structured schedule to ensure proper learning across all domains.

  • Drone Technology: 4 Days
  • Satellite (CanSat/CubeSat): 3 Days
  • Rocketry Training: 4 Days
  • Remote Sensing (GIS): 3 Days
  • Disaster Management: 3 Days

This schedule ensures that students get a balanced understanding of each domain.

Internship Benefits for Students

Skill Development

This internship helps students build skills in cutting-edge technologies like drones, satellite systems, and GIS. These skills are highly valuable in industries such as aerospace, defense, environmental science, and data analysis.

Hands-on Learning

Unlike theoretical courses, this program emphasizes practical exposure through projects and real-world applications.

Industry Exposure

Students get the opportunity to learn from experts and understand how the space industry operates.

Certification

After completing the internship, participants will receive a certificate, which can enhance their resume and LinkedIn profile.

Why You Should Apply for India Space Lab Internship 2026

There are several reasons why this internship stands out:

  • It focuses on future technologies
  • It is accessible online, so no travel is required
  • It offers structured and guided learning
  • It provides industry-relevant knowledge
  • It is affordable compared to other technical programs

If you are serious about building a career in space or emerging technologies, this internship can be a great starting point.

Important Links for Registration

Students can apply using the official links below:

  • https://isl.internship.indiaspaceweek.org/
  • https://isl.ac.in/

Make sure to apply before the deadline to secure your seat.

Important Instructions for Students

  • Ensure you have a stable internet connection for online classes
  • Complete registration early to avoid missing out
  • Keep your academic details ready before applying
  • Actively participate in sessions to gain maximum benefit

Is This Internship Worth It?

Yes, for students interested in space technology, drones, satellite systems, or research, this internship is definitely worth considering.

Although there is no stipend, the knowledge, exposure, and certification you gain can significantly boost your career opportunities.

Final Conclusion

The India Space Lab Summer Internship 2026 is a golden opportunity for students to step into the world of space technology and advanced engineering domains. With structured training, expert guidance, and real-world exposure, this internship can help you build a strong foundation for your future career.

If you are looking to upgrade your skills and explore new technological fields, do not miss this opportunity.

If you are looking for a high-impact opportunity in AI-powered product development, the Full Stack Developer Internship at Horrazon Intelligence Private Limited is one of the most exciting roles for 2026. This internship is not just about learning basics—it is about working on a real AI SaaS platform that is moving from prototype to scalable deployment.

At www.notesgallery.com, we bring you verified and high-value opportunities, and this Full Stack Developer Internship stands out because of its direct exposure to AI systems, full-stack architecture, and startup-level execution.

About Horrazon.AI

Horrazon.AI is building a next-generation AI-powered Marketing Analyst Agent that helps businesses make intelligent marketing decisions automatically. The platform combines machine learning models like CLTV (Customer Lifetime Value) and ROAS (Return on Ad Spend) with a full-stack SaaS system.

This Full Stack Developer Internship allows you to work on a real product that is entering its scaling phase, which means your contributions directly impact the system’s growth.

Overview of Full Stack Developer Internship

This Full Stack Developer Internship is ideal for candidates who want to work on real AI systems instead of theoretical or dummy projects.

Technology Stack

One of the strongest advantages of this Full Stack Developer Internship is the modern and industry-relevant tech stack:

Frontend: React.js, TypeScript
Backend: Go (Golang)
Machine Learning: Python (XGBoost, Deep Neural Networks)
Architecture: Multi-tenant SaaS system
Cloud: AWS (S3, SageMaker, RDS)

Working with this stack during the Full Stack Developer Internship will significantly boost your technical profile.

Key Responsibilities

During this Full Stack Developer Internship, you will work across multiple layers of the system:

Frontend Development

  • Build responsive UI using React.js
  • Create dashboards, analytics panels, and conversational UI
  • Optimize performance with lazy loading and efficient state management
  • Integrate frontend with backend APIs

Backend Development

  • Design RESTful APIs using Go
  • Implement JWT-based authentication systems
  • Manage multi-tenant data architecture
  • Optimize backend for performance and scalability

System Integration

  • Integrate frontend, backend, and ML services
  • Work with REST and gRPC communication
  • Build data pipelines for real-time analytics

AI/ML Integration

  • Work with CLTV, ROAS, and CAC models
  • Manage data flow between ML models and application
  • Support AI-driven decision systems

Cloud & Infrastructure

  • Gain exposure to AWS services
  • Assist in deployment pipelines
  • Work on scalable backend systems

This Full Stack Developer Internship gives you end-to-end product development exposure.

Required Skills

To apply for this Full Stack Developer Internship, candidates should have:

  • Strong knowledge of React.js and TypeScript
  • Basic backend understanding (Go preferred)
  • Knowledge of REST APIs and client-server architecture
  • Understanding of databases (SQL or NoSQL)
  • Familiarity with Git and version control
  • Understanding of data structures and algorithms

Preferred (but not mandatory):

  • Golang experience
  • ML basics
  • AWS or cloud exposure
  • SaaS architecture knowledge

What You Will Gain

This Full Stack Developer Internship is designed for serious learners and builders.

You will gain:

  • Real-world AI SaaS product experience
  • End-to-end system design exposure
  • Experience working with founders
  • Knowledge of scalable architecture
  • Strong portfolio projects
  • Startup-level ownership and learning

At www.notesgallery.com, we highly recommend this Full Stack Developer Internship for students who want to work in AI-driven startups.

Selection Process

The selection process for this Full Stack Developer Internship includes:

  1. Resume Screening
  2. Technical Interview
  3. Final Discussion

Applicants must submit:

  • Updated Resume
  • GitHub or Portfolio (mandatory)
  • Project description

Who Should Apply

You should apply for this Full Stack Developer Internship if:

  • You are serious about full stack development
  • You want to work on AI products
  • You enjoy solving complex problems
  • You want startup exposure
  • You are comfortable working independently

This Full Stack Developer Internship is perfect for students aiming for product-based companies.

Final Thoughts

The Full Stack Developer Internship at Horrazon Intelligence is not a basic internship—it is an opportunity to work on a real AI SaaS system that is scaling.

If you want to gain deep technical exposure, build real-world systems, and work with cutting-edge technologies, this Full Stack Developer Internship is worth applying for.

For more internships, guides, and updates, keep visiting www.notesgallery.com.

FAQs

1. Who can apply for the Full Stack Developer Internship?

Engineering students, undergraduates, postgraduates, and freshers can apply.

2. Is this Full Stack Developer Internship work from home?

Yes, it is a full-time work-from-home internship.

3. What technologies are used?

React.js, TypeScript, Go (Golang), Python ML models, and AWS.

4. Is prior experience required?

No, but strong fundamentals and projects are important.

5. Is this internship good for AI careers?

Yes, it provides direct exposure to AI SaaS systems.

title.rendered: Times Internet Internship 2026: ₹20,000 Stipend, Eligibility, Apply Online & Full Details

content.rendered:
If you are looking for a reputed internship opportunity in the digital industry, then the Times Internet Internship 2026 is a strong option to consider. This internship offers a stipend of up to ₹20,000 per month along with the chance to work with one of India’s largest digital media companies.

In today’s competitive job market, internships play a crucial role in shaping your career. They help you gain practical exposure, develop real-world skills, and understand how companies operate. The Times Internet internship is especially valuable because it provides experience in business operations, product management, and coordination.

About Times Internet

Times Internet is the digital arm of The Times Group, one of India’s most established media organizations. Founded in 1999, the company has played a major role in shaping India’s digital ecosystem.

With over 270 million unique visitors every month and more than 21 billion page views, Times Internet operates across a wide range of digital platforms. It manages over 38 different brands that focus on news, entertainment, finance, sports, and lifestyle.

The company is known for creating products that inform, entertain, and assist users globally. Backed by a strong legacy and continuous innovation, Times Internet continues to grow rapidly in the digital space.

Times Internet Internship 2026 Overview

Here are the key details of the internship:

  • Internship Name: Times Internet Internship 2026
  • Role: General Management Intern
  • Location: Noida
  • Duration: 6 Months
  • Stipend: ₹10,000 – ₹20,000 per month
  • Last Date to Apply: 22 April 2026

This internship is designed to give students a complete understanding of business operations and cross-functional teamwork.

Roles and Responsibilities

As a General Management Intern, you will be involved in a variety of tasks that contribute to the smooth functioning of the organization. This role is ideal for students who want to learn about business processes and coordination.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Collaborating with business and product teams to support cross-functional projects
  • Coordinating with internal stakeholders to manage ongoing operations
  • Conducting tele-calling with vendors, partners, and customers for follow-ups
  • Maintaining and updating databases to ensure data accuracy
  • Assisting in data compilation, analysis, and report preparation
  • Supporting process improvements and ensuring timely completion of tasks

These responsibilities will help you develop both technical and soft skills, making you better prepared for future roles.

Skills Required

To perform effectively in this internship, certain basic skills are required. While prior experience is not mandatory, having the following skills can increase your chances of selection:

  • Good communication skills
  • Basic knowledge of data handling and reporting
  • Ability to coordinate with multiple teams
  • Attention to detail
  • Problem-solving mindset

Students who are proactive and willing to learn will gain the most from this internship.

Stipend and Benefits

One of the main attractions of the Times Internet Internship 2026 is the stipend and the benefits that come along with it.

You will receive:

  • Monthly stipend ranging from ₹10,000 to ₹20,000
  • Internship completion certificate
  • Letter of Recommendation based on performance
  • Practical experience in a leading digital company

This internship provides a balance between learning and earning, which makes it a valuable opportunity for students.

Location and Duration

The internship is based in Noida and will be conducted over a period of six months.

Noida is a major IT and corporate hub, especially for media and digital companies. Working in such an environment can give you exposure to professional work culture and networking opportunities.

Why You Should Apply for Times Internet Internship 2026

There are several reasons why this internship is worth applying for.

First, Times Internet is a well-known and reputable company, which adds significant value to your resume. Second, the internship provides hands-on experience in business operations and coordination, which are essential skills in any career.

Additionally, working with cross-functional teams will help you understand how different departments collaborate to achieve common goals. This kind of exposure is difficult to gain through classroom learning alone.

Who Can Apply

This internship is suitable for a wide range of students who are interested in business, management, and operations roles.

You can apply if you are:

  • A student pursuing B.Tech, BBA, B.Com, MBA, or similar courses
  • Interested in business operations and management
  • Looking to gain corporate experience
  • Willing to work in a team environment

Freshers are also eligible to apply, making it accessible for students who are just starting their career journey.

How to Apply for Times Internet Internship 2026

To apply for the Times Internet internship, click here.

Tips to Increase Your Selection Chances

Since many students apply for internships at reputed companies like Times Internet, it is important to stand out.

Here are some useful tips:

  • Keep your resume concise and professional
  • Highlight your communication and coordination skills
  • Mention any relevant projects or internships
  • Be clear and honest about your skills

A well-prepared application can significantly improve your chances of getting shortlisted.

Important Deadline

The last date to apply for the Times Internet Internship 2026 is 22 April 2026.

It is recommended to apply as early as possible to avoid missing out on this opportunity.

Is This Internship Worth It

Yes, the Times Internet Internship 2026 is definitely worth considering. It offers valuable experience, a decent stipend, and the opportunity to work with a well-established company.

For students who want to build a career in business, management, or digital industries, this internship can be a strong starting point.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

What is the stipend for Times Internet Internship 2026?

The stipend ranges from ₹10,000 to ₹20,000 per month.

What is the duration of the internship?

The internship duration is 6 months.

Can freshers apply for this internship?

Yes, freshers are eligible to apply.

Where is the internship located?

The internship is based in Noida.

What is the last date to apply?

The last date is 22 April 2026.

Conclusion

The Times Internet Internship 2026 is a valuable opportunity for students who want to gain real-world experience in a leading digital company. With a structured role, practical exposure, and a decent stipend, it provides everything a student needs to start their professional journey.

If you are serious about building your career and gaining industry exposure, this internship is worth applying for. Make sure to submit your application before the deadline and present your skills effectively.

title.rendered: How SuperGrads CAT Coaching Helps Students Jump from 70 to 99 Percentile

content.rendered:
SuperGrads CAT Coaching for 70 to 99 percentile improvement in CAT exam.

Cracking the Common Admission Test (CAT) is no small feat. Every year, lakhs of aspirants compete for a limited number of seats in India’s top management institutes. While many candidates begin their preparation journey with high hopes, a significant number find themselves stuck around the 60–75 percentile range. The leap from 70 to 99 percentile is not just about working harder—it’s about working smarter, with the right guidance, strategy, and mindset.

This is where SuperGrads CAT Coaching plays a transformative role. It is designed not just to teach concepts, but to reshape the way students approach the exam. Let’s explore how SuperGrads enables aspirants to make this massive percentile jump and secure their place among the top scorers.

Understanding the 70 to 99 Percentile Gap

Before diving into how SuperGrads helps, it’s important to understand why this jump is so challenging. Students in the 70 percentile bracket usually have:

  • Basic conceptual clarity
  • Moderate problem-solving ability
  • Limited exam strategy
  • Poor time management under pressure

On the other hand, 99 percentile scorers demonstrate:

  • Deep conceptual mastery
  • Exceptional speed and accuracy
  • Strong test-taking strategy
  • High emotional resilience during exams

The difference lies not in intelligence, but in refinement. SuperGrads focuses precisely on this refinement process.

Personalized Learning Paths

One of the biggest mistakes aspirants make is following a one-size-fits-all study plan. SuperGrads CAT Coaching recognizes that every student has unique strengths and weaknesses.

After an initial diagnostic assessment, students receive:

  • A personalized study plan
  • Section-wise improvement strategies
  • Customized practice modules

For example, a student strong in Quantitative Aptitude but weak in VARC (Verbal Ability and Reading Comprehension) will receive targeted reading strategies, vocabulary building exercises, and RC practice sets. This focused approach ensures efficient use of time and energy.

Concept Clarity to Advanced Application

At the 70 percentile level, most students understand the basics. However, CAT is not about basic questions—it’s about applying concepts in tricky, unfamiliar ways.

SuperGrads bridges this gap by:

  • Revisiting core concepts with advanced problem sets
  • Teaching multiple approaches to solve a single question
  • Emphasizing pattern recognition

Students are trained to identify shortcuts, eliminate options quickly, and avoid common traps. This is especially crucial for sections like DILR (Data Interpretation and Logical Reasoning), where innovation matters more than rote learning.

Rigorous Mock Test Strategy

Mock tests are the backbone of CAT preparation, but simply taking tests is not enough. What truly matters is how you analyze them.

SuperGrads offers:

  • Full-length mock tests aligned with the actual exam pattern
  • Sectional tests for targeted improvement
  • Detailed performance analytics

Each mock test is followed by in-depth analysis sessions where students learn:

  • Why they got a question wrong
  • How to solve it faster
  • Whether to attempt or skip similar questions in the future

This iterative process transforms average performers into strategic thinkers. Over time, students begin to see patterns in the CAT 2024 Question Paper and anticipate similar trends for upcoming exams.

Time Management and Exam Strategy

Many students fail to cross the 90 percentile barrier not because they lack knowledge, but because they mismanage time during the exam.

SuperGrads trains students in:

  • Section-wise time allocation
  • Question selection techniques
  • Decision-making under pressure

For instance, students are taught to quickly identify “easy wins” and avoid getting stuck on difficult questions. They also learn when to move on, which is critical in a time-bound exam like CAT.

Strengthening Weak Areas

A common issue among 70 percentile scorers is uneven performance across sections. Scoring well in one section but poorly in another can significantly impact overall percentile.

SuperGrads addresses this by:

  • Conducting regular sectional tests
  • Offering targeted doubt-solving sessions
  • Providing additional practice for weaker areas

The goal is to ensure balanced performance across VARC, DILR, and QA, which is essential for achieving a 99 percentile score.

Expert Mentorship and Guidance

Having access to experienced mentors can make a huge difference. SuperGrads provides:

  • One-on-one mentorship sessions
  • Strategy discussions with CAT toppers
  • Continuous performance tracking

Mentors help students stay on track, adjust strategies when needed, and maintain motivation throughout the preparation journey. They also provide insights into how toppers approach the exam, which can be incredibly valuable.

Adaptive Practice and Real Exam Simulation

CAT is known for its unpredictability. Each year, the difficulty level and question patterns change. SuperGrads prepares students for this uncertainty through adaptive practice.

Features include:

  • Dynamic question banks that adjust difficulty based on performance
  • Real exam simulations with time pressure
  • Exposure to diverse question types

This ensures that students are not caught off guard, whether they face a tougher-than-expected paper or an unconventional question format.

Focus on Accuracy Over Attempts

One of the biggest misconceptions in CAT preparation is that attempting more questions leads to a higher score. In reality, accuracy plays a far more important role due to negative marking.

SuperGrads emphasizes:

  • Intelligent question selection
  • Minimizing guesswork
  • Improving accuracy rates

Students learn to balance speed with precision, ensuring that their attempts translate into maximum marks.

Continuous Feedback and Improvement

Improvement is a continuous process, and SuperGrads ensures that students receive regular feedback on their performance.

This includes:

  • Weekly progress reports
  • Section-wise performance breakdown
  • Actionable improvement plans

Such structured feedback helps students stay focused and make consistent progress, gradually pushing their percentile higher.

Building Mental Resilience

The journey from 70 to 99 percentile is not just academic—it’s psychological. Stress, self-doubt, and burnout can hinder performance.

SuperGrads addresses this by:

  • Conducting motivation sessions
  • Teaching stress management techniques
  • Encouraging a growth mindset

Students learn to stay calm under pressure, maintain confidence, and perform at their best on exam day

Leveraging Technology for Better Learning

Modern preparation requires modern tools. SuperGrads integrates technology to enhance learning outcomes.

Key features include:

  • Interactive online classes
  • AI-driven performance analysis
  • Mobile-friendly learning platforms

This makes CAT online coaching more effective and accessible, allowing students to learn anytime, anywhere.

Learning from Previous Year Papers

Analyzing past papers is a crucial part of CAT preparation. SuperGrads ensures that students thoroughly understand:

  • Question patterns
  • Difficulty levels
  • Topic weightage

By studying the CAT 2025 Question Paper (when available) and comparing it with previous papers, students gain insights into evolving trends. This helps them stay ahead of the curve and adapt their strategies accordingly.

Community and Peer Learning

Preparing for CAT can be a lonely journey, but it doesn’t have to be. SuperGrads fosters a strong learning community where students can:

  • Discuss doubts with peers
  • Share strategies and resources
  • Stay motivated through healthy competition

Being part of a community keeps students engaged and accountable, which is essential for long-term success.

Real Success Stories

What truly sets SuperGrads apart is its track record. Many students who started with average scores have gone on to achieve top percentiles.

These success stories highlight:

  • The effectiveness of structured preparation
  • The importance of mentorship
  • The power of consistent effort

They also serve as inspiration for current aspirants, proving that the 99 percentile goal is achievable with the right approach.

Conclusion

The journey from 70 to 99 percentile in CAT is undoubtedly challenging, but it is far from impossible. It requires a combination of smart strategy, consistent practice, and the right guidance.

SuperGrads CAT Coaching provides all of this and more. By focusing on personalized learning, advanced problem-solving, rigorous testing, and mental resilience, it equips students with the tools they need to excel.

If you’re stuck in the mid-percentile range and aiming for the top, it’s time to rethink your preparation strategy. With the right support system, that 99 percentile dream can very much become a reality.

Remember: It’s not about how much you study it’s about how effectively you prepare. And with the right coaching, every aspirant has the potential to make that leap.

title.rendered: Regarding Challenge Evaluation (Stage–2) of the Odd Semester, Session 2025–26.

content.rendered:
AKTU Students, Attention! Demystifying Challenge Evaluation (Stage–2) for Odd Semester, Session 2025–26

Hey AKTU Warriors! Are you feeling a bit anxious about your recent odd semester results? Perhaps you believe your hard work didn’t quite translate into the marks you deserved? Don’t worry, you’re not alone, and AKTU understands these concerns. That’s why the university provides a robust mechanism for students to seek re-evaluation, and today we’re diving deep into a crucial aspect of it: the official notice Regarding Challenge Evaluation (Stage–2) of the Odd Semester, Session 2025–26. This is a very important update for many of you, especially if you’re looking to improve your scores after an initial re-evaluation process. So, grab a chai, settle in, and let’s break down everything you need to know about this vital opportunity to ensure fairness in your academic journey.

The journey of an engineering student at AKTU is filled with rigorous exams, late-night study sessions, and the constant pursuit of knowledge. Sometimes, despite all efforts, the marks on the mark sheet might not reflect your true performance. This is where the challenge evaluation process comes into play, offering a glimmer of hope for those who feel their answer sheets weren’t assessed correctly. Stage-2 is particularly significant as it’s a follow-up for those who might still have discrepancies even after the first re-evaluation.

Key Highlights: Understanding the Challenge Evaluation (Stage–2)

This notice is paramount for students seeking clarity and potential improvement in their odd semester examination marks. Here’s a quick rundown of the essential points you must keep in mind:

  • What it is: Challenge Evaluation (Stage–2) is the second phase of the re-evaluation process for students who are not satisfied with their marks even after applying for the initial re-evaluation (copy viewing and re-totaling).
  • Purpose: It allows students to get their answer sheets re-evaluated by a different set of examiners, ensuring a fresh and unbiased assessment.
  • Target Session: This specific circular pertains to the Odd Semester examinations for the Academic Session 2025–26.
  • Application Process: Students will need to apply through their ERP portal, following specific guidelines and paying the requisite fee.
  • Eligibility: Typically, students who have already applied for the first stage of re-evaluation and are still dissatisfied with the outcome are eligible for Stage-2.
  • Significance: This is often the final opportunity to challenge your marks, making it a critical step for students aiming for better academic standing.
  • Official Communication: All details, including application deadlines and fees, will be communicated through official AKTU circulars. It’s crucial to refer to these notices directly.

Important Dates: Mark Your Calendars (Tentative for 2025-26)

While the specific circular for “Regarding Challenge Evaluation (Stage–2) of the Odd Semester, Session 2025–26” will contain precise dates, based on previous trends and the academic calendar, here’s a general idea of what to expect. Please remember, these are illustrative dates, and you MUST check the official AKTU circular for the exact schedule for 2025-26.

Aapko yeh dates bahut dhyaan se dekhni hongi, taaki koi bhi deadline miss na ho:

  • Application Window Opens: Approximately 2-3 weeks after the declaration of Stage-1 re-evaluation results (e.g., Mid-March 2026).
  • Last Date for Online Application: Typically, a window of 7-10 days from the opening date (e.g., End of March 2026).
  • Last Date for Fee Payment: Usually coincides with the application deadline (e.g., End of March 2026).
  • Re-evaluation Process Completion: Within 4-6 weeks of the application deadline.
  • Declaration of Stage-2 Results: Approximately 1-2 months after the application window closes (e.g., End of April/Early May 2026).

Pro Tip: Always set reminders on your phone or calendar for these crucial dates. AKTU deadlines are strict, and missing them could mean missing out on your chance for re-evaluation.

Who is Affected by This Notice?

This notice primarily affects a specific group of students within AKTU:

  • Odd Semester Students (Session 2025–26): This includes students from various undergraduate (B.Tech, B.Pharm, B.Arch, etc.) and postgraduate (M.Tech, MBA, MCA, etc.) programs who appeared for their odd semester exams in the academic year 2025-26.
  • Students Dissatisfied with Stage-1 Re-evaluation: If you applied for the initial copy viewing or re-totaling and still feel your marks are incorrect or not reflective of your performance, this Stage-2 is for you.
  • All Branches and Semesters: While the notice is general, students from all engineering branches (CSE, ECE, ME, CE, EE, IT, etc.), pharmacy, architecture, management, and other affiliated courses are eligible, provided they meet the criteria for Stage-1 application and dissatisfaction.
  • Students Seeking Mark Improvement: Any student who believes their grade point average (GPA) or specific subject marks can be improved through a thorough re-assessment should consider this option.

Agar aapko lagta hai ki aapke marks aur achhe aa sakte the, toh yeh notice aapke liye bahut important hai.

How to Check / Download the Official Notice (Step-by-Step Guide)

Getting your hands on the official circular is the first and most crucial step. Here’s a simple, numbered guide to help you navigate the AKTU website and download the notice Regarding Challenge Evaluation (Stage–2) of the Odd Semester, Session 2025–26:

  1. Visit the AKTU Official Website: Open your web browser and go to www.aktu.ac.in. This is your primary source for all official announcements.
  2. Navigate to the “Circulars” or “Notices” Section: Look for sections like “Circulars,” “Notices,” “Latest Updates,” or “Examination Notices” on the homepage. These are usually prominently displayed or found under an “Academics” or “Students” menu.
  3. Search for Relevant Keywords: Use the search bar (if available) within the circulars section and type keywords like “Challenge Evaluation,” “Odd Semester,” “Stage-2,” or “2025-26.”
  4. Locate the Specific Notice: Scroll through the list of recent circulars. The notice you’re looking for will likely be titled “Regarding Challenge Evaluation (Stage–2) of the Odd Semester, Session 2025–26” or something very similar.
  5. Click to View/Download: Once you find the correct circular, click on the title or the “Download PDF” icon next to it. The PDF document will either open in your browser or download directly to your device.
  6. Read Carefully: Make sure to read the entire notice thoroughly. Pay close attention to the eligibility criteria, application fees, application procedure, and, most importantly, the deadlines.

title.rendered: AKTU Challenge Evaluation 2026: Fee, Last Date, Rules, Process and Complete Guide

content.rendered:
AKTU Challenge Evaluation 2026 has become one of the most searched topics among engineering students following the release of the odd semester results. Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University has officially opened the application process for challenge evaluation, which is also known as stage two rechecking. This process allows students to request a fresh evaluation of their answer sheets if they believe their original marks do not accurately reflect their performance.

Many students often feel that their initial marks are not a true representation of their efforts in the exams. In such cases, challenge evaluation offers a valuable second opportunity. However, it is important to understand that this process comes with specific risks, costs, and strict rules defined by the university.

In this detailed guide, you will find comprehensive information about AKTU Challenge Evaluation 2026, including fees, last date, eligibility, the marking system, the refund policy, and a reasoned discussion on whether you should apply.

also read : ShareChat Internship 2026: Stipend, Eligibility, Roles, and Application Process

AKTU Challenge Evaluation 2026 Latest Update

According to the official notice released by AKTU, the challenge evaluation process has commenced for students who appeared in the odd semester examinations of the 2025-26 session. The exams were conducted between December 2025 and February 2026, and the results have already been declared.

Students who are not satisfied with their marks can now apply for re-evaluation through the official ERP portal. The university has clearly stated that this is a paid process and that the final marks after evaluation may either increase or decrease, depending on the re-assessment.

Important Dates for AKTU Challenge Evaluation 2026

Understanding the timeline is critical, as missing the deadline means losing this opportunity entirely.

The theory examinations were conducted from 23 December 2025 to 31 January 2026. Practical exams were held between 10 February and 19 February 2026. After the result declaration, the challenge evaluation process was started.

The last date to apply for AKTU Challenge Evaluation 2026 is 29 March 2026. Students are strongly advised not to wait until the final day, as server issues and payment failures are common during peak traffic times.

AKTU Challenge Evaluation 2026 Application Fee

One of the most important factors in this process is the fee. AKTU has set a fixed charge of 2500 rupees per subject for challenge evaluation.

This means if a student wishes to apply for multiple subjects, the total cost will increase accordingly. For example, if you apply for two subjects, you will be required to pay 5000 rupees. For three subjects, the total becomes 7500 rupees.

The entire payment must be completed online through the ERP portal. Without a successful payment, the application will not be accepted by the system.

Who Should Apply for Challenge Evaluation

Not every student should apply for challenge evaluation. This process is best suited for students who are confident that a genuine mistake was made during the evaluation of their answer paper.

Students who expected significantly higher marks based on their performance but received unexpectedly low scores can consider applying. It is also useful for those who are very close to passing marks or who are looking to improve their division or overall percentage.

However, students who are generally satisfied with their marks or are unsure about their actual exam performance should think very carefully before applying. Because marks can decrease, there is always a significant risk involved.

Step by Step Process to Apply

The application process for AKTU Challenge Evaluation 2026 is simple but must be followed carefully to avoid any errors.

  1. ERP Login: First, students need to log in to the official AKTU ERP portal using their personal credentials (roll number and password).
  2. Navigate: After logging in, you must navigate to the specific “Challenge Evaluation” section on the dashboard.
  3. Subject Selection: Next, select the specific subject or subjects for which you want to request re-evaluation.
  4. Fee Payment: After selecting the subjects, proceed to the payment section and pay the required fee of 2500 rupees per subject using an online method.
  5. Submission: Once the payment is confirmed as successful, submit the final application form.
  6. Confirmation: It is highly recommended to download or take a screenshot of the submission confirmation page for future reference.

After submission, the university will assign new examiners who will re-check your answer sheets.

AKTU Marking Rules for Challenge Evaluation

One of the most critical aspects of this process is the marking system used by AKTU. Students must clearly understand this rule before applying, as it can be double-edged.

In challenge evaluation, your answer sheet will be thoroughly checked by two completely different examiners. The marks given by both of these new examiners will then be considered.

The final marks will be calculated as the average of the marks given by these two examiners. This average will be treated as your new final score, regardless of whether it is higher or lower than your original marks.

This rule makes the process risky, especially for students who are unsure about the precision of their original answers. If both examiners assign lower marks, your final score will decrease.

Refund Policy Explained

To maintain fairness in this expensive process, AKTU has defined a specific refund policy.

If the difference between your original marks and the new average marks from the challenge evaluation is more than 20 percent, you will receive a partial refund. In such cases, 1000 rupees will be deducted as an administrative charge, and the remaining 1500 rupees will be refunded to your bank account.

However, if the difference is 20 percent or less, no refund will be provided.

Correct Bank Details are Mandatory

To ensure you receive your refund, students must enter correct and complete bank details on the portal during the application process. This includes the account number, the IFSC code, and the bank name. Any mistake in these details may result in the failure of the refund transaction, and the university will not be held responsible for incorrect entries.

Important Instructions for Students

Before applying for challenge evaluation, students must keep a few important points in mind to ensure the process runs smoothly and that they fully understand the implications.

  • Last Date: Always apply well before the final deadline of 29 March 2026. Do not wait for the final day, as technical issues are common.
  • Confidence is Key: Make sure you are truly confident about your performance before applying. This is not a trial option to see if marks might increase.
  • Finality: Once applied, the new result will be final. There is no going back to the old marks.
  • Marks Can Decrease: Understand clearly that your marks can increase or decrease. There is no guarantee of an improvement.
  • Correct Information: Ensure that all payment and bank details are correctly filled out.

Should You Apply for AKTU Challenge Evaluation 2026?

This is the most important question every student must answer for themselves. The decision should be a balanced one, based on confidence and an understanding of your performance.

You Should Apply If:

  • You strongly believe that your original marks are not justified and that there has been an error in evaluation.
  • You expected much higher marks based on your answers and your knowledge of the marking scheme.
  • You are on the border of passing a critical subject and are confident a re-check will help.

You Should Avoid Applying If:

  • You are generally satisfied with your marks and it is only out of curiosity.
  • You are unsure about how you performed in the exam.
  • You do not want to take the risk of your marks decreasing.
  • Taking this unnecessary risk could lead to a decrease in marks, which may negatively affect your academic record.

It is always better to make a decision based on an objective analysis of your exam performance rather than emotion.

Common Mistakes to Avoid

Many students make simple mistakes while applying, which can lead to significant problems later on.

  • Applying without Analysis: Do not apply without objectively analyzing your performance in the specific exam paper.
  • Applying for All Subjects: Avoid applying for multiple subjects blindly, as this drastically increases the financial burden.
  • Incorrect Bank Details: Do not enter incorrect bank details; this is the primary cause of refund failures.
  • Ignoring the Marking Rule: Do not ignore the rules mentioned by AKTU, especially the risky average marking system.

Conclusion

AKTU Challenge Evaluation 2026 provides students with a valuable opportunity to correct possible evaluation mistakes in their exam results. However, it is not a guaranteed way to increase marks. The process involves significant cost, strict rules, and a certain level of risk.

Students must carefully analyze their performance, understand the marking system, and then decide whether to apply or not. Making an informed decision will help you avoid the unnecessary loss of both money and marks.

If you are genuinely confident that your marks are incorrect, then this process can be highly beneficial. Otherwise, it is better to accept your current result and focus your energy on future examinations.

Lossless compression ensures that the original data can be perfectly reconstructed after decompression. Techniques such as Huffman coding, run-length encoding, and Lempel-Ziv algorithms are important topics.

title.rendered: Microsoft Internship 2026: Eligibility, Stipend, Responsibilities & How to Apply

content.rendered:
Microsoft Internship 2026: Microsoft has opened applications for the Microsoft Datacenter Technician (DCT) Internship 2026 in India. This internship is a great opportunity for students who want to gain hands-on experience in IT infrastructure, hardware support, and cloud operations.

If you are interested in data centers, networking, and cloud computing, this internship can help you gain practical knowledge while working with one of the world’s largest technology companies.

In this article, we will cover everything about the Microsoft Internship 2026, including eligibility, responsibilities, stipend, location, and how to apply.

About Microsoft

Microsoft is one of the world’s leading technology companies, known for developing popular products and services used by millions of people worldwide.

Some of the most popular Microsoft products include:

  • Windows Operating System
  • Microsoft Azure
  • Microsoft Office 365
  • Bing Search Engine
  • Xbox Gaming Platform
  • OneDrive Cloud Storage

Microsoft manages its global cloud infrastructure through its Cloud Operations & Innovation (CO+I) division.

Currently, Microsoft operates:

  • 100+ data centers worldwide
  • More than 1 million servers
  • Infrastructure supporting billions of users globally

These data centers power Microsoft Azure, which allows businesses and organizations to run applications, store data, and scale digital services efficiently.

Microsoft Internship 2026 Overview

Roles and Responsibilities

As a Datacenter Technician Intern, you will work with Microsoft’s infrastructure teams and assist in managing daily data center operations.

Your responsibilities may include:

1. Data Center Infrastructure Support

You will assist in the deployment and maintenance of physical infrastructure inside the data center.

2. Hardware Installation

Interns may help install and troubleshoot components such as:

  • Servers
  • Network cables
  • Storage systems
  • Networking equipment

3. Handling Storage Devices

You may work with data-bearing devices like:

  • Hard Disk Drives (HDD)
  • Solid State Drives (SSD)

Proper handling procedures will be followed to ensure data security.

4. Ticket-Based Support System

Microsoft uses a ticket-based support system to manage infrastructure issues.

Interns will help:

  • Track technical issues
  • Update support tickets
  • Assist engineers in resolving problems

5. Equipment Handling

Interns may help move hardware equipment using pallet jacks or assisted lifting tools.

6. Inventory and Asset Management

You will collaborate with the Datacenter Inventory and Asset Management Team (DIAT) to manage:

  • Hardware inventory
  • Shipping and receiving
  • Asset tracking

7. Team Collaboration

Interns will work with various Microsoft teams to maintain efficient data center operations.

Eligibility Criteria

To apply for the Microsoft Datacenter Technician Internship 2026, candidates must meet the following requirements.

Required Qualifications

Applicants must have:

  • High School Diploma or equivalent qualification
  • Minimum 18 years of age
  • Basic knowledge of computer hardware
  • Interest in IT infrastructure and networking
  • Currently pursuing a technical qualification

Citizenship Requirement

Candidates must be:

  • Indian citizens, OR
  • Legally eligible to work in India.

Students studying the following fields may benefit most from this internship:

  • Computer Science
  • Information Technology
  • Electronics
  • Networking
  • Cloud Computing

Internship Location

content.rendered:

  • Footwear
  • Accessories

The platform follows a unique omnichannel retail model, which means customers can shop online while also benefiting from offline store services.

Interns will create product descriptions and category content for the Tata CLiQ website. This content helps customers understand the product features and improves search visibility.

title.rendered: AKTU Placement Portal Registration 2026: Students Must Register on URISE Portal Before 14 March

content.rendered:
AKTU Placement Portal Registration 2026: Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University (AKTU) has released an important notice regarding student registration on the Central Training & Placement Cell portal (URISE). According to the official circular, all students studying in AKTU affiliated institutions must register on the URISE Training & Placement Portal.

The university has made it mandatory for students to complete registration before 14 March 2026 so that they can participate in placement drives, internships, and job opportunities.

In this article, we will explain the AKTU URISE portal registration process, official link, required details, and benefits for students.

AKTU Official Notice About Placement Portal Registration

According to the circular issued by AKTU Training and Placement Cell, all colleges affiliated with the university must ensure that their students register on the URISE portal.

The notice clearly states that:

  • Student registration on the placement portal is mandatory.
  • Colleges must ensure that all eligible students complete registration.
  • The last date to complete registration is 14 March 2026.
  • Login details and SOP are available in the director login portal for institutions.

The portal is managed by the Central Training & Placement Cell to connect students with industries.

URISE Placement Portal Official Link

Students can register on the official placement portal using the link below:

Portal Link:
https://urise.up.gov.in/frontend/Homepage/trainingplacement

This portal is part of the URISE – Unified Reimagined Innovation for Students Empowerment initiative.

What is the URISE Portal?

The URISE portal is a centralized platform created by the Uttar Pradesh government to help students access:

  • Training programs
  • Placement opportunities
  • Internship opportunities
  • Job notifications
  • Skill development programs

Students from AKTU and other technical institutes in Uttar Pradesh can use this platform.

How to Register on AKTU URISE Placement Portal

Follow the steps below to register on the portal.

Step 1: Visit the Official Website

Go to the URISE placement portal.

Step 2: Click on Register

On the homepage, click on Register as Student.

Step 3: Enter Basic Details

You will need to enter:

Step 4: Verify Details

The system will fetch student details automatically such as:

  • Program

Step 5: Fill Additional Information

Companies post job opportunities which students can apply for directly.

Important Date

Students are advised to complete registration before the deadline.

Why This Portal is Important for AKTU Students

The URISE portal provides a centralized placement system where students can easily connect with companies.

Benefits include:

  • Direct job opportunities
  • Transparent placement process
  • Access to internships
  • Skill development programs
  • Industry exposure

This initiative helps improve employability and career opportunities for students.

Conclusion

AKTU has made URISE placement portal registration mandatory for students studying in affiliated institutions. Students should register on the portal before 14 March 2026 to avoid missing placement and internship opportunities.

All students are advised to visit the portal, complete their profile, and regularly check for job notifications and placement drives.

Yes, according to the official notice, registration on the placement portal is mandatory.

The last date mentioned in the notice is 14 March 2026.

title.rendered: AKTU DigiShakti Flash Message Notice 2026: Educational Messages to Be Sent on Student Tablets & Smartphones

content.rendered:
AKTU DigiShakti Flash Message Notice 2026: Dr. APJ Abdul Kalam Technical University (AKTU), Uttar Pradesh, has issued an important notification regarding the DigiShakti Portal. According to the notice dated 10 March 2026, educational departments and universities can now send educational flash messages directly to students’ tablets and smartphones distributed under the Swami Vivekananda Yuva Sashaktikaran Yojana.

This new initiative aims to strengthen digital communication between the government, universities, and students by delivering important academic information directly to their devices.

AKTU DigiShakti Flash Message Notice 2026 – Overview

What is the DigiShakti Portal?

The DigiShakti Portal is an online platform launched by the Uttar Pradesh Government to manage the distribution of digital devices such as tablets and smartphones to students studying in higher education institutions.

Under this system, students receive devices to support digital learning and online education. Now, the government has expanded the portal’s functionality to allow departments to send educational flash messages directly to student devices.

These flash messages may include:

  • Academic announcements
  • Educational content
  • Government schemes for students
  • Career guidance information
  • Important university notices

Purpose of the Flash Message System

The main objective of introducing the flash message system is to ensure that students receive important educational updates instantly on their tablets and smartphones.

This initiative will help students stay informed about:

  • Academic opportunities
  • Government programs
  • Internship and job updates
  • Digital education resources
  • University notices

How Departments Send Flash Messages Through DigiShakti Portal

The government has also released a User Manual for Sending Flash Messages through the DigiShakti portal. The process is explained step-by-step below.

Step 1: Login to the DigiShakti Portal

The Department Nodal Officer must first log in to the DigiShakti portal using official credentials.

Portal Link:
https://digishaktiup.in/app

Login credentials include:

  • Department User ID
  • Password
  • Captcha verification

Step 2: Go to the Transactions Tab

After logging in, the officer must navigate to the Transactions section on the dashboard.

Inside this section, the option “Send Flash Message” will be available.

Step 3: Click on “Send Message”

Next, the officer needs to click the Send Message button.

This action will open the Flash Message Form where the required details must be filled.

Step 4: Fill the Flash Message Form

In the flash message form, the following information needs to be entered:

  • Department Name
  • University / Institution
  • Course or Category
  • Message Type
  • Title of the Message
  • Message Content
  • URL or reference link (optional)

The message written here will be sent to students as an educational notification.

Step 5: Click on Send Button

After filling in all required information, the officer must click the Send button.

Once submitted successfully, the message will be delivered to the students’ devices.

Step 6: Message Delivery Confirmation

After sending the message, the sender can verify the delivery by checking the View Message column in the dashboard.

This section allows departments to track and view previously sent flash messages.

Number of Messages Already Sent

According to the official report included in the notice, several departments have already started using the DigiShakti system.

Currently, a total of 3877 flash messages have been sent through the DigiShakti portal to students across different departments and universities.

Benefits of DigiShakti Flash Messages for Students

This new feature provides several advantages for students:

✔ Instant updates on tablets and smartphones
✔ Quick access to educational information
✔ Awareness of government schemes
✔ Notifications about academic activities
✔ Career and internship opportunities

By using this system, universities and departments can communicate more effectively with students.

Official DigiShakti Portal Link

Students and departments can access the portal using the following link:

DigiShakti Portal:
https://digishaktiup.in/app

Conclusion

The AKTU DigiShakti Flash Message Notice 2026 introduces an efficient digital communication system for students in Uttar Pradesh. Through the DigiShakti portal, educational departments can now send flash messages containing academic updates, government schemes, and important information directly to students’ tablets and smartphones.

This initiative supports the government’s vision of strengthening digital education and improving information accessibility for students.

FAQs

What is DigiShakti Flash Message?

DigiShakti Flash Message is a notification system that allows departments to send educational messages directly to students’ tablets and smartphones.

Who can send flash messages through DigiShakti?

Only authorized departmental nodal officers and universities can send messages through the DigiShakti portal.

Which students will receive these messages?

Students who have received tablets or smartphones under the Swami Vivekananda Yuva Sashaktikaran Scheme will receive these messages.
