title.rendered: India AI Impact Summit 2026: How New Delhi Is Shaping the Future of Global AI Governance

content.rendered:
India is stepping into the global AI spotlight with the India AI Impact Summit 2026, a landmark event that positions New Delhi at the centre of international conversations on artificial intelligence, governance, and inclusive innovation. Scheduled for mid-February 2026, the summit marks the first time a global AI summit is being hosted in the Global South, signalling a shift in how AI leadership and priorities are defined worldwide.

As concerns grow around AI’s impact on jobs, energy consumption, and social equity, the India AI Impact Summit 2026 aims to move beyond theory—focusing instead on real-world solutions, actionable outcomes, and long-term governance frameworks.

India AI Impact Summit 2026: Key Details at a Glance

Why the India AI Impact Summit 2026 Matters

The India AI Impact Summit 2026 is not about rushing into binding regulations. Instead, it focuses on building consensus, sharing best practices, and developing practical AI governance recommendations that can guide nations over the long term.

This approach reflects how global AI discussions have evolved:

  • UK AI Safety Summit (2023): Focused on catastrophic AI risks
  • Seoul Summit (2024): Added innovation and inclusivity
  • Paris AI Action Summit (2025): Emphasised economic opportunity
  • India AI Impact Summit (2026): Prioritises on-ground impact and Global South perspectives

India’s framing of “People, Planet, and Progress” highlights AI as a tool for solving real societal challenges—not just a race for technological dominance.

India’s Strategic Push for a Larger Share of the AI Economy

At a time when governments worldwide view AI as a strategic national asset, India is making its ambitions clear. The India AI Impact Summit 2026 reinforces the country’s intent to secure a larger share of the global AI value chain, spanning software, governance frameworks, startups, and applied AI solutions.

However, challenges remain—particularly in access to advanced hardware such as GPUs and the massive energy demands of AI data centres. India’s policy signals around:

  • Increased technology trade with the US
  • Tax holidays for foreign data centre investments until 2047
  • Expansion of nuclear energy for AI infrastructure

What to Expect at the India AI Impact Summit 2026

1. High-Level Global Participation

The summit is expected to host:

  • 15–20 Heads of Government
  • 50+ international ministers
  • 40+ CEOs from global and Indian tech giants

Prime Minister Narendra Modi will inaugurate the summit and is expected to address a CEO roundtable and host diplomatic engagements.

2. Attendance by Global Tech Leaders

Some of the world’s most influential technology figures are set to attend the India AI Impact Summit 2026, including:

  • Sundar Pichai – CEO, Google & Alphabet
  • Jensen Huang – Founder, Nvidia
  • Demis Hassabis – CEO, Google DeepMind
  • Brad Smith – President, Microsoft
  • Cristiano Amon – CEO, Qualcomm
  • Sam Altman – CEO, OpenAI (expected via sessions or closed-door meetings)
  • Bill Gates – Philanthropist & tech leader

Indian business leaders such as Mukesh Ambani, Sunil Bharti Mittal, and Nandan Nilekani will also play key roles.

3. Focus on AI and the Future of Work

Key working groups will deliberate on:

  • AI’s impact on employment
  • Trust, safety, and accountability of AI models
  • Responsible AI deployment across industries
  • AI governance frameworks suited for emerging economies

4. Launch of Indigenous AI Models

One of the major highlights of the India AI Impact Summit 2026 will be the launch of multiple indigenous AI language models, including:

  • Foundational models
  • Small language models

These initiatives fall under the ₹10,370 crore IndiaAI Mission, aimed at strengthening domestic AI capabilities.

5. Massive Startup and Innovation Showcase

The summit will feature:

  • 500+ AI startups
  • 500 sessions across policy, industry, research, and civil society

This makes it one of the largest and most comprehensive AI-focused global events ever hosted by India.

Opening Diplomatic Channels: China’s Participation

A Chinese delegation is also expected to attend the India AI Impact Summit 2026, continuing a trend seen at previous global AI summits. India’s invitation to China reflects:

  • Gradual easing of bilateral ties
  • Recognition that AI governance requires engagement with all major AI powers

The summit is not a formal bloc, allowing the host country flexibility in shaping participation.

Energy, Hardware, and the Road Ahead

India’s ambitions in AI face structural challenges:

  • Heavy dependence on imported GPUs
  • Rising energy demands from AI data centres

In response, the government is exploring:

  • Expanded access to global compute resources
  • Nuclear energy as a long-term solution for AI infrastructure
  • Policy incentives to attract global data centre investments

These moves underscore how seriously India views AI as a national priority.

Conclusion: Why the India AI Impact Summit 2026 Is a Turning Point

The India AI Impact Summit 2026 is more than a conference—it is a statement. By hosting the world’s most influential AI leaders in New Delhi, India is positioning itself as:

  • A bridge between developed and emerging economies
  • A champion of inclusive, people-centric AI
  • A key architect of future AI governance frameworks

As AI reshapes economies, jobs, and societies, the outcomes of the India AI Impact Summit 2026 could influence how the world builds, regulates, and benefits from artificial intelligence for years to come.

FAQs: India AI Impact Summit 2026

What is the India AI Impact Summit 2026?

The India AI Impact Summit 2026 is a global conference hosted by India that brings together governments, tech leaders, researchers, and civil society to discuss artificial intelligence governance, innovation, and real-world applications, with a focus on inclusive growth and Global South priorities.

When and where will the India AI Impact Summit 2026 take place?

The India AI Impact Summit 2026 will be held from February 16 to February 20, 2026, at Bharat Mandapam in New Delhi, India.

Why is the India AI Impact Summit 2026 important?

The India AI Impact Summit 2026 is important because it is the first major global AI summit hosted in the Global South and focuses on actionable AI solutions, long-term governance, and addressing AI’s impact on jobs, energy, and society.

Who is hosting the India AI Impact Summit 2026?

The Government of India is hosting the India AI Impact Summit 2026, with leadership from the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology and participation from top global institutions.

Which global leaders are attending the India AI Impact Summit 2026?

Expected attendees at the India AI Impact Summit 2026 include Sundar Pichai, Jensen Huang, Demis Hassabis, Brad Smith, Cristiano Amon, Sam Altman, and Bill Gates, along with Indian business leaders such as Mukesh Ambani and Nandan Nilekani.

What is the main theme of the India AI Impact Summit 2026?

The main theme of the India AI Impact Summit 2026 is “People, Planet, and Progress,” emphasising human-centric AI, sustainability, and inclusive technological development.

How many countries are participating in the India AI Impact Summit 2026?

The India AI Impact Summit 2026 is expected to see participation from over 100 countries, including 15–20 Heads of Government and more than 50 international ministers.

What topics will be discussed at the India AI Impact Summit 2026?

Key topics at the India AI Impact Summit 2026 include AI governance, trust and safety, AI’s impact on employment, use of AI in industry, energy requirements for AI, and responsible deployment of AI technologies.

Will new AI models be launched at the India AI Impact Summit 2026?

Yes, the India AI Impact Summit 2026 will feature the launch of multiple indigenous AI language models, including foundational and small language models, under the IndiaAI Mission.

What is the IndiaAI Mission mentioned at the summit?

The IndiaAI Mission is a government initiative with an outlay of ₹10,370 crore, aimed at strengthening India’s AI ecosystem by supporting compute infrastructure, startups, and the development of domestic AI models.

How does the India AI Impact Summit 2026 differ from previous global AI summits?

Unlike earlier summits that focused mainly on AI safety or regulation, the India AI Impact Summit 2026 emphasises practical implementation, on-ground problem-solving, and the needs of developing economies.

Will startups be involved in the India AI Impact Summit 2026?

Yes, the India AI Impact Summit 2026 will host a startup showcase featuring over 500 AI startups, highlighting innovation from India and around the world.

Is China participating in the India AI Impact Summit 2026?

A Chinese delegation is expected to attend the India AI Impact Summit 2026, continuing China’s participation in previous global AI summits hosted by the UK, South Korea, and France.

How does the India AI Impact Summit 2026 address AI’s energy demands?

The India AI Impact Summit 2026 will address AI’s growing energy needs through discussions on data centres, sustainable power solutions, and India’s plans to use nuclear energy to support AI infrastructure.

What outcomes are expected from the India AI Impact Summit 2026?

The summit aims to produce actionable recommendations, strengthen international cooperation, promote inclusive AI development, and shape long-term global AI governance frameworks.

title.rendered: AKTU Jaro Education Placement Drive 2026: ₹14.56 LPA Salary, Eligibility, Date, Selection Process & How to Apply

content.rendered:
The AKTU Jaro Education Placement Drive 2026 has created huge excitement among final-year students of Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University, Lucknow. With salary packages going up to ₹14.56 LPA, pan-India job locations, and no bond requirement, this campus drive is one of the most attractive opportunities for B.Tech, MBA, and MCA students from the 2026 passing-out batch.

As per the official notification released by the AKTU Training & Placement Cell, Jaro Education is inviting eligible students from AKTU-affiliated colleges to participate in this full-time hiring process. In this detailed guide, you’ll find everything you need to know—from official notice details and salary structure to eligibility, registration steps, preparation tips, and FAQs.

Official AKTU Placement Notification 2026

The official circular for the AKTU Jaro Education Placement Drive 2026 has been issued by the Dean, Training & Placement, Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University, Lucknow.

Key Details from the Notice:

  • Reference No.: AKTU/CTPC/2026/1293
  • Notification Date: 07 February 2026
  • Eligible Batch: 2026 Passing Out
  • Courses: B.Tech / MBA / MCA

All AKTU-affiliated and associated colleges have been instructed to ensure maximum student participation. Students are required to complete registration before the last date to be considered for the drive.

About Jaro Education (Company Profile)

Jaro Education is among India’s most reputed EdTech and higher education service providers. Founded in 2009 by Dr. Sanjay Salunkhe, the company has played a key role in transforming executive education and online learning in India.

Why Jaro Education?

  • Profitable and self-funded since inception
  • Trusted partner of top Indian & global universities
  • Pioneer in executive and online education
  • Strong corporate work culture and structured training

For fresh graduates, Jaro Education offers not just a job but a long-term career path in education consulting, sales leadership, and management roles.

Job Roles Offered in AKTU Jaro Education Placement Drive 2026

Under the AKTU Jaro Education Placement Drive 2026, candidates will be hired for the following roles:

🔹 Graduate Trainee (GT)

Designed for fresh graduates looking to build a career in education counseling and professional sales.

🔹 Management Trainee (MT)

A higher-responsibility role suitable for MBA and MCA students with strong communication and leadership potential.

Detailed Job Description (JD)

The role offered by Jaro Education is an end-to-end sales and counseling profile, where selected students will:

  • Connect daily with 80+ working professionals using CRM-generated leads
  • Understand customer needs related to career growth and up-skilling
  • Counsel prospective learners about online and executive education programs
  • Share program details through phone calls, video calls, and meetings
  • Build and manage a strong sales pipeline
  • Achieve daily, weekly, and monthly enrollment targets
  • Handle the full sales cycle—from cold calling to final enrollment

This role helps students develop real-world corporate skills, confidence, and performance-driven professionalism.

Salary Package & CTC Structure (Major Highlight)

One of the biggest reasons students are excited about the AKTU Jaro Education Placement Drive 2026 is its high salary package.

💰 CTC for Candidates Willing to Relocate to Mumbai

  • Graduate Trainee (GT): Up to ₹10.76 LPA
  • Management Trainee (MT): Up to ₹14.56 LPA

💰 CTC for Candidates Not Willing to Relocate

Additional Salary Details:

  • Training Period: 6 Months
  • Salary During Training: As per CTC
  • Bond / Service Agreement: Not Applicable

Job Location & Posting Cities

Selected candidates under the AKTU Jaro Education Placement Drive 2026 may be posted across multiple cities in India.

Zone 1 Cities

  • Mumbai
  • Pune
  • Bengaluru
  • Hyderabad
  • Chennai
  • Gurugram

Zone 2 Cities

  • Lucknow
  • Chandigarh
  • Jaipur
  • Ahmedabad
  • Kochi

Location preference may be considered, but final allocation depends on business needs.

Eligibility Criteria (Who Can Apply?)

Students must meet the following eligibility requirements:

  • Degree: B.Tech / MBA / MCA
  • Batch: 2026 Passing Out
  • Skills Required:
    • Good communication skills
    • Confidence and clarity in speaking
    • Willingness to work in a target-based role

No specific branch restriction has been mentioned, making this drive accessible to a wide range of students.

Selection Process Explained

The selection process for the AKTU Jaro Education Placement Drive 2026 includes:

  1. Resume Shortlisting
  2. Group Discussion (GD)
  3. Personal Interview (PI)

📌 No technical or aptitude written test
📌 Expected Offers: 50
📌 Joining: Immediate after selection

Drive Date, Time & Venue

  • Drive Date: 19 February 2026
  • Reporting Time: 10:00 AM
  • Venue: Sector-11, Jankipuram Vistaar, AKTU Campus, Lucknow

Students are advised to report on time with all required documents.

How to Apply for AKTU Jaro Education Placement Drive 2026

Students must complete both registrations:

Step 1: Company Registration

👉 https://tinyurl.com/Zaroeducation2026

Step 2: AKTU ERP Registration (Mandatory)

Register on erp.aktu.ac.in

⚠️ Last Date to Apply: 10 February 2026

Missing any step may result in disqualification.

Preparation Tips for Better Selection

  • Prepare a clear and professional resume
  • Practice communication and GD skills
  • Learn basics of sales and EdTech industry
  • Maintain confident body language in PI
  • Be honest and career-focused in answers

Why You Should Not Miss This Drive

The AKTU Jaro Education Placement Drive 2026 stands out because it offers:

  • Salary up to ₹14.56 LPA
  • No bond or service agreement
  • Open for B.Tech, MBA, MCA students
  • Nationwide job locations
  • Strong career growth in EdTech sector

Final Words

title.rendered: IIT Roorkee SPARK Internship 2026: Eligibility, Application Process, Stipend & Selection

content.rendered:
The IIT Roorkee SPARK Internship 2026 is one of the most prestigious summer research internship programs in India for undergraduate and postgraduate students. Offered by the Indian Institute of Technology Roorkee, this program provides academically strong students with an opportunity to work directly under IIT Roorkee faculty on real-world research problems.

The IIT Roorkee SPARK Internship 2026 is specially designed for students who are inclined toward research, higher studies, or research-driven technical careers. Unlike typical industrial internships, SPARK focuses on research methodology, analytical thinking, and problem-solving skills in core engineering, science, and interdisciplinary domains.

At www.notesgallery.com, we regularly publish verified internship updates, and this article gives you complete and accurate information about the IIT Roorkee SPARK Internship 2026.

About IIT Roorkee SPARK Internship 2026

The IIT Roorkee SPARK Internship 2026 is the official summer research internship program conducted by IIT Roorkee. SPARK stands for Student-Professor Academic Research Kernel, and it acts as the primary channel through which external students participate in faculty-led research during the summer break.

Through the IIT Roorkee SPARK Internship 2026, selected candidates are assigned to a faculty mentor and work on a defined research project. The internship emphasizes academic discipline, structured research output, and deep understanding of research tools and techniques.

This program is ideal for students planning to pursue M.Tech, MS, PhD, or research-oriented roles in the future.

What is the SPARK Internship at IIT Roorkee?

The SPARK Internship is a research-based summer internship conducted in offline mode at the IIT Roorkee campus. Under the IIT Roorkee SPARK Internship 2026, students actively participate in research activities such as:

  • Literature review
  • Experimental or computational work
  • Data analysis and modeling
  • Documentation and reporting

The program is academically rigorous and should not be confused with short-term training or skill-based internships. Selection is based on merit, research alignment, and faculty discretion.

Research Domains Available Under IIT Roorkee SPARK Internship 2026

The IIT Roorkee SPARK Internship 2026 offers projects across a wide range of disciplines. Research areas depend on faculty availability and ongoing funded projects.

Major domains include:

  • Biotechnology and Life Sciences
  • Biomedical Engineering and Bioinformatics
  • Civil Engineering, Water Resources, and Climate Studies
  • Computer Science, Data Science, AI, and Machine Learning
  • Electrical, Electronics, and Communication Engineering
  • Mechanical Engineering and Thermal Sciences
  • Materials Science and Nanotechnology
  • Physics, Chemistry, and Applied Mathematics
  • Environmental Science and Sustainability
  • Earth Sciences, Geology, and Geophysics

Students are encouraged to choose research areas that closely match their academic background and long-term goals.

Eligibility Criteria for IIT Roorkee SPARK Internship 2026

To apply for the IIT Roorkee SPARK Internship 2026, candidates must meet strict academic criteria.

Basic Eligibility:

  • Must be enrolled in a UG or PG program from a recognized Indian institute
  • Must have completed at least two semesters
  • Eligible degrees include B.Tech, B.E, B.Arch, M.Sc, and MA (relevant disciplines)

Applicants must upload academic transcripts, a short resume, and a research statement. A No Objection Certificate (NOC) is usually required at the time of joining.

Internship Duration and Mode

The IIT Roorkee SPARK Internship 2026 follows a fixed summer schedule:

  • Duration: 6 to 8 weeks
  • Mode: Offline (On-campus at IIT Roorkee)
  • Working Type: Full-time research internship

On-campus participation allows interns to access laboratories, libraries, computing facilities, and direct faculty mentorship.

Stipend and Benefits

Students selected under the IIT Roorkee SPARK Internship 2026 receive financial and academic benefits.

Stipend:

  • ₹2,500 per week for institute-funded internships
  • Project-funded internships may have variable stipends

Benefits:

  • Hands-on research experience at IIT Roorkee
  • Guidance from experienced faculty members
  • Access to advanced research infrastructure
  • Official internship completion certificate

How to Apply for IIT Roorkee SPARK Internship 2026

The application process for the IIT Roorkee SPARK Internship 2026 is completely online.

Steps to apply:

  1. Register on the official SPARK portal
  2. Fill in academic and personal details
  3. Upload semester-wise marksheets
  4. Submit a 500-word research statement
  5. Upload a concise 1–2 page resume
  6. Select preferred research areas or faculty (if applicable)

All communication regarding selection is done through the SPARK portal.

Selection Process

The IIT Roorkee SPARK Internship 2026 follows a faculty-driven selection process.

  • No written test or interview
  • Applications are reviewed by faculty members
  • Selection depends on academic performance, research interest, and project alignment
  • Final decisions are taken by individual faculty mentors

Important Dates (Expected)

  • Application opens: Mid-February 2026
  • Application deadline: March 2026
  • Internship period: May to July 2026

Exact dates are announced on the official portal.

Why Follow www.notesgallery.com?

At www.notesgallery.com, we provide free study materials, verified internship updates, job alerts, and university news, helping students stay informed and career-ready with trusted information.

FAQs – IIT Roorkee SPARK Internship 2026

1. Is the IIT Roorkee SPARK Internship 2026 paid?
Yes, selected interns receive a stipend of ₹2,500 per week under institute-funded projects.

2. Who can apply for the IIT Roorkee SPARK Internship 2026?
UG and PG students who have completed at least two semesters and meet the CGPA criteria can apply.

3. Is the IIT Roorkee SPARK Internship 2026 online or offline?
The internship is conducted offline at the IIT Roorkee campus.

4. Is a No Objection Certificate required?
Yes, candidates from institutes other than IIT Roorkee usually need to submit an NOC at joining.

5. How competitive is the IIT Roorkee SPARK Internship 2026?
It is highly competitive due to limited seats, strict CGPA cut-offs, and faculty-based selection.

content.rendered:
The Federal Government 3MTT DeepTech Upskilling Programme is a major opportunity for young Nigerians who want to build strong careers in Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, and advanced digital technologies. This initiative is part of Nigeria’s long-term plan to develop world-class technical talent and prepare citizens for the global digital economy.

If you are interested in AI, machine learning, or data-driven careers, the 3MTT DeepTech Ready Upskilling Programme offers free training, certification, and real-world experience—without IELTS and with full sponsorship.

In this article, you’ll find complete details about the programme, eligibility, benefits, available courses, and a step-by-step guide on how to apply.

About the 3MTT DeepTech Upskilling Programme

The 3MTT DeepTech Ready Upskilling Programme is a technology training initiative launched by the Federal Government of Nigeria to empower Nigerians with in-demand digital and deep-tech skills.

The programme focuses on advanced learning paths in data and artificial intelligence, helping participants move beyond beginner knowledge to industry-ready expertise. It is designed for individuals who already have some background in tech and are ready to upgrade their skills to a professional level.

This initiative aligns with the national digital transformation strategy and supports Nigeria’s ambition to become a global exporter of technical talent.

Vision Behind the 3MTT Programme

The 3 Million Technical Talent (3MTT) programme is driven by the vision of President Bola Ahmed Tinubu, which aims to create 2 million digital jobs and strengthen Nigeria’s technology ecosystem.

The programme operates under the Federal Ministry of Communications, Innovation & Digital Economy and is a key part of the Renewed Hope Agenda, focusing on employment, innovation, and economic growth.

The first phase of the initiative is being implemented in collaboration with National Information Technology Development Agency (NITDA), alongside training providers, industry partners, and job placement organizations.

  • Be fully available for the entire programme duration
  • Possess intermediate knowledge in relevant technical or digital fields
  • Be committed to completing learning activities and projects

This programme is ideal for students, graduates, early-career professionals, and tech enthusiasts who want to move into advanced roles in data and AI.

Benefits of the 3MTT DeepTech Upskilling Programme

  • 6-month intensive training per cohort
  • Self-paced learning combined with on-site and mentor support
  • Hands-on real-world projects to build a strong professional portfolio

  • Opportunities for internships and placement support

By the end of the programme, participants will be well-prepared for high-value roles in Nigeria and internationally.

Available Courses Under the 3MTT DeepTech Programme

The programme offers specialized deep-tech tracks, including:

  • Advanced Data Analysis and Visualization
  • Data Science & Machine Learning
  • Data Architecture
  • Geospatial Data Science
  • Computer Vision
  • Natural Language Processing (NLP)

The 3MTT DeepTech Ready Upskilling Programme is more than just a training opportunity—it is a career-defining platform. With global demand for AI and data professionals rising rapidly, this programme gives Nigerians a competitive edge in the digital job market.

If you are serious about building a future in Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, or advanced technology, this is an opportunity you should not miss.

Final Thoughts

The Federal Government 3MTT DeepTech Upskilling Programme represents a major investment in Nigeria’s digital future. With free access to high-quality training, certifications, and industry exposure, participants gain the skills needed to succeed in today’s tech-driven world.

title.rendered: AKTU Odd Semester Examination 2025–26 Official Notice: Exam Dates, Admit Card, Verification Process & Student Guidelines

content.rendered:
Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University (AKTU), Lucknow has released an important official notification regarding the conduct of the Odd Semester examinations for the academic session 2025–26. This notice is applicable to students studying in AKTU-affiliated institutions across Uttar Pradesh and includes essential information related to examination dates, admit card issuance, verification procedures, and institutional responsibilities.

AKTU Odd Semester Examination 2025–26

About the Issuing Authority

The notice has been issued by Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University, Uttar Pradesh, through the office of the Controller of Examination. AKTU is a state technical university responsible for conducting examinations for engineering, pharmacy, management, and other professional courses.

Any notification issued by AKTU is mandatory for all affiliated colleges and enrolled students, making it extremely important to understand and follow the instructions carefully.

Academic Session and Student Coverage

The notification clearly states that it is applicable for the academic session 2025–26 and covers students appearing in Odd Semester examinations. This includes:

  • First-year students enrolled in various programs
  • Students of higher semesters falling under odd semester pattern
  • Students appearing in supplementary (carry over) examinations

The university has clarified that both regular and supplementary candidates must follow the same examination rules and procedures.

Examination Schedule and Mode

As per the official notice, the AKTU Odd Semester Examination 2025–26 will be conducted in offline mode at designated examination centers.

Official Exam Dates

Students must appear for the examinations strictly as per the schedule and center allotted by the university.

Admit Card Release Information

The admit card is a mandatory document for appearing in the examination. According to the notice related to AKTU Odd Semester Examination 2025–26, the admit cards will be released online before the commencement of exams.

Important Points Regarding Admit Card

  • All details on the admit card must be checked carefully

Students are advised not to delay downloading the admit card to avoid technical or administrative issues.

Mandatory Admit Card Verification Process

A major highlight of the notice is the admit card verification requirement. AKTU has clearly instructed that admit cards must be verified at the institutional level.

What Verification Means

Verification ensures that:

  • Student eligibility is confirmed
  • Enrollment and examination details are correct
  • The student is officially authorized to appear in the exam

Colleges are responsible for verifying student records and ensuring that verified admit cards are provided to students on time.

Failure to complete verification may lead to problems during exam entry.

Responsibilities of Affiliated Institutions

AKTU has placed significant responsibility on affiliated colleges for the smooth conduct of the AKTU Odd Semester Examination 2025–26.

Duties Assigned to Colleges

  • Verify student eligibility and academic records
  • Ensure accurate data submission to the university
  • Facilitate admit card verification
  • Coordinate with AKTU examination authorities
  • Prevent eligible students from facing unnecessary issues

Institutions must act responsibly to ensure that students are not deprived of appearing in examinations due to administrative delays.

Instructions for Supplementary Examination Students

The notice also applies to students appearing in supplementary (carry over) examinations. AKTU has clarified that:

  • Supplementary candidates are fully eligible
  • Same exam dates and rules apply
  • Admit card download and verification are compulsory
  • No separate notification will be issued

Students with backlog subjects should remain in constant contact with their respective colleges for updates and confirmation.

Why This Notification Is Important for Students

The notice related to AKTU Odd Semester Examination 2025–26 is extremely important because it directly impacts a student’s academic progress. Ignoring any instruction mentioned can result in:

  • Denial of entry into the examination hall
  • Last-minute confusion and stress
  • Administrative complications
  • Possible loss of an academic opportunity

Students are strongly advised to take this notification seriously and complete all formalities on time.

Step-by-Step Checklist for Students

To avoid problems, students should follow this simple checklist:

  1. Regularly check official AKTU notifications
  2. Download the admit card as soon as it is released
  3. Verify personal and academic details
  4. Get the admit card verified by the institution
  5. Keep multiple printed copies
  6. Carry a valid photo ID on exam day
  7. Reach the examination center well before reporting time

Proper preparation and awareness can help students focus fully on their exams.

Examination Discipline and Conduct

AKTU examinations are conducted under strict guidelines. Students must:

  • Follow instructions given by exam invigilators
  • Avoid unfair means
  • Carry only permitted materials
  • Maintain discipline inside the exam hall

Violation of examination rules may lead to strict disciplinary action, including cancellation of the exam or result.

title.rendered: ISRO 21 Days Internship 2026: Summer ISRO Internship for College Students at IISU

content.rendered:
The ISRO 21 Days Internship 2026 is one of the most prestigious summer opportunities for Indian college students who dream of working in the space and research ecosystem. Conducted under the guidance of the Indian Space Research Organisation, this internship allows students to gain hands-on exposure at various ISRO centers, including the ISRO Inertial Systems Unit (IISU).

The Summer ISRO Internship 2026 is especially popular because it aligns perfectly with college vacations (May–July) and offers a minimum duration of 21 days, extendable up to 45 days. While there is no stipend, the learning, certification, and brand value of ISRO make it highly valuable for students planning careers in engineering, science, research, or higher studies.

This article is a 100% non-copied, SEO-optimized, and student-friendly guide covering eligibility, application process, key dates, benefits, and FAQs related to the ISRO Internship 2026.

ISRO Internship 2026 Overview

The ISRO Internship 2026 is designed to introduce young minds to real-world applications of space science and technology. Selected students are placed in unclassified areas of ISRO centers where they work under experienced scientists and engineers.

At IISU, interns are usually exposed to:

  • Inertial navigation systems
  • Sensors and control systems
  • Applied electronics and mechanical systems
  • Data analysis and simulation tasks

The ISRO 21 Days Internship is ideal for students who want practical exposure beyond textbooks and classroom learning.

Who Can Apply for ISRO Internship 2026? (Eligibility Criteria)

To apply for the Summer ISRO Internship 2026, candidates must meet the following eligibility conditions:

Basic Eligibility

  • Applicant must be an Indian citizen
  • Must be a regular, full-time, on-campus student

Educational Qualifications

Students pursuing or enrolled in the following programs are eligible:

  • BE / BTech
  • ME / MTech
  • BSc (Physics / Chemistry)
  • MSc / Integrated MSc
  • BS–MS (Physics / Chemistry)
  • PhD (Science & Technology streams)

The course should be from a recognized university or institution in India or abroad.

Academic Requirement

  • Minimum 60% marks or equivalent CGPA (some centers may prefer higher merit)

Important Rules

  • A student is allowed only one internship per degree
  • Internship is permitted only in unclassified areas
  • Selection depends on facility availability and project relevance

Due to a large number of applications, not all eligible students are selected, so it’s advised to apply early and keep backup options.

ISRO Internship 2026 Duration & Internship Blocks

The duration of the ISRO 21 Days Internship 2026 is:

  • Minimum: 21 days
  • Maximum: 45 days

Internship Time Slots

👉 For most students, the Summer ISRO Internship 2026 is the preferred option.

ISRO Internship 2026 Stipend Details

One of the most commonly asked questions is about stipend.

Important:
❌ No stipend, remuneration, or financial assistance is provided by IISU / ISRO.

The internship is purely learning- and experience-oriented, and students receive:

  • Official ISRO Internship Completion Certificate
  • Exposure to India’s top space research environment

How to Apply for ISRO Internship 2026 (Step-by-Step)

The ISRO Internship 2026 application process is simple but requires attention to detail.

Step 1: Download the Application Form

  • Visit official ISRO center websites such as IISU or related ISRO portals
  • Download the prescribed internship application format

Step 2: Prepare Required Documents

  • Detailed biodata / resume
  • Academic mark sheets
  • Bonafide certificate
  • No Objection Certificate (NOC)
  • Area of interest and skills
  • Previous projects or internships (if any)

Step 3: Get College Approval

  • Application must be duly signed and stamped by the Principal / HOD

Step 4: Submit the Application

You can submit the application:

  • By post to the concerned ISRO center
  • Or via scanned copy by email (as mentioned in the notification)

Incomplete or late applications are rejected without consideration.

Selection Process for ISRO Internship 2026

The selection process is merit-based and project-oriented.

Key selection factors include:

  • Academic performance
  • Relevance of your course to ISRO projects
  • Availability of guides and facilities
  • Quality of application and biodata

The final decision is communicated to the college HOD / Principal, not directly to the student.

Benefits of ISRO 21 Days Internship 2026

Even without a stipend, the ISRO Internship 2026 offers massive long-term value:

  • Real-world exposure to space research
  • Mentorship from ISRO scientists
  • Strong resume and academic profile boost
  • Certificate from India’s top research organization
  • Helpful for GATE, higher studies, PhD, and research careers

Many former interns report better chances in research programs and top universities after completing an ISRO internship.

Mentioning Airbus Internship 2026 (Alternative Option)

Students interested in aerospace and space technology can also explore the Airbus Internship 2026 as a complementary opportunity.

The Airbus Internship 2026:

  • Offers paid internships
  • Focuses on aviation, satellites, and GenAI-based engineering
  • Provides global exposure and industry experience

Applying for both ISRO Internship 2026 and Airbus Internship 2026 can significantly broaden your learning and career scope.

Selection Tips for ISRO Internship 2026

To improve your chances of selection:

  • Apply well before the ISRO internship 2026 last date
  • Highlight skills like Python, MATLAB, data analysis, GIS, electronics
  • Align your interests with ISRO’s ongoing projects
  • Keep your application clear, concise, and error-free
  • Get strong academic recommendations from faculty

Seats are limited, so early and focused applications matter.

title.rendered: AKTU Practical & Project Exam Notice 2026: Hard Copy Submission Deadline, Guidelines and Complete Details

content.rendered:
Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University (AKTU), Lucknow has released an important examination-related notice for the academic session 2025–26. This update is extremely important for all affiliated colleges and students who appeared in odd semester practical and project examinations.

As per the official circular issued on 06 February 2026, AKTU has instructed colleges to submit hard copies of practical and project exam marks that have already been uploaded online. This step is mandatory for final verification and smooth processing of student results.

Background of the AKTU Practical and Project Examinations 2025–26

During the odd semester of the academic session 2025–26, AKTU successfully conducted practical and project examinations for various undergraduate and postgraduate courses. These exams were held as per the academic calendar and university guidelines.

After completion of the examinations, colleges were instructed to upload marks online through the official examination or ERP portal. To ensure accuracy, the university also provided a one-week correction window during which colleges could review and correct any mistakes in uploaded marks.

After this correction period, the uploaded marks were considered final, and now AKTU has moved to the next step of physical verification through hard copy submission.

Official Details of the AKTU Notice

The notice has been issued by Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University, Lucknow, through the Controller of Examination. The circular clearly states that this instruction applies to all affiliated institutions without exception.

Important details from the notice include:
Issue Date: 06 February 2026
Academic Session: 2025–26
Semester: Odd Semester
Exam Type: Practical and Project Examinations

This confirms that the notice is official, compulsory and applicable to all relevant courses and colleges.

Last Date for Hard Copy Submission

One of the most critical points mentioned in the notice is the deadline.

The last date to submit hard copies of practical and project exam marks is 15 February 2026.

Colleges must submit these documents to the AKTU Examination Office, Lucknow. Submissions after the deadline may not be accepted, which could lead to delays in result processing.

Documents Required for Submission

AKTU has clearly mentioned what colleges need to submit.

Colleges are required to submit hard copies of all practical and project marks that were uploaded online. These hard copies must be properly arranged subject-wise and semester-wise.

The documents must be spiral bound and must carry signatures of the concerned examiner, Head of Department and authorized institutional authority. The data in the hard copy must exactly match the marks uploaded on the online portal.

Any mismatch between online and offline records can cause serious issues, including rejection of records or delay in result declaration.

Courses and Students Covered Under This Notice

This notice applies to all undergraduate and postgraduate programs conducted by AKTU where practical or project examinations were held in the odd semester 2025–26.

Courses covered include B.Tech, M.Tech, MBA, MCA, B.Pharm, M.Pharm and other technical or professional programs affiliated with AKTU.

If a student’s course includes a practical or project component, this notice is relevant and important for them.

Why AKTU Requires Hard Copy Submission

Many students may wonder why hard copies are required when marks are already uploaded online. AKTU follows a strict verification process to ensure accuracy and transparency.

Hard copies help in cross-verifying online data, prevent clerical or technical errors and serve as official academic records. They are also required for audit purposes and future reference.

This dual system of online submission and physical verification helps maintain the credibility of the examination system and protects student records.

One-Week Correction Window Explained

After online mark submission, AKTU provided a one-week correction period. During this time, colleges were allowed to review the uploaded marks and make corrections if any errors were found.

Once this correction window closed, the data was locked. The hard copy submission now acts as the final confirmation of marks and performance of students.

Instructions for College Authorities

AKTU has directed principals, directors, examination controllers and department heads to ensure full compliance with the notice.

College authorities must verify the accuracy of marks, ensure proper binding and signatures, and submit the documents within the deadline. Any negligence may invite administrative action or rejection of records by the university.

What Students Should Do Now

Although the notice is officially addressed to colleges, students should also stay alert and proactive.

Students are advised to contact their college examination department and confirm that their practical or project marks have been uploaded correctly. Keeping copies of internal assessment records is also recommended.

Students should regularly monitor official AKTU updates and immediately report any discrepancies to their college authorities before the deadline.

Impact on Results and Academic Records

Failure to submit hard copies on time can directly impact result processing. Delays in submission may lead to delayed results, missing marks or verification problems.

Such issues can later affect degree issuance, migration certificates, transcripts and even future admissions. Therefore, this step is crucial for both colleges and students.

Key Points Summary

  • The notice applies to practical and project exams of odd semester 2025–26.
  • Hard copies of online uploaded marks must be submitted.
  • The last date for submission is 15 February 2026.
  • Documents must be properly bound and signed.
  • Timely submission ensures smooth and error-free result declaration.

Final Conclusion

The AKTU Practical and Project Exam Notice 2026 is a crucial administrative step to ensure transparency, accuracy and reliability in examination records. While colleges are responsible for official submission, students should remain informed and involved.

Proper coordination between colleges and the university will help ensure timely result declaration and hassle-free academic progress for students.

title.rendered: AKTU Internal Marks Upload 2025–26: First & Second Semester Sessional Marks Dates, Guidelines & Official Update

content.rendered:
Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University (AKTU), Lucknow has released a crucial academic notification related to the AKTU Internal Marks Upload 2025–26 process for affiliated colleges. This update is especially important for first-year students enrolled in various technical and professional programs for the academic session 2025–26.

As per the official circular issued by Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University, institutions must upload Theory Sessional and Practical Sessional marks for eligible students through the university’s ERP portal within the prescribed timeline.

Overview of AKTU Internal Marks Upload 2025–26

The AKTU Internal Marks Upload 2025–26 notification was released on 06 February 2026 by the Examination Controller’s office. It clearly outlines the schedule and responsibilities for uploading internal assessment marks of students appearing in the odd semester examinations.

This notice applies to first year first semester (Regular & Carry Over), first year second semester (Carry Over), theory subjects, and practical or lab subjects. AKTU has emphasized that the uploading process must be completed strictly within the given dates to avoid academic complications.

AKTU Internal Marks Upload 2025–26 Important Dates

According to the official circular, the schedule for internal marks submission is as follows:

  • Online Upload Start Date: 07 February 2026
  • Online Upload Last Date: 15 February 2026
  • Hard Copy Submission Deadline: 20 February 2026

Colleges are advised not to wait for any extension, as the AKTU Internal Marks Upload 2025–26 timeline is fixed and mandatory.

What Are Internal (Sessional) Marks in AKTU?

Internal marks, also known as sessional marks, are awarded by colleges based on continuous evaluation throughout the semester. These marks include performance in class tests, assignments, attendance, laboratory work, viva-voce, and internal practical exams.

During the AKTU Internal Marks Upload 2025–26, both theory and practical sessional marks must be uploaded accurately, as they are directly added to the end-semester examination marks to prepare the final result.

Subjects and Students Covered Under This Update

The AKTU Internal Marks Upload 2025–26 covers marks of regular first-semester students, carry-over students of first semester, carry-over students of second semester, theory sessional components, and practical or lab sessional components.

Marks for each student must be uploaded subject-wise as per the university’s guidelines.

Step-by-Step Process for AKTU Internal Marks Upload 2025–26

For colleges and faculty members, the internal marks uploading process generally involves logging in to the AKTU ERP portal using authorized credentials, selecting the academic session 2025–26, choosing the correct semester and subject, entering student-wise internal marks carefully, verifying all entries before final submission, locking and submitting marks online, taking a printout of the uploaded data, getting the document signed by authorized officials, and submitting the hard copy to AKTU before 20 February 2026.

Once locked, corrections may not be allowed, making accuracy during the AKTU Internal Marks Upload 2025–26 extremely important.

Important Instructions Issued by AKTU

AKTU has issued strict instructions to all affiliated institutions regarding the AKTU Internal Marks Upload 2025–26 process. All marks must be uploaded only through the ERP portal, and offline submissions will not be accepted. Any discrepancy or error in marks will be the sole responsibility of the institution. After online uploading, signed hard copies must be submitted to the examination office by the given deadline. Late submission may result in result delays or missing internal marks for students.

Why AKTU Internal Marks Upload 2025–26 Is Important for Students

Internal marks play a vital role in a student’s academic performance. During the AKTU Internal Marks Upload 2025–26, even a small error can affect semester results, SGPA and CGPA, clearance of carry-over subjects, and overall academic progression.

Incorrect or delayed uploading may lead to withheld results or incomplete mark sheets, causing unnecessary stress for students.

What Should AKTU Students Do?

Students are advised to stay proactive during the AKTU Internal Marks Upload 2025–26 period by staying in contact with subject teachers, confirming that internal marks have been uploaded, reporting discrepancies immediately to the college, and regularly checking official AKTU updates.

Being alert can help students avoid result-related issues later.

What Happens After Internal Marks Submission?

Once the AKTU Internal Marks Upload 2025–26 process is completed, AKTU will compile internal and external examination marks, semester results will be prepared, results will be published on the official portal, and mark sheets will be generated accordingly.

Timely submission ensures smooth and transparent result declaration.

Official Source and Authenticity

This article is written strictly on the basis of the official AKTU circular dated 06 February 2026, issued by the Examination Controller. Readers are advised to refer to the original notice for complete authenticity and record purposes

Final Conclusion

The AKTU Internal Marks Upload 2025–26 notification is a critical update for colleges and students alike. Institutions must strictly follow the given timeline, and students should remain vigilant to ensure their internal marks are uploaded correctly.

Proper compliance will help avoid result delays and ensure a smooth academic process for the academic session 2025–26.

title.rendered: Why Indian AI Startup Founders Are Moving to the US for Funding and Users: A Wake-Up Call for India

content.rendered:
The global artificial intelligence race is accelerating, but a worrying trend has emerged in India’s startup ecosystem. Indian AI startup founders moving to the US has become a noticeable pattern, with over 100 founders reportedly relocating or preparing to relocate in search of better funding, customers, and growth opportunities.

This development has sparked conversations across policy circles, investor networks, and the startup community. Is India losing its AI edge, or are founders simply following global business realities?

What’s Driving This Shift to the US?

For many entrepreneurs, the decision is less emotional and more strategic. The rise in Indian AI startup founders moving to the US is being driven by several practical factors that directly impact startup survival and scale.

Easier Access to Large AI Funding

AI startups are capital-intensive. From GPUs to cloud infrastructure and research teams, costs rise quickly. In the US, venture capital firms are more open to:

  • Backing deep-tech AI models
  • Writing larger cheques
  • Supporting long-term experimentation

This funding environment plays a major role in why Indian AI startup founders moving to the US see better growth prospects there.

Closer to Paying Customers

Most AI startups operate in B2B, SaaS, or enterprise segments. Large customers for these products are primarily based in North America. Being physically present helps founders:

  • Build trust with enterprise clients
  • Close deals faster
  • Iterate products based on real-time feedback

This customer proximity is another major reason behind Indian AI startup founders moving to the US.

Strong AI Talent Ecosystem

The US offers a dense network of AI researchers, experienced engineers, and repeat founders. Collaboration becomes easier, and hiring for niche AI roles is faster—something that significantly speeds up innovation.

Is This a Brain Drain for India?

The concern is valid, but the situation is complex. While headlines highlight Indian AI startup founders moving to the US, many of these startups still keep:

  • Engineering teams in India
  • R&D operations in Indian tech hubs
  • Indian founders actively involved in domestic innovation

Experts describe this as a “brain split” rather than a complete brain drain. However, the risk increases when core intellectual property and global headquarters shift permanently overseas.

Why India Should Be Concerned

If this trend continues, India could face:

  • Loss of ownership over cutting-edge AI products
  • Reduced influence in global AI standards
  • Dependence on foreign AI platforms
  • A future where India exports talent but not technology

The long-term impact of Indian AI startup founders moving to the US could reshape India’s role in the global AI economy.

What Needs to Change in India’s AI Ecosystem?

To retain top AI founders, India must address structural gaps rather than blaming entrepreneurs.

Expand Deep-Tech Funding

India needs more late-stage funds focused specifically on AI and deep technology, not just early-stage startups.

Government as an AI Customer

Instead of only regulating, the government can adopt AI solutions through pilots, public procurement, and large-scale deployments.

Clear and Stable AI Policies

Founders need regulatory clarity around data, AI ethics, and compliance to confidently build from India.

Affordable Compute and Infrastructure

Access to GPUs, cloud credits, and research infrastructure is critical to reduce the cost of innovation.

The Bigger Picture

The rise of Indian AI startup founders moving to the US is not a rejection of India—it is a response to where opportunity currently exists. Founders go where capital, customers, and speed align.

If India wants to lead the AI revolution, it must create an ecosystem where building globally competitive AI companies from Indian soil is not just possible, but preferable.

The future of Indian AI depends not only on talent, but on vision, execution, and ecosystem readiness.

title.rendered: Data Analyst Job at Unstop, South Delhi: Freshers & Experienced Professionals Can Apply

content.rendered:
Unstop, one of India’s fastest-growing career and talent platforms, has announced an exciting Data Analyst job opportunity in South Delhi. This role is open to freshers as well as experienced professionals (0–3 years) who are passionate about data, analytics, and business insights. If you enjoy working with numbers, dashboards, user behavior, and real-world datasets, this opportunity at Unstop can be a strong career move.

With data-driven decision-making at the heart of Unstop’s operations, the Data Analyst role offers hands-on exposure to analytics, stakeholder collaboration, and leadership-level reporting in a dynamic startup environment.

About Unstop

Unstop is a leading platform that connects students and early professionals with opportunities to learn, grow, compete, and get hired by top organizations. From hackathons and competitions to hiring challenges and upskilling programs, Unstop handles massive volumes of user and employer data every day. This makes analytics a core function within the company.

By joining Unstop as a Data Analyst, you become part of a team that directly influences platform performance, hiring strategies, campaign outcomes, and user experience through meaningful data insights.

Role Overview: Data Analyst at Unstop

As a Data Analyst, you will work closely with cross-functional teams to analyze platform data, user behavior, hiring trends, and campaign performance. Your insights will help improve decision-making across departments, making this role both impactful and intellectually rewarding.

This position is ideal for candidates who enjoy working with structured and unstructured data, building dashboards, identifying trends, and translating numbers into clear business stories.

Key Responsibilities

The Data Analyst at Unstop will be responsible for a wide range of analytics tasks, including:

  • Collecting, cleaning, and analyzing large datasets from internal tools and platforms
  • Building dashboards and reports using Excel, Google Sheets, and visualization tools like Metabase
  • Identifying trends, patterns, and anomalies to support business and hiring decisions
  • Working closely with stakeholders across marketing, hiring, product, and leadership teams
  • Monitoring key performance indicators (KPIs) and preparing regular performance reports
  • Supporting special initiatives such as hiring campaigns, hackathons, and growth experiments
  • Conducting competitor benchmarking and contributing to market intelligence analysis

This role offers exposure to both operational analytics and strategic decision-making.

Required Skills and Qualifications

To be successful in this Data Analyst job at Unstop, candidates should have:

  • Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills
  • Proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets, including pivot tables and lookup functions
  • Basic knowledge of SQL (preferred but not mandatory)
  • Familiarity with BI tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or Looker Studio (a plus)
  • High attention to detail and strong time-management abilities
  • Clear communication skills to explain data insights to non-technical stakeholders
  • Prior experience in analytics or data-related roles is an advantage but not mandatory

Freshers with strong fundamentals and practical exposure are encouraged to apply.

Recruitment Process at Unstop

The hiring process at Unstop is designed to assess both analytical ability and real-world problem-solving skills. The selection stages include:

MindStorm – Analytics Screening

A quick-fire analytics round to test your fundamentals, logic, and problem-solving approach.

AI Interview

An AI-driven interview round focusing on your analytical thinking and responses.

Interview Round 1

A discussion-based round that evaluates your mindset, approach to analytics, and problem-solving methods.

Interview Round 2

A hands-on data round where you work with real datasets to uncover insights and present your analysis.

Exploratory Call

A final interaction to understand your background, career goals, and expectations while explaining the role in detail.

What You Will Gain

Working as a Data Analyst at Unstop comes with several professional advantages:

  • Hands-on experience in a fast-growing, data-driven startup
  • Exposure to real-world business challenges and large-scale datasets
  • Opportunities to collaborate directly with leadership and cross-functional teams
  • Strong learning curve in analytics, reporting, and business intelligence
  • A valuable role that strengthens your long-term data and analytics career

Job Location and Experience

  • Location: South Delhi
  • Experience Required: 0–3 years
  • Openings: 1

Both fresh graduates and early-career professionals are eligible for this role.

How to Apply

Candidates interested in the Data Analyst job at Unstop can apply directly through the Unstop platform. If you are enthusiastic about using data to drive meaningful business decisions and want to work in a growth-oriented environment, this opportunity is worth applying for.

For queries related to the role, you can contact Unstop at:
Email: careers@unstop.com

Final Note

Unstop continues to build a strong analytics culture, making this Data Analyst position a valuable opportunity for candidates who want to sharpen their data skills while working on impactful projects. If analytics excites you and you enjoy solving real business problems with data, this role could be the right step forward in your career.

FAQs – Data Analyst Job at Unstop

1. Who is eligible to apply for the Data Analyst position at Unstop?
Both freshers and experienced professionals with 0–3 years of experience can apply. Candidates should have strong analytical skills and basic knowledge of Excel/Google Sheets. Prior analytics experience is a plus but not mandatory.

2. What is the job location for the Data Analyst role?
The position is based in South Delhi. Candidates should be open to working from the specified location as per company requirements.

3. What skills are most important for this role?
Key skills include data analysis, Excel/Google Sheets proficiency, attention to detail, problem-solving, and the ability to communicate insights clearly. Knowledge of SQL and BI tools like Power BI or Tableau is preferred.

4. What does the recruitment process look like?
The hiring process includes multiple stages such as an analytics screening round (MindStorm), an AI interview, two interview rounds focusing on analytical thinking and real data, and a final exploratory call.

5. What kind of growth can a Data Analyst expect at Unstop?
Data Analysts at Unstop gain hands-on experience with real-world datasets, exposure to leadership, and opportunities to work on high-impact projects, making it a strong role for long-term career growth in analytics.

title.rendered: IIT Madras Internship 2026: ₹15,000 Monthly Stipend, Eligibility, Dates & Application Process

content.rendered:
The IIT Madras Internship 2026 has emerged as one of the most awaited summer research opportunities for students across India. Conducted under the well-known Summer Fellowship Programme (SFP), this internship allows talented and motivated students to experience academic and research life at one of the country’s most respected institutes. Along with valuable research exposure, selected candidates will receive a monthly stipend of ₹15,000, making it both an intellectually and financially rewarding experience.

Organised by Indian Institute of Technology Madras, the programme is specially designed for students who are not currently studying in any IIT. It welcomes applicants from engineering, science, humanities, and management backgrounds who demonstrate strong academic performance and research potential.

This article provides a fully original, non-copyrighted, and student-friendly explanation of the IIT Madras Internship 2026, covering eligibility, stipend, important dates, departments, required documents, and the complete application process.

Overview of IIT Madras Internship 2026

The IIT Madras Summer Fellowship Programme 2026 is a structured research internship aimed at identifying and nurturing future researchers, academicians, and innovators. During the programme, students work closely with IIT Madras faculty members on focused research problems, gaining exposure to real-world academic research and advanced laboratory environments.

Unlike regular internships that focus mainly on industry tasks, this fellowship is research-oriented. It is ideal for students planning to pursue M.Tech, MS, PhD, MBA, or research careers in India or abroad.

Selected students will stay on campus, interact with peers from across the country, and experience the academic culture of IIT Madras.

The IIT Madras Internship 2026 is known for its competitive selection process and high academic standards.

Undergraduate Students

Accommodation and Campus Facilities

Living on campus offers students a chance to fully experience IIT Madras’s academic environment and interact with fellow interns and researchers.

Departments Offering Internships at IIT Madras

The IIT Madras Internship 2026 covers a wide range of disciplines, making it suitable for students from diverse academic backgrounds.

Engineering Departments

  • Applied Mechanics & Biomedical Engineering
  • Biotechnology
  • Chemical Engineering
  • Civil Engineering
  • Computer Science & Engineering
  • Data Science and Artificial Intelligence
  • Electrical Engineering
  • Mechanical Engineering
  • Engineering Design
  • Metallurgical & Materials Engineering
  • Medical Science and Technology
  • Ocean Engineering

Science Departments

  • Chemistry
  • Mathematics

Other Fields

  • Management Studies

Each department offers research topics aligned with current academic and industry challenges.

Stipend Details and Internship Benefits

Students selected for the IIT Madras Paid Internship 2026 will receive:

  • Total support for the full two-month duration

  • Research mentorship from top faculty

Many past interns have used this experience to strengthen applications for higher education and research programmes.

title.rendered: TCS MBA Hiring 2026: Official Mass Hiring Opportunity for Management Postgraduates

content.rendered:
Tata Consultancy Services (TCS) has officially announced TCS MBA Hiring 2026, a prestigious mass hiring initiative aimed at Management Postgraduates from the Batch of 2026. This recruitment drive is designed to attract future-ready business professionals who aspire to build a meaningful management career while contributing to large-scale business and technology transformation.

With registrations currently open and the last date to apply being 11 February 2026, eligible candidates should not miss this opportunity to join one of India’s most respected global organizations.

Be the Pioneer of Business with Purpose

TCS invites management graduates to become pioneers of purpose-driven business leadership. Through TCS MBA Hiring 2026, selected candidates will work with cutting-edge business teams in IT services, contributing to innovation, strategy, and enterprise transformation across global clients.

This hiring program is ideal for candidates who want to combine management expertise with technology-driven solutions in a structured and growth-oriented environment.

TCS MBA Hiring 2026 – Key Dates & Highlights

  • Hiring Program: TCS MBA Hiring – Batch of 2026
  • Registration Status: Open
  • Last Date to Register: 11 February 2026 (Wednesday)
  • Test Date: 12 March 2026 (Thursday)
  • Test Mode: In-Centre (Offline)
  • Test Partner: TCS iON
  • Batch Eligible: 2026

Eligible Courses & Specializations

Candidates must be pursuing a 2-year full-time MBA/MMS/PGDBA/PGDM program from a recognized university or college and belong to the Batch of 2026.

Eligible specializations include:

  • Marketing
  • Finance
  • Operations
  • Supply Chain Management
  • Information Technology
  • General Management
  • Business Analytics
  • Project Management
  • Related Management Disciplines

Note: Part-time or correspondence courses are not considered eligible.

Detailed Eligibility Criteria

Academic Requirements

Candidates must have a minimum of 60% aggregate or equivalent CGPA across:

  • Class 10
  • Class 12
  • Diploma (if applicable)
  • Graduation
  • Post-Graduation

Graduation Background

  • Any graduate degree from a recognized university or college is eligible.

Backlogs / Arrears

  • Candidates with up to one backlog may apply.
  • All backlogs must be cleared before joining TCS if selected.

Education Gap

  • Gaps must be declared.
  • Total academic gap should not exceed 24 months.
  • Supporting documents will be verified.

Course Type

  • Only full-time education is allowed.

Work Experience

  • Candidates with 0–2 years of experience are eligible.
  • All experience must be declared in the application form.

Age Criteria

  • Minimum Age: 18 years
  • Maximum Age: 28 years

Application Process for TCS MBA Hiring 2026

Follow these steps carefully to complete your application:

Step 1: Login to TCS NextStep Portal

  • Visit the official TCS NextStep Portal
  • Select category as “IT”

Step 2: Register & Apply

  • Existing users can log in using their CT/DT Reference ID
  • New users must register by choosing the IT category
  • Complete the application form and click “Apply for Drive”

Step 3: Test Centre Selection

  • Choose In-Centre test mode
  • Select your preferred test centre
  • Submit your application

Step 4: Track Application Status

  • Go to Track My Application
  • Status should reflect “Applied for Drive”

Apply now —> click here

Important Instructions from TCS

  • This is a mandatory In-Centre test
  • Test centre allotment is first-come, first-serve
  • Candidates must carry original academic documents for the interview
  • All test communication will be sent only by TCS iON
  • TCS does not send emails from unofficial domains
  • TCS does not charge any fee at any stage of recruitment
  • No third-party agencies are involved in hiring

Providing incorrect or misleading information may lead to disqualification at any stage.

TCS MBA Hiring 2026 – Test Pattern

The assessment will be conducted by TCS iON.

  • Total Duration: 90 minutes
  • Sections:
    • Verbal Ability
    • Numerical Ability
    • Business Aptitude

The test evaluates analytical thinking, business understanding, and problem-solving skills.

Why Choose TCS MBA Hiring 2026

  • Opportunity to work with a global IT & consulting leader
  • Exposure to enterprise-level business operations
  • Structured career growth and leadership development
  • Strong learning ecosystem and long-term stability
  • Purpose-driven work culture with global impact

Helpdesk & Official Support

For any assistance related to TCS MBA Hiring 2026, candidates can contact:

  • Email: ilp.support@tcs.com
  • Toll-Free Helpline: 18002093111

Final Note

The TCS MBA Hiring 2026 drive is a golden opportunity for management postgraduates who want to begin their professional journey with a trusted and globally respected organization. Eligible candidates are advised to complete their registration well before the deadline.

Last Date to Apply: 11 February 2026
Test Date: 12 March 2026

Apply early, prepare smartly, and take the first step toward a purpose-driven management career with TCS.

FAQs

1. What is TCS MBA Hiring 2026?

TCS MBA Hiring 2026 is an official recruitment initiative by Tata Consultancy Services for management postgraduates from the Batch of 2026. It provides an opportunity to join TCS business and IT services teams through an in-centre assessment and interview process.

2. Who is eligible to apply for TCS MBA Hiring 2026?

Candidates pursuing a 2-year full-time MBA/MMS/PGDBA/PGDM program from a recognized university or college, graduating in 2026, are eligible to apply.

3. Which specializations are eligible for this hiring drive?

Eligible specializations include Marketing, Finance, Operations, Supply Chain Management, Information Technology, General Management, Business Analytics, Project Management, and related disciplines.

4. What is the last date to apply for TCS MBA Hiring 2026?

The last date to register is 11 February 2026 (Wednesday).

5. When will the TCS MBA Hiring 2026 test be conducted?

The test is scheduled for 12 March 2026 (Thursday).

6. What is the mode of the TCS MBA Hiring 2026 test?

The test will be conducted in In-Centre (offline) mode at designated TCS iON centres.

7. Under which category should candidates register on TCS NextStep Portal?

Candidates must register under the “IT” category on the TCS NextStep Portal. Applications under the BPS category will not be considered.

8. Is clicking on “Apply for Drive” mandatory?

Yes, clicking “Apply for Drive” after submitting the application form is mandatory. Without this step, the application will not be considered.

9. What is the minimum academic percentage required?

Candidates must have at least 60% aggregate or equivalent CGPA across Class 10, Class 12, Graduation, and Post-Graduation.

10. Are candidates with backlogs eligible?

Candidates with up to one backlog can apply. However, all backlogs must be cleared before joining TCS if selected.

11. Is prior work experience required for TCS MBA Hiring 2026?

Work experience is not mandatory. Candidates with 0–2 years of experience are eligible, but any experience must be declared in the application form.

12. What is the age limit for TCS MBA Hiring 2026?

The minimum age is 18 years and the maximum age is 28 years.

13. What sections are included in the TCS MBA Hiring test?

The assessment includes three sections:

  • Verbal Ability
  • Numerical Ability
  • Business Aptitude

The total test duration is 90 minutes.

14. How will candidates receive test-related communication?

All test-related communication will be sent by TCS iON, the official test partner, through registered email IDs only.

15. Does TCS charge any fee for the hiring process?

No. TCS does not charge any fees at any stage of the recruitment process. Candidates should beware of fake job offers.

16. Can candidates from NIOS apply for TCS MBA Hiring 2026?

Yes, candidates who completed Class 10 or 12 through NIOS are eligible, provided their Graduation and Post-Graduation courses are full-time.

17. How can candidates track their application status?

Candidates can track their status using the “Track My Application” option on the TCS NextStep Portal. The status should show “Applied for Drive”.

18. Who should be contacted for help or technical issues?

For any assistance, candidates can contact the TCS Helpdesk:

  • Email: ilp.support@tcs.com
  • Toll-Free Number: 18002093111

title.rendered: Mobile Application Internship at Codeflare Labs 2026: Eligibility, Stipend, Duration & Full Details

content.rendered:
The demand for skilled mobile application developers is growing rapidly, and internships that offer real-world exposure are becoming the most effective way for students to enter the tech industry. One such opportunity is the Mobile Application Internship by Codeflare Labs, a structured 6-month work-from-home internship designed for undergraduate, postgraduate, and engineering students across India.

This internship focuses on Android application development, modern UI/UX practices, backend integration, and professional development workflows. For students who want hands-on experience with live projects and industry-relevant tools, this internship can be a strong career-building step.

About Codeflare Labs Mobile Application Internship

Codeflare Labs is offering a fully remote Mobile Application Developer Internship where interns will work on real-world Android applications using modern technologies like Java, Kotlin, Firebase, and Jetpack components. The program is structured to help beginners as well as intermediate developers improve their practical skills while working in a professional environment.

The internship duration is 6 months, divided into a probation phase and a paid performance-based phase. Candidates who perform exceptionally well may also receive a full-time job offer after completion.

Eligibility Criteria

The Mobile Application Internship at Codeflare Labs is open to a wide range of candidates, including:

  • Undergraduate students
  • Postgraduate students
  • Engineering students
  • Candidates with a basic understanding of Android development

There is no restriction on specialization as long as the candidate has foundational knowledge of mobile app development concepts and is willing to learn.

Roles and Responsibilities

Interns selected for this program will be actively involved in the mobile app development lifecycle. Key responsibilities include:

  • Designing, developing, and maintaining Android applications using Java and Kotlin
  • Creating responsive and user-friendly interfaces using XML, UI/UX principles, and Material Design
  • Integrating applications with RESTful APIs using Retrofit or Volley
  • Working with Firebase services such as Authentication, Firestore, Realtime Database, and Storage
  • Implementing local data storage using SQLite or Room Database
  • Using Jetpack components like LiveData, ViewModel, Navigation, and WorkManager
  • Writing and executing test cases using JUnit and Espresso
  • Debugging and troubleshooting issues using ADB, Logcat, and Android Studio tools
  • Collaborating with team members using Git and GitHub

These responsibilities ensure interns gain exposure to both frontend and backend aspects of Android app development.

Required Skills

To apply for this internship, candidates should have:

  • Basic knowledge of Java or Kotlin
  • Familiarity with Android SDK and Android Studio
  • Understanding of UI/UX design principles and XML layouts
  • Awareness of APIs, databases, and modern mobile architectures
  • Strong problem-solving and debugging skills
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment
  • A learning mindset and commitment to completing the full internship duration

Internship Structure and Stipend Details

The internship follows a performance-based structure:

  • Total Duration: 6 months
  • First 2 Months: Probation period (unpaid)
  • Performance evaluation during probation
  • Next 4 Months: Paid internship phase
  • Monthly Stipend: ₹1,000 to ₹4,000 (based on performance and contribution)

High-performing interns may receive a full-time employment opportunity with Codeflare Labs. The full-time salary will be disclosed at the time of the offer.

Perks and Benefits

Interns who successfully complete the program will receive multiple career benefits, including:

  • Internship Completion Certificate
  • Letter of Recommendation for top performers
  • Hands-on experience with real-world mobile app projects
  • Work-from-home flexibility
  • Skill enhancement through practical project ownership
  • Pre-Placement or Full-Time Job Offer for high performers

These benefits make the Codeflare Labs Mobile Application Internship a valuable addition to a student’s resume.

Important Dates and Work Details

  • Application Deadline: 17 February 2026
  • Internship Location: Remote (India)
  • Working Days: 5 days per week
  • Internship Type: Work From Home
  • Internship Timing: Full-time
  • Duration: 6 months

Apply now —> click here

Candidates must commit to the complete duration, as early exit may affect certification and future opportunities.

Important Notes for Applicants

  • This is a completely remote internship
  • Completion of the probation period does not guarantee a stipend
  • Performance is evaluated continuously throughout the internship
  • Codeflare Labs does not charge any application or joining fees
  • For official queries, candidates can contact: hr@codeflarelabs.com

Such verified internship opportunities are regularly highlighted on platforms like NotesGallery to help students find genuine career options without falling into paid internship traps.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

1. Is the Codeflare Labs Mobile Application Internship paid?
Yes, the internship is partially paid. The first 2 months are unpaid probation, followed by a paid phase of 4 months with a stipend ranging from ₹1,000 to ₹4,000 per month based on performance.

2. Is this internship work from home?
Yes, this is a fully remote internship and can be done from anywhere in India.

3. Who can apply for this internship?
Undergraduate students, postgraduate students, and engineering students with basic knowledge of Android development are eligible to apply.

4. Will I get a job offer after the internship?
High-performing interns may receive a full-time job offer or pre-placement opportunity, but it is not guaranteed for all candidates.

5. Do I need prior work experience to apply?
No prior work experience is required. However, basic knowledge of Java/Kotlin and Android development concepts is expected.
