title.rendered: AKTU Marksheet 2024-25 Released: Official Notice on Distribution for Passed Students

content.rendered:
Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University (AKTU), Lucknow, has officially issued an important notification regarding the AKTU marksheet 2024-25 for students who successfully passed their examinations in the academic session 2024-25. This announcement brings relief to thousands of students who were waiting for confirmation about the availability and distribution of their marksheets.

According to the official circular dated 04 February 2026, AKTU has completed the printing process of the AKTU marksheet 2024-25 and has dispatched the marksheets to all affiliated colleges through postal services. Students are advised to collect their marksheets directly from their respective institutions.

This article provides complete details about the AKTU marksheet distribution process, official instructions, and what students should do next.

Official Announcement on AKTU Marksheet 2024-25

As per the official notice released by the Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University, the university has printed and sent the AKTU marksheet 2024-25 of all passed students to their colleges.

The notification has been formally sent to all Directors and Principals of AKTU-affiliated institutions, instructing them to ensure timely and smooth distribution of marksheets to students.

This information is based strictly on the official AKTU circular .

Key Highlights of AKTU Marksheet 2024-25 Notice

The official circular regarding the AKTU marksheet 2024-25 includes the following important points:

  • Marksheets for all passed students of session 2024-25 have been printed
  • AKTU marksheets have been sent to colleges via post
  • The notice applies to all AKTU courses and programs
  • Digital academic records are also available
  • Colleges are responsible for distributing marksheets
  • The process follows Government of India and Uttar Pradesh Government guidelines

This confirms that the university has completed its responsibility regarding marksheet preparation.

Who Will Receive AKTU Marksheet 2024-25?

The AKTU marksheet 2024-25 will be issued to:

  • Students who have successfully passed their examinations
  • Students enrolled in AKTU-affiliated institutions
  • Candidates belonging to the academic session 2024-25

Eligible courses include:

  • B.Tech
  • B.Pharm
  • MBA
  • MCA
  • Other undergraduate and postgraduate programs

Only students who have cleared their exams are eligible for the AKTU marksheet 2024-25.

How to Collect AKTU Marksheet 2024-25?

AKTU does not send marksheets directly to students’ homes. The distribution process is handled through colleges.

AKTU Marksheet Distribution Process

  1. AKTU prints the AKTU marksheet 2024-25
  2. Marksheets are dispatched to affiliated colleges
  3. Colleges receive and verify the documents
  4. Colleges notify students about availability
  5. Students collect their AKTU marksheet 2024-25 from the institute

Students should remain in contact with their college examination cell for updates.

Digital Records for AKTU Marksheet 2024-25

The official notice also confirms that digital academic records for the AKTU marksheet 2024-25 have been prepared following approved procedures.

Digital records are useful for:

  • Online job applications
  • Higher education admissions
  • Provisional verification
  • Scholarship applications

These records are legally valid and recognized by government authorities.

Instructions for Colleges Regarding AKTU Marksheet 2024-25

AKTU has instructed all affiliated colleges to:

  • Distribute the AKTU marksheet 2024-25 without delay
  • Maintain accurate student records
  • Follow official verification procedures
  • Complete all administrative work on time

Colleges will be responsible for any delay or mismanagement in marksheet distribution.

What Should Students Do Now?

Students awaiting their AKTU marksheet 2024-25 should follow these steps:

  • Government and private job applications
  • Internships and training programs
  • Scholarships and education loans
  • Official academic verification

Without the marksheet, students may face delays in career opportunities.

Common Issues Students May Face

Some students may experience:

  • Delay in college-level distribution
  • Lack of communication from administration
  • Minor printing errors

Students are advised to stay patient and rely only on official information regarding the AKTU marksheet 2024-25.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

Q1. Is AKTU marksheet 2024-25 released?
Yes, AKTU has officially printed and dispatched the marksheets.

Q2. Will AKTU send marksheet directly to students?
No, students must collect the AKTU marksheet 2024-25 from their college.

Q3. Are digital marksheets valid?
Yes, digital academic records are valid as per government norms.

Q4. What if my college has not informed me yet?
You should directly contact your college examination cell.

title.rendered: AKTU B.Pharm Even Semester Exam Centre List 2025-26 Released: District-Wise Tentative Centres Announced

content.rendered:
Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University (AKTU), Lucknow has officially released the AKTU B.Pharm Even Semester Exam Centre List 2025-26 for students enrolled in the Bachelor of Pharmacy (B.Pharm) programme. This notification is extremely important for all students who are going to appear in Regular, Carry Over, and Supplementary examinations of the even semester during the academic session 2025-26.

As per the official notice issued by the Examination Controller, the tentative examination centres have been allotted district-wise across Uttar Pradesh. The examinations are scheduled to be conducted from 10 February 2026 to 19 February 2026 in offline mode at designated centres .

Official Notice Overview

AKTU released this notice through its Examination Control Office, Lucknow. The main objective of the notice is to inform affiliated institutions and students about the tentative list of examination centres for B.Pharm even semester exams and to invite objections or corrections, if any.

The university has clearly instructed colleges to carefully verify the centre details and report discrepancies within the given deadline.

AKTU B.Pharm Even Semester Exam Centre List 2025-26 – Key Details

The AKTU B.Pharm Even Semester Exam Centre List 2025-26 has been shared with all affiliated colleges for verification before finalisation.

Important Instructions by AKTU for Colleges

According to the official circular:

  • The list released is tentative, not final.
  • Colleges must verify:
    • Examination centre name
    • Centre code
    • College mapping
    • District allocation
  • Any objection or correction must be sent through email.

📧 Official Email ID: dcoe-a@aktu.ac.in
🕓 Last Date & Time: 05 February 2026 till 4:00 PM

After this deadline, no request for change will be accepted by the university under any circumstances .

District-Wise Coverage in AKTU B.Pharm Exam Centre List 2025-26

The AKTU B.Pharm Even Semester Exam Centre List 2025-26 covers a large number of districts across Uttar Pradesh, ensuring smooth and fair examination conduct.

Some major districts included are:

  • Agra
  • Aligarh
  • Ambedkar Nagar
  • Ayodhya
  • Azamgarh
  • Barabanki
  • Bareilly
  • Basti
  • Bijnor
  • Bulandshahr
  • Etawah
  • Gautam Buddha Nagar
  • Ghaziabad
  • Ghazipur
  • Gonda
  • Gorakhpur

  • Kannauj
  • Kanpur
  • Lucknow

Each district has one or more nodal examination centres, under which multiple pharmacy colleges are mapped.

  • Pharmacy College, Azamgarh

Why the Exam Centre List Is Important for Students

Tentative List:

Final List:

  • Released after objection review
  • No further changes allowed
  • Used for actual exam conduct

The final AKTU B.Pharm Even Semester Exam Centre List 2025-26 will be issued after reviewing all objections received within the deadline.

What Students Should Do Now

10 February 2026 to 19 February 2026

title.rendered: Cepheid Hiring Challenge 2026 (Java): Complete Guide for Freshers and Experienced Developers

content.rendered:
Cepheid has officially announced the Cepheid Hiring Challenge 2026 (Java), creating an exciting opportunity for both freshers and experienced professionals across India. This online hiring challenge is open to candidates with 0 to 15 years of experience, making it one of the most inclusive tech hiring drives of 2026. With a strong focus on Java, Angular, and problem-solving skills, this challenge is ideal for developers who want to build a meaningful career in healthcare technology.

title.rendered: AKTU B.Pharm 1st Semester Notes (Syllabus, Subjects & Study Guide)

content.rendered:
The Bachelor of Pharmacy (B.Pharm) program under Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University (AKTU) begins with a strong foundation in medical science, pharmaceutical principles, and communication skills. The 1st semester syllabus is designed to introduce students to human anatomy, basic pharmaceutics, pharmaceutical chemistry, and analytical techniques that are essential for future pharmacy studies.

This article provides a complete overview of the AKTU B.Pharm 1st Semester syllabus, subject-wise details, and how these subjects help students academically and professionally.

AKTU B.Pharm 1st Semester Notes – Download Section

  • AKTU B.Pharm 8th Semester Notes (Syllabus, Subjects & Study Guide)

  • AKTU B.Pharm 7th Semester Notes (Syllabus, Subjects & Study Guide)

  • AKTU B.Pharm 6th Semester Notes (Syllabus, Subjects & Study Guide)

  • AKTU B.Pharm 5th Semester Notes (Syllabus, Subjects & Study Guide)

  • AKTU B.Pharm 3rd Semester Notes (Syllabus, Subjects & Study Guide)

  • AKTU B.Pharm 4th Semester Notes (Syllabus, Subjects & Study Guide)

  • AKTU B.Pharm 2nd Semester Notes (Syllabus, Subjects & Study Guide)

  • AKTU B.Pharm 1st Semester Notes (Syllabus, Subjects & Study Guide)

Overview of AKTU B.Pharm 1st Semester

  • Course Name: Bachelor of Pharmacy (B.Pharm)
  • University: AKTU (Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University)
  • Semester: 1st Semester
  • Pattern: Theory + Practical
  • Evaluation: Internal Assessment + End Semester Examination

The semester focuses equally on theoretical knowledge and laboratory skills, ensuring students understand both concepts and applications.

AKTU B.Pharm 1st Semester Theory Subjects

BP101T – Human Anatomy and Physiology (Theory)

This subject introduces the structure and functions of the human body. Students study:

  • Levels of structural organization
  • Skeletal, muscular, nervous, and cardiovascular systems
  • Digestive and respiratory systems
  • Basic physiological mechanisms

Importance: This subject forms the backbone of pharmacy education, helping students understand how drugs interact with the human body.

BP102T – Pharmaceutical Analysis I (Theory)

This subject focuses on analytical methods used in pharmacy, including:

  • Fundamentals of analytical chemistry
  • Errors in pharmaceutical analysis
  • Acid-base titrations
  • Introduction to volumetric analysis

Importance: It builds accuracy and analytical thinking, which are crucial in drug testing and quality control.

BP103T – Pharmaceutics I (Theory)

This subject deals with the basics of dosage forms and formulation science:

  • Introduction to pharmaceutics
  • Types of dosage forms
  • Weights and measures
  • Pharmaceutical calculations

Importance: It lays the foundation for drug formulation and manufacturing concepts.

BP104T – Pharmaceutical Inorganic Chemistry (Theory)

This subject covers inorganic compounds used in pharmacy:

  • Classification of inorganic drugs
  • Sources and preparation of inorganic pharmaceuticals
  • Therapeutic uses of inorganic compounds
  • Limit tests for impurities

Importance: Helps students understand the chemical nature and therapeutic role of inorganic substances.

BP105T – Communication Skills (Theory)

This subject improves professional and academic communication:

  • Verbal and non-verbal communication
  • Reading and writing skills
  • Presentation techniques
  • Basics of pharmacy-related communication

Importance: Essential for patient counseling, presentations, and professional interaction.

BP106RBT / BP106RMT – Remedial Biology / Remedial Mathematics (Theory)

Students choose Biology or Mathematics based on their background:

  • Remedial Biology: Cell structure, tissues, basic genetics
  • Remedial Mathematics: Algebra, calculus, and basic statistics

Importance: Strengthens basic concepts required for pharmaceutical sciences.

AKTU B.Pharm 1st Semester Practical Subjects

BP107P – Human Anatomy and Physiology (Practical)

Includes:

  • Study of organs and tissues
  • Practical experiments related to physiology
  • Identification and viva

BP108P – Pharmaceutical Analysis I (Practical)

Includes:

  • Acid-base titration experiments
  • Standardization techniques
  • Analytical calculations

BP109P – Pharmaceutics I (Practical)

Includes:

  • Preparation of pharmaceutical formulations
  • Understanding dispensing procedures
  • Practical pharmacy techniques

BP110P – Pharmaceutical Inorganic Chemistry (Practical)

Includes:

  • Limit tests
  • Identification of inorganic compounds
  • Laboratory preparation methods

BP111P – Communication Skills (Practical)

Includes:

  • Group discussions
  • Role plays
  • Presentation practice
  • Listening and speaking exercises

BP112RBP – Remedial Biology (Practical)

Includes:

  • Microscopic study
  • Basic biological experiments
  • Observation and reporting

Why AKTU B.Pharm 1st Semester Notes Are Important

  • Help in exam-oriented preparation
  • Simplify complex concepts
  • Useful for internal assessments and viva
  • Support quick revision before exams
  • Strong base for higher semesters

Final Words

The AKTU B.Pharm 1st Semester syllabus is carefully structured to build a strong academic foundation for pharmacy students. Subjects like Human Anatomy and Physiology, Pharmaceutics, and Pharmaceutical Analysis play a vital role throughout the B.Pharm journey. By studying proper notes and understanding the syllabus clearly, students can score well and develop practical knowledge essential for the pharmaceutical industry.

title.rendered: AKTU Application Deadline Extended for Affiliated Colleges for Academic Session 2025–26

content.rendered:
Lucknow, January 2026: Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University (AKTU), Lucknow, has officially announced that the AKTU Application Deadline Extended for affiliated colleges for the Academic Session 2025–26. As per the latest office memorandum issued by the university, affiliated institutions can now submit their applications till 10 February 2026.

This announcement has brought relief to several colleges that were struggling to complete documentation and procedural requirements within the earlier deadline. The decision has been taken with the approval of the competent authority and is applicable to all AKTU-affiliated institutions across Uttar Pradesh .

AKTU Application Deadline Extended: What the Official Notice Confirms

According to the official notification released by the Registrar’s Office, AKTU had earlier issued multiple instructions regarding the submission of applications for the Academic Session 2025–26. These notifications were dated 22 December 2025, 11 January 2026, and 22 January 2026.

Initially, colleges were instructed to submit applications between 12 July 2025 and 31 October 2025. Later, the last date was extended to 30 January 2026. Now, under the latest update, the AKTU Application Deadline Extended further till 10 February 2026, giving institutions additional time to complete the required formalities.

Who Will Benefit from the AKTU Application Deadline Extended?

The revised deadline applies to all colleges affiliated with AKTU that are running or planning to run academic programs for the 2025–26 session. This includes institutions offering:

  • Undergraduate programs
  • Postgraduate programs
  • Engineering and technical courses
  • Management and professional programs
  • Pharmacy courses
  • Architecture and allied disciplines

Colleges seeking continuation, extension, or approval of academic activities must ensure compliance within the revised timeline.

Important Instructions Issued Along with Deadline Extension

Along with announcing that the AKTU Application Deadline Extended, the university has issued clear instructions for affiliated institutions. Colleges must ensure that:

  • Application forms are filled accurately
  • All required documents are properly uploaded or attached
  • Submissions are completed on or before 10 February 2026
  • There are no errors or missing details

AKTU has also cautioned that incomplete or incorrect applications may result in delays or rejection, even after the deadline extension.

Why AKTU Application Deadline Extended for 2025–26?

Although AKTU has not officially mentioned a specific reason, academic sources suggest that several institutions requested additional time due to administrative and compliance-related challenges.

The decision to extend the deadline aims to:

  • Reduce last-minute errors in applications
  • Improve the overall quality of submissions
  • Ensure smoother academic planning for the upcoming session
  • Prevent delays in admissions and course approvals

By announcing that the AKTU Application Deadline Extended, the university has shown a practical and balanced approach toward academic administration.

Administrative Authority Behind the Decision

The notification confirming the AKTU Application Deadline Extended has been issued by the Registrar (Kulsachiv) of Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University, Lucknow. Copies of the notice have been forwarded to:

  • Technical Education Department, Government of Uttar Pradesh
  • Vice-Chancellor’s Office
  • Examination Controller
  • Joint and Assistant Registrars
  • Nodal officers and concerned administrative staff

This ensures that the revised deadline is implemented uniformly across all affiliated colleges .

What Students Should Understand About This Update

Although the notice primarily concerns colleges, the AKTU Application Deadline Extended also has indirect benefits for students. Timely completion of institutional approvals helps in:

  • Smooth admission processes
  • On-time start of academic sessions
  • Avoidance of last-minute academic disruptions
  • Better planning of examinations and coursework

Students are advised to stay in contact with their colleges and regularly check official AKTU announcements for admission-related updates.

Impact of AKTU Application Deadline Extended on Academic Session 2025–26

The extension of the application deadline is expected to positively influence the Academic Session 2025–26. With additional time, institutions can focus on meeting academic, infrastructural, and regulatory requirements more effectively.

By ensuring that approvals are completed on time, the AKTU Application Deadline Extended helps maintain consistency and academic quality across all affiliated colleges.

Final Reminder for Affiliated Colleges

AKTU has clearly stated that 10 February 2026 should be treated as the final deadline. Institutions are strongly advised not to wait until the last day to submit their applications.

No further extension has been announced so far, and colleges should complete the process well in advance to avoid technical or administrative issues.

Conclusion

The announcement that the AKTU Application Deadline Extended till 10 February 2026 is a crucial update for all AKTU-affiliated colleges. The decision provides institutions with additional time to complete essential formalities while ensuring that the Academic Session 2025–26 proceeds smoothly.

Colleges must make full use of this opportunity and adhere strictly to university guidelines. Students, meanwhile, should stay updated through official channels to avoid missing important academic information.

title.rendered: Mukhyamantri Kanya Sumangala Yojana 2026: Official New Guidelines, Age Criteria, Aadhaar Rules & Payment System

content.rendered:
Mukhyamantri Kanya Sumangala Yojana: The Government of Uttar Pradesh has issued official revised guidelines in January 2026 to ensure the effective and transparent implementation of the Mukhyamantri Kanya Sumangala Yojana. These instructions focus on Aadhaar authentication, category-wise age limits, verification process, and Aadhaar-based payments, as approved by the Women and Child Development Department.

This article explains the correct and official information based entirely on the government notification.

About Mukhyamantri Kanya Sumangala Yojana

Mukhyamantri Kanya Sumangala Yojana is a state-level girl child welfare scheme of Uttar Pradesh aimed at improving the health, education, and social security of girls from birth to higher education.

Objectives of the Scheme

  • Prevention of female foeticide
  • Promotion of girl child education
  • Prevention of child marriage
  • Financial support at different life stages
  • Creating a positive social mindset toward daughters

Reason for Issuing New Guidelines (2026)

According to the official order, several implementation issues were identified, including:

  • Duplicate or overlapping applications
  • Errors in beneficiary identification
  • Payment delays due to incorrect bank details
  • Lack of uniform age eligibility

To address these issues, the government issued clear operational directions for all departments and district authorities .

Aadhaar Authentication – Mandatory as per Official Order

  • Aadhaar authentication has been implemented on the scheme portal since October 2022.
  • From 2026 onward, Aadhaar verification is mandatory for approval.

Aadhaar Requirement by Category

  • Category 01 & 02 → Aadhaar of Mother and Father
  • Category 03, 04, 05 & 06 → Aadhaar of Mother, Father, and Girl Child
  • Aadhaar VID (Virtual ID) is permitted as an alternative

❗ Applications without Aadhaar authentication will not be approved.

Aadhaar Based Payment System (ABPS) – Officially Implemented

The government has approved Aadhaar Based Payment System (ABPS) for direct benefit transfer.

Official Payment Order

  1. Payment will be made first to the mother’s Aadhaar-linked bank account
  2. If the mother’s account is not NPCI-mapped and the father’s account is mapped → payment to father
  3. If neither account is NPCI-mapped → NPCI mapping must be completed
  4. For Category-06, if the girl child applies herself → payment to her Aadhaar-linked account

This ensures accurate beneficiary identification and fraud prevention .

Category-Wise Age Eligibility (Official Table)

To prevent multiple applications, strict age limits have been defined.

👉 Applying in more than one category at the same time is not permitted.

Verification Process (As per Government Instructions)

  • Rural Areas → Block Development Officer (BDO)
  • Urban Areas → Sub-Divisional Magistrate (SDM)
  • Maximum verification period → 30 days
  • District-level scrutiny after verification
  • 10% random re-verification by District Probation Officer
  • Incorrect or false applications will be rejected

Bank Account & PFMS Validation

  • Bank account details are verified through PFMS
  • Errors such as incorrect account number, IFSC, or inactive account must be corrected
  • Without successful Aadhaar-NPCI mapping, payment will not be released

Helpdesk and Call Center Facility

As per the order:

  • A dedicated Helpdesk / Call Center will be established
  • Purpose:
    • Provide correct scheme information
    • Resolve application-related problems
    • Support portal-related technical issues
  • Expenses will be covered under the scheme’s administrative budget

Important Instructions for Applicants

  • Ensure Aadhaar authentication before applying
  • Apply only in the eligible age category
  • Upload valid and correct documents
  • Avoid duplicate or incorrect applications
  • Track application status regularly

Conclusion

The Mukhyamantri Kanya Sumangala Yojana 2026 revised guidelines strengthen transparency, accountability, and efficiency. Aadhaar-based verification and payments ensure that benefits reach the genuine beneficiary without delay.

Applicants are advised to follow the official rules strictly to avoid rejection.

title.rendered: AKTU Challenge Evaluation 2026: B.Pharm 1st Semester & Even Semester Students Can Apply Till 03 February

content.rendered:
AKTU Challenge Evaluation 2026: Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University (AKTU), Lucknow has officially released an important notification regarding Challenge Evaluation for B.Pharm students of the 2024–25 academic session. This notice is especially relevant for B.Pharm First Semester and Even Semester (remaining students) who are not satisfied with their examination marks.

According to the official circular issued on 29 January 2026, eligible students can now apply for online challenge evaluation within the given deadline.

What Is Challenge Evaluation?

Challenge Evaluation is a process where students can challenge the marks awarded in their answer sheets if they believe there is a significant discrepancy. Under this system:

  • Answer sheets are re-evaluated by subject experts
  • The average marks of two examiners are considered
  • The revised marks (if applicable) are treated as final

This process ensures transparency and fairness in AKTU’s evaluation system.

Courses & Students Eligible

As per the notice, the following students are eligible:

  • B.Pharm First Semester (2024–25)
  • B.Pharm Even Semester – Remaining / Left-out Students
  • Students whose answer sheets are available on ERP login

👉 Only those students who are dissatisfied with their current marks should apply.

also read : Fractal Internship 2026 for Students & Freshers: Hybrid Work, Free Food & Multiple India Locations

Important Dates (Must Read)

⚠️ No application will be accepted after the last date.

Challenge Evaluation Fees

  • ₹2500 per subject
  • Payment mode: Online only

💸 Refund Rule (Important)

  • If the difference between original marks and revised marks is more than 20%, then:
    • ₹1000 will be refunded
  • If the difference is less than 20%, no refund will be provided

Evaluation Rules (As Per AKTU Guidelines)

The university has clearly mentioned the following rules:

  • Two subject experts will evaluate the answer sheet
  • Average of both examiners’ marks will be considered
  • The revised marks will be:
    • Final
    • Updated in the marksheet
  • No further rechecking or review will be allowed after this

Bank Details: Be Careful!

Students must carefully fill in:

  • Account Number
  • IFSC Code
  • Bank Name

⚠️ If incorrect bank details are entered:

  • The university will not be responsible
  • Refund issues (if any) will be the student’s responsibility

How to Apply for AKTU Challenge Evaluation?

Follow these steps carefully:

  1. Visit the AKTU ERP Portal
  2. Login using your Enrollment Number & Password
  3. Check your Answer Sheet
  4. Select the subject(s) for challenge evaluation
  5. Pay the required online fee
  6. Submit the application and save the receipt

Official Reference & Authority

This challenge evaluation process is conducted as per:

  • Government Order No. 39298/16-1099/17/2020 (11 Dec 2020)
  • University Examination Committee 68th Meeting Resolution
  • Earlier AKTU circular dated 05 December 2025

This confirms that the process is fully official and legally valid.

Important Instructions for Colleges

AKTU has directed all affiliated colleges to:

  • Inform students immediately
  • Ensure smooth application process
  • Assist students if required
  • Avoid misinformation or delays

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

Q1. Is challenge evaluation the same as rechecking?

No. Challenge evaluation involves re-evaluation by experts, not just totaling.

Q2. Can marks decrease after challenge evaluation?

Yes. Revised marks can be increased or decreased and will be final.

Q3. Can I apply offline?

No. Only online applications are accepted.

Q4. Is this applicable for other courses?

As of now, this notice is only for B.Pharm students.

Final Advice for Students

If you:

  • Strongly feel there is a major error in evaluation
  • Are confident about your performance
  • Can accept the risk of mark decrease

👉 Then challenge evaluation can be a useful option.

Otherwise, apply wisely and carefully before the deadline.

title.rendered: India AI Impact Buildathon 2026 by HCL GUVI: AKTU Students Get a National AI Opportunity with ₹4 Lakh Prize Pool

content.rendered:
Artificial Intelligence (AI) is rapidly transforming industries, careers, and the future of technology. To encourage student innovation and AI skill development, Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University (AKTU) has officially circulated an important notice regarding the India AI Impact Buildathon 2026, organized by HCL GUVI.

This is a national-level AI buildathon conducted as part of the India AI Impact Summit 2026, a prestigious Government of India initiative. The event provides AKTU students with a rare opportunity to work on real-world AI problems, gain national exposure, and compete for a ₹4,00,000 prize pool.

What is India AI Impact Buildathon 2026?

The India AI Impact Buildathon 2026 is not a conventional hackathon. It is a structured AI buildathon designed to help students learn, build, and showcase AI-based solutions for real-world challenges.

Key objectives of the buildathon include:

  • Encouraging youth participation in AI innovation
  • Solving real-world problems aligned with MeitY (Ministry of Electronics & IT)
  • Providing guided learning before actual product building
  • Offering a national platform for showcasing AI skills

The buildathon is designed in a way that even first-time hackathon participants can confidently take part.

Who is Organizing This Buildathon?

The event is organized by HCL GUVI, a well-known upskilling and technology learning platform, under the umbrella of the India AI Impact Summit 2026.

The summit itself is a Government of India initiative, expected to be attended by top national and global leaders, including:

  • Hon’ble Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi
  • Global technology leaders and innovators
  • Senior industry experts and policymakers

This makes the buildathon a highly prestigious national event.

AKTU Official Circular Overview

AKTU, through its Dean – Training & Placement, has officially informed all affiliated and associated colleges to actively encourage their students to participate in this buildathon.

The circular highlights that:

  • Registrations are already open
  • The event is of national importance
  • Students from all disciplines can participate
  • Colleges should promote maximum participation

This confirms that the buildathon is officially recognized and supported by AKTU .

Important Dates and Event Schedule

Students must carefully note the following important dates:

⚠️ Online submissions must be completed before 5 February 2026.

₹4,00,000 Prize Pool and Rewards 💰

One of the biggest attractions of the India AI Impact Buildathon 2026 is its ₹4 lakh prize pool.

Participants stand to gain:

  • 🏆 Total prize pool of ₹4,00,000
  • 📜 Co-branded participation certificates from HCL GUVI and India AI Impact Summit
  • 🇮🇳 Opportunity to represent their institution at a national platform
  • 🤝 Networking with AI professionals, innovators, and industry leaders
  • 💼 Strong resume-building project experience

These rewards make the buildathon extremely valuable for students aiming for internships, placements, or startup opportunities.

Eligibility Criteria: Who Can Apply?

The eligibility criteria for this buildathon are highly inclusive:

  • ✅ Students from AKTU-affiliated colleges
  • ✅ All academic disciplines (Engineering, Management, Science, etc.)
  • ✅ Any year of study
  • ✅ Individual or team participation allowed
  • ✅ Open to beginners as well as experienced students

No prior hackathon experience is mandatory.

Buildathon Structure Explained

Phase 1: Online Buildathon Round

  • Students must register on the official landing page
  • Participants work on real-world AI problem statements
  • Solutions are developed and submitted online
  • The online round remains open until 5 February 2026

This phase allows students to participate remotely from anywhere.

Phase 2: Offline Finale in New Delhi

  • From the online round, 750 participants will be shortlisted
  • Shortlisted teams will be invited to New Delhi
  • Final event venue: Dr. Ambedkar International Centre
  • Live presentations and evaluations will take place

This phase provides participants with national-level visibility and recognition.

Why This Buildathon is Different from Traditional Hackathons

Unlike typical hackathons that focus only on coding speed, the India AI Impact Buildathon emphasizes:

  • Structured learning before solution development
  • Real-world government-aligned problem statements
  • AI-driven product thinking
  • Practical impact rather than theoretical ideas

This makes the event suitable for both beginners and advanced learners.

Benefits for AKTU Students

By participating in this buildathon, AKTU students can gain:

  1. Hands-on experience in AI solution development
  2. Exposure to national-level innovation platforms
  3. Confidence in presenting ideas to experts
  4. Industry-recognized certification
  5. Valuable networking opportunities
  6. A strong addition to their resume and portfolio

For students planning careers in AI, data science, software development, or startups, this event can be a major milestone.

How to Register for India AI Impact Buildathon 2026

Follow these simple steps to register:

  1. Visit the official registration page
    👉 https://bit.ly/4sYEGg6
  2. Complete the registration form
  3. Select the problem statement
  4. Build your AI-based solution
  5. Submit before 5 February 2026

Late submissions will not be accepted.

Official Contact for Queries

For any concerns or clarifications, students or college authorities can contact AKTU at:

📧 tnp.aktu@aktu.ac.in

This contact information is officially mentioned in the AKTU circular .

Why Students Should Not Miss This Opportunity

If you are a student who:

  • Wants to learn AI practically
  • Aims for national exposure
  • Wishes to compete for a ₹4 lakh prize pool
  • Plans to strengthen your resume

Then the India AI Impact Buildathon 2026 is an opportunity you should not miss.

Final Conclusion

The India AI Impact Buildathon 2026 by HCL GUVI is a prestigious, government-supported initiative that offers AKTU students a chance to learn, innovate, and compete on a national stage.

With a structured learning approach, real-world AI challenges, and significant rewards, this buildathon can play a key role in shaping students’ careers in technology and innovation.

👉 Registration closes on 5 February 2026.
Apply early, build impactful AI solutions, and represent your institution at a national level.

title.rendered: This Remote Opportunity Is Making Waves: Engineering Intern Automation/QA at Kintsugi AI

content.rendered:
If you are an engineering or computer science student searching for a high-impact remote internship, this is one opportunity you should not ignore. The Engineering Intern Automation/QA at Kintsugi AI role is quickly gaining attention among students who want real-world AI, automation, and SaaS experience, not just certificate-based internships.

Unlike traditional internships that focus only on theory or minor tasks, this role allows you to work directly on production automation systems that power real businesses globally.

In this detailed guide, we’ll explore why the Engineering Intern Automation/QA at Kintsugi AI role is different, what skills you’ll gain, and why it is perfectly aligned with what modern tech companies actually look for in fresh engineers.

Why the Engineering Intern Automation/QA at Kintsugi AI Is a Big Deal

Today, students are more informed than ever. They don’t just want an internship—they want career-ready exposure.

The Engineering Intern Automation/QA at Kintsugi AI role stands out because it gives interns access to:

  • Live automation pipelines used by customers
  • AI-powered workflow orchestration systems
  • Real debugging, testing, and monitoring responsibilities
  • Collaboration with engineering and customer-facing teams

This is exactly the kind of experience that helps you move confidently into full-time backend, QA, or automation engineering roles.

About Kintsugi AI: A Quick Introduction

Kintsugi AI is a fast-growing startup focused on sales tax automation for e-commerce and SaaS companies. Using AI-powered tools, the company helps businesses:

  • Reduce tax preparation time by up to 75%
  • Cut compliance costs by nearly 50%
  • Automate complex workflows such as filings, registrations, and reporting

Instead of relying on manual spreadsheets and error-prone processes, Kintsugi AI builds scalable automation systems that work reliably at scale.

Joining the Engineering Intern Automation/QA at Kintsugi AI role means becoming part of this mission-driven journey.

Role Overview: What You’ll Do as an Engineering Intern

As an intern on the Automations/QA team, your role will sit at the intersection of engineering, operations, and customer success.

You won’t be limited to observing—you’ll actively contribute to systems that matter.

1. Building Automation Workflows

You’ll help design, build, and maintain workflows using:

  • n8n (workflow automation)
  • Browser-based RPA tools like Sola
  • Internal APIs and integrations

These workflows are responsible for critical compliance tasks, making accuracy and reliability essential.

2. Monitoring and Troubleshooting Systems

One of the most valuable skills you’ll gain as part of the Engineering Intern Automation/QA at Kintsugi AI role is system debugging.

You will:

  • Monitor automation pipelines
  • Identify failures or performance issues
  • Investigate root causes and apply fixes

This kind of experience is rarely offered at the internship level.

3. Supporting Customer-Facing Teams

You’ll work closely with:

  • Customer Success teams
  • Onboarding specialists

Your job will be to:

  • Investigate workflow issues reported by teams
  • Help with automation configuration
  • Triage bugs and ensure quick resolution

This teaches you how engineering decisions directly affect real users and businesses.

4. Testing Before Production Release

Before new automations go live, interns help:

  • Test workflows thoroughly
  • Validate edge cases
  • Collect internal feedback

This strengthens both your QA mindset and system-thinking ability, which are critical for modern engineering roles.

Skills Required (Student-Friendly Expectations)

The Engineering Intern Automation/QA at Kintsugi AI position is designed for learners—not experts.

You are eligible if you:

  • Are pursuing a degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field
  • Have basic familiarity with Python, JavaScript, or TypeScript
  • Are interested in automation, backend systems, or integrations
  • Enjoy problem-solving and debugging

You don’t need years of experience—curiosity and willingness to learn matter more.

Bonus Skills That Give You an Edge

While not mandatory, the following skills can strengthen your application:

  • Understanding of REST APIs and webhooks
  • Exposure to cloud platforms like AWS or GCP
  • Experience with workflow tools such as n8n or Airflow
  • Prior technical support or internal tooling experience

Even if you lack these, the internship itself is designed to help you learn them.

What You’ll Learn From This Internship

The Engineering Intern Automation/QA at Kintsugi AI role helps you develop skills that are directly aligned with industry needs:

  • How real SaaS automation systems are designed
  • How AI-driven workflows operate in production
  • How to debug complex system failures
  • How engineering teams collaborate with operations
  • How customer impact shapes technical decisions

These lessons go far beyond what classroom learning can offer.

Remote, Full-Time & Startup Culture

This internship is:

  • 🌍 Fully remote (open to Southeast Asia candidates)
  • ⏱️ Full-time and immersive
  • 🚀 Based in a fast-growing startup environment

You’ll work in a flexible, supportive culture where interns are treated as contributors, not observers.

Why This Internship Is Resume-Gold for Students

Recruiters care about practical exposure, and that’s exactly what the Engineering Intern Automation/QA at Kintsugi AI role provides.

After completing this internship, you’ll be able to confidently talk about:

  • Automation architecture
  • QA in production systems
  • SaaS workflow reliability
  • Cross-functional collaboration

This makes you stand out during placements, interviews, and future job applications.

Application Process: Simple and Transparent

To apply, candidates need to submit:

  • Basic personal details
  • LinkedIn profile
  • Resume (PDF format, max 5 MB)

The hiring process is handled via Dover, and the company follows AI employment regulations for fair and ethical hiring.

How to Apply?

How to Apply?

If you are an interested candidate, you can apply for Engineering Intern Automation/QA at Kintsugi AI (Remote Internship) and get hands-on experience working on real AI automation and QA systems.

👉 Apply Here

Final Thoughts: Should You Apply?

If you are serious about building a future in:

  • Automation engineering
  • Backend systems
  • QA and reliability engineering
  • AI-powered SaaS platforms

Then the Engineering Intern Automation/QA at Kintsugi AI role is absolutely worth applying for.

This is not just another internship—it’s a career-shaping opportunity that gives you real skills, real confidence, and real-world exposure.

What is BARC OCES DGFS 2026?

BARC OCES DGFS 2026 is a national-level recruitment and training programme aimed at hiring young engineers and science graduates for India’s nuclear and advanced research programs.

This recruitment has been conducted annually since 1957, making it one of the most trusted scientific career pathways in India. After successful training, candidates work in top research facilities such as BARC, IGCAR, AMD, and other DAE units.

Why BARC OCES DGFS 2026 is a Golden Career Opportunity

title.rendered: AKTU Students के लिए ISRO Internship & Student Project Trainee Scheme 2026 – Apply Online Now

content.rendered:
ISRO Internship: Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University (AKTU) से जुड़े छात्रों के लिए एक golden opportunity सामने आई है। AKTU ने अपने सभी affiliated colleges के छात्रों को Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO) की Internship Scheme और Student Project Trainee Scheme में भाग लेने का मौका दिया है।

यह मौका खासतौर पर उन छात्रों के लिए है जो engineering, computer science, AI, electronics, space technology और research के क्षेत्र में अपना करियर बनाना चाहते हैं। इस योजना के तहत छात्र ISRO के विभिन्न centres में real-world projects पर काम कर सकते हैं।

AKTU द्वारा यह सूचना 21 जनवरी 2026 को आधिकारिक पत्र के माध्यम से जारी की गई है ।

ISRO Internship Scheme क्या है?

ISRO Internship Scheme एक national-level academic program है, जिसके तहत Undergraduate, Postgraduate और PhD students को ISRO के वैज्ञानिकों और इंजीनियरों के साथ काम करने का अवसर मिलता है।

इस internship का मुख्य उद्देश्य छात्रों को:

  • Live space & technology projects पर काम करने का अनुभव देना
  • Classroom knowledge को real-world problems से जोड़ना
  • Research & innovation skills को improve करना
  • Future career के लिए strong profile बनाना

ISRO Student Project Trainee Scheme क्या है?

Student Project Trainee Scheme उन छात्रों के लिए है जो:

  • Final year project कर रहे हैं
  • Research-oriented project पर guidance चाहते हैं
  • Space science, AI, Remote Sensing, Robotics जैसे advanced domains में काम करना चाहते हैं

इस scheme के अंतर्गत छात्र ISRO Centres में long-term project training कर सकते हैं।

कौन-कौन से AKTU Students Apply कर सकते हैं?

AKTU के अनुसार, निम्नलिखित category के छात्र इस scheme के लिए eligible हैं :

Eligible Students List

  • B.Tech / BE – 6th semester complete
  • M.Tech / ME – 1st semester complete
  • B.Sc / Diploma – Final year students
  • M.Sc – 1st semester complete
  • PhD Scholars – Coursework complete

👉 Minimum requirement:

  • 60% marks या CGPA 6.32/10

Internship Duration (Course-wise)

ISRO Internship में कौन-कौन से Domains Available हैं?

ISRO ने कई high-demand technical domains को शामिल किया है, जैसे:

  • Computer Science & IT
  • Artificial Intelligence (AI) / Machine Learning
  • Electronics & Communication Engineering
  • Mechanical Engineering
  • Aerospace Engineering
  • Robotics & Mechatronics
  • Remote Sensing & GIS
  • Data Science
  • Material Science
  • Physics, Chemistry & Environmental Science

यह internship खासतौर पर future-ready technologies पर focus करती है।

ISRO Internship के Benefits

ISRO Internship & Student Project Trainee Scheme से छात्रों को कई बड़े फायदे मिलते हैं:

  • ✅ ISRO Scientists से direct mentorship
  • ✅ Live research & development exposure
  • ✅ National-level certificate from ISRO
  • ✅ Resume & higher studies profile strong होती है
  • ✅ Deep-tech & space sector में career opportunities
  • ✅ Research mindset develop होता है

⚠️ Note:
ISRO internship में कोई stipend या accommodation नहीं दिया जाता, लेकिन learning exposure बहुत high-value होता है।

Application Process – Step by Step

Step 1: ISRO Official Portal पर Apply करें

Students को सबसे पहले ISRO की official website पर जाकर apply करना होगा:

👉 ISRO Internship Portal:
https://www.isro.gov.in/InternshipAndProjects.html

Step 2: AKTU Innovation Hub Google Form (Mandatory)

ISRO portal पर apply करने के बाद, AKTU Innovation Hub द्वारा जारी Google Form भरना अनिवार्य है ।

👉 Google Form Link:
https://forms.gle/Hduv2jyc5xx9wTEd8

इस step का उद्देश्य:

  • Centralized coordination
  • University-level record keeping
  • Students को proper guidance देना

Important Instructions for Students

  • Application 45 days पहले submit करना advisable है
  • Incomplete या गलत form reject हो सकता है
  • One student = One internship per degree
  • Parallel internship allowed नहीं है
  • Selection email अगर joining से 7 दिन पहले नहीं आता, तो application considered नहीं मानी जाएगी

AKTU Official Contacts (For Help)

अगर किसी student को clarification चाहिए, तो वे contact कर सकते हैं:

  • Mr. Suraj – Manager, Innovation Hub AKTU
    📞 8318698755
  • Email:
    ceo.ihubup@aktu.ac.in

Why AKTU Students Should Not Miss This Opportunity?

अगर आप AKTU student हैं और ISRO जैसी prestigious organization के साथ काम करने का सपना देखते हैं, तो यह opportunity आपके career को next level पर ले जा सकती है।

आज के time में जब AI, space tech और research-based careers तेजी से grow कर रहे हैं, ISRO internship आपके लिए game changer साबित हो सकती है।

Conclusion

AKTU ISRO Internship & Student Project Trainee Scheme 2026 students के लिए एक rare और valuable opportunity है। अगर आप engineering, science या technology background से हैं, तो बिना देर किए ISRO Internship apply online करें और AKTU Google Form भी जरूर भरें।

title.rendered: AKTU National Voters Day 2026: 25 January को मतदाता जागरूकता शपथ, सभी कॉलेजों के लिए जरूरी निर्देश

content.rendered:
AKTU National Voters Day 2026: भारत में लोकतंत्र की सबसे बड़ी ताकत मतदाता (Voter) होता है। इसी लोकतांत्रिक भावना को मजबूत करने के लिए हर साल 25 January को National Voters Day मनाया जाता है। वर्ष 2026 में यह दिवस और भी खास है क्योंकि AKTU (Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University, Lucknow) ने इससे जुड़ा एक आधिकारिक कार्यालय आदेश (Office Order) जारी किया है, जिसमें विश्वविद्यालय और उससे संबद्ध सभी कॉलेजों/संस्थानों को मतदाता जागरूकता कार्यक्रम और शपथ आयोजित करने के स्पष्ट निर्देश दिए गए हैं।

इस लेख में हम जानेंगे:

  • National Voters’ Day 2026 क्या है
  • AKTU का नया Office Order क्या कहता है
  • 25 January 2026 को क्या करना अनिवार्य है
  • Voter’s Pledge का पूरा अर्थ
  • Students, Faculty और Staff के लिए क्यों जरूरी है यह दिन

National Voters Day क्या है? (What is AKTU National Voters Day)

National Voters’ Day (NVD) हर साल 25 January को मनाया जाता है। यह दिन Election Commission of India की स्थापना की वर्षगांठ के रूप में मनाया जाता है। इसका मुख्य उद्देश्य है:

  • नागरिकों को मतदान के अधिकार के प्रति जागरूक करना
  • युवाओं को पहली बार वोट डालने के लिए प्रेरित करना
  • लोकतंत्र में निष्पक्ष, स्वतंत्र और शांतिपूर्ण चुनाव के महत्व को समझाना

2026 में National Voters’ Day की थीम है:

“My Vote, My India – My Vote is the Heart of Indian Democracy”

AKTU Office Order 2026: क्या कहा गया है?

AKTU द्वारा जारी कार्यालय आदेश (दिनांक 22 जनवरी 2026) के अनुसार:

  • 25 January 2026 (रविवार) को
  • पूर्वाह्न 11:00 बजे
  • विश्वविद्यालय मुख्यालय एवं सभी संबद्ध संस्थानों में
  • मतदाता जागरूकता दिवस (Voters’ Awareness Day) मनाया जाएगा
  • सभी शिक्षक, कर्मचारी और अधिकारी
  • National Voters’ Pledge (मतदाता शपथ) लेंगे

यह आदेश विश्वविद्यालय के सभी विभागों, कॉलेजों, परीक्षा नियंत्रक कार्यालय, निदेशालय और संबद्ध संस्थानों पर लागू होगा

25 January 2026 को क्या करना अनिवार्य है?

AKTU के आदेश के अनुसार, सभी संस्थानों को निम्नलिखित कार्य अनिवार्य रूप से करने होंगे:

👉 जिन संस्थानों में ऑनलाइन लिंक की सुविधा दी जाएगी, वहाँ उपस्थिति ऑनलाइन भी दर्ज की जा सकती है।

National Voters’ Pledge 2026 (मतदाता शपथ)

AKTU द्वारा जारी डॉक्यूमेंट में Voter’s Pledge को English और Hindi दोनों भाषाओं में शामिल किया गया है।

🇬🇧 Voter’s Pledge (English)

“We, the citizens of India, having abiding faith in democracy, hereby pledge to uphold the democratic traditions of our country and the dignity of free, fair and peaceful elections, and to vote in every election fearlessly and without being influenced by considerations of religion, race, caste, community, language or any inducement.”

🇮🇳 मतदाता शपथ (Hindi)

“हम, भारत के नागरिक, लोकतंत्र में अपनी पूर्ण आस्था रखते हुए यह शपथ लेते हैं कि हम अपने देश की लोकतांत्रिक परंपराओं की मर्यादा को बनाए रखेंगे तथा स्वतंत्र, निष्पक्ष एवं शांतिपूर्ण निर्वाचन की गरिमा को अक्षुण्ण रखते हुए, निर्भीक होकर, धर्म, वर्ग, जाति, समुदाय, भाषा अथवा किसी भी प्रलोभन से प्रभावित हुए बिना सभी निर्वाचनों में अपने मताधिकार का प्रयोग करेंगे।”

Students के लिए National Voters’ Day क्यों जरूरी है?

हालाँकि AKTU के आदेश में मुख्य रूप से Teachers और Staff का उल्लेख है, लेकिन यह दिन Students के लिए भी बेहद महत्वपूर्ण है:

  • B.Tech / MBA / MCA / PhD Students को Voting Awareness मिलती है
  • 18+ Students को पहली बार वोट डालने की प्रेरणा
  • Democracy, Constitution और Civic Duty की समझ
  • Campus में Responsible Citizen Culture का विकास

आज का student, कल का voter और नेता होता है।

Faculty और Staff के लिए क्या महत्व है?

Faculty और Non-Teaching Staff समाज के Role Model होते हैं। जब शिक्षक और कर्मचारी मतदाता शपथ लेते हैं:

  • Students पर सकारात्मक प्रभाव पड़ता है
  • Fair Voting की संस्कृति बनती है
  • Institutional Responsibility मजबूत होती है
  • Democracy सिर्फ किताबों में नहीं, व्यवहार में दिखती है

AKTU का यह कदम क्यों महत्वपूर्ण है?

AKTU उत्तर प्रदेश का सबसे बड़ा तकनीकी विश्वविद्यालय है। इससे जुड़े लाखों छात्र और हजारों शिक्षक हैं। ऐसे में:

  • एक ही दिन
  • एक ही समय
  • पूरे प्रदेश में
  • लोकतंत्र की शपथ

यह अपने आप में एक Mass Democratic Awareness Drive बन जाती है।

National Voters Day 2026 से जुड़े FAQs

Q1. क्या 25 January 2026 को कॉलेज बंद रहेगा?

👉 नहीं, यह एक कार्यक्रम आधारित दिवस है, अवकाश नहीं।

Q2. क्या Online Attendance मान्य होगी?

👉 हाँ, जहाँ विश्वविद्यालय/संस्थान द्वारा लिंक दिया जाएगा।

Q3. क्या Students के लिए अनिवार्य है?

👉 आदेश मुख्य रूप से Staff के लिए है, लेकिन Students को भी शामिल किया जा सकता है।

Q4. शपथ न लेने पर कोई कार्रवाई?

👉 यह एक राष्ट्रीय और नैतिक कर्तव्य है, इसलिए सभी को इसमें भाग लेना चाहिए।

निष्कर्ष (Conclusion)

National Voters Day 2026 सिर्फ एक औपचारिक कार्यक्रम नहीं, बल्कि लोकतंत्र को मजबूत करने की एक collective responsibility है।
AKTU द्वारा जारी यह Office Order यह स्पष्ट करता है कि विश्वविद्यालय केवल तकनीकी शिक्षा तक सीमित नहीं है, बल्कि Responsible Citizenship को भी उतना ही महत्व देता है।

अगर आप AKTU से जुड़े Student, Teacher या Staff हैं, तो
25 January 2026, सुबह 11 बजे
मतदाता शपथ लेकर
लोकतंत्र को मजबूत करने में अपना योगदान जरूर दें।

title.rendered: ISRO Internship Scheme & Student Project Trainee -Opportunity for Student Participation

content.rendered:
The Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO), through its Scientific Research and Training Division (SRTD) at the Space Applications Centre (SAC), has released an official notification announcing an opportunity for student participation under the ISRO Internship Scheme and Student Project Trainee Scheme. This initiative is designed to provide students from recognized universities and institutions across India with direct exposure to real-world space research, satellite applications, and advanced scientific development.

The opportunity for student participation – ISRO Internship Scheme & Student Project Trainee Scheme aims to nurture young talent by allowing students to work closely with ISRO scientists and engineers. Through structured internships and project training programs, students gain hands-on experience in cutting-edge domains such as space science, remote sensing, satellite technology, electronics, computer science, mechanical systems, and interdisciplinary research areas.

Overview of the ISRO Internship and Student Project Trainee Schemes

The ISRO Internship Scheme and Student Project Trainee Scheme are administered by SAC, Ahmedabad, under ISRO’s Department of Space. These programs are intended for undergraduate, postgraduate, and doctoral students who wish to enhance their academic knowledge through practical exposure.

The opportunity for student participation – ISRO Internship Scheme & Student Project Trainee Scheme allows students to engage in scientific research, technology development, and application-based projects aligned with ISRO’s ongoing missions and research priorities. Selected candidates work under the mentorship of experienced scientists, gaining invaluable insight into India’s space ecosystem.

Download official form–> click here

Download official notice–>click here

AKTU Official site–> Go

Academic and Research Benefits for Students

Participation in the ISRO internship or project trainee program offers numerous academic advantages. Students gain practical exposure to laboratory facilities, advanced instrumentation, data analysis systems, and real-time project environments. The opportunity for student participation – ISRO Internship Scheme & Student Project Trainee Scheme helps bridge the gap between theoretical learning and applied research.

Students also benefit from structured training, exposure to interdisciplinary collaboration, and guidance on research methodologies. For many candidates, this experience becomes a strong foundation for future careers in research, higher studies, or technical roles in space and allied sectors.

Eligibility Criteria for Applicants

As per the official instructions, candidates applying for the opportunity for student participation – ISRO Internship Scheme & Student Project Trainee Scheme must fulfill the following conditions:

Applicants must be citizens of India and must be enrolled as regular on-campus students in a recognized university or institution. SAC offers internships only to bona fide students for the full duration of the proposed internship or project training.

The schemes are open to students pursuing B.E./B.Tech, M.E./M.Tech, B.Sc., M.Sc., Diploma, and PhD programs, subject to completion of the required semester or coursework as prescribed in the official guidelines.

Application Submission Process

Candidates must submit a duly filled, signed, and scanned PDF copy of the application form via email. The application must be sent to the official email ID of SAC as mentioned in the notice.

The file name format is mandatory and must follow this structure:
ShortName_Degree_Subject_CGPA_Duration_ProposedJoiningDate_UniversityShortName_UniversityCity.pdf

The email subject line must follow the prescribed format, for example:
YourShortName_SRTD_Application_MobileNumber

A copy of the email must also be marked to the Bona fide certificate issuing authority, Head of Institute, or Placement Office. Incomplete applications or incorrectly formatted submissions are liable to be rejected. This step is critical for the opportunity for student participation – ISRO Internship Scheme & Student Project Trainee Scheme.

Important Timeline and Processing Guidelines

Applicants are strongly advised to submit their applications at least 45 days prior to the proposed joining date. This allows sufficient time for verification, screening, and administrative processing.

Due to the large number of applications received each year, ISRO may not be able to accommodate all candidates. Students are therefore encouraged to explore alternative internship options as a backup. If no selection email is received up to 7 days before the proposed joining date, the application should be considered unsuccessful for that cycle.

Selection Rules and Internship Conditions

Selected students are required to submit the hard copy of the original application form at the time of joining. A student is permitted to pursue only one internship per degree, and no parallel academic or professional assignment is allowed during the internship period.

The opportunity for student participation – ISRO Internship Scheme & Student Project Trainee Scheme does not provide any stipend, accommodation, or monetary compensation. Additionally, no application or processing fee is charged to candidates.

Code of Conduct and Verification Authority

During the internship or project training period, students must strictly adhere to the policies and guidelines of the Department of Space (DOS) and ISRO. SAC reserves the right to request original documents for verification at any stage.

Furthermore, SAC holds the authority to terminate the internship or project training if a candidate is found violating institutional rules or regulations. These conditions ensure discipline, confidentiality, and professional conduct within ISRO premises.

Declaration and Candidate Responsibility

Applicants must declare that all information provided in the application is true, complete, and correct to the best of their knowledge. Any false or misleading information may result in immediate cancellation of candidature.

By submitting the application, the candidate confirms that they have read and accepted all terms and conditions related to the opportunity for student participation – ISRO Internship Scheme & Student Project Trainee Scheme.

Conclusion

The opportunity for student participation – ISRO Internship Scheme & Student Project Trainee Scheme represents a prestigious platform for students aspiring to build careers in science, engineering, and space technology. With exposure to real-world research, national-level projects, and expert mentorship, this initiative plays a crucial role in shaping the next generation of Indian scientists and technologists.

Eligible students are encouraged to carefully follow the official instructions, submit applications well in advance, and prepare themselves for a competitive selection process. Participation in ISRO’s academic programs is not only a learning experience but also a milestone in a student’s professional journey.

title.rendered: AI for Bharat Hackathon 2026: Indian Developers के लिए ₹40 लाख का AI Opportunity

content.rendered:
AI for Bharat Hackathon 2026 उन Indian developers के लिए एक game-changing opportunity है, जो सिर्फ AI के बारे में पढ़ना नहीं, बल्कि real-world AI solutions build करना चाहते हैं। अगर आप student हैं, working professional, startup founder या freelancer — यह program आपको learning, building, recognition और rewards सब एक ही platform पर देता है।

आज India में AI skills की demand तेजी से बढ़ रही है, और AI for Bharat Hackathon 2026 इसी gap को fill करने के लिए launch किया गया है। यह सिर्फ एक hackathon नहीं, बल्कि एक end-to-end AI journey है — learning से लेकर national-level pitching तक।

AI for Bharat Hackathon 2026 क्या है?

AI for Bharat Hackathon 2026 एक nationwide AI initiative है, जिसे Hack2skill द्वारा organize किया गया है और इसमें Amazon Web Services (AWS) का strong sponsorship support है।

इस program का main objective है Indian developers को:

  • Generative AI और Cloud skills सिखाना
  • India-centric problems पर AI solutions build करवाना
  • Students और professionals को industry-level exposure देना

यह program completely online है, इसलिए India के किसी भी कोने से participate किया जा सकता है।

AI for Bharat Hackathon 2026 – Quick Overview

👉 Clearly, AI for Bharat Hackathon 2026 learning + earning दोनों का perfect combo है।

Program Structure: AI for Bharat Hackathon 2026

इस program को 2 major phases में divide किया गया है, ताकि participants step-by-step grow कर सकें।

Phase 1: Learning Phase (Foundation Build करने के लिए)

Learning Phase का goal है developers को AI + Cloud basics से लेकर advanced concepts तक prepare करना।

Learning Phase में क्या मिलेगा?

  • Live & On-demand workshops
  • Generative AI fundamentals
  • Intelligent agent design
  • Foundation model integration
  • Scalable AI architecture
  • Hands-on labs (Amazon Workshop Studio पर)

Certificate कैसे मिलेगा?

AI for Bharat Hackathon 2026 का official certificate पाने के लिए आपको:

  1. Workshop attend / watch करनी होगी
  2. Hands-on lab complete करना होगा
  3. AWS Builder Center पर technical blog publish करना होगा

✔️ यह certificate resume और LinkedIn profile के लिए highly valuable है।

Phase 2: Building Phase (National Hackathon)

Learning के बाद start होता है AI for Bharat Hackathon 2026 – Building Phase, जहां participants अपने ideas को functional AI prototypes में convert करते हैं।

Building Phase के benefits:

  • Cash prizes
  • AWS experts की mentorship
  • National recognition
  • Grand Finale में pitching opportunity

Who Can Participate in AI for Bharat Hackathon 2026?

AI for Bharat Hackathon 2026 exclusively Indian developers के लिए है:

  • Students – UG / PG enrolled
  • Professionals – Full-time या part-time working
  • Startups – AI-based products build करने वाले
  • Freelancers – Portfolio और credibility बढ़ाने के लिए

👉 चाहे आप beginner हों या experienced, AI for Bharat Hackathon 2026 हर level के developer को welcome करता है।

Hackathon Tracks & Problem Statements

🎓 Student Track

Student Track में focus होता है:

  • Innovative ideas
  • Early-stage prototypes
  • Community & social impact

Student Track Problem Areas:

  • AI for Learning & Developer Productivity
  • AI for Media, Content & Digital Experiences
  • AI for Communities, Access & Public Impact

Professional / Startup Track

Professional Track ज्यादा scalable और market-ready solutions पर focus करता है।

Professional Track Problem Areas:

  • AI for Retail, Commerce & Market Intelligence
  • AI for Healthcare & Life Sciences
  • AI for Rural Innovation & Sustainable Systems

Evaluation Criteria (Judging कैसे होगी?)

AI for Bharat Hackathon 2026 में judging structured और transparent है।

Judges खास तौर पर यह देखते हैं:

  • AI क्यों जरूरी है?
  • Solution real-world problems solve करता है या नहीं
  • India-centric impact कितना strong है

Final Submission Requirements

AI for Bharat Hackathon 2026 में final submission के लिए आपको यह सब देना होगा:

  • Functional AI prototype (Amazon Bedrock / Amazon Q)
  • GitHub code repository
  • Max 3-minute video pitch
  • Technical blog (AWS Builder Center)
  • Presentation deck (10–12 slides)

👉 Well-documented submissions के chances जीतने में ज्यादा होते हैं।

AI for Bharat Hackathon 2026 Timeline (Important Dates)

(Timeline tentative है और change हो सकता है)

Why You Should Join AI for Bharat Hackathon 2026?

अगर आप:

  • AI और Generative AI सीखना चाहते हैं
  • AWS tools के साथ hands-on experience चाहते हैं
  • ₹40 लाख prize pool के लिए compete करना चाहते हैं
  • Resume और portfolio strong बनाना चाहते हैं

तो AI for Bharat Hackathon 2026 आपके लिए must-join program है।

आज के time में सिर्फ certificates नहीं, real projects + exposure matter करता है — और यही चीज़ AI for Bharat Hackathon 2026 आपको provide करता है।

Conclusion

AI for Bharat Hackathon 2026 Indian developers के लिए एक rare opportunity है, जहां learning, building, networking और earning — चारों चीज़ें एक साथ मिलती हैं। अगर आप serious हैं AI career को लेकर, तो इस program को skip करना future में regret बन सकता है।

title.rendered: Important Circular Regarding Practical Examination Schedule of M.Sc. First Semester – University of Lucknow

content.rendered:
The University of Lucknow has issued an important circular regarding practical examination schedule of M.Sc. First Semester, providing official confirmation about the upcoming practical examinations for postgraduate students. This circular has been released by the Department of Computer Science and is meant to inform all concerned students about the finalized examination date, timing, and venue.

Such academic circulars play a vital role in ensuring transparency and smooth academic operations within the university. The important circular regarding practical examination schedule of M.Sc. First Semester is especially significant as it directly impacts students’ assessment and semester progression.

Official Announcement by the Department of Computer Science

According to the official notice released by the Department of Computer Science, University of Lucknow, the practical examination of M.Sc. First Semester has been scheduled for 24 January 2026. The examination will commence from 12:00 Noon onwards and will be conducted within the department premises itself.

The important circular regarding practical examination schedule of M.Sc. First Semester has been issued under the authority of the Head of the Department of Computer Science, which confirms that the information is accurate and officially approved. Students are advised to rely only on such authorized communications for examination-related updates.

Date, Time, and Examination Venue Details

As clearly mentioned in the circular, the M.Sc. First Semester practical examination will be held on Saturday, 24 January 2026. The reporting time begins at 12:00 Noon, and students are expected to be present before the examination starts.

The venue for the examination is the Department of Computer Science, University of Lucknow. No external examination center has been allotted, making it essential for students to reach the department campus on time. The important circular regarding practical examination schedule of M.Sc. First Semester does not mention batch-wise timing, therefore students should remain attentive to further departmental instructions.

Importance of Practical Examinations for M.Sc. Students

Practical examinations are a core component of postgraduate education, particularly in computer science programs. They assess not only theoretical understanding but also hands-on skills, logical thinking, and real-time problem-solving ability. The important circular regarding practical examination schedule of M.Sc. First Semester marks a crucial stage in the academic evaluation process.

Performance in practical exams significantly contributes to semester results. Hence, students are advised to complete all laboratory work, practical files, and internal assessments well in advance. Proper preparation aligned with the examination schedule can help students perform confidently and efficiently.

Instructions for Students Appearing in the Examination

The circular advises students to regularly check the Notice Board of the Department of Computer Science for any further updates or instructions. Universities often release additional guidelines such as lab allocations, viva schedules, or examination rules closer to the examination date.

Students appearing for the practical examination should carry their University Identity Card, laboratory records, and any other materials prescribed by the department. Following departmental rules and instructions is mandatory during the examination process. The important circular regarding practical examination schedule of M.Sc. First Semester should be treated as the primary reference until further notice.

University’s Approach to Examination Transparency

The University of Lucknow follows a structured and disciplined academic framework. By issuing the important circular regarding practical examination schedule of M.Sc. First Semester in advance, the university ensures that students receive timely and accurate information.

The notice has also been circulated to administrative authorities. A copy has been sent to the In-charge of the University Website for uploading on the official portal, ensuring digital accessibility. title.rendered: RGPV Students Big alert: क्या फिर से बदलेगा नया time table ?

content.rendered:
RGPV Students Big Alert – Rajiv Gandhi Proudyogiki Vishwavidyalaya (RGPV), Bhopal has officially released the B.Tech Examination Time Table for the December 2025 session. Since the notice went public, a common question is trending among students: Will the RGPV new time table change again?

RGPV B.Tech Time Table December 2025: Official Overview

According to the official notification issued by Rajiv Gandhi Proudyogiki Vishwavidyalaya, Bhopal, the following details apply to all B.Tech examinations:

  • Examination Session: December 2025
  • Exam Timing: 10:00 AM to 01:00 PM
  • Authority: Controller of Examinations, RGPV

Students are advised to strictly follow the dates and subject sequence mentioned in the notice.

1️⃣ B.Tech Semester I & II – Common for All Branches

The following schedule is applicable to B.Tech 1st and 2nd Semester students of all engineering branches.

📅 Examination Schedule

Practical Examinations: 06 March 2026 to 13 March 2026

2️⃣ B.Tech Semester I & II – CSBS (Computer Science & Business Systems)

RGPV has released a separate and structured timetable for CSBS students.

📅 CSBS Examination Schedule

CSBS Practical Exams: 12 March 2026 to 19 March 2026

3️⃣ B.Tech Semester III – Regular & Working Professional Students

For B.Tech 3rd Semester students, including Working Professionals, RGPV has issued a branch-wise timetable covering all engineering disciplines.

📅 Semester III Examination Pattern

Practical Examinations: 09 March 2026 to 16 March 2026

Each branch such as CSE, IT, ME, CE, EC, EX, AI, EV and others must follow its respective subject codes as mentioned in the official notice.

Downlaod notice from official site –> click here

RGPV Students Big Alert: Will the Time Table Change Again?

Impact on Academic Calendar and Festivals

Another major concern being raised by students is the extended examination duration. As per the current schedule, RGPV B.Tech examinations begin in early February and continue till mid-March, including theory and practical examinations. This results in an examination window of nearly one full month, which is unusually long for a single session.

Students have pointed out that this extended schedule directly overlaps with Holi celebrations, which generally fall in March. Due to continuous examinations, practicals, and internal assessments, many students may not get sufficient time to travel back to their hometowns or participate in festival-related activities. This has led to growing discussions among students regarding academic pressure, mental fatigue, and lack of adequate breaks during the examination period.

While no official statement has been released by RGPV addressing this concern, students are hoping that the university may consider optimizing the schedule or clustering examinations more efficiently, as seen in previous years. However, until any formal revision is announced, the current timetable remains valid and binding.

Given these factors, students are advised to plan their academic commitments carefully and stay updated through official RGPV notifications only. Any change, if approved by the university authorities, will be communicated through an official corrigendum.

This situation further strengthens the relevance of the RGPV Students Big Alert, as even a minor adjustment in dates could significantly impact student planning.

Important Instructions for Students

  • Carefully verify your admit card details and exam center
  • Follow the exact subject order mentioned in the timetable
  • Do not rely on unofficial sources or social media rumors
  • Keep checking the official RGPV website and university notices

Final Verdict

At present, the RGPV B.Tech December 2025 Time Table is officially confirmed and valid. Students should continue their exam preparation according to this schedule unless RGPV releases a new notice.

Any future update related to RGPV Students Big Alert, timetable revision, or exam postponement will be communicated only through official university channels.

title.rendered: Tata New Bike: 90km माइलेज के साथ सिर्फ ₹32,999? जानिए पूरी सच्चाई

content.rendered:
भारतीय टू-व्हीलर मार्केट में एक बार फिर से हलचल मच गई है। सोशल मीडिया और ऑटो न्यूज़ पोर्टल्स पर Tata New Bike को लेकर जबरदस्त चर्चा चल रही है। दावा किया जा रहा है कि Tata Motors जल्द ही अपनी नई Tata 125cc बाइक लॉन्च कर सकती है, जो लगभग 90km/l माइलेज और बेहद किफायती कीमत में आ सकती है। कुछ रिपोर्ट्स में इसकी कीमत ₹32,999 से ₹42,000 के बीच बताई जा रही है, जिसने बजट ग्राहकों की उत्सुकता और बढ़ा दी है।

इस ब्लॉग पोस्ट में हम आपको Tata New Bike से जुड़ी डिज़ाइन, इंजन, माइलेज, फीचर्स, कीमत और संभावित लॉन्च से जुड़ी हर जरूरी जानकारी आसान भाषा में बताएंगे।

प्रैक्टिकल स्टाइलिंग के साथ फ्रेश और मॉडर्न डिज़ाइन

Tata New Bike का डिज़ाइन सिंपल लेकिन यूथ-फ्रेंडली बताया जा रहा है। यह बाइक खासतौर पर रोज़मर्रा के इस्तेमाल को ध्यान में रखकर डिजाइन की जा सकती है।

संभावित डिज़ाइन हाइलाइट्स:

  • शार्प हेडलैंप और LED लाइटिंग
  • स्पोर्टी बॉडी ग्राफिक्स
  • स्टाइलिश फ्यूल टैंक
  • अलॉय व्हील्स और बॉडी-कलर्ड पैनल्स
  • सीधी और आरामदायक राइडिंग पोज़िशन

यह डिज़ाइन कॉलेज स्टूडेंट्स, ऑफिस गोअर्स और डेली कम्यूटर्स—सभी को ध्यान में रखकर तैयार किया जा सकता है।

पावरफुल 125cc इंजन और स्मूद परफॉर्मेंस

रिपोर्ट्स के अनुसार Tata New Bike में नया 125cc सिंगल-सिलेंडर इंजन दिया जा सकता है, जिसे खासतौर पर माइलेज और स्मूद राइड के लिए ट्यून किया जाएगा।

इंजन से जुड़ी उम्मीदें:

  • बेहतर लो-एंड टॉर्क
  • शहर के ट्रैफिक में आसान राइड
  • कम वाइब्रेशन और शांत ऑपरेशन
  • डेली यूज़ और डिलीवरी वर्क के लिए भरोसेमंद परफॉर्मेंस

यह इंजन उन लोगों के लिए परफेक्ट हो सकता है जो कम खर्च में ज्यादा चलने वाली बाइक चाहते हैं।

90km/l माइलेज – सबसे बड़ा प्लस पॉइंट

Tata New Bike 2025 की सबसे ज्यादा चर्चा इसके माइलेज को लेकर हो रही है। कहा जा रहा है कि यह बाइक लगभग 90km/l माइलेज दे सकती है, जो इसे भारत की सबसे ज्यादा फ्यूल एफिशिएंट 125cc बाइक्स में शामिल कर सकता है।

माइलेज ज्यादा होने के कारण:

  • हल्का फ्रेम
  • ऑप्टिमाइज़्ड इंजन ट्यूनिंग
  • बेहतर फ्यूल मैनेजमेंट टेक्नोलॉजी

आज के बढ़ते पेट्रोल प्राइस के दौर में यह माइलेज बजट यूज़र्स के लिए गेम-चेंजर साबित हो सकता है।

स्मार्ट डिजिटल कंसोल और मॉडर्न फीचर्स

Tata New Bike में कंपनी कई स्मार्ट फीचर्स देने की तैयारी कर सकती है, जो इसे युवाओं के लिए और भी आकर्षक बना देंगे।

संभावित फीचर्स:

  • फुल डिजिटल इंस्ट्रूमेंट क्लस्टर
  • स्पीडोमीटर, ट्रिप मीटर, फ्यूल इंडिकेटर
  • गियर पोज़िशन इंडिकेटर
  • USB मोबाइल चार्जिंग
  • साइड-स्टैंड इंजन कट-ऑफ
  • सर्विस रिमाइंडर

ये फीचर्स आमतौर पर महंगी बाइक्स में देखने को मिलते हैं, लेकिन Tata इन्हें बजट सेगमेंट में ला सकती है।

आरामदायक सस्पेंशन और आसान हैंडलिंग

भारतीय रोड कंडीशन को देखते हुए Tata New Bike में कंफर्टेबल सस्पेंशन सेटअप मिलने की उम्मीद है।

  • फ्रंट में टेलिस्कोपिक फोर्क्स
  • रियर में डुअल शॉक एब्जॉर्बर
  • हल्का और बैलेंस्ड चेसिस

इस सेटअप के साथ खराब सड़कों पर भी राइड स्मूद रहने की संभावना है।

सेफ्टी के लिए मजबूत ब्रेकिंग सिस्टम

सुरक्षा के मामले में भी Tata कोई समझौता नहीं करना चाहेगी।

संभावित सेफ्टी फीचर्स:

  • फ्रंट डिस्क ब्रेक
  • रियर ड्रम ब्रेक
  • कंबाइंड ब्रेकिंग सिस्टम (CBS)
  • ग्रिपी टायर्स

यह सिस्टम अचानक ब्रेकिंग के समय बेहतर कंट्रोल देने में मदद करेगा।

Tata New Bike की कीमत और रनिंग कॉस्ट

मीडिया रिपोर्ट्स के मुताबिक Tata New Bike 2025 की शुरुआती कीमत ₹32,999 से ₹42,000 के बीच हो सकती है। अगर यह कीमत सही साबित होती है, तो यह बाइक:

  • स्टूडेंट्स
  • पहली बार बाइक खरीदने वाले
  • मिडिल क्लास फैमिली
  • डिलीवरी राइडर्स

के लिए एक शानदार ऑप्शन बन सकती है। कम माइलेज खर्च और सस्ती सर्विस इसे लॉन्ग टर्म में किफायती बनाएगी।

Tata New Bike 2025 क्यों बन सकती है गेम-चेंजर?

Tata New Bike 2025 इसलिए खास मानी जा रही है क्योंकि इसमें:

  • दमदार 125cc इंजन
  • 90km/l का शानदार माइलेज
  • स्मार्ट डिजिटल फीचर्स
  • बेहद किफायती कीमत

का संतुलन देखने को मिल सकता है। यही वजह है कि लॉन्च से पहले ही यह बाइक चर्चा में बनी हुई है।

निष्कर्ष

अगर आप कम बजट में एक भरोसेमंद, स्टाइलिश और ज्यादा माइलेज देने वाली बाइक की तलाश में हैं, तो Tata New Bike 2025 आपके लिए एक बेहतरीन विकल्प साबित हो सकती है। हालांकि अभी कंपनी की ओर से कोई आधिकारिक घोषणा नहीं हुई है, लेकिन लॉन्च के बाद यह बाइक भारतीय कम्यूटर सेगमेंट में बड़ा बदलाव ला सकती है।

Disclaimer

इस लेख में दी गई जानकारी मीडिया रिपोर्ट्स और बाजार में चल रही चर्चाओं पर आधारित है। बाइक की कीमत, माइलेज और फीचर्स की आधिकारिक पुष्टि लॉन्च के समय ही होगी। खरीद से पहले कंपनी की आधिकारिक वेबसाइट या नजदीकी डीलरशिप से जानकारी जरूर जांच लें।
