title.rendered: Hero Splendor Electric 2026: 300Km Range, Smart Features और Petrol से पूरी आज़ादी

content.rendered:
भारत की सबसे भरोसेमंद बाइक Hero Splendor अब एक नए Electric अवतार में मार्केट में धमाल मचाने आ रही है। साल 2026 में Hero MotoCorp ने अपनी पहली Hero Splendor Electric को पेश कर दिया है, जो पुरानी Splendor की विश्वसनीयता और नई इलेक्ट्रिक टेक्नोलॉजी का शानदार कॉम्बिनेशन है।

कंपनी के अनुसार, यह इलेक्ट्रिक बाइक 240–300 किलोमीटर तक की रेंज, बेहद कम चार्जिंग कॉस्ट और स्मार्ट फीचर्स के साथ आती है। यही वजह है कि इसे भारत के मिडिल क्लास और डेली कम्यूटर्स के लिए एक Game Changer माना जा रहा है।

Hero Splendor Electric 2026 – Highlights

  • Range: 240–300 Km (Eco Mode)
  • Charging Cost: सिर्फ ₹10 में फुल चार्ज
  • Top Speed: 75 Km/h
  • 0–60 Km/h: मात्र 7 सेकंड
  • Price: ₹1.15 लाख से शुरू (Ex-Showroom)

डिजाइन और लुक (Design & Styling)

Hero Splendor Electric का डिजाइन जानबूझकर क्लासिक Splendor जैसा ही रखा गया है, ताकि पुराने ग्राहकों को अपनापन महसूस हो।

मुख्य डिजाइन अपडेट्स:

  • LED Headlamp & Tail Lamp
  • Fully Digital Instrument Cluster
  • Alloy Wheels
  • EV Blue Accent & Electric Badging

हल्का बॉडी फ्रेम बाइक को बेहतर बैटरी परफॉर्मेंस और शानदार माइलेज देता है, जो भारतीय सड़कों के लिए परफेक्ट है।

मोटर और बैटरी (Motor & Battery)

इस इलेक्ट्रिक बाइक में दिया गया है:

  • 5.5 kW Mid-Drive BLDC Motor
  • 3.5 kWh Detachable Lithium-ion Battery
  • IP67 Rating (Water & Dust Proof)

चार्जिंग टाइम:

  • Normal Charger: ~4 घंटे
  • Fast Charger: 1 घंटे में 80% चार्ज

रेंज और परफॉर्मेंस (Range & Performance)

Hero Splendor Electric की सबसे बड़ी ताकत इसकी लंबी रेंज है।

Riding Modes:

  • Eco Mode: 240–300 Km रेंज
  • Power Mode: 180 Km रेंज, तेज पिकअप

शहर की ट्रैफिक में यह बाइक स्मूद, साइलेंट और बेहद किफायती राइडिंग अनुभव देती है।

फीचर्स और टेक्नोलॉजी (Smart Features)

Hero Splendor Electric को बनाया गया है एक Smart Electric Bike:

  • Full Digital Speedometer
  • Bluetooth Connectivity & Mobile App
  • GPS Navigation & Anti-Theft Tracking
  • USB Charging Port
  • Smart Key & Push Start
  • Reverse Mode
  • Battery Health Monitoring
  • Auto Cut-off Charging

सस्पेंशन और ब्रेकिंग (Suspension & Brakes)

  • Front: Telescopic Suspension
  • Rear: Twin Shock Absorbers
  • Brakes: Dual Disc Brakes + CBS
  • Wheels: 18-inch Tubeless Tyres

यह सेटअप खराब सड़कों पर भी शानदार स्टेबिलिटी और सेफ्टी देता है।

कीमत और वेरिएंट (Price & Variants)

Hero Splendor Electric को दो वेरिएंट में लॉन्च किया गया है:

Pro Variant में बेहतर रेंज, बड़ी बैटरी और एक्स्ट्रा स्मार्ट फीचर्स मिलते हैं।

चार्जिंग सिस्टम

  • Home 5A Socket Support
  • Fast Charging Adapter Included

कंपनी आने वाले समय में भारतभर में Hero Electric Charging Stations लगाने की योजना पर भी काम कर रही है।

पर्यावरण और बचत (Eco Friendly & Savings)

  • Petrol Bike Cost: ~₹2/Km
  • Hero Splendor Electric Cost: ~₹0.20/Km

हर महीने ₹2000–₹3000 तक की बचत संभव है।
इसके साथ ही Zero Emission के कारण पर्यावरण को भी बड़ा फायदा मिलेगा।

भारतीय बाजार में मुकाबला

Hero Splendor Electric का मुकाबला इन बाइक्स से होगा:

  • Ola Electric Motorcycle
  • Revolt RV400
  • Oben Rorr
  • Tork Kratos R

लेकिन Hero ब्रांड ट्रस्ट + लंबी रेंज + किफायती कीमत इसे सबसे आगे खड़ा करती है।

निष्कर्ष (Conclusion)

Hero Splendor Electric 2026 सिर्फ एक नई बाइक नहीं, बल्कि भारत में Electric Mobility का नया युग है।
कम खर्च, लंबी रेंज, स्मार्ट फीचर्स और Hero का भरोसा — यह बाइक हर भारतीय राइडर के लिए एक परफेक्ट ऑप्शन बन सकती है।

अगर आप पेट्रोल से छुटकारा चाहते हैं और एक भरोसेमंद इलेक्ट्रिक बाइक की तलाश में हैं, तो Hero Splendor Electric आपके लिए बेस्ट चॉइस हो सकती है।

title.rendered: CodeMore Cybersecurity Internship 2026: Apply Online for Free Certificate by April 30

content.rendered:
CodeMore Cybersecurity Internship 2026 is one of the most searched Free Software Internship 2026 opportunities for students and freshers who want to build a strong career in cybersecurity. Launched in collaboration with Codelevate, this internship offers hands-on learning, industry exposure, and a free verified certificate, with the option to work remotely.

If you are looking for a cyber security internship for freshers or a cybersecurity internship remote, this program is worth applying for before the April 30, 2026 deadline.

About CodeMore Cybersecurity Internship 2026

The CodeMore Cybersecurity Internship 2026 is designed to help learners understand real-world cybersecurity concepts used to protect systems, networks, and sensitive data. Unlike basic theory courses, this Free Software Internship 2026 focuses on practical skills such as identifying vulnerabilities, understanding cyberattacks, and applying security controls.

Through guided labs and projects, interns learn how modern security teams operate in real organizations.

title.rendered: Visiting Students Research Programme (VSRP) – TIFR Hyderabad

content.rendered:
The Visiting Students Research Programme (VSRP) at TIFR Hyderabad is designed to enrich students’ academic experience and introduce them to the world of scientific research. This programme allows students to work closely with faculty members on research projects, helping them gain hands-on exposure and make informed decisions about pursuing a career in research.

Every year, TIFR Hyderabad hosts a limited number of visiting students under two major categories.

I. Summer Research Programme

The Summer Research Programme is conducted every year during May to July for a duration of 8 weeks. Students can join this programme through the following routes:

(a) TIFR Hyderabad Summer Research Programme

Students can directly apply to the Summer Research Programme hosted by TIFR Hyderabad.

(b) KVPY / Science Academies Route

Several faculty members at TIFR Hyderabad are associated with national Science Academies. Students selected under the Summer Research Fellowship Programme (SFRP) conducted by these academies may be allocated to TIFR Hyderabad faculty members.

Note:
Selection through this route is completely handled by the Science Academies, and allocation depends on the availability of positions with respective faculty members at TIFR Hyderabad.

Eligibility Criteria

For Route (a): TIFR Hyderabad Programme

  • Students from any stream who are:
    • In the final year of a 3-year B.Sc. programme, or
    • In the pre-final or final year of M.Sc., Integrated M.Sc., 4-year B.Sc., B.Tech., or B.E. programmes
  • Ph.D. students are not eligible
  • Students who have participated in the VSRP in previous years are not eligible to apply again

For Route (b): KVPY / Science Academies

  • Eligibility will be as per the rules and guidelines of the respective Science Academy or KVPY programme

Application Process

The call for VSRP 2026 is now open.

  • Interested candidates can apply online through the official application link
  • Selected students will be informed via email by mid-March 2026
  • Last date to submit applications:
    31 January 2026, 5:00 PM (IST)

For any queries related to the programme, students can write to:
visiting_students@tifrh.res.in

Stipend and Accommodation

For Route (a): TIFR Hyderabad Programme

  • Monthly stipend of ₹9,000
  • Travel reimbursement as per TIFR rules
  • Free shared accommodation provided by the institute

For Route (b): KVPY / Science Academies

  • Stipend and accommodation will be provided as per the respective academy’s rules

II. Semester / Long-Term Visiting Students Research Programme

Apart from the summer programme, TIFR Hyderabad also offers opportunities for semester-long or long-term visiting students.

Some faculty members collaborate with institutions that allow students enrolled in undergraduate, integrated, or professional programmes to earn research credits outside their home institutions. Interested students may apply directly to faculty members through their parent institution.

Additionally, TIFR Hyderabad hosts visiting students throughout the year for:

  • Master’s degree final-year projects
  • Professional degree final-year research projects

The duration of the visit depends on the nature and scope of the research project.

Accommodation may be provided subject to availability.

Contact Information

For further information, candidates may contact:

Coordinator – VSRP
Tata Institute of Fundamental Research
36/P, Gopanpally Village,
Serilingampally Mandal,
Ranga Reddy District,
Hyderabad – 500046, India

Email: visiting_students@tifrh.res.in

official article-> read here

Why VSRP at TIFR Hyderabad Is a Valuable Opportunity

Participating in the Visiting Students Research Programme (VSRP) at TIFR Hyderabad can be a life-changing academic experience for students who are curious about research and higher studies. Unlike regular classroom learning, VSRP allows students to work on real research problems under the guidance of experienced scientists and researchers. This exposure helps students understand how research ideas are developed, tested, and communicated in professional academic environments.

Another major advantage of the programme is the opportunity to interact with students and researchers from diverse academic backgrounds. This collaborative environment enhances critical thinking, problem-solving skills, and scientific communication. Many students also gain clarity about pursuing M.Sc., Ph.D., or research-oriented careers after completing their undergraduate or postgraduate studies.

Moreover, participation in VSRP strengthens a student’s academic profile. Research experience at a reputed institute like TIFR is highly valued in applications for higher education, fellowships, and international universities. Students often use the work done during VSRP as a foundation for future projects, research papers, or recommendations.

Overall, VSRP is not just a short-term programme but a gateway to long-term academic growth. For students who wish to explore research seriously, the Visiting Students Research Programme at TIFR Hyderabad provides the right environment, mentorship, and exposure to take the next step confidently.

title.rendered: AKTU AI Manthan 2026: Why This Opportunity Matters for Serious AI Startups (Apply Before 24 January)

content.rendered:
If you are working on a real AI product, building a functional prototype, or running an early-stage AI startup, then AKTU AI Manthan 2026 deserves your attention. This is not a routine college event or a casual hackathon. It is a selection-based, government-supported AI platform where only 10 startups will be chosen to present their work before senior academic leaders and government authorities.

The program is being organized by Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University (AKTU), Lucknow, with a clear focus on practical Artificial Intelligence applications that can be deployed in education, governance, healthcare, and public systems.

What Is AKTU AI Manthan 2026?

AKTU AI Manthan 2026 is a flagship initiative focused on understanding the challenges and opportunities of Artificial Intelligence in higher and technical education. Alongside expert discussions, the event features a highly selective AI Startup Showcasing Zone.

This showcasing zone is meant for startups that have moved beyond ideas and are ready to demonstrate:

  • A working AI product
  • A functional MVP
  • Or a deployable prototype

In short, this platform is designed for execution-driven AI teams, not concept-stage projects.

Why the AI Startup Showcasing Zone Is Important

Participation in the showcasing zone is not open to everyone. Only 10 AI startups will be shortlisted after evaluation.

This makes the event valuable for one key reason:
you are presenting in front of people who can actually approve pilots, deployments, and collaborations.

For selected startups, this is an opportunity to:

  • Demonstrate real AI solutions
  • Gain credibility at the state and national level
  • Build direct connections with decision-makers

Unlike many startup events, the focus here is not on pitches alone, but on real-world usability and impact.

Important Dates and Venue

Key Dates

  • Event Dates: 27–28 January 2026
  • Last Date to Apply: 24 January 2026 (till 6:00 PM)

Venue

  • Vishvesharaya Hall, 4th Floor
  • Administrative Building, AKTU Campus, Lucknow
  • Startup stalls and registration: Ground Floor

Applications submitted after the deadline are unlikely to be considered.

Benefits for Selected AI Startups

Startups selected for AKTU AI Manthan 2026 will receive benefits that go beyond visibility.

These include:

  • Live demonstration of AI-based products or solutions
  • Certificate awarded by the Hon’ble Governor of Uttar Pradesh
  • Opportunity for direct interaction with senior leadership
  • Networking with Vice Chancellors, Directors, and academic heads
  • Exposure to policymakers and ecosystem leaders
  • Potential for B2G and institutional collaborations
  • Strong credibility for future funding and pilots

AKTU positions this event as a launchpad for real implementation, not just recognition.

How Startups Are Selected

Applications will be evaluated on multiple practical factors, including:

  • Relevance of the problem being solved
  • Use of AI as a core technology
  • Development stage (working solution preferred)
  • Innovation and originality
  • Social, economic, or governance impact
  • Scalability and deployment readiness
  • Team clarity and execution strength

The evaluation focuses more on what works today than on what might work someday.

Who Can Apply for AKTU AI Manthan 2026

You are eligible to apply if your startup:

  • Is AI-based
  • Is founded by students, alumni, or supported by faculty
  • Is registered under DPIIT
  • Has a working prototype, MVP, or deployed solution

Supported Domains

  • Education
  • Healthcare
  • Agriculture
  • Governance
  • Smart Cities
  • Cybersecurity
  • FinTech
  • Sustainability

How to Apply

All interested startups must apply through the official registration form:

Application Link: https://bit.ly/45hAmhI

Applications can also be submitted using the QR code mentioned in the official AKTU notification.

The deadline to apply is 24 January 2026, 6:00 PM.

Frequently Asked Questions

Is there any registration fee?
No registration fee has been mentioned in the official notification.

How many startups will be selected?
Only 10 AI startups will be shortlisted.

Is this event limited to AKTU students only?
No. Student-founded, alumni-founded, and faculty-supported startups from across India can apply.

Where will the event be held?
At the AKTU Campus, Lucknow, in the Administrative Building.

Practical Tips Before Applying

If you plan to apply, keep these points in mind:

  • Focus on showing a working solution
  • Clearly explain how AI is used in your product
  • Highlight real impact and use cases
  • Keep answers simple and honest
  • Avoid exaggerated claims
  • Submit the form well before the deadline

Final Thoughts

AKTU AI Manthan 2026 is a rare opportunity for AI startups seeking meaningful exposure, government-level credibility, and real implementation possibilities. With only 10 startups being selected, competition will be strong, but the value of participation is equally high.

If your AI solution is ready to be seen, this is the right platform.

Apply before 24 January 2026, 6:00 PM.

content.rendered:
Financial Accounting & Analysis is one of the most important and scoring subjects in the MBA 1st Semester under AKTU. For many students, this subject feels challenging at the beginning because it involves numbers, formats, and interpretation of financial statements. However, if prepared correctly using Previous Year Question Papers (PYQs), this subject can become one of the easiest to score well in.

On this page, you will get a clear idea about the subject, syllabus focus, commonly asked questions, and how to use PYQs effectively for better performance.

About Financial Accounting & Analysis (MBA 1st Sem – AKTU)

Financial Accounting & Analysis focuses on recording, summarizing, and interpreting financial information of a business. The subject helps MBA students understand how financial data is prepared and how it is used for decision-making by managers, investors, and other stakeholders.

In the AKTU MBA syllabus, this subject is designed to build a strong foundation in accounting concepts and financial statement analysis. It combines theoretical concepts with practical numerical problems, which makes PYQ-based preparation extremely useful.

Key areas covered in this subject include:

  • Basic accounting concepts and principles
  • Journal entries and final accounts
  • Financial statements
  • Cost concepts and depreciation
  • Financial statement analysis

Syllabus Overview with Exam-Oriented Focus

To use PYQs effectively, it is important to know which syllabus units are most important.

Unit 1: Accounting Concepts and Principles

This unit covers basic accounting terms, accounting standards, and fundamental principles. Questions like definitions, advantages, and limitations of accounting are often asked.

Unit 2: Accounting Process and Final Accounts

This unit is highly important for numerical questions. Topics include:

  • Journal entries
  • Trial balance
  • Trading account
  • Profit & Loss account
  • Balance sheet

Most MBA 1st Semester PYQ (Financial Accounting & Analysis) include at least one full numerical from this unit.

Unit 3: Depreciation Accounting

Questions on methods of depreciation such as:

  • Straight Line Method
  • Written Down Value Method
  • Advantages and disadvantages of depreciation

These questions are frequently repeated in PYQs.

Unit 4: Financial Statements

This unit focuses on preparation and interpretation of financial statements. Both theory and numerical questions are common from this section.

Unit 5: Financial Statement Analysis

This is one of the most scoring units. Topics include:

  • Ratio analysis
  • Liquidity ratios
  • Profitability ratios
  • Solvency ratios

Numerical problems from ratio analysis appear almost every year.

Commonly Asked Questions in Previous Year Papers

Based on analysis of MBA 1st Semester PYQ (Financial Accounting & Analysis), the following questions are repeatedly asked:

  • Define financial accounting. Explain its objectives.
  • Explain accounting concepts and conventions.
  • Prepare Trading and Profit & Loss Account from given data.
  • Calculate depreciation using Straight Line and WDV methods.
  • What is financial statement analysis? Explain its importance.
  • Calculate liquidity and profitability ratios.
  • Difference between financial accounting and management accounting.

Consumer Behaviour is the study of individuals, groups, or organizations and the processes they use to select, purchase, use, and dispose of products or services. It helps marketers understand why consumers behave the way they do in the marketplace.

Neuro Marketing, on the other hand, is an emerging field that applies neuroscience techniques to marketing research. Together, Consumer Behaviour and Neuro Marketing help organizations design better marketing strategies based on real consumer insights.

title.rendered: JEE Main 2026 Admit Card Released: Complete Modern Guide for January Session 1 Candidates

content.rendered:
The JEE Main 2026 Admit Card has officially been released by the National Testing Agency (NTA) for candidates appearing in Session 1 (January 2026). According to the public notice dated 17 January 2026, students whose examinations are scheduled on 21, 22, 23, and 24 January 2026 can now download their JEE Main 2026 Admit Card from the official website jeemain.nta.nic.in.

This update marks a crucial phase for lakhs of engineering aspirants across India and abroad, as the admit card is a mandatory document to appear in the examination.

DOWNLOAD CIRCULAR

What Is JEE Main 2026 Session 1?

The Joint Entrance Examination (JEE) Main 2026 is conducted in two sessions—January and April. Session 1 (January attempt) gives candidates an early opportunity to qualify for top engineering institutions and improve their scores in the next session if required.

The JEE Main 2026 Admit Card for Session 1 confirms:

  • Exam date and shift
  • Exam city and centre
  • Candidate identity and eligibility

Without the JEE Main 2026 Admit Card, entry into the examination hall is strictly prohibited.

JEE Main 2026 Exam Dates and Admit Card Schedule

As per the official notice, the admit card release and exam schedule are as follows:

📅 Exams on 21, 22, 23 & 24 January 2026

  • Paper: Paper 1 (B.E./B.Tech)
  • Admit Card Status: Released
  • Admit Card Release Date: 17 January 2026

📅 Exams on 28 & 29 January 2026

  • Papers Included:
    • Paper 1 (B.E./B.Tech)
    • Paper 2A (B.Arch)
    • Paper 2B (B.Planning)
    • Paper 2A & 2B (B.Arch + B.Planning)
  • Admit Card Status: Will be released in due course

Candidates appearing on later dates should regularly check the official website for updates related to the JEE Main 2026 Admit Card.

JEE Main 2026 Exam Shift Timings

The examination will be conducted in two shifts per day under Indian Standard Time (IST):

  • First Shift: 09:00 AM to 12:00 Noon
  • Second Shift: 03:00 PM to 06:00 PM
    (In some cases, second shift may extend up to 06:30 PM)

The exact shift allotted to each candidate is clearly mentioned on the JEE Main 2026 Admit Card.

How to Download JEE Main 2026 Admit Card (Step-by-Step)

Follow these steps carefully to download your JEE Main 2026 Admit Card:

  1. Visit https://jeemain.nta.nic.in
  2. Click on “JEE Main 2026 Admit Card – Session 1”
  3. Enter your Application Number and Date of Birth
  4. Click on Submit
  5. Download the JEE Main 2026 Admit Card PDF
  6. Take at least two printouts for safety

👉 Important: Ensure the QR Code and Barcode are visible on the JEE Main 2026 Admit Card.

Details to Verify on JEE Main 2026 Admit Card

After downloading, candidates must verify the following details on their JEE Main 2026 Admit Card:

  • Candidate Name
  • Roll Number
  • Application Number
  • Exam Date and Shift
  • Exam Centre Address
  • Photograph and Signature
  • QR Code and Barcode
  • Exam Day Instructions

Any discrepancy should be reported immediately to NTA.

Exam City and Centre Guidelines

NTA has already informed candidates about their exam city in advance. The exact centre address, reporting time, and gate closing time are mentioned on the JEE Main 2026 Admit Card.

Candidates are advised to:

  • Visit the exam centre location a day before the exam
  • Plan travel in advance
  • Reach the centre well before reporting time

Exam Day Do’s and Don’ts (Important)

✅ Do’s

  • Carry a printed JEE Main 2026 Admit Card
  • Bring the same Photo ID uploaded during registration
  • Follow subject-specific instructions
  • Maintain discipline during the exam

❌ Don’ts

  • No mobile phones, calculators, smart watches, or electronic gadgets
  • No papers, notes, or study material
  • No unfair practices

Violation of rules can lead to cancellation of candidature.

Problem Downloading JEE Main 2026 Admit Card? Here’s Help

If a candidate faces issues while downloading the JEE Main 2026 Admit Card, NTA provides official support:

  • Helpline Number: 011-40759000
  • Email: jeemain@nta.ac.in

Always mention your application number while contacting support.

Official Websites for JEE Main 2026 Updates

For authentic and latest information related to the JEE Main 2026 Admit Card, candidates should visit only:

  • www.nta.ac.in
  • https://jeemain.nta.nic.in

Avoid unofficial sources and social media rumours.

Why JEE Main 2026 Admit Card Is Extremely Important

The JEE Main 2026 Admit Card is not just a hall ticket—it is:

  • Proof of eligibility
  • Proof of identity
  • Confirmation of exam centre and shift
  • Mandatory entry document

No candidate is allowed to appear for the exam without a valid JEE Main 2026 Admit Card and photo ID.

READ MORE : Free WordPress Development Course 2026: Learn Website Building at No Fees, No Coding Degree

Final Conclusion

The release of the JEE Main 2026 Admit Card is a critical moment for candidates appearing in the January Session 1 examination. Students scheduled for 21–24 January 2026 should immediately download and verify their admit cards, while those appearing on 28–29 January 2026 must wait for the next update.

Staying calm, following instructions, and preparing smartly will help candidates perform their best in JEE Main 2026. We wish all aspirants success in their examination journey.

content.rendered:

In this blog post, you’ll find complete details about free WordPress development courses, who can apply, what you’ll learn, skills you’ll gain, and how this can help you build a career in 2026.

About the Free WordPress Development Course 2026

The Free WordPress Development Course 2026 is designed for beginners and aspiring web developers who want practical, job-ready skills. These courses focus on real-world WordPress development, including content management, theme customization, plugin basics, and website security.

Many platforms now provide interactive learning, where you can practice concepts, test your understanding, and build projects step by step. You start with WordPress fundamentals and gradually move to advanced development techniques.

By the end of the course, you will be able to:

  • Build complete WordPress websites
  • Customize themes and layouts
  • Manage users and content efficiently
  • Improve performance and security

A basic knowledge of HTML, CSS, or PHP is helpful, but not compulsory for beginners.

Why Learn WordPress Development in 2026?

WordPress continues to dominate the web. Millions of websites worldwide run on WordPress, making it a valuable skill for the future.

Key reasons to learn WordPress in 2026:

  • High demand: Businesses, startups, and bloggers need WordPress developers
  • Low entry barrier: No computer science degree required
  • Freelancing opportunities: Many developers earn ₹30,000 to ₹1 lakh per month through freelance work
  • Career growth: Entry-level WordPress roles offer good starting packages in India
  • Future-ready: WordPress is integrating AI tools, block editors, and automation features

A Free WordPress Development Course allows you to learn all this without financial pressure.

Who Can Apply for Free WordPress Development Courses?

These courses are open to almost everyone. There are no strict eligibility criteria.

Eligible learners include:

  • Students: Engineering, commerce, arts, or diploma students
  • Freshers: 12th pass or college dropouts looking for skills
  • Career switchers: Non-technical professionals entering IT
  • Freelancers: Wanting to add WordPress services
  • Small business owners: To create and manage their own websites

All you need is:

  • A laptop or desktop
  • Stable internet connection
  • Willingness to practice

What Will You Learn?

A good WordPress Development Course 2026 covers both basics and advanced topics.

Core learning areas:

  • WordPress installation and setup
  • Understanding themes, plugins, and the WordPress dashboard
  • Hooks, filters, shortcodes, and the WordPress loop
  • Creating custom post types and taxonomies
  • Theme development (templates, menus, widgets)
  • AJAX and cron jobs for dynamic features
  • Database interaction using WPDB
  • Website performance optimization
  • WordPress security best practices

Most courses include hands-on projects, helping you learn by doing.

Skills You’ll Gain

After completing a free WordPress development course, you’ll gain in-demand technical skills:

  • WordPress development
  • PHP basics
  • HTML & CSS
  • JavaScript and jQuery
  • MySQL & database management
  • Content Management Systems (CMS)
  • Website security fundamentals
  • AJAX implementation
  • Web development workflow

These skills are useful for jobs, freelancing, and personal projects.

Benefits of a Free WordPress Development Course

Choosing a free course comes with many advantages:

  • Zero cost learning: No fees, no risk
  • Hands-on experience: Build real websites
  • Flexible schedule: Learn at your own pace
  • Portfolio ready: Showcase your work to clients or employers
  • Career opportunities: Freelance, job, or startup support
  • Community support: Get help from forums and learner groups

Many learners start earning within a few months after completing their first WordPress projects.

A Free WordPress Development Course 2026 is an excellent opportunity to learn website building at zero cost. Whether you are a student, fresher, freelancer, or business owner, WordPress skills can open multiple income and career paths.

With consistent practice and real projects, you can move from beginner to professional without spending money on expensive courses.

content.rendered:
UP Board 10th OMR Sheet 2026 Download – पूरी जानकारी हिंदी में

UP Board 10th OMR Sheet 2026 Download: उत्तर प्रदेश माध्यमिक शिक्षा परिषद (UPMSP) द्वारा कक्षा 10वीं की बोर्ड परीक्षा 2026 में कुछ विषयों के लिए OMR शीट का प्रयोग किया जाता है। ऐसे में सभी छात्रों के लिए यह जानना बेहद जरूरी हो जाता है कि OMR शीट क्या होती है, इसे कैसे भरा जाता है और कौन-सी गलतियाँ करने से नंबर कट सकते हैं।

हर साल हजारों छात्र केवल OMR शीट भरने में हुई छोटी-सी गलती के कारण अपने कीमती अंक खो देते हैं। यही कारण है कि परीक्षा से पहले OMR शीट का अभ्यास करना बहुत जरूरी हो जाता है। इस आर्टिकल में हम आपको UP Board 10th OMR Sheet 2026 PDF डाउनलोड करने का तरीका, सही भरने की प्रक्रिया और जरूरी सावधानियों के बारे में विस्तार से बताएंगे।

अगर आप ऐसी ही परीक्षा से जुड़ी सही और भरोसेमंद जानकारी चाहते हैं, तो आप www.notesgallery.com पर विज़िट कर सकते हैं, जहाँ छात्रों के लिए नोट्स, पीडीएफ और गाइड उपलब्ध कराई जाती है।

  • UP Board 10th OMR Sheet 2026 Download – Overview
  • OMR शीट में गलती करने पर कितने नंबर कट सकते हैं
  • UP Board OMR Sheet भरने का सही तरीका (Step by Step)
  • OMR Sheet भरते समय ध्यान रखने योग्य मुख्य बातें

UP Board 10th OMR Sheet 2026 क्या है?

OMR (Optical Mark Recognition) शीट एक विशेष प्रकार की उत्तर पुस्तिका होती है, जिसे कंप्यूटराइज्ड मशीन के माध्यम से चेक किया जाता है। इसमें छात्रों को दिए गए विकल्पों (A, B, C, D) में से सही उत्तर वाले गोले को पूरी तरह काला करना होता है।

UP Board 10वीं की परीक्षा में आमतौर पर 20 ऑब्जेक्टिव प्रश्न OMR शीट पर पूछे जाते हैं। इन 20 प्रश्नों के पूरे 20 नंबर होते हैं, यानी यदि OMR शीट गलत भर दी गई तो पूरा नुकसान हो सकता है।

UP Board 10th OMR Sheet 2026 Download – Overview

छात्र UPMSP की आधिकारिक वेबसाइट से या भरोसेमंद एजुकेशन प्लेटफॉर्म जैसे www.notesgallery.com से OMR शीट का सैंपल डाउनलोड करके अभ्यास कर सकते हैं।

यूपी बोर्ड 10वीं OMR शीट में गलती करने पर कटेंगे नंबर

यदि आप साल 2026 में UP Board 10वीं की परीक्षा देने जा रहे हैं, तो यह जानकारी आपके लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है। OMR शीट को कोई शिक्षक नहीं बल्कि कंप्यूटर मशीन चेक करती है।

कंप्यूटर किसी तरह की भावना या अनुमान नहीं लगाता। अगर आपने:

  • गलत गोला भर दिया
  • एक से अधिक गोले भर दिए
  • व्हाइटनर या कट-पीट का प्रयोग किया
  • रोल नंबर या विषय कोड गलत भरा

तो आपकी OMR शीट अमान्य (Invalid) मानी जा सकती है और आपके पूरे 20 नंबर भी कट सकते हैं।

इसीलिए परीक्षा से पहले OMR शीट भरने की प्रैक्टिस करना बेहद जरूरी है, जिसकी PDF आप www.notesgallery.com से आसानी से डाउनलोड कर सकते हैं।

UP Board OMR Sheet भरने का सही तरीका (Step by Step)

OMR शीट भरते समय नीचे दिए गए सभी स्टेप्स को ध्यान से फॉलो करें:

OMR शीट को ध्यान से पढ़ें

सबसे पहले परीक्षा में दी गई OMR शीट के सभी निर्देशों को ध्यानपूर्वक पढ़ें।

सही पेन का प्रयोग करें

OMR शीट केवल काले या नीले बॉल पेन से ही भरें। जेल पेन या पेंसिल का प्रयोग न करें।

रोल नंबर भरें

अपना रोल नंबर पहले बॉक्स में अंकों में लिखें, फिर नीचे दिए गए संबंधित गोले को सही तरीके से काला करें।

विषय कोड दर्ज करें

विषय का कोड भी उसी तरह भरें जैसे रोल नंबर भरा जाता है।

सही उत्तर का चयन करें

हर प्रश्न के लिए केवल एक ही विकल्प (A, B, C या D) का गोला पूरी तरह काला करें।

कट-पीट या व्हाइटनर न करें

OMR शीट पर व्हाइटनर, रबर या कट का प्रयोग बिल्कुल न करें।

OMR Sheet भरते समय रखें ये खास बातें

  • गोले को हल्का नहीं, पूरा काला करें
  • एक प्रश्न में दो गोले कभी न भरें
  • रोल नंबर और विषय कोड दोबारा चेक करें
  • OMR शीट को मोड़ें नहीं
  • शीट को साफ और सुरक्षित रखें

क्योंकि OMR शीट मशीन से चेक होती है, इसलिए गलती सुधारने का कोई मौका नहीं मिलता।

निष्कर्ष (Conclusion)

UP Board 10th OMR Sheet 2026 परीक्षा का एक बेहद अहम हिस्सा है। अगर आपने इसे सही तरीके से भर लिया, तो आपके पूरे 20 नंबर सुरक्षित रहेंगे। लेकिन अगर थोड़ी-सी भी लापरवाही की, तो बड़ा नुकसान हो सकता है।

title.rendered: Zorvyn Fintech SDET Internship 2026: ₹40,000 Monthly Stipend, Remote Opportunity

content.rendered:
Zorvyn Fintech SDET Internship 2026 is now open for applications, offering a high-paying ₹40,000 monthly stipend for aspiring software engineers and testers. This internship is specially designed for freshers and early-career candidates who want real-world exposure in the FinTech domain while working on scalable, production-level systems.

With a remote-first work culture, structured mentorship, and the possibility of a Pre-Placement Offer (PPO), this internship stands out as one of the best SDET internships in India for 2026.

About Zorvyn Fintech

Zorvyn Fintech is a technology-driven financial company focused on building secure, high-performance digital solutions for modern financial systems. The company works at the intersection of software engineering, automation, and financial architecture, making it an ideal place for students who want strong industry exposure.

What is an SDET Internship?

An SDET (Software Development Engineer in Test) Internship blends software development and testing into a single role. Instead of only finding bugs, SDETs design automation frameworks, write testable code, and ensure long-term product quality.

During this internship, selected candidates will:

  • Work on backend systems and automation tools
  • Learn industry-standard testing and development workflows
  • Collaborate with developers, QA teams, and product managers

This role is ideal for students who enjoy coding + problem solving, not just manual testing.

Who Can Apply for Zorvyn Fintech SDET Internship?

Zorvyn Fintech is looking for motivated and curious learners. You can apply if you have:

  • Strong basics of programming and data structures
  • Knowledge of C, C++, Java, or similar languages
  • Understanding of object-oriented programming (OOPs)
  • Familiarity with Git or version control systems
  • Logical thinking and debugging skills
  • Willingness to learn new tools and workflows

📌 Freshers, final-year students, and recent graduates are welcome
📌 Prior projects or internships are a plus
📌 Women and diverse candidates are encouraged to apply

Roles & Responsibilities

As an SDET Intern at Zorvyn Fintech, you will:

  • Work closely with senior engineers on live software systems
  • Write clean, readable, and maintainable code
  • Assist in testing APIs, microservices, and backend workflows
  • Participate in code reviews and debugging sessions
  • Help improve system performance, reliability, and security
  • Learn CI/CD, unit testing, and automation best practices

This internship focuses on learning by building, not just theory.

Perks & Benefits

The Zorvyn Fintech SDET Internship 2026 offers more than just a stipend:

  • 💰 ₹40,000 monthly stipend
  • 🏠 Remote work (Worldwide)
  • 👨‍🏫 Dedicated mentorship from experienced engineers
  • 📚 Access to internal learning resources and workshops
  • 🧠 Hands-on experience with FinTech systems
  • 🚀 Pre-Placement Offer (PPO) up to ₹14 LPA, based on performance

Why Learning SDET Skills is a Smart Career Move

SDET roles are among the fastest-growing tech careers globally.

  • 🔥 High demand for automation engineers in India
  • 🤖 Automation & AI testing replacing manual testing rapidly
  • 💼 SDETs earn 20–30% higher salaries than manual testers
  • 🔄 Career flexibility (DevOps, QA Lead, Backend Development)
  • 🧩 Strong problem-solving and coding exposure

This internship helps you build these skills in a real industry environment.

Internship Details at a Glance

How to Apply for Zorvyn Fintech SDET Internship?

Interested candidates can apply through the official Zorvyn Fintech application portal.

Direct Link

👉 Apply as early as possible — limited seats available and applications are reviewed on a rolling basis.

The Zorvyn Fintech SDET Internship 2026 is a golden opportunity for students and freshers who want:

  • A high stipend internship
  • Remote work flexibility
  • Strong exposure to software development and testing

If you’re serious about building a career in software engineering, automation, or FinTech, this internship is absolutely worth applying for.

title.rendered: AKTU Digital Tabulation Register (DTR) Notice 2026: Important Instructions for Colleges

content.rendered:
AKTU Digital Tabulation Register: Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University (AKTU), Lucknow has officially issued an important notice regarding the Digital Tabulation Register (DTR) for the Odd Semester Examinations Session 2025–26. This notice is crucial for all affiliated institutions, principals, examination in-charges, and ERP coordinators.

The university has clearly instructed colleges to verify, authenticate, and complete the Digital Tabulation Register (DTR) process on the ERP portal within the prescribed time to ensure timely declaration of results.

Below is a detailed, student- and college-friendly explanation of the official AKTU DTR notice.

What is Digital Tabulation Register (DTR)?

The Digital Tabulation Register (DTR) is an online academic record that contains internal assessment marks of students. These marks are uploaded by colleges on the AKTU ERP portal and later used for:

  • Final result preparation
  • Error-free evaluation
  • Transparent academic record management

Without proper DTR submission and verification, results cannot be declared.

AKTU Official Notice Overview

According to the notice issued by Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University, the following key points have been highlighted:

  • The Odd Semester written examinations were conducted from 23 December 2025 to 31 January 2026
  • Colleges have already uploaded internal marks (DTR) on the ERP portal
  • Now, institutions must verify, authenticate, and finalize the uploaded DTR data

This directive applies to regular students of various programs including B.Tech, B.Pharm, and other courses.

Important Instructions for Colleges (AKTU DTR 2026)

AKTU has strictly instructed all affiliated institutions to follow these steps:

✅ Step 1: Login to ERP Portal

  • Use your Institute ERP Login
  • Access the Digital Tabulation Register (DTR) section

✅ Step 2: Verify Internal Marks

  • Carefully check:
    • Student roll numbers
    • Subject codes
    • Internal assessment marks
  • Ensure there are no errors or missing entries

✅ Step 3: Authenticate DTR

  • DTR must be verified and authenticated
  • Authentication should include:
    • Proper approval
    • Supporting documents (if required)

✅ Step 4: Final Submission

  • Submit the verified DTR online
  • In case of discrepancies, resolve them before final submission

Failure to complete these steps may result in delay of examination results.

Why AKTU DTR Verification is Important?

The university has emphasized that:

  • Incomplete or incorrect DTR data can:
    • Delay result declaration
    • Create academic discrepancies
    • Affect students’ future admissions or placements

That is why AKTU has asked colleges to take this process very seriously and complete it on priority.

Email Support for DTR Issues

If any institution faces technical issues or discrepancies during verification, AKTU has provided an official email support:

📧 dcoeexam@aktu.ac.in

Colleges can send their issues with proper details for quick resolution.

Who Issued the Notice?

The notice has been issued by the Examination Controller, AKTU, and circulated to:

  • Joint Examination Controllers
  • ERP In-charge officers
  • Concerned university officials

This ensures that the message reaches all levels of examination administration.

Impact on Students

Although this notice is primarily for colleges, students should be aware that:

  • Their results depend on DTR completion
  • Delay by college = delay in result
  • Students are advised to:
    • Stay in touch with their college examination cell
    • Regularly check AKTU result updates

also read : AKTU Odd Semester 2025–26 Practical Exam Date Extension: Big Relief for Students

Final Words

The AKTU Digital Tabulation Register (DTR) Notice 2026 is a critical step toward ensuring transparent, accurate, and timely result declaration for Odd Semester examinations.

All affiliated colleges must complete the verification and authentication process without delay to avoid any inconvenience to students.

For students, this means results are expected only after successful DTR submission by colleges.

title.rendered: ISRO RESPOND Basket 2026: AKTU Invites Research Proposals from Affiliated Colleges (Apply by 31 January 2026)

content.rendered:
Lucknow | January 2026 — Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University (AKTU), Lucknow has officially invited research proposals from its affiliated colleges under the ISRO Sponsored Research Programme – ISRO RESPOND Basket 2026. This prestigious national-level initiative by the Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO) aims to strengthen collaboration between Indian academia and the national space programme.

What is ISRO RESPOND Basket 2026?

RESPOND (Sponsored Research Programme) is ISRO’s flagship academic research initiative designed to fund mission-oriented R&D projects in collaboration with Indian universities and research institutions.

🔗 Official ISRO RESPOND Programme Page:
👉 https://www.isro.gov.in/SponsoredResearch.html

The RESPOND Basket 2026 is the sixth edition of this programme and focuses on:

  • Prototype development
  • Technology Readiness Level (TRL) enhancement
  • Problem statements directly sourced from ISRO missions

Why This Opportunity Is Important for AKTU Colleges

According to the official AKTU circular, this programme enables affiliated colleges to:

  • Collaborate directly with ISRO scientists
  • Receive funded research grants
  • Develop advanced prototypes
  • Publish high-impact research papers
  • Improve NAAC/NIRF research metrics
  • Contribute to national and future space missions

AKTU’s Innovation Hub will provide centralized coordination, mentoring, and proposal guidance.

Who Can Apply for ISRO RESPOND Basket 2026?

Eligible applicants include:

  • ✔️ Full-time faculty members of recognized institutions
  • ✔️ Researchers from autonomous R&D institutions
  • ✔️ Interdisciplinary research teams

Eligibility Conditions

  • Principal Investigator (PI) must be a full-time employee
  • PI age must be below 65 years (including project duration)
  • Proposals from unaffiliated individuals will not be considered

Research Areas Covered Under RESPOND Basket 2026

RESPOND Basket 2025 includes research problems from almost every major ISRO centre, including VSSC, SAC, URSC, NRSC, LPSC, IPRC, PRL, IIRS, NESAC, ISTRAC, HSFC, SDSC SHAR, and ISRO Headquarters.

High-Demand Domains

  • Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning
  • Secure AI & Knowledge Systems
  • Satellite Communication & Navigation
  • Remote Sensing & GIS
  • Advanced Materials & Composites
  • Propulsion & Cryogenics
  • Quantum Computing & Space Electronics
  • Human Spaceflight & Space Station Systems

Each listed topic clearly defines:

  • Scope of work
  • Linkage with ISRO missions
  • Expected deliverables
  • ISRO scientist as focal point

Important Dates

  • Last Date to Apply: 31 January 2026
  • Mode: Online submission only

How to Apply for ISRO RESPOND Basket 2026 (Step-by-Step)

🔹 Step 1: Register on ISRO Sponsored Research Portal

Faculty members must submit their proposal through ISRO’s official portal:

👉 https://www.isro.gov.in/SponsoredResearch.html

🔹 Step 2: Mandatory AKTU Innovation Hub Registration

After registering on the ISRO portal, AKTU faculty must also fill the Innovation Hub Google Form for centralized coordination.

👉 AKTU Innovation Hub Google Form:
https://bit.ly/4b5RD15

This step is mandatory to:

  • Track AKTU participation
  • Provide proposal guidance
  • Enable inter-college collaboration
  • Represent proposals at university and state levels

Proposal Evaluation Process

All proposals submitted under RESPOND Basket 2026 will be evaluated by ISRO experts based on:

  • Novelty and originality
  • Technical methodology
  • Alignment with ISRO missions
  • Experience of the Principal Investigator
  • Project duration and budget feasibility

Only mission-relevant, high-quality proposals will receive funding approval.

Official Advisory from AKTU

AKTU has instructed Directors of affiliated institutes to circulate this opportunity widely among faculty members and research scholars and motivate them to apply at the earliest. The university aims to enhance its role in India’s space and deep-tech ecosystem through RESPOND Basket 2025.

also read : AKTU IBM Consulting Hiring 2026: Associate System Engineer Opportunity for Female Students

Final Note

The ISRO RESPOND Basket 2026 is a golden research opportunity for AKTU-affiliated colleges. With direct ISRO mentorship, funded projects, and national-level exposure, this programme can significantly boost both individual research careers and institutional reputation.

Faculty members are advised to start proposal preparation immediately and avoid last-minute submissions.

title.rendered: AKTU IBM Consulting Hiring 2026: Associate System Engineer Opportunity for Female Students

content.rendered:
AKTU Placement News 2026: Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University (AKTU) has released an official placement notification for IBM Consulting Hiring 2026, creating a high-value career opportunity for female B.Tech students of the 2026 batch. The hiring is for the role of Associate System Engineer and is open to students from Computer Science, Information Technology, Information Science, and related branches.

This drive is conducted through the AKTU Training & Placement Cell and follows a structured registration and selection process. Interested students must complete the application within the given timeline to be considered

IBM Consulting Hiring 2026 – Key Details

  • Company Name: IBM Consulting
  • University: Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University
  • Job Role: Associate System Engineer
  • Hiring Type: On-Campus (AKTU)
  • Eligible Batch: 2026
  • Eligible Branches: B.Tech (CS / IT / Information Science & related)
  • Minimum Eligibility: 6 CGPA or 60%
  • Gender Criteria: Female candidates only
  • Salary Package: ₹4.50 LPA + ₹25,000 one-time settling allowance
  • Last Date to Apply: 19 January 2026 (04:00 PM IST)

Why IBM Consulting Is a Strong Career Choice

IBM is a 114-year-old global technology leader with operations across finance, healthcare, government, telecom, automotive, and education sectors. IBM Consulting is the consulting and services arm of IBM, known for delivering large-scale digital transformation, cloud solutions, analytics, and enterprise applications.

For fresh graduates, IBM Consulting offers:

  • Exposure to real-world enterprise projects
  • Structured learning and mentoring
  • Long-term career growth in IT and consulting domains
  • Global delivery experience with Indian and international clients

Associate System Engineer – Job Profile

As an Associate System Engineer, selected candidates will work on enterprise-level software solutions. The role includes:

  • Designing and developing software applications
  • Writing, testing, debugging, and maintaining code
  • Working on multiple technologies and platforms
  • Following Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) standards
  • Collaborating with teams to achieve project objectives

Required Skill Set

  • Programming knowledge in Java, C, C++, Python, or Node.js
  • Understanding of SDLC concepts
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills

IBM Job Location Details (PAN India)

Candidates may be placed at any IBM location across India, including:

Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Chennai, Pune, Mumbai, Delhi/NCR, Kolkata, Ahmedabad, Lucknow, Kochi, Coimbatore, Mysore, and Bhubaneswar.

Applicants must be flexible for relocation, as project deployment can be anywhere in India.

Eligibility Criteria for AKTU IBM Hiring 2026

To participate in this placement drive, candidates must meet all the conditions below:

  • Must be a final-year B.Tech student (Pass-out year: 2026)
  • Branch: Computer Science / IT / Information Science or related
  • Minimum 6 CGPA or 60% aggregate
  • No active backlogs at the time of registration
  • Degree must be completed before joining IBM
  • Aggregate percentage calculated by considering all subjects, including electives

Registration Process (Very Important)

The application process consists of two mandatory steps. Skipping any step will lead to rejection.

Step 1: Apply on IBM Career Portal

Candidates must first apply for the Associate System Engineer role on IBM’s official career portal. After successful submission, IBM will generate a PERSON RECORD ID, which is sent via email by IBM Talent Acquisition.
Link – https://ibm.biz/BdeS5z .

Note the Person Record ID which will be shared in an email from IBM Talent Acquisition : talent@ibm.com .

Step 2: Submit Google Form

Using the PERSON RECORD ID, candidates must fill out the mandatory Google Form provided by AKTU. Applications without a valid PERSON RECORD ID will not be accepted.

Registration Link:- https://forms.gle/JUbnfzvb27MwuUnh9

Important Instructions

  • Use only a personal email ID and mobile number
  • Do not use college or institutional email IDs
  • Late or incomplete registrations will not be considered

Selection Process Overview

  • All rounds are elimination-based
  • First round will be an online coding assessment (virtual)
  • Details of further technical and HR rounds will be shared later
  • Any form of malpractice may result in permanent disqualification from IBM recruitment

IBM Salary Package and Benefits

  • CTC: ₹4.50 Lakh per annum
  • Additional Benefit: ₹25,000 one-time settling allowance
  • Travel and accommodation are not provided for physical rounds, if conducted

Important Dates to Remember

Final Advice for AKTU Female Students (Batch 2026)

The AKTU IBM Consulting Hiring 2026 drive is a highly valuable opportunity for female students aiming to start their careers with a reputed global MNC. With a competitive salary, structured learning environment, and nationwide exposure, this role can provide a strong foundation in the IT and consulting industry.

title.rendered: AKTU Digital Evaluation 2026: University Releases Official Guidelines and Evaluation Center List for Session 2025–26

content.rendered:
AKTU Digital Evaluation 2026: Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University (AKTU), Uttar Pradesh, has officially issued a major notification regarding Digital Evaluation of answer sheets for the academic session 2025–26. This update is extremely important for faculty members, evaluators, and affiliated institutions, as it directly affects the timely declaration of results for odd and even semester examinations.

The notice, released by the Controller of Examination, AKTU, confirms that the university will continue with the Digital Evaluation (Online Copy Checking) system and has instructed institutions to ensure full cooperation and active participation in the evaluation process.

This article provides a complete, simplified, and detailed explanation of the AKTU Digital Evaluation 2026 notice, including important instructions, responsibilities of institutions, evaluation timelines, portal details, and the complete evaluation center framework.

What Is AKTU Digital Evaluation?

AKTU Digital Evaluation is a technology-driven answer sheet checking system where:

  • Student answer copies are scanned
  • Evaluators check copies online through a secure portal
  • Physical handling of copies is eliminated
  • Evaluation becomes faster, more transparent, and error-free

title.rendered: AKTU Result 2026 to Be Declared During Exams, Students Won’t Have to Wait for Months

content.rendered:
Lucknow:
In a major relief for lakhs of students, Dr. APJ Abdul Kalam Technical University (AKTU) has announced a significant change in its examination and result declaration system. As per the latest update, AKTU Result 2026 will now be released during the examination period itself, eliminating the long waiting time students usually face after exams.

This decision marks a historic shift in AKTU’s evaluation process and is expected to bring transparency, speed, and efficiency to the university’s examination system.

AKTU Result 2026: What Is the New System?

For many years, AKTU students have struggled with delayed results. In several cases, semester results were declared three to six months after the completion of exams. This delay often caused problems related to:

  • Admission to next semesters
  • Internships and placements
  • Competitive exam applications
  • Academic planning and mental stress

To address these issues, AKTU administration has introduced a parallel evaluation system, where answer sheets will be evaluated while exams are still ongoing.

Digital Evaluation to Speed Up Results

The university has officially implemented a Digital Evaluation System for AKTU Result 2026. Under this system:

  • Answer sheets are scanned immediately after exams
  • Digital copies are sent to evaluation centers
  • Teachers begin checking papers without waiting for all exams to end
  • Results will be prepared subject-wise in phases

This approach ensures that once a set of exams is completed, the evaluation is already near completion, allowing results to be published quickly.

Official Statement from Examination Controller

According to Examination Controller Prof. Deepak Nathiya, the university is following a completely new strategy this year.

He stated that as exams are conducted, the evaluation process is starting simultaneously. The goal is to declare results within one month of the exam, instead of forcing students to wait for several months.

This confirms that AKTU Result 2026 will be faster than any previous year.

Examination Schedule and Result Timeline

As per AKTU officials:

  • Semester examinations are being conducted from 23 December to 31 January
  • Evaluation of December exams has already begun
  • Results for earlier exams will be released first
  • Remaining results will follow in a phased manner

This means students will not need to wait for the entire examination cycle to finish before checking their results.

Teachers Prepared for Digital Evaluation

To ensure smooth implementation, AKTU administration has issued official instructions to all affiliated colleges. These include:

  • Mandatory cooperation in digital evaluation
  • Availability of teachers at evaluation centers
  • Subject-wise allocation of answer sheets
  • Maintaining quality, accuracy, and fairness in checking

Teachers have also been instructed to evaluate answer sheets only for their respective subjects to maintain result accuracy.

Major Relief for AKTU Students

The new result system will directly benefit students in multiple ways:

  • No long delays in semester results
  • Timely start of the next academic session
  • Better planning for placements and higher studies
  • Reduced stress and uncertainty
  • Improved academic efficiency

The AKTU Result 2026 reform is being considered one of the most student-friendly decisions taken by the university in recent years.

Why This Change Is Important

With more than lakhs of students enrolled, AKTU is one of the largest technical universities in India. Implementing such a system sets an example for other universities facing similar challenges.

If successful, this digital and parallel evaluation model could become a permanent framework for AKTU examinations in the coming years.

What Are Open Electives in AKTU?

Open Electives are subjects offered by AKTU that allow students to explore interdisciplinary knowledge beyond their core branch. In the 2nd Year B.Tech AKTU syllabus, open electives are designed to build awareness about technology, environment, ethics, management, and emerging trends.

Almost every branch—CSE, IT, ME, CE, EE, ECE—has common or overlapping open elective options. That’s why Open Elective PYQs 2nd Year B.Tech AKTU become extremely useful, as the exam pattern often remains similar across branches.

Why Open Elective PYQs 2nd Year B.Tech AKTU Are Important

Here are some strong reasons why you must focus on Open Elective PYQs 2nd Year B.Tech AKTU:

  1. Repeated Questions: AKTU frequently repeats questions or concepts from previous years.
  2. Exam Pattern Understanding: PYQs help you understand 3-mark, 5-mark, and 7-mark question trends.
  3. Unit-wise Preparation: You can easily identify high-weightage units.
  4. Time Management: Solving PYQs improves writing speed and answer structuring.
  5. Scoring Advantage: Open electives are generally theory-based and scoring if prepared smartly.

Many toppers rely only on class notes + Open Elective PYQs 2nd Year B.Tech AKTU for revision.

content.rendered:
AKTU Odd Semester Exams Rescheduled at the Last Moment: Students Caught Off-Guard Amid Ongoing Practicals

Examinations are one of the most sensitive phases of a student’s academic life. During this time, clarity, stability, and timely communication matter more than anything else. Recently, students of Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University (AKTU) faced unexpected confusion when the Odd Semester Examination Session 2024–25 was rescheduled just a day before the exam, as per the official notice dated 15 January 2026.

At NotesGallery.com, we aim to highlight genuine student concerns in a responsible way—and this situation deserves attention.

What the Official Notice States

The official notification titled:

“Regarding Rescheduling Odd Semester Examination Session 2024–25 (15.01.2026)”

announced a change in the examination schedule due to unavoidable reasons.

While such decisions fall under university administration, the timing of the announcement—released at the last moment—became the main cause of concern for students.

Revised Dates of Exam

Practicals Were Already Ongoing

One important detail that cannot be ignored is that AKTU practical examinations were already scheduled and running till 21 January.
Most students were already balancing:

  • Daily practical exams
  • Lab records and viva preparation
  • Theory exam revision side by side

In such a tightly packed schedule, any sudden change creates unnecessary mental pressure, even if the exam is postponed.

Why Last-Moment Rescheduling Is Still Problematic

This is not about postponement—it’s about how and when the information is shared.

Mental Readiness Gets Disturbed

Students mentally prepare themselves according to fixed dates. A sudden change, especially during ongoing practicals, breaks concentration and momentum.

Revision Planning Becomes Uncertain

Many students follow a strict revision timetable between practicals and theory exams. When dates shift suddenly, students are left unsure how to re-adjust their preparation.

At NotesGallery.com, several students shared similar feelings:

“Practicals ke beech me theory ka plan bana rakha tha, ab sab mix ho gaya.”

Who Is Actually Affected?

To be clear and factual:

  • Final-year students are not directly affected in this situation
  • The main impact is on 1st, 2nd, and 3rd-year students whose odd semester exams were scheduled alongside practicals

This clarity is important, and NotesGallery.com believes in presenting facts accurately.

Could This Have Been Communicated Earlier?

Students are not questioning authority—they are questioning timing.

If rescheduling was unavoidable:

  • Could the notice have been released earlier?
  • Could students have been informed in advance during practical scheduling?

Even a short prior update could have helped students mentally prepare and plan better.

Education Needs Stability, Especially During Exams

Examinations already come with stress.
What students expect from an academic institution is:

  • Predictability
  • Clear timelines
  • Respect for students’ preparation efforts

Sudden decisions—even if justified—can unintentionally increase pressure.

At NotesGallery.com, our focus is always on helping students manage academics better through notes, PYQs, and timely updates.

A Constructive Way Forward

Without targeting or blaming, a few improvements can make a real difference:

  • Advance alerts if schedule changes are expected
  • Better coordination between practical and theory exams
  • Student-first communication during examination periods

Such steps can strengthen trust between students and the university.

NotesGallery.com: Supporting Students, Responsibly

This article is not written to spread negativity.
It is written to reflect student experiences honestly and responsibly.

At NotesGallery.com, we will continue to:

  • Share verified AKTU notices
  • Provide reliable study resources
  • Raise student concerns without crossing boundaries

Final Words

The rescheduling of AKTU Odd Semester exams at the last moment, especially while practicals are still ongoing till 21 January, has understandably left students unsettled.

Students are adaptable—but they deserve timely communication.

We hope future academic decisions consider the student perspective more closely.

title.rendered: AKTU Affiliation Deadline Extended 2026: Colleges Get More Time for Session 2025-26

content.rendered:
Lucknow | January 2026
Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University (AKTU), Uttar Pradesh has issued an important official notice regarding extension of last date for affiliation-related applications for the academic session 2025–26. This update brings major relief to engineering, pharmacy, management, and other professional institutions affiliated with AKTU.

As per the latest office memorandum, the university has extended the deadline up to 20 January 2026 for submitting pending applications related to new institutions, additional courses, and intake expansion, which were earlier scheduled to close on 10 January 2026.

What Is This AKTU Notice About?

AKTU periodically invites applications from colleges for:

  • New institute affiliation
  • Introduction of new courses
  • Increase in approved intake
  • Other academic expansions for the upcoming session

For the 2025–26 academic year, AKTU had already notified the application process under relevant University Act / Statutes (Act clause 6.01). However, considering requests and administrative feasibility, the university has now extended the final submission date.

This decision has been communicated through an official office notice issued in January 2026 by the university headquarters, Lucknow .

Old vs New Deadline (Quick Overview)

Who Will Benefit from This Extension?

This deadline extension is extremely important for:

  • Engineering Colleges (B.Tech / M.Tech)
  • Pharmacy Colleges (B.Pharm / M.Pharm)
  • Management Institutes (MBA / MCA)
  • Other Professional & Technical Institutions affiliated with AKTU

Colleges that were unable to complete documentation, approvals, or online filing by the earlier deadline now have additional time to submit error-free applications.

Important Instructions for Colleges

According to the notice:

  • Institutions must strictly follow the revised deadline
  • Applications should be submitted complete in all respects
  • Incomplete or incorrect applications may be rejected during scrutiny
  • Colleges should ensure proper verification before final submission

AKTU has clearly instructed institutions to not wait till the last day and submit their files well in advance.

Why Did AKTU Extend the Date?

Although AKTU has not explicitly stated a reason, such extensions are usually granted due to:

  • High volume of applications
  • Technical or documentation delays
  • Requests from affiliated institutions
  • Ensuring fair opportunity to all colleges

This move reflects AKTU’s intent to maintain transparency and academic planning for the upcoming session.

Official Authority & Signature

The notice has been issued with official approval and is signed by the Registrar (Kulsachiv) of AKTU, making it a valid and enforceable university order .

Copies of the notice have also been forwarded to:

  • Principal Secretary, Technical Education, UP
  • Finance Officer, AKTU
  • Controller of Examination, AKTU
  • Joint / Deputy Registrars
  • Concerned administrative offices

What Happens After 20 January 2026?

Colleges must note that:

  • No further extension is guaranteed
  • Late submissions may not be entertained
  • Delayed applications can affect course approval for 2025–26

Hence, institutions are strongly advised to complete the affiliation process before the revised deadline.

Impact on Students (Indirect but Important)

Although this notice is institution-focused, it indirectly benefits students because:

  • More approved seats and courses
  • Timely academic planning
  • Better clarity during admissions and counselling

A smooth affiliation process ensures no last-minute confusion during AKTU admissions and counselling rounds.

Key Takeaways (Quick Points)

  • AKTU has extended affiliation application deadline to 20 Jan 2026
  • Applicable for Session 2025–26
  • Covers new institutes, new courses & intake expansion
  • Earlier deadline was 10 Jan 2026
  • Colleges must submit complete & verified applications

Final Words

This latest AKTU notification is a significant administrative update for all affiliated colleges in Uttar Pradesh. Institutions that were running short on time now have a golden opportunity to complete formalities without risking rejection.

For students, educators, and college management, staying updated with such official AKTU notices is crucial for smooth academic operations.

👉 We recommend colleges to act immediately and not wait till the last date.

title.rendered: AKTU Scholarship Rules Amended in 2026: Big Relief for SC, ST and OBC Students Admitted Through Management & Spot Quota

content.rendered:
Lucknow, January 2026: In a major relief for thousands of students, the Uttar Pradesh government has officially amended the Post-Matric Scholarship Rules 2023 for Scheduled Caste (SC), Scheduled Tribe (ST), and Other Backward Class (OBC) students. The amendment directly impacts students studying in AKTU-affiliated universities and private institutions, especially those admitted through management quota, spot admission, or institute-level processes.

The updated rules were issued by the Social Welfare Department, Government of Uttar Pradesh, and have been formally communicated to Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University (AKTU), Lucknow, which has instructed all affiliated institutions to implement the changes with immediate effect .

Why This AKTU Scholarship Amendment Is Important

Over the last few years, several students belonging to SC, ST, and OBC categories had complained that their scholarship applications were rejected despite meeting income and academic eligibility criteria. The main reason for rejection was the mode of admission, particularly:

  • Management quota admissions
  • Spot round admissions
  • College-level counseling admissions

Due to ambiguity in Scholarship Rules 2023, such admissions were often treated as non-transparent, leading to scholarship denial. Following repeated representations and administrative review, the Uttar Pradesh government decided to clarify and amend the relevant provisions.

Official Details of the Notification

  • Issuing Department: Social Welfare Department, UP Government
  • Forwarding Authority: AKTU, Lucknow
  • Date of Issue: 09 January 2026
  • Rules Amended:
    • Rule 5(xiv) – Note-2
    • Rule 5(xii) – Note-3
  • Applicable Institutions: All AKTU-affiliated colleges and universities

AKTU has directed institutions to take necessary action in accordance with the amended rules without delay .

What Has Changed in the Scholarship Rules?

Management Quota Students Now Eligible for Scholarship

Earlier, students admitted through management quota were generally excluded from scholarship benefits. The amended rules now clearly state that:

Management quota students will be eligible for scholarship if:

  • Admission is conducted through a transparent and documented process
  • A merit list is prepared and published
  • No capitation fee or illegal payment is involved
  • Fees are charged as per approved norms

This clarification is expected to benefit a large number of students studying in private engineering, management, pharmacy, and technical colleges under AKTU.

Spot Admission Students Get Major Relief

Spot admissions, which are conducted to fill vacant seats, were earlier treated with suspicion during scholarship verification.

As per the new amendment:

  • Spot admission students cannot be automatically declared ineligible
  • Admission must be merit-based and officially notified
  • Selection must follow transparent procedures
  • Approval from competent authority is mandatory

This change ensures that students who secured admission through legitimate spot rounds are not deprived of financial support.

Transparency Made Mandatory for Scholarship Approval

The amended rules put strong emphasis on transparent admission practices.

Scholarship benefits will be allowed only when:

  • Admission notifications are publicly issued
  • Merit lists are properly prepared
  • Selection criteria are clearly defined
  • Admission records are maintained correctly

Any admission process that lacks transparency will result in scholarship rejection.

Government’s Clear Warning on Illegal Admissions

The Uttar Pradesh government has clearly stated that the amendment:

  • Does not legalize illegal admissions
  • Does not allow capitation fee
  • Does not support arbitrary selection

Scholarship will not be granted if:

  • Admission is done secretly
  • No merit list exists
  • Excess or illegal fees are charged
  • Institutional norms are violated

This ensures the scholarship scheme remains protected from misuse.

Old vs New Scholarship Rules: What Changed?

Who Will Benefit from This AKTU Scholarship Update?

The amendment is expected to benefit:

  • SC, ST, and OBC students
  • Economically weaker families
  • Students studying in AKTU-affiliated private colleges
  • Candidates admitted through:
    • Management quota
    • Spot rounds
    • Institute-level counseling

Students whose scholarship applications were earlier rejected or kept pending due to admission category may now have a valid chance for approval.

Instructions Issued to AKTU-Affiliated Colleges

AKTU has directed all colleges to:

  • Implement the amended rules immediately
  • Maintain transparent admission documentation
  • Upload correct details on scholarship portals
  • Cooperate with verification authorities

Non-compliance may lead to administrative action and rejection of student scholarship claims .

What Students Should Do Now

Students are advised to:

  1. Review their admission category
  2. Keep documents ready:
    • Merit list proof
    • Admission letter
    • Fee receipts
  3. Check scholarship status on the portal
  4. Contact the college scholarship cell if:
    • Scholarship was rejected earlier
    • Verification is pending

Students must ensure their admission was transparent and merit-based.

Impact on Future Admissions and Scholarships

Education experts believe this amendment will:

  • Promote fair admission practices
  • Reduce misuse of management quota
  • Strengthen transparency in private institutions
  • Ensure scholarships reach deserving students

The move is also expected to reduce disputes during scholarship verification in future academic sessions.

ALSO READ : Aadhaar VC ID’athon 2026: Build the Future of Digital Identity in India

Conclusion

The AKTU Scholarship Rule Amendment 2026 marks a significant policy correction by the Uttar Pradesh government. By clearly defining eligibility for management quota and spot admission students, the government has ensured that deserving SC, ST, and OBC students are not unfairly denied financial support.

Colleges and students are now expected to strictly follow the amended rules to ensure smooth scholarship processing.

title.rendered: Aadhaar VC ID’athon 2026: Build the Future of Digital Identity in India

content.rendered:
India’s digital public infrastructure is evolving rapidly, and Aadhaar-based Verifiable Credentials (AVC) are set to play a major role in secure, privacy-first digital identity solutions. To accelerate innovation in this space, the Unique Identification Authority of India (UIDAI) has announced the Aadhaar VC ID’athon 2026—an exciting opportunity for startups and private sector innovators to build real-world, impactful use cases.

This ID’athon is not just a competition; it is a national innovation platform that offers hands-on development experience, expert mentorship, and cash prizes up to ₹5 lakh.

What is the Aadhaar VC ID’athon?

The Aadhaar VC ID’athon is an innovation challenge focused on Aadhaar-based Verifiable Credentials. Participants are invited to design and develop solutions that use verifiable, digitally signed credentials linked with Aadhaar—while respecting privacy, consent, and offline verification principles.

The goal is to encourage secure, scalable, and citizen-centric digital identity use cases that can be adopted across sectors such as education, finance, healthcare, travel, and governance.

Why UIDAI is Promoting Verifiable Credentials

Verifiable Credentials (VCs) are a globally recognized standard for digital identity. With Aadhaar VC, India is enabling:

  • Offline verification without sharing Aadhaar numbers
  • User consent–based identity sharing
  • Tamper-proof, digitally signed credentials
  • Interoperability across platforms

Through this ID’athon, UIDAI wants innovators to demonstrate how Aadhaar VC can be used responsibly to solve real problems at scale.

Who Can Apply?

The Aadhaar VC ID’athon is open to:

  • Startups (early-stage to growth-stage)
  • Private sector companies
  • Technology innovators and solution builders
  • Product teams working on digital identity, security, or governance solutions

Both individual startups and teams are encouraged to participate.

Key Benefits of Participating

1. Hands-On Development Experience

Participants will get practical exposure to Aadhaar VC APIs and sandbox environments, enabling them to build production-ready prototypes.

2. Expert Mentorship & Guidance

Shortlisted teams will receive mentorship from domain experts, UIDAI ecosystem specialists, and industry leaders, helping refine both technical and business aspects.

3. National-Level Visibility

Solutions developed during the ID’athon may be showcased at a national level, opening doors to pilot opportunities and long-term adoption.

4. Attractive Cash Prizes

Winning teams will receive significant monetary rewards as recognition for their innovation.

Cash Prizes Breakdown

Apart from cash prizes, participants gain credibility, exposure, and ecosystem access that can be far more valuable in the long run.

Use Case Areas You Can Explore

Participants can build Aadhaar VC–based solutions in areas such as:

  • Digital certificates and credentials (education, skill, training)
  • Offline identity verification for service delivery
  • Secure onboarding and KYC alternatives
  • Access control and authentication systems
  • Travel, hospitality, and event verification
  • Government-to-citizen digital services

Innovations that align with Digital India and Tech for Good principles are highly encouraged.

Important Dates

  • Application Mode: Online

Early application is recommended to get sufficient time for development and testing.

How to Apply for Aadhaar VC ID’athon 2026

Follow these simple steps:

  1. Visit the official UIDAI sandbox portal
  2. Go to the ID’athon page
  3. Register your startup or team
  4. Submit your idea and relevant details
  5. Start building using Aadhaar VC tools

Apply Now:
https://sandbox.uidai.gov.in/ideathonPage

Why This ID’athon Matters for Startups

For Indian startups, the Aadhaar VC ID’athon offers a rare chance to:

  • Work directly with India’s core digital identity infrastructure
  • Build solutions with real policy and national relevance
  • Strengthen credibility by associating with UIDAI
  • Explore long-term commercialization and adoption pathways

If you are working in Digital Identity, DPI, GovTech, FinTech, or Privacy Tech, this opportunity can be a major milestone for your startup journey.

Final Thoughts

The Aadhaar VC ID’athon 2026 is more than a competition—it is an invitation to co-create the future of India’s digital identity ecosystem. With strong institutional backing, meaningful problem statements, and attractive rewards, this initiative perfectly blends innovation with national impact.
