title.rendered: AKTU Admission Fee 2025–26 Officially Announced: BBA and BCA Vocational Fee Fixed at ₹54,100

content.rendered:
Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University (AKTU), Uttar Pradesh, has officially released a crucial admission-related update for students planning to enroll in vocational degree programs. According to the latest university circular, the AKTU Admission Fee 2025–26 for BBA and BCA Vocational courses has been fixed.

The official notice was issued on 15 December 2025 and has been circulated to all AKTU-affiliated institutions across Uttar Pradesh.

AKTU Admission Fee 2025–26: What Students Must Know

As per the decision taken by the Admission and Fee Regulation Committee, the AKTU Admission Fee 2025–26 for vocational courses has been finalized at ₹54,100.

This fee will be applicable for the entire Academic Session 2025–26 (One Year) and is meant for private degree-level institutions affiliated with AKTU.

AKTU Fee Structure 2025–26 for Vocational Courses

Why the AKTU Admission Fee 2025–26 Announcement Matters

Every year, thousands of students seek admission through AKTU, and uncertainty about fee structure often leads to confusion. The confirmation of the AKTU Admission Fee 2025–26 brings transparency and helps students and parents plan their admissions without stress.

This update is especially important for students choosing skill-based and employment-oriented vocational degree programs.

Key Highlights of AKTU Admission Fee 2025–26

  • The AKTU Admission Fee 2025–26 has been officially approved by the university
  • The decision is based on recommendations of the Admission and Fee Regulation Committee
  • The fee structure follows UP Government Technical Education guidelines
  • The update applies only to private AKTU-affiliated colleges
  • The fee is valid strictly for Academic Session 2025–26

Important Advice for Students Taking Admission in 2025–26

Students applying for admission under AKTU Admission 2025–26 should ensure that colleges charge only the officially approved amount. Always ask for proper fee receipts and written confirmation of charges.

If any institution demands an amount higher than the AKTU Admission Fee 2025–26, students are advised to report the issue to university authorities.

Instructions Issued to AKTU Affiliated Colleges

AKTU has clearly instructed all Directors and Principals of affiliated institutions to strictly follow the AKTU Admission Fee 2025–26 guidelines. Charging excess fees may lead to disciplinary action by the university.

This step has been taken to safeguard student interests and maintain transparency in the admission process.

Frequently Asked Questions

What is the AKTU Admission Fee 2025–26 for B.Voc courses?
The AKTU Admission Fee 2025–26 for B.Voc courses is ₹54,100.

Is the same fee applicable for B.Sc Vocational courses?
Yes, the AKTU Admission Fee 2025–26 for B.Sc Vocational courses is also ₹54,100.

Does this fee apply to government colleges?
No, this notification mainly applies to private AKTU-affiliated institutions.

Is the AKTU Admission Fee 2025–26 officially confirmed?
Yes, the fee has been confirmed through an official AKTU circular dated 15 December 2025.

READ MORE : AKTU Odd Sem Exam Form Date Extended 2025 Till 20 December

Final Update for Students

The announcement of the AKTU Admission Fee 2025–26 is a major relief for students planning admissions in vocational degree programs. With the fee officially fixed at ₹54,100, students can now proceed with confidence and clarity.

For more AKTU admission updates, fee news, exam notifications, and official circulars, stay connected with our website.

  • Recheck exam form details carefully

Ignoring these steps may lead to exam form rejection, even after the AKTU Odd Semester Exam Form Extension 2025–26.

Instructions for Colleges

AKTU has instructed colleges to:

  • Inform students immediately about the extension
  • Verify exam forms before final submission
  • Provide assistance to students facing payment issues

Colleges play a crucial role in smooth implementation of the AKTU Odd Semester Exam Form Extension 2025–26.

Yes, it applies to all AKTU-affiliated institutions.

title.rendered: Big Relief for AKTU Students: AKTU UFM Result Update Allows Odd Semester Exam Form Filling

content.rendered:
Lucknow | Education Desk:
Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University (AKTU) has finally released a major relief update for students facing result-related issues. As per the latest AKTU UFM Result Update, the university has updated the results of students whose status was earlier marked as UFM (Unfair Means).

This AKTU UFM Result Update comes as a big relief, as affected students can now proceed to fill the 2025–26 Odd Semester exam form, which was earlier blocked due to the UFM status.

AKTU UFM Result Update: What Exactly Has Changed

According to academic sources, students whose Even Semester results showed UFM and who followed the instructed process by emailing or submitting representations to AKTU have now seen their status resolved. The AKTU UFM Result Update is now visible on the AKTU One View portal.

Students are advised to immediately log in and verify their updated result to avoid any last-minute problems.

Exam Form Filling Open After AKTU UFM Result Update

After the latest AKTU UFM Result Update, students are now eligible to:

  • Fill the Odd Semester examination form
  • Complete fee payment within the deadline
  • Continue academic progression without restriction

University officials have clearly stated that there is no decision to postpone exams. The examination schedule will follow the already released datesheet.

No Exam Postponement Confirmed

Despite repeated student queries, AKTU authorities have clarified that the AKTU UFM Result Update does not impact the exam schedule. Exams will be conducted as planned, and students should focus on preparation instead of exam postponement rumours.

Any official change will only be communicated through AKTU notifications.

Strict Warning Issued for Upcoming Exams

Along with the AKTU UFM Result Update, students have been issued a strong advisory regarding exam conduct. Any violation during upcoming semester exams may again result in UFM.

Students must strictly avoid:

  • Mobile phone usage inside the exam hall
  • Carrying chits, papers, or electronic devices
  • Copying or any unfair practice

Students are also warned not to write personal details such as mobile number, roll number (outside designated space), college name, or college code on the answer sheet, as these are major reasons behind UFM cases.

Why AKTU Students Get UFM: Key Reasons

Based on previous records, most UFM cases arise due to:

  • Writing contact details in answer sheets
  • Trying to identify oneself to the examiner
  • Using mobile phones or electronic devices
  • Ignoring exam hall instructions

Even a single mistake can lead to serious academic consequences.

Exam Preparation Support After AKTU UFM Result Update

Following the AKTU UFM Result Update, students are encouraged to prepare seriously for upcoming exams using available resources:

  • One-shot revision lectures for most AKTU subjects
  • Exam-oriented preparation for First Year, Second Year, Third Year, and MCA students
  • Important questions and PDF notes for quick revision

These resources can help students perform better in limited time.

What Students Should Do Now

After the AKTU UFM Result Update, students should:

  • Check their updated result on AKTU One View
  • Fill the Odd Semester exam form immediately
  • Prepare strictly according to the official datesheet
  • Follow all exam rules to avoid future UFM issues

AKTU will continue to release official updates related to exams and results. Students are advised to stay informed and focused.

Best wishes to all AKTU students for their upcoming examinations.

FAQ

Q1. What is the latest AKTU UFM Result Update?
The latest AKTU UFM Result Update confirms that the university has updated the results of students whose status was earlier marked as UFM. Affected students can now check their updated result on the AKTU One View portal.

Q2. Can students fill the Odd Semester exam form after the AKTU UFM Result Update?
Yes, after the AKTU UFM Result Update, students whose UFM status has been cleared are now allowed to fill the 2025–26 Odd Semester exam form.

Q3. Where can I check my updated UFM result?
Students can check their updated status through the official AKTU One View Result portal using their roll number and date of birth.

Q4. Will AKTU postpone the Odd Semester exams due to UFM issues?
No, there is no official announcement regarding exam postponement. Exams will be conducted as per the released datesheet.

Q5. What activities can lead to UFM in AKTU exams?
Using mobile phones, copying, carrying chits, or writing personal information such as mobile number, college name, or roll number on the answer sheet can lead to UFM.

Q6. What precautions should students take in upcoming exams?
Students should strictly follow exam hall rules, avoid unfair practices, and ensure no personal details are written on the answer sheet to prevent UFM.

Q7. What should I do if my UFM result is still not updated?
If the UFM status is still showing, students should immediately contact their college administration or follow the official AKTU grievance or email process for further clarification.

content.rendered:
डॉ. ए.पी.जे. अब्दुल कलाम प्राविधिक विश्वविद्यालय (AKTU), लखनऊ ने सत्र 2024-25 के BBA, BCA, Pharm D, B.Voc और B.Des पाठ्यक्रमों की परीक्षाओं के AKTU Challenge Evaluation (चैलेंज मूल्यांकन) को लेकर महत्वपूर्ण अधिसूचना जारी की है।

विश्वविद्यालय द्वारा इन सभी कोर्सेज़ का परीक्षा परिणाम पहले ही घोषित किया जा चुका है। ऐसे में जो छात्र अपने प्राप्त अंकों से संतुष्ट नहीं हैं, उनके लिए AKTU Challenge Evaluation का विकल्प उपलब्ध कराया गया है।

किन छात्रों के लिए है यह Challenge Evaluation?

AKTU से संबद्ध सभी संस्थानों में अध्ययनरत वे छात्र/छात्राएं:

  • जिनका BBA / BCA / Pharm D / B.Voc / B.Des परीक्षा परिणाम जारी हो चुका है
  • जो अपनी उत्तर-पुस्तिका के मूल्यांकन से असंतुष्ट हैं
  • जो उत्तर पुस्तिका देखने के बाद पुनर्मूल्यांकन (Challenge Evaluation) कराना चाहते हैं

Challenge Evaluation की प्रक्रिया क्या है?

AKTU द्वारा Challenge Evaluation को दो चरणों में आयोजित किया जा रहा है:

पहला चरण: उत्तर पुस्तिका देखने का अवसर

  • छात्र पहले अपनी डिजिटल मूल्यांकित उत्तर-पुस्तिका देख सकते हैं
  • इसके लिए ₹300 प्रति विषय शुल्क निर्धारित किया गया है
  • आवेदन केवल ERP Login के माध्यम से Online किया जाएगा

आवेदन की तिथि:
➡️ 11 दिसम्बर 2025 से 14 दिसम्बर 2025 तक

दूसरा चरण: Challenge Evaluation आवेदन

  • डिजिटल उत्तर पुस्तिका देखने के बाद
  • यदि छात्र असंतुष्ट रहता है
  • तो वह निर्धारित Challenge Evaluation शुल्क जमा कर आगे आवेदन कर सकता है

डिजिटल उत्तर पुस्तिका कहाँ मिलेगी?

पहले चरण के आवेदन के बाद:

  • छात्र की डिजिटल मूल्यांकित उत्तर पुस्तिका
  • उसके AKTU ERP Login में उपलब्ध करा दी जाएगी

किन नियमों के अनुसार होगा Challenge Evaluation?

Challenge Evaluation की पूरी प्रक्रिया:

  • उत्तर प्रदेश शासनादेश संख्या 39298/16-1099/17/2020 (दिनांक 11 सितम्बर 2020)
  • एवं राज्यपाल/कुलाधिपति के अपर मुख्य सचिव द्वारा जारी मानक निर्देशों
    के अनुसार संपन्न कराई जाएगी।

संस्थानों के लिए AKTU का निर्देश

AKTU ने सभी संबद्ध कॉलेजों के:

  • निदेशक
  • प्राचार्य

को निर्देशित किया है कि वे:

  • इस सूचना को छात्रों तक समय पर पहुँचाएं
  • Challenge Evaluation आवेदन प्रक्रिया में आवश्यक सहयोग प्रदान करें

छात्रों के लिए महत्वपूर्ण सलाह

  • आवेदन की अंतिम तिथि का विशेष ध्यान रखें
  • ERP Login से ही आवेदन करें
  • पहले उत्तर पुस्तिका अच्छी तरह देखें, उसके बाद ही Challenge Evaluation का निर्णय लें
  • शुल्क जमा करने के बाद आवेदन वापस नहीं लिया जा सकता

निष्कर्ष

AKTU का यह निर्णय उन छात्रों के लिए राहत भरा है, जो अपने अंकों को लेकर असमंजस में हैं। Challenge Evaluation 2025 छात्रों को पारदर्शी और निष्पक्ष मूल्यांकन का एक और अवसर प्रदान करता है। यदि आपको लगता है कि आपकी उत्तर पुस्तिका में अंक सही नहीं जोड़े गए हैं, तो यह मौका जरूर उपयोग करें।

title.rendered: AKTU Announces Tentative Exam Centers for Odd Semester 2025-26; Big Update for Students Before Final List

content.rendered:
Lucknow, December 12, 2025: A major update has been released for thousands of AKTU students as the university officially published the tentative exam centers for Odd Semester Exams 2025-26. The notice, issued under AKTU/Exam/2025/2400, has immediately become one of the most searched topics among engineering and management students preparing for end-semester exams.

Tentative Exam Centers for Odd Semester 2025-26 Released — Students Should Stay Alert

AKTU has announced the AKTU Odd Semester Exam Centers 2025-26 for all undergraduate and postgraduate programs, excluding B.Pharm 1st Year, 1st Semester. The university confirmed that exams will be held from:

  • 23 December 2025 to 24 January 2025

These centers will host Regular and Carry Over students, and the list closely follows the previous year’s exam pattern across various districts of Uttar Pradesh.

This announcement is extremely crucial, as students have already started searching for their exam locations, travel routes, and accommodations.

Colleges Must Correct Errors by 15 December — Strict Deadline

The university has clearly instructed all affiliated colleges to verify their allotted exam centers and send corrections only through email before the deadline.

Correction Submission Details

After this deadline, no modifications will be accepted, even in case of errors. Colleges are therefore urged to act immediately.

What Students Should Do Right Now

Students should keep an eye on the final list, which will be released after the correction window closes. Meanwhile:

  • Check updates regularly on AKTU ERP
  • Stay connected with your college administration
  • Follow official AKTU announcements
  • Don’t rely on unofficial exam center lists circulating on social media

The AKTU Odd Semester Exam Centers 2025-26 update is trending on Google Discover because thousands are actively searching for exam-related news.

Inside the Official Notice: Key Points

The notice, issued by Prof. Rajeev Kumar, Controller of Examinations, highlights:

  • The exam center list is tentative
  • Colleges must verify and report any mismatch
  • Students must be informed immediately after the final list is released
  • Exams will be conducted across multiple districts, ensuring smooth logistics

The notification has also been forwarded to university officials including the Pro-Vice Chancellor, Registrar, ERP In-charge, and Public Relations Officer.

Why This Update Is Important for Every AKTU Student

The exam center determines:

  • Where you will take your exam
  • How early you need to travel
  • Whether additional arrangements (transport, hostel, stay) are needed

Since this is a tentative list, the final list may bring changes. That’s why students are advised to review official updates frequently to avoid last-minute confusion.

title.rendered: IIT Guwahati Internship 2026: Stipend Up To ₹25,000, WFH Opportunity — Apply Before 7 January

content.rendered:
The prestigious IIT Guwahati has opened applications for the IIT Guwahati Internship 2026, offering a work-from-home role with a monthly stipend of up to ₹25,000. This opportunity is for the position of VR Development Intern, and students passionate about AR/VR, Unity, and interface design can benefit greatly from this highly reputed internship program.

The IIT Guwahati Internship comes from the Department of Design’s Embedded Interaction Lab (EILab), a leading applied research lab working on futuristic technologies. With collaborations involving Samsung, Nokia, Microsoft, IBM, P&G, and the Government of India, the IIT Guwahati Internship provides exceptional exposure to cutting-edge research and real-world innovation.

About IIT Guwahati & EILab

The Embedded Interaction Lab (EILab) at IIT Guwahati is known for its breakthrough research in:

  • Next-generation input interfaces for Virtual Reality and flexible displays
  • Technology-driven social innovation
  • Collaborative industrial research with global tech giants

The team includes highly skilled researchers, PhD scholars, designers, developers, and engineering students. The IIT Guwahati Internship gives selected candidates the opportunity to work closely with this multidisciplinary group.

Roles & Responsibilities

Selected interns under the IIT Guwahati Internship 2026 will work on VR applications for Meta Quest devices (Quest 3/3S). Key tasks include:

  • Integrating advanced VR features into Unity
  • Adding UI elements and interactive features
  • Incorporating 3D anatomical models
  • Writing simple C# scripts for interactions such as grasping, pointing, object movement, and triggers
  • Optimizing performance through rendering improvements, batching, LODs, and profiling
  • Collaborating with 3D artists and designers for smooth asset integration
  • Maintaining modular and clean code following best practices

This makes the IIT Guwahati Internship particularly ideal for students skilled in Unity, C#, 3D interaction design, or XR technologies.

Location

Work From Home (WFH)
This remote setup makes the IIT Guwahati Internship accessible to students across India.

Duration

6 Months

Stipend & Perks

  • Monthly stipend: ₹10,000 – ₹25,000
  • Internship Certificate
  • Letter of Recommendation (LOR)

These benefits make the IIT Guwahati Internship one of the best paid VR-based internships available for 2026.

Deadline to Apply

The last date to apply for the IIT Guwahati Internship 2026 is 7 January 2026. Interested candidates are advised to apply early as positions may fill quickly due to high demand.

The university received multiple requests from colleges and students regarding technical issues and financial delays. In response, AKTU extended the last date for the AKTU Exam Form 2025 process, giving students an additional opportunity to complete their submissions.

Earlier, the last date for the AKTU Exam Form was December 12, but the university revised the schedule considering student convenience.

  • Closing Time: 5:00 PM
  • Portal: AKTU ERP Portal
  • Applicable: Regular & Carry-over Students
  • Exams Covered: Practical, Project, Written

The university has clearly instructed that both the AKTU Exam Form 2025 and the fee must be submitted before the revised deadline.

Colleges Asked to Inform Students Immediately

AKTU has directed all affiliated colleges to notify students about the updated AKTU Exam Form 2025 deadline. Institutions must ensure that no student misses the chance to fill the AKTU Exam Form 2025 within the extended window.

The notification has been signed and issued by Prof. Rajeev Kumar, Controller of Examinations.

Why This Update Matters

The extension is crucial for students who:

  • Faced ERP portal issues
  • Needed more time for fee submission
  • Missed the earlier deadline due to academic workload

With the updated AKTU Exam Form 2025 date, students get a final opportunity to complete the process without stress.

A. Through the AKTU ERP Portal only.

Students whose results reflect NPTY/NPFY Status must submit the AKTU Carry Over Exam Form 2025 to be eligible for the upcoming exams.

title.rendered: AKTU Issues Urgent Order to Implement Student Mental Health Guidelines After High Court Directive

content.rendered:
In a major development, Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University (AKTU) has issued an urgent directive instructing all affiliated colleges and institutions to strictly implement the AKTU student mental health guidelines. This action follows the Hon’ble High Court’s order in the case CRI.A No. 3177/2025 (Sukdeb Saha vs. Andhra Pradesh & Others) passed on 25 July 2025.

The official circular (पत्रांक: ए०के०टी०यू० / अधि० छात्र क0/2025/759) dated 09 December 2025, signed by Registrar Rina Singh, emphasizes immediate compliance and submission of a detailed report by institutions.

High Court Order Triggers Immediate Action

According to the circular, the AKTU student mental health guidelines must be enforced as mandated by the High Court. The University references two major government communications:

  • Joint Secretary, Technical Education, Letter dated 05 December 2025
  • Principal Secretary, Higher Education, Letter dated 26 November 2025

Both documents direct implementation of a statewide student mental health & suicide-prevention strategy in all educational institutions.

What AKTU Has Ordered

The university has reminded institutions that previous communications, including letters dated 22 September 2025 and 09 September 2025, had already instructed strict adherence to the AKTU student mental health guidelines.

Now, AKTU has reiterated the order with urgency.

All affiliated colleges—government, private, aided, and self-financed—must:

  • Establish proper mental health support systems
  • Implement suicide-prevention protocols
  • Follow state-issued mental health strategies
  • Submit an Action Taken Report (ATR) immediately

This report will be forwarded to the state government for compliance monitoring.

Why the Guidelines Matter

The AKTU student mental health guidelines aim to:

  • Support students experiencing emotional stress
  • Reduce rising incidents of student self-harm
  • Create preventive systems within campuses
  • Ensure trained counsellors and grievance mechanisms are active
  • Increase accountability at institutional level

The High Court has stressed that student mental safety is a legal obligation, not merely an administrative formality.

Who Received the Circular?

The AKTU circular has been forwarded to:

  • Vice-Chancellor
  • Finance Officer
  • Controller of Examinations
  • All Deans
  • Director, UPID Noida
  • Architecture & Planning Faculty
  • Centre for Advanced Studies
  • Public Relations Office
  • Registrar’s Office Staff

Each branch has been instructed to ensure the AKTU student mental health guidelines are implemented without delay.

Institutes Must Submit Action Taken Reports

AKTU has clearly stated that institutions must immediately submit their reports detailing:

  • Steps taken for student mental health
  • Implementation of suicide-prevention guidelines
  • Establishment of counselling facilities
  • Awareness activities conducted on campus

Failure to comply may lead to administrative consequences.

Student Impact

Students across AKTU campuses can expect:

  • Better access to counselling
  • More awareness programs
  • Stronger campus support systems
  • Immediate help channels for mental health crises

The AKTU student mental health guidelines are expected to significantly improve student support and safety across more than 750 affiliated colleges.

READ MORE : AKTU Branch Change 2025 Official Notice Released: Branch Allotments Confirmed for B.Tech 2nd Year (3rd Sem)

Conclusion

AKTU’s latest directive marks a strong administrative push to strengthen student mental health systems across Uttar Pradesh. With the High Court order in place, institutions are now legally required to implement the AKTU student mental health guidelines and report compliance immediately.

Affiliated institutes have been instructed to check the institute-wise AKTU Branch Change list and notify all students whose branch change has been approved. Colleges must also update their academic records and ensure ERP/attendance systems reflect the new branch allocation.

The AKTU Branch Change 2025 system provides academically eligible students a chance to shift to their preferred engineering branch at the beginning of the third semester. This decision can significantly influence a student’s academic performance, specialization choices, and career opportunities.

Since the branch change shapes the student’s educational direction, the final list of AKTU Branch Change carries major importance.

Yes, it applies to B.Tech 2nd year, 3rd semester students for the 2025–26 session.

इसलिए इस प्रक्रिया को समय पर पूरा करना बहुत ज़रूरी है।

Step 1: Google पर RGPV Search करके Student Registration Page खोलें

सबसे पहले Google में “RGPV” सर्च करें।
सर्च रिज़ल्ट में नीचे आपको कई ऑप्शन दिखेंगे:

  • Result View
  • Student Login
  • View Time Table
  • Student Registration
  • Examination Form

आपको Student Registration पर क्लिक करना है।

इसके बाद आपकी स्क्रीन पर Guidelines for Students Admitted in 2025 दिखाई देंगी। इन्हें पढ़कर X (cross) पर क्लिक करें।

Step 2: Registration Requirements ध्यान से पढ़ें

यहां आपको बताया जाएगा कि रजिस्ट्रेशन के लिए क्या-क्या चाहिए:

  • Passport Photo (JPG, सही साइज में)
  • Signature (JPG)
  • Valid Email ID
  • Active Mobile Number
  • Enrollment Number
  • Strong Password बनाने की गाइडलाइन

यह सभी चीजें तैयार रखें।

Step 3: Admission Year और Course चुनें

अब आपको:

  • Admission Year → 2025
  • Course → B.Tech / M.Tech / Lateral Entry / Diploma

सेलेक्ट करना है।

इसके बाद आपको Institute Select करने का विकल्प मिलेगा।
Dropdown में MP के सभी RGPV-affiliated कॉलेज दिखाई देंगे।
अपना कॉलेज का कोड या नाम चुनें (जैसे 0158 Radha Raman Engineering College)।

Step 4: Branch चुनें और अपनी Details Verify करें

अब आप अपनी ब्रांच चुनें, जैसे:

  • Civil Engineering
  • Mechanical
  • CSE
  • IT
  • Electrical

ब्रांच सेलेक्ट करते ही आपके बैच की सूची सामने आएगी जिसमें दिखेगा:

  • आपका नाम
  • पिता का नाम
  • DOB
  • Gender

यह Details ध्यान से Verify करें।
अगर कोई गलती है—Enrollment हो जाने के बाद Correction Form कॉलेज के माध्यम से भरा जा सकता है।

Step 5: Student Registration Form Fill करें

फॉर्म में आपकी Basic Details पहले से भरकर आ जाती हैं।
अब आपको भरना है:

✔ Permanent Address

(Aadhaar Card के अनुसार भरें)

✔ State → District → Pincode

अपने State को सही चुनना बहुत ज़रूरी है।

✔ Mobile Number

(Active और आपके पास होना चाहिए)

✔ Email ID

(वही डालें जिस पर OTP मिलता हो)

✔ Blood Group

(अगर नहीं पता तो कोई भी चुन सकते हैं)

Step 6: Username और Password Create करें

  • Username = आपका Enrollment Number
  • Password Minimum 7 Characters
  • Password में शामिल होना चाहिए:
    • Capital Letters
    • Small Letters
    • Numbers
    • Special Symbols (#, @, $, !)

पासवर्ड लिखकर कहीं सुरक्षित स्थान पर रखें—क्योंकि यही आगे Exam Form में भी काम आएगा।

Step 7: Registration Fee Payment (₹260)

भुगतान करने के दो तरीके:

1. Union Bank / HDFC NetBanking

आपके या आपके मित्र के खाते से भुगतान कर सकते हैं।

2. MP Online Kiosk पर जाकर

अगर बैंक खाता नहीं है तो MP Online पर भी रजिस्ट्रेशन हो सकता है
(लगभग ₹50 एक्स्ट्रा सर्विस चार्ज लग सकता है)।

पेमेंट Successful होते ही आपका RGPV Portal Registration 2025 पूरा हो जाता है।

Step 8: Portal Login करें

होम पेज पर जाएं →
Right Side में तीन लाइन मेन्यू पर क्लिक करें →
Student Life → Login

अब:

  • Username (Enrollment Number)
  • Password
  • Captcha

भरकर Login करें।

अब आपका RGPV Student Dashboard खुल जाएगा।

Step 9: Enrollment Form Fill करें

Student Dashboard → Student Services → Enrollment Form

अब यहां मांगी गई सभी जानकारी बहुत सावधानी से भरें:

  • Personal Details
  • Address
  • Category
  • Previous Education (10th/12th)
  • Document Upload

Enrollment Fees:

  • MP Students → ₹150
  • Other State Students → ₹650

पेमेंट Successful होते ही Enrollment Complete।

Step 10: Print निकालना न भूलें

Enrollment Complete होने के बाद 3 Printouts ज़रूर निकलें:

  1. Enrollment Form Print
  2. Enrollment Fee Receipt
  3. Portal Registration Fee Receipt

इन सभी को अपने कॉलेज में जमा करना होता है।

Step 11: ABC ID / APAAR ID भी बनाएं

अब DigiLocker App इंस्टॉल करें और ABC ID बनाएं।

इसमें आपको भरना होगा:

  • University Name → Rajiv Gandhi Proudyogiki Vishwavidyalaya
  • Enrollment Number
  • Admission Year → 2025

ABC Card का Print निकालकर कॉलेज में सबमिट करें।

Final Important Notes

  • RGPV Portal Registration 2025 समय सीमा के भीतर पूरा करें
  • Password और Enrollment Number कभी न भूलें
  • Payment Fail न होने दें
  • Enrollment Form को ध्यान से भरें
  • ABC ID बनाना अनिवार्य है

Conclusion

इस गाइड में आपने सीखा कि कैसे Step-by-Step आप RGPV Portal Registration 2025 और Enrollment Form आसानी से पूरा कर सकते हैं।

title.rendered: AKTU Exam 2025-26: Will Exams Start From 23 December? Simple & Clear Update

content.rendered:
The AKTU Exam 2025 Tentative Date Sheet is out, and many students want to know whether exams will actually begin from 23 December.
Here is the easiest and most clear explanation for all students.

What Does Tentative Date Mean in AKTU Exam 2025?

  • A tentative date is not final.
  • It only means the AKTU Exam 2025 is planned around that time, but the date can change anytime.

So, the 23 December date is not confirmed yet.

Why Students Are Confused About AKTU Exam

After the tentative date sheet, students are asking:

“Will AKTU Exam 2025 really start on 23 December?”

  • Some think the exam will be postponed.
  • Some think the exam will happen on time.

This confusion exists because AKTU has changed dates many times earlier.

What AKTU Did Last Year

Case 1: First Semester

  • Tentative dates were released
  • Students prepared
  • On admit card day, exams were cancelled
  • New date sheet came after 18 days
  • Exams happened almost one month late

Case 2: Second Semester

  • Tentative dates were released
  • Students expected delay
  • AKTU conducted exams exactly on time

This is why students are unsure about the AKTU 2025-26 Exam dates.

Will AKTU Exam Start From 23 December?

Let’s look at the current situation:

  • Many colleges have incomplete syllabus
  • PUT/PWT exams are still pending
  • Final date sheet for AKTU Exam is not released
  • Teachers are asked to finish the syllabus fast
  • Exam form processing is still going on

Because of these reasons, it seems difficult for the AKTU 2025-26 Exam to start on 23 December.

But AKTU is unpredictable, so the exam can still happen on this date.

Probability for AKTU Exam 2025

So, January is more likely, but December is also possible.

What Should Students Do for AKTU Exam ? (Easy Plan)

1. Start studying lightly

Just 2–3 hours daily is enough.

2. Prepare as if exam may happen on 23 December

If exams move to January, you get extra revision time.

3. Trust only official AKTU notices

Avoid fake forwarded messages.

4. Make a weekly study plan

This keeps you stress-free and focused.

Final Answer About AKTU Exam

✔ Will exams happen on 23 December?

Maybe, but not confirmed.

✔ Is January more likely for AKTU 2025-26 Exam ?

Yes, there is a higher chance.

✔ Should you start preparing now?

Yes, definitely.

Early preparation helps you whether exams happen in December or January.

READ MORE : AKTU Exam Form Payment Pending 2025: Students Stuck—Here’s the Fix That Actually Works

Important Note for Students Appearing in AKTU 2025-26 Exam

If exams happen early, you are ready.
If exams get delayed, you get more revision time.
Either way—you benefit.

Stay calm and study consistently.

FAQs

Q: Will the AKTU Exam 2025 start from 23 December?
A: The 23 December date is only tentative, not final. The exam may start on this date, but there is a higher chance that AKTU will shift the exam to January 2026.

Q: Is the 23 December date confirmed for AKTU Exam 2025?
A: No, it is not confirmed. AKTU has not released the final date sheet yet. Only the tentative timetable is available.

Q: Why is there so much confusion about the AKTU Exam 2025?
A: In previous years, AKTU has sometimes postponed exams and sometimes conducted them exactly on the tentative dates. Because of this inconsistent pattern, students are unsure what will happen this year.

Q: What does “tentative date” mean for AKTU exams?
A: A tentative date is a temporary or expected date that can change anytime. It is not the official schedule.

Q: What is the most likely month for AKTU Exam 2025?
A: Based on the current situation, January 2026 seems more likely, though December is still possible.

Q: Why are many colleges not ready for the 23 December exam?
A: Many colleges still have incomplete syllabus, pending PUT/PWT exams, and unfinished practicals, making it difficult to start exams in December.

Q: When will AKTU release the final date sheet for AKTU Exam 2025?
A: AKTU usually releases the final date sheet 7–12 days before the exam. Students should check the official AKTU website regularly.

Q: Should students wait for the final date sheet before studying?
A: No. Students should start preparing now. If the exam happens in December, they will be ready; if it is postponed to January, they will get extra revision time.

Q: How should students prepare during uncertain exam dates?
A: Students should study 2–3 hours daily, revise units one by one, follow a weekly plan, and avoid believing fake updates.

Q: Will practical exams also be delayed?
A: Yes, if the main AKTU Exam 2025 is postponed to January, practical exams will likely be delayed too.

Q: Can AKTU suddenly conduct exams on the tentative date?
A: Yes, AKTU has done this before. That’s why students should not take tentative dates lightly and must stay prepared.

Q: What is the safest preparation strategy for AKTU Exam 2025?
A: Start early, study slowly, stay consistent, and prepare as if the exam might start on 23 December but expect that it may happen in January.

title.rendered: AKTU Exam Form Payment Pending 2025: Students Stuck—Here’s the Fix That Actually Works

content.rendered:
Lucknow, December 2025: Thousands of AKTU students are facing the AKTU Exam Form Payment Pending issue while submitting their odd-semester exam forms. According to multiple reports, the payment amount is being deducted from bank accounts, but the ERP dashboard is showing blank status, no transaction ID, or pending even after several hours.

Technical experts and academic coordinators have now explained the exact reason behind the issue — and a verified working solution has been released that is helping students get instant payment success.

Why the AKTU Exam Form Payment Pending Issue Is Increasing in 2025

As per student feedback and ERP portal logs, two primary factors are responsible:

1. Payment attempts made from mobile phones

The AKTU ERP payment gateway uses multiple redirections.
Mobile browsers often refresh automatically, causing incomplete payment confirmation — resulting in a “Pending” status.

2. UPI approval delay

If a student takes more than a few seconds to approve a UPI request, the ERP gateway fails to record the final confirmation, even though the amount is deducted.

Both issues lead to incomplete transaction mapping on the server.

Official Working Fix: How Students Can Prevent Payment Pending Immediately

After reviewing repeated complaints, technical experts recommend the following verified step-by-step method, which has shown 99% success rate among students.

Step 1: Complete the Exam Form Using a Laptop, Not a Mobile Device

College ERP coordinators confirm that:

  • Laptop browsers handle redirection better
  • Mobile auto-refresh issues are avoided
  • Payment gateways load fully without interruption

Students should also verify:

  • Core subjects
  • Elective subjects
  • Attendance records

If subjects are incorrect or attendance is missing, colleges can update this instantly through their ERP dashboard.

Step 2: Use Paytm UPI for Payment (Most Stable Method)

Follow these steps for a successful transaction:

  1. Log in to the AKTU ERP portal on a laptop
  2. Open Exam Form Dashboard → Click Pay Fees
  3. Select Paytm UPI as the payment method
  4. Enter full UPI ID
  5. Click Proceed
  6. Approve the payment in the UPI app immediately

Experts strongly advise not refreshing or switching tabs during this process.

This method ensures complete gateway redirection, resulting in instant success.

How to Verify If the Payment Was Successfully Processed

Once payment is completed, students should:

  • Open a new tab
  • Clear Browser Cookies & Site Data
  • Log back into ERP
  • Open the Exam Form Dashboard

If the process was successful, the dashboard will show:

“Payment Status: SUCCESS”

This verification step is crucial to avoid confusion.

What Students Should Do If Payment Shows Pending After 72 Hours

AKTU guidelines state that students should wait up to 72 hours for auto-updates.
However, if the status remains unchanged:

Students must email the payment support team with:

  • MIS Number
  • Payment ID / Transaction ID
  • Date & Time
  • Screenshot of deduction
  • Issue summary

Most cases are resolved manually within 24–48 hours.

Refund Cases: What It Means for Students

If the payment amount is refunded:

  • The payment did not reach AKTU’s system
  • The exam form is not submitted
  • The student must make the payment again using a laptop

Refunds indicate a failed transaction, not a successful submission.

Official Recommendation: How Students Can Avoid Payment Issues in the Future

Experts suggest the following guidelines:

  • Always use a laptop for AKTU ERP transactions
  • Prefer Paytm UPI for smoother redirection
  • Avoid refreshing the page during payment
  • Clear browser cookies after completing payment
  • Re-check dashboard status before logging out

According to ERP administrators, following these steps significantly reduces the chances of mistakes and payment delays.

Conclusion

The AKTU Exam Form Payment Pending issue has become a major concern for students across Uttar Pradesh.
However, with the recommended laptop-based method and correct payment process, students can ensure instant success and avoid unnecessary delays.

Students facing unresolved issues are encouraged to contact their college ERP coordinator or use the official email support for payment verification.

title.rendered: AKTU Scholarship Verification 2024-25: Important Notice Issued for All Affiliated Institutes

content.rendered:
The Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University (AKTU), Uttar Pradesh has issued a major notice related to the AKTU Scholarship Verification 2024-25 process. The circular directs all affiliated government and self-financed institutes to complete online verification of student scholarship applications and actual student strength within the prescribed timelines.

According to the official communication (dated 06 December 2025), the Department of Social Welfare, Government of Uttar Pradesh has instructed that the online verification for Post-Matric Scholarship and Fee Reimbursement must be completed between 04 December 2025 and 09 December 2025.

This notice is crucial because the AKTU Scholarship Verification 2024-25 ensures that only eligible students receive benefits under the state scholarship scheme.

What AKTU Has Directed the Institutes to Do?

As per the new instructions, AKTU has asked all affiliated institutions to verify and certify the following:

1. Student Enrollment Authentication

Institutes must confirm that all students listed in forwarded scholarship applications are actually studying in their institution. This is a mandatory part of the AKTU Scholarship Verification 2024-25 procedure.

2. Proper Checking of Online Applications

Every online application submitted under the scholarship scheme must be thoroughly checked, matched with institutional records, and verified for accuracy. Institutes must ensure that all entries are correct and error-free.

3. Forward Only Eligible Candidates

According to the scholarship guidelines, only eligible applicants should be forwarded for approval. This step forms the core of the AKTU Scholarship Verification 2024-25 process.

4. No Student Should Apply for Multiple Scholarships

Institutes must verify that forwarded students have not applied for any other Government of India scholarship scheme. Violations will be treated as serious discrepancies.

5. No Ineligible Student Should Be Forwarded

Institutes must certify that no application belonging to an ineligible student has been forwarded. Any future detection of false information will make the institution solely responsible.

Affidavit Requirement for AKTU Scholarship Verification 2024-25

AKTU has strictly instructed all Directors/Principals to submit an affidavit confirming the following:

  • All forwarded applications belong to genuine, enrolled students.
  • Each application has been examined and verified according to norms.
  • No ineligible or duplicate applicant has been forwarded.
  • No student has applied under any other scholarship scheme.

This affidavit must be signed by the Director/Principal and submitted along with the complete class-wise and year-wise student list.

Last Date for Submission: 08 December 2025

Institutes must submit:

  • Verified student lists (category-wise, year-wise)
  • The original signed affidavit
  • Proof of online verification completion

Deadline: 08 December 2025

AKTU has clearly mentioned that any delay or discrepancy will be the responsibility of the institution itself, emphasizing the seriousness of the AKTU Scholarship Verification 2024-25 process.

READ MORE : AKTU Asks Colleges to Upload AKTU Detained Students List 2025 by December 12

Why This Notice Is Important for Students?

This verification process directly impacts scholarship disbursement. Completing AKTU Scholarship Verification 2024-25 on time ensures:

  • Smooth approval of scholarship applications
  • Timely payment of fee reimbursement
  • Removal of errors and ineligible entries
  • Transparency in the scholarship system

Students are advised to stay in touch with their institution to ensure their details are correctly verified.

title.rendered: AKTU Asks Colleges to Upload AKTU Detained Students List 2025 by December 12

content.rendered:
Lucknow, December 6, 2025:
AKTU has released an important notice for all its affiliated colleges and institutes. The university has asked every institution to upload the AKTU Detained Students List 2025 on the ERP portal latest by December 12, 2025, evening 5 PM. This announcement comes as the university prepares to conduct the Odd Semester Exams 2025 in offline mode.

What AKTU Has Announced

The notice, issued by the Controller of Examinations, clearly states that every college must carefully identify students who need to be detained according to the university rules, mainly due to attendance shortages or internal performance issues. These details must be uploaded in the AKTU Detained Students List 2025 through the official ERP system.

The university has strictly mentioned that the deadline will not be extended.

If Colleges Don’t Upload the List, What Happens?

AKTU has taken a very direct stand this time. According to the notice, if any institution fails to upload the AKTU Detained Students List 2025 by the final deadline, the university will assume that no student from that college is detained.

In such cases, AKTU will automatically issue admit cards to all students, even if someone actually had attendance or internal marks issues. This makes the AKTU Detained Students List 2025 extremely important for colleges to submit on time.

What Students Should Do Now

Students who feel they might appear in the AKTU Detained Students List 2025 should immediately check with their college. Detention decisions are made at the institute level, not by AKTU directly.

If students want to avoid confusion before the AKTU Odd Semester Exam 2025, they should verify their attendance records and internal marks and stay in touch with their department.

Why the Detained Students List Matters

The AKTU Detained Students List 2025 plays a major role in making sure:

  • Students meet minimum attendance rules
  • Internal assessment is taken seriously
  • Exam eligibility remains fair for everyone
  • The university maintains academic discipline

Without this list, the exam process becomes less transparent, which is why AKTU has been strict about submission.

Who Received the Notice?

The notice has also been shared with several senior officials of the university, including the Pro-Vice Chancellor, Registrar, Finance Officer, ERP Incharge, and even the Vice-Chancellor’s office. This shows how seriously AKTU is monitoring the AKTU Detained Students List 2025 process.

READ MORE : Breaking Update: AKTU Challenge Evaluation Results 2024-25 Released – Check Your Revised Marks Now

Final Takeaway

AKTU has made it clear: the AKTU Detained Students List 2025 must be uploaded by December 12, 2025, without fail. If colleges ignore this, admit cards will be issued to every student automatically.

Students are advised to stay alert, stay connected with their college, and keep following updates related to the AKTU Odd Semester Exam 2025.

title.rendered: AKTU Important Notice : प्री-रजिस्ट्रेशन और नामांकन फॉर्म भरने की आखिरी मौका – छात्रों में बढ़ी चिंता

content.rendered:
AKTU Important Notice 2025 जारी किया गया है, जिसमें विश्वविद्यालय ने प्री-रजिस्ट्रेशन, नामांकन फॉर्म, और परीक्षा फॉर्म भरने से जुड़ी महत्वपूर्ण जानकारी साझा की है। यह नोटिस विशेष रूप से B.Tech प्रथम वर्ष और अन्य पाठ्यक्रमों में प्रवेशित उन छात्रों के लिए है जिन्होंने निर्धारित अंतिम तिथि तक अपने दस्तावेज पूरे नहीं किए।

पहला पॉइंट: प्री-रजिस्ट्रेशन पूरा न करने वाले छात्र ध्यान दें

AKTU Important Notice 2025 के अनुसार, वे छात्र/छात्राएँ जिन्होंने 15 नवंबर 2025 रात 11:59 बजे तक अपना प्री-रजिस्ट्रेशन नहीं किया था या शुल्क जमा न करने के कारण प्रक्रिया अधूरी रह गई थी, उन्हें अंतिम मौका दिया गया है।

  • विश्वविद्यालय का ERP Login पोर्टल 6 दिसंबर 2025 से 8 दिसंबर 2025 तक खुला रहेगा।
  • इस अवधि में छात्रों को अनिवार्य रूप से प्री-रजिस्ट्रेशन की प्रक्रिया पूरी करनी होगी।
  • ध्यान देने योग्य बात यह है कि नया प्री-रजिस्ट्रेशन करने की अनुमति नहीं है, केवल पहले से अधूरी प्रक्रिया को पूरा किया जा सकता है।

यह अपडेट सभी नए प्रवेशित छात्रों के लिए बेहद महत्वपूर्ण है, इसलिए AKTU Important Notice 2025 को गंभीरता से पढ़ना आवश्यक है।

दूसरा पॉइंट: नामांकन/परीक्षा फॉर्म अब 10 दिसंबर 2025 तक भर सकते हैं

AKTU Important Notice 2025 में आगे बताया गया है कि:

  • जिन छात्रों ने नामांकन फॉर्म या परीक्षा फॉर्म निर्धारित अंतिम तिथि तक नहीं भरे हैं, वे अभी भी भर सकते हैं।
  • ERP Login के माध्यम से यह प्रक्रिया 6 दिसंबर से 10 दिसंबर 2025 तक उपलब्ध रहेगी।

➤ यह राहत उन सभी छात्रों के लिए फायदेमंद है, जिनके फॉर्म तकनीकी समस्या या गलती के कारण अधूरे रह गए थे।

AKTU Important Notice 2025: छात्रों के लिए मुख्य निर्देश

  1. प्री-रजिस्ट्रेशन, नामांकन और परीक्षा फॉर्म की प्रक्रिया को निर्धारित तिथियों में पूरा करें।
  2. नया प्री-रजिस्ट्रेशन स्वीकार नहीं किया जाएगा—सिर्फ अधूरी प्रक्रिया ही पूरी की जा सकती है।
  3. ERP Login पोर्टल को समय सीमा में उपयोग कर सभी आवश्यक औपचारिकताएँ पूरी करें।
  4. समय पर फॉर्म न भरने की स्थिति में छात्र आगे की प्रक्रियाओं में शामिल नहीं हो पाएंगे।

Why This AKTU Important Notice 2025 Matters?

यह नोटिस छात्रों के लिए इसलिए महत्वपूर्ण है क्योंकि:

  • बिना प्री-रजिस्ट्रेशन के सीट कन्फर्म नहीं होती।
  • नामांकन फॉर्म न भरने पर छात्र विश्वविद्यालय रिकॉर्ड में शामिल नहीं होते।
  • परीक्षा फॉर्म न भरने पर छात्र सेमेस्टर परीक्षा में नहीं बैठ सकते।

इसलिए छात्रों के लिए यह आवश्यक है कि AKTU Important Notice 2025 में बताई गई सभी बातों पर तुरंत कार्रवाई करें।

READ MORE : Breaking Update: AKTU Challenge Evaluation Results 2024-25 Released – Check Your Revised Marks Now

Conclusion

AKTU Important Notice 2025 छात्रों को अंतिम अवसर दे रहा है ताकि वे अपना प्री-रजिस्ट्रेशन, नामांकन और परीक्षा फॉर्म समय पर जमा कर सकें। विश्वविद्यालय ने स्पष्ट कहा है कि यह विशेष विंडो केवल कुछ दिनों के लिए ही उपलब्ध है, इसलिए विलंब न करें।

यह अपडेट विद्यार्थियों के लिए अत्यंत जरूरी है — समय पर प्रक्रिया पूरी करें ताकि किसी प्रकार की परेशानी आगे न आए।

title.rendered: Breaking Update: AKTU Challenge Evaluation Results 2024-25 Released – Check Your Revised Marks Now

content.rendered:
The AKTU Challenge Evaluation Results for the 2024-25 Odd and Even Semesters have finally been released. This is an important update for thousands of students who applied for re-evaluation and were waiting for confirmation on their revised marks.

Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University has officially published the AKTU Challenge Evaluation Results on its portal, and students can now log in and check their updated scores with just a few steps.

What’s Included in the AKTU Challenge Evaluation Results 2024-25?

As per the latest notification, the university has uploaded results for:

  • 2024-25 Odd Semester
  • 2024-25 Even Semester

Students who submitted applications for scrutiny or re-evaluation can now verify whether their marks have been changed after the challenge evaluation process.

The AKTU Challenge Evaluation Results ensure transparency and provide an opportunity for students to correct potential marking errors.

Why Some Students Are Not Able to See Changes Yet?

Many students have reported that their updated marks are not visible immediately. This is completely normal. The AKTU portal updates results in phases, so there may be a slight delay.

If your AKTU Challenge Evaluation Results are not visible:

  • Do not panic
  • Wait for 24–48 hours
  • The university will update all pending results before the last date of exam form submission

AKTU typically ensures that all revised marks are reflected in time so that students do not face issues in filling their next semester exam forms.

How to Check AKTU Challenge Evaluation Results?

Here is the quick method to check your AKTU Challenge Evaluation Results:

  1. Visit the official AKTU website
  2. Go to the Results or Student Dashboard section
  3. Log in using your roll number and password
  4. Click on “Challenge Evaluation Results”
  5. Download or screenshot the updated result for future reference

Make sure you keep a copy of your revised marks in case you need them during exam form submission or internal processing.

What Should Students Do Next?

After checking your AKTU Challenge Evaluation Results, you should:

  • Verify whether your marks have increased
  • Ensure your updated marks reflect in the final marksheet before the deadline
  • Contact your college examination cell if the result is still not updated after a few days

This release will help students plan their academic progress for the next semester smoothly.

The release of AKTU Challenge Evaluation Results 2024-25 brings relief and clarity for all students who applied for re-evaluation. If your result isn’t updated yet, stay patient—AKTU will update all revised scores before the exam form deadline.

title.rendered: AKTU One-Year Extension 2025: Big Relief for Students as University Grants Final Chance to Complete Degrees

content.rendered:
The AKTU One-Year Extension 2025 announcement has brought huge relief to thousands of students across Uttar Pradesh. Dr. A.P.J. This update has become one of the most talked-about decisions of the year, giving fresh hope to students whose academic progress was stuck.

Why AKTU Approved the One-Year Extension 2025

The university observed that many students could not complete their programs within the maximum duration defined by AKTU’s ordinance.

To support such students, AKTU’s Examination Committee and Academic Council collectively decided to introduce the AKTU One-Year Extension 2025, ensuring that students get one final attempt to finish their degree.

  • Inform every eligible student about the AKTU One-Year Extension 2025
  • Ensure students fill exam forms within the official schedule
  • Verify documents and eligibility
  • Provide all necessary support to complete the process

Students should contact their college immediately to avoid missing deadlines.

What the AKTU One-Year Extension 2025 Means for Students

This decision is highly significant for students who:

  • Could not take exams due to medical or personal challenges
  • Accumulated backlogs beyond the allowed time
  • Faced genuine difficulties that interrupted their academic progress

With the AKTU One-Year Extension 2025, these students now have a chance to complete their degree without losing their entire academic investment.

The university has clearly stated that this will be the final opportunity. No extensions will be allowed beyond 2025–26.

title.rendered: AKTU Issues Notice to Pratapgarh Engineering College Over Missing Practical Marks for 2023-24 & 2024-25 Sessions

content.rendered:
Lucknow, December 2025: Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University (AKTU), Uttar Pradesh, has sent an official notice to Bharat Ratna Babasaheb Bhimrao Ambedkar Government Engineering College, Pratapgarh (Institute Code 1216) after it was found that the institute did not upload internal and external practical marks for multiple semesters of the 2023-24 and 2024-25 academic sessions.

The letter, issued under Office Order No. AKTU/P-Exam/2025/2370, states that the missing marks have directly affected result updates on the AKTU ERP portal, prompting the university to demand an urgent explanation from the college administration.

What the AKTU Notice Says

According to AKTU, the college had earlier sent a communication—
Letter No. 477 / R030 / Pratapgarh / 2025, dated 17 November 2025—
regarding pending results. After reviewing the matter, the university confirmed that:

  • Internal practical marks for several subjects were not uploaded.
  • External practical marks for a number of courses also remain unsubmitted.
  • These missing entries have delayed the result processing for many students.

AKTU states that without the submission of complete marks, student results cannot be updated, which could impact progression, back-paper evaluation, and final mark sheets.

Clear Report Demanded From the Institute

The notice, signed by Prof. Rajeev Kumar, Controller of Examinations (In-Charge), AKTU, instructs the institute to provide a clear and immediate explanation for the delay.

The university has emphasized the seriousness of the matter, directing the institute to submit its report “as early as possible” so that pending results can be processed.

Copies of the notice have also been forwarded to:

  • Joint/Deputy Controller of Examinations, AKTU
  • Staff Officer to the Hon’ble Vice Chancellor, AKTU, for review

Impact on Students

The missing marks are likely to affect:

  • Odd and Even semester results of sessions 2023-24 & 2024-25
  • SGPA/CGPA calculations
  • Back-paper results
  • Final transcripts and degree processing

Students from the affected batches may notice incomplete or withheld results on the ERP portal until the college uploads the required data.

Why This Notice Matters

Such notices highlight ongoing challenges in exam data management within affiliated colleges. Since AKTU processes results strictly based on ERP submissions, any delay from the institute directly impacts students.

The university has taken a strict stance, making it clear that result delays due to non-submission of marks will not be tolerated.

READ MORE : AKTU Challenge Evaluation Phase-II Out: Answer Sheets Live on ERP – Check Now!

What Happens Next

  • The institute must upload all missing internal and external practical marks.
  • A detailed explanation must be submitted to AKTU.
  • Once verification is complete, AKTU will update affected student results.

The university is expected to take further action depending on the institute’s response.

dcoe-a@aktu.ac.in

title.rendered: AKTU Exam Form 2025: विश्वविद्यालय ने जारी किया बड़ा नोटिस, 23 दिसंबर से ऑफलाइन परीक्षाएँ

content.rendered:
लखनऊ, 2 दिसंबर 2025 – डॉ. ए.पी.जे. अब्दुल कलाम प्राविधिक विश्वविद्यालय (AKTU) ने सत्र 2025-26 के Odd Semester के लिए महत्वपूर्ण नोटिस जारी करते हुए बताया है कि AKTU Exam Form 2025 भरने की प्रक्रिया आधिकारिक रूप से शुरू हो चुकी है। Regular और Carry Over दोनों श्रेणी के छात्रों को निर्धारित तिथियों के भीतर ERP पोर्टल से फॉर्म भरना अनिवार्य किया गया है।

विश्वविद्यालय ने स्पष्ट किया है कि Odd Semester की सभी परीक्षाएँ 23 दिसंबर 2025 से ऑफलाइन मोड में आयोजित की जाएँगी।

किन छात्रों को भरना है AKTU Exam Form 2025

नीचे दी गई सूची के अनुसार सभी कोर्स के इन सेमेस्टर के छात्रों को AKTU Exam Form 2025 भरना होगा:

  • B.Tech – 3rd, 5th, 7th
  • B.Pharm – 3rd, 5th, 7th
  • B.Arch, MBA (INT), M.Tech (INT), MCA-DD, MCA (INT) – 3rd, 5th, 7th, 9th
  • BHMCT, BFA, BFAD – 3rd, 5th, 7th
  • MBA (All), MCA, M.Arch, M.Tech, M.Pharm, MURP – 3rd
  • BBA, BCA, BVoc – 3rd, 5th
  • Pharm D (Only Carry Over) – 1st, 2nd, 3rd, 4th Year

AKTU Exam Form 2025 की महत्वपूर्ण तिथियाँ

नीचे तालिका में AKTU Exam Form 2025 की पूरी समय-सारिणी दी गई है:

23 दिसंबर से ऑफलाइन परीक्षाएँ

विश्वविद्यालय ने नोटिस में बताया कि:

  • Odd Semester की सभी परीक्षाएँ ऑफलाइन होंगी
  • परीक्षा व्यवस्था पिछले वर्षों की तरह ही रहेगी
  • विस्तृत परीक्षा कार्यक्रम अलग से जारी किया जाएगा
  • सभी कॉलेज छात्रों की उपस्थिति और समय पर तैयारी सुनिश्चित करें

साथ ही संस्थानों को निर्देश दिया गया है कि एकेडमिक कैलेंडर के अनुसार पठन-पाठन पूरा कराने के लिए आवश्यक होने पर अवकाश दिनों में भी अतिरिक्त कक्षाएँ संचालित की जाएँ।

READ MORE : AKTU COP Result 2025 Released: 2nd, 3rd, and 4th Semester Back Paper Results Updated on One View

कॉलेजों के लिए महत्वपूर्ण निर्देश

AKTU ने सभी संबद्ध संस्थानों को निम्न निर्देश दिए हैं:

  • ERP पोर्टल पर छात्रों को समय से AKTU Exam Form 2025 भरवाया जाए
  • परीक्षा शुल्क समय पर जमा कराया जाए
  • सभी फॉर्म तिथि के भीतर कॉलेज द्वारा verify किए जाएँ
  • कोई भी छात्र परीक्षा प्रक्रिया से छूट न पाए
  • पठन-पाठन दिवस और संपर्क घंटे विश्वविद्यालय के मानकों के अनुसार पूरे हों

नोटिस की प्रतिलिपि कुलपति, कुलसचिव, वित्त अधिकारी, उप परीक्षा नियंत्रक, ERP प्रभारी और जनसम्पर्क अधिकारी को भी भेजी गई है।

title.rendered: AKTU COP Result 2025 Released: 2nd, 3rd, and 4th Semester Back Paper Results Updated on One View

content.rendered:
Lucknow: Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University has released a major update for students across multiple semesters. The AKTU COP Result 2025 for 2nd semester, 3rd semester, and 4th semester back paper examinations has now been declared on the official AKTU One View portal.

With this triple update, thousands of students who appeared in COP exams for any of these semesters can now check their updated marks online. The early release of the AKTU COP Result 2025 indicates that AKTU is moving ahead with an accelerated academic schedule this year.

2nd Semester COP Result Also Declared

In addition to higher semesters, the 2nd semester COP Result has also been updated. Many first-year students who appeared for back paper exams confirmed that their revised marks are now visible on One View.

The inclusion of the 2nd semester in the latest AKTU COP Result 2025 update shows that the university has completed evaluations across multiple academic levels simultaneously.

3rd and 4th Semester COP Results Updated Together

Students from the 3rd and 4th semesters have also reported that their COP results were uploaded earlier than expected. The publication of the AKTU COP Result 2025 for both semesters on the same day highlights a faster evaluation cycle compared to previous years.

This coordinated release indicates that AKTU is clearing pending evaluations quickly.

Challenge Evaluation Stage-II Notice Also Published

Along with the AKTU COP Result 2025, AKTU has released an update regarding Challenge Evaluation Stage-II, confirming that the scrutiny and re-evaluation processes are also moving ahead rapidly.

The combined release of COP results and challenge evaluation updates suggests strong administrative preparation for upcoming semester exams.

Upcoming Exams Expected Earlier Than Usual

After the declaration of the AKTU COP Result 2025 for 2nd, 3rd, and 4th semesters, experts believe that the next round of AKTU exams may begin soon. Based on the current timeline, the exams could be organized either:

  • In the last week of December, or
  • In the first week of January

The quick release of the AKTU COP Result 2025 strongly indicates that AKTU wants to maintain an uninterrupted academic calendar.

title.rendered: AKTU Challenge Evaluation 2025: प्री-फाइनल इयर और सम सेमेस्टर की कॉपियों का चैलेंज मूल्यांकन शुरू, जानें पूरी प्रक्रिया

content.rendered:
AKTU ने सत्र 2024-25 के सम सेमेस्टर द्वितीय चरण और सम सेमेस्टर प्रथम चरण प्री-फाइनल इयर परीक्षा में शामिल छात्रों के लिए AKTU Challenge Evaluation 2025 प्रक्रिया को आधिकारिक रूप से शुरू कर दिया है। विश्वविद्यालय ने परीक्षाओं का परिणाम जारी करने के बाद उन छात्रों के लिए मौका दिया है जो अपनी उत्तर-पुस्तिकाओं का पुनर्मूल्यांकन करवाना चाहते हैं।

इस नोटिस के माध्यम से सभी AKTU-संबद्ध कॉलेजों के निदेशक और प्राचार्य को भी महत्वपूर्ण निर्देश भेजे गए हैं। विद्यार्थियों को अपनी कॉपी देखने, जांचने और निर्धारित शुल्क जमा करके AKTU Challenge Evaluation 2025 के लिए समय से आवेदन करना होगा।

AKTU Challenge Evaluation 2025 – आवेदन तिथि

AKTU ने आवेदन के लिए स्पष्ट टाइमलाइन जारी की है:

  • शुरूआत: 29 नवम्बर 2025
  • अंतिम तिथि: 08 दिसम्बर 2025

छात्र निर्धारित अवधि के भीतर ERP लॉगिन के जरिए आवेदन कर सकते हैं। आवेदन देर से करने पर इसे स्वीकार नहीं किया जाएगा, इसलिए सभी छात्रों को समय रहते प्रक्रिया पूरी करनी चाहिए।

ERP पोर्टल पर उत्तर पुस्तिका उपलब्ध

AKTU ने चैलेंज मूल्यांकन की पारदर्शिता बढ़ाने के लिए छात्रों की answer copy को सीधे ERP लॉगिन पर उपलब्ध कराया है।
जैसे ही छात्र ERP में लॉगिन करते हैं, वे अपनी उत्तर-पुस्तिका को:

  • देख सकते हैं
  • जांच सकते हैं
  • किसी भी संभावित गलती या अनचेक उत्तर को पहचान सकते हैं

इसके बाद AKTU Challenge Evaluation 2025 के लिए आवेदन कर सकते हैं।

AKTU Challenge Evaluation 2025 फीस

विश्वविद्यालय ने प्रति विषय निम्न शुल्क निर्धारित किया है:

  • ₹2500 प्रति विषय

ऑनलाइन चैलेंज मूल्यांकन केवल तभी स्वीकार किया जाएगा जब फीस सफलतापूर्वक जमा हो जाए। बैंक विवरण (Account Number, IFSC Code, Bank Name) भरते समय छात्रों को पूरी सावधानी बरतनी होगी, क्योंकि गलत जानकारी देने पर भुगतान में विलंब या रिफंड में दिक्कत हो सकती है।

कौन-कौन आवेदन कर सकता है?

AKTU ने यह प्रक्रिया उन छात्रों के लिए शुरू की है जिनको:

  • अपने प्राप्तांक पर संदेह हो
  • कॉपी में चेकिंग से संबंधित त्रुटि का शक हो
  • किसी उत्तर का मूल्यांकन सही न लगे
  • मार्क्स में विसंगति प्रतीत हो

ऐसे सभी विद्यार्थी बिना किसी प्रतिबंध के AKTU Challenge Evaluation 2025 के लिए आवेदन कर सकते हैं।

चैलेंज मूल्यांकन कैसे किया जाएगा?

AKTU ने शासनादेश और परीक्षा समिति के निर्णय के आधार पर चैलेंज मूल्यांकन के लिए तीन मुख्य नियम तय किए हैं:

1. दो विषय विशेषज्ञ कॉपी का मूल्यांकन करेंगे

दो परीक्षक कॉपी की जाँच करेंगे और:

  • दोनों द्वारा दिए गए अंकों का औसत निकाला जाएगा
  • यही औसत अंक अंतिम अंक माना जाएगा

यह व्यवस्था AKTU Challenge Evaluation 2025 की निष्पक्षता सुनिश्चित करती है।

2. यदि अंतर 20% से अधिक

यदि मूल अंक और नए औसत अंक के बीच प्रश्न पत्र के पूर्णांक के 20% से अधिक का अंतर निकलता है:

  • छात्र को जमा शुल्क ₹2500 में से ₹1500 वापस किए जाएंगे
  • ₹1000 प्रोसेसिंग चार्ज के रूप में काटे जाएंगे

3. गलत बैंक विवरण की जिम्मेदारी छात्र की

यदि छात्र गलत खाते की जानकारी देता है, तो:

  • रिफंड में समस्या आएगी
  • इसकी पूर्ण जिम्मेदारी छात्र पर होगी

इसलिए AKTU Challenge Evaluation 2025 में आवेदन करते समय बैंक डिटेल्स को दो बार जांचने की सलाह दी गई है।

आवेदन प्रक्रिया – AKTU Challenge Evaluation 2025

1. AKTU ERP लॉगिन करें

छात्र रोल नंबर और पासवर्ड से लॉगिन करेंगे।

2. उत्तर-पुस्तिका देखें

ERP पर उपलब्ध उत्तर-पुस्तिका डाउनलोड करके ध्यान से जांचें।

3. विषय का चयन करें

जिस विषय का चैलेंज मूल्यांकन करवाना है, उसका चयन करें।

4. ऑनलाइन शुल्क जमा करें

₹2500 प्रति विषय की फीस जमा करें।

5. आवेदन सबमिट करें

फॉर्म सबमिट करने के बाद इसकी कॉपी सुरक्षित रख लें।

AKTU Challenge Evaluation 2025 रिजल्ट कब आएगा?

यूनिवर्सिटी आमतौर पर चैलेंज मूल्यांकन के परिणाम:

  • 3 से 6 हफ्ते
    में जारी करती है।

रिजल्ट ERP पोर्टल पर अपडेट किया जाता है। छात्रों को नियमित रूप से पोर्टल चेक करने की सलाह दी जाती है।

निष्कर्ष

AKTU Challenge Evaluation 2025 उन छात्रों के लिए बड़ा अवसर है जिन्हें लगता है कि उनकी उत्तर-पुस्तिका का मूल्यांकन सही नहीं हुआ। पूरी प्रक्रिया पारदर्शी है, ERP पर कॉपी उपलब्ध है और जाँच दो परीक्षकों द्वारा की जाती है। यदि आपको लगता है कि आपके मार्क्स अपेक्षित नहीं हैं, तो यह प्रक्रिया आपके लिए निर्णायक साबित हो सकती है।

title.rendered: Cognizant Fresher Hiring 2025: Big Recruitment Drive for BE/BTech Graduates — Apply Before 5 December

content.rendered:
If you are a 2025 engineering graduate searching for a reliable IT job in a top multinational company, this is the biggest update you need right now. Cognizant Fresher Hiring 2025 has officially opened its GenC recruitment window, and students across India are applying at a rapid pace. The last date to submit the application is 5 December 2025 at 11:59 PM, and the platform is already witnessing high traffic.

Cognizant is hiring for its major tech hubs including Chennai, Bangalore, Hyderabad, Pune, Kolkata, Kochi, Coimbatore, Bhubaneswar, and Indore. The starting package for this year’s Cognizant Fresher Hiring 2025 is INR 4 LPA, making it one of the most preferred roles among engineering graduates.

Apply Now for Cognizant Fresher Hiring 2025

Students can apply only through the official Cognizant hiring portal (Superset).

<<Direct Link>>

APPLY NOW

Why This Hiring News Is Trending Everywhere

Cognizant’s GenC role consistently ranks among the top choices for freshers because of its:

  • Software development–focused training
  • Early exposure to real client projects
  • Stable career growth
  • Nationwide hiring scale

The Cognizant Fresher Hiring 2025 update is gaining massive traction on social media, placement groups, and job boards because the recruitment window is comparatively short and the competition is high. Students prefer applying early before the portal gets overloaded.

Eligibility Criteria for Cognizant Fresher Hiring 2025

  • Only 2025 batch BE/BTech/ME/MTech graduates can apply
  • Minimum 60% in X, XII, Diploma, UG, PG
  • No rounding off of scores is accepted
  • Candidates must have no standing arrears at joining

  • Superset registration email must remain unchanged

content.rendered:

This is exactly why solving Civil 3rd Year AKTU PYQS (Structural Analysis) becomes the most reliable and effective exam preparation strategy. PYQs not only give clarity on repeated questions but also help you identify chapter-wise weightage, numerical patterns, and the examiner’s expectations. Importance of PYQs in Structural Analysis Preparation

Structural Analysis is a foundation subject in Civil Engineering because it forms the basis for advanced subjects like RCC, Steel Design, Bridge Engineering, and Earthquake Engineering. The complexity of its concepts makes it essential for students to practice as many numerical problems as possible. The reason Civil 3rd Year AKTU PYQS (Structural Analysis) is so important is because almost 60 to 70 percent of exam papers typically repeat previous patterns, either directly or in modified form.

PYQs reveal exactly which core topics receive the most attention every year. These include shear force and bending moment diagrams, influence lines, slope and deflection methods, three hinged arches, method of consistent deformations, and stiffness matrix method. By analyzing older papers, students can predict the exam’s difficulty level and practice more effectively. This targeted revision helps students avoid last-minute confusion and boosts their accuracy in solving numerical problems.

What Makes Structural Analysis Difficult for Students

Structural Analysis involves deep understanding of load behavior, internal forces, and mathematical techniques used to evaluate structural performance. Many students struggle with this subject because they try to memorize concepts instead of practicing numerical applications. The subject requires consistent problem-solving, and Civil 3rd Year AKTU PYQS (Structural Analysis) helps simplify these difficult topics through real exam examples.

The subject becomes challenging due to long formulas, multiple methods for solving the same problem, and the requirement for accuracy in drawing diagrams. For example, students often get confused between the slope-deflection method, moment distribution method, and energy methods. PYQs show exactly which type of question is more likely to appear and help you focus your energy on the most relevant methods.

Key Topics Frequently Asked in AKTU Structural Analysis Exams

When you analyze the last 10 years of Civil 3rd Year AKTU PYQS (Structural Analysis), certain topics clearly appear more frequently than others. These include:

1. Shear Force and Bending Moment Diagrams

Students are often asked to draw complete SFD and BMD for beams under various loading situations. These questions are almost guaranteed every year.

2. Influence Line Diagrams

This topic is crucial for moving load analysis. At least one major numerical problem from influence lines is asked in most AKTU papers.

3. Slope and Deflection Methods

Methods like Macaulay’s method, conjugate beam method, and unit load method appear repeatedly. PYQs show which method is most frequently used in exams.

4. Arches and Cables

Three-hinged arches, horizontal thrust calculations, and cable tension problems form an important portion of the exam.

5. Indeterminate Structures

Stiffness matrix, flexibility matrix, and moment distribution methods frequently appear as long numerical questions.

Preparing these topics through PYQs makes the entire subject more predictable and manageable.

How PYQs Help You Score Better Marks

The biggest advantage of practicing Civil 3rd Year AKTU PYQS (Structural Analysis) is that it reduces the overall revision time. Instead of studying every chapter in depth, students can focus on the ones that matter the most. PYQs help you understand the marking scheme, the preferred solving method, and the level of detail expected in diagrams and steps.

Many Civil Engineering students say that completing at least five years of PYQs improves their exam confidence by more than 80 percent. PYQs also reveal important repeated numericals, similar problem patterns, and the difficulty level of 10-mark questions. Solving them helps you avoid silly mistakes and improves your time management during the exam.

Tips to Score High in Structural Analysis Using PYQs

Follow these strategies to get maximum benefit from PYQs:

Study the solutions of PYQs step by step and note down formulas separately.
Solve each PYQ at least twice to improve accuracy and speed.
Refer to AKTU-oriented textbooks only, focusing on solved examples.
Draw neat and properly labeled diagrams for SFD, BMD, ILD, and arches.
Always revise conceptual topics like determinacy, stiffness method, and energy principles.
Discuss difficult PYQs with seniors or classmates for better understanding.

Using Civil 3rd Year AKTU PYQS (Structural Analysis) along with your class notes is the best way to score above 60 or even 75 marks in this subject.

Conclusion

Structural Analysis becomes much easier when you prepare smartly with PYQs. The subject requires conceptual clarity and repetitive numerical practice, and PYQs offer both. If you want to improve your marks, reduce exam fear, and study efficiently, then solving Civil 3rd Year AKTU PYQS (Structural Analysis) should be your top priority. Make PYQs a part of your daily study plan and you will notice a major improvement in your speed, confidence, and exam performance.

title.rendered: Civil 3rd Year AKTU PYQS (Open Channel Flow)

content.rendered:
Civil 3rd Year AKTU PYQS (Open Channel Flow) is one of the most essential resources for students preparing for AKTU civil engineering exams. Open Channel Flow is a core subject that helps students understand how water flows in natural and artificial channels such as rivers, canals, spillways, and drainage systems. Since the subject contains both theoretical and numerical concepts, PYQs become extremely helpful in identifying the types of questions AKTU repeatedly asks. Students often find this subject tricky due to the formulas, flow classifications, and hydraulic concepts, but practicing previous year questions removes most of the confusion and helps in scoring high.

Importance of Open Channel Flow in Civil Engineering

Open Channel Flow is fundamental for hydraulic engineering, irrigation engineering, water resource projects, and flood management. Whether it is designing canals, predicting river behavior, constructing drainage systems, or managing urban stormwater, civil engineers must thoroughly understand the behavior of water in open channels. This makes mastering the subject crucial for every student.
Solving Civil 3rd Year AKTU PYQS (Open Channel Flow) strengthens conceptual clarity and teaches students the exact pattern of questions AKTU commonly asks, especially numericals.

Why PYQs Are Essential for Exam Preparation

Previous year questions act as a direct guide to the exam pattern. Students get a clear idea of which topics carry more weightage and which formulas are applied repeatedly. Most long-answer questions revolve around gradually varied flow, critical flow concepts, hydraulic jumps, and uniform flow. Many numericals also come directly from Manning’s equation, Chezy’s equation, discharge calculation, and flow classification.
Practicing Civil 3rd Year AKTU PYQS (Open Channel Flow) helps students understand the difficulty level, improve their speed, and learn how to write stepwise solutions that fetch maximum marks.

Most Repeated Topics in PYQs

1. Uniform Flow

This topic appears almost every year. Students must know Manning’s formula, Chezy’s equation, hydraulic radius, energy slope, and discharge calculations. PYQs often include numerical problems based on finding flow velocity, discharge, or channel dimensions.

2. Critical Flow

PYQs commonly include the concept of critical depth, specific energy, Froude number, and conditions for critical flow. Students are asked to derive formulas, explain its significance, or solve critical depth numericals.

3. Hydraulic Jump

This is one of the most high-weightage topics. PYQs include classifications of hydraulic jumps, energy dissipation, sequent depth calculations, and applications of hydraulic jumps in hydraulic structures.

4. Gradually Varied Flow (GVF)

Students must understand GVF profiles, slope types, and differential equations of GVF. PYQs mostly ask to sketch profiles, identify flow zones, or solve classification-based problems.

5. Specific Energy and Specific Force

Questions include definitions, graphical interpretation, and application in flow analysis. Many numericals involve the relation between depth, discharge, and energy.

6. Non-Uniform Flow

Conceptual questions about rapidly varied flow (RVF) and gradually varied flow (GVF) appear frequently. Diagrams and profile interpretation are important for scoring.

7. Channel Design

PYQs often include economical channel sections such as the most economical trapezoidal and rectangular channel. Students must know derivations and conditions of maximum discharge.

How PYQs Help Students Score Higher

Solving Civil 3rd Year AKTU PYQS (Open Channel Flow) helps students focus on key topics instead of wasting time on less important sections. PYQs highlight which formulas are essential and how detailed answers must be. The subject contains numerical problems that require accuracy, and practicing PYQs increases confidence. Many students lose marks by writing incomplete derivations or skipping diagrams. PYQs help avoid such mistakes by showing perfect answer patterns.

Perfect Study Strategy for Open Channel Flow

To score high, students should follow this strategy:
– Start with uniform flow and critical flow, as these topics are the backbone of numericals.
– Prepare all formulas separately, especially for hydraulic jumps and GVF.
– Solve Civil 3rd Year AKTU PYQS (Open Channel Flow) chapter-wise to understand the type of questions asked from each unit.
– Always draw diagrams clearly — AKTU gives good marks for neat sketches.
– Practice at least 5–10 numericals daily during revision.

Why Notesgallery Helps Civil Engineering Students

On www.notesgallery.com, students get structured, accurate, and exam-oriented PYQs for Open Channel Flow. These PYQs cover both numericals and theory questions so students can prepare efficiently without searching multiple books.

Conclusion

Open Channel Flow is a scoring subject if prepared with the right approach. PYQs simplify the entire syllabus by highlighting repeated concepts and giving students real exam experience. Solving Civil 3rd Year AKTU PYQS (Open Channel Flow) boosts understanding, improves problem-solving ability, and ensures strong exam performance. Importance of Geotechnical Engineering in Civil Engineering

Geotechnical Engineering is one of the core branches of Civil Engineering. It deals with the study of soil, rock, foundations, and underground structures. In practical fieldwork, engineers use geotechnical principles to design stable foundations for buildings, bridges, dams, highways, and retaining walls. This subject builds the foundation of knowledge for your future internships and placements. While preparing from textbooks is important, analyzing Civil 3rd Year AKTU PYQS (Geotechnical Engineering) helps you understand real exam expectations and common question patterns.

Why PYQs Are Essential for Exam Preparation

AKTU exams frequently repeat concepts, numerical types, and theoretical questions from previous years. Students who study PYQs can identify which units are most scoring and which topics require deeper understanding. For example, soil classification, permeability, consolidation, compaction, shear strength, and bearing capacity are some of the most repeatedly asked areas. Solving Civil 3rd Year AKTU PYQS (Geotechnical Engineering) not only improves memory retention but also enhances your ability to solve numerical problems under time pressure.

Key Topics Covered in Geotechnical Engineering PYQs

To make your preparation more structured, here are the topics that appear regularly in AKTU question papers:

Soil Index Properties

These include Atterberg limits, specific gravity, water content, density, and soil classification. PYQs often include short notes and numerical questions related to these properties.

Permeability and Seepage

Questions on Darcy’s law, laboratory tests, and flow nets are frequently repeated. PYQs help you understand the numerical patterns and variations in seepage analysis.

Compaction and Consolidation

These units carry heavy numerical weightage. Most Civil 3rd Year AKTU PYQS (Geotechnical Engineering) contain calculation-based questions from consolidation settlement and compaction curves.

Shear Strength of Soil

Mohr-Coulomb failure theory, direct shear test, and triaxial test remain among the most important and commonly asked topics. PYQs show how theory and numericals are usually mixed in the exam.

Bearing Capacity and Foundation Design

Foundation engineering questions appear every year. PYQs help you understand commonly asked formulas and problem-solving methods.

Combine PYQs with class notes and standard books like Braja M. Das to strengthen concepts. Always practice numericals with step-by-step solutions to avoid silly mistakes. The more you practice Civil 3rd Year AKTU PYQS (Geotechnical Engineering), the more confident you become in attempting long and numerical questions accurately.

Stay consistent with your study routine, revise formulas daily, and focus more on repeated areas. Most students score well when they balance PYQ practice with conceptual clarity. Understanding the Subject Scope

The subject covers two main components: Quantity Estimation and Construction Management. Construction Management focuses on planning, scheduling, safety, and construction economics.
