title.rendered: AKTU Virtual Internship 2025: 1 Credit for 30-Hour Online Internship | New Policy for Students

content.rendered:
Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University (AKTU), Lucknow, has officially launched the AKTU Virtual Internship 2025 initiative to promote online learning and enhance students’ industry exposure. Starting from the academic session 2025-26, this new policy will allow students to earn one academic credit for every 30-hour virtual internship completed with recognized organizations.

The AKTU Virtual Internship 2025 policy is a revolutionary move that bridges the gap between academic learning and real-world experience. Students will now be able to complete online internships through reputed companies like Infosys, IBM, NIELIT, SmartBridge, and Softpro, and have their work officially recognized in their university results.

MoUs Signed with Top Industry Partners

To implement the AKTU Virtual Internship 2025, the university has signed Memorandums of Understanding (MoUs) with several top national and international companies. These include Infosys, IBM, NIELIT (National Institute of Electronics & Information Technology), SmartBridge, Softpro India, and NEMI.

Through these partnerships, students can access both paid and unpaid virtual internships in various technical domains. This collaboration ensures that AKTU students gain real-world industrial exposure while continuing their studies under the AKTU Online Internship Credit system.

This marks a significant leap toward integrating online learning and skill-based education within the academic structure of the university.

Details of the AKTU Internship Policy 2025

Under the AKTU Internship Policy 2025, students will earn credits based on the total hours of internship completed. The policy follows the National Credit Framework (NCF) guidelines, which recognize 30 hours of practical training as equivalent to 1 academic credit.

Duration and Credit Structure:

The AKTU Virtual Internship 2025 also recognizes these internships as Mini Projects, allowing students to include them in their academic evaluation.

The performance of students will be jointly evaluated by the industry partner and the university, ensuring both academic and practical assessment.

Eligibility: Who Can Participate?

The AKTU Virtual Internship 2025 policy applies to students of the 3rd, 5th, and 7th semesters enrolled in programs such as B.Tech, B.Pharm, MBA, and MCA.

Students from both the university campus and affiliated colleges can register for online internships with the partner institutions. Once the internship is completed, credits will be added to their academic transcript under the AKTU Online Internship Credit System.

Evaluation and Certification

After completing their virtual internship, students will receive an official certificate from the respective organization—such as IBM, Infosys, or NIELIT—certifying their participation and completion.

The AKTU Virtual Internship 2025 framework ensures that both the university and industry partner jointly assess students’ performance. Students who complete at least 30 hours will be eligible for 1 credit, while those completing 60 hours can earn 2 credits.

This initiative will not only motivate students to gain hands-on experience but also give them an industry-verified certification that adds value to their resumes.

Promoting Online Learning and Skill Development

The AKTU Virtual Internship 2025 initiative is a crucial step toward integrating online education and industrial exposure. Many students, especially from rural or remote regions, face challenges in accessing physical internships.

With this policy, students can complete virtual internships from home through recognized platforms, eliminating location barriers while still earning academic credits.

This not only promotes online learning but also makes students more industry-ready, improving their employability after graduation.

Statement by Dean (UG) Prof. Anurag Tripathi

Prof. Anurag Tripathi, Dean of Undergraduate Studies at AKTU, said:

“The AKTU Virtual Internship 2025 program is a bridge between academia and industry. Students completing 60 hours of online internships will receive two academic credits. This initiative will enhance industry-academia collaboration and open new employment opportunities for students.”

He further stated that all affiliated colleges have been instructed to implement the new AKTU Internship Policy 2025 from the academic session 2025-26 and encourage students to participate actively.

Key Benefits of AKTU Virtual Internship 2025

The AKTU Virtual Internship 2025 initiative offers a structured, accessible, and beneficial path for students to integrate learning with real-world applications.

New Incubation Center at Government Women Polytechnic, Lucknow

Alongside the AKTU Virtual Internship 2025, a new Incubation Center is being established at the Government Women Polytechnic, Lucknow. This center aims to empower over 1,300 women engineering students by encouraging innovation, entrepreneurship, and skill development.

The center will include smart classrooms, modern laboratories, and dedicated mentorship programs. It will also organize workshops on business planning, marketing, and finance, helping students transform their ideas into startups.

According to Principal Mr. Sanjeev Kumar Singh, the new facility is nearly complete and is expected to start operations by December 2025.

This initiative complements the AKTU Virtual Internship 2025, as both focus on preparing students for real-world challenges and boosting employability.

Why AKTU Virtual Internship 2025 Is a Game-Changer

The AKTU Virtual Internship 2025 program represents a major shift in India’s higher education system. It combines academic learning, skill development, and practical training into one cohesive framework.

By partnering with leading companies and offering virtual opportunities, AKTU ensures that students are industry-ready before they graduate. This program aligns with India’s National Education Policy (NEP 2020) and National Credit Framework (NCF), which emphasize experiential learning.

Key advantages include:

  • Real-world experience with top organizations
  • Enhanced technical and professional skills
  • Academic recognition through credits
  • Equal opportunities for all students, regardless of location
  • Increased placement and employment potential

Impact on Students and the Education System

The introduction of the AKTU Virtual Internship 2025 will reshape the student learning experience across all affiliated colleges. By allowing online internships to count toward academic credits, AKTU is helping students bridge the gap between theory and practice.

This move will significantly improve students’ technical expertise, analytical thinking, and communication abilities—skills that are essential in today’s competitive job market.

The initiative will also help industries discover and train young talent early, thereby strengthening the overall industry-academia relationship.

READ MORE : AKTU MBA 2nd Semester Result 2025 Declared – Check Your Result Now on One View Portal

Conclusion: A Visionary Step for the Future

The AKTU Virtual Internship 2025 initiative is a forward-looking policy that embraces online learning, skill development, and industry exposure. By granting one academic credit for every 30-hour virtual internship, AKTU has set a new benchmark for digital and practical education in India.

This policy will empower students to learn directly from leading companies, gain recognized certifications, and enhance their employability—all while continuing their regular academic programs.

With the AKTU Virtual Internship 2025, the university has once again proven its commitment to preparing students for the future of technology and innovation.

title.rendered: AKTU MBA 2nd Semester Result 2025 Declared – Check Your Result Now on One View Portal

content.rendered:
Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University (AKTU), Lucknow, has officially declared the AKTU MBA 2nd Semester Result 2025 for regular students studying under the session 2024-25. The notification was released under letter number AKTU/P.Ni.Ka./2025/2276 dated 06 November 2025, and signed by Prof. Deepak Nagariya, Controller of Examinations, AKTU.

This update brings great relief and excitement for thousands of MBA students who appeared in the AKTU MBA 2nd Semester Examination 2025 held between 02 July 2025 and 29 July 2025.

In this article, you’ll find complete details about the AKTU MBA 2nd Semester Result 2025, how to check it online, direct link, official notice highlights, and important FAQs.

AKTU Official Notification Summary

According to the official notice released by AKTU Lucknow, the MBA 2nd Semester Result 2025 has been approved and uploaded on the AKTU One View Portal.

The result includes the performance of regular students enrolled in the MBA First Year, Second Semester under the even semester second phase examinations of session 2024-25.

Students can now check their AKTU MBA 2nd Semester Result 2025 by visiting the official website — www.aktu.ac.in — and logging into the One View result portal.

AKTU MBA 2nd Semester Exam 2025 Highlights

How to Check AKTU MBA 2nd Semester Result 2025 Online

Students can easily check their AKTU MBA 2nd Semester Result 2025 by following these simple steps:

  1. Visit the official AKTU website — https://www.aktu.ac.in
  2. On the homepage, click on the “Results” or “One View” link.
  3. You’ll be redirected to the AKTU One View portal — https://erp.aktu.ac.in/WebPages/OneView/OneView.aspx
  4. Enter your Roll Number and Captcha Code.
  5. Click on the Search button.
  6. Your AKTU MBA 2nd Semester Result 2025 will appear on the screen.
  7. Download or print your result for future reference.

Details Mentioned in AKTU MBA 2nd Semester Result 2025

When you download your AKTU MBA 2nd Semester Result 2025, you will find the following details printed on it:

  • Student’s Name
  • Roll Number
  • Enrollment Number
  • Course Name (MBA)
  • Semester (2nd)
  • Institute Name
  • Subject-wise Marks
  • Internal and External Marks
  • Total Marks
  • Result Status (Pass/Fail)
  • Grade and SGPA

Check all the details carefully. In case of any discrepancy, contact your college examination cell immediately.

What the Official AKTU Notice Says

The official circular signed by Prof. Deepak Nagariya, Controller of Examinations, states:

“It is to inform that the result of MBA Course First Year Second (2nd) Semester Regular students under the Even Semester Second Phase Examination of session 2024-25, conducted between 02 July 2025 and 29 July 2025, has been approved and declared. The result is now available on the university website (One View).”

The notice also instructs all affiliated institute directors and principals to inform students and take necessary actions accordingly.

What’s Next After AKTU MBA 2nd Semester Result 2025

Once you’ve checked your AKTU MBA 2nd Semester Result 2025, here’s what you should do next:

  1. Download and Save the Result Copy: Keep a digital and printed copy for your records.
  2. Check Internal Performance: Analyze subject-wise performance to identify your strengths and weaknesses.
  3. Prepare for the Next Semester: Start focusing on 3rd semester subjects and specialization papers.
  4. Back Paper (If Any): If you didn’t pass a subject, wait for the back paper notification, usually released soon after result announcements.

Important Notes for Students

  • The AKTU MBA 2nd Semester Result 2025 is provisional until the final mark sheet is issued by the university.
  • Verify your marks on the One View dashboard and report any issues to your college authorities.
  • For official confirmation or transcripts, contact your college exam cell.
  • Results for other courses like B.Tech, MCA, and M.Pharm of the same session may be declared soon.

Student Reactions

Many students expressed happiness after the AKTU MBA 2nd Semester Result 2025 was declared, as it plays a crucial role in placements and summer internships.

A student from IET Lucknow said:
“The AKTU MBA 2nd Semester Result 2025 was much awaited. Now we can finally focus on preparing for our next semester and upcoming placement drives.”

FAQs – AKTU MBA 2nd Semester Result 2025

Q1. When was the AKTU MBA 2nd Semester Result 2025 declared?
Ans: The result was declared on 06 November 2025.

Q2. Where can I check my AKTU MBA 2nd Semester Result 2025?
Ans: You can check it on the AKTU One View Portal at https://erp.aktu.ac.in.

Q3. What details are required to check the AKTU MBA 2nd Semester Result 2025?
Ans: You need your Roll Number and Captcha Code.

Q4. Is the AKTU MBA 2nd Semester Result 2025 for regular or carry-over students?
Ans: This result is for regular students of the MBA First Year, Second Semester under session 2024-25.

Q5. What should I do if I find an error in my AKTU MBA 2nd Semester Result 2025?
Ans: Contact your college exam cell immediately for correction.

Q6. Will AKTU release revaluation forms after the MBA 2nd Semester Result 2025?
Ans: Yes, revaluation or scrutiny forms are usually released soon after result publication.

Q7. What is the next step after checking the AKTU MBA 2nd Semester Result 2025?
Ans: Save your result, review your scores, and begin preparing for the 3rd semester and internships.

Conclusion

The declaration of the AKTU MBA 2nd Semester Result 2025 marks an important milestone for MBA students of AKTU. With results now available on the AKTU One View Portal, students can easily access their marks and continue with their academic progress.

For the latest updates on AKTU results, exam notices, back paper forms, and circulars, keep visiting www.aktu.ac.in and stay connected with trusted educational news portals for official AKTU announcements.

title.rendered: AI Pragyan Faculty Development Program 2025: Generative AI Training for Faculty by IBM, SmartBridge & AICTE

content.rendered:
Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University (AKTU) has announced a unique opportunity for faculty members across Engineering, Science, and Business streams — the AI Pragyan Faculty Development Program 2025. This national-level initiative, organized by SmartBridge in collaboration with IBM SkillsBuild and AICTE, aims to upskill educators in Generative AI and help them become academic innovators.

What is AI Pragyan Faculty Development Program 2025?

The AI Pragyan Faculty Development Program 2025 is a 3-week, 30-hour virtual training program designed exclusively for faculty members of AKTU-affiliated and associated colleges. The goal is to empower teachers with practical knowledge of Generative AI — a rapidly evolving technology shaping industries like engineering, healthcare, finance, and education.

This initiative highlights AKTU’s commitment to enhancing academic excellence and promoting the integration of Artificial Intelligence in education.

Key Highlights of AI Pragyan Faculty Development Program 2025

Participants of the AI Pragyan Faculty Development Program 2025 will experience a comprehensive learning journey that includes:

  • 💡 Hands-on Bootcamps and Self-Paced Learning: Engage in guided sessions by AI experts along with flexible self-learning modules.
  • 🧠 Expert Mentorship & Use-Case Development: Build real-world Generative AI use cases under expert mentorship.
  • 🧾 Free Access to IBM SkillsBuild Platform: Participants get free access to premium IBM learning resources.
  • 🎓 Digital Credentials via Credly: Earn globally recognized IBM credentials for completing the training.
  • 📜 Program Certificate upon Completion: Receive an official certificate validating your AI skills and contribution to innovation.

Eligibility and Target Participants

The AI Pragyan Faculty Development Program 2025 is open to faculty members from engineering, science, and business disciplines affiliated with Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University (AKTU). The program is specifically curated for teachers who want to integrate Generative AI concepts into their teaching and research activities.

Registration Details

Interested faculty members are encouraged to register before the deadline:

Why Join AI Pragyan Faculty Development Program 2025?

Joining the AI Pragyan Faculty Development Program 2025 provides several benefits:

  1. Upskill in Generative AI technologies used by global leaders.
  2. Learn directly from IBM mentors and certified trainers.
  3. Build and present AI-powered use cases relevant to your subject.
  4. Enhance your academic profile with IBM SkillsBuild and Credly digital badges.
  5. Network with educators and innovators from across India.

This program not only enhances technical expertise but also enables educators to inspire students toward future-ready AI innovations.

Official Communication

According to the official circular (Ref: AKTU/CTPC/2025/1274, dated 06 November 2025), issued by Prof. Neelam Srivastava, Dean – Training & Placement, IET Lucknow, affiliated colleges are advised to encourage their faculty to register for this unique AI training initiative before the deadline.

Conclusion

The AI Pragyan Faculty Development Program 2025 represents a major step in transforming India’s higher education ecosystem through Generative AI. With the joint efforts of AKTU, IBM, AICTE, and SmartBridge, this initiative empowers educators to become innovators — bridging the gap between academia and real-world AI applications.

Faculty members are encouraged not to miss this golden opportunity to join the AI Pragyan Faculty Development Program 2025 and become a part of India’s growing AI revolution.

1. What is AI Pragyan Faculty Development Program 2025?

->The AI Pragyan Faculty Development Program 2025 is a 3-week, 30-hour virtual training initiative by SmartBridge, in collaboration with IBM SkillsBuild and AICTE, designed to upskill faculty members in Generative AI. It helps educators learn to apply AI tools and technologies in real-world academic and research environments.

2. Who can participate in AI Pragyan Faculty Development Program 2025?

The program is ideal for teachers who want to integrate Generative AI concepts into their classroom teaching and projects.

3. What is the duration of AI Pragyan Faculty Development Program 2025?

->The AI Pragyan Faculty Development Program 2025 will run for 3 weeks, totaling 30 hours of online learning. It includes a mix of hands-on bootcamps, self-paced modules, and mentorship sessions.

4. Is there any fee to join the AI Pragyan Faculty Development Program 2025?

->No, the AI Pragyan Faculty Development Program 2025 is completely free of cost for faculty members. It is jointly supported by IBM SkillsBuild, SmartBridge, and AICTE, in collaboration with AKTU

5. What is the last date for registration?

->Faculty members must complete their registration for the AI Pragyan Faculty Development Program 2025 by November 9, 2025. Late registrations may not be accepted, so participants are encouraged to apply early.

title.rendered: AKTU Pharmacy Admission 2025-26: Step-by-Step Online Registration Guide for Vacant Seats

content.rendered:
AKTU Pharmacy Admission 2025-26: Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University (AKTU), Lucknow has officially announced the Pharmacy Admission 2025-26 registration for vacant seats after counseling. This is a golden opportunity for candidates who could not secure admission earlier. As per the official notice (Letter No. AKTU/KusKa/Nomination/2025/9198 dated November 7, 2025), the online pre-registration window is open till November 10, 2025.

Important Dates for AKTU Pharmacy Admission 2025-26

AKTU Pharmacy Admission 2025-26: Step-by-Step Registration Process

AKTU has provided a detailed online registration process for candidates seeking admission to B.Pharm and D.Pharm courses in affiliated private colleges. Follow the steps below carefully.

Step 1: Visit the Official Website
Go to the official AKTU website — https://aktu.ac.in. On the homepage, you will see a “Pharmacy Admission 2025-26 Registration” link or pop-up. Click on it.

Step 2: Open the Registration Form
After clicking the link, the Pre-registration Form will appear. Fill in your personal details, qualification information, and select your preferred course.

Step 3: Enter Accurate Details
Candidates must fill in the information carefully. Once entered, the following details cannot be edited later — Name, Father’s Name, Date of Birth, Mobile Number, Email ID, Lateral Entry details, and qualification data.

Step 4: Verify Mobile Number through OTP
Verify your contact number using the OTP sent to your registered mobile. All future updates and communication from the university will be sent to the same mobile number and email ID.

Step 5: Receive Registration Number & Pay Fee
After OTP verification, a Registration Number will be generated. Use this to access your Dashboard, where you must pay the online registration fee. After payment, upload your educational certificates, photograph, and signature.

Step 6: Review & Final Submit
After completing all the steps, you’ll have the chance to review your filled data. Once verified, click Final Submit and take a printout of your registration form for records.

Step 7: Ensure QR Code is Visible
Your registration printout must display a QR Code. If the QR Code is missing, your registration will be considered invalid.

Important Note:
Registrations without successful online fee payment will not be accepted. Make sure all steps of your AKTU Pharmacy Admission 2025-26 registration are completed properly.

Registration Fee Details

Post Registration: Counseling Process

After completing registration, candidates must participate in Institute-level Counseling on November 10, 2025, at their chosen Pharmacy Institutes. Seat allotment will be based on CUET-2025 or 10+2 Merit. Institutions are instructed to verify all candidate documents properly and publish their merit list by 9:00 PM on November 10, 2025, on their respective websites.

Key Instructions for AKTU Pharmacy Admission 2025-26

  1. Only online registration through the official website is valid.
  2. Use an active mobile number and email ID throughout the process.
  3. Ensure successful fee payment to validate your application.
  4. Keep your registration printout with a visible QR Code.
  5. Check the official AKTU website regularly for updates — https://aktu.ac.in.

Why You Should Apply Now

The AKTU Pharmacy Admission 2025-26 process offers a final chance to secure admission in private Pharmacy colleges under AKTU. If you missed earlier counseling rounds, this is your opportunity to get admission based on merit. Submit your application online before November 10, 2025, to confirm your eligibility for counseling.

READ MORE : AKTU Virtual Internship 2025: Online Internship Opportunities for Students | Apply Now

Conclusion

The AKTU Pharmacy Admission 2025-26 process is a transparent, online-based system designed to ensure every eligible student gets a fair chance for admission. Follow the registration steps carefully, complete fee payment on time, and be ready for institute-level counseling. Apply now through https://aktu.ac.in and secure your seat in one of the reputed Pharmacy colleges affiliated with AKTU.

title.rendered: AKTU Virtual Internship 2025: Online Internship Opportunities for Students | Apply Now

content.rendered:
Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University (AKTU), Lucknow has officially announced the AKTU Virtual Internship 2025 program for all students enrolled in affiliated and associated colleges. Under this new initiative, students will be able to participate in virtual internships through MoU partner organizations of the university.

This step by AKTU aims to promote industry-academia collaboration, practical exposure, and skill-based learning among students. The internships will be conducted entirely online, providing flexibility for students to gain professional experience alongside their regular coursework.

The official notice for AKTU Virtual Internship 2025 was released on 07 November 2025, under reference number AKTU/DEAN UG/2024/821, signed by Prof. Anurag Tripathi, Dean UGSE, AKTU.

What is AKTU Virtual Internship 2025

The AKTU Virtual Internship 2025 is an online internship program designed to offer students practical industry exposure through online training and project-based learning. The internships are available throughout the year and can be paid or unpaid, depending on the organization.

These internships will be considered equivalent to the Mini Project or Internship component mentioned in the AKTU syllabus for 3rd, 5th, and 7th semesters. Students can complete the internship during their preceding academic year as long as it does not interfere with their regular classes.

This initiative aligns with the National Education Policy (NEP) 2020, focusing on improving employability skills and hands-on learning for AKTU students.

List of MoU Partner Organizations Offering Virtual Internships

The following MoU partner industries are currently offering virtual internship opportunities to AKTU students under the AKTU Virtual Internship 2025 program:

These partner companies are providing virtual internships across multiple domains such as software development, AI, data analytics, IoT, web technologies, and cybersecurity.

Key Guidelines for AKTU Virtual Internship 2025

AKTU has issued detailed guidelines to ensure a structured and academic approach to the AKTU Virtual Internship 2025 program. Below are the main points mentioned in the official circular:

  1. Internship Type:
    The Virtual Internship will be considered equivalent to a Mini Project or Project-Based Learning component as per the AKTU syllabus.
  2. Duration and Credit System:
    The internship must be of minimum 60 hours duration and will carry 2 academic credits. According to the National Credit Framework (NCrF), students will earn 1 credit for every 30 hours of practical work.
  3. Timing of Internship:
    Students can complete their virtual internship during the academic year preceding the semester in which the presentation is to be made.
  4. Evaluation Process:
    The evaluation will be conducted jointly by the industry partner and AKTU, ensuring that students are graded fairly on their practical knowledge and performance.
  5. Certificate of Completion:
    Upon successful completion, the industry partner will issue an official internship certificate, and the respective college will evaluate the student’s performance in the following semester.
  6. Approved Industry Partners:
    Students are encouraged to choose MoU-approved industries such as IBM, SmartBridge, and NIELIT. However, they are also free to undertake internships from any other recognized organization.
  7. Applicability:
    The provisions under AKTU Virtual Internship 2025 will be applicable to students admitted from session 2025–26 onwards.

Credit and Evaluation System

This credit structure ensures that the internship not only provides industry knowledge but also contributes to a student’s academic performance under AKTU regulations.

Benefits of AKTU Virtual Internship 2025

The AKTU Virtual Internship 2025 offers multiple academic and professional benefits to students across all branches and semesters. Some key advantages include:

  • Practical Skill Development:
    Students gain hands-on experience in real-world projects from reputed organizations like IBM and SmartBridge.
  • Academic Recognition:
    Internships completed under this scheme are officially recognized by AKTU and carry academic credits.
  • Flexibility:
    Being fully online, students can participate in the internship from anywhere without disrupting their class schedule.
  • Career Growth:
    The internship adds valuable experience to a student’s resume, increasing job opportunities during campus placements.
  • NEP 2020 Alignment:
    The program supports the objectives of the National Education Policy by integrating practical learning with academics.

How to Apply for AKTU Virtual Internship 2025

Here’s a simple step-by-step guide to apply for the AKTU Virtual Internship 2025:

  1. Visit the official link of your preferred MoU partner organization (e.g., IBM, SmartBridge, NIELIT).
  2. Register using your name, college details, and AKTU enrollment number.
  3. Choose your preferred internship domain like AI, Machine Learning, or Web Development.
  4. Complete the required online learning modules or project tasks.
  5. Submit your project report or assessment as per instructions.
  6. Receive your official completion certificate from the organization.
  7. Submit the certificate to your college for credit evaluation in the next semester.

Official Statement from AKTU

According to Prof. Anurag Tripathi, Dean UGSE, AKTU:
“Students who undertake these virtual internships will be formally recognized by their colleges, and their participation will be awarded with academic credits under university guidelines.”

This statement reflects AKTU’s commitment to promoting skill-based education and preparing students for the challenges of the modern job market.

Conclusion

The AKTU Virtual Internship 2025 is an excellent opportunity for students to gain practical industry experience while continuing their academic studies. It provides flexibility, certification, and academic credit—all in one program.

Students studying in AKTU-affiliated colleges should not miss this chance to work with reputed industry partners like IBM, SmartBridge, NIELIT, and Softpro. Start your journey today by registering online and making the most of the AKTU Virtual Internship 2025 program.

title.rendered: AKTU Challenge Evaluation 2025: बी.टेक, बी.फार्म और एमबीए छात्रों के लिए चैलेंज मूल्यांकन शुरू

content.rendered:
डॉ. ए.पी.जे. अब्दुल कलाम प्राविधिक विश्वविद्यालय (AKTU), लखनऊ ने सत्र 2024-25 के सम सेमेस्टर (Even Semester) के लिए AKTU Challenge Evaluation 2025 प्रक्रिया शुरू कर दी है। विश्वविद्यालय ने यह सूचना 07 नवम्बर 2025 को एक आधिकारिक नोटिस के माध्यम से जारी की है। यह नोटिस परीक्षा नियंत्रक प्रो. दीपक नगरिया द्वारा हस्ताक्षरित है।

इस प्रक्रिया के अंतर्गत B.Tech, B.Pharm और MBA पाठ्यक्रमों के छात्र जो सत्र 2024-25 सम सेमेस्टर की द्वितीय चरण की परीक्षा (Second Phase Exam) में शामिल हुए थे, अब अपनी उत्तर पुस्तिकाओं का Challenge Evaluation या Rechecking करवा सकते हैं।

AKTU Challenge Evaluation 2025 क्या है?

AKTU Challenge Evaluation 2025 विश्वविद्यालय द्वारा दी गई एक पारदर्शी मूल्यांकन प्रक्रिया है। इसमें छात्र पहले अपनी डिजिटल उत्तर पुस्तिका (Digital Answer Sheet) ऑनलाइन देख सकते हैं। यदि छात्र मूल्यांकन से असंतुष्ट होते हैं, तो वे पुनः मूल्यांकन (Re-Evaluation) के लिए आवेदन कर सकते हैं।

इस प्रणाली का उद्देश्य छात्रों को निष्पक्ष मूल्यांकन (Fair Assessment) का अवसर देना है ताकि किसी भी प्रकार की मूल्यांकन त्रुटि को सुधारा जा सके।

आवेदन की महत्वपूर्ण तिथियाँ

AKTU Challenge Evaluation 2025 के लिए आवेदन केवल निर्धारित अवधि के भीतर ही किया जा सकता है। अंतिम तिथि के बाद कोई भी आवेदन स्वीकार नहीं किया जाएगा।

आवेदन शुल्क और भुगतान प्रक्रिया

  • प्रति विषय शुल्क: ₹300
  • भुगतान माध्यम: AKTU ERP Portal के माध्यम से ऑनलाइन

छात्रों को अपने ERP Login के माध्यम से यह शुल्क जमा करना होगा। आवेदन करने के बाद, छात्र अपनी डिजिटल मूल्यांकित उत्तर-पुस्तिका ERP पोर्टल पर देख सकेंगे।

यदि छात्र उत्तर-पुस्तिका देखने के बाद भी असंतुष्ट होते हैं, तो वे नियत तिथि तक पुनः Challenge Evaluation के लिए आवेदन कर सकते हैं।

आवेदन करने की प्रक्रिया (How to Apply for AKTU Challenge Evaluation 2025)

  1. विश्वविद्यालय के ERP Portal पर जाएँ: https://erp.aktu.ac.in
  2. अपने ERP Login से साइन इन करें।
  3. “Challenge Evaluation” विकल्प चुनें।
  4. जिन विषयों में पुनर्मूल्यांकन कराना है, उनका चयन करें।
  5. प्रति विषय ₹300 शुल्क का ऑनलाइन भुगतान करें।
  6. आवेदन सबमिट करें और पुष्टि संदेश प्राप्त करें।
  7. निर्धारित तिथि के बाद अपनी डिजिटल उत्तर पुस्तिका ERP में देखें।

किन पाठ्यक्रमों के लिए लागू है?

यह प्रक्रिया AKTU Challenge Evaluation 2025 निम्नलिखित कोर्सों के लिए लागू है:

शासनादेश और दिशा-निर्देश

AKTU ने छात्रों को निर्देश दिया है कि वे आवेदन करने से पहले उत्तर प्रदेश शासनादेश संख्या 39298/16-1099/17/2020 दिनांक 11 सितम्बर 2020 और राज्यपाल/कुलाधिपति के अपर मुख्य सचिव के पत्र संख्याः ई-7443/D3-जी.एल./03 जी.एस./2019 (टी.सी.) का अध्ययन करें।

इन दस्तावेजों में Challenge Evaluation से संबंधित सभी मानक निर्देश (Guidelines) दिए गए हैं, जिनका पालन आवेदन प्रक्रिया के दौरान आवश्यक है।

विश्वविद्यालय का निर्देश

AKTU परीक्षा नियंत्रक प्रो. दीपक नगरिया ने सभी सम्बद्ध कॉलेजों के निदेशक और प्राचार्यों को निर्देशित किया है कि वे छात्रों को समय पर इस सूचना की जानकारी दें और इच्छुक छात्रों को आवेदन करने में सहायता प्रदान करें।

विश्वविद्यालय ने यह भी कहा है कि छात्रों को ERP Portal के माध्यम से सही और सटीक जानकारी भरनी चाहिए ताकि किसी भी प्रकार की त्रुटि से बचा जा सके।

AKTU Challenge Evaluation 2025 का सारांश

महत्वपूर्ण निर्देश

  1. आवेदन केवल ऑनलाइन माध्यम से स्वीकार किए जाएंगे।
  2. ऑफलाइन या मैनुअल आवेदन मान्य नहीं होगा।
  3. अंतिम तिथि के बाद कोई आवेदन स्वीकार नहीं किया जाएगा।
  4. शुल्क किसी भी परिस्थिति में वापस नहीं किया जाएगा।
  5. छात्रों को केवल ERP Portal के माध्यम से आवेदन करना है।
  6. डिजिटल उत्तर-पुस्तिका देखने के बाद ही चैलेंज मूल्यांकन के लिए आवेदन किया जा सकता है।

FAQs – AKTU Challenge Evaluation 2025

प्रश्न 1: AKTU Challenge Evaluation 2025 कब शुरू हुआ?
उत्तर: यह प्रक्रिया 07 नवम्बर 2025 से शुरू हो चुकी है।

प्रश्न 2: AKTU Challenge Evaluation 2025 की अंतिम तिथि क्या है?
उत्तर: अंतिम तिथि 17 नवम्बर 2025 है।

प्रश्न 3: आवेदन शुल्क कितना है?
उत्तर: प्रति विषय ₹300 का शुल्क निर्धारित किया गया है।

प्रश्न 4: किन कोर्सों के लिए यह प्रक्रिया लागू है?
उत्तर: B.Tech, B.Pharm और MBA कोर्सों के लिए लागू है।

प्रश्न 5: क्या ऑफलाइन आवेदन किया जा सकता है?
उत्तर: नहीं, आवेदन केवल ERP Portal के माध्यम से ही किया जाएगा।

प्रश्न 6: क्या उत्तर पुस्तिका देखने के बाद पुनः मूल्यांकन के लिए आवेदन संभव है?
उत्तर: हां, यदि छात्र असंतुष्ट हों तो नियत तिथि तक Challenge Evaluation के लिए आवेदन कर सकते हैं।

आधिकारिक लिंक

  • आधिकारिक नोटिस: https://aktu.ac.in
  • ERP लॉगिन: https://erp.aktu.ac.in

READ MORE : India AI Impact Summit 2026: Huge Prizes, Global Exposure, and a Golden Chance for Students & Innovators

निष्कर्ष

AKTU Challenge Evaluation 2025 छात्रों के लिए एक उत्कृष्ट अवसर है जिससे वे अपने परीक्षा परिणाम में पारदर्शिता सुनिश्चित कर सकते हैं।

title.rendered: HACK IITK 2026: IIT Kanpur और AKTU ने मिलकर शुरू किया Cybersecurity Hackathon — छात्रों के लिए बड़ा मौका

content.rendered:
डॉ. ए.पी.जे. अब्दुल कलाम प्राविधिक विश्वविद्यालय (AKTU), लखनऊ ने हाल ही में एक बड़ा सर्कुलर जारी किया है जिसमें यह बताया गया है कि IIT Kanpur के C3iHub (Cybersecurity and Cyber Defense of Critical Infrastructure Hub) द्वारा आयोजित Hackathon Event – HACK IITK 2026 में AKTU के छात्र भी भाग ले सकते हैं।

यह इवेंट 1 नवंबर 2025 से 21 फरवरी 2026 तक चलेगा और पूरी तरह ऑनलाइन मोड में आयोजित किया जाएगा। इसका उद्देश्य है — भारत के युवाओं में साइबर सुरक्षा (Cybersecurity) के प्रति जागरूकता फैलाना और उन्हें नई तकनीकों के प्रति प्रेरित करना।

What is HACK IITK 2026?

HACK IITK 2026 भारत का एक नेशनल-लेवल साइबरसिक्योरिटी हैकाथॉन है, जिसे IIT Kanpur का C3iHub आयोजित कर रहा है। यह एक ऐसा प्लेटफॉर्म है जहाँ देशभर के छात्र और शोधकर्ता (students and researchers) मिलकर साइबर अपराधों और साइबर सुरक्षा चुनौतियों के समाधान खोजेंगे।

इस इवेंट का मकसद है कि छात्र रियल-वर्ल्ड साइबरसिक्योरिटी प्रॉब्लम्स को समझें, उनका विश्लेषण करें और नए इनोवेटिव सॉल्यूशंस तैयार करें जो आने वाले समय में साइबर अटैक्स से देश को सुरक्षित रख सकें।

Objective of the Hackathon

HACK IITK 2026 का प्रमुख उद्देश्य छात्रों में साइबर सुरक्षा के प्रति रुचि पैदा करना है।
आज की डिजिटल दुनिया में साइबर हमले (cyber attacks) और डेटा चोरी जैसी घटनाएँ तेजी से बढ़ रही हैं। इसलिए यह जरूरी है कि युवा पीढ़ी इस क्षेत्र की गहराई से समझ हासिल करे।

इस कार्यक्रम के जरिए छात्र:

  • साइबरसिक्योरिटी के नए टूल्स और तकनीकों के बारे में जान सकेंगे।
  • इंडस्ट्री एक्सपर्ट्स और मेंटर्स से डायरेक्ट गाइडेंस प्राप्त कर सकेंगे।
  • और सबसे महत्वपूर्ण — रियल टाइम साइबर प्रॉब्लम्स का समाधान खोजने की दिशा में काम करेंगे।

Who Can Participate in HACK IITK 2026

इस इवेंट में भाग लेने के लिए कोई बड़ी शर्त नहीं है।
AKTU से संबद्ध सभी कॉलेजों के B.Tech, M.Tech, MCA और रिसर्च स्कॉलर्स इसमें हिस्सा ले सकते हैं।

साथ ही, AKTU के पूर्व छात्र (Alumni) भी इस नेशनल लेवल हैकाथॉन में भाग ले सकते हैं।
यह एक शानदार मौका है उनके लिए जो:

  • Cybersecurity, Ethical Hacking, या Network Defense में रुचि रखते हैं,
  • या फिर किसी CTF (Capture The Flag) जैसी प्रतियोगिता में अपना स्किल दिखाना चाहते हैं।

Event Details of HACK IITK 2026

Tracks and Structure of the Hackathon

HACK IITK 2026 को दो मुख्य ट्रैक में बांटा गया है, ताकि छात्र अपनी रुचि के अनुसार भाग ले सकें:

1. CTF Track (Capture The Flag)

  • इस ट्रैक में प्रतिभागियों को साइबरसिक्योरिटी पहेलियाँ और अटैक-सिनेरियो दिए जाएंगे।
  • प्रतिभागियों को कोड, नेटवर्क और सिस्टम की कमजोरियों को खोजकर उनका समाधान निकालना होगा।
  • यह ट्रैक छात्रों को ethical hacking की दिशा में गहराई से सोचने का मौका देगा।

2. Solution Track

  • इस ट्रैक का उद्देश्य है वास्तविक साइबर चुनौतियों का नवाचारपूर्ण समाधान (Innovative Solution) निकालना।
  • प्रतिभागी टीम्स अपने प्रोजेक्ट्स सबमिट करेंगी जो वास्तविक साइबर प्रॉब्लम्स से जुड़े होंगे।
  • इस ट्रैक के जरिए छात्रों को रिसर्च, डेवलपमेंट और इनोवेशन का पूरा अनुभव मिलेगा।

Benefits for Participants

HACK IITK 2026 में भाग लेने वाले प्रतिभागियों के लिए कई आकर्षक अवसर हैं:

  • 🎯 Real-world Exposure:
    साइबरसिक्योरिटी से जुड़े रियल वर्ल्ड केस और चुनौतियाँ सीखने को मिलेंगी।
  • 💡 Industry Mentorship:
    IIT Kanpur और C3iHub के विशेषज्ञों से डायरेक्ट गाइडेंस मिलेगी।
  • 💰 Cash Prizes & Cloud Credits:
    विजेताओं को पुरस्कार राशि के साथ-साथ क्लाउड क्रेडिट और इंटरनशिप के अवसर भी मिलेंगे।
  • 🧑‍💻 Internship Opportunities:
    विजेता टीमों को C3iHub, IIT Kanpur में इंटर्नशिप या जॉब का मौका मिलेगा।
  • 🔒 Cyber Safety Awareness:
    प्रतिभागी यह सीखेंगे कि कैसे cyber-safe रहना है और मॉडर्न साइबर अटैक्स से खुद को बचाना है।

How to Register for HACK IITK 2026

पंजीकरण की प्रक्रिया बेहद आसान है।
छात्र नीचे दिए गए लिंक पर जाकर HACK IITK 2026 के लिए रजिस्टर कर सकते हैं:

👉 https://hackathon.c3ihub.iitk.ac.in/

रजिस्ट्रेशन के बाद प्रतिभागियों को अपनी टीम बनाकर संबंधित ट्रैक चुनना होगा।
फिर दिए गए समय के अनुसार चुनौतियों को हल करना होगा और अपने सॉल्यूशन सबमिट करने होंगे।

Why AKTU Students Should Not Miss HACK IITK 2026

AKTU के छात्रों के लिए यह इवेंट एक गोल्डन अपॉर्च्युनिटी है।
IIT Kanpur जैसे प्रतिष्ठित संस्थान के साथ काम करने का मौका मिलना अपने आप में गौरव की बात है।

  • यह इवेंट टेक्निकल स्किल्स को प्रैक्टिकल अनुभव में बदलने का अवसर देगा।
  • छात्रों को national-level exposure मिलेगा।
  • और सबसे बड़ी बात — साइबरसिक्योरिटी जैसे क्षेत्र में करियर बनाने की दिशा में यह एक strong foundation साबित होगा।

Message from AKTU T&P Cell

AKTU की Dean of Training and Placement, प्रो. नीलम श्रीवास्तव ने अपने पत्र में सभी कॉलेजों को निर्देशित किया है कि वे अपने छात्रों को इस इवेंट में भाग लेने के लिए प्रोत्साहित करें।
उनका कहना है कि ऐसे आयोजन छात्रों में innovation और technical confidence बढ़ाने में सहायक होते हैं।

Final Words

HACK IITK 2026 सिर्फ एक प्रतियोगिता नहीं, बल्कि एक ऐसा अवसर है जिससे छात्र Cybersecurity के क्षेत्र में एक मजबूत करियर बना सकते हैं।
IIT Kanpur का यह प्रयास भारत में ethical hacking और digital defense की दिशा में एक बड़ा कदम है।

title.rendered: India AI Impact Summit 2026: Huge Prizes, Global Exposure, and a Golden Chance for Students & Innovators

content.rendered:
Artificial Intelligence is no longer the future — it is the present. Every day, AI is transforming how we learn, work, heal, build, and innovate. And now, India is preparing to showcase its talent to the world through a massive global event: the India AI Impact Summit 2026.

If you are a student, researcher, or innovator looking for a life-changing opportunity, this summit might be the biggest platform you’ll see all year. The prizes are huge, the exposure is global, and the impact could shape your entire career.

Recently, AKTU (Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University) officially encouraged all affiliated colleges to participate in the India AI Impact Summit 2026. That’s because this one event has everything — innovation, competition, global networking, and rewards worth lakhs.

Let’s dive into the full details, categories, benefits, and how you can participate.

Why India AI Impact Summit 2026 Matters Right Now

AI is growing faster than any technology in history. With automation, deep learning, and data-driven tools entering every industry, India wants to prepare its youth for the next big leap. The India AI Impact Summit 2026 does exactly that — it gives young innovators a chance to build solutions that solve real-world challenges.

Whether it’s smart agriculture, healthcare access, climate solutions, education, or digital governance, the summit encourages people to think big and build even bigger.

For thousands of students and innovators, this event is a launchpad into the global AI community.

Categories You Can Compete In

The India AI Impact Summit 2026 is divided into three major global competitions. Each category is designed to bring out the best ideas from different groups of innovators.

1. AI for All: Global Impact Challenge

This category is perfect for creating AI solutions that help society, especially under-served communities. Think solutions based on:

  • Climate resilience
  • Smart farming
  • Health diagnosis
  • Accessible education
  • Public safety
  • Disaster response

Awards:
Top 10 teams win ₹25 lakhs each
Top 20 teams get global visibility in the innovation showcase

This is one of the most prestigious tracks of the India AI Impact Summit 2026.

2. AI by Her: Global Impact Challenge

A powerful initiative to bring more women into the AI space. Women-led teams can participate with projects in areas like:

  • Robotics
  • Healthcare AI
  • Smart vehicles
  • Assistive tools
  • AI for equality

Awards:
Top 10 teams receive ₹25 lakhs
Top 20 teams get international exposure

This category not only celebrates women in AI but also encourages female leadership in tech.

3. YUVAI Global Youth Challenge

Designed exclusively for students and young innovators, this is one of the most exciting categories of the India AI Impact Summit 2026.

Young teams can submit ideas related to:

  • Rural development
  • Water management
  • Employment & skill solutions
  • Cyber wellness
  • Digital inclusion

Awards:
Top 8 teams receive a combined prize pool worth ₹85 lakhs

For many young participants, this category is a dream opportunity.

If you’re wondering whether the India AI Impact Summit 2026 is worth your effort, the answer is a big yes. Here’s why:

Very few competitions offer ₹25 lakh awards to multiple teams. This can help you:

  • Build a research prototype

  • Launch your innovation career

Top teams get global visibility — something that directly helps with:

title.rendered: AKTU Free Workshop on Web Technologies and Machine Learning 2025 for B.Tech Students Announced

content.rendered:
Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University (AKTU), Lucknow, has officially announced the AKTU free workshop on Web Technologies and Machine Learning, a unique opportunity designed to upgrade the technical and employability skills of engineering students across Uttar Pradesh.

This initiative, organized under the guidance of Prof. Neelam Srivastava, Dean – Training & Placement, AKTU, is being held in collaboration with Softpro India Pvt. Ltd., a leading industrial training and software development organization. The workshop will run throughout November 2025 at multiple training centers, allowing students to gain hands-on experience in web development and machine learning — two of the most sought-after domains in today’s job market.

About the AKTU Free Workshop on Web Technologies and Machine Learning

The AKTU free workshop on Web Technologies and Machine Learning has been launched as part of AKTU’s broader mission to make students industry-ready. It offers a rare blend of academic learning and real-world exposure. The program is completely free of cost and open to B.Tech 3rd and 4th-year students from all affiliated colleges.

Students who participate will learn directly from industry experts, complete real-time projects, and receive a joint certification from AKTU and Softpro India Pvt. Ltd., which adds genuine value to their resumes.

According to the official circular (Ref: AKTU/CTPC/2025/1273, dated November 3, 2025), this initiative falls under the Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) signed between AKTU and Softpro India in November 2023, with the goal of enhancing practical exposure and employability among engineering graduates.

Objective of the Workshop

The main objective behind the AKTU free workshop on Web Technologies and Machine Learning is to bridge the persistent gap between classroom education and industrial requirements. While most students learn programming and theory during their academic years, many lack exposure to real-world applications.

This free workshop aims to:

  • Equip students with practical skills in web design, full stack development, and machine learning.
  • Enhance students’ problem-solving and coding capabilities.
  • Help participants understand how modern digital technologies are used in actual projects.
  • Boost the placement readiness of students in emerging tech fields.

By focusing on web technologies and machine learning, AKTU aims to give its students a competitive edge in the IT industry, where both skills are in high demand.

Workshop Structure and Duration

Each batch of the AKTU free workshop on Web Technologies and Machine Learning will run for three days, with six hours of training per day. The sessions will include live lectures, practical coding exercises, and project work.

Eligibility: B.Tech 3rd and 4th-year students
Duration: 3 Days (6 Hours per day)
Batch Size: 100 students per session
Fees: 100% Free
Certification: Joint certificate by AKTU and Softpro India

Students can choose their preferred training dates from the following schedule:

  • November 10–12, 2025
  • November 13–15, 2025
  • November 20–22, 2025
  • November 26–28, 2025

Since batch sizes are limited, students are encouraged to register early through the official AKTU registration link:
https://aktuworkshop.trainingatsoftpro.com/
Registration Deadline: November 9, 2025

Topics Covered During the Workshop

The AKTU free workshop on Web Technologies and Machine Learning consists of two major learning modules carefully designed to give participants both breadth and depth in the respective technologies.

1. Design to Deploy – A Full Stack Web Journey

This section focuses on the entire life cycle of web application development — from designing the front end to deploying a functional website or web app. Students will learn key tools and technologies like HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Node.js, and databases. The goal is to give them a clear picture of how a real-world application is structured and hosted.

2. Machine Learning – Learn, Code & Predict

The second module introduces students to the exciting world of artificial intelligence and machine learning. Participants will gain hands-on experience in building models that can analyze data and make predictions. Using Python programming and popular libraries such as Scikit-learn and Pandas, students will learn how data drives decision-making in today’s tech landscape.

These modules will be taught through practical demonstrations, mini-projects, and guided sessions by Softpro India’s expert trainers.

Training Venues Across Uttar Pradesh

To ensure maximum participation, the AKTU free workshop on Web Technologies and Machine Learning will be held at multiple locations, each equipped with modern infrastructure and high-speed internet for coding and deployment tasks:

  1. Softpro Skill Development Centre, Greater Noida – Knowledge Park-I, near Pari Chowk Metro Station.
  2. Softpro Skill Development Centre, Modinagar – Inside Dr. K. N. Modi Institute of Engineering & Technology.
  3. Softpro House, Lucknow (Jankipuram) – 3/213, Sector J, Jankipuram.
  4. Softpro Full Stack Academy, Lucknow (Gomti Nagar) – 1/6, Vastu Khand.

All training centers are conveniently located near academic hubs, ensuring easy access for students from nearby districts.

Why Students Should Not Miss This Opportunity

The AKTU free workshop on Web Technologies and Machine Learning is more than just a short-term training — it’s an employability booster. With the job market demanding a combination of coding, problem-solving, and analytical thinking, this workshop prepares students for interviews, internships, and future employment opportunities.

Here’s why it’s worth joining:

  • It’s completely free, removing any financial barriers.
  • Students earn a joint certificate from AKTU and Softpro India Pvt. Ltd.
  • Participants get hands-on exposure to real coding environments.
  • It improves technical confidence and boosts resumes.
  • It helps students build industry-ready projects that can be showcased during placements.

In a competitive job market, certifications backed by both an academic institution and an industry partner make a big difference. That’s exactly what this workshop delivers.

About the Organizing Partner – Softpro India Pvt. Ltd.

Softpro India Pvt. Ltd. is one of the most respected training and software development companies in North India. Known for its high-quality educational programs, Softpro India has trained thousands of students in emerging technologies and collaborated with several technical universities, including AKTU.

For the AKTU free workshop on Web Technologies and Machine Learning, Softpro India will take full responsibility for:

  • Conducting live sessions with expert trainers.
  • Providing study materials, coding kits, and project resources.
  • Managing on-site logistics and infrastructure.
  • Coordinating certification and feedback.

Their experience ensures that every participant receives top-quality, practical learning — not just theoretical exposure.

Expert Remarks from AKTU

Prof. Neelam Srivastava, Dean of Training & Placement, stated that AKTU’s collaboration with Softpro India aims to “prepare students for the technology-driven workforce by merging academic excellence with industrial skill development.”

She added that the AKTU free workshop on Web Technologies and Machine Learning is part of the university’s ongoing mission to improve placement outcomes and make AKTU graduates globally competitive.

This initiative also reflects AKTU’s proactive approach toward creating opportunities that are free, accessible, and relevant to the needs of both students and the industry.

How to Register

Interested students can register online by visiting the official AKTU workshop portal:
https://aktuworkshop.trainingatsoftpro.com/

The last date for registration is November 9, 2025, and slots will be filled on a first-come-first-serve basis.

For queries or assistance, students can reach out via email at tnp@aktu.ac.in.

READ MORE : AKTU Challenge Evaluation 2025: Apply Online for Even Semester Answer Sheet Rechecking

Conclusion

The AKTU free workshop on Web Technologies and Machine Learning represents a powerful opportunity for engineering students to gain hands-on experience in two of the most critical skill areas for modern engineers. Whether you’re passionate about full stack development or exploring the world of artificial intelligence, this workshop provides the perfect foundation to start building real, career-ready skills.

By combining academic knowledge with industrial training, AKTU and Softpro India are creating a learning experience that’s practical, accessible, and future-focused. Every B.Tech student aiming to improve their technical abilities and placement prospects should seize this chance.

Register before November 9, 2025, and take the first step toward mastering Web Technologies and Machine Learning under the guidance of AKTU and Softpro India Pvt. Ltd.

title.rendered: AKTU Challenge Evaluation 2025: Apply Online for Even Semester Answer Sheet Rechecking

content.rendered:
Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University (AKTU), Lucknow ने AKTU Challenge Evaluation 2025 की प्रक्रिया शुरू कर दी है। यदि आपने सम सेमेस्टर (Even Semester) परीक्षा 2024-25 में भाग लिया था और अपने प्राप्त अंकों से असंतुष्ट हैं, तो आपके लिए यह एक शानदार मौका है। आप अब अपनी उत्तर पुस्तिकाओं (Answer Sheets) का Challenge Evaluation 2025 के अंतर्गत पुनर्मूल्यांकन (Rechecking) करवा सकते हैं।

विश्वविद्यालय ने इसके लिए आधिकारिक सूचना जारी की है, जिसका पत्रांक ए०के०टी०यू०/प०नि०का०/2025/2275 दिनांक 04 नवम्बर 2025 है। यह प्रक्रिया छात्रों के लिए पूरी तरह से ऑनलाइन रखी गई है।

AKTU Challenge Evaluation 2025 Important Dates

🔹 Who Can Apply for AKTU Challenge Evaluation 2025?

AKTU Challenge Evaluation 2025 उन्हीं छात्रों के लिए है जिन्होंने सत्र 2024-25 की Even Semester (सम सेमेस्टर) परीक्षा में भाग लिया था। यह परीक्षा 17 मई 2025 से 13 जून 2025 के बीच आयोजित की गई थी।

इन कोर्सेस के छात्र Challenge Evaluation 2025 के लिए आवेदन कर सकते हैं:

How to Apply for AKTU Challenge Evaluation 2025 Online

  1. Login to AKTU ERP Portal:
    Visit erp.aktu.ac.in and log in using your student credentials.
  2. Check Your Answer Sheet:
    आपकी Answer Sheet पहले से ही ERP Login में उपलब्ध करा दी गई है। उसे ध्यान से देखें और अगर आपको किसी विषय के अंक गलत लगते हैं तो उसी विषय के लिए आवेदन करें।
  3. Pay Application Fee:
    Application Fee ₹2500/- per subject है, जो Online Payment के माध्यम से जमा करनी होगी।
  4. Submit Final Application:
    Payment के बाद सुनिश्चित करें कि आवेदन सफलतापूर्वक सबमिट हुआ है। एक Acknowledgment Receipt ज़रूर डाउनलोड कर लें।

Rules & Evaluation Process in AKTU Challenge Evaluation 2025

AKTU के अनुसार Challenge Evaluation 2025 में निम्नलिखित नियम लागू होंगे:

  1. प्रत्येक उत्तर पुस्तिका का मूल्यांकन दो विषय विशेषज्ञों (Examiners) द्वारा किया जाएगा।
  2. दोनों विशेषज्ञों द्वारा दिए गए अंकों का औसत (Average Marks) लिया जाएगा।
  3. यही औसत अंक Final Marks माने जाएंगे और अंक पत्र में अपडेट किए जाएंगे।
  4. यदि पुनर्मूल्यांकन (Challenge Evaluation) के बाद प्राप्त औसत अंक और मूल अंक में 20% से अधिक का अंतर आता है, तो छात्र को ₹1500/- की Fee Refund दी जाएगी।
  5. Refund प्रक्रिया के लिए छात्र को आवेदन करते समय सही Bank Details (Account Number, IFSC Code, Bank Name) देना आवश्यक है।
  6. गलत बैंक विवरण भरने पर विश्वविद्यालय किसी भी असुविधा के लिए जिम्मेदार नहीं होगा।

Fee Refund Policy – AKTU Challenge Evaluation 2025

अगर Challenge Evaluation के बाद आपके नए अंक और पुराने अंक में 20% से ज्यादा अंतर निकलता है, तो आपको ₹2500 में से ₹1500 वापस कर दिए जाएंगे (₹1000 Processing Fee के रूप में काटी जाएगी)।
Refund आपके द्वारा दिए गए बैंक अकाउंट में सीधे जमा होगा, इसलिए विवरण ध्यान से भरें।

Documents Required for AKTU Challenge Evaluation 2025

  1. AKTU ERP Login Credentials
  2. Answer Sheet Screenshot / Copy (for personal record)
  3. Bank Account Details (for refund, if applicable)
  4. Online Payment Proof (for confirmation)

Important Instructions for Students

  • आवेदन केवल उन्हीं छात्रों के लिए मान्य है जिन्होंने सत्र 2024-25 सम सेमेस्टर परीक्षा में भाग लिया है।
  • आवेदन की अंतिम तिथि 12 नवंबर 2025 है, इसके बाद कोई भी आवेदन स्वीकार नहीं किया जाएगा।
  • Fee जमा करने के बाद किसी भी परिस्थिति में Application Cancel या Modify नहीं किया जा सकता।
  • Students को सलाह दी जाती है कि वे आवेदन से पहले अपनी Answer Sheet को ध्यान से देखें।
  • Refund केवल Eligible छात्रों को ही मिलेगा, इसलिए सभी विवरण सही भरें।

Official Reference

इस प्रक्रिया के लिए जारी आधिकारिक पत्र का संदर्भ है:

Letter No.: ए०के०टी०यू०/प०नि०का०/2025/2275
Date: 04 November 2025
Signed By: प्रो० दीपक नगरिया, परीक्षा नियंत्रक, डॉ. ए.पी.जे. अब्दुल कलाम प्राविधिक विश्वविद्यालय, लखनऊ।

Why AKTU Challenge Evaluation 2025 is Important for Students

कई बार छात्र अपनी मेहनत और परफॉर्मेंस के अनुसार अंक नहीं पाते। ऐसे में AKTU Challenge Evaluation 2025 छात्रों को पारदर्शी मौका देता है कि वे अपनी उत्तर पुस्तिका का दोबारा मूल्यांकन करवा सकें।
यह प्रक्रिया न केवल निष्पक्षता को सुनिश्चित करती है, बल्कि छात्रों को अपनी मेहनत के सही परिणाम पाने का अवसर भी देती है।

AKTU Challenge Evaluation 2025 – Key Points Summary

  • आवेदन तिथि: 04 से 12 नवंबर 2025
  • आवेदन माध्यम: Online via ERP Portal
  • शुल्क: ₹2500 प्रति विषय
  • उत्तर पुस्तिका ERP पर उपलब्ध
  • मूल्यांकन दो विशेषज्ञों द्वारा
  • 20% से अधिक अंतर होने पर ₹1500 Refund

READ MORE : AKTU Pre-Registration & Enrollment Date Extended 2025: Last Date 10 November, Official Notice Released

Conclusion

AKTU Challenge Evaluation 2025 छात्रों के लिए एक महत्वपूर्ण अवसर है। यदि आपको लगता है कि आपके अंक आपके उत्तरों के अनुरूप नहीं हैं, तो बिना देर किए ERP Portal पर जाकर आवेदन करें। ध्यान रखें कि आवेदन की अंतिम तिथि 12 नवंबर 2025 है। यह प्रक्रिया पूरी तरह ऑनलाइन है और छात्रों को न्यायसंगत मूल्यांकन सुनिश्चित करती है।

title.rendered: AKTU Pre-Registration & Enrollment Date Extended 2025: Last Date 10 November, Official Notice Released

content.rendered:
AKTU Pre-Registration : Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University (AKTU), Lucknow has officially announced a major update for students who took admission in session 2025-26. The university has extended the last date for completing online pre-registration, enrollment, and examination form submission till 10 November 2025 (11:59 PM).

This extension is a relief for thousands of newly admitted students across Uttar Pradesh, as it provides additional time to complete the crucial online registration process. According to the notice, the decision to extend the date comes in compliance with the Hon’ble Supreme Court’s directions and the approval of the competent authority.

The official circular has been issued under letter number AKTU/KusoKa/Namankan-12/2025/9153 and signed by Registrar (Reena Singh) on 3 November 2025.

New Deadline for AKTU Pre-Registration & Enrollment

Earlier, many students were facing difficulties in completing their AKTU pre-registration and exam form submission due to technical or admission-related delays. Keeping this in mind, the university has now extended the last date for all students enrolled in UG, PG, and Lateral Entry courses.

  • New Last Date: 10 November 2025
  • Time: Till 11:59 PM
  • Applicable For: UG, PG, and Lateral Entry courses

This means that students who haven’t completed their AKTU pre-registration and enrollment yet can now do so without penalty before the given date.

The focus keyword AKTU Pre-Registration Date Extended 2025 becomes crucial here because this official notice impacts every new student admitted in this academic session.

Why AKTU Extended the Pre-Registration Date 2025

The AKTU Pre-Registration Date Extended 2025 decision was taken primarily to ensure that no student loses the opportunity to appear in semester examinations due to delay in form submission.

The main reasons for extension include:

  1. Supreme Court Order: AKTU is following the order passed by the Hon’ble Supreme Court regarding student admission timelines.
  2. Administrative Approval: The competent authority of the university approved the extension.
  3. Student Convenience: Thousands of students had pending pre-registration due to technical glitches and admission confirmations.
  4. Institutional Responsibility: Affiliated colleges needed more time to verify student data and finalize enrollment.

The AKTU Pre-Registration Date Extended 2025 update ensures that every student entering the university system in session 2025-26 gets proper registration and eligibility for exams.

Instructions for All Affiliated Colleges

The circular has been addressed to Directors and Principals of all AKTU-affiliated institutions. Every college must now complete the following tasks before 10 November 2025:

  1. Complete pre-registration of new students in the AKTU ERP portal.
  2. Ensure enrollment and exam form submission are completed for every student.
  3. Guide students about the last date and help those facing login or payment issues.
  4. Verify all uploaded documents before final submission.

All institutions are expected to strictly adhere to the extended timeline mentioned in the AKTU Pre-Registration Date Extended 2025 notification. Any negligence may affect the exam eligibility of students.

Official Details from the Notice

Here are the key highlights of the official notice issued by AKTU:

The notice also emphasizes that other existing processes will remain unchanged. This means only the last date is extended — all rules, formats, and eligibility criteria are the same as before.

What Students Need To Do Now

All newly admitted students in session 2025-26 should immediately take the following steps before 10 November 2025 to avoid last-minute issues:

  1. Visit the official AKTU ERP portal: https://erp.aktu.ac.in
  2. Login using your credentials provided by your college.
  3. Complete pre-registration details, ensuring your data matches your admission records.
  4. Verify enrollment details under your college’s supervision.
  5. Fill out the examination form for the upcoming semester.
  6. Submit and make payment if required.
  7. Download confirmation receipts for record keeping.

Remember, the AKTU Pre-Registration Date Extended 2025 notice is your final chance to finish all formalities. Missing this deadline could affect your exam eligibility.

Copy Circulated To

The university has also circulated the notice to several internal departments for action and awareness:

  • Finance Officer, AKTU Lucknow
  • Controller of Examination, AKTU Lucknow
  • Deputy/Assistant Registrar
  • Coordinator, UPCET (AKTU)
  • ERP In-Charge, AKTU – to ensure technical changes in the portal
  • Staff Officer to Hon’ble Vice-Chancellor
  • All concerned officers and employees

This internal circulation ensures that the AKTU Pre-Registration Date Extended 2025 update reaches every administrative level of the university.

Important Notes

  • No further date extension is expected after 10 November 2025.
  • Students must complete all formalities before the deadline to be eligible for exams.
  • Colleges are instructed to not delay the verification process.
  • If students face ERP-related issues, they should immediately inform the ERP in-charge of their college.

By following the new timeline, both students and colleges can ensure smooth functioning of academic operations under AKTU.

Why This Update Is Important for Students

This AKTU Pre-Registration Date Extended 2025 announcement is not just about extending the date — it is about providing equal opportunity for all new students. Thousands of students come from rural and semi-urban areas and often face delays in admission confirmation or document verification.

By extending the pre-registration date, AKTU ensures that no student is left behind due to technical or administrative delays. It also aligns with the Supreme Court’s directives for maintaining transparency and fairness in the admission process.

Final Advice for Students

Students are strongly advised to not wait till the last day for filling their pre-registration and exam forms. The AKTU Pre-Registration Date Extended 2025 notice is a final opportunity to complete all processes smoothly.

Late or incomplete registration may cause serious issues in exam form acceptance and semester result declaration later. Therefore, log in to the AKTU ERP portal today and complete the process before 10 November 2025 (11:59 PM).

title.rendered: AKTU Pharmacy Notice 2025 – Important Update on PCI Approval Process for 2026-27

content.rendered:
Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University, Uttar Pradesh (AKTU Lucknow) has issued a significant official circular titled AKTU Pharmacy Notice 2025, concerning the approval process for pharmacy courses for the academic year 2026-27. This notice provides clarification regarding the Consent of Affiliation and State Government NOC required for institutions applying to start or continue pharmacy programs under the Pharmacy Council of India (PCI).

The AKTU Pharmacy Notice 2025 is crucial for all institutions that intend to apply for B.Pharm or other pharmacy-related courses in the upcoming academic year. The notice aims to bring transparency to the approval process and ensure that all institutions follow the correct regulatory framework as prescribed by the University and the Uttar Pradesh Government.

Background of AKTU Pharmacy Notice 2025

The circular, numbered AKTU/Kus.Ka./2025/9144, was officially released in November 2025 by Registrar Reena Singh. It was issued in response to the Pharmacy Council of India’s letter (No. 14-56/2024-PCI – Approval Process for 2026-27) dated October 3, 2025.

The Pharmacy Council of India (PCI) announced that the online portal for the 2026-27 academic session has been opened for institutions to submit their applications for approval. According to the PCI guidelines, the last date for submission was October 31, 2025.

This PCI communication required all new and existing pharmacy colleges to upload certain essential documents, including the Consent of Affiliation and NOC from the State Government, while applying for approval to start or continue pharmacy courses such as B.Pharm.

Documents Required for PCI Application (As per AKTU Pharmacy Notice 2025)

The AKTU Pharmacy Notice 2025 highlights the mandatory documents that every institution must submit during the PCI approval process. These documents include:

  1. Consent of Affiliation of Examining Authority – This document must be valid for the 2026-27 academic session. It acts as an assurance that the affiliating university (AKTU) supports the course to be conducted under its authority.
  2. NOC (No Objection Certificate) from the State Government – This certificate must also be valid for the same academic session (2026-27).

If the State Government has officially stopped issuing NOCs for new pharmacy courses, then the institution must upload an official communication from the government as proof of this policy.

Clarification by AKTU in the Pharmacy Notice 2025

The AKTU Pharmacy Notice 2025 clearly states that the University Act and Regulations do not contain any provision for issuing Consent of Affiliation or NOC. This clarification means that AKTU itself cannot issue these documents independently unless such a provision exists in official university regulations or government orders.

According to the Uttar Pradesh Government’s Technical Education Department order (No. 1/1129089/2025/16-1099/21/2025 dated 31.10.2025), the process for opening new pharmacy institutions and introducing new pharmacy courses in existing institutions has been defined. However, within this procedure, there is no mention of any requirement or provision for issuing a State Government NOC for the commencement of new pharmacy programs.

Therefore, AKTU Pharmacy Notice 2025 emphasizes that unless the State Government specifically directs otherwise, AKTU will not issue a separate Consent of Affiliation or NOC to any institution.

Future Course of Action for Pharmacy Institutions

In the AKTU Pharmacy Notice 2025, the university further explains that if the Pharmacy Council of India (PCI) grants approval to an institution for starting a new pharmacy course or establishing a new college, then AKTU will proceed with the affiliation process in accordance with the rules mentioned in the University Act, Regulations, and Government Orders.

This means the university’s role will begin after PCI approval is granted, ensuring that all affiliated pharmacy institutions comply with the norms of both AKTU and PCI.

Institutions must therefore carefully follow the PCI’s official process and submit the required documents on time. The university will later review the PCI-approved list and grant affiliation to eligible colleges according to the prescribed legal and administrative procedures.

Recipients of the AKTU Pharmacy Notice 2025

As per the circular, copies of the AKTU Pharmacy Notice 2025 were sent to:

  1. Additional Chief Secretary, Technical Education Department, Government of Uttar Pradesh, Lucknow.
  2. Staff Officer, Office of the Hon’ble Vice-Chancellor, AKTU, for information to the Vice-Chancellor.
  3. All Pharmacy Institutions affiliated with AKTU for information and compliance.

This distribution ensures that all concerned departments and colleges are fully aware of the latest changes and clarifications issued by AKTU.

Importance of AKTU Pharmacy Notice 2025

The AKTU Pharmacy Notice 2025 plays a significant role in maintaining uniformity and compliance across all pharmacy institutions under the university. Many colleges were previously uncertain about whether they needed to obtain a Consent of Affiliation or a State Government NOC before applying to PCI. This notice removes that confusion.

By clearly stating that such provisions are not defined within the university’s regulatory framework, AKTU ensures that institutions do not face unnecessary delays or procedural errors during their PCI approval applications.

This step by AKTU also aligns with the government’s aim to streamline higher education processes, reduce redundant documentation, and encourage transparency in technical education across Uttar Pradesh.

Key Highlights of the AKTU Pharmacy Notice 2025

  • Issued in November 2025 by Registrar Reena Singh.
  • Based on PCI letter No. 14-56/2024-PCI (dated 03-10-2025).
  • Clarifies that AKTU does not issue Consent of Affiliation or State NOC.
  • Institutions must apply directly to PCI through the official portal.
  • AKTU will provide affiliation only after PCI approval, as per government rules.
  • Applicable for the academic year 2026-27 for new pharmacy courses or institutions.

READ MORE : AKTU UFM Notice 2025: Students Using Unfair Means Must Submit Explanation Before November 5

Final Summary

The AKTU Pharmacy Notice 2025 is a crucial update for all colleges planning to start or expand pharmacy courses under the Pharmacy Council of India’s approval process for 2026-27. AKTU has made it absolutely clear that the University does not issue Consent of Affiliation or NOC, as there are no such provisions in its regulations or the government order.

Institutions are advised to apply to PCI with the required documents and await further actions from the university after PCI’s decision. This circular reinforces AKTU’s commitment to following transparent and lawful procedures in technical and pharmaceutical education.

title.rendered: AKTU Year Back 2025: Complete Guide, Conditions, Credit Rules, and How to Avoid It

content.rendered:
If you are a student of Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University (AKTU), Lucknow, then you must have heard about “year back.” Many students get confused about what it actually means, when it applies, and how it can be avoided. In this article, we will explain everything about AKTU Year Back 2025 as per the official AKTU ordinance, including promotion rules, credit conditions, and real-life examples to make it simple and easy to understand.

What is Year Back in AKTU?

The term AKTU Year Back 2025 refers to a situation when a student fails to meet the required credit criteria to get promoted to the next academic year. It means that the student cannot move to the next year of the course until the required minimum credits are earned. This rule ensures that every student maintains a basic academic standard while progressing through the B.Tech or any other AKTU program.

According to the official AKTU Ordinance, all rules are clearly defined. One of the most important sections regarding promotion is Clause 10.1, which mentions:

“No restriction from promotion from odd semester to even semester.”

This means that if you are studying in an odd semester (like 1st, 3rd, 5th, or 7th), you will be promoted to the next even semester (2nd, 4th, 6th, or 8th) without any issue, regardless of whether you have back papers or not. However, the real rule of AKTU Year Back 2025 applies when you are being promoted from an even semester to the next odd semester, i.e., from one academic year to another.

Promotion from Odd to Even Semester

AKTU students are allowed to move freely from an odd semester to the next even semester. For example:

  • From 1st semester to 2nd semester – promotion is allowed.
  • From 3rd semester to 4th semester – promotion is allowed.
  • From 5th semester to 6th semester – promotion is allowed.

In simple words, there is no restriction between odd and even semester promotion. The AKTU Year Back 2025 condition does not apply here at all.

Promotion from Even to Odd Semester (Main Year Back Rule)

The year back condition applies when you want to move from an even semester to the next odd semester. That is, after completing one full academic year (two semesters), you must meet certain credit requirements set by AKTU. If you fail to meet those minimum credits, you will not be promoted and will face AKTU Year Back 2025.

Condition 1: One Semester Must Be Fully Cleared

The first and simplest way to avoid AKTU Year Back 2025 is by clearing all subjects and labs of any one semester of the academic year. If you have cleared one complete semester, then you automatically earn all the required minimum credits for promotion.

For example, if your 1st semester is completely cleared but you still have some backlogs in the 2nd semester, you will still be promoted to the next year. Clearing one full semester ensures that you meet the required credit threshold.

Condition 2: Earn Minimum Required Credits

The second condition for promotion in AKTU Year Back 2025 is based on credit requirements. Every semester has a certain number of total credits defined in the evaluation scheme. You must earn at least the minimum credits equal to one complete semester’s total credits to be promoted.

Let us understand this with an example.

Suppose:

  • 1st Semester = 22 credits
  • 2nd Semester = 22 credits
    Total = 44 credits in the first academic year.

According to AKTU rules, to be promoted from 1st year to 2nd year, you must earn minimum credits equal to one semester, i.e., 22 credits. If you achieve these credits, you will be promoted, even if you have some backlogs.

Example Calculation

If you earn:

  • 16 credits in 1st semester, and
  • 8 credits in 2nd semester,
    your total credits become 24.

Since 24 > 22, you meet the minimum credit requirement. Therefore, you will be promoted to the next year and AKTU Year Back 2025 will not apply to you.

However, this also means you have some subjects still pending (since you have less than total credits), but you can clear them later in back paper exams.

When Does Year Back Apply?

You will face AKTU Year Back 2025 if your total earned credits in the entire academic year are less than the minimum required credits of one semester. This happens when you fail in several subjects and do not achieve the credit target.

For example:

  • 1st semester credits earned = 10
  • 2nd semester credits earned = 8
    Total = 18 credits
    Minimum required = 22 credits

Since your total is less than 22, you will not be promoted to the next year and AKTU Year Back 2025 will apply.

Year Back Condition for Higher Years (2nd, 3rd, and 4th Year)

The same rule applies to all academic years. Every time you complete an even semester and move to the next academic year, you must check your credit requirement.

Example:

  • 3rd semester = 25 credits
  • 4th semester = 23 credits

Here, the minimum credit requirement is equal to the smaller one, i.e., 23 credits. If you earn 23 or more credits in the combined total of 3rd and 4th semester, you will be promoted to 3rd year. Otherwise, AKTU Year Back 2025 will apply.

This same rule continues for 3rd year to 4th year promotion as well. The concept remains constant throughout your degree.

What to Do If You Get Year Back?

If unfortunately you get AKTU Year Back 2025, do not panic. You are allowed to appear in back paper exams for the subjects you failed in. Once you clear those subjects and earn the minimum required credits, you can be promoted in the next cycle.

During the year back period, you can continue preparing for practicals, projects, and sessional work so that you are ready for the next attempt. AKTU provides multiple chances to clear backlogs, so students can easily recover from year back if they stay consistent.

How to Avoid AKTU Year Back 2025

Here are some practical tips to make sure you never face year back issues:

  1. Track your credits regularly: After every semester, calculate your total earned credits and compare them with the minimum requirement.
  2. Clear backlogs early: Do not wait for the final year to clear back papers. Try to clear them as soon as possible.
  3. Maintain attendance: Keep at least 75% attendance to secure good sessional marks.
  4. Focus on labs and internals: These are easy credits that can make a big difference in total credit count.
  5. Seek guidance: Discuss your situation with faculty or academic mentors if you are close to the minimum credit limit.
  6. Study smart: Focus on high-credit subjects first as they impact your total credit count the most.

Summary Table – AKTU Year Back 2025 Rules

Final Words

The AKTU Year Back 2025 system is not a punishment but a structured academic rule to maintain educational quality. It ensures that students are genuinely progressing with enough knowledge and performance. If you carefully manage your subjects, credits, and backlogs, you can easily avoid year back issues.

Remember, clearing one semester completely or earning the minimum credit requirement is the key to avoiding AKTU Year Back 2025. Stay consistent, manage your studies smartly, and you will move ahead smoothly every year.
