title.rendered: AKTU UFM Notice 2025: Students Using Unfair Means Must Submit Explanation Before November 5

content.rendered:
Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University (AKTU), Lucknow has issued an important circular for students under the Unfair Means (UFM) category during the Even Semester Examinations 2024-25. The university has officially informed that all such students must send their written explanation letters to the given official email address before November 5, 2025.

The notification, officially titled AKTU UFM Notice 2025, is crucial for all affiliated colleges under AKTU. Any student who fails to respond within the deadline may face serious consequences, including result cancellation or suspension.

What Is AKTU UFM Notice 2025 About

According to the circular number AKTU/Exam Cell/2025/2272, issued in November 2025, the notice comes directly from Prof. Rajeev Kumar, Controller of Examinations, AKTU Lucknow. The letter is addressed to all Directors and Principals of colleges affiliated with AKTU, asking them to inform students who were caught or suspected of using unfair means (UFM) during the university exams.

This latest AKTU UFM Notice 2025 covers both phases of the Even Semester Examinations 2024-25, held earlier this year.

  • Phase 1 exams were conducted from May 17, 2025, to June 13, 2025.
  • Phase 2 exams were conducted from July 2, 2025, to July 29, 2025.

During these examinations, several students were found using unfair means like unauthorized notes, mobile devices, or copying. These cases are categorized under UFM, and their results have been put on hold until the UFM Committee reviews their explanations.

Deadline to Submit UFM Explanation

Under the AKTU UFM Notice 2025, all students found in the UFM list must send their written explanations before November 5, 2025, to the university’s official email ID.

Email for submission: aktuufm@gmail.com

Students must mention the following details clearly in their email:

  1. Roll Number
  2. Subject Code
  3. A short written explanation of the incident

AKTU has also mentioned that each student should send only one email. Multiple or incomplete submissions will not be accepted.

What Happens If You Don’t Respond

The AKTU UFM Notice 2025 clearly states that students who do not send their explanation by November 5, 2025, will be considered unwilling to present their side. In that case, the university will assume that the student has nothing to say and will proceed with a final decision based only on existing reports.

The UFM Committee of AKTU will review all available evidence and explanations to decide whether the student is guilty or not. Ignoring the notice can lead to:

  • Result cancellation
  • Subject failure
  • Suspension for a semester or more

Students are strongly advised to take this notice seriously and respond before the deadline.

Understanding What UFM Means in AKTU

UFM stands for Unfair Means. It refers to any form of cheating or misconduct during examinations. The AKTU UFM Notice 2025 has been released to handle such cases fairly and transparently.

Common examples of UFM under AKTU examination rules include:

  • Carrying handwritten notes or printed material inside the exam hall
  • Using mobile phones, earphones, or smartwatches during the exam
  • Copying answers from another student’s sheet
  • Attempting to communicate with others during the test
  • Writing answers on unauthorized sheets or question papers

These actions violate university regulations, and students found guilty may lose their exam results or face disciplinary action.

How the UFM Committee Works

The AKTU UFM Committee plays an important role in ensuring fairness. Once students submit their explanation letters, the committee reviews each case carefully. After evaluation, one of the following outcomes is decided:

  1. The student is found not guilty – result released normally.
  2. The student is found guilty of a minor mistake – warning or partial penalty.
  3. The student is found guilty of serious misconduct – result canceled or student debarred.

By issuing the AKTU UFM Notice 2025, the university gives every student a fair chance to defend themselves before any final action is taken.

Simplified Summary of the AKTU UFM Circular

The AKTU UFM Notice 2025 can be summarized as follows:

  • Students caught using unfair means in Even Semester 2024-25 exams must submit a written explanation by November 5, 2025.
  • Email should be sent to aktuufm@gmail.com only once.
  • Roll number and subject code must be clearly mentioned.
  • No late submissions will be accepted.
  • If no response is received, the university will finalize decisions without student input.

All affiliated colleges have been instructed to inform affected students immediately and help them submit their responses.

How to Check If You Are on the UFM List

AKTU generally does not publish a public UFM list. However, students can identify if they fall under UFM by checking their result status on the AKTU One View portal.

Steps to check UFM status:

  1. Visit the official website https://aktu.ac.in
  2. Open the One View Result Portal https://erp.aktu.ac.in/WebPages/OneView/OneView.aspx
  3. Enter your roll number and check your result
  4. If your result shows “UFM” or “Result Withheld,” it means you are under the AKTU UFM Notice 2025

In that case, prepare your explanation letter and send it immediately before the due date.

How to Write an Effective Explanation Letter

Here’s a simple format students can follow for writing their explanation letter:

Subject: Explanation Regarding UFM Case – Roll No. [Your Roll Number]

Respected Sir/Madam,

I am a student of [Your College Name], Roll No. [XXXXX]. During the Even Semester Exam 2024-25, my answer sheet was marked under the UFM category. I sincerely apologize if any misunderstanding occurred. I assure you that I had no intention of using unfair means during the exam. Kindly consider my request sympathetically and release my result.

Yours faithfully,
[Your Name]
[Branch and Year]

This format ensures your email looks professional and respectful.

Important Points to Remember

  • Submit your explanation before November 5, 2025.
  • Send your email only once to aktuufm@gmail.com.
  • Mention roll number and subject code correctly.
  • Keep your explanation short, polite, and clear.
  • Wait for the UFM Committee’s final decision after submission.

Why This AKTU UFM Notice 2025 Matters

The AKTU UFM Notice 2025 is not just a warning — it’s an opportunity for students to explain their side and avoid permanent marks on their academic record. It shows the university’s fair approach in handling exam misconduct cases by giving every student a chance to present their defense.

Students who respond on time and cooperate fully have higher chances of getting their results released. Therefore, this notice is extremely important for those whose results are currently withheld.

Conclusion

The AKTU UFM Notice 2025 serves as a final reminder for all students accused of using unfair means during the Even Semester 2024-25 exams. The last date to submit your explanation letter is November 5, 2025. Failing to do so may result in strict action, including result cancellation.

Send your explanation immediately to aktuufm@gmail.com and make sure you include your roll number and subject code clearly. Stay alert, act responsibly, and maintain academic honesty in future examinations.

This notice from AKTU emphasizes that while academic pressure can be high, integrity and discipline must always come first.

title.rendered: AKTU B.Tech 2nd Semester Result 2025 Declared: PWG, PCP, Fail का मतलब जानिए

content.rendered:
AKTU B.Tech 2nd Semester Result 2025 घोषित: Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University (AKTU) ने आखिरकार AKTU B.Tech 2nd Semester Result 2025 घोषित कर दिया है। जैसे ही रिजल्ट जारी हुआ, हजारों स्टूडेंट्स ने अपने मार्क्स और स्टेटस देखना शुरू किया। कई स्टूडेंट्स को रिजल्ट समझ नहीं आ रहा है — खासकर “PWG”, “PCP” और “Fail” जैसे रिजल्ट स्टेटस को लेकर।

अगर आपका रिजल्ट अभी-अभी आया है और आप सोच रहे हैं कि AKTU B.Tech 2nd Semester Result 2025 में आपका स्टेटस क्या बताता है, तो यह आर्टिकल आपके सारे डाउट्स क्लियर करेगा।

AKTU Result Status Types – Meaning in Detail

AKTU B.Tech 2nd Semester Result 2025 में यूनिवर्सिटी चार मुख्य रिजल्ट स्टेटस दिखाती है —

  1. PASS
  2. PWG (Pass With Grace)
  3. PCP (Pass With Carry Paper)
  4. FAIL (Year Back)

अब इन चारों का मतलब आसान भाषा में जानते हैं।

1. PASS – पूरी तरह पास

अगर आपके रिजल्ट में “Result Status: PASS” लिखा है, तो इसका मतलब है कि आपने सभी सब्जेक्ट्स क्लियर कर लिए हैं।

  • आपको किसी भी सब्जेक्ट में बैक पेपर (Carry Paper) नहीं देना है।
  • आपके रिजल्ट में CP = 0 लिखा होगा।
  • आप अगले ईयर में प्रमोट हो चुके हैं।

Example:
Result Status: PASS
Carry Paper (CP): 0

इसका मतलब है कि आपने सभी सब्जेक्ट्स पास कर लिए और अब नेक्स्ट ईयर में पढ़ाई जारी रख सकते हैं।
यानी AKTU B.Tech 2nd Semester Result 2025 में PASS स्टेटस आना सबसे अच्छी खबर है।

2. PWG – Pass With Grace (ग्रेस मार्क्स से पास)

अगर आपके रिजल्ट में “PWG” लिखा है, तो इसका मतलब है कि आपको कुछ सब्जेक्ट्स में Grace Marks देकर पास किया गया है।

AKTU नियम के अनुसार —

  • यूनिवर्सिटी किसी स्टूडेंट को अधिकतम 7 ग्रेस मार्क्स तक दे सकती है।
  • ग्रेस केवल 1 या 2 सब्जेक्ट्स में मिल सकते हैं।
  • जिस सब्जेक्ट में ग्रेस मिलता है, उसके सामने E# (E Hash) लिखा होता है।

Example:
अगर किसी स्टूडेंट को एक सब्जेक्ट में 16 मार्क्स मिले और पास होने के लिए 21 चाहिए, तो यूनिवर्सिटी उसे 5 ग्रेस मार्क्स दे सकती है।

External Marks: 16
Internal Marks: Pass
Status: PWG
Note: E# (Grace Marks Applied)

इसका मतलब आप पास हैं और AKTU B.Tech 2nd Semester Result 2025 में आपका स्टेटस PWG दिखेगा।

क्या आप Grace Marks रिजेक्ट कर सकते हैं?

हाँ, अगर आप चाहते हैं कि यूनिवर्सिटी द्वारा दिए गए ग्रेस मार्क्स काउंट न हों, तो आप उसे Reject कर सकते हैं।

ऐसा करने के लिए —

  1. एक Application Letter लिखें।
  2. एक Affidavit बनवाकर अपने कॉलेज में सबमिट करें।
  3. बताएं कि “आप ग्रेस मार्क्स नहीं चाहते और बैक पेपर देना चाहते हैं।”

उसके बाद आपकी उस सब्जेक्ट में एक Carry Paper (CP) गिनी जाएगी।
आप आने वाले सेमेस्टर में उसका एग्जाम देकर अपनी परफॉर्मेंस सुधार सकते हैं।

यानी, PWG स्टेटस आपको प्रमोट करता है, लेकिन आप चाहें तो उसे बैक पेपर से रिप्लेस कर सकते हैं।

3. PCP – Pass With Carry Paper

अगर आपके रिजल्ट में “PCP” लिखा है, तो इसका मतलब है कि आप पास हैं लेकिन एक या अधिक सब्जेक्ट्स में Carry Paper है।

  • आप अगले ईयर में प्रमोट हो चुके हैं।
  • लेकिन आपको आगे चलकर उन सब्जेक्ट्स के बैक पेपर देने होंगे।

Example:
Result Status: PCP
Carry Paper: 1

इसका मतलब है कि आप पास हैं, लेकिन आपको उस एक सब्जेक्ट को क्लियर करना होगा जिसमें बैक लगी है।

अगर किसी स्टूडेंट की 2–3 बैक हैं (फर्स्ट और सेकंड सेम मिलाकर), तो उन्हें अगले सेमेस्टर में उन सब्जेक्ट्स के बैक पेपर देने होंगे।

इसलिए, AKTU B.Tech 2nd Semester Result 2025 में PCP आने पर चिंता करने की जरूरत नहीं — आप प्रमोट हैं, बस बैक क्लियर करनी है।

4. FAIL – Year Back (ईयर रिपीट करना होगा)

अगर आपके रिजल्ट में “FAIL” लिखा है, तो इसका मतलब है कि आपकी Year Back लग गई है।

  • अगर आप 1st Year में Fail हैं, तो आपको 1st Year दोबारा करना होगा।
  • अगर आप 2nd Year में Fail हैं, तो आपको 2nd Year रिपीट करना पड़ेगा।

Fail स्टेटस आने पर आप Next Year में प्रमोट नहीं होते और वही ईयर दोबारा पढ़ना होता है।

AKTU B.Tech 2nd Semester Result 2025 में Fail का मतलब Year Back होता है।

PWG, PCP, PASS और FAIL में अंतर

यह टेबल AKTU B.Tech 2nd Semester Result 2025 को समझने में मदद करती है।

क्या PWG और PCP में प्रमोशन मिलता है?

हाँ, AKTU B.Tech 2nd Semester Result 2025 में अगर आपका स्टेटस PWG या PCP है, तो आप Promoted माने जाते हैं।

  • PWG का मतलब है कि आपने ग्रेस मार्क्स से पास किया है।
  • PCP का मतलब है कि आपने कैरी पेपर के साथ पास किया है।

सिर्फ “Fail” स्टेटस आने पर ही Year Back लगता है।

Next Steps After Result

अगर आपका Result Status “PASS” है:
आपको कोई एक्शन लेने की जरूरत नहीं। आप नेक्स्ट ईयर में प्रमोट हैं।

अगर “PWG” है:
आप ग्रेस मार्क्स से पास हैं। चाहें तो उस सब्जेक्ट में बैक पेपर देकर सुधार करें या वैसे ही प्रमोट रहें।

अगर “PCP” है:
नेक्स्ट सेमेस्टर में बैक पेपर का फॉर्म भरें और उस सब्जेक्ट का एग्जाम दें।

अगर “FAIL” है:
आपको उसी ईयर को दोबारा करना होगा। अपने कॉलेज से Year Repeat और Re-exam की जानकारी लें।

Important Tips for Students

  1. AKTU Result देखने के लिए आधिकारिक वेबसाइट पर जाएं – https://aktu.ac.in
  2. अपने Result Status (PASS, PWG, PCP, FAIL) को ध्यान से पढ़ें।
  3. अगर कोई डाउट हो, तो कॉलेज के Exam Cell से संपर्क करें।
  4. बैक पेपर या री-एग्जाम का फॉर्म समय पर भरें।
  5. PWG स्टेटस को लेकर कोई कन्फ्यूजन हो तो ग्रेस रिजेक्शन प्रक्रिया अपनाएं।

READ MORE : Last Chance! IIT Bhubaneswar Free Winter Internship 2025 – Limited Seats, Apply Now

Conclusion

इस साल का AKTU B.Tech 2nd Semester Result 2025 स्टूडेंट्स के लिए राहत और उलझन दोनों लेकर आया है।
अगर आपका स्टेटस PASS है तो Congratulations।
अगर PWG या PCP है तो आप प्रमोट हैं, बस आगे कुछ सब्जेक्ट्स क्लियर करने होंगे।
और अगर Fail आया है, तो हिम्मत न हारें — अगले प्रयास में बेहतर करें।

AKTU B.Tech 2nd Semester Result 2025 से जुड़ी हर अपडेट, Circulars, Admit Card और Exam News के लिए हमारी वेबसाइट पर बने रहें।

title.rendered: AKTU B.Tech 1st Year 2nd Semester Result 2025 Declared at aktu.ac.in – Check Now

content.rendered:
AKTU B.Tech 1st Year 2nd Semester Result 2025 Declared – Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University (AKTU), Uttar Pradesh, has officially announced the B.Tech 1st Year 2nd Semester Result 2025 on its official website aktu.ac.in. The results have been released for both regular and carry-over students of the Even Semester (Phase 1) examinations conducted in July 2025.

All students enrolled in AKTU-affiliated colleges can now access their results through the One View Portal by entering their Enrollment Number or Roll Number. This marks an important academic update for B.Tech students of the 2024–28 batch, completing their first year under AKTU’s new evaluation guidelines.

Let’s explore all details, including result dates, how to check your marks, official notification highlights, and next steps after the result.

What is AKTU B.Tech 1st Year 2nd Semester Result 2025?

The AKTU B.Tech 1st Year 2nd Semester Result 2025 represents the official outcome of the Even Semester exams held in July 2025 for students of Batch 2024–28.

It includes all branches under the B.Tech program such as:

  • Computer Science and Engineering
  • Mechanical Engineering
  • Civil Engineering
  • Electrical Engineering
  • Electronics and Communication Engineering
  • Information Technology and others

The results have been uploaded after thorough verification and approval by Prof. Deepak Nagariya, Controller of Examinations, AKTU Lucknow.

Important Dates – AKTU B.Tech 1st Year 2nd Semester Result 2025

How to Check AKTU B.Tech 1st Year 2nd Semester Result 2025

Follow the steps below to check your result easily:

  1. Visit the official website aktu.ac.in
  2. Click on “One View Result Portal” or directly visit erp.aktu.ac.in
  3. Enter your Enrollment Number or Roll Number
  4. Select Semester – 2nd and Course – B.Tech
  5. Click Submit
  6. Your detailed marksheet and result status will appear
  7. Download and save the marksheet for future reference

Official AKTU Notification Highlights

As per the official circular (Ref. No. AKTU/COE/2025/2004) issued by Prof. Deepak Nagariya, the B.Tech 1st Year 2nd Semester Result 2025 has been declared for students who appeared in the Even Semester exams (Phase 1) held in July 2025.

All affiliated colleges have been directed to inform students about the result and verify internal and external marks records.

Circular Summary – AKTU Result Notice 2025

About AKTU and One View Portal

Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University (AKTU), headquartered in Lucknow, is one of India’s largest technical universities, affiliating over 700 engineering colleges across Uttar Pradesh.

The One View Portal (erp.aktu.ac.in) is AKTU’s official platform where students can:

  • Check semester-wise results
  • View detailed marksheets and grades
  • Apply for scrutiny or revaluation
  • Access academic records instantly

Steps After Checking AKTU B.Tech Result 2025

Once you’ve checked your result, make sure to:

  • Download and print your online marksheet for future use.
  • Review subject-wise marks, including theory, internal, and practical components.
  • Report any errors or discrepancies to your college’s examination cell.
  • If unsatisfied with marks, apply for Scrutiny or Re-evaluation through the ERP portal.
  • Students who have cleared all subjects can proceed to 3rd Semester (2nd Year) starting November 2025.

Revaluation and Scrutiny Process 2025

AKTU provides an online facility for students who wish to recheck their marks.

Key Points:

  • The scrutiny/revaluation window will open shortly after the result release.
  • Apply through the ERP Portal using your student login.
  • A nominal fee per subject is applicable.
  • Updated results (if any changes) will be published on the same One View portal.
  • Keep an eye on college notices and AKTU’s official site for the latest deadlines.

Significance of AKTU B.Tech 1st Year 2nd Semester Result 2025

This result is extremely important as it:

  • Marks the completion of your first academic year under AKTU.
  • Determines your promotion to the next year (3rd Semester).
  • Contributes to your Cumulative Grade Point Average (CGPA).
  • Helps students identify their academic strengths and areas for improvement.

Students with good scores may also qualify for departmental scholarships or internships offered by their institutes.

Expected Next Announcements from AKTU

Following the release of the B.Tech 1st Year 2nd Semester Result 2025, AKTU is likely to announce:

  • Carry-over exam schedule for students with backlogs.
  • Challenge evaluation and revaluation timelines.
  • Academic Calendar 2025–26 for the Odd Semester (3rd Semester).

Stay updated on official announcements via aktu.ac.in and ERP notifications.

FAQs – AKTU B.Tech 1st Year 2nd Semester Result 2025

Q1. When was the AKTU B.Tech 1st Year 2nd Semester Result 2025 declared?
The result was officially announced on 31 October 2025.

Q2. When were the exams held?
The Even Semester exams took place in July 2025.

Q3. How can I check my result?
Visit the AKTU One View Portal – erp.aktu.ac.in and enter your details.

Q4. Does it include both regular and carry-over students?
Yes, both categories are covered under this result declaration.

Q5. What if I find an error in my marks?
Contact your college examination cell or apply for scrutiny through the ERP portal.

READ MORE : AKTU B.Tech 2nd Year 4th Semester Result 2025 Declared at aktu.ac.in – Check Now

Conclusion

The AKTU B.Tech 1st Year 2nd Semester Result 2025 is a major academic update for engineering students across Uttar Pradesh. The university has ensured a transparent and quick evaluation process, making results easily accessible through the One View portal.

Students are advised to check their results carefully, download the marksheet, and proceed with the re-evaluation process if required. For further updates regarding carry-over exams, revaluation deadlines, or academic calendar 2025–26, visit the official website – aktu.ac.in.

title.rendered: Last Chance! IIT Bhubaneswar Free Winter Internship 2025 – Limited Seats, Apply Now

content.rendered:
The Indian Institute of Technology (IIT) Bhubaneswar has officially opened applications for its IIT Bhubaneswar Free Winter Internship 2025, a prestigious opportunity for students across India. With limited seats and a fast-approaching deadline, this internship offers a unique chance for students to gain real-world experience, work on live research projects, and learn directly from top IIT faculty members.

As one of the top IITs in India, IIT Bhubaneswar Free Winter Internship 2025 programs are designed to bridge the gap between theoretical learning and practical application. Students who participate in these internships not only enhance their academic skills but also improve their chances of securing research opportunities, higher studies, or jobs in reputed organizations.

If you are a student passionate about technology, innovation, and research, this winter internship is the perfect way to make your vacation productive.

Why Should You Apply for IIT Bhubaneswar Free Winter Internship 2025?

IIT Bhubaneswar is known for its strong research culture, state-of-the-art laboratories, and academic excellence. Participating in an IIT internship gives you a taste of how real-world research and innovation take place at one of India’s premier institutions.

Here are the main reasons why you should apply:

  • The internship provides a chance to work under renowned IIT professors and researchers.
  • Students can participate in live interdisciplinary projects that have real-world impact.
  • You get access to modern labs, computing facilities, and libraries.
  • A certificate from IIT Bhubaneswar adds significant value to your resume.
  • The experience enhances your academic and professional profile, especially for those planning to apply for M.Tech, MS, or Ph.D. programs in the future.

Students from various fields such as Engineering, Science, Humanities, and Management can apply and explore innovative research areas that match their interests.

Key Features of the IIT Bhubaneswar Free Winter Internship 2025

The Free Winter Internship at IIT Bhubaneswar comes with several highlights that make it one of the most sought-after short-term academic opportunities in India.

  • Duration: 3 to 4 weeks (scheduled during winter vacation, starting early December 2025).
  • Mode: Primarily on-campus internship. However, a few departments may allow hybrid mode depending on project nature.
  • Eligibility: Students pursuing B.Tech, M.Tech, M.Sc, or equivalent degrees from recognized universities.
  • Certificate: All participants will receive an official internship completion certificate from IIT Bhubaneswar.
  • Accommodation: Hostel facilities are available on a payment basis, depending on availability.
  • Project Type: Encourages interdisciplinary and innovative projects across multiple domains.
  • Academic Credit: Some students may earn credits based on their home institution’s policy.

This structure ensures that students not only gain technical exposure but also experience the IIT ecosystem — an opportunity that can make a big difference in their career journey.

Who Can Apply?

The internship program is open to a wide range of students from across India. IIT Bhubaneswar aims to include bright and motivated students from different disciplines who have a keen interest in research and innovation.

Eligible candidates include:

  • Undergraduate, postgraduate, and Ph.D. students from recognized academic institutions.
  • Students from diverse fields such as Basic Sciences, Earth Sciences, Engineering, Humanities, Management, and Materials Engineering.
  • Candidates maintaining a minimum CGPA of 7.5 or equivalent (recommended for better chances of selection).
  • Students from government-funded colleges, universities, and IITs’ academic partner institutions are especially encouraged to apply.

Applicants from any part of India can apply — there is no regional restriction. The program promotes diversity and encourages applications from students of all backgrounds.

Duration and Timelines

The duration of the internship will be approximately 3 to 4 weeks during the winter vacation period (December 2025).

Students are expected to be available full-time during the internship. Attendance, participation in project work, and submission of reports are compulsory for successful completion and certification.

Application Submission Process

Students interested in applying must follow the proper online procedure:

  • Applications are accepted only through the official IIT Bhubaneswar internship portal.
  • Offline or email submissions will not be considered.
  • The application form must include personal details, academic records, and preferred departments or project areas.
  • Applicants must upload necessary documents such as a resume, academic transcripts, and a statement of purpose.
  • Once submitted, candidates cannot modify their applications.

The last date to apply is November 6, 2025 (11:00 PM IST). Late applications will not be entertained.

Selection Procedure

The selection process is designed to ensure that the most deserving and capable candidates get the opportunity.

  1. Initial Screening: Departments and schools at IIT Bhubaneswar will conduct a preliminary review of all applications.
  2. Shortlisting: Based on academic performance, statement of purpose, and research interest, candidates will be shortlisted.
  3. Final Selection: A selection committee will finalize the list of selected interns.
  4. Notification: Selected candidates will be informed via email. The final list will also be published on the official IIT Bhubaneswar website.

Candidates who are not selected will not receive separate notifications.

Important Notes for Applicants

Notification of Selection
Only shortlisted and selected candidates will be contacted via email. The official list will also be displayed on the institute’s website.

Accommodation and Food
Selected students can avail hostel accommodation at IIT Bhubaneswar on a payment basis, depending on room availability. The cost of food and other facilities will have to be borne by the interns.

Fellowship
Although the internship is primarily academic and unpaid, selected supervisors may offer stipends or fellowships depending on the availability of funds in their research projects.

Institute Guidelines
During their stay, interns must adhere to IIT Bhubaneswar’s rules and regulations. They will be issued temporary ID cards for accessing campus facilities like the library, internet, and labs.

Benefits of IIT Bhubaneswar Free Winter Internship 2025

Participating in this internship can be a career-changing experience for students. Here are some of the major benefits:

  • Practical Experience: Gain real-world exposure through research and development projects.
  • Expert Mentorship: Learn directly from IIT Bhubaneswar professors and research supervisors.
  • Certificate of Completion: A valuable credential from IIT Bhubaneswar that enhances your profile.
  • Academic Credit: Some universities may consider this internship for academic credit.
  • Networking Opportunities: Connect with peers, researchers, and faculty from top institutions across India.
  • Access to Resources: Utilize IIT’s advanced laboratories, computing resources, and research libraries.
  • Fellowship Opportunities: Some projects may offer financial assistance or stipends.
  • Accommodation: On-campus hostel facilities are available at nominal rates.

This experience not only strengthens your technical knowledge but also boosts your problem-solving, teamwork, and research skills — all essential for future success in both academia and industry.

Important Dates and Application Details

Application Mode: Online submission only via the official IIT Bhubaneswar Internship Portal.
Applicants must upload all required documents and choose preferred departments for research projects before the deadline.

How to Apply

To apply for the IIT Bhubaneswar Free Winter Internship 2025, follow these steps:

  1. Visit the official IIT Bhubaneswar Internship Portal.
  2. Register using your valid email ID and create a login account.
  3. Fill in all details carefully — including educational background, department preference, and project area.
  4. Upload required documents such as resume, transcripts, and statement of purpose.
  5. Review and submit your application before the last date.

Official Links:
IIT Bhubaneswar Free Winter Internship 2025 Official Portal – Click Here

READ MORE : YUVAI Global Youth AI Challenge 2025: Empowering India’s Young Innovators for the Future of AI

Conclusion

The IIT Bhubaneswar Free Winter Internship 2025 is an excellent opportunity for students who wish to gain real research exposure and experience life at a premier Indian Institute of Technology.

It’s not just a short-term internship — it’s a gateway to innovation, mentorship, and future career opportunities. With limited seats and a high level of competition, students are advised to apply as early as possible and submit complete, accurate details.

Make your winter count by interning at one of India’s most reputed institutes. Learn, explore, and innovate with IIT Bhubaneswar this winter.

Research. Innovate. Build your future with IIT Bhubaneswar.

title.rendered: YUVAI Global Youth AI Challenge 2025: Empowering India’s Young Innovators for the Future of AI

content.rendered:
India has taken another powerful step toward becoming a global hub for artificial intelligence (AI). The Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY) has announced the YUVAI Global Youth AI Challenge 2025, a nationwide initiative designed to inspire and empower young minds aged 13–21 years.

The YUVAI Global Youth AI Challenge 2025 aims to nurture AI talent among youth and encourage them to create AI-based solutions that address real-world problems — from sustainability and education to smart infrastructure and healthcare.

This initiative will lead up to the India AI Impact Summit 2026, scheduled to be held at Bharat Mandapam, New Delhi, on 19–20 February 2026, where the best young innovators will get an opportunity to showcase their ideas before global leaders and policymakers.

What is YUVAI Global Youth AI Challenge 2025?

The YUVAI (Young, Upcoming, and Versatile AI Innovators) Global Youth AI Challenge 2025 is an initiative launched by MeitY under the IndiaAI Mission. It aims to empower youth with foundational AI skills while providing a platform to develop and present AI-based solutions for social good.

The program includes virtual bootcamps, mentorship sessions, and opportunities for participants to present their innovations to a global audience at the upcoming India AI Impact Summit 2026.

The challenge is completely free to participate in and open to both individuals and teams (up to 3 members) under the age of 21.

Objectives of the YUVAI Global Youth AI Challenge 2025

The main objective of the YUVAI Global Youth AI Challenge 2025 is to enable youth to use AI for societal transformation. Below are the key goals:

  1. Engage youth with AI experts through mentorship and workshops to gain real-world experience.
  2. Train selected participants in 10-day virtual AI bootcamps with tools, skills, and practical knowledge.
  3. Promote AI for social good, focusing on sustainability, equality, and accessibility.
  4. Create opportunities for exposure, connecting Indian youth with international innovators and investors.
  5. Foster a strong AI innovation ecosystem that makes India a global leader in ethical and impactful AI.

Expected Impact of the Challenge

The YUVAI Global Youth AI Challenge 2025 is expected to make a significant impact on India’s innovation landscape:

  • Encourages multi-lateral innovation through international collaboration.
  • Builds a generation of AI-ready youth equipped with both technical and ethical knowledge.
  • Strengthens India’s domestic youth innovation ecosystem by providing mentorship and exposure to global AI practices.
  • Helps India take a leading role in AI innovation by nurturing young problem solvers and innovators.

Themes of the Challenge

The YUVAI Global Youth AI Challenge 2025 encourages participants to design AI-based solutions under the following suggestive themes:

1. Empowering People and Communities

AI solutions that enhance mental health, elderly care, fitness, nutrition, and inclusive education for all, including students with disabilities.

2. Transforming Core Sectors

Projects that improve agriculture, manufacturing, logistics, waste management, and industrial transformation through sustainable AI applications.

3. Future-Ready Infrastructure

AI ideas that build smart cities, green environments, promote clean energy, and improve public service delivery.

4. Open Innovation (Wildcard)

Participants can also submit cross-sector AI solutions with the potential for large-scale impact and scalability.

Each of these themes promotes AI for social good, combining innovation with ethics and inclusion.

Who Can Participate in YUVAI Challenge 2025?

Participation is open to all youth aged 13–21 years, including:

  • Individual participants (one person ≤ 21 years old)
  • Teams of up to 3 members, all aged ≤ 21 years

This inclusive structure allows school students, college students, and early innovators to showcase their creativity and problem-solving ability through AI.

title.rendered: AKTU B.Tech 2nd Year 4th Semester Result 2025 Declared at aktu.ac.in – Check Now

content.rendered:
AKTU B.Tech 2nd Year ,4th Semester Result 2025 Declared:
Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University (AKTU), Uttar Pradesh, has officially announced the B.Tech 2nd Year ,4th Semester Result 2025 on its official website aktu.ac.in. The results have been released for both regular and carry-over students of the Even Semester (Phase 1) examinations conducted in July 2025.

Students from all affiliated colleges under AKTU can now check their results through the One View portal by entering their enrollment or roll number. This declaration marks an important update for B.Tech students who appeared in the Even Semester 2024–25 session.

Let’s go through the complete details, including result dates, official notification, how to check results, and what to do next after checking your marks.

What is AKTU B.Tech 2nd YEAR ,4th Semester Result 2025?

The AKTU B.Tech 2nd Year ,4th Semester Result 2025 is the official declaration of students’ performance in the Even Semester examinations held in July 2025.
This result covers all B.Tech branches such as Computer Science, Mechanical, Electrical, Civil, Electronics, IT, and others.

The 2nd Year corresponds to first-year students (Batch 2024–28), while the 4th Semester includes second-year students (Batch 2023–27).
The results have been published online after thorough verification and approval from the Controller of Examinations, Prof. Deepak Nagariya.

Important Dates – AKTU B.Tech 2nd & 4th Semester Result 2025

How to Check AKTU B.Tech 2nd Year ,4th Semester Result 2025

Students can easily check their semester result through the official AKTU One View portal. Follow the step-by-step process below:

  1. Visit the official website aktu.ac.in
  2. Click on “One View Result Portal” or go directly to erp.aktu.ac.in
  3. Enter your Enrollment Number or Roll Number
  4. Select your Semester (2nd or 4th) and Course (B.Tech)
  5. Click “Submit”
  6. Your detailed marks and result status will appear on the screen

Official AKTU Notification Highlights

According to the official notification (Ref. No.: AKTU/COE/2025/2003) issued by Prof. Deepak Nagariya, Controller of Examinations, the university has officially declared the results for B.Tech 2nd and 4th Semester students who appeared in the Even Semester Examinations held in July 2025.

All affiliated colleges have been instructed to inform their students about the result declaration and take necessary steps regarding any discrepancies, if found.

Circular Summary – AKTU Result Notice 2025

About AKTU and One View Portal

Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University (AKTU), located in Lucknow, is one of India’s largest technical universities, with over 700 affiliated engineering colleges across Uttar Pradesh.

The One View Portal is an online platform developed by the university that allows students to view their semester results, marksheets, and grades instantly. This portal provides complete transparency and convenience for students of all AKTU-affiliated colleges.

Steps After Checking AKTU B.Tech Result 2025

After viewing your AKTU B.Tech 2nd or 4th Semester Result 2025, students should take the following steps:

  • Download and print your online marksheet for future use.
  • Check subject-wise marks carefully, including internal, external, and practical scores.
  • If you find any error or missing marks, report to your college’s examination cell immediately.
  • In case of unsatisfactory marks, students can apply for re-evaluation or scrutiny through the AKTU ERP portal.
  • Students who have cleared all subjects can now prepare for the next semester classes beginning November 2025.

Revaluation and Scrutiny Process 2025

AKTU allows students to apply for scrutiny or challenge evaluation if they are not satisfied with their marks.
Here’s what you need to know:

  • The re-evaluation window will open shortly after the result announcement.
  • Applications can be made online through the ERP login portal.
  • A fee per subject will be charged as per AKTU rules.
  • After evaluation, the updated results will be published on the same One View platform.

Students are advised to stay updated through their college notice boards and the official AKTU website for re-evaluation deadlines.

Significance of AKTU B.Tech 2nd YEAR, 4th Semester Result 2025

This result is significant for all students, as it determines their academic progress and overall Cumulative Grade Point Average (CGPA).

  • For 2nd-semester students, it marks the successful completion of their first academic year.
  • For 4th-semester students, it signifies the halfway milestone of their 4-year B.Tech program.

The results also help students prepare for internships, training programs, and other academic opportunities offered by their colleges.

After the B.Tech 2nd and 4th Semester Result declaration, AKTU is expected to announce:

  • Carry-over exam schedules for students who did not clear some subjects.
  • Challenge evaluation dates and online form links.
  • Academic calendar for Odd Semester (2025–26 session).

Students should regularly check aktu.ac.in and the ERP portal for upcoming updates.

FAQs – AKTU B.Tech 2nd Year 4th Semester Result 2025

Q1. When was the AKTU B.Tech 2nd Year ,4th Semester Result 2025 declared?
The result was officially released on 30 October 2025.

Q2. When were the B.Tech exams conducted?
The Even Semester exams were held in July 2025.

Q3. How can students check their results?
By visiting the AKTU One View Portal at erp.aktu.ac.in.

Q4. Are both regular and carry-over students included?
Yes, the result includes regular and carry-over students from the July 2025 examinations.

Q5. What to do if there’s an error in the result?
Contact your college exam cell or apply for scrutiny/revaluation through the official portal.

Conclusion

The declaration of the AKTU B.Tech 2nd Year ,4th Semester Result 2025 marks an important academic event for thousands of engineering students across Uttar Pradesh.
The exams were conducted smoothly in July 2025, and the results have been made available online for easy access.

Students are advised to check their marks carefully, download their result, and follow the next academic steps as per their performance.

For all future updates regarding re-evaluation, carry-over exams, and academic calendars, visit the official website – aktu.ac.in.

title.rendered: AKTU Recruitment 2025: Apply for SRF, JRF, RA, PA & Project Linked Personnel under ISEA Phase-III

content.rendered:
If you’re looking to start your career in research or project management in the field of Information Security, then the AKTU Recruitment 2025 notification is an excellent opportunity for you.
Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University (AKTU), Lucknow, has officially announced vacancies for SRF, JRF, RA, PA, Young Fellows, and Project Linked Personnel under the Information Security Education Awareness (ISEA) Phase-III project — sponsored by the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY), Government of India.

This article will guide you through all the essential details — from eligibility, salary, and selection process to how to apply for AKTU Recruitment 2025 — in a simple and engaging way.

About the AKTU Recruitment 2025

Under the official notification Ref No. AKTU/IH/2025/456 (dated October 16, 2025), AKTU invites applications for two research positions (SRF/JRF/RA/PA/Young Fellows) and one Project Linked Personnel position.

These roles are purely temporary, but they offer an incredible opportunity to work on one of India’s most prestigious cybersecurity projects — ISEA Phase-III.

Overview of Vacancies

All positions are under AKTU Recruitment 2025, funded by MeitY, with a project tenure till March 31, 2026 (extendable based on performance and funds).

Eligibility Criteria for AKTU Recruitment 2025

1. For SRF/JRF/RA/PA/Young Fellows

  • Essential Qualification:
    • B.Tech/B.E. in Computer Science or related areas
    • M.Sc./M.Tech. in Mathematics, Computer Science, or related disciplines
    • Ph.D. in Mathematics or Computer Science (from recognized institutions)
  • Desirable Qualification:
    Candidates with experience or coursework in the following areas will get preference:
    • Cryptology
    • Quantum Cryptology
    • Coding Theory

2. For Project Linked Personnel

  • Essential Qualification:
    • Graduate in any discipline
    • Minimum 3 years of work experience in a project or computer-related job
    • Strong documentation and technical drafting skills

If you have strong technical aptitude, research interest, or project coordination skills, the AKTU Recruitment 2025 gives you the platform to showcase your potential.

Salary and Benefits

Under the AKTU Recruitment 2025, selected candidates will receive the following pay structure:

  • SRF/JRF/RA/PA/Young Fellows: ₹35,000 per month (consolidated, no other allowances)
  • Project Linked Personnel: ₹25,000 per month (consolidated)

Additionally, selected research candidates may be eligible for a one-time contingency research grant, depending on fund availability.

Age Limit

The upper age limit for all posts under AKTU Recruitment 2025 is 35 years as of July 1, 2025.
However, relaxations will apply as per government norms for:

  • SC/ST/OBC
  • Women candidates
  • Differently-abled applicants
  • Experienced professionals (with relevant additional years in the field)

Important Dates – AKTU Recruitment 2025

Candidates are advised to submit their applications before the deadline to ensure consideration in the AKTU Recruitment 2025 process.

Application Process for AKTU Recruitment 2025

Applying for AKTU Recruitment 2025 is simple and fully online. Follow these steps carefully:

Step 1: Prepare Your Resume

Your resume should be addressed to:
Dr. Anuj Kumar Sharma
Chief Investigator, ISEA Phase-III Project
Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University, Lucknow

Include the following details:

  • Full Name
  • E-mail Address
  • Contact Number
  • Parent/Spouse Name
  • Date of Birth
  • Academic Qualifications (from Class 10 onward with percentages)
  • GATE / NET details (if applicable)
  • Work Experience / Publications
  • Category (SC/ST/OBC/Differently-abled)

Step 2: Write a 500-word Essay

Depending on the post, write one of the following essays:

  • For SRF/JRF/RA/PA/Young Fellows:
    “How would you plan to explain basic cryptology to students with a mathematics background at 10+2 level and basic programming knowledge?”
  • For Project Linked Personnel:
    “Information Security Education and Awareness (ISEA) Project Phase-III initiatives and how you can contribute to this project as a Project Linked Personnel.”

Step 3: Send Application via Email

Send your completed application to:
📩 isea@aktu.ac.in
📩 Copy to: assodean.innovation@aktu.ac.in

Email Subject: “Application for [Name of the Post] – AKTU Recruitment 2025”

Attach:

  • Scanned copies of all academic documents
  • Self-attested ID card (Aadhaar, PAN, or Passport)

Shortlisted candidates will be contacted via email or phone.

Selection Process

The selection process for AKTU Recruitment 2025 involves:

  1. Screening of Applications: Based on eligibility and qualifications.
  2. Interview: Scheduled tentatively between November 5–10, 2025.
  3. Final Selection: Based on performance, qualifications, and project requirements.

The shortlisted candidates will be informed at least one week before the interview.

⚙️ Project Duration and Terms

  • The appointments are purely temporary, ending on March 31, 2026, unless extended based on funding and performance.
  • AKTU reserves the right not to fill any position if suitable candidates are not found.
  • Selected candidates must comply with all project-related terms and conditions under the ISEA Phase-III guidelines.

About the ISEA Phase-III Project

The Information Security Education and Awareness (ISEA) Phase-III project is a flagship initiative of MeitY, Government of India. Its mission is to promote cybersecurity education and awareness across academic institutions and the public.

Key objectives include:

  • Strengthening India’s cyber defense through education.
  • Promoting cryptology and cybersecurity research.
  • Building a skilled workforce in information security.
  • Spreading awareness about safe digital practices.

By joining this mission through the AKTU Recruitment 2025, you become part of India’s growing cybersecurity network.

Why You Should Apply for AKTU Recruitment 2025

  1. Work on a National Mission: Contribute to a Government of India–funded cybersecurity initiative.
  2. Research Opportunities: Explore cutting-edge topics like cryptology and quantum security.
  3. Skill Growth: Learn project management, technical writing, and advanced data security concepts.
  4. Networking: Collaborate with experts and researchers across India.
  5. Career Development: Build a strong academic and research portfolio.

For anyone passionate about cybersecurity, AI, or mathematical research, AKTU Recruitment 2025 offers an unparalleled opportunity to kickstart a rewarding career.

Final Words

The AKTU Recruitment 2025 under ISEA Phase-III is not just a job opportunity — it’s a chance to be part of India’s technological advancement in the field of information security. With limited positions available, make sure to apply before November 3, 2025, and prepare well for your essay and interview.

If you have the skills, passion, and curiosity to contribute to India’s digital security ecosystem, this is your moment.

title.rendered: AKTU Management Quota 2025-26: Online Pre-Registration for B.Pharm and Pharm-D Started at aktu.ac.in

content.rendered:
Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University (AKTU), Lucknow has officially announced the online pre-registration process for Pharmacy courses (B.Pharm and Pharm-D) under the AKTU Management Quota 2025-26.

According to the latest notification (Letter No. AKTU/KUS.KA/Namankan/2025/2458, dated 27 October 2025), all pharmacy institutes affiliated with AKTU must ensure that newly admitted students under the management quota complete their online pre-registration through the university’s ERP portal.

This registration is mandatory for all students seeking admission under the AKTU Management Quota 2025-26. Without completing this process, students will not be eligible for the final enrollment procedure.

AKTU Management Quota 2025-26: Important Dates

The AKTU Management Quota 2025-26 pre-registration portal has been activated on the official website — https://aktu.ac.in.
All institutes must ensure that their students complete the registration within these dates to avoid cancellation of their admission.

Who Needs to Register?

This online pre-registration process is mandatory for all B.Pharm and Pharm-D students who are taking admission under the Management Quota for session 2025-26 in AKTU-affiliated colleges.

Any student who fails to complete the pre-registration by the deadline will not be considered for the enrollment process under AKTU Management Quota 2025-26.

AKTU Management Quota 2025-26: Registration Fee Details

Students must pay the registration fee online through the university’s ERP payment gateway. Registrations without successful online payment will not be valid under any circumstances.

Step-by-Step Process for AKTU Management Quota 2025-26 Pre-Registration

The AKTU Management Quota 2025-26 registration process has been explained step-by-step below as per the official notice:

Step 1: Visit the Official Website

Go to the official AKTU website — https://aktu.ac.in.
A dedicated link or pop-up for “Pharmacy Management Quota Pre-registration 2025-26” will appear on the homepage.

Step 2: Click on the Registration Link

Click on the displayed registration link. You will be redirected to the online pre-registration form for B.Pharm or Pharm-D management quota students.

Step 3: Fill the Application Form

Fill in all required details carefully — including personal information, academic qualifications, and course selection (B.Pharm or Pharm-D).
Complete the form step by step as guided on the page.

Step 4: Important — No Changes Allowed Later

Please note that once you fill in your details (such as name, father’s name, date of birth, mobile number, email ID, and qualification details), they cannot be edited later.
Ensure all information is accurate before submission.

Step 5: Verify Mobile Number via OTP

After filling the form, verify your mobile number using OTP verification.
All future updates regarding your registration will be communicated through this verified mobile number and email ID.

Step 6: Get Registration Number and Pay Fees

Once the OTP is verified, you will receive a unique registration number.
Log in to your dashboard using this registration number and proceed to pay the registration fee online.

Step 7: Upload Required Documents

After the fee payment, upload the required documents — including academic certificates, photograph, and signature — in the specified format.

Step 8: Review and Final Submit

After uploading, review your entire application form carefully.
Once satisfied, click on Final Submit to complete your registration.
Finally, take a printout of the registration form and ensure that the QR code is clearly visible on the printed copy.

Note: Any registration without successful fee payment or missing QR code will be treated as invalid under the AKTU Management Quota 2025-26.

Why AKTU Management Quota 2025-26 Pre-Registration is Important

The online pre-registration system ensures transparency and accountability in the admission process under the AKTU Management Quota 2025-26.
It helps the university maintain accurate student data, verify eligibility, and streamline the enrollment process through its ERP (Enterprise Resource Planning) module.

Without pre-registration, even if a student has been admitted by a college, AKTU will not include them in the official enrollment record.

Official Statement from AKTU

The notification was issued by Mrs. Reena Singh, Registrar, AKTU, Lucknow.
It emphasizes that all pharmacy institutions affiliated with the university must ensure compliance with the online registration timeline.

Copies of this circular have been sent to:

  • Finance Officer, AKTU
  • Controller of Examinations, AKTU
  • Deputy Registrar (Enrollment), AKTU
  • ERP In-charge, AKTU
  • Staff Officer to Vice-Chancellor, AKTU

Key Highlights of AKTU Management Quota 2025-26

  • Applies only to B.Pharm and Pharm-D courses.
  • Registration is completely online via the ERP module.
  • Pre-registration is mandatory for all management quota students.
  • Incomplete or unpaid registrations will not be accepted.
  • Institutes must ensure compliance before October 30, 2025.

Common Mistakes to Avoid During AKTU Management Quota 2025-26 Registration

  1. Entering incorrect personal details (cannot be changed later).
  2. Skipping OTP verification — your registration will not be activated.
  3. Failure to pay the online fee — invalid registration.
  4. Missing document upload — leads to rejection.
  5. Not printing the form with a visible QR code.

title.rendered: AKTU Sports Fest 2025-26: Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University Announces State-Level Sports Event

content.rendered:
Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University (AKTU), Lucknow, has officially released the notification for the AKTU Sports Fest 2025-26. The university has confirmed that the State Level Dr. Abdul Kalam Sports Fest 2025-26 will take place on November 6 and 7, 2025, at Galgotias College of Engineering and Technology (GCET), Greater Noida.

The AKTU Sports Fest 2025-26 is one of the most awaited annual events organized by the university. It aims to promote sportsmanship, teamwork, and fitness among students from all AKTU-affiliated institutions across Uttar Pradesh. The event brings together the best athletes who have already proven their excellence at the zonal level.

Overview of AKTU Sports Fest 2025-26

The Dr. Abdul Kalam Sports Fest is organized every year in memory of India’s former President and renowned scientist, Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam. This annual festival provides a competitive yet healthy platform for students to demonstrate their physical strength, endurance, and team coordination.

The AKTU Sports Fest 2025-26 continues this legacy by offering students from across the state a chance to compete at a higher level, after qualifying through zonal events. It represents the culmination of talent and discipline that Dr. Kalam inspired in the youth of the nation.

Key Details at a Glance

AKTU Sports Fest 2025-26 Official Notification

According to the circular issued by Prof. O.P. Singh, Dean of Student Welfare (DSW), AKTU Lucknow, all affiliated colleges are directed to nominate their eligible students for the AKTU Sports Fest 2025-26. The event will be hosted at Galgotias College of Engineering and Technology, Greater Noida, which has been selected as the State Level Centre (Code: 097) for this session.

The circular mentions that only those students who have secured Gold Medals in the Zonal Level Sports Fest 2025-26 will be eligible to participate in the state-level competition. Participating colleges are required to complete the prescribed registration form and submit it to the host college before October 28, 2025.

Important Contact Details

The university has provided contact information for both the Director and the Coordinator of the AKTU Sports Fest 2025-26 to ensure smooth communication and event coordination.

Director (State Level Centre):

  • Name: Dr. Vikram Bali
  • Mobile: 9891372928
  • Email: director.097@aktu.ac.in, director@galgotiacollege.edu

Coordinator (Sports Fest):

  • Name: Dr. Pallavi Goel
  • Mobile: 8800494121

Institutions can reach out to these officials for any clarification related to the schedule, accommodation, reporting process, or participation confirmation.

About the Venue – Galgotias College of Engineering & Technology

The AKTU Sports Fest 2025-26 will be held at Galgotias College of Engineering & Technology (GCET), located in Knowledge Park-II, Greater Noida. Known for its world-class infrastructure and modern facilities, GCET is one of AKTU’s most reputed affiliated colleges.

The campus offers excellent sports amenities, open fields, and organized arrangements suitable for hosting a large-scale university-level sports fest. Its convenient location in Greater Noida also makes it accessible for participants traveling from various zones of Uttar Pradesh.

Eligibility and Registration for AKTU Sports Fest 2025-26

Participation in the AKTU Sports Fest 2025-26 is limited to students who have achieved the Gold Medal position in the Zonal Sports Fest held earlier this academic year.

To ensure fair representation, colleges must:

  1. Fill out the State Level Sports Fest Participation Form provided with the official AKTU circular.
  2. Submit the completed form to Galgotias College (Centre Code: 097) by October 28, 2025.
  3. Ensure all information is accurate, including event names, student details, and zonal performance records.
  4. Contact the organizing committee in case of any procedural clarification before the deadline.

Late or incomplete entries will not be entertained by the organizing centre.

Objectives of the AKTU Sports Fest 2025-26

The AKTU Sports Fest 2025-26 serves as a platform for students to showcase their physical abilities and teamwork while promoting the university’s focus on holistic development. The objectives of this event include:

  • Encouraging students to maintain physical health and fitness.
  • Promoting team spirit, cooperation, and sportsmanship.
  • Discovering and nurturing sporting talent across AKTU-affiliated colleges.
  • Providing a space for cultural and inter-college interaction.
  • Inspiring students through the values and vision of Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam — discipline, dedication, and innovation.

Through such events, AKTU aims to develop students who are not only academically strong but also mentally and physically resilient.

Instructions for AKTU-Affiliated Colleges

All affiliated colleges under AKTU are instructed to:

  • Inform eligible students (Gold Medal winners in zonal competitions) about the state-level event.
  • Facilitate their registration process and ensure timely submission of participation forms.
  • Coordinate with Galgotias College regarding accommodation and event logistics.
  • Verify student credentials and maintain discipline during the event.
  • Follow the event guidelines as shared by the Dean, Student Welfare Office.

Failure to comply with the deadlines and instructions may disqualify a college or student from participating in the event.

The Spirit of Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam and AKTU Sports Fest 2025-26

The AKTU Sports Fest 2025-26 is not just a competition but a tribute to Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam’s enduring legacy of youth empowerment and excellence. His belief that “great dreams of great dreamers are always transcended” resonates deeply with this event, where young minds channel their energy and determination toward success.

The fest encourages students to balance academics with sports, highlighting that leadership, discipline, and focus are essential qualities both on and off the field.

Why AKTU Sports Fest 2025-26 Matters

Sports play a vital role in shaping a student’s overall development. The AKTU Sports Fest 2025-26 is designed to nurture well-rounded individuals who can manage pressure, exhibit teamwork, and demonstrate perseverance.

Such initiatives by AKTU create a sense of pride and belonging among students and strengthen the bond between the university and its affiliated colleges. Over the years, AKTU’s commitment to promoting physical education has resulted in the rise of several outstanding athletes who have represented the university at state and national levels.

READ MORE : AKTU Notice 2025: Challenge Evaluation Process Extended for Final and Pre-Final Year Students

Conclusion

The AKTU Sports Fest 2025-26 is set to be one of the most exciting inter-college events of the year, offering students a stage to compete, collaborate, and celebrate the spirit of sportsmanship. Scheduled for November 6 and 7, 2025, at Galgotias College of Engineering & Technology, Greater Noida, the event promises a vibrant atmosphere filled with energy and enthusiasm.

All AKTU-affiliated colleges are urged to complete the necessary formalities and ensure the participation of their eligible students before the October 28, 2025 deadline. For any inquiries or updates, institutions can contact Dr. Vikram Bali or Dr. Pallavi Goel at the provided details.

The AKTU Sports Fest 2025-26 truly embodies Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam’s vision of empowering youth through education, innovation, and physical excellence.

For more AKTU updates, notices, and event news, stay connected with NotesGallery.com — your trusted platform for academic and university updates.

title.rendered: AKTU Notice 2025: Challenge Evaluation Process Extended for Final and Pre-Final Year Students

content.rendered:
Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University (AKTU), Lucknow, has released an important notification for students of the 2024–25 academic session. The notice, numbered Tech/Exam/2025/2256 and dated 18 October 2025, outlines the schedule and procedure for the regular evaluation of answer sheets for final and pre-final year students. This evaluation applies to students who appeared in the even semester examinations held between 17 May 2025 and 13 June 2025.

The circular emphasizes that the evaluation process is a routine academic provision, allowing students to request a re-evaluation of their answer scripts if they believe there might have been discrepancies in marking or totaling. AKTU has also announced an extension of the submission date for evaluation forms, which now stands at 26 October 2025 (Sunday). This extension offers students additional time to complete their applications and submit them through their respective colleges.

Courses and Semesters Eligible for Regular Evaluation

The university’s notice specifies which courses and semesters are covered under this regular evaluation process for the 2024–25 session. These include both undergraduate and postgraduate programs across various streams. The eligibility details are listed below:

Students from these programs who have taken their even semester exams are eligible to apply for the evaluation process. The re-evaluation gives them the opportunity to verify that their answer sheets were correctly checked and marks accurately recorded.

Important Links

Purpose of the Regular Evaluation Process

Every year, AKTU conducts the regular evaluation process to uphold academic fairness and transparency. The aim is to allow students to ensure their hard work is correctly reflected in their results. Unlike carry-over or supplementary examinations, this is not for failed students; rather, it’s for any student who wishes to confirm that their paper has been properly evaluated.

Through this initiative, the university continues its commitment to providing fair academic assessment and addressing student concerns efficiently. It also reinforces trust in the evaluation system, as every student gets a formal channel to request a

review without complications.

Eligibility and Application Procedure

Only those students who appeared in the even semester examinations held between May and June 2025 are eligible to apply for regular evaluation. The process must be initiated through the respective colleges, which will collect applications, verify them, and forward them to AKTU within the given timeframe.

Students are required to pay a fee of ₹300 per subject, as stated in the notice. Payment receipts must be attached along with the application form before submission. It is the responsibility of the college administration to check all details carefully before sending the compiled forms and answer copies to the university.

Incomplete applications or those submitted directly to the university without institutional verification will not be accepted. Hence, students are advised to coordinate with their colleges and ensure their paperwork is complete well before the last date.

Extended Date for Submission

To accommodate all affiliated colleges and students, AKTU has extended the last date for submission of regular evaluation forms and answer books. The updated schedule is provided below:

This extension provides a crucial opportunity for students who might have missed the initial deadline due to administrative delays. Colleges are advised to strictly adhere to the new date and ensure timely forwarding of all verified applications to the examination cell.

https://notesgallery.com/aktu-b-tech-4th-year-free-study-materials/    Fourth Year

Key Instructions for Students and Institutions

The notice highlights several important points that both students and colleges must follow. Students must ensure that all applications are filled accurately with proper subject codes and examination details. Colleges must upload the verified data to the university portal and maintain a physical record for audit purposes.

All communications related to the evaluation process will be handled through official university channels. The Controller of Examinations, Prof. Deepak Nagaria, will oversee the entire process to ensure compliance with university regulations and maintain fairness throughout the evaluation.

Why This Notice Matters for AKTU Students

The regular evaluation process is a crucial academic right for students who want to verify their examination results. It reflects AKTU’s transparent evaluation policy and its dedication to providing students with a fair chance to review their academic performance. Many students each year find the process helpful in identifying genuine marking errors or discrepancies in totaling, which can make a difference in their final grades.

For final and pre-final year students, this notice is especially significant. Since their results directly impact placements, internships, or postgraduate admissions, ensuring the accuracy of their marks is essential. By extending the deadline to 26 October 2025, AKTU has shown consideration for students who might have needed more time to prepare their applications.

What Students Should Do Next

Students should immediately visit their respective colleges, collect the evaluation form, and complete it with accurate details. After paying the ₹300 per subject fee, they should submit the filled form and payment proof to the college office. Colleges will then forward all verified applications to the university. It is advisable for students to keep a copy of the submitted form and acknowledgment receipt for their own records.

By taking prompt action, students can ensure they do not miss this opportunity. The extended last date should not be taken lightly, as applications submitted after 26 October 2025 will not be accepted under any circumstances.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

1. What is the AKTU notice issued on 18 October 2025 about?
It concerns the regular evaluation process for final and pre-final year students of the 2024–25 session who appeared in even semester exams held between May and June 2025.

2. Who is eligible to apply for the evaluation?
Students from eligible programs listed in the notice can apply through their colleges for the regular evaluation of their answer copies.

3. What is the last date for submission?
The extended last date for submission is 26 October 2025 (Sunday) till 5:00 p.m.

4. How much is the evaluation fee?
The evaluation fee is ₹300 per subject, as mentioned in the university’s official notification.

5. How can students apply for the process?
Applications must be submitted through the student’s college, with all documents and payment receipts attached before the final date.

title.rendered: AKTU Circular 2025: Submission of Reports on Atal Bihari Vajpayee Centenary Programs

content.rendered:
Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University (AKTU), Lucknow has issued a new circular (Letter No: AKTU/Innovation Hub/2025/454 dated 14/10/2025). This AKTU Circular 2025 is addressed to all Directors and Principals of the university’s affiliated institutions. The circular directs every college to submit details of the programs organized under the celebration of Bharat Ratna Shri Atal Bihari Vajpayee Ji’s Centenary Year.

AKTU has asked all affiliated colleges to upload a complete report including photographs and video clips of the events held between August 25, 2025, and September 24, 2025, on the official portal before October 17, 2025.

Objective of AKTU Circular 2025

The objective of the AKTU Circular 2025 is to encourage all institutions to celebrate the centenary year of Atal Bihari Vajpayee Ji by conducting innovative, academic, and cultural activities. These programs aim to promote innovation, creativity, and social engagement among students. The university’s Innovation and Social Entrepreneurship Cell has been guiding colleges in organizing such events throughout the year.

By collecting and compiling reports from every institution, AKTU aims to prepare a consolidated university-level report highlighting student participation, innovation, and social initiatives conducted in the honor of the late Prime Minister Atal Bihari Vajpayee.

Background and Previous Instructions

The AKTU Circular 2025 continues the series of earlier communications released by the university regarding the centenary celebrations. Previous circulars include:

  • Circular No. 5359 dated 18.12.2024
  • Circular No. 5645 dated 15.01.2025
  • Circular No. 5706 dated 22.01.2025
  • Circular No. 6264 dated 25.03.2025
  • Circular No. 6769 dated 12.06.2025
  • Circular No. 7844 dated 05.08.2025
  • Circular No. 8171 dated 15.09.2025

All of these circulars directed affiliated colleges to organize innovation-driven and research-based programs that reflect the vision and ideals of Bharat Ratna Atal Bihari Vajpayee Ji. The new AKTU Circular 2025 focuses on collecting and submitting the summary and documentation of those activities.

Activities Covered Under the Centenary Celebration

According to the AKTU Circular 2025, colleges were instructed to organize and document various programs between August 25, 2025, and September 24, 2025. These include:

  1. Innovation and Research Promotion Activities – Workshops, research exhibitions, and idea presentations to promote innovation among students.
  2. Student Project and Model Exhibitions – Display of technical models, creative projects, and innovative prototypes designed by students.
  3. Educational and Cultural Activities – Seminars, essay competitions, and events to celebrate the leadership, vision, and contributions of Atal Bihari Vajpayee Ji.

These activities aim to create awareness about innovation and inspire students to follow the leadership and values of Shri Vajpayee Ji.

Submission Link and Deadline

As per the AKTU Circular 2025, all affiliated institutions are required to upload their event details, photos, and videos using the following submission link or QR code:

Official Upload Link: https://shorturl.at/Nt5.JT

Submission Deadline: October 17, 2025

Colleges must ensure that all details are accurate and complete before uploading, as the university will compile the submissions to create a unified report for the entire state.

Institutions Required to Comply

This directive is mandatory for all colleges affiliated with AKTU, including engineering, management, pharmacy, and architecture institutions.

Every Director or Principal must verify that:

  • The report is complete with event details, photos, and video clips.
  • The submission includes the correct institute name and code.
  • The report highlights the objectives, outcomes, and participation levels of the organized events.

Failure to submit the required information before the deadline may result in the exclusion of the institution’s name from the official university report.

Purpose Behind the AKTU Circular 2025

The AKTU Circular 2025 represents the university’s commitment to promoting research, innovation, and cultural development in technical education. The key purposes include:

  • Encouraging creativity and practical learning among students.
  • Honoring the values and vision of Bharat Ratna Atal Bihari Vajpayee Ji.
  • Preparing a university-level report summarizing all academic and social initiatives.
  • Promoting student engagement through innovation and social entrepreneurship.

AKTU believes that such initiatives not only enrich the academic culture but also foster leadership and innovation among students.

Issued By

The AKTU Circular 2025 has been issued by:

Prof. Bhartendu Nath Mishra
Dean, Innovation & Social Entrepreneurship
Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University, Lucknow

Copies of this circular have also been sent to:

title.rendered: AKTU PMSSS Quota 2025 Notice: Colleges Must Submit Student Details by 15th October 2025 (Government Nominee Admissions Excluding B.Pharm)

content.rendered:
Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University (AKTU), Lucknow has released an official notice for all affiliated colleges regarding students admitted under the AKTU PMSSS Quota 2025 and Government Nominee category. According to the university circular (Letter No. AKTU/Enrollment-35/2025/8562 dated 13-10-2025), all institutions are required to submit the details of students admitted through PMSSS (Prime Minister’s Special Scholarship Scheme) or Government Nominee quota for the academic session 2025-26, excluding B.Pharm courses.

This notice emphasizes that the complete list of such students must be prepared in a certified Excel sheet and sent to the official university email address enrollment.helpline@aktu.ac.in before 15th October 2025.

About the AKTU PMSSS Quota 2025 Notice

University Name: Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University, Uttar Pradesh, Lucknow
Letter Number: ए०के०टी०यू०/नामांकन-35/2025/8562
Issued Date: 13 October 2025
Issued By: Dr. D.P. Singh, Deputy Registrar (उप कुलसचिव)
Subject: Submission of details of students admitted through PMSSS Quota / Government Nominee (except B.Pharm).

The AKTU PMSSS Quota 2025 notice is mandatory for all affiliated institutions. The university is collecting student data to maintain accurate enrollment records for candidates admitted through special government channels.

What Colleges Need to Do Under AKTU PMSSS Quota 2025

The notice directs all AKTU-affiliated colleges to follow these steps:

  1. Prepare a complete list of newly admitted students under PMSSS Quota or Government Nominee for the 2025-26 session.
  2. Do not include any B.Pharm students, as the notice explicitly excludes this program.
  3. Use the official Excel format provided by AKTU.
  4. Get the list certified by the Director/Principal of the institute.
  5. Email the verified list to enrollment.helpline@aktu.ac.in before 15th October 2025.

The university will verify these details to ensure that every student admitted under AKTU PMSSS Quota 2025 is properly enrolled and recognized by the university.

Important Deadlines for AKTU PMSSS Quota 2025

Colleges must strictly follow the deadline mentioned in the AKTU PMSSS Quota 2025 notice to avoid delays or discrepancies in student enrollment records.

Email Format for Submission (AKTU PMSSS Quota 2025)

To ensure smooth submission, institutions should use a clear and professional email format as shown below:

Subject: PMSSS Quota Admission Details – [Institute Name] – Session 2025-26

Body Example:

Dear Sir/Madam,

Please find attached the certified Excel sheet containing details of students admitted under PMSSS / Government Nominee Quota (except B.Pharm) for the academic year 2025-26 from our institute.

Regards,
[Institute Name]
[Director’s Name]
[Contact Information]

Attachment: Excel Sheet (signed and verified by the Director/Principal)

This process will help AKTU easily verify the information submitted under the AKTU PMSSS Quota 2025 scheme.

Understanding PMSSS Quota

The PMSSS (Prime Minister’s Special Scholarship Scheme) is a central government initiative aimed at providing scholarships to meritorious students from Jammu & Kashmir and Ladakh. These students are given the opportunity to pursue higher education across India through a special admission quota.

Under the AKTU PMSSS Quota 2025, such students are enrolled in technical and professional courses at affiliated colleges of AKTU. The university requires colleges to report these admissions officially to maintain proper records, verify enrollment data, and ensure that the scholarship process runs smoothly.

Why the AKTU PMSSS Quota 2025 Notice Matters

This notice is crucial for colleges and students because it ensures:

✅ Proper enrollment of PMSSS and Government Nominee students in AKTU’s records.
✅ Transparency in the admission process.
✅ Avoidance of future issues in student verification, examination forms, and result processing.
✅ Smooth coordination between AKTU, AICTE, and state authorities managing PMSSS scholarships.

Every institution must strictly adhere to the AKTU PMSSS Quota 2025 guidelines to ensure there are no administrative issues later.

Suggested Columns for Excel Sheet (for Reference)

Although the official format is attached with the circular, here’s a suggested layout for colleges preparing their list under the AKTU PMSSS Quota 2025:

Institutions should double-check all data before submission and ensure it is certified properly.

Copy of Notice Sent To

  • The Registrar, AKTU, Lucknow
  • Finance Officer, AKTU, Lucknow
  • Controller of Examination, AKTU, Lucknow
  • ERP In-charge, AKTU, Lucknow

Responsibilities of Institutions

To comply with the AKTU PMSSS Quota 2025 notice, institutions must:

  • Collect accurate student details (name, course, quota type, etc.).
  • Verify each student’s admission letter or document under PMSSS or Government Nominee category.
  • Prepare the Excel file in the correct format.
  • Get it signed and stamped by the Principal or Director.
  • Send it to the designated email before the due date.

Failing to send the data by 15th October 2025 may result in administrative delays in enrollment confirmation or record updates.

Summary of AKTU PMSSS Quota 2025 Notice

The AKTU PMSSS Quota 2025 circular clearly highlights that:

  • Data submission is mandatory for all affiliated colleges.
  • B.Pharm students are excluded from this notice.
  • The deadline for submission is 15th October 2025.
  • The official submission email is enrollment.helpline@aktu.ac.in.
  • Colleges must ensure certification and accuracy before submission.

Key Points to Remember

  • Always use the official Excel format shared by AKTU.
  • Include all students under PMSSS or Government Nominee category only.
  • Double-check the email address before sending.
  • Submit before the final deadline — no extension is mentioned in the circular.

By following these guidelines, colleges can ensure compliance with the AKTU PMSSS Quota 2025 requirements and avoid any enrollment-related issues later in the semester.

Conclusion

The AKTU PMSSS Quota 2025 notice is a crucial step to ensure that all government-sponsored and PMSSS students are correctly recorded in the university’s database. Colleges affiliated with AKTU must act promptly and submit their verified student lists to enrollment.helpline@aktu.ac.in by 15th October 2025.

This process strengthens transparency, ensures accurate enrollment data, and supports the successful implementation of the Prime Minister’s Special Scholarship Scheme under AKTU Lucknow.
