title.rendered: Reliance Industries Limited GET Program 2026 – Apply Now for Engineering Graduates (Full Details)

content.rendered:
The Reliance Industries Limited GET Program 2026 is one of the most awaited career opportunities for engineering students in India. Every year, Reliance Industries Limited (RIL) recruits top engineering talent through this program and provides them with hands-on technical exposure, leadership training, and career growth opportunities.

If you are a final-year B.Tech/B.E. student graduating in 2026, this is your golden ticket to begin your career with India’s largest private sector company — Reliance Industries Limited. Through the Graduate Engineer Trainee (GET) Program, RIL aims to shape young engineers into future leaders capable of managing world-class industrial projects.

About Reliance Industries Limited

Reliance Industries Limited (RIL) is India’s most valuable private sector company, with operations spanning across oil & gas exploration, refining, petrochemicals, new energy, retail, and digital services.

For the financial year ending March 31, 2025, Reliance recorded:

  • Revenue: ₹1,071,174 Crore (US$125.3 Billion)
  • Net Profit: ₹81,309 Crore (US$9.5 Billion)
  • Global Rankings:
    • 45th in Forbes Global 2000 (2025)
    • 88th in Fortune Global 500 (2025)
    • Recognized in TIME100 Most Influential Companies (2024)

With innovation at its core, Reliance Industries continues to lead India’s transition towards a sustainable and digital future.

About the RIL Graduate Engineer Trainee (GET) Program 2026

The Reliance Industries Limited GET Program 2026 is a one-year, structured training and development initiative aimed at grooming fresh engineering graduates into high-performing professionals. It combines technical learning, on-the-job exposure, mentorship, and leadership skill development.

Through this program, trainees will:
✅ Gain hands-on experience in real-time industrial projects
✅ Learn discipline-specific and cross-functional skills
✅ Undergo technical and behavioral training sessions
✅ Receive mentorship from senior industry experts

This program acts as a launchpad for students who wish to grow into technical experts, project leaders, or managerial professionals within the Reliance ecosystem.

Eligibility Criteria for Reliance Industries Limited GET Program 2026

To apply for the Reliance Industries Limited GET Program 2026, candidates must fulfill the following eligibility conditions:

  • Qualification: Final-year full-time B.Tech/B.E. students (graduating in 2026)
  • Approved Colleges: Must be from AICTE-approved institutions
  • Eligible Branches:
    • Chemical Engineering
    • Mechanical Engineering
    • Electrical Engineering
    • Civil Engineering
    • Fire Engineering
    • Metallurgical Engineering
    • Instrumentation Engineering
  • Minimum Academic Score: 60% or 6.0 CGPA in 10th, 12th, Diploma (if any), and in engineering (up to latest semester)
  • No Backlogs: Active backlogs or academic detentions are not allowed
  • Education Gap: Maximum of 3 years allowed between courses
  • Citizenship: Must be a resident of India

If you meet these criteria, you are eligible to apply for the Reliance Industries Limited GET Program 2026 and begin your professional journey with RIL.

Important Dates and Recruitment Process

The selection process for the Reliance Industries Limited GET Program 2026 is highly competitive and includes multiple stages.

🕒 Last Date to Apply: 15 October 2025
🧠 Assessment Date: 29 October 2025

Candidates shortlisted from the assessment stage will be invited for physical interviews at one of the designated RIL centers across India.

Salary and Benefits

The Reliance Industries Limited GET Program 2026 offers an impressive compensation package:

  • 💰 ₹7.5 LPA – for candidates from non-IIT colleges
  • 💰 ₹9 LPA – for candidates from IITs

In addition to this, GETs receive multiple benefits:

  • Training in world-class facilities
  • Mentorship under senior professionals
  • Exposure to Reliance’s diverse business sectors
  • Opportunities for fast-track growth and international assignments

Possible Posting Locations

GETs under the Reliance Industries Limited GET Program 2026 can be posted at any of the company’s industrial sites across India, including:

🏭 Jamnagar, Hazira, Dahej, Nagothane, Vadodara, Patalganga, Silvassa, Barabanki, and Hoshiarpur.

These are some of the largest integrated industrial complexes in the world, providing excellent exposure and learning opportunities.

Departments Offering GET Opportunities

The Reliance Industries Limited GET Program 2026 opens pathways to multiple technical divisions within RIL, such as:

  • Reliance Project Management Group (RPMG): Managing large-scale capital investments and industrial projects.
  • Oil & Gas Exploration Division: Working on deep-sea exploration projects like KG D6 Block.
  • Procurement & Contracting (P&C): Streamlining material procurement and vendor operations.
  • Reliance New Energy Division: Contributing to RIL’s mission of achieving Net Zero Carbon by 2035.
  • Reliance Bioenergy: Driving innovation in sustainable energy solutions.

How to Apply for Reliance Industries Limited GET Program 2026

Follow these steps to successfully apply:

  1. Visit the official Unstop Job Page or RIL Careers Portal.
  2. Click on “Apply Now” and complete your registration with accurate academic and personal details.
  3. Submit your application before 15 October 2025.
  4. Wait for the screening result by the RIL recruitment team.
  5. If shortlisted, appear for the online assessment test on 29 October 2025.
  6. Finally, attend the in-person interviews scheduled for December 2025.

⚠️ Tip: Double-check all entered details, as incorrect information may lead to disqualification.

Why Join Reliance Industries Limited as a GET?

Joining the Reliance Industries Limited GET Program 2026 means becoming part of India’s largest and most innovative industrial ecosystem.

Here’s why it’s a dream opportunity for many engineers:

  • Hands-on exposure to industrial-scale operations
  • Opportunity to work on energy transition and green technologies
  • Professional growth through training and mentorship
  • Strong brand recognition across industries
  • Competitive salary and long-term career development

Reliance doesn’t just offer a job — it offers a career built on innovation, excellence, and impact.

FAQs — Reliance Industries Limited GET Program 2026

Q1. What is the salary for GET 2026?
A1. ₹7.5 LPA for Non-IIT and ₹9 LPA for IIT candidates.

Q2. Is there any fee to apply?
A2. No, the Reliance Industries Limited GET Program 2026 has no application fee.

Q3. Can Electronics and Communication engineers apply?
A3. No, only students from Chemical, Mechanical, Electrical, Civil, Fire, Metallurgical, and Instrumentation are eligible.

Q4. Are backlogs allowed?
A4. No. Students with active backlogs or academic detentions are not eligible.

Q5. What is the last date to apply?
A5. The last date to apply for the Reliance Industries Limited GET Program 2026 is 15 October 2025.

Final Thoughts

The Reliance Industries Limited GET Program 2026 is a career-defining opportunity for aspiring engineers. With its strong technical exposure, high salary package, and association with one of India’s most trusted brands, it sets the stage for a successful engineering career.

Don’t miss the deadline — apply before 15 October 2025 and start your journey with Reliance Industries Limited, a company that shapes India’s industrial future.

title.rendered: LinkedIn for Students: Why Starting Early Can Transform Your Career in 2025

content.rendered:
Are you a class 11th or 12th student or just beginning your college journey? Do you think LinkedIn is something you should use later when you have achievements to show? If that sounds familiar, you’re not alone. Many students delay creating a LinkedIn profile because they feel they have nothing special to post or achieve yet. But this delay can cost you valuable opportunities.

The truth is simple — those who start using LinkedIn for Students early gain a massive advantage over those who wait. Whether you are in school or college, LinkedIn can open doors to internships, mentorships, and even job offers. In today’s competitive world, learning how to use LinkedIn effectively is one of the smartest moves a student can make.

Why LinkedIn for Students Matters in 2025

LinkedIn is no longer just a platform for professionals or job seekers; it has become a space where students can learn, connect, and grow. When used correctly, LinkedIn for Students can help you:

  • Build your personal brand online
  • Connect with mentors, alumni, and industry leaders
  • Discover internships and online courses
  • Learn about new career paths and skills
  • Get noticed by recruiters and companies early

In short, it’s your professional identity online. While others waste hours scrolling on Instagram or Snapchat, students who use LinkedIn wisely build credibility and visibility that directly impact their careers.

The Common Mistake: Waiting Too Long to Start

Many college students regret not starting early on LinkedIn. They assume they need achievements, internships, or certifications to begin. But the biggest mistake is waiting.

Take the story of Swati, a B.Com student from Delhi University. She started using LinkedIn only in her second year because she thought she had nothing to post. But once she started, her very first two posts gained over 12,000 impressions and helped her connect with professionals from across India and abroad. Her only regret was not starting earlier.

That’s what LinkedIn for Students teaches you — you don’t need perfection to start; you need consistency and courage. Every small post, every comment, and every new connection adds value to your professional journey.

Step-by-Step Guide to Build Your LinkedIn Profile

Your LinkedIn for Students profile is your digital resume. It shows the world who you are and what you’re learning. Here’s how you can make a strong profile that stands out:

1. Choose a Clear and Confident Profile Picture

Your picture creates the first impression. Use a bright, clear photo where your face is visible. It doesn’t have to be a studio photo — a neat selfie with good lighting works fine.

2. Add a Meaningful Banner

Your banner (background image) should reflect your interests or aspirations. You can use a simple background, a quote, or a photo related to your field, such as coding, books, or business.

3. Write a Short and Powerful Bio

Your bio tells people who you are and what you’re passionate about. Example:
“Class 12 Student | Exploring Opportunities in Finance and Marketing | Passionate About Learning New Skills.”
This short line instantly tells others what you’re curious about.

4. Highlight Education, Experience, and Certificates

Add your school or college, any internships, or even small volunteer experiences. You can also upload certificates from free government platforms like AICTE, SWAYAM, or NPTEL. These show your eagerness to learn and grow.

5. Add Skills and Interests

Mention skills like communication, leadership, public speaking, Excel, Python, or content writing — anything you’ve practiced or want to improve. Recruiters and mentors often search for students based on these skills.

A complete and professional-looking profile increases your visibility and helps you appear in search results. That’s the first step to mastering LinkedIn for Students.

How to Communicate Professionally on LinkedIn

One major advantage of using LinkedIn for Students is that it teaches you professional communication. When you message or comment, remember — LinkedIn is not Instagram. Keep your tone polite and clear.

Here’s how you can start a message:

“Hello [Name], I’m a first-year student exploring opportunities in [Field]. I came across your profile and found your journey inspiring. Could you please share how I can get started in this domain?”

If you’re unsure how to write such messages, you can use AI tools like ChatGPT to draft them. The goal is to sound respectful, curious, and professional.

The “I Will Go First” Rule

Students often hesitate to message seniors, talk to teachers, or post something online. But success on LinkedIn depends on initiative. The best philosophy for students is — “I will go first.”

Whether it’s starting a conversation in class, asking a senior about internships, or commenting on a post — go first. That small step can lead to new connections, mentors, or even career guidance. As Swati shared in her experience, she connected with an international creator just because she had the courage to text first.

On LinkedIn for Students, initiative always pays off.

Using LinkedIn as a Learning Platform

LinkedIn isn’t just for networking; it’s a goldmine for learning. When you use LinkedIn for Students, don’t treat it like Instagram. Instead of scrolling aimlessly, focus on reading posts, articles, and discussions.

Follow people who share insights about careers, skills, and industries you’re interested in. Read their posts and learn how they reached where they are. You can also follow pages like AICTE, NPTEL, Microsoft Learn, or Google Students to stay updated with skill-building opportunities.

Spending just 15 minutes a day on LinkedIn can teach you more about real-world careers than any textbook.

What to Post on LinkedIn as a Student

The question most beginners ask is, “What should I post on LinkedIn?” The answer is — post your journey. Authenticity works better than perfection.

Here are some ideas for your first few posts:

  • A short introduction about yourself and your goals.
  • Something new you learned recently — a course, video, or article.
  • A reflection on your college event or project experience.
  • Achievements — even small wins like completing an online course.
  • A quote or lesson that inspired you.

Use simple language and add an image or infographic if possible. Visual posts attract more engagement. Over time, your activity will show that you’re serious about your personal and professional growth.

That’s exactly how LinkedIn for Students helps you stand out in the crowd.

How to Network and Find Referrals

Networking is the foundation of success on LinkedIn. The main goal of LinkedIn for Students is to help you connect with people who can guide and inspire you.

Here’s how you can start building your network:

  1. Search for alumni from your school or college.
  2. Connect with people working in the field you’re interested in.
  3. Follow recruiters, company pages, and student communities.
  4. Comment meaningfully on others’ posts.
  5. Always send a short personalized note when connecting.

Many students get internship or job referrals simply because they built genuine relationships through LinkedIn. Remember, networking is about learning and helping — not begging for favors.

The Power of Engagement

Before posting your own content, engage with others. Like, comment, and share meaningful posts. When you interact, your name starts appearing in feeds, and the algorithm promotes your profile.

Even 10 minutes of daily engagement can improve your visibility. That’s why LinkedIn for Students is such a powerful tool — it rewards consistent learners.

Benefits of Starting Early on LinkedIn

Starting early gives you a head start in your career journey. Here’s what you gain by building your LinkedIn for Students profile now:

By the time others start using LinkedIn in their final year, you’ll already have a polished profile, a valuable network, and real opportunities waiting for you.

Final Thoughts

The best time to start using LinkedIn for Students is today. You don’t need to wait until you have a degree, a certificate, or an internship. Every big opportunity starts with one small step — creating your profile and engaging with people.

LinkedIn can’t guarantee success, but it can give you access — access to knowledge, people, and opportunities that can shape your entire career. It’s not about competition or comparison; it’s about growth.

So, take that first step. Open LinkedIn, upload your picture, write your bio, and start connecting. One day, you’ll look back and thank yourself for starting early. Because LinkedIn for Students is not just a platform — it’s your launchpad to success.

title.rendered: AKTU Enrollment Form 2025 Extended: New Last Date, Verification Schedule, and Full Details

content.rendered:
Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University (AKTU), Lucknow has officially extended the last date for filling the AKTU Enrollment Form 2025 for newly admitted students of session 2025–26.

According to the latest circular issued by the university — Letter No: AKTU/KUSO-KA/Namankan 35-3/2025/8560 dated October 10, 2025, students can now fill their AKTU Enrollment Form 2025 up to October 25, 2025.

This circular was signed and released by Dr. D.P. Singh, Deputy Registrar, AKTU Lucknow, following approval from the competent authorities.

AKTU Enrollment Form 2025 – Important Dates (Revised Schedule)

The university took this decision to provide sufficient time to all colleges and students who faced delays in completing the enrollment process due to technical or documentation issues.

What is AKTU Enrollment Form 2025?

The AKTU Enrollment Form 2025 is an official registration process conducted by Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University for all newly admitted students in the academic session 2025–26.

Filling out the enrollment form on the AKTU ERP Portal (https://erp.aktu.ac.in) is mandatory for every student. Only after completing the enrollment process, students become officially recognized under AKTU’s academic database, allowing them to:

  • Appear in semester examinations
  • Receive official admit cards
  • Access academic records
  • Apply for scholarships or university-level schemes

Hence, completing the AKTU Enrollment Form 2025 is the very first and most crucial step after taking admission to any AKTU-affiliated college.

Why AKTU Extended the Enrollment Form Date

Many institutions and students requested AKTU to extend the enrollment deadline due to several valid reasons such as:

  • Technical glitches in the ERP system
  • Delayed admission confirmations
  • Incomplete document verification at the college level
  • Students joining late due to counseling rounds

Considering these issues, the university administration approved the extension to October 25, 2025, for form submission and November 5, 2025, for verification.

This extension ensures that no eligible student is left out of the enrollment process and that all institutes can verify student data properly.

Step-by-Step Process to Fill AKTU Enrollment Form 2025

Students must carefully follow the steps below to successfully fill and verify their AKTU Enrollment Form 2025:

Step 1: Visit the Official Portal

Go to the official AKTU ERP Portal at https://erp.aktu.ac.in

Step 2: Login or Register

Use your credentials provided by the college. If you are a new student, your college will provide the login ID and password for ERP access.

Step 3: Fill in Personal Details

Enter your full name, date of birth, category, gender, and contact details. Ensure that all information matches your high school or equivalent certificate.

Step 4: Academic Information

Fill in your previous qualification details such as 10th, 12th, Diploma, or any other qualifying examination information.

Step 5: Upload Required Documents

Scan and upload the following documents clearly:

  • Class 10 and 12 Marksheet
  • Transfer or Migration Certificate
  • Admission Letter
  • Aadhar Card
  • Passport-size Photograph
  • Signature

Step 6: Verify and Submit

Double-check all details and submit the form. Once submitted, take a printout of the acknowledgment for your reference.

Step 7: College Verification

After submission, the college administration will verify your form between October 26 and November 5, 2025.
Make sure to contact your college to confirm the verification status.

Who Issued the AKTU Circular

The circular regarding the AKTU Enrollment Form 2025 date extension was issued by:
Dr. D.P. Singh, Deputy Registrar (Enrollment Section),
Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University, Lucknow.

Copies of the notice were also sent to:

  • Registrar, AKTU Lucknow
  • Finance Officer, AKTU
  • Controller of Examination
  • ERP In-charge
  • Vice-Chancellor’s Office (for information)

This confirms that the notice is officially approved and applicable to all AKTU-affiliated colleges across Uttar Pradesh.

Importance of AKTU Enrollment Form 2025

Many new students often overlook the importance of completing the enrollment form on time. Here’s why it matters:

  1. Official University Registration:
    Without enrollment, you won’t appear in the AKTU university database.
  2. Exam Eligibility:
    Only enrolled students can fill out semester exam forms and receive admit cards.
  3. Scholarship and Fees Benefits:
    Enrollment is necessary to apply for government scholarships or university-based schemes.
  4. Record Maintenance:
    AKTU uses ERP data to maintain student performance records and results.
  5. Identity Validation:
    Enrollment confirms that you are officially admitted under AKTU for the given course and session.

Common Mistakes to Avoid While Filling AKTU Enrollment Form 2025

  • Entering incorrect personal details or spellings
  • Uploading blurred or incorrect documents
  • Forgetting to get the form verified by the college
  • Missing the deadline (25 October 2025)
  • Using unofficial links other than the ERP portal

Avoiding these mistakes ensures your enrollment is approved without rejection or delay.

AKTU Official Notification Highlights

“As per the competent authority’s approval, the last date for filling the AKTU Enrollment Form 2025 is extended up to October 25, 2025, and the verification process will be conducted from October 26, 2025 to November 5, 2025.”
— (Dr. D.P. Singh, Deputy Registrar, AKTU Lucknow)

Expert Tip for Students

After completing your enrollment, regularly check your ERP dashboard for updates on:

  • Fee payment receipts
  • Internal marks submission
  • Examination form opening dates
  • Admit card releases

Being proactive helps avoid last-minute issues during exams.

Key Details at a Glance

READ MORE : AKTU Official Notice: Regarding AKTU Dashmottar Scholarship 2025

Conclusion

The AKTU Enrollment Form 2025 is a vital process that every newly admitted student must complete. With the university extending the last date to October 25, 2025, students now have extra time to submit and verify their forms properly.

Students are advised not to wait until the last day. Log in to the AKTU ERP portal, complete your enrollment, and get it verified by your college before November 5, 2025. Failure to complete this process on time may prevent you from appearing in semester exams or accessing university facilities.

title.rendered: AKTU Official Notice: Regarding AKTU Dashmottar Scholarship 2025

content.rendered:
Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University (AKTU), Lucknow has officially issued a notice regarding the AKTU Dashmottar Scholarship 2025 for all affiliated colleges and institutes in Uttar Pradesh. This scholarship aims to provide financial support and fee reimbursement to students belonging to all deprived sections under the Dashmottar Scholarship Scheme 2024-25.

The AKTU Dashmottar Scholarship 2025 portal has now been opened for all eligible students, as per the schedule released by the Uttar Pradesh Government and the Social Welfare Department. This step ensures that every deserving student pursuing higher education in AKTU-affiliated colleges can receive timely scholarship benefits and fee reimbursements.

Objective of AKTU Dashmottar Scholarship 2025

The main goal of the AKTU Dashmottar Scholarship 2025 is to help financially weaker students from various categories — including SC, ST, OBC, Minority, and General (Economically Weaker Sections) — continue their studies without any financial burden.

Through this scholarship, students studying in post-matric classes (after class 10) under AKTU-affiliated institutions can apply for fee reimbursement and academic allowance directly through the government portal.

Official Notification Details

As per the official circular issued by AKTU (Letter No. AKTU/KUSO/Scholarship/2025/8546 dated 10 October 2025), the University has instructed all affiliated institutions to strictly follow the schedule released by the Uttar Pradesh Social Welfare Department (Letter No. 160/2025/2690/26-3-2025 dated 06 October 2025).

The circular was signed by Reena Singh, Registrar of AKTU, directing all college directors and principals to ensure timely completion of all activities related to the AKTU Dashmottar Scholarship 2025 process.

Important Dates and Schedule (2024–25 Session)

Below is the official schedule for all key activities related to the AKTU Dashmottar Scholarship 2025 process:

All students are advised to complete their scholarship applications and verifications strictly within these dates to avoid rejection.

How to Apply for AKTU Dashmottar Scholarship 2025

Follow the below steps to apply for the AKTU Dashmottar Scholarship 2025:

  1. Visit the Official Website – Go to scholarship.up.gov.in.
  2. New Registration – Click on Student → Registration → Post Matric (Within State).
  3. Select Category – Choose your respective category (SC/ST/OBC/Minority/General).
  4. Fill the Form – Enter your personal, academic, and bank details carefully.
  5. Upload Documents – Upload required documents in the given format.
  6. Submit Form – After verifying all details, submit the form online.
  7. Take Printout – Download and print the final submitted application.
  8. Submit to College – Attach required documents and submit the hard copy to your institute before the deadline.

Documents Required for AKTU Dashmottar Scholarship 2025

Students applying for the AKTU Dashmottar Scholarship 2025 need to attach the following documents:

  • Aadhaar Card of Student
  • Caste Certificate (if applicable)
  • Income Certificate (valid within 6 months)
  • Residence Certificate
  • Last Year’s Marksheet
  • Fee Receipt / Admission Slip
  • Bank Passbook (with Aadhaar linked account)
  • Passport-size Photo

Make sure all documents are clear, valid, and uploaded in the correct size and format.

Eligibility Criteria

To be eligible for the AKTU Dashmottar Scholarship 2025, students must fulfill the following conditions:

  • Must be a permanent resident of Uttar Pradesh.
  • Must be studying in a recognized AKTU-affiliated institution.
  • Annual family income should be within the prescribed limits:
    • SC/ST: ₹2,50,000
    • OBC/Minority/General (EWS): ₹2,00,000
  • Should not be availing any other major government scholarship simultaneously.
  • Must have passed previous year examinations with required attendance and performance.

Important Instructions

  • Students must ensure that their Aadhaar is linked to their bank account for successful PFMS payment.
  • Applications with incomplete or incorrect details will be rejected automatically.
  • Colleges must verify and forward all applications by the specified date to avoid delay in fund disbursement.
  • University officials and district welfare officers will verify details digitally using online signatures.
  • Students should check their status regularly on the portal after submission.

Benefits of AKTU Dashmottar Scholarship 2025

The AKTU Dashmottar Scholarship 2025 provides two major financial aids:

  1. Tuition Fee Reimbursement – Based on the actual course fee verified by the university.
  2. Maintenance Allowance (Hostel/Day Scholar) – For daily expenses of eligible students.

This helps in reducing the financial burden on students and promotes equal educational opportunities.

Official Authorities and Verification

According to the notification, the AKTU Dashmottar Scholarship 2025 process will be monitored by:

  • Director, Social Welfare Department, UP
  • District Social Welfare Officers
  • Registrar, AKTU Lucknow (Reena Singh)
  • NIC State Unit, Lucknow

The final fund transfer will be processed through the PFMS (Public Financial Management System) directly into students’ Aadhaar-linked bank accounts.

Conclusion

The AKTU Dashmottar Scholarship 2025 is a crucial opportunity for students from economically weaker and deprived backgrounds to continue their education without worrying about tuition fees or other financial constraints.

All AKTU-affiliated colleges are directed to ensure timely completion of the verification and submission process. Students are strongly advised to apply before 31 October 2025 and keep checking the portal for updates.

By following the correct steps and deadlines, students can easily benefit from this initiative and focus on their academic success.

READ MORE : AKTU CORS User Registration 2025: Official Notice for All Affiliated Colleges

FAQs – AKTU Dashmottar Scholarship 2025

Q1. When will the AKTU Dashmottar Scholarship 2025 portal open?
The portal is open from 27 October 2025 for all eligible students.

Q2. What is the last date to apply?
The last date for online submission is 31 October 2025.

Q3. Can General Category (EWS) students apply?
Yes, students under the Economically Weaker Section (EWS) can apply under this scheme.

Q4. How will students receive their scholarship amount?
The amount will be directly credited to the Aadhaar-linked bank account via PFMS.

Q5. Where can I check my application status?
You can check the status on scholarship.up.gov.in using your registration number and date of birth.

title.rendered: AKTU CORS User Registration 2025: Official Notice for All Affiliated Colleges

content.rendered:
Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University (AKTU), Lucknow, has officially released a new circular regarding AKTU CORS User Registration 2025.
This important notification (Letter No. AKTU/KUS.KA./Sth./2025/8556, dated 10 October 2025) directs all affiliated institutes to complete their CORS (Continuously Operating Reference Station) user registration as per the instructions of the Survey of India, Lucknow Directorate.

The AKTU CORS User Registration 2025 aims to promote the use of modern geospatial technology in academics, research, and infrastructure projects. This initiative will connect AKTU institutes to India’s national geospatial data network for enhanced precision, collaboration, and innovation.

What is CORS and Why It Matters

CORS stands for Continuously Operating Reference Station — a high-tech geospatial infrastructure established by the Survey of India (SOI).
It provides real-time GNSS (Global Navigation Satellite System) data with centimeter-level accuracy, enabling highly precise surveying and mapping activities.

The AKTU CORS User Registration 2025 will allow AKTU-affiliated colleges to utilize this technology in fields such as:

  • Civil Engineering and Structural Design
  • Urban and Rural Planning
  • Agricultural Mapping and Soil Analysis
  • Environmental Research
  • Disaster Management
  • Construction and Infrastructure Development

By connecting to the CORS network, institutes can directly access India’s national reference framework for accurate and unified geospatial data.

Purpose of the AKTU CORS User Registration 2025 Circular

The AKTU CORS User Registration 2025 circular emphasizes the need for registration to access the benefits of the CORS network.
It refers to the official letter from the Survey of India (Letter No. TA-3388/39-C (CORS) dated 25.09.2025), highlighting that CORS data enhances GNSS-based measurements, providing centimeter-level precision.

AKTU has instructed its affiliated colleges to complete registration under this initiative to strengthen academic and research collaboration between educational institutions and national geospatial systems.

Key Benefits of AKTU CORS User Registration 2025

The AKTU CORS User Registration 2025 initiative brings several advantages to AKTU institutes, faculty, and students. Here are the key benefits:

1. Centimeter-Level Accuracy

CORS ensures highly precise GNSS data, essential for projects that demand accuracy in mapping, surveying, and structural design.

2. Integration with National Geospatial Data

Once registered, all data collected by AKTU colleges will automatically integrate into the Survey of India’s national CORS network, promoting standardized and accessible datasets.

3. Research and Innovation Boost

The AKTU CORS User Registration 2025 will open doors for new research in AI-based mapping, Smart Cities, AgriTech, and Environmental Monitoring.

4. Academic Enhancement

Colleges will be able to train students on advanced GNSS and GIS technologies, improving their technical knowledge and employability.

5. Government and Industry Collaboration

Institutes registered under the AKTU CORS User Registration 2025 can collaborate with government agencies and private companies for geospatial and civil infrastructure projects.

Official Details from the AKTU Circular

The circular clearly directs all AKTU institutions to follow the guidelines of the Survey of India and complete their CORS User Registration process promptly.

How to Complete AKTU CORS User Registration 2025

If you are a part of an AKTU-affiliated college, here’s a general step-by-step process to complete your AKTU CORS User Registration 2025:

  1. Visit the Official Survey of India CORS Portal – The portal provides access to registration and CORS data services.
  2. Create an Institutional Account – Use your college’s official email ID and details to register.
  3. Provide Required Information – Enter details like institute name, address, department, and the purpose of CORS usage.
  4. Attach Authorization Documents – Upload necessary verification papers as instructed by the U.P. Geospatial Directorate.
  5. Submit and Await Verification – The Survey of India team will review and approve your application.
  6. Start Using CORS Services – After approval, institutes can access accurate GNSS data for academic and research purposes.

Why AKTU CORS User Registration 2025 is a Game Changer

The AKTU CORS User Registration 2025 initiative marks a major step toward integrating geospatial intelligence into India’s technical education ecosystem.

Here’s how it will revolutionize education and research:

  • Enhanced Learning Experience: Students in Civil, Mechanical, and Environmental Engineering will gain real-world exposure to modern surveying tools.
  • Better Research Output: Institutions will be able to produce globally competitive research with precise geospatial data.
  • Smart Campus Development: Colleges can use CORS data for smart infrastructure and digital mapping of their campuses.
  • Disaster Preparedness: With accurate location data, colleges can contribute to projects on flood mapping, land-use planning, and disaster management.

The AKTU CORS User Registration 2025 aligns with India’s Digital India and National Geospatial Policy 2022, which encourages universities to adopt cutting-edge digital mapping technologies.

Official Statement from AKTU Registrar

In the circular, Ms. Reena Singh (Registrar, AKTU) stated that all affiliated institutions must act as per the Survey of India’s directions and complete the CORS User Registration process at the earliest.
The circular was distributed to key university officials, including the Vice-Chancellor, Controller of Examination, Finance Officer, and all Deans and Directors of AKTU, to ensure wide implementation.

Impact on AKTU Students and Colleges

The AKTU CORS User Registration 2025 will directly impact the quality of education and research in all AKTU-affiliated colleges.
Here’s how students and teachers benefit:

  • Students will learn to use professional GNSS and GIS tools.
  • Faculty can carry out government-funded research projects with accurate data.
  • Institutes can collaborate with other universities and organizations through shared geospatial datasets.
  • Employability of students will increase as industries now demand GIS and GNSS-skilled engineers.

This initiative will make AKTU one of the first state technical universities in India to adopt nationwide CORS integration at the institutional level.

READ MORE : AKTU Vantagenode Hiring Opportunity 2025 for B.Tech & MBA Students – Apply Now

Conclusion

The AKTU CORS User Registration 2025 is a landmark move by Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University to bring cutting-edge geospatial technology into education and research.
By connecting to the Survey of India’s CORS network, AKTU ensures accurate, integrated, and reliable data for academic and industrial purposes.

All affiliated institutes are advised to complete their AKTU CORS User Registration 2025 immediately to access the national-level CORS services and contribute to India’s growing geospatial ecosystem.

title.rendered: AKTU Nagarro Placement 2025: Nagarro Hired 7 Students from AKTU 2025 Batch for Software Developer Role

content.rendered:
Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University (AKTU), Lucknow has officially announced the AKTU Nagarro Placement 2025 result, marking a successful completion of the Nagarro hiring drive for final-year students of B.Tech (CSE, IT, ECE), MCA, and M.Tech (CSE) programs.

According to the circular issued by Prof. Neelam Srivastava, Dean of Training and Placement at AKTU, 7 talented students from affiliated colleges have been selected by Nagarro for the position of Software Developer (Trainee – SD).

The AKTU Nagarro Placement 2025 drive started with an official notification in June 2025 and concluded with the declaration of final results in October 2025.

AKTU Nagarro Placement 2025 – Overview

About Nagarro

Nagarro is a global IT and digital product engineering company headquartered in Munich, Germany, with offices in India, Sweden, the USA, Mexico, and many other countries. Nagarro provides outsourced software development services to startups and large enterprises, helping them achieve their strategic technology goals.

The company is known for its innovative culture, flexible work environment, and world-class engineering practices. The AKTU Nagarro Placement 2025 initiative gave students a valuable opportunity to join this globally respected tech organization.

Nagarro Job Profile and Responsibilities

Under the AKTU Nagarro Placement 2025 drive, Nagarro offered the position of Trainee – Software Developer to selected candidates. The role involves:

  • Executing the full Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC)
  • Designing flowcharts, layouts, and documentation to identify requirements and solutions
  • Writing efficient, testable, and well-documented code
  • Integrating software components into complete systems
  • Developing software verification and quality assurance procedures
  • Troubleshooting and upgrading existing systems
  • Deploying applications and collecting user feedback
  • Ensuring compliance with project plans and coding standards

Candidates were expected to demonstrate strong analytical skills, adaptability to changing environments, and a keen willingness to learn new technologies.

title.rendered: 6 Best Paid Government Internships for College Students in India (₹10,000 – ₹40,000 Stipend)

content.rendered:
Are you a college student dreaming of working in a government job but don’t want to wait until graduation or clear multiple competitive exams? What if you could get hands-on government experience right now — and earn a stipend up to ₹40,000 per month?

Yes! Top Indian government organizations like ISRO, DRDO, RBI, UIDAI, and several ministries regularly offer paid internships for students. These internships not only give you a glimpse into the functioning of the Indian government but also strengthen your resume for future opportunities.

In this article, we’ll explore the 6 best government internships in India divided into three main categories — Policy & Governance, Ministry Internships, and Research & Technology Internships — with complete details on eligibility, application process, duration, and stipend.

Category 1: Policy and Governance Internships

These internships allow you to understand how government policies are created, implemented, and monitored. Perfect for students of Law, Public Policy, Economics, Management, or Engineering, they provide real-world exposure to policymaking and governance.

1. DPIIT Internship Scheme

(Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade)

The DPIIT Internship under the Ministry of Commerce and Industry offers a golden opportunity to work on policies related to trade, industry, and startups.

Eligibility:

  • Students pursuing Graduation, Post-graduation, or Research.
  • Streams: Engineering, Management, Law, Economics, Finance, Computer Science, or Library Management.

Duration: 1 to 3 months
Stipend: ₹10,000 per month
Application Period:

  • 1st March to 30th April
  • 1st September to 31st October

How to Apply:

  1. Visit the official DPIIT Internship Portal.
  2. Fill out the online application form.
  3. Verify your email and mobile number and submit the form.

✅ Selected interns receive a Certificate of Experience after completion.

2. UIDAI Internship (Aadhaar Authority of India)

The Unique Identification Authority of India (UIDAI) is known for offering some of the highest-paying government internships in India.

Eligibility:
Students and graduates from all streams can apply — Engineering, Design, Law, Commerce, Mass Communication, Finance, and Computer Applications.
Degrees accepted: BE/BTech, ME/MTech, BBA, BCom, BCA, MCA, PhD.

Duration: 6 weeks to 12 months
Stipend: Up to ₹50,000/month
Locations: New Delhi, Bengaluru, and regional offices

Application Process:

  • Apply online when the portal opens (usually in May or June).
  • You can also email your CV with a No Objection Certificate (NOC) and recommendation letter.
  • Shortlisted candidates are interviewed virtually or in person.

✅ Successful interns work on projects related to Cybersecurity, Aadhaar Operations, IT, and Data Analytics.

Category 2: Ministry Internships

If you’re curious about how Indian ministries operate, these internships will give you a real taste of government administration and policy execution.

3. Digital India Internship (MeitY)

(Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology)

This internship is part of India’s flagship Digital India program — the force behind services like DigiLocker, UMANG App, and Aadhaar Authentication.

Eligibility:

  • Technical Roles: BE/BTech, ME/MTech, MSc, MCA (Computer Science, IT, Electronics)
  • Legal Roles: LLB students
  • Policy Roles: Students from Economics or Statistics

Duration: 2–3 months (June–August)
Stipend: ₹10,000/month

How to Apply:

  1. Visit the MeitY Internship Portal in April.
  2. Register and fill in personal, academic, and reference details.
  3. Upload documents and submit the application form.

✅ Selected interns work at the Ministry office in New Delhi, gaining mentorship and project experience in e-Governance.

4. Ministry of Finance Internship (Department of Economic Affairs)

If you’re passionate about Finance, Economics, or Management, the DEA Internship under the Ministry of Finance is an exceptional choice.

Eligibility:

  • Postgraduate or PhD students in Economics, Finance, Management, or Law.

Duration: 3 months
Stipend:

  • PG Students – ₹10,000/month
  • PhD Scholars – ₹20,000/month

Application Process:

  1. Apply through the official Ministry of Finance Internship Portal.
  2. PhD applicants must upload their research proposal.
  3. A selection committee reviews applications and shortlists candidates.

✅ Interns work directly with Joint Secretaries and Economic Advisors at the North Block, New Delhi, contributing to real government projects.

Category 3: Research and Technology Internships

These are the most sought-after internships for STEM students, offering exposure to cutting-edge innovation, defense, and space research.

5. ISRO Internship

(Indian Space Research Organisation)

If space exploration excites you, the ISRO Internship Program is a dream opportunity. Interns work on projects related to satellite technology, rocket design, and space missions.

Eligibility:

  • Final-year or recently graduated students in Science, Engineering, or PhD programs.

Duration: 6 weeks to 6 months
Stipend: Mostly unpaid (some labs may offer ₹5,000–₹15,000)

How to Apply:

  • Choose your preferred ISRO Research Center (like URSC or VSSC).
  • Apply via the center’s official internship portal.
  • Selection is based on academic performance and project relevance.

✅ Interns work under senior ISRO scientists on live research projects.

6. DRDO Internship

(Defence Research and Development Organisation)

The DRDO Internship is perfect for students interested in defense technology, robotics, or advanced engineering. DRDO has over 40 labs across India offering internships and fellowships.

Eligibility:

  • Pre-final or final-year students of BTech, MTech, MSc, or PhD.

Duration: 2 to 6 months
Stipend: ₹5,000 to ₹15,000/month (varies by lab and project)

Application Process:

  1. Visit the DRDO Careers Page for open internships.
  2. Download the form and submit it to the respective lab with required documents.
  3. Shortlisted candidates may be interviewed before final selection.

✅ Selected interns work directly with DRDO scientists on live defense and innovation projects.

Final Words: How to Apply for Government Internships Easily

Many of these government internships are also listed on platforms like Internshala, where you can apply with a few clicks. Keep an eye on official websites between March–October, as most applications open during this period.

Government internships not only give you valuable experience and a stipend, but they also open doors for future government jobs and research opportunities.

Quick Summary on Government Internship

Conclusion On Government Internship

If you’re a college student looking for real-world experience, networking opportunities, and a chance to work with India’s top government organizations, these 6 paid government internships are the perfect start.

So don’t wait — check the official websites of DPIIT, UIDAI, MeitY, Finance Ministry, ISRO, and DRDO and start applying today!

title.rendered: AKTU Challenge Evaluation 2025: Important Notice for Even Semester (Session 2024-25) Students

content.rendered:
Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University (AKTU), Lucknow, has officially released an important notification regarding the AKTU Challenge Evaluation 2025 for the Even Semester (Session 2024-25). The circular, issued by Prof. Deepak Nagaria, Controller of Examinations, on 8th October 2025, provides complete details about the process, eligibility, courses covered, and application procedure for students who wish to get their evaluated answer sheets rechecked or reviewed.

Let’s break down everything you need to know about the AKTU Challenge Evaluation 2025, including key dates, fees, and step-by-step instructions.

Exam & Notification Overview

The written examinations for the Even Semester (Session 2024-25) were conducted between 17th May 2025 and 13th June 2025 across various centers under AKTU. Now, students studying in the mentioned courses and semesters can apply for the Challenge Evaluation 2025 if they are not satisfied with their declared results.

This process allows students to view their digitally evaluated answer sheets and, if unsatisfied after reviewing them, request a re-evaluation (Challenge Evaluation).

Courses & Semesters Covered Under AKTU Challenge Evaluation 2025

According to the official notice, the following courses and semesters are included for the AKTU Challenge Evaluation 2025:

Only regular students whose results have already been declared are eligible to apply for the challenge evaluation process.

How to Apply for AKTU Challenge Evaluation 2025

The application process for the AKTU Challenge Evaluation 2025 is completely online through the AKTU ERP portal. Students must follow the procedure mentioned below:

  1. Login to AKTU ERP Portal using your credentials.
  2. Navigate to the “Challenge Evaluation” section.
  3. Select the subjects for which you wish to apply for answer sheet viewing.
  4. Pay ₹300 per subject through the online payment gateway available on ERP.
  5. Submit your application before the last date (17th October 2025).

After successful submission, the digitally evaluated answer sheet will be made available for viewing in the student’s ERP account.

Application Fee Details

  • Fee per subject: ₹300 (Three Hundred Only)
  • Mode of payment: Online via ERP Login
  • Application window: 8th October 2025 to 17th October 2025

Important Dates to Remember

What Happens After Viewing the Answer Sheet

Once the digitally evaluated answer sheet is made available, students can check their evaluated answers and marks.

If a student feels that their evaluation was incorrect or unfair, they can then proceed to apply for the Challenge Evaluation 2025, which involves a re-evaluation of their answer script by a senior examiner, as per university guidelines.

This two-step process ensures transparency and fairness in the AKTU evaluation system.

Guidelines & Reference Orders

The challenge evaluation process will be conducted in accordance with:

  • Government Order No.: 39298/16-1099/17/2020, dated 11 September 2020
  • Letter by the Additional Chief Secretary, Governor/Chancellor’s Office: No. E-7443/03-G.S./2019 (T.C.)

These documents define the official guidelines and procedures that must be followed by all applicants.

Why AKTU Challenge Evaluation 2025 is Important

The AKTU Challenge Evaluation 2025 gives students a fair chance to:

  • Review how their answer sheets were evaluated.
  • Identify any potential mistakes in marking or totaling.
  • Request re-evaluation if they genuinely believe there’s an error.

This step strengthens academic integrity and ensures that students’ hard work is evaluated accurately.

Responsibilities of Colleges

All affiliated institutions under Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University (AKTU) are instructed to:

  • Inform students about the Challenge Evaluation 2025 notice at their level.
  • Ensure that interested students are guided properly for the online application.
  • Help them in completing the fee payment and ERP login steps within the deadline.

Official Authorities Notified

The circular has also been forwarded to:

  • Vice-Chancellor
  • Registrar
  • Finance Officer
  • Joint/Deputy Controller of Examination
  • ERP In-Charge (for technical updates)
  • Public Relations Officer (for official announcement)
  • Staff Officer to Vice-Chancellor (for VC’s review)

Key Highlights at a Glance

  • Notice Issued By: Prof. Deepak Nagaria, Controller of Examinations, AKTU
  • Notice Number: AKTU/P.N./2025/2239
  • Date of Issue: 8th October 2025
  • Applicable For: Regular students of Even Semester (Session 2024-25)
  • Fee: ₹300 per subject
  • Apply Between: 8th – 17th October 2025
  • Mode: Online via ERP Login

Conclusion

The AKTU Challenge Evaluation 2025 is a valuable opportunity for students who believe their answer sheets were not properly evaluated. By allowing students to view and challenge their evaluated copies, AKTU continues to promote transparency, trust, and academic fairness in the examination process.

Students are advised to apply before the deadline and follow all official instructions carefully via the AKTU ERP portal.

For more updates regarding AKTU notices, exams, and evaluations, keep visiting our blog regularly.

title.rendered: How to Maintain 8+ CGPA in AKTU: Smart Tips for Every Student

content.rendered:
Every year, thousands of students join Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University (AKTU) with big goals and excitement. But once the semester starts, the pressure of exams, assignments, and attendance quickly builds up. Many students end up with backlogs or low marks, wondering how others manage to keep a strong score.

The truth is, maintaining an 8+ CGPA in AKTU isn’t about studying all day or memorizing everything. It’s about having a smart plan, knowing what matters most, and preparing in a focused way. Let’s break down the most effective strategies that can help you maintain a high CGPA without losing your peace of mind.

1. Understand How AKTU Exams Are Structured

The first step toward a good CGPA is understanding how AKTU exams actually work. Each subject is divided into five units, and your performance is measured through sessionals, practicals, and final exams.

  • Sessionals: Two internal tests are conducted during the semester.
  • POT (Practical or Tutorial): Internal marks based on practical work or attendance.
  • Final Exam: The university exam that carries the highest weightage.

Once you understand this structure, you can divide your preparation into phases and target each part smartly. This clarity alone can make it much easier to maintain 8+ CGPA in AKTU.

2. Start With the Quantum Series and PYQs

One of the biggest secrets among toppers is using the Quantum Series. It contains previous year questions (PYQs) and most important topics for every subject.

Instead of trying to read entire textbooks, focus on the Quantum Series. It highlights the topics that have actually appeared in exams before, so you don’t waste time on irrelevant sections.

You can buy Quantum books from local stores or get them online. If you are consistent with Quantum and PYQs, your exam preparation will automatically improve, and you’ll find it easier to maintain 8+ CGPA in AKTU.

3. Attend Classes and Make Short Notes

Many students attend classes only for attendance, but if you really want to improve your CGPA, make short notes during lectures. These notes don’t have to be detailed; even key points, formulas, and definitions are enough.

When exams arrive, your own notes will help you remember concepts faster than any book or video. Writing things down improves understanding and memory, and that directly helps in scoring higher marks.

Building the habit of making short notes is one of the most effective and practical ways to maintain 8+ CGPA in AKTU.

Click Links given below for notes/Imp. Ques/PYQs

https://notesgallery.com/aktu-b-tech-1st-year-free-study-materials/    First Year

https://notesgallery.com/aktu-b-tech-2nd-year-free-study-materials/   Second Year

https://notesgallery.com/aktu-b-tech-3rd-year-free-study-materials/    Third Year

https://notesgallery.com/aktu-b-tech-4th-year-free-study-materials/    Fourth

4. Prepare for Sessional Exams Strategically

Sessional exams are not just internal tests; they also help you prepare early for the final semester exam. Each sessional usually covers two units — the first sessional includes Unit 1 and Unit 2, while the second covers Unit 3 and Unit 4.

If you start preparing before each sessional, you’ll have already studied four out of five units before the final exam. That means when the final exam comes, you only need to revise and focus on Unit 5.

This steady, small-step approach helps you stay consistent throughout the semester and makes it much easier to maintain 8+ CGPA in AKTU.

5. Focus on High-Credit Subjects

All subjects don’t carry equal weight. Some are 4-credit subjects, others are 3-credit or 2-credit. High-credit subjects contribute more to your CGPA, so they deserve more attention.

If you perform well in the 4-credit subjects, even a few lower marks in minor subjects won’t affect your overall score much. So when planning your study schedule, always start with the subjects that have the highest credit points.

Understanding this credit system helps you focus where it matters most and is one of the smartest ways to maintain 8+ CGPA in AKTU.

6. Study the Three Most Important Topics from Each Unit

You don’t have to study every single topic in detail. University question papers often repeat patterns. Pick the three most important topics from every unit, study them deeply, and revise them twice before the exam.

By doing this, you’ll cover around 15 to 20 key topics across the whole subject. That’s more than enough to score 70–80 marks, which easily keeps you above the 8 CGPA level.

This selective approach saves time and ensures you’re focusing on what truly matters. It’s a proven strategy followed by many toppers who successfully maintain 8+ CGPA in AKTU.

7. Use the Final Week Wisely

The last seven days before exams can make or break your performance. Instead of panicking, make a plan for these days.

  • Watch short concept revision videos on YouTube.
  • Go through previous year question papers and solve them.
  • Focus on important topics you’ve already prepared.

Many educators release videos highlighting likely exam questions based on trends. These help you focus better and avoid wasting time on unimportant chapters. Following these resources will help you confidently face exams and maintain 8+ CGPA in AKTU.

8. Join AKTU Student Communities

AKTU students share a lot of useful content online — from notes and question papers to exam tips. Join Telegram or WhatsApp groups related to your branch or semester.

These communities are helpful during exam time. You can clear doubts quickly, find the latest study material, and stay informed about important updates. Learning together keeps you motivated and disciplined, which are both key to maintaining 8+ CGPA in AKTU.

9. Stay Consistent and Manage Time

Consistency is the real secret behind a good CGPA. You don’t need to study all day — even two or three focused hours daily are enough. But do it every day.

Avoid distractions, revise regularly, and practice problem-solving. Use weekends to revise old topics so that nothing gets forgotten. If you manage your time well, your preparation becomes smooth and stress-free.

Consistency, more than talent, helps you maintain 8+ CGPA in AKTU in the long run.

READ MORE : AKTU Circular 2025: Submit Details of Atal Bihari Vajpayee Birth Centenary Programs

Conclusion on 8+ CGPA in AKTU

Scoring and maintaining an 8+ CGPA in AKTU is not about being a genius — it’s about following the right methods. Use Quantum Series for focused study, make short notes, understand credit weightage, prepare for sessionals properly, and revise consistently.

AKTU exams are predictable if you study smartly. Follow a structured plan, stay disciplined, and don’t wait for the last week to start preparation. Remember, every small effort adds up.

If you follow these tips sincerely, you will not only pass every semester without backlogs but also build a strong academic record. In the end, when someone asks how you manage your marks so well, you’ll proudly say —
“I know how to maintain 8+ CGPA in AKTU.”

title.rendered: UP News: 7 October Declared Public Holiday in Uttar Pradesh | Maharishi Valmiki Jayanti 2025 Holiday Officially Announced

content.rendered:
The Uttar Pradesh Government has officially declared 7 October 2025 as a public holiday across the state. The day marks the celebration of Maharishi Valmiki Jayanti 2025, a festival dedicated to the revered sage who composed the great Indian epic Ramayana.

Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath had earlier announced this decision during a public gathering in Shravasti district, stating that the day will now be recognized as a state-level special holiday in Uttar Pradesh. Following his announcement, the UP Government issued an official order confirming that all government offices, schools, and public institutions will remain closed on 7 October 2025.

This declaration of UP Holiday 7 October 2025 is being seen as a gesture of respect towards Maharishi Valmiki and his teachings that continue to inspire millions across India.

The Official Government Order

On Saturday, 4 October 2025, the Uttar Pradesh Government released an official notification declaring 7 October 2025 as a statewide public holiday.

The order states:
“On the occasion of Maharishi Valmiki Jayanti 2025, all government and semi-government offices, boards, and corporations under the Government of Uttar Pradesh shall remain closed on Tuesday, 7 October 2025.”

With this announcement, the UP Holiday 7 October 2025 will apply to:

  • All state government offices
  • Educational institutions (schools, colleges, universities)
  • Boards, corporations, and public sector organizations

However, essential services such as hospitals, police stations, fire departments, and emergency services will continue to function as usual.

Significance of Maharishi Valmiki Jayanti 2025

Maharishi Valmiki Jayanti 2025 is celebrated to honor Sage Valmiki, who is revered as the Adikavi (the first poet) and the author of the epic Ramayana. He is remembered for his timeless teachings on morality, truth, and righteousness.

Valmiki Jayanti symbolizes the importance of knowledge, compassion, and equality. Devotees across India celebrate the day by organizing prayers, processions, and community gatherings to pay tribute to the sage.

By declaring UP Holiday 7 October 2025, the government aims to acknowledge Valmiki’s contribution to Indian literature, culture, and social harmony.

Background: How the Holiday Was Declared

The demand for reinstating the public holiday on Maharishi Valmiki Jayanti was raised by the Bhartiya Valmiki Dharm Samaj, a social organization representing the Valmiki community.

Members of the community had submitted a memorandum to the government requesting that 7 October be declared a public holiday, as it used to be earlier before being discontinued.

Responding to their appeal, Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath announced during his speech in Shravasti:
“Maharishi Valmiki Ji showed us the path of truth, dharma, and justice. To honor his great contribution, the Uttar Pradesh Government has decided to observe Maharishi Valmiki Jayanti as a state holiday every year.”

Soon after his public announcement, the UP Government order confirmed the declaration, officially marking UP Holiday 7 October 2025 as a significant day in the state calendar.

What Makes This UP Holiday 7 October 2025 Important

This holiday is not just a symbolic gesture—it carries deep social and cultural meaning.

1. Revival of an Old Tradition

Earlier, Maharishi Valmiki Jayanti was observed as a public holiday in Uttar Pradesh, but it was discontinued for several years. With this announcement, the tradition has been revived in 2025.

2. Respect for Social Harmony

Maharishi Valmiki Jayanti promotes values of equality and justice, resonating strongly with the ideals of social harmony that the state government seeks to encourage.

3. Boost to Cultural Awareness

The decision helps educate the younger generation about the life and teachings of Maharishi Valmiki, reinforcing pride in India’s ancient literary and spiritual heritage.

CM Yogi Adityanath’s Words

Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath emphasized that Maharishi Valmiki’s life is a source of guidance for humanity. He said:
“Maharishi Valmiki Ji’s teachings inspire us to live with truth, compassion, and discipline. Uttar Pradesh will now celebrate his Jayanti every year with devotion and respect.”

He further added that the UP Holiday 7 October 2025 will not only honor Valmiki’s contributions but also strengthen the cultural unity of the state.

Which Institutions Will Remain Closed on 7 October 2025

As per the government order, the UP Holiday 7 October 2025 will be applicable to:

  • All State Government offices and departments
  • Government-aided and private schools affiliated with state boards
  • Colleges and universities under UP Government
  • Boards and public corporations

Banks and private companies may choose to follow the holiday as per their internal policies, but most educational and administrative offices will remain closed across the state.

Message Behind Maharishi Valmiki Jayanti

Maharishi Valmiki’s teachings transcend religion and caste. His life reflects transformation—from a hunter to a sage—symbolizing the power of repentance, self-realization, and devotion.

By observing UP Holiday 7 October 2025, the Uttar Pradesh Government aims to promote Valmiki’s message of:

  • Truth (Satya)
  • Compassion (Karuna)
  • Equality (Samata)
  • Knowledge (Gyaan)

The day will be marked by cultural programs, community service events, and religious gatherings across the state.

Key Highlights of UP Holiday 7 October 2025

Public Reaction and Community Response

The decision to declare UP Holiday 7 October 2025 has received widespread appreciation, especially from the Valmiki community. Social organizations have welcomed the move, calling it a long-overdue acknowledgment of Maharishi Valmiki’s legacy.

Citizens have also expressed gratitude towards CM Yogi Adityanath for recognizing the cultural importance of this day. Many have termed it a “historic and inclusive decision” by the state government.

READ MORE : Zoho Hiring 2025 – Software Developer Jobs in Chennai (1–4 Years Experience)

Conclusion

The declaration of UP Holiday 7 October 2025 for Maharishi Valmiki Jayanti marks a proud and meaningful moment for Uttar Pradesh. It is not merely a day off from work but a reminder of the values of truth, compassion, and equality that Maharishi Valmiki preached centuries ago.

By reinstating this holiday, the Uttar Pradesh Government has demonstrated its respect for India’s ancient wisdom and its commitment to promoting social unity.

So on 7 October 2025, as the entire state observes Maharishi Valmiki Jayanti 2025, let us all take a moment to remember the great sage who gave the world one of its greatest epics and an eternal message of righteousness.

title.rendered: AKTU Circular 2025: Submit Details of Atal Bihari Vajpayee Birth Centenary Programs

content.rendered:
Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University (AKTU), Lucknow, has officially released AKTU Circular 2025 on 6th October 2025, instructing all affiliated colleges to share information, photographs, and videos related to programs conducted under the Atal Bihari Vajpayee Birth Centenary Year celebrations.

This AKTU Circular 2025 aims to collect detailed reports of all events held in memory of Bharat Ratna Shri Atal Bihari Vajpayee Ji across affiliated colleges and institutions. The collected data will be compiled at the university level for recordkeeping, publication, and showcasing the educational community’s active participation in honoring the former Prime Minister’s legacy.

About the AKTU Circular 2025

  • Issued by: Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University (AKTU), Lucknow
  • Issued on: 6th October 2025
  • Letter Number: E/Co-ordination/2025/8518
  • Issued from: Sector-11, Jankipuram Vistar Yojana, Lucknow – 226031
  • Signed by: Dr. R.K. Singh, Deputy Registrar (उप कुलसचिव)
  • Subject: Information regarding the Atal Bihari Vajpayee Birth Centenary Year events organized by affiliated colleges.

According to AKTU Circular 2025, all affiliated institutions must upload their program details on the official link provided by the university.

Purpose of the AKTU Circular 2025

The AKTU Circular 2025 focuses on gathering complete event information from all affiliated universities, colleges, and technical institutes that celebrated the Atal Bihari Vajpayee Birth Centenary Year.

The goal is to document and preserve the contributions of every college that honored the late leader through various educational, cultural, and social activities.

Each institution must submit:

  • Details of the event conducted
  • High-quality photographs
  • Short video clips
  • Names of the organizers and participants

This step ensures transparency and active participation across the AKTU Lucknow ecosystem, promoting a culture of respect, awareness, and educational involvement.

Submission Link for Colleges

All affiliated colleges must upload their reports and multimedia files at the following official university link:

👉 https://shorturl.at/Nt5JT

The AKTU Circular 2025 clearly states that photographs, videos, and event summaries must be uploaded through this portal to be considered for compilation in the official records.

Information Required for Submission

According to the AKTU Circular 2025, institutions need to provide the following materials:

  1. Event Description:
    Mention the type of event (seminar, cultural function, debate, essay competition, etc.) and summarize its objective.
  2. Photographs:
    Upload clear and authentic images highlighting participants, banners, and key moments from the celebration.
  3. Videos:
    Short video clips showing speeches, performances, or tribute sessions conducted during the program.
  4. Event Date and College Details:
    Include the name of the institution, department, and date of event for proper documentation.

Why AKTU Circular 2025 is Important

The AKTU Circular 2025 has both cultural and educational importance. It helps preserve the memory of Atal Bihari Vajpayee Ji, one of India’s most respected leaders known for his integrity, leadership, and love for education.

By participating in this centenary celebration, students not only pay tribute to a visionary leader but also learn about his contribution to nation-building, democracy, and development.

For AKTU Lucknow, this circular is an opportunity to bring together all affiliated colleges under a common initiative promoting knowledge, patriotism, and leadership values.

Historical Context of the Celebration

The Atal Bihari Vajpayee Birth Centenary Year (2024–2025) marks 100 years since the birth of the Bharat Ratna awardee, who served as the Prime Minister of India and laid the foundation for many educational reforms.

Under his leadership, India saw advancements in technology, education, and infrastructure — values that AKTU upholds today.

Therefore, the AKTU Circular 2025 aligns with the spirit of national remembrance and academic participation by encouraging institutions to organize events that reflect Vajpayee Ji’s ideals.

Colleges’ Responsibilities Under AKTU Circular 2025

Each affiliated college is instructed to:

  • Organize at least one event related to the birth centenary celebrations.
  • Maintain proper documentation of the event.
  • Upload all data before the deadline through the official link.
  • Ensure authenticity and accuracy in submissions.
  • Encourage student participation through debates, art competitions, and seminars.

The circular also requests the Registrar, Examination Office, and Time Table Committee members to ensure compliance and oversee the process.

Distribution of the AKTU Circular 2025

The AKTU Circular 2025 has been circulated to multiple departments and authorities:

  1. Registrar, AKTU Lucknow
  2. Members of the Time Table Committee
  3. All affiliated institutions under AKTU
  4. Assistant Registrar (Exam)
  5. Staff Officer to Vice-Chancellor

This wide distribution ensures that no institution misses out on the instructions or submission deadlines.

Encouraged Activities for Colleges

To make the celebrations more meaningful, AKTU encourages the following student and faculty activities:

  • Essay Writing Competitions on Vajpayee Ji’s contributions.
  • Speech and Debate Competitions about his leadership and governance.
  • Cultural Programs showcasing patriotic themes.
  • Poster Making and Quiz Contests on Indian democracy and education.
  • Documentary Screenings on Vajpayee Ji’s life and achievements.

These activities help connect students with India’s political, social, and educational legacy while fulfilling the objectives of AKTU Circular 2025.

Expected Outcomes of the AKTU Circular 2025

The implementation of this circular will:

  • Strengthen student engagement and social responsibility.
  • Promote value-based education across AKTU campuses.
  • Enhance the visibility of university-level cultural participation.
  • Foster a deeper understanding of India’s democratic values.

By collecting and showcasing these celebrations, AKTU Lucknow demonstrates its commitment to holistic education that blends academics with national consciousness.

About AKTU Lucknow

Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University (AKTU), Lucknow, is one of India’s largest technical universities, overseeing more than 700 affiliated institutions. The university regularly issues official circulars like AKTU Circular 2025 to maintain communication and coordination with all affiliated colleges.

Through initiatives like these, AKTU continues to promote leadership, innovation, and patriotism among students across Uttar Pradesh.

Conclusion

The AKTU Circular 2025 is a significant initiative to document and celebrate the Atal Bihari Vajpayee Birth Centenary Year. All affiliated colleges under AKTU Lucknow are directed to submit photographs, videos, and event descriptions showcasing their participation in honoring one of India’s most admired leaders.

By following the university’s instructions, institutions not only comply with administrative requirements but also contribute to preserving the legacy of Vajpayee Ji — a leader whose vision for education and development continues to inspire generations.

title.rendered: Build a Production-Ready App Using ChatGPT, Cursor, and TestPride | AI Tools for Developers

content.rendered:
In today’s fast-evolving tech world, AI tools for developers are changing the way software is built. Tools like ChatGPT, Cursor, and Copilot are helping developers code faster than ever before. But here’s the truth — most people don’t know how to use these tools effectively. As a result, they end up with incomplete or non-production-ready projects.

In this article, you’ll learn a step-by-step process to use ChatGPT, Cursor, and TestPride together to build a fully production-ready app — even if you’re a beginner. This AI-powered workflow can take your coding efficiency to the next level.

Step 1: Create a Perfect PRD Using ChatGPT

Every successful app starts with a clear Product Requirement Document (PRD). Normally, writing one manually can take hours. But with ChatGPT, you can generate a professional PRD in just a few seconds.

How to do it:

Open ChatGPT and enter this prompt:

You are a Product Manager. Write a PRD for [Your Project Name]. Output should be in markdown format.

Example:
“You are a Product Manager. Write a PRD for Khedapati Sarkar Mandir App. Output should be in markdown format.”

ChatGPT will instantly generate a detailed PRD including:

  • Project overview
  • Goals and objectives
  • Target audience
  • Features list
  • Technical requirements
  • Success metrics

This PRD will serve as the foundation for your app. Once you have it ready, the next step is to pass it to Cursor AI for automatic code generation.

Step 2: Generate Code Automatically with Cursor

The next step is to use Cursor, an advanced AI-powered coding assistant. Cursor can read your PRD and automatically generate working code based on the features and requirements mentioned.

How Cursor works:

  1. It reads your PRD line by line.
  2. Understands the key components and functionality.
  3. Generates corresponding frontend and backend code using languages like HTML, CSS, JavaScript, or Python.

This process saves a lot of time compared to manual coding. However, there’s one challenge — the auto-generated code often contains bugs or broken functions.

That’s where TestPride comes in to make your project production-ready.

Step 3: Use TestPride for Bug Detection and Auto Fixing

After code generation, the most time-consuming part is testing and debugging. Manually checking each function takes hours. To solve this, developers use TestPride, an AI tool that automatically tests, detects, and fixes bugs.

How to use TestPride:

  1. Open your project in Cursor and select the file you want to test.
  2. Type this command: Test it using TestPride
  3. TestPride will automatically:
    • Generate a test plan
    • Run each function individually
    • Identify bugs and performance issues
    • Create a detailed bug report
    • Send it back to Cursor for precise fixes

Cursor will then fix those issues accurately without random guessing. The result — a bug-free, production-ready app built entirely with AI assistance.

Step 4: Boost Coding Efficiency from 42% to 93%

Using TestPride in combination with Cursor significantly boosts developer efficiency.
Studies show that developers using only Cursor achieve around 42% efficiency, while those who integrate TestPride reach up to 93% efficiency.

This huge jump happens because TestPride eliminates repetitive debugging and error-checking, allowing you to focus on design and innovation instead of fixing minor issues.

Focus Keyword: ChatGPT, Cursor, TestPride

Step 5: Setup TestPride for Free

The best part? TestPride is currently free to use.
You can easily integrate it into your workflow without any complex setup.

A detailed setup process is available in a shared Google Sheet that includes:

  • Installation steps
  • API integration guide
  • Linking with Cursor and ChatGPT
  • Common commands and examples

The setup link is available in the description or resource section of this post. Once done, you’ll be ready to use TestPride efficiently in your daily projects.

Why ChatGPT + Cursor + TestPride is a Game-Changer

This combination is a complete AI-powered coding ecosystem that can transform how you build applications.

Together, these tools help developers build professional-level projects quickly and efficiently without manual debugging or endless testing cycles.

Example Workflow Recap

  1. Create PRD with ChatGPT – Define your project goals and requirements clearly.
  2. Generate code using Cursor – Let AI handle coding for you.
  3. Test and fix with TestPride – Automatically test and debug your project.
  4. Deploy your app – Get a 100% production-ready app in record time.

This AI-driven workflow allows even beginners to work like professional software developers.

Focus Keyword: ChatGPT, Cursor, TestPride

SEO and Performance Benefits of Using These Tools

If you’re building websites or blogs, ChatGPT, Cursor, and TestPride can also improve your SEO performance:

  • ChatGPT structures your content for better readability and SEO ranking.
  • Cursor generates clean, optimized web code.
  • TestPride ensures that your website has no performance or functionality errors that can affect SEO.

Together, they not only help you build apps faster but also improve your website’s ranking and reliability.

Conclusion

If you’re a beginner developer or someone who wants to build apps quickly without sacrificing quality, then ChatGPT, Cursor, and TestPride are the perfect tools for you.

This powerful combination allows you to plan, code, test, and deploy applications faster than ever before. It reduces human errors, saves time, and produces production-ready results — all with the help of AI.

By mastering these three tools, you can turn your development process into a smart, efficient, and automated workflow.

Now is the time to embrace the power of AI tools for developers and take your coding journey to the next level.
