title.rendered: AKTU B.Tech Duration 2025: 4 Years or 7 Years? Complete Guide for Students

content.rendered:
If you are a student studying under AKTU or planning to take admission soon, you must have heard people saying different things about the duration of the B.Tech course. Some say it is only a four-year program, while others claim that it continues for seven years. The confusion is common among students, especially those worried about backlogs and degree completion.

In this post, you will get a complete explanation of the AKTU B.Tech duration, how the 7-year rule works, what happens if you have backlogs, and what you should do to complete your degree successfully.

1. The Official AKTU B.Tech Duration

According to AKTU guidelines, the Bachelor of Technology program runs for four academic years, which include eight semesters. This is the regular duration followed by all affiliated colleges across Uttar Pradesh.

However, AKTU gives students an additional three years to clear any pending subjects or backlogs. So, the total duration allowed for completing a B.Tech degree becomes seven years from the date of admission.

To summarize:

  • Regular course duration: 4 years (8 semesters)
  • Maximum allowed duration: 7 years (including 3 extra years for backlogs)

This means that if you take admission in 2021, you can complete your degree by 2028. Beyond this period, your registration becomes invalid.

2. Why AKTU Provides 3 Extra Years

AKTU understands that not every student can complete their degree within the standard four years. Some may face difficulties due to tough subjects, personal issues, or health problems. To ensure that such students get a fair chance, the university provides an additional three years to clear all pending subjects.

For instance, if you enrolled in 2020, your regular course will end in 2024, but you still have time till 2027 to clear any remaining subjects. Therefore, the total AKTU B.Tech duration becomes seven years from the date of admission.

3. What Happens If You Cross 7 Years

Once the seven-year period is over, AKTU strictly discontinues your degree if you still have even one active backlog. You will not be allowed to appear in any further re-exams, and the university will not issue your final degree.

This rule is applied uniformly across all colleges affiliated with AKTU. Therefore, it is very important to plan your studies wisely and make sure you clear every subject within the permitted seven-year time frame.

4. Example of the AKTU B.Tech Duration Rule

Let’s take an example for better understanding.

Suppose a student takes admission in 2021. The regular course runs from 2021 to 2025. After that, AKTU allows an extension from 2025 to 2028. So, 2028 becomes the final year to clear any pending subjects.

If a student fails to clear all papers by 2028, their B.Tech degree will be discontinued permanently. This simple rule forms the basis of the AKTU B.Tech duration policy.

5. How to Clear Backlogs During the AKTU B.Tech Duration

Backlogs are common, but AKTU provides multiple chances for students to clear them within the official duration.

(a) Back Paper or Carry Over Exam
After every semester, AKTU conducts carry-over or back paper exams for students who fail in one or more subjects. These exams are usually held along with the regular semester exams.

(b) Improvement Exam
If you are not satisfied with your marks, you can apply for improvement exams to increase your scores and improve your CGPA.

(c) Special Carry Over Exam
For final-year students, AKTU sometimes conducts special carry-over exams to give them one final opportunity to clear their backlogs before the degree deadline.

By using these opportunities properly, you can easily finish your degree within the allowed AKTU B.Tech duration.

6. The Reality of Missing the 7-Year Limit

Consider this scenario. A student takes admission in 2018 and completes all eight semesters by 2022 but still has a few backlogs. They assume they can clear them later and keep delaying. When 2025 arrives, they realize the seven-year period is over. Even if they appear and pass the exam later, the university will not issue their degree because the official duration has ended.

This is why it is critical to keep track of your remaining papers and use every back exam opportunity within the allowed seven-year duration.

7. How to Avoid Delays and Backlogs

Here are a few practical tips to ensure you complete your B.Tech on time under AKTU:

  1. Attend classes regularly to secure good internal marks.
  2. Prepare for semester exams using previous year question papers.
  3. Take internal assessments seriously because even small marks can help you pass.
  4. Do not skip back paper exams; attempt them as soon as possible.
  5. Keep checking your result and backlog status on the AKTU ERP portal.

Finishing your degree within the AKTU B.Tech duration is not about being perfect; it is about staying consistent and aware.

8. AKTU B.Tech Duration for Lateral Entry Students

If you joined B.Tech through lateral entry (after completing a diploma or B.Sc.), your regular course duration is three years instead of four. But AKTU still provides the same three-year extension for backlog clearance.

So for lateral entry students:

  • Regular duration: 3 years
  • Maximum duration: 6 years

The same AKTU B.Tech duration rule applies, but the total time is reduced by one year since the course starts from the second year.

9. Common Myths About AKTU B.Tech Duration

There are a few misconceptions among students that need to be cleared:

Myth 1: “I can apply for an extra year beyond seven years.”
Fact: No, AKTU does not provide any extensions beyond the seven-year limit.

Myth 2: “If I have only one backlog left after seven years, I can request special permission.”
Fact: The system automatically discontinues your record after seven years. There is no option to continue beyond that.

Myth 3: “The seven years are counted from the last exam.”
Fact: The seven years are counted from the date of admission, not from the final exam.

10. Summary of AKTU B.Tech Duration Rules

  • Regular course duration: 4 years (8 semesters)
  • Maximum duration: 7 years from admission date
  • Extension provided: 3 years for clearing backlogs
  • After 7 years: Degree discontinued
  • Applies to: All AKTU colleges
  • Lateral entry duration: 3 years + 3 years extension = 6 years

Final Thoughts

The B.Tech course under AKTU may appear to be a four-year program, but in reality, the university allows a total of seven years to complete it. This includes three additional years for students who need extra time to clear their subjects.

However, the extra time should be treated as an opportunity, not as an excuse to delay your studies. Once the seven-year limit is crossed, the university does not provide any further chances.

To make the most of your AKTU B.Tech duration, stay regular with your studies, keep track of your results, and use every chance you get to clear your backlogs. Completing your degree within time not only helps you avoid stress but also opens the path to a smooth career ahead.

The Life Insurance Corporation of India (LIC) launched this scholarship scheme to provide financial assistance to meritorious students from low-income families.

title.rendered: NITI Aayog Internship 2025: Eligibility, Duration, Stipend, and Application Process

content.rendered:
If you are a student looking for an opportunity to gain hands-on exposure to policymaking, research, and governance, then the NITI Aayog Internship 2025 is something you should not miss. Every year, the Government of India’s top policy think tank opens its doors for bright young minds from across the country to work on important projects, research, and developmental initiatives.

This internship is not just about working under professionals but also about understanding how India’s planning and policymaking works in reality. In this detailed blog post, we will cover everything you need to know about the NITI Aayog Internship 2025—including eligibility criteria, application process, important dates, duration, and benefits.

About NITI Aayog

The NITI Aayog (National Institution for Transforming India) is the premier policy think tank of the Government of India. It was established to replace the Planning Commission with a focus on cooperative federalism. This institution emphasizes a bottom-up approach, where states and Union Territories actively participate in shaping the country’s development agenda.

The Aayog plays a key role in designing strategies for economic growth, digital transformation, health, education, environment, and achieving Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs). For students, interning here is a once-in-a-lifetime chance to work on real policy research and gain insight into India’s governance system.

About NITI Aayog Internship 2025

The NITI Aayog Internship 2025 is designed to offer students exposure to various verticals, divisions, and units within the organization. Interns will work on research-oriented tasks, empirical data collection, and analysis.

For many students, this internship provides a unique opportunity to observe how policies are drafted, analyzed, and implemented in India. Additionally, this internship may help in building a strong career in public policy, civil services, international organizations, consulting, or research.

The internship is available in different months between December 2025 and May 2026, and applicants can select the month that suits them best.

Key Features of NITI Aayog Internship 2025

Here are the major highlights of the internship:

  • Interns will get exposure to real policy-making processes.
  • Work will involve research, data analysis, and report preparation.
  • Students will engage with different divisions within NITI Aayog.
  • The internship period is minimum 6 weeks and maximum 6 months.
  • A certificate will be provided after successful completion.

Eligibility Criteria

The NITI Aayog Internship 2025 has specific eligibility criteria for undergraduate, postgraduate, and PhD students. Let’s look at the details:

  1. For Undergraduate Students:
    • Must have completed/appeared in the second year (4th semester) of a bachelor’s degree program.
    • Must have secured at least 85% marks in Class 12th.
  2. For Postgraduate Students:
    • Must have completed/appeared in the first year (2nd semester) of a postgraduate program.
    • Should have secured at least 70% marks in graduation.
  3. For Ph.D./Research Students:
    • Students pursuing research or Ph.D. can apply if they meet the academic requirements.
  4. For Fresh Graduates/PG Students Waiting for Admission:
    • Students who have appeared for final exams or completed their degree can also apply.
    • They must have scored at least 70% marks in all semesters.
    • The gap between the final exam result and the desired internship month should not exceed six months.

📌 Example: If your results were declared in June 2025, you can apply for internships starting until December 2025.

Duration of Internship

The NITI Aayog Internship 2025 can last from six weeks to six months.

  • Minimum duration: 6 weeks
  • Maximum duration: 6 months

⚠️ Important: If an intern leaves before completing the minimum duration, they will not be issued any certificate.

Application Process for NITI Aayog Internship 2025

The application process is completely online. Students can apply via the official portal of NITI Aayog. The portal opens every month from 1st to 10th.

Here is the step-by-step guide:

  1. Visit the official NITI Aayog Internship Portal.
  2. Register with your details (name, email, mobile number).
  3. Fill in your academic details, percentage, and preferred internship month.
  4. Upload necessary documents like mark sheets, ID proof, and recommendation letters (if asked).
  5. Submit the application before the deadline.

👉 The last date to apply for the current cycle of NITI Aayog Internship 2025 is 10th October 2025.

Perks and Benefits

One of the most asked questions is: Does the NITI Aayog Internship 2025 offer a stipend?

The answer is No—there is no monetary stipend. However, the internship offers benefits that are far more valuable in the long run:

  • Certificate of Completion: Issued by the Adviser of the concerned division.
  • Practical Experience: Exposure to policy-making and governance.
  • Networking: Opportunity to connect with policymakers, researchers, and fellow interns.
  • Career Boost: Adds huge value to your resume, especially for those aiming for careers in UPSC, international agencies, consulting, or public policy.

Why You Should Apply for NITI Aayog Internship 2025

Here’s why the NITI Aayog Internship 2025 is highly recommended for students:

  1. Prestige & Recognition: Being associated with India’s top think tank is a huge achievement.
  2. Real Policy Exposure: Unlike private internships, you get to see policymaking up close.
  3. Skill Development: Enhances research, analysis, and communication skills.
  4. Future Opportunities: Many former interns use this experience to apply for higher studies abroad or prestigious jobs.

Important Dates

  • Application window: 1st to 10th October 2025
  • Internship commencement: From December 2025 onwards
  • Minimum duration: 6 weeks
  • Maximum duration: 6 months
APPLY NOW

Tips to Increase Your Selection Chances

  • Maintain a strong academic record (minimum 70–85% required).
  • Prepare a good Statement of Purpose (SOP) highlighting your interest in public policy.
  • Show prior interest in research, economics, or governance.
  • Apply early within the application window.
  • Keep all academic documents ready.

Conclusion

The NITI Aayog Internship 2025 is a golden opportunity for students to gain practical insights into governance, policymaking, and research. Even though it doesn’t offer a stipend, the value of experience, networking, and the certificate makes it one of the most sought-after internships in India.

If you are eligible, don’t wait—make sure you apply before 10th October 2025 and start your journey towards becoming a future policymaker.

Q1. Who can apply for the NITI Aayog Internship 2025?
Ans: Undergraduate (after 2nd year), postgraduate, Ph.D., and fresh graduates (within 6 months) with good academic records can apply.

Q2. Is the NITI Aayog Internship paid?
Ans: No, there is no stipend. However, a certificate is provided upon successful completion.

Q3. What is the duration of the internship?
Ans: Minimum 6 weeks and maximum 6 months.

Q4. What is the last date to apply for the NITI Aayog Internship 2025?
Ans: The deadline is 10th October 2025.

Q5. How can I apply?
Ans: Apply online through the official portal of NITI Aayog.

title.rendered: AKTU Circular 2025: Teachers Salary Payment Information (Bank or Cash)

content.rendered:
Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University (AKTU), Uttar Pradesh, has released an important notification for all affiliated institutions. The AKTU Circular 2025 was issued on 26 August 2025 and focuses on ensuring transparency in the salary payment of teachers working in private degree-level engineering institutions.

The circular refers to the directions given by the Uttar Pradesh Legislative Assembly’s Public Accounts Committee (2024-25) in its meeting held on 04 July 2025. The main concern raised was about the mode of salary payment for teachers—whether they are being paid through bank transfer or cash.

This article covers all the important details of the AKTU Circular 2025, including its purpose, deadlines, and implications for institutions, teachers, and students.

Key Details of AKTU Circular 2025

  • Circular Number: AKTU/Establishment/2025/8390
  • Date of Issue: 26 August 2025
  • Issued by: Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University (AKTU), Lucknow
  • Authority Signatory: Registrar (Reena Singh)
  • Subject: Submission of information regarding salary payment of teachers in affiliated institutions (Bank or Cash)
  • Based on: UP Legislative Assembly Public Accounts Committee meeting (04 July 2025)

Why Was AKTU Circular 2025 Issued?

The AKTU Circular 2025 was issued to address a significant concern regarding the mode of salary payments in private degree-level engineering colleges affiliated with AKTU. The Public Accounts Committee observed that in many institutions, there is no clear record of whether teachers receive their salaries directly in their bank accounts or through cash payments.

The government and the university want to ensure:

  1. Transparency – Teachers must receive salaries in a traceable and legitimate manner.
  2. Accountability – Institutions must disclose and justify their salary payment process.
  3. Record-Keeping – The university and government should have clear records of teacher payments for audit and review.
  4. Financial Security for Teachers – Regular bank payments prevent delays and irregularities in salaries.

By enforcing this circular, AKTU is working to improve trust, governance, and financial discipline across its affiliated institutions.

Instructions for Affiliated Institutions

According to the AKTU Circular 2025, all affiliated institutions are required to submit detailed information about salary payment of their teachers. The instructions are as follows:

  • Institutions must specify whether salaries are being paid through Bank Transfer or Cash.
  • The information must be provided in the prescribed MS Excel format.
  • The report must be submitted within 3 days of receiving the circular.
  • The data must be sent to the following email ID: afrcup1155@gmail.com.

Failure to comply with these instructions within the stipulated timeline may lead to strict action by the authorities.

Where to Submit Information?

  • Format: MS Excel (as prescribed in the circular)
  • Email Address: afrcup1155@gmail.com
  • Timeline: Within 3 days of the issuance of the circular

Who Will Receive Copies of the Circular?

The AKTU Circular 2025 was also forwarded to important offices for necessary action and records:

  1. Secretary, Admission and Fee Regulatory Committee (AFRC), Lucknow
  2. Assistant Registrar, Establishment Section, AKTU
  3. Staff Officer, Vice-Chancellor’s Office, AKTU

This ensures that multiple stakeholders remain informed and can take follow-up actions if institutions fail to submit the required information.

Impact of AKTU Circular 2025 on Teachers

The AKTU Circular 2025 holds great significance for teachers working in affiliated private institutions. Here’s how:

  • Assurance of Transparency: Teachers can be confident that their salaries are officially recorded and monitored.
  • Financial Security: With a push towards bank transfers, salary delays and irregularities are likely to reduce.
  • Job Satisfaction: When financial processes are transparent, teachers can focus more on academics instead of worrying about payments.

Impact of AKTU Circular 2025 on Institutions

For institutions, the circular brings both responsibility and accountability.

  • They must maintain updated salary records.
  • Institutions that still rely on cash-based payments will now have to disclose this officially.
  • Failure to comply could lead to scrutiny from both AKTU and the state government.
  • Colleges will be under pressure to shift towards bank-based salary transfers, which align with modern financial practices.

Why Students Should Care About AKTU Circular 2025

At first glance, this circular might appear to concern only teachers and administrators. However, students are also indirectly affected:

  • Better Teaching Environment: When teachers are paid transparently and on time, their focus remains on teaching rather than salary disputes.
  • Trust in Institutions: Students and parents gain more confidence in institutions that follow proper financial practices.
  • Overall Quality Improvement: Transparent financial systems ultimately enhance the reputation of the university and its affiliated colleges.

READ MORE : Microsoft Internship 2025: Apply for Product Design, Technology Consultant & Cloud Network Engineer Roles

Conclusion

The AKTU Circular 2025 is a vital step towards ensuring transparency, accountability, and good governance in the financial practices of private degree-level engineering institutions affiliated with AKTU.

By mandating institutions to disclose whether salaries are paid via Bank Transfer or Cash, the university is protecting the interests of teachers and improving the credibility of institutions.

This move not only benefits teachers but also has a positive ripple effect on students, parents, and the overall quality of education under AKTU.

Institutions must take this circular seriously and comply within the given timeline to avoid strict action and to support the vision of transparent higher education governance.

title.rendered: Microsoft Internship 2025: Apply for Product Design, Technology Consultant & Cloud Network Engineer Roles

content.rendered:
Are you dreaming of kickstarting your career with one of the world’s top tech giants? If yes, then the Microsoft Internship 2025 program is a golden opportunity for students across India. Microsoft frequently rolls out internship opportunities in different domains such as software engineering, product design, consulting, and cloud technologies. These internships not only provide valuable industry exposure but also open doors to future full-time opportunities.

In this article, we’ll cover:

  • Current Microsoft Internship 2025 openings in India
  • Eligibility criteria and qualifications
  • Application process and tips
  • Skills you need to prepare for Microsoft internships
  • Benefits of joining Microsoft as an intern

Why Choose a Microsoft Internship 2025?

Microsoft is one of the most sought-after companies by students and fresh graduates worldwide. A Microsoft internship allows you to:

  • Work on real-world projects with industry leaders.
  • Gain mentorship from top professionals.
  • Improve your problem-solving, coding, and analytical skills.
  • Strengthen your resume for future placements.
  • Build global-level networking opportunities.

Moreover, these internships are placement-oriented, making them an excellent launchpad for your career in technology, business, or consulting.

Current Microsoft Internship 2025 Openings in India

As of now, there are three active internship opportunities available in India under the Microsoft Internship 2025 program. Here are the details:

1. Product Design Intern

  • Location: Multiple locations across India (offline, not remote)
  • Eligibility:
    • Currently pursuing a bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, Technology, or related fields.
    • Must have at least one semester remaining after completion of the internship.
  • Preferred Qualification:

    • Knowledge of technology solutions and change management.

2. Technology Consultant Intern

Skills Needed for Microsoft Internship 2025

To increase your chances of getting selected for Microsoft Internship 2025, focus on building these essential skills:

  1. Strong Programming Language Knowledge – Be proficient in at least one programming language (Java, C++, Python, or C#).
  2. Data Structures & Algorithms (DSA) – Almost every technical interview at Microsoft revolves around problem-solving and DSA questions.
  3. Problem-Solving Ability – Practice coding questions from platforms like LeetCode, HackerRank, and Codeforces.
  4. Communication & Teamwork – For consulting and product roles, strong communication and stakeholder management skills are highly valued.
  5. Certifications (Optional but Valuable) – Agile, Scrum, and Cloud certifications can give you an extra edge.

Benefits of Microsoft Internship 2025

  • Resume Boost: Stand out during campus placements.

title.rendered: Azim Premji Scholarship 2025: Eligibility, Benefits, Last Date, and Apply Online

content.rendered:
If you are a girl student who has completed Class 12th and taken admission in graduation or diploma courses, the Azim Premji Scholarship 2025 can support your higher education. This scholarship is specially designed for girls who face financial challenges in continuing their studies after school. In this post, we will cover eligibility, benefits, important dates, required documents, and the complete application process.

What is Azim Premji Scholarship 2025?

The Azim Premji Scholarship 2025 is an initiative of the Azim Premji Foundation. It provides financial assistance to girl students who have completed Class 10th and 12th from government schools and have taken admission in undergraduate or diploma courses.

The main aim of this scholarship is to ensure that girls do not drop out of higher education due to financial problems or family pressure.

Eligibility Criteria for Azim Premji Scholarship 2025

  • Only girl students are eligible.
  • Must have passed Class 10th and 12th from a Government School/College.
  • Must have taken admission in the first year of the academic session 2025–26.
  • Admission should be in a regular undergraduate degree or diploma course (BA, B.Sc, B.Com, B.Ed, D.El.Ed, B.Tech, etc.).
  • The duration of the course must be between 2 years and 5 years.
  • Students studying in Private or Government Colleges/Universities can apply.

Eligible States/UTs

The scholarship is not open to all states in India. Only students belonging to the following states/UTs can apply:

Arunachal Pradesh, Assam, Bihar, Chhattisgarh, Jharkhand, Karnataka, Madhya Pradesh, Manipur, Meghalaya, Mizoram, Nagaland, Odisha, Puducherry, Rajasthan, Sikkim, Telangana, Tripura, Uttar Pradesh, and Uttarakhand.

Benefits of Azim Premji Scholarship 2025

  • Scholarship amount of ₹30,000 per year.
  • The amount will be given in two installments of ₹15,000 each.
  • Scholarship will continue for the entire course duration (2 to 5 years).
  • Renewal is required every year, based on academic performance and document submission.

Documents Required

Applicants must upload the following documents while filling out the online application form:

  • Class 10th & 12th Marksheet and Certificate
  • College Admission Proof (Fee Receipt/Admission Letter)
  • Aadhaar Card
  • Passport size Photograph
  • Scanned Signature

All documents must be uploaded in PDF/JPEG format.

Application Process – How to Apply for Azim Premji Scholarship 2025

  1. Visit the official website: azimpremjifoundation.org/scholarship
  2. Click on New Applicant.
  3. Enter your details such as Name, Gender, Mobile Number, and Email ID.
  4. Verify your mobile number with OTP and set a password.
  5. Login using registration credentials.
  6. Fill out the application form and upload the required documents.
  7. Submit the form for review.
  8. Once approved, the scholarship amount will be credited in installments.

Last Date to Apply

  • Round 1 Last Date: 30 September 2025 (till 11:59 PM)
  • Round 2 Last Date: 1 January 2026

This means applications can be submitted twice a year.

Important Points to Remember

  • The scholarship is only for girls.
  • No application fee or hidden charges are required.
  • Renewal is mandatory every year for continuation of the scholarship.
  • Beware of fake agents demanding money for application – the process is completely free.

Conclusion

The Azim Premji Scholarship 2025 is a golden opportunity for girl students who want to pursue higher education but face financial difficulties. title.rendered: AKTU Sports Fest 2025-26: Dates, Events, Rules, and Complete Details

content.rendered:
Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University (AKTU), Lucknow, has officially announced the schedule for its annual sports festival, the AKTU Sports Fest 2025-26. This is one of the most awaited events for students across the university’s affiliated colleges, as it provides them with a chance to participate in different sports, showcase their athletic skills, and represent their institutions at higher levels.

The announcement of the AKTU Sports Fest 2025-26 marks the beginning of an exciting journey for thousands of students across Uttar Pradesh. The university has circulated the official notification to all affiliated colleges, highlighting the schedule, rules, responsibilities of institutions, and the process of submission of required proforma.

In this detailed article, we will cover the schedule of the sports fest, the types of events expected, the rules and regulations, the responsibilities of institutions, and why this fest is so important for students of AKTU.

AKTU Sports Fest 2025-26 Schedule

The University has divided the sports fest into two phases: the zonal level competitions and the state level competitions.

  • The zonal level competitions of the AKTU Sports Fest 2025-26 will be organized from 16 October 2025 to 18 October 2025. These matches will take place at designated zonal centers across the state, and winners from these centers will qualify for the next stage.
  • The state level competitions of the AKTU Sports Fest 2025-26 are scheduled from 6 November 2025 to 8 November 2025. The final rounds will bring together the best teams and athletes from all zones to compete for top honors.

By dividing the fest into two phases, the University ensures equal opportunity for all institutions and also provides a structured platform for students to gradually progress from zonal to state level.

Events and Sports in AKTU Sports Fest 2025-26

While the official list of games and events has been circulated with the notification, based on previous years, the AKTU Sports Fest 2025-26 is expected to include both team sports and individual sports. These commonly include:

  • Athletics such as running, long jump, and shot put
  • Cricket, one of the most popular games among students
  • Football, with zonal matches leading to highly competitive state finals
  • Volleyball and Basketball, both fast-paced team games
  • Badminton and Table Tennis, which test individual focus and reflexes
  • Chess, a mind game that has been part of previous fests
  • Kabaddi and Kho-Kho, traditional Indian sports that bring great energy to the competition

The variety of sports ensures that students from different backgrounds and interests get the chance to participate. This diversity also reflects the University’s vision of promoting both modern and traditional sports equally.

Rules and Regulations of AKTU Sports Fest 2025-26

The University has specified common rules and regulations that will govern both zonal and state level competitions. Some of the key rules include:

  1. Only bonafide students of AKTU-affiliated institutions are allowed to participate in the sports fest.
  2. Every participant must carry valid identity proof issued by the institution.
  3. Teams must be formed according to the official guidelines provided by the University.
  4. The rules of the respective games will apply during the matches, and referees’ decisions will be final.
  5. Students and institutions must strictly follow the principles of fair play and sportsmanship.

These rules are designed to maintain transparency and fairness throughout the fest.

Responsibilities of Institutions

The University has also outlined certain responsibilities for its affiliated institutions regarding the AKTU Sports Fest 2025-26.

  • Colleges are required to encourage and motivate their students to take part in the fest and ensure maximum participation.
  • Each institution must complete and submit the prescribed proforma related to expenditure for the fest.
  • The proforma for the first installment of expenses must be submitted no later than 29 September 2025.
  • The submission must be done through email at dean.sw@aktu.ac.in.
  • Institutions are also expected to provide proper facilities and arrangements for their teams during the zonal and state level competitions.

These steps are crucial for ensuring the smooth functioning of the sports fest at both levels.

Importance of Submitting the Proforma

To manage the finances related to the organization of the fest, the University has requested institutions to submit the required proforma. This allows the University to release the first installment of payment to the zonal and state centers in time. If colleges fail to send the proforma by the deadline, it could delay the financial arrangements for their centers, which might affect the smooth conduct of the competitions.

Therefore, institutions must take this responsibility seriously and complete the submission before the given deadline of 29 September 2025.

Why AKTU Sports Fest 2025-26 is Important for Students

The AKTU Sports Fest 2025-26 is not just another university event. It holds special importance for students in multiple ways.

  • It encourages students to adopt a healthy and active lifestyle, balancing academics with physical fitness.
  • Sports teach leadership qualities, teamwork, discipline, and time management—skills that are equally important in professional life.
  • The fest serves as a platform to identify exceptional talent who can represent AKTU in inter-university or even national-level competitions.
  • Participating in such events boosts confidence, helps students build networks, and provides exposure beyond classroom learning.

For many students, the AKTU Sports Fest becomes one of the most memorable parts of their university life.

Highlights from the Official Circular

The official circular issued by the University provides all necessary details about the organization of the fest. It was released under letter number AKTU/2 Student/2025/8399, dated 26 September 2025. The circular has been signed by Registrar Reena Singh.

The subject of the circular clearly mentions the organization of the Dr. Abdul Kalam Sports Fest 2025-26 and calls upon all affiliated institutions to ensure student participation and timely completion of formalities. Copies of the circular have also been forwarded to the finance officer, exam controller, dean of student welfare, and other key officials for necessary action.

Conclusion

The AKTU Sports Fest 2025-26 is an excellent opportunity for students to showcase their sportsmanship and represent their colleges at a larger stage. With zonal competitions scheduled from 16 to 18 October 2025 and state-level competitions from 6 to 8 November 2025, students should start preparing well in advance.

Institutions must fulfill their responsibilities by submitting the required proforma before 29 September 2025 and by motivating their students to participate in large numbers.

The sports fest is more than just a competition; it is a celebration of energy, teamwork, and determination. For students of AKTU, this is the perfect chance to step onto the field, play with passion, and create memories that last a lifetime.

title.rendered: Uber Software Engineering Internship 2025: Eligibility, Requirements, Tips & How to Apply

content.rendered:
Uber Software Engineering Internship 2025: If you are an aspiring software engineer looking for a top-notch internship in 2025, here’s some exciting news for you. Uber is hiring Software Engineering Interns for January–June 2025 in Bangalore. This is one of the most awaited off-campus opportunities of the year, as Uber is known not only for its cutting-edge technology but also for offering one of the best internship stipends, perks, and career growth opportunities in the industry.

In this detailed guide, we’ll cover everything you need to know about the Uber Software Engineering Internship 2025 — from eligibility criteria to application process, technical requirements, resume tips, and interview preparation strategies.

Why Uber Internship 2025 is a Big Opportunity?

Uber is a global leader in mobility and technology solutions, operating in more than 70 countries. Working here as an intern means exposure to:

  • Real-world large-scale systems.
  • A world-class engineering team.
  • Opportunities to work on impactful projects across domains like Web Development, Android Development, Backend Systems, Data Engineering, and more.
  • A chance to convert the internship into a Pre-Placement Offer (PPO) if you perform well.

For students graduating in 2026, this is a golden chance to kickstart your career with one of the most prestigious tech companies in the world.

Uber Software Engineering Internship 2025 – Key Details

Eligibility Criteria for Uber Internship 2025

The eligibility is simple and clear:

  • You must be enrolled in a Bachelor’s degree program (B.Tech/B.E.).
  • You must be graduating in 2026.
  • You should be available for a 6-month full-time internship from January to June 2025.

That’s it. No extra conditions or specific tech stack requirements. Uber mainly looks for talented programmers with problem-solving ability and strong projects.

What Skills Does Uber Look For?

Unlike many companies that ask for specific frameworks, Uber keeps its requirements flexible. Instead of specific tools, they focus on your resume, coding ability, and projects.

Recommended Skills for Shortlisting:

  1. Programming Proficiency
    • Strong knowledge of at least one Object-Oriented Programming language (C++, Java, Python, or Go).
    • Knowledge of Data Structures & Algorithms (DSA).
  2. Projects Section (Most Important)
    • Uber values high-quality projects.
    • Projects should be unique, complex, modularized, and ideally deployed online.
    • Single-page apps or beginner projects don’t make much impact—focus on solving real problems.
  3. Certifications (Optional)
    • Company-backed certifications (like Oracle, IBM, Microsoft) add value.
    • Avoid adding low-value certifications from random platforms.
  4. Problem-Solving Skills
    • Good coding profiles on platforms like LeetCode, HackerRank, Codeforces add weight to your resume.
    • Participation in hackathons and coding contests is a plus.

How to Make Your Resume Stand Out for Uber Internship 2025?

One of the biggest challenges for students in off-campus placements is not cracking interviews, but getting their resume shortlisted. Here are some tips to help you stand out:

  1. Use a Clean Template
    • Avoid Canva, fancy designs, or colorful templates.
    • Use a formal Overleaf template (ATS-friendly).
  2. Optimize for ATS (Applicant Tracking System)
    • Ensure your resume scores at least 70–75% on ATS tools.
    • Use tools like Resumeworded or Enhancv to check.
  3. Highlight Strong Projects
    • Make sure your projects have unique names, deployment links, and GitHub repositories.
    • Add features like authentication, APIs, or scalability to stand out.
  4. Showcase Competitive Programming or DSA
    • Add coding achievements (like LeetCode rating, solved problems, Codeforces rank).
  5. Internships/Experience
    • If you have any prior internships or freelance work, add them.

Interview Process for Uber Internship 2025

Uber’s interview process is tough but transparent. Here’s what to expect:

  1. Online Assessment
    • Based on Data Structures and Algorithms (DSA).
    • Medium to Hard level problems (LeetCode style).
  2. Technical Interviews (2–3 rounds)
    • DSA coding problems.
    • Questions on CS fundamentals (OOPs, OS, DBMS, Networking).
    • Questions from your resume projects and tech stack.
  3. Hiring Manager/Behavioral Round
    • Questions about teamwork, problem-solving approach, and internship expectations.

👉 Pro Tip: Focus on DSA (Medium–Hard level), Resume Projects, and System Design Basics.

Preparation Tips for Uber Internship 2025

To maximize your chances:

  • Start practicing DSA daily (LeetCode Medium/Hard).
  • Polish your resume projects – deploy them and keep your GitHub updated.
  • Revise CS Fundamentals – OOPs, OS, DBMS, Networking.
  • Take part in mock interviews to boost confidence.
  • Join hackathons or open-source programs to strengthen your profile.

How to Apply for Uber Software Engineering Internship 2025?

  • Applications are live on Uber’s Careers page (link provided in official announcements).
  • Prepare your resume first before applying.
  • Apply ASAP, as such internships close quickly due to high demand.

READ MORE : UP Scholarship 2025 Online Apply: Complete Step-by-Step Guide

Final Thoughts

The Uber Software Engineering Internship 2025 is one of the best off-campus opportunities for students graduating in 2026. With a 6-month duration, excellent pay, and the possibility of a Pre-Placement Offer, this is a dream internship for many.

If you’re serious about getting selected:

  • Focus on your resume quality.
  • Build high-quality projects.
  • Strengthen your DSA skills.
  • Apply as soon as possible before the position closes.

🚀 Don’t wait — prepare your resume today and apply for the Uber Internship 2025 to kickstart your dream career!

title.rendered: AKTU Notice 2025: Update on the Fourth National Chief Secretary Conference in December 2025

content.rendered:
Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University (AKTU), Lucknow, issued a new AKTU Notice 2025 on September 25, 2025. This notice is related to the upcoming Fourth National Chief Secretary Conference, scheduled to be held in December 2025.

In this official circular, AKTU has directed all affiliated institutions to provide an updated status report on the action points highlighted for the conference. These reports must be submitted directly to the Central Control Room, Ministry of MSME, Government of India, with copies also sent to the Government of Uttar Pradesh and AKTU University.

This article explains the details of the notice, its instructions, deadlines, and why it is important for AKTU-affiliated colleges, faculty, and students.

Key Details of AKTU Notice 2025

  • Issued by: Registrar (Reema Singh), AKTU Lucknow
  • Date of Issue: 25th September 2025
  • Letter Number: AKTU/KUSKA/STA/2025/8292
  • Subject: Status update on the action points of the Fourth National Chief Secretary Conference, December 2025
  • Reference: Government of Uttar Pradesh Technical Education Department Letter No. 1/1093076/2025 dated 18.09.2025, and MSME Department, Government of India email dated 11.09.2025

Summary of Instructions

The notice specifies the following points:

  1. All affiliated institutions must follow the instructions given in the Government of Uttar Pradesh letter dated 18th September 2025.
  2. Each institution is required to prepare a report on the progress of action points related to the conference.
  3. The report must be sent to the Ministry of MSME at the email address champions@gov.in.
  4. A copy of the same report must be forwarded to both the U.P. Government and AKTU.
  5. Timely compliance is expected from all institutions.

Submission of Reports

  • Primary email for submission: champions@gov.in (Central Control Room, MSME Department, Government of India)
  • Copies to: Government of Uttar Pradesh and AKTU Lucknow

Attachments with the Notice

The AKTU Notice 2025 refers to:

  • Government of Uttar Pradesh Technical Education Department Letter No. 1/1093076/2025 dated 18th September 2025.
  • MSME Department, Government of India email dated 11th September 2025.

Importance of AKTU Notice 2025

This notice is significant for several reasons:

  1. National-Level Significance: The Fourth National Chief Secretary Conference is an important national event where key governance and MSME-related policies are discussed. Contributions from institutions add value to this conference.
  2. Role of Institutions: Technical universities and affiliated colleges are expected to contribute through research, innovation, and MSME-related initiatives. This notice ensures their involvement at the national level.
  3. Strengthening MSME Sector: MSMEs are the backbone of India’s economy. By engaging educational institutions, the government ensures that entrepreneurship and innovation remain aligned with national goals.

Impact on Students, Faculty, and Institutions

For faculty and researchers, the notice highlights the importance of aligning academic research with national policies. It offers opportunities for collaboration with the MSME sector and for contributing to policy-based reports.

For institutions, compliance with the notice enhances their recognition at a national level. It strengthens their relationship with government departments and opens up more opportunities for funding and research partnerships.

  • Prepare a comprehensive status report on MSME-related initiatives and progress.
  • Submit the report to champions@gov.in.
  • Forward copies to the U.P. Government and AKTU.
  • Maintain records of all communication.
  • Ensure timely submission of reports.

The Chief Secretary Conference is more than just an administrative meeting. It is a platform where national and state-level priorities are reviewed, and strategies for future development are set. It focuses on areas such as governance, MSME development, innovation, and education.

By ensuring participation from institutions like AKTU, the government bridges the gap between education and policy-making. This strengthens the link between technical education and the nation’s economic goals.

title.rendered: AKTU Official Notice: AKTU Enrollment and Examination Form 2025-26 for 1ST Year Students

content.rendered:
Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University (AKTU), Lucknow, has officially released important instructions regarding the enrollment and examination form process for newly admitted students in the academic session 2025-26. This announcement applies to all institutes affiliated with AKTU, covering students admitted through both counseling and management quota.

In this detailed guide, we will explain the AKTU enrollment process 2025-26, examination fee details, document verification, deadlines, and step-by-step instructions to help students complete their registration successfully.

Key Highlights of AKTU Enrollment 2025-26

  • Enrollment and exam form submission dates: September 30, 2025 – October 10, 2025
  • Applicable for: All newly admitted students through counseling and management quota (except B.Pharm course)
  • Document verification dates: October 5, 2025 – October 15, 2025
  • Exam fee:
    • ₹7,500 for all undergraduate courses (except B.Pharm)
    • ₹10,000 for postgraduate courses
  • Hard copy submission deadline: Within three working days after document verification

The focus keyword: AKTU enrollment 2025-26 will be used frequently in this article to ensure students searching online can find this information easily.

AKTU Enrollment 2025-26: Important Dates

Students admitted in the 2025-26 session must complete the enrollment process through the university’s ERP portal. The official schedule is as follows:

Missing these deadlines may result in serious consequences, as the responsibility will rest entirely on the concerned institute.

Step-by-Step Guide for AKTU Enrollment 2025-26

Here is the complete process for AKTU enrollment 2025-26:

1. Online Form Filling

  • Students must log in to the AKTU ERP portal using the credentials provided by their institute.
  • Fill in all personal and academic details carefully.
  • Upload scanned copies of required documents (educational certificates, ID proof, and admission-related papers).

2. Payment of Exam Fees

  • Students are required to pay the examination fee online through the ERP portal.
  • Fee structure:
    • Undergraduate courses (except B.Pharm): ₹7,500
    • Postgraduate courses: ₹10,000

3. Document Verification

  • Document verification will be carried out between October 5 and October 15, 2025.
  • University-appointed verifiers will mark entries, which will appear in the institute’s login.
  • Institutes must upload these verified entries as per the university’s procedure.

4. Submission of Hard Copies

  • After document verification, students must submit a hard copy of the enrollment form along with the original migration certificate at their institute.
  • The institute is required to send these documents to the university within three working days.

Examination Fee Details

The examination fee for AKTU enrollment 2025-26 varies according to the course:

  • Undergraduate Programs (except B.Pharm): ₹7,500
  • Postgraduate Programs: ₹10,000

This fee must be paid online only via the ERP portal at the time of enrollment.

Responsibilities of Institutes

AKTU has made it clear that institutes play a crucial role in ensuring smooth completion of the enrollment process. Key responsibilities include:

  • Ensuring all newly admitted students complete their enrollment by October 10, 2025.
  • Verifying student documents during the official verification window (October 5 – October 15).
  • Uploading verifier entries correctly on the ERP portal.
  • Submitting hard copies of enrollment forms and original migration certificates to the university within three working days after verification.

Failure to comply may lead to accountability issues for the concerned institute.

Why AKTU Enrollment 2025-26 is Important

Enrollment is not just a formality; it is an essential step for:

  1. University Registration – Without enrollment, students will not be officially registered under AKTU.
  2. Examination Eligibility – Only enrolled students can fill the exam forms and appear in semester exams.
  3. Student Verification – Ensures that only genuine students with valid documents are part of the academic session.
  4. Record Management – Enrollment helps AKTU maintain accurate academic and administrative records.

Common Mistakes to Avoid

To ensure a smooth AKTU enrollment 2025-26 process, students should avoid these common errors:

  • Submitting incomplete or incorrect details in the ERP portal.
  • Uploading blurred or invalid documents.
  • Missing the deadline of October 10, 2025 for enrollment.
  • Not submitting the hard copy of the enrollment form and migration certificate within the given timeframe.

Tips for Students

  • Keep all documents ready in advance (Mark sheets, Transfer Certificate, Migration Certificate, ID proof, and Passport-size photographs).
  • Double-check personal details like name, father’s name, date of birth, and course details before submission.
  • Pay the exam fee early to avoid last-minute server issues.
  • Track institute updates regarding document verification.

READ MORE : AKTU Pre-Registration 2025: Complete Guide for Newly Admitted Students

Final Thoughts

The AKTU enrollment 2025-26 process is a critical requirement for all newly admitted students. With clear instructions, specified deadlines, and a step-by-step procedure, students must complete this process carefully to secure their academic journey under AKTU.

By following the official guidelines, paying the exam fee on time, and ensuring document verification, students can avoid unnecessary complications later. Institutes must also take responsibility for timely completion of enrollment and submission of documents to the university.

For students, the key takeaway is simple: Complete your AKTU enrollment 2025-26 on time, keep your documents ready, and double-check every step. This will ensure you are eligible to appear in exams and smoothly continue your academic journey.

title.rendered: AKTU Pre-Registration 2025: Complete Guide for Newly Admitted Students

content.rendered:
Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University (AKTU), Lucknow has released an important notification for newly admitted students regarding the AKTU Pre-Registration 2025 process. Many students who have already been allotted a registration number have not yet completed their pre-registration. To help them, the university has opened the ERP portal for a specific time window, allowing all such students to complete the process.

In this article, we will cover every detail you need to know about AKTU Pre-Registration 2025 including dates, eligibility, step-by-step procedure, important instructions, and why it is essential for every new student.

What is AKTU Pre-Registration 2025?

When students take admission into any institute affiliated with AKTU for the academic session 2025-26, they are required to complete a process called pre-registration through the university’s ERP (Enterprise Resource Planning) portal.

This pre-registration ensures that the student’s personal details, academic details, and allotted registration number are properly verified and stored in the official university database. Without completing this process, the student’s name will not be included in the final registration list of the university, which can create issues in future examinations and academic activities.

Official Notification Highlights

As per the official circular (Letter No: AKTU/Naamankan-35/2025/2277 dated 20th September 2025):

  • Students who have already been allotted a registration number but have not yet completed their pre-registration process will get a final chance.
  • The AKTU ERP portal will remain open for pre-registration between 23rd September 2025 (from 1:00 PM) to 25th September 2025 (till 11:59 PM).
  • All affiliated institutes are directed to ensure that every newly admitted student completes their pre-registration within this given time frame.

AKTU Pre-Registration 2025 Dates

Students must strictly follow this timeline as no further extension has been announced by the university.

Who Needs to Complete Pre-Registration?

The following category of students must complete AKTU Pre-Registration 2025:

  • All newly admitted students of session 2025-26 in AKTU-affiliated institutes.
  • Students who already have their registration number but could not complete the pre-registration earlier due to any reason.

If you fall into this category, it is mandatory for you to complete the process before the last date.

Step-by-Step Guide to Complete AKTU Pre-Registration 2025

Follow the steps below carefully to avoid mistakes while completing your pre-registration:

  1. Visit the ERP Portal
    • Go to the official AKTU ERP website: erp.aktu.ac.in.
  2. Login with Registration Number
    • Enter your allotted registration number and login credentials.
  3. Fill Required Details
    • Provide your personal information such as name, date of birth, parent details, and contact information.
    • Enter your academic details, including admission details, course, and institute.
  4. Verify Information
    • Cross-check all the information carefully. Any wrong entry may create problems in the future.
  5. Submit the Form
    • Once verified, submit the form to complete your AKTU Pre-Registration 2025.
  6. Take Printout
    • Download and keep a printout of the acknowledgement for future reference.

Importance of AKTU Pre-Registration 2025

Completing pre-registration is not just a formality, but a crucial step for every student. Here’s why it matters:

  • Inclusion in University Records – Without completing pre-registration, your details will not be updated in AKTU’s official database.
  • Eligibility for Examinations – Only students who complete pre-registration will be considered eligible for appearing in semester exams.
  • Scholarship and Benefits – Government or university scholarships often require valid registration; incomplete pre-registration may block such benefits.
  • Smooth Academic Journey – From hall tickets to mark sheets, everything depends on proper registration.

Instructions for Institutes

The circular has also directed all affiliated institutions to take necessary steps to inform and assist students in completing their AKTU Pre-Registration 2025. Directors and Principals of institutions must ensure that:

  • All students are notified about the pre-registration window.
  • Necessary guidance and computer facilities are provided for students facing difficulties.
  • No student is left out from the pre-registration process before the last date.

Common Mistakes to Avoid

While completing the AKTU Pre-Registration 2025 process, students often make some errors. Keep the following points in mind:

  • Do not wait till the last moment; servers may slow down due to heavy traffic.
  • Ensure that your registration number is entered correctly.
  • Double-check spellings of your name, father’s name, and course details.
  • Always keep a copy of your submitted form and acknowledgement.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

Q1. What happens if I do not complete AKTU Pre-Registration 2025 within the deadline?
Ans: Your registration will remain incomplete and you may not be eligible for exams, results, and other academic processes.

Q2. Can I edit my details after submission?
Ans: Students should carefully fill the form. Minor corrections may be possible through the institute, but it is better to enter correct details in the first attempt.

Q3. Is the pre-registration process online or offline?
Ans: The entire process is online through the AKTU ERP portal.

Q4. I have not received my registration number yet. Can I do pre-registration?
Ans: No, only students who already have their registration number can proceed with pre-registration.

Read more : AKTU Invites Startups to UP International Trade Show 2025 at Greater Noida

Conclusion

The AKTU Pre-Registration 2025 process is a critical step for all newly admitted students in the academic session 2025-26. The university has clearly mentioned that students who already have a registration number but haven’t completed pre-registration must do so between 23rd September to 25th September 2025 on the ERP portal.

Students are strongly advised not to delay and complete the process at the earliest. Institutes must also ensure that no student is left behind in this process. Completing pre-registration on time will ensure a smooth academic journey, hassle-free examinations, and access to scholarships.

So, if you are a newly admitted student at AKTU or its affiliated institutes, don’t miss this final opportunity to complete your AKTU Pre-Registration 2025.

title.rendered: AKTU Invites Startups to UP International Trade Show 2025 at Greater Noida

content.rendered:
Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University (AKTU), Lucknow, has issued an official circular inviting its affiliated institutes, startups, and students to actively participate in the UP International Trade Show 2025, which will be held from 25th to 29th September 2025 at India Expo Mart, Greater Noida, Uttar Pradesh.

The event is being organized on a grand scale with the participation of 70 countries and more than 5 lakh visitors, making it one of the most significant international trade shows in India this year. AKTU’s Innovation Hub will represent the university and showcase over 40 startups from its incubation ecosystem. These startups will present their innovative products and services at the Innovation Hub Stall, Hall No. 5, Stall No. 08/08.

This announcement opens doors for students, faculty, entrepreneurs, and innovators to gain international exposure, connect with industry leaders, and explore new opportunities in technology and entrepreneurship.

What is the UP International Trade Show 2025?

The UP International Trade Show (UPITS) is a flagship event organized by the Government of Uttar Pradesh to highlight the state’s growth, investment potential, and startup ecosystem. The 2025 edition is expected to be the largest so far, with global participation from over 70 countries.

Some key highlights include:

  • 5 days of exhibitions at India Expo Mart, Greater Noida.
  • Participation of 150+ startups from across India.
  • Showcasing of innovative technologies, products, and services across different sectors.
  • Networking opportunities with investors, policymakers, entrepreneurs, and industry experts.

For AKTU students and startups, this trade show is more than just an exhibition—it is a global learning experience.

AKTU’s Role in UP International Trade Show 2025

The Innovation Hub of AKTU is leading the university’s participation in the event. Here’s what AKTU is contributing:

  • 40+ Startups from AKTU Incubation Centers will be displayed at the Innovation Hub stall.
  • Hall No. 5, Stall No. 08/08 will serve as the official AKTU space.
  • AKTU will provide its student innovators and entrepreneurs a platform to demonstrate their creativity, technical skills, and entrepreneurial mindset.

This presence emphasizes AKTU’s strong commitment to fostering a startup culture and innovation-driven learning ecosystem.

Benefits for AKTU Students and Startups

Participation in the UP International Trade Show 2025 comes with multiple benefits for AKTU students, faculty, and incubated startups. Some of the most important advantages are:

1. Global Exposure

Students and startups will showcase their work to international visitors, including investors, government officials, and entrepreneurs from over 70 countries. This provides visibility on a global stage.

2. Networking Opportunities

The trade show brings together venture capitalists, angel investors, industry leaders, and policymakers. Networking at this event can open new doors for funding, mentorship, and collaborations.

3. Real-World Learning Experience

Entrepreneurship and innovation are best learned outside the classroom. By interacting with professionals and potential investors, students will understand how the startup ecosystem works at a global level.

4. Opportunities for Non-Incubated Students

Even institutions that do not have incubation centers are encouraged to send their faculty members and students. For them, this is a chance to learn from live startup experiences, interact with innovators, and explore entrepreneurial pathways.

5. Future Prospects

Participation in such international events helps students build confidence, presentation skills, and professional networks that may support them in their career and startup journey.

AKTU’s Call to Action for Institutes

The circular issued by AKTU clearly states the following instructions for affiliated colleges:

  • Institutes with incubation centers must ensure the participation of their startup teams, managers, and faculty in-charges.
  • Institutes without incubation centers are encouraged to send interested faculty members and students to visit the AKTU stall.
  • The circular urges colleges to circulate this information among students and encourage maximum participation.

By doing this, AKTU aims to strengthen the entrepreneurship and innovation ecosystem across all its affiliated institutes.

Event Details at a Glance

Here is a quick summary of the event details for easy reference:

How to Register for Participation

To attend the UP International Trade Show 2025, all visitors and participants must register online.

👉 Click here to register: UP International Trade Show 2025 Domestic Visitor Registration

Once registered, participants will receive passes to attend the event. It is recommended that all AKTU-affiliated colleges complete registration at the earliest to avoid last-minute delays.

Message from AKTU Leadership

Prof. B.N. Mishra, Dean of Innovation & Social Entrepreneurship at AKTU, has emphasized that this trade show is a “valuable opportunity for startups and students to engage with the wider startup ecosystem, gain exposure, and build meaningful networks.”

His message encourages both startups and students to actively participate and make the most of this international platform.

Why AKTU’s Participation is Important

AKTU’s active involvement in the UP International Trade Show highlights:

  • The university’s commitment to promoting innovation and entrepreneurship.
  • Its role in building global exposure for students.
  • The support it provides to young innovators through incubation centers.

By showcasing 40+ startups, AKTU is not only supporting its students and entrepreneurs but also contributing to Uttar Pradesh’s vision of becoming a hub for innovation-driven development.

Conclusion

The UP International Trade Show 2025 at Greater Noida is a massive opportunity for AKTU students, startups, and affiliated institutions. With the participation of 70 countries and over 5 lakh visitors, it is a platform that promises global networking, collaboration, and learning.

AKTU’s Innovation Hub is set to showcase the creativity and entrepreneurial spirit of its startups, while students and faculty members will get a chance to learn, engage, and grow in the global startup ecosystem.

If you are part of AKTU’s incubation ecosystem or a student passionate about innovation, this is your chance to shine at an international platform. Don’t miss it!

content.rendered:
UP Scholarship 2025 Online Apply process has officially started, and this year the government has introduced a mandatory OTR (One Time Registration) system for all students. अगर आप SC, ST, OBC, Minority या General Category से आते हैं और 9वीं से 12वीं तक पढ़ाई कर रहे हैं, तो यह आर्टिकल आपके लिए बहुत मददगार होने वाला है। यहां हम आपको विस्तार से बताएंगे कि UP Scholarship 2025 Online Apply कैसे करना है, OTR नंबर कैसे जनरेट करना है और पूरी आवेदन प्रक्रिया क्या है।

Why UP Scholarship 2025 is Important for Students?

उत्तर प्रदेश सरकार हर साल लाखों छात्रों को UP Scholarship उपलब्ध कराती है। इसका मकसद यह है कि आर्थिक रूप से कमजोर छात्रों की पढ़ाई बिना किसी रुकावट के चलती रहे।

  • यह स्कॉलरशिप प्री-मैट्रिक (9वीं-10वीं),
  • पोस्ट-मैट्रिक (11वीं-12वीं)
  • और उच्च शिक्षा (Graduation, Diploma, ITI, Polytechnic, PG, PhD) के छात्रों के लिए लागू होती है।

इस बार का सबसे बड़ा बदलाव यह है कि UP Scholarship 2025 Online Apply करने के लिए OTR Registration अनिवार्य कर दिया गया है।

Step 1: OTR Registration (वन टाइम रजिस्ट्रेशन)

UP Scholarship 2025 Online Apply करने से पहले आपको OTR Registration करना जरूरी है।

  1. सबसे पहले अपने ब्राउज़र में Scholarship UP सर्च करें या ऑफिशियल पोर्टल पर जाएं।
  2. यहां आपको OTR पंजीकरण करें का ऑप्शन मिलेगा, उस पर क्लिक करें।
  3. “I Agree” पर क्लिक करके आगे बढ़ें।
  4. अब अपनी Category चुनें –
    • अनुसूचित जाति (SC)
    • अनुसूचित जनजाति (ST)
    • अन्य पिछड़ा वर्ग (OBC)
    • अल्पसंख्यक वर्ग (Minority)
    • सामान्य वर्ग (General)
  5. इसके बाद अपना मोबाइल नंबर डालें और Captcha दर्ज करें।
  6. OTP आएगा, उसे वेरिफाई करें।
  7. अब Aadhaar Number दर्ज करें और OTP के जरिए आधार को Verify करें।
  8. आपको DigiLocker में लॉगिन करके एक 6 Digit Security PIN सेट करना होगा।
  9. Aadhaar Verification के बाद आपके सामने पूरा डेटा आ जाएगा।
  10. सारी डिटेल Verify करने के बाद आपका UTR Number जनरेट हो जाएगा।

👉 इस UTR Number को सुरक्षित रखना बेहद जरूरी है क्योंकि आगे फॉर्म भरते समय यही काम आएगा।

Step 2: New Registration for UP Scholarship 2025

OTR Registration के बाद अब आपको New Registration करना होगा।

  1. होम पेज पर जाएं और Student → New Registration पर क्लिक करें।
  2. यहां अलग-अलग कैटेगरी के लिए विकल्प मिलेंगे –
    • SC / ST / General
    • OBC
    • Minority
  3. इसके बाद चुनें कि आप Pre-Matric (9वीं-10वीं) या Post-Matric (11वीं-12वीं) या Higher Education में पढ़ रहे हैं।
  4. अपना UTR Number और पासवर्ड डालें।
  5. अब जिला और स्कूल/कॉलेज का नाम चुनें।
  6. 6 से 12 अंकों का एक पासवर्ड सेट करें और Confirm करें।
  7. Captcha दर्ज करें और Submit करें।
  8. आपका Registration Slip जनरेट होगा। इसे Print या PDF में Save कर लें।

Step 3: UP Scholarship 2025 Application Form भरना

अब आपको Scholarship Form भरना होगा।

  1. Login Fresh पर क्लिक करें और Pre-Matric / Post-Matric ऑप्शन चुनें।
  2. अपना UTR Number और Password डालें।
  3. अब फॉर्म खुल जाएगा, जहां आपको ये डिटेल भरनी होंगी –
    • स्कूल/कॉलेज का नाम
    • कक्षा में प्रवेश की तारीख
    • बोर्ड का Registration Number
    • Transfer Certificate (अगर स्कूल बदला है तो)
    • पिछली कक्षा पास करने का वर्ष और स्कूल का नाम
    • Pin Code
  4. सभी डिटेल भरकर Submit करें।

Step 4: Income & Caste Certificate Verification

UP Scholarship 2025 Online Apply में Income और Caste Certificate Verify करना अनिवार्य है।

  • Income Certificate:
    • आवेदन संख्या और प्रमाण पत्र क्रमांक दर्ज करें।
    • Captcha डालकर “Get Data” पर क्लिक करें।
    • ऑटोमेटिक फैमिली इनकम फेच हो जाएगी।
  • Caste Certificate:
    • प्रमाण पत्र संख्या दर्ज करें।
    • सब-कास्ट ऑटोमेटिक आ जाएगी।
    • Verify करके Submit करें।

Step 5: Final Submission & Print

  1. सभी डिटेल Verify करने के बाद Final Submission करें।
  2. Application Form Print करें।
  3. इस Form को अपने School/College में जमा करना जरूरी है।
  4. संस्था द्वारा Verification के बाद ही आपका Scholarship Approve होगा।

Read more in detail about U.P. Scholarship:

  1. https://notesgallery.com/aktu-scholarship-2025-26-naac-nba-exemption/
  2. https://notesgallery.com/aktu-scholarship-2025-post-matric-scheme-process/
  3. https://notesgallery.com/up-scholarship-2025-post-matric-application-dates/

Common Mistakes to Avoid in UP Scholarship 2025 Online Apply

  • UTR Number गलत दर्ज करना।
  • Income Certificate गलत नाम से लगाना (यह माता या पिता के नाम पर होना चाहिए)।
  • आधार कार्ड और नाम की स्पेलिंग में अंतर होना।
  • गलत Category चुनना।
  • पासवर्ड भूल जाना।

Benefits of UP Scholarship 2025

  • SC, ST, OBC, Minority और General Category के Students को फायदा।
  • आर्थिक बोझ कम होता है।
  • Higher Studies करने में आसानी होती है।
  • Transparent Online Process से सीधे Bank Account में पैसा।

FAQs on UP Scholarship 2025 Online Apply

Q1. UP Scholarship 2025 Online Apply कब तक कर सकते हैं?
Ans: इसकी Official Last Date Government द्वारा जारी की जाती है। Students को समय रहते Apply करना चाहिए।

Q2. OTR Number भूल गया हूं, क्या कर सकता हूं?
Ans: Portal पर “Forget OTR” का विकल्प मिलता है। आप दोबारा Recover कर सकते हैं।

Q3. क्या Income Certificate Student के नाम से बन सकता है?
Ans: नहीं, Income Certificate माता या पिता (जो भी कमाता है) के नाम से बनना चाहिए।

Q4. Scholarship की राशि सीधे Bank Account में कब आती है?
Ans: Verification Process पूरा होने के बाद राशि सीधे DBT के जरिए आपके खाते में Transfer होती है।

READ MORE : Government Internships in India 2025: Complete Guide, Eligibility, Stipend & Deadlines

Conclusion

अगर आप उत्तर प्रदेश में पढ़ाई कर रहे हैं और सरकारी स्कॉलरशिप का लाभ उठाना चाहते हैं, तो आपको UP Scholarship 2025 Online Apply प्रक्रिया को सही तरीके से पूरा करना होगा। इस बार OTR Registration सबसे जरूरी स्टेप है जिसे हर छात्र को करना अनिवार्य है।

सभी Step ध्यान से Follow करें, Certificates को सही तरीके से Upload करें और Final Print जरूर अपने School/College में जमा करें। इस तरीके से आप आसानी से UP Scholarship 2025 का लाभ उठा पाएंगे।

👉 अगर आपको यह गाइड पसंद आई हो तो इसे अपने दोस्तों के साथ जरूर शेयर करें।

title.rendered: Government Internships in India 2025: Complete Guide, Eligibility, Stipend & Deadlines

content.rendered:
When students think about building their careers, most of them imagine private companies, MNCs, or startups. But did you know that Government Internships in India 2025 are among the most valuable opportunities you can grab? These internships not only provide exposure to real-world policymaking and governance but also offer stipends, certificates, and the chance to work on projects that impact millions of people.

The problem is—many students miss out. Not because they don’t have the skills, but because they don’t know when, where, or how to apply. Unlike private companies, there is no single portal for all government internships. Each ministry, department, or regulator has its own timeline and process.

That’s why in this article, we are giving you a complete roadmap of the top Government Internships in India 2025. We will cover internships that are open all year round as well as those with fixed deadlines. No matter whether you are from engineering, commerce, finance, arts, or science—you will find an internship here that fits your profile.

Why Apply for Government Internships in India 2025?

Before diving into the list, let’s understand why these internships are worth your time:

  • Hands-on exposure to policymaking, governance, and administration.
  • Stipends ranging from ₹8,000 to ₹70,000 per month.
  • Prestigious recognition that adds weight to your resume.
  • Opportunity to work on real issues such as renewable energy, foreign relations, banking, women empowerment, and stock markets.
  • Networking with policymakers, researchers, and professionals.

Clearly, Government Internships in India 2025 are not just about learning—they are career boosters.

Government Internships Open All Year Round

Some internships don’t have a fixed cycle. You can apply any month of the year.

1. NITI Aayog Internship 2025

  • Eligibility: Undergraduate, postgraduate, or research students with at least 70% marks.
  • Duration: 6 weeks to 6 months.
  • Application Window: Open from 1st to 10th of every month.
  • How to Apply: Visit the official NITI Aayog Internship Portal.
  • Work Profile: Policy research, documentation, data analysis.

💡 This is one of the most popular Government Internships in India 2025 because it offers exposure to high-level policymaking.

2. Ministry of Women & Child Development (MWCD) Internship

  • Duration: 2 months (Four terms: May–June, Aug–Sept, Nov–Dec, Feb–March).
  • Application Dates: 1st to 10th of the preceding month for each batch.
  • Work Profile: Report writing, policy analysis, documentation, data support.
  • How to Apply: Register and fill out the application form on the MWCD portal.

This internship is a great choice for students passionate about social work and policy improvement.

3. SECI (Solar Energy Corporation of India) Internship

  • Eligibility: Engineering, MBA, CA, CS, ICWA, CMA students.
  • Duration:
    • Engineering: 3–6 months
    • MBA: 7 weeks–6 months
    • CA/CS/ICWA: Up to 3 years
  • Stipend: ₹8,000 – ₹12,000 per month.
  • Application Window: 1st–10th of every month.
  • How to Apply: Submit your application on the SECI website.

SECI offers an incredible opportunity in the renewable energy sector—a field that’s booming in India.

Government Internships in India 2025 With Fixed Deadlines

Some government internships follow a strict cycle. Missing the deadline means waiting an entire year.

4. Ministry of External Affairs (MEA) Internship

  • Duration: 6 months (Two terms – April–Sept & Oct–March).
  • Eligibility: Final-year undergraduates and recent graduates.
  • Application Timeline:
    • Term 1: Jan–Feb
    • Term 2: July–Aug
  • Stipend: ₹10,000 per month.
  • How to Apply: Apply online via MEA Internship Portal.
  • Work Profile: Research, report writing, policy analysis, foreign relations.

This is one of the most prestigious Government Internships in India 2025 because you work directly with India’s foreign policy makers.

5. RBI Summer Placement Internship

  • Eligibility: Pre-final year students of any degree program.
  • Duration: 3 months.
  • Application Timeline: 15th Oct – 15th Dec.
  • Stipend: ₹20,000 per month.
  • How to Apply: Apply through the RBI careers page.

This internship is highly competitive and provides deep exposure to the central banking environment.

6. RBI Research Internship

  • Eligibility: Students pursuing or planning PhD in Economics, Finance, Banking, etc.
  • Duration: 6 months (Mumbai-based).
  • Application Timeline:
    • Jan–May (for July batch)
    • July–Nov (for Jan batch)
  • Stipend: ₹45,000 per month.
  • How to Apply: Download form from RBI website and email it along with CV, SOP, and references.

This is ideal for students who want a research career in economics or finance.

7. SEBI Internships

SEBI, the regulator of India’s stock market, offers multiple Government Internships in India 2025.

a) SEBI Young Professional Program (YPP)

  • Duration: 1 year.
  • Eligibility: Students, graduates, and postgraduates.
  • Stipend: ₹70,000 per month.
  • Application Timeline: Usually August–September.
  • Work Profile: Stock market operations, fintech, cybersecurity, digital systems.

b) SEBI ITD Internship

  • Duration: Flexible (3–4 days a week).
  • Stipend:
    • ₹25,000 (3 days/week)
    • ₹30,000 (4 days/week)
  • Application Timeline: January (via college placement cell).

c) SEBI Financial Content Writing Internship

  • Duration: 1 year.
  • Stipend: ₹45,000 per month (₹35,000 with accommodation).
  • Application Timeline: October.
  • How to Apply: Submit application by post to SEBI HQ, Mumbai.

SEBI internships are some of the highest-paying government internships in India 2025, perfect for finance and IT students.

Comparison Table: Government Internships in India 2025

Tips to Secure Government Internships in India 2025

  1. Prepare a strong resume highlighting academics, projects, and relevant skills.
  2. Write a professional Statement of Purpose (SOP)—most ministries ask for it.
  3. Apply early (don’t wait till the last day).
  4. Stay updated by regularly checking official portals.
  5. Build references—letters of recommendation increase your chances.

Final Thoughts

If you are a student aiming to boost your career, Government Internships in India 2025 are golden opportunities. From policymaking at NITI Aayog to financial regulation at SEBI, from international relations at MEA to banking research at RBI—these internships cover every field.

The best part? Many of them offer good stipends, certificates, and exposure to national-level projects. Whether you’re from engineering, commerce, arts, or finance, there is definitely a program waiting for you.

So, mark the deadlines, keep your documents ready, and start applying. Your next big career break could be just one government internship away.
