UP Scholarship 2025 (उत्तर प्रदेश छात्रवृत्ति योजना) का नया शासनादेश 10 जून 2025 को जारी किया गया है। इसमें वित्तीय वर्ष शैक्षिक सत्र 2025-26 के लिए दशमोत्तर छात्रवृत्ति (Post-Matric Scholarship) की पूरी समय-सारिणी (Time Table) तय कर दी गई है। यह योजना सामान्य वर्ग, अन्य पिछड़ा वर्ग (OBC), और अल्पसंख्यक वर्ग के उन छात्रों के लिए है जो उच्च कक्षाओं (Intermediate, UG, PG, Diploma, Technical Courses आदि) में अध्ययनरत हैं।

इस आर्टिकल में हम विस्तार से जानेंगे:

  • UP Scholarship 2025 का उद्देश्य
  • पात्रता (Eligibility Criteria)
  • आवेदन प्रक्रिया (Application Process)
  • शासनादेश में जारी समय-सारिणी (Official Timeline)
  • जरूरी दस्तावेज
  • Renewal और Verification प्रक्रिया
  • FAQs

UP Scholarship 2025 का उद्देश्य

उत्तर प्रदेश सरकार का मुख्य उद्देश्य है कि कोई भी छात्र आर्थिक कठिनाई के कारण शिक्षा से वंचित न रहे। इस योजना के अंतर्गत छात्रों को शैक्षणिक भत्ता (Maintenance Allowance) और शुल्क प्रतिपूर्ति (Fee Reimbursement) दिया जाएगा।

इस बार की UP Scholarship 2025 योजना को लेकर सरकार ने सख्त समय-सारिणी (Strict Timeline) जारी की है ताकि आवेदन से लेकर राशि वितरण तक की पूरी प्रक्रिया पारदर्शी और समयबद्ध तरीके से पूरी हो।

UP Scholarship 2025 Eligibility Criteria

  1. Domicile: छात्र उत्तर प्रदेश का मूल निवासी होना चाहिए।
  2. Educational Qualification: छात्र किसी मान्यता प्राप्त संस्थान में अध्ययनरत हो।
  3. Category: सामान्य वर्ग (EWS), OBC, और अल्पसंख्यक वर्ग।
  4. Income Criteria:
    • सामान्य वर्ग (EWS): ₹2,00,000 तक
    • OBC: ₹2,00,000 तक
    • अल्पसंख्यक वर्ग: ₹2,00,000 तक

UP Scholarship 2025 Important Dates (Official Time Table)

नीचे दी गई तालिका शासनादेश में बताई गई प्रमुख तिथियों को दर्शाती है:

UP Scholarship 2025 Application Process

  1. पोर्टल पर रजिस्ट्रेशन – scholarship.up.gov.in पर जाएं और नए छात्र पंजीकरण (New Registration) पर क्लिक करें।
  2. लॉगिन और आवेदन फॉर्म भरना – व्यक्तिगत विवरण, शैक्षिक जानकारी, बैंक डिटेल्स दर्ज करें।
  3. दस्तावेज अपलोड करना – आवश्यक प्रमाणपत्र और मार्कशीट स्कैन करके अपलोड करें।
  4. Final Submit – आवेदन की जांच कर अंतिम सब्मिशन करें।
  5. हार्ड कॉपी जमा करना – आवेदन का प्रिंट निकालकर सभी दस्तावेजों के साथ संस्थान में जमा करें।

Documents Required for UP Scholarship 2025

  • आधार कार्ड
  • जाति प्रमाण पत्र
  • आय प्रमाण पत्र (1 अप्रैल 2025 के बाद जारी)
  • पिछली कक्षा की मार्कशीट
  • प्रवेश पत्र और फीस रसीद
  • बैंक पासबुक (DBT के लिए आधार से लिंक)
  • पासपोर्ट साइज फोटो

Renewal Process for UP Scholarship 2025

  • पुराने छात्र Renewal Login से आवेदन करेंगे।
  • नई कक्षा का विवरण, पिछली कक्षा का परिणाम और नए दस्तावेज अपलोड करें।
  • आय प्रमाणपत्र फिर से जमा करना होगा।
  • Final Submit और संस्थान द्वारा सत्यापन करवाना अनिवार्य है।

Verification & Rejection Rules

छात्रवृत्ति के दौरान आवेदन कई कारणों से निरस्त हो सकता है। सामान्य गलतियां:

  • बैंक डिटेल्स गलत भरना
  • आय या जाति प्रमाण पत्र अमान्य होना
  • आधार कार्ड में नाम/जन्मतिथि मेल न खाना
  • एक ही छात्र द्वारा दो आवेदन करना
  • हार्ड कॉपी समय पर जमा न करना

Benefits of UP Scholarship 2025

  • आर्थिक रूप से कमजोर छात्रों को सहारा।
  • शैक्षणिक शुल्क की प्रतिपूर्ति (Fee Reimbursement)।
  • Maintenance Allowance सीधे बैंक खाते में।
  • छात्रों को उच्च शिक्षा में निरंतरता।
  • DBT सिस्टम से पारदर्शिता।

FAQs: UP Scholarship 2025

Q1. UP Scholarship 2025 के लिए आवेदन कब से शुरू होगा?

👉 शासनादेश के अनुसार, आवेदन 10 जुलाई 2025 से शुरू होंगे।

Q2. अंतिम तिथि क्या है?

👉 छात्रों के लिए आवेदन की अंतिम तिथि 20 दिसम्बर 2025 है।

Q3. क्या सामान्य वर्ग के छात्र भी आवेदन कर सकते हैं?

👉 हां, सामान्य वर्ग (EWS) के छात्र भी पात्रता और आय सीमा पूरी करने पर आवेदन कर सकते हैं।

Q4. राशि कब मिलेगी?

👉 PFMS प्रणाली के माध्यम से जनवरी 2026 से मार्च 2026 तक किस्तों में छात्रवृत्ति का भुगतान होगा।

Q5. क्या Renewal छात्रों के लिए भी वही प्रक्रिया है?

👉 Renewal छात्रों को केवल नई कक्षा और मार्कशीट अपडेट करनी होगी।

READ MORE : AKTU Scholarship 2025: Government Order on Time-Table for Post-Matric Scholarship Payment

निष्कर्ष

UP Scholarship 2025 उत्तर प्रदेश के लाखों छात्रों के लिए एक बड़ी राहत है। सरकार ने इस बार पूरी प्रक्रिया के लिए कठोर टाइमलाइन तय की है ताकि छात्रवृत्ति समय पर छात्रों तक पहुंच सके।

यदि आप भी उच्च कक्षाओं में अध्ययनरत हैं, तो समय पर आवेदन करें और सभी दस्तावेज सही तरीके से अपलोड करें।

👉 अधिक जानकारी और आवेदन के लिए आधिकारिक पोर्टल देखें: scholarship.up.gov.in

IT 3rd Year AKTU PYQS (Web Technology)

Web Technology is one of the most important subjects in Information Technology. It focuses on the fundamentals of internet applications, website development, client-server architecture, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and backend technologies. For AKTU students in their third year, IT 3rd Year AKTU PYQS (Web Technology) are extremely valuable as they reveal exam trends and repeated questions. At www.notesgallery.com, students can easily access these question papers in one place to prepare smartly and score better.

Why Web Technology Matters in IT

Before diving into the importance of PYQS, let’s understand why Web Technology is significant:

  • It explains the core working of the internet and web apps.
  • Students learn about frontend and backend development.
  • It builds practical knowledge for projects and internships.

This makes IT 3rd Year AKTU PYQS (Web Technology) essential for every student aiming to excel.

Important Topics in Web Technology PYQS

Some concepts are asked frequently in IT 3rd Year AKTU PYQS (Web Technology). Students should pay attention to:

  • HTML and CSS fundamentals
  • JavaScript and DOM manipulation
  • PHP, JSP, and server-side scripting
  • Client-server models
  • Database handling in web applications
  • Web application security
  • AJAX, XML, and data handling
  • Modern frameworks and their role

These are the high-weightage areas where PYQs play a key role.

How to Prepare with Web Technology PYQS

Here are some strategies for smart use of PYQS:

  • Sort PYQs chapter-wise for easy revision.
  • Highlight high-frequency questions.
  • Write answers in exam-style format.
  • Revise flowcharts, diagrams, and examples.
  • Do a quick revision of last 5 years’ papers.

This method ensures focused preparation.

Why Use www.notesgallery.com for Web Technology PYQS

Finding authentic resources is a challenge, but www.notesgallery.com provides:

  • Authentic and updated PYQS.
  • Free download in PDF format.
  • Easy navigation for all IT subjects.

  • Use PYQS during last-minute revision.

Why focus on IT 3rd Year AKTU PYQS (Web Technology)?

  • They reveal frequently asked questions so you know where to concentrate your effort.
  • PYQS help you practice time management and structure answers within an exam duration.
  • Solving PYQS improves your ability to apply concepts like client-server architecture, scripting, and database integration.
  • Repeated practice with IT 3rd Year AKTU PYQS (Web Technology) reduces exam anxiety because the format becomes familiar.

Core topics usually covered in Web Technology PYQS

Students who prioritize these areas while practicing PYQS tend to score better:

  • HTML, CSS fundamentals and semantic markup
  • JavaScript basics, DOM manipulation, event handling
  • Server-side scripting (PHP / JSP / Node concepts) and form handling
  • Client-server architecture, HTTP methods, REST basics
  • Database connectivity (SQL basics, CRUD operations in web apps)
  • AJAX, JSON, XML and asynchronous data handling
  • Web security (XSS, CSRF, SQL injection prevention)
  • Basic web frameworks, session management, cookies

Labs and practicals: don’t ignore the hands-on part

  • Many PYQS include lab-related or practical scenario questions — be ready to explain code flow, request-response cycles, and database queries.
  • Practice small projects: a login system, simple CRUD app, or an AJAX-based search — these help answer application-oriented PYQS with confidence.
  • Maintain a one-page cheatsheet of common SQL queries, HTTP status codes, and JavaScript snippets for quick review.

Smart study plan using PYQS (sample 4-week schedule)

Week 1: Revise basic theory (HTML/CSS/JS) and solve 2 years of PYQS.
Week 2: Focus on server-side concepts and database integration; solve 2 more years of PYQS.
Week 3: Practice lab-based and application questions; simulate full paper under timed conditions.
Week 4: Revise repeated questions, polish answer presentation, and use www.notesgallery.com for any missing papers.

Common mistakes students make with PYQS

  • Relying only on PYQS without understanding fundamentals — PYQS should supplement, not replace, textbooks.

  • Poor time management during practice — always simulate exam timing.
  • Not reviewing incorrect attempts — analyze mistakes and ensure they don’t repeat.

Final advice

Solving IT 3rd Year AKTU PYQS (Web Technology) regularly turns abstract topics into clear, answerable questions. Use PYQS to map out which chapters need extra practice, simulate exams under real conditions, and strengthen both theoretical and practical skills. The Government of Uttar Pradesh has issued an important order regarding the time-table for payment of scholarships to students of Scheduled Caste (SC), Scheduled Tribe (ST), General Category, Other Backward Class (OBC), and Minority Class under the Post-Matric Scholarship Scheme for the academic session 2025-26.

This order, released through Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University (AKTU), Lucknow, emphasizes the timely verification and submission of student data to ensure that scholarships are disbursed without delay. The scheme, commonly referred to as the AKTU Scholarship 2025, plays a vital role in supporting economically weaker students across Uttar Pradesh.

Overview of AKTU Scholarship 2025

The AKTU Scholarship 2025 is part of the state government’s larger initiative to provide financial assistance to students pursuing higher education. Under this scheme, tuition fees, maintenance allowances, and other educational expenses are covered for students belonging to SC, ST, OBC, General (EWS), and Minority communities.

The scholarship is implemented through the UP Scholarship Portal (scholarship.up.gov.in), and all affiliated colleges under AKTU are required to participate in the verification and master data locking process.

Key Highlights of the Government Order

The government order specifies the following major points regarding the AKTU Scholarship 2025:

  1. Beneficiaries: SC, ST, OBC, General Category (EWS), and Minority students.
  2. Scheme: Post-Matric Scholarship (दशमोत्तर छात्रवृत्ति योजना).
  3. Timeline: A strict schedule for institutions to verify, lock, and submit student data.
  4. Deadline for Institutions: All affiliated colleges must submit verified data to AKTU by 10 October 2025.
  5. Verification Process: Institutions must digitally lock fee and seat details on the UP Scholarship Portal and forward the verified documents to AKTU.

Purpose of the Government Order

The primary goal of this order is to streamline the scholarship disbursement process. Delays in data submission by institutions in past sessions caused disruptions for students. By issuing a revised time-table, the government ensures:

  • Transparency in the scholarship system.
  • Timely disbursement of funds to students.
  • Accountability of affiliated institutions.
  • Fair access to financial assistance for all eligible students.

Application and Verification Process for Students

The process for applying under AKTU Scholarship 2025 is as follows:

  1. Student Registration: Students must register on the official UP Scholarship Portal.
  2. Form Filling: Complete the online form with personal, academic, and income details.
  3. Document Upload: Upload required documents like caste certificate, income certificate, and academic marksheets.
  4. Institution Verification: Submit the printed form and documents to the institution.
  5. Institution Locking: Colleges verify student data, lock it digitally, and send it to AKTU.
  6. University Verification: AKTU performs the final locking and forwards it to the state department for fund release.

Documents Required

Students applying under AKTU Scholarship 2025 must provide:

  • Aadhaar Card
  • Caste Certificate (for SC/ST/OBC/Minority)
  • Income Certificate
  • High School and Intermediate Mark Sheets
  • Admission Proof / Enrollment Certificate
  • Fee Receipt issued by the institution
  • Bank Passbook (student’s name)
  • Passport-size Photograph

Categories Covered Under the Scheme

The government order covers a wide range of student communities under the Post-Matric Scholarship Scheme:

  • Scheduled Castes (SC)
  • Scheduled Tribes (ST)
  • Other Backward Classes (OBC)
  • General Category (Economically Weaker Section)
  • Minority Communities – Muslims, Sikhs, Christians, Jains, Buddhists, and Parsis.

Important Dates for AKTU Scholarship 2025

  • Government Order Issued: 20 September 2025
  • Deadline for Institutions to Submit Data: 10 October 2025
  • Student Application Last Date: As per the updated schedule on the UP Scholarship Portal
  • Final Data Locking by University: Post 10 October 2025

Benefits of AKTU Scholarship 2025

The AKTU Scholarship 2025 offers multiple benefits to students, including:

  1. Financial Assistance – Covers tuition fees and other educational expenses.
  2. Equal Access – Ensures that students from weaker sections get equal opportunities in higher education.
  3. Encouragement for Technical Studies – Helps increase enrollment in B.Tech, MBA, MCA, and other professional courses.
  4. Timely Support – Revised time-table ensures students receive scholarship benefits without delay.

Why Students are Searching for AKTU Scholarship 2025

Every year, lakhs of students across Uttar Pradesh apply for scholarships. In 2025, AKTU Scholarship 2025 has become a trending query because the government has strictly enforced deadlines for institutions.

If institutions fail to submit data by the given date, students’ scholarship payments may be delayed. This makes the government order and revised schedule crucial for all AKTU students.

Conclusion

The government order on AKTU Scholarship 2025 highlights the importance of timely verification and data submission by affiliated institutions. With the final deadline of 10 October 2025, institutions are required to lock and submit all student data to AKTU, ensuring that scholarships under the Post-Matric Scholarship Scheme reach eligible students on time.

👉 Students are advised to complete their application process on the UP Scholarship Portal and regularly check updates from AKTU and the Uttar Pradesh government.

This initiative will not only provide financial relief but also encourage thousands of students to pursue higher education without financial barriers.

Quick Summary

  • Scheme: AKTU Scholarship 2025 (Post-Matric Scholarship Scheme)
  • Beneficiaries: SC, ST, OBC, General (EWS), Minority students
  • Government Order Date: 20 September 2025
  • Last Date for Institutions: 10 October 2025
  • Official Portal: scholarship.up.gov.in

FAQs for AKTU Scholarship 2025

Q1. What is AKTU Scholarship 2025?
The AKTU Scholarship 2025 is a Post-Matric Scholarship Scheme under which SC, ST, OBC, General (EWS), and Minority students of Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University can receive tuition fee reimbursement and financial assistance.

Q2. Who is eligible for AKTU Scholarship 2025?
Students belonging to Scheduled Caste, Scheduled Tribe, Other Backward Classes, General Category (EWS), and Minority communities enrolled in AKTU-affiliated institutions are eligible, provided they meet the income criteria.

Q3. What is the last date for AKTU Scholarship 2025?
As per the government order, institutions must complete master data locking and submit documents by 10 October 2025. Students should apply before the deadline mentioned on the UP Scholarship Portal.

Q4. How can students apply for AKTU Scholarship 2025?
Students must apply online through the UP Scholarship Portal (scholarship.up.gov.in), fill in their academic and income details, upload documents, and submit the form to their institution for verification.

Q5. What documents are required for AKTU Scholarship 2025?
Students need Aadhaar card, caste certificate, income certificate, mark sheets, admission proof, fee receipt, bank passbook, and a passport-size photograph.

title.rendered: AKTU Scholarship 2025-26: SC/ST & General Post-Matric Scholarship Rule Exemption Announced

content.rendered:
AKTU Scholarship 2025 : Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University (AKTU), Lucknow has released an important notification on 20 September 2025 regarding the Uttar Pradesh SC/ST & General Category Post-Matric Scholarship Scheme 2025-26. As per the notice, affiliated institutions and universities have been informed about an exemption related to NAAC and NBA accreditation requirements under the Post-Matric Scholarship Guidelines 2023.

This decision comes after directions from the Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment, Government of India and the UP Government’s Social Welfare Section, granting relaxation for the academic year 2025-26.

In this blog post, we will cover:

  • What the AKTU Scholarship Circular 2025-26 says
  • Key points of exemption under Scholarship Rule 6 (xvii)
  • Impact on students and institutions
  • Benefits for SC/ST & General Category students
  • Important dates and references
  • FAQs related to AKTU Scholarship 2025

What Does the AKTU Scholarship Circular 2025-26 Say?

The circular issued by AKTU (Letter No. AKTU/Kus.Ka./Scholarship/2025/8246 dated 20.09.2025) informs all directors and principals of AKTU-affiliated institutions about the exemption provided in the UP SC/ST & General Post-Matric Scholarship Scheme Rules-2023.

  • According to the Government of India letter (No. K-11011/28/2021-SCD-V-Part (1) dated 12.06.2025), all universities and educational institutions are exempted from the NAAC and NBA grading requirement for the 2025-26 session under the SC Post-Matric Scholarship Scheme.
  • The exemption has been approved by the Social Justice and Empowerment Ministry, New Delhi, and forwarded by the UP Government’s Social Welfare Section-3 (Letter No. 140/2025/2118/26-3-2025-1927901 dated 02.09.2025).

This exemption is temporary and only valid for the academic year 2025-26.

Key Provision in Scholarship Rule 6 (xvii)

As per the UP Post-Matric Scholarship Rules 2023 (11th Amendment, dated 27.09.2023), Rule 6 (xvii) clearly mentions requirements related to NAAC/NBA accreditation for institutions offering scholarships.

However, the Government of India has now provided special relaxation for 2025-26:

  • Institutions without NAAC or NBA grading will still be eligible for their students to avail SC/ST & General Category Post-Matric Scholarships.
  • This will ensure that students from all affiliated institutions can continue receiving financial assistance without interruption.

Why Was This Exemption Necessary?

Many institutions across Uttar Pradesh and India are in the process of applying for NAAC/NBA accreditation, but the process is lengthy and time-consuming. Without this exemption, lakhs of students might have been deprived of scholarship benefits due to their institution’s accreditation status.

Thus, the exemption ensures that:

  • SC/ST students continue to receive financial support for higher education.
  • General category students under the scholarship scheme also benefit.
  • Institutions not yet accredited are not penalized, and student welfare remains a priority.

Impact on AKTU Students

The decision is a major relief for AKTU students in the academic year 2025-26. Here’s how it impacts them:

  1. Eligibility Maintained – Even if their college does not have NAAC/NBA accreditation, students will still be eligible for Post-Matric Scholarships.
  2. Financial Support Continued – Tuition fees, maintenance allowances, and other benefits under the UP Scholarship Scheme will not be affected.
  3. Encouragement for Higher Education – Students from SC/ST and General categories can continue their studies without financial barriers.

Benefits of AKTU Scholarship Exemption 2025

The exemption in Rule 6 (xvii) brings the following benefits:

  • Equal Opportunity: Students across accredited and non-accredited institutions get fair access to scholarships.
  • Support for SC/ST Students: Financial aid continues without interruption.
  • General Category Advantage: Eligible general category students are also included.
  • Institutional Relief: Colleges without NAAC/NBA status do not face hurdles in supporting their students.

Important Dates & References

FAQs on AKTU Scholarship Exemption 2025-26

Q1. Which students are covered under the AKTU Scholarship exemption 2025-26?
Ans: Students from SC, ST, and eligible General categories under the UP Post-Matric Scholarship Scheme are covered.

Q2. Is NAAC/NBA accreditation mandatory for scholarships in 2025-26?
Ans: No. For the academic year 2025-26, institutions are exempted from this requirement.

Q3. Does this exemption apply permanently?
Ans: No, it is only valid for the session 2025-26. From 2026-27 onwards, accreditation rules may again apply.

Q4. What should institutions do after this notification?
Ans: Institutions should ensure timely scholarship applications for all eligible students, regardless of accreditation status.

Q5. Where can students check official details?
Ans: On the AKTU official website (aktu.ac.in) and the UP Scholarship Portal.

Conclusion

The AKTU Scholarship Exemption 2025-26 is a student-friendly decision ensuring that financial assistance under the Post-Matric Scholarship Scheme is not disrupted due to accreditation requirements. It reflects the government’s commitment to student welfare, equal opportunity, and accessibility in higher education.

All AKTU-affiliated colleges and universities are advised to implement this circular immediately and help students complete their scholarship applications smoothly.

For students, this is a golden opportunity to continue their education with full financial support under the UP Scholarship Scheme 2025-26.

title.rendered: AKTU Holiday Official Notice: Holiday Declared on Navratri 2025

content.rendered:
AKTU Holiday 22 September 2025 – Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University (AKTU), Lucknow has officially declared a holiday on 22nd September 2025 (Monday) on the occasion of Navratri Pratham Diwas (शुभ नवरात्रि का प्रथम दिवस). This notification has been issued by the Office of the Registrar, AKTU and applies to the university headquarters as well as all affiliated colleges and institutions.

This decision comes after the public holiday on 5th September 2025 (Teachers’ Day) was cancelled by the university to celebrate Shikshak Diwas with cultural and academic programs. To balance the holiday calendar, the university administration has now granted a compensatory holiday on 22 September 2025.

In this article, we will cover the complete details of the AKTU holiday notice, the reason behind this decision, its impact on students and staff, the list of institutions covered, and FAQs for better clarity.

Official Notice Summary

The holiday announcement was made via Notification No. ए०के०टी०यू०/कुस0का0/2025/8240, issued on 20th September 2025 by Mr. Keshav Singh, Registrar, AKTU.

Important Points from the Notice:

  • Holiday Declared: 22nd September 2025 (Monday)
  • Occasion: Navratri First Day (शुभ नवरात्रि)
  • Reason: Compensatory holiday for 5th September (Teachers’ Day) when the university remained open.
  • Issued By: Office of the Registrar, AKTU, Lucknow
  • Notice Number: ए०के०टी०यू०/कुस0का0/2025/8240
  • Date of Issue: 20 September 2025

This notice has been circulated to all university officers, affiliated college principals, directors, and administrative staff for implementation.

Why AKTU Declared Holiday on 22nd September 2025

The background of this decision is very important for students and staff:

  1. On 4th September 2025, the university issued a circular (No. ए०के०टी०यू०/कुस0का0/2025/8110) cancelling the public holiday on 5th September.
  2. The reason was to organize Teachers’ Day celebrations across all AKTU-affiliated institutions.
  3. As a result, students and staff attended college on 5th September, and cultural programs were organized to honor teachers.
  4. To balance the academic calendar and holiday schedule, AKTU decided to shift the holiday to 22nd September 2025.
  5. The new date coincides with the auspicious beginning of Navratri, making it a meaningful holiday for all.

Thus, AKTU Holiday 22 September 2025 serves both as a compensatory holiday and a festive break.

Institutions Covered Under the Holiday

The AKTU Holiday on 22 September 2025 will be applicable to:

  1. AKTU Headquarters, Lucknow
  2. Institute of Engineering & Technology (IET), Lucknow
  3. Centre for Advanced Studies (CAS), Lucknow
  4. Faculty of Architecture & Planning, Lucknow
  5. UPID, Noida
  6. All affiliated colleges and institutions under AKTU
  7. Various faculties including Pharmacy, Management, and Technology

All teaching and non-teaching staff, officers, and students in these institutions will observe the holiday.

What Students Should Know About AKTU Holiday 22 September 2025

  • No classes will be conducted on this date.
  • Students can utilize the holiday for Navratri celebrations or personal activities.
  • Those preparing for mid-semester exams or end-semester exams can use this time for revision.
  • If any exams or practicals were scheduled on 22nd September, they will be rescheduled by the university.
  • Students are advised to check their college website or notice board for updated schedules.

Impact on Faculty and Staff

  • Administrative offices of AKTU will remain closed.
  • All teaching and non-teaching staff will get a day off.
  • Colleges must ensure the holiday is communicated to students in advance.
  • Departments may adjust their academic calendar to maintain syllabus completion.

Cultural and Festive Significance

Navratri is one of the most important Hindu festivals, marking the victory of good over evil. Celebrating the first day of Navratri with a university holiday allows students and staff to:

  • Participate in family religious rituals.
  • Attend local cultural events and Durga Puja pandals.
  • Begin the festival with peace of mind, without academic obligations.

Thus, the AKTU Holiday 22 September 2025 not only balances the academic schedule but also respects cultural traditions.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

1. Why is AKTU closed on 22nd September 2025?

AKTU is closed on 22nd September 2025 to observe the first day of Navratri. This holiday is given as compensation because the university remained open on 5th September (Teachers’ Day).

2. Does this holiday apply to all affiliated colleges?

Yes, the AKTU Holiday 22 September 2025 is applicable to all affiliated colleges, faculties, and centers under AKTU.

3. Will exams scheduled on 22nd September be postponed?

Yes, if any examination or practical was scheduled, the Examination Controller will release a revised schedule. Students should check their college notice board or aktu.ac.in for updates.

4. Who issued the holiday notification?

The notice was issued by Mr. Keshav Singh, Registrar (कुलसचिव), AKTU on 20th September 2025.

5. Was there any holiday on 5th September 2025?

No. The holiday on 5th September 2025 was cancelled to celebrate Teachers’ Day with academic and cultural events.

READ MORE : Siemens Scholarship 2025-26: Complete Guide for Engineering Students

Conclusion

The AKTU Holiday 22 September 2025 is an important update for all students, staff, and affiliated institutions. By shifting the cancelled 5th September holiday to 22nd September, the university has ensured both academic continuity and cultural respect.

Students can use this holiday to celebrate Navratri with their families, while also preparing for upcoming exams. For further updates, it is recommended to regularly check the official AKTU website (aktu.ac.in) and institution-specific notices.

title.rendered: AKTU 6th Semester Result 2025 Declared – Check B.Tech & B.Pharm Results

Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University (AKTU), Lucknow has officially declared the AKTU 6th Semester Result 2025 for B.Tech and B.Pharm students. The results are now available online on the official university website aktu.ac.in through the One View Result Portal. How to Check AKTU 6th Semester Result 2025 Online?

Students can follow the step-by-step process below to check their AKTU 6th Semester Result 2025 online:

  1. Visit the official website: aktu.ac.in.
  2. Click on the One View Result Portal link.
  3. Enter your Roll Number and Captcha Code in the required fields.
  4. Click on the “Submit” button.

👉 Yes, the result has been released for regular students of B.Tech and B.Pharm 6th semester.

👉 Immediately contact your college administration and apply for revaluation/scrutiny if required.

👉 No, this notification is only for regular exam results. Back paper results will be declared separately.

title.rendered: AKTU Sewa Pakhwada 2025: A Nationwide Movement of Service and Social Responsibility

content.rendered:
India has always been known for its spirit of service and community welfare. Continuing this tradition, Sewa Pakhwada 2025 is being organized from 17th September 2025 to 2nd October 2025 across various universities, institutions, and public organizations. This special campaign is not just an event; it is a movement that aims to instill values of social responsibility, environmental care, and community development among students, teachers, and citizens.

The Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University (AKTU), Lucknow has issued a directive to all its affiliated and constituent colleges to actively participate in this initiative. During these 16 days, multiple programs will be conducted, ranging from cleanliness drives to tree plantation, from awareness campaigns to cultural activities.

What is Sewa Pakhwada 2025?

Sewa Pakhwada 2025 is a two-week-long initiative inspired by the vision of service and nation-building. It aligns with the philosophy of Mahatma Gandhi, whose birth anniversary (2nd October) marks the conclusion of this campaign. The program focuses on engaging youth, academic institutions, and communities in activities that contribute directly to society’s well-being.

Unlike regular campaigns, Sewa Pakhwada 2025 has a broader perspective—it not only encourages cleanliness and environmental activities but also focuses on inclusivity, education, women empowerment, health awareness, and respect for senior citizens.

Objectives of Sewa Pakhwada 2025

The campaign has clear objectives that make it impactful:

  • Promote cleanliness and environmental sustainability through drives like Swachhta Abhiyan and tree plantation.
  • Encourage health and nutrition awareness by conducting speeches and workshops.
  • Strengthen community bonds through visits to orphanages, old-age homes, and Anganwadi centers.
  • Inspire youth and students to contribute actively to nation-building.
  • Ensure inclusive participation by honoring Class 3 and 4 employees, women’s groups, and self-help communities.

Key Programs Under Sewa Pakhwada 2025

Here are the major activities that will be organized under the Sewa Pakhwada 2025 initiative:

Online Interaction with University Leadership

As part of Sewa Pakhwada 2025, the AKTU has scheduled an online interaction session on 19th September 2025 at 2:30 PM under the chairmanship of the Hon’ble Vice-Chancellor. Principals and Directors of all affiliated colleges are required to attend this meeting.

  • Meeting Link: Zoom Link
  • Meeting ID: 912 7711 4632
  • Passcode: 290452

This online interaction is a vital step to ensure smooth coordination and proper execution of programs across all institutions.

Role of Students and Teachers in Sewa Pakhwada 2025

The success of Sewa Pakhwada 2025 largely depends on the active participation of students and teachers.

  • Students’ Role: They will take part in cleanliness drives, plantation activities, nutrition awareness programs, and cultural events. Their energy and creativity will make the campaign vibrant.
  • Teachers’ Role: Teachers will guide, motivate, and lead various programs. Initiatives like donating clothes, organizing exhibitions, and conducting workshops will highlight their leadership.

This collective effort will build a stronger bridge between education and society.

Social Impact of Sewa Pakhwada 2025

The programs under Sewa Pakhwada 2025 will create long-lasting benefits for society:

  • Environmental Impact: Cleanliness drives and tree plantation will lead to cleaner and greener surroundings.
  • Social Impact: Visits to old age homes, orphanages, and Anganwadi centers will strengthen compassion and care.
  • Educational Impact: Reading programs, exhibitions, and awareness campaigns will inspire students and enhance learning.
  • Cultural Impact: Mothers’ conferences and blessings from saints will preserve traditions and promote inclusivity.

Why Sewa Pakhwada 2025 Matters

In today’s world, where people are often caught up in their personal goals, Sewa Pakhwada 2025 reminds us of the importance of selfless service. By engaging educational institutions in community development, it sets an example for future generations.

It also connects academic knowledge with practical social responsibilities, ensuring that education is not limited to classrooms but extends to real-life impact.

Conclusion

Sewa Pakhwada 2025 is more than a campaign—it is a celebration of service, humanity, and responsibility. From 17th September to 2nd October 2025, universities, colleges, and communities across Uttar Pradesh and India will actively participate in a series of impactful programs.

By engaging students, teachers, and society at large, this initiative will build a strong culture of service and responsibility, paving the way for a better future.

As we celebrate Gandhi Jayanti on 2nd October, Sewa Pakhwada 2025 will stand as a true tribute to the ideals of service, simplicity, and nation-building.

content.rendered:
Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University (AKTU), Lucknow has recently announced the process for AKTU Challenge Evaluation 2025 for odd semester Phase-II examinations of session 2024-25. This notification is important for all students who appeared in the exams conducted between 28 February 2025 and 22 March 2025 and are not satisfied with their results.

In this guide, we will explain everything about the AKTU Challenge Evaluation 2025 including important dates, application procedure, fee structure, refund policy, and the rules students must follow.

What is AKTU Challenge Evaluation 2025?

The AKTU Challenge Evaluation 2025 is a re-evaluation system designed to ensure fairness in the marking process. Unlike simple re-checking, this system involves two different subject experts who re-evaluate the answer sheet. The final marks are calculated by taking the average of both evaluations.

This process was introduced by AKTU to increase transparency and give students confidence that their answer copies have been checked properly.

Key Highlights of AKTU Challenge Evaluation 2025

Here are the most important details students should know:

Who Can Apply for AKTU Challenge Evaluation 2025?

Not every student can apply for this process. The eligibility conditions are:

  • Students who appeared in the Odd Semester Phase-II exams (2024-25).
  • Students whose results are already declared.
  • Students who are not satisfied with their marks and want re-checking.
  • Answer copies should be visible on the student’s ERP login portal.

If these conditions are met, the student can apply for the AKTU Challenge Evaluation 2025.

Step-by-Step Application Process

Students who want to apply for AKTU Challenge Evaluation 2025 must follow these steps carefully:

  1. Login to ERP Portal
    • Go to the official AKTU ERP login page.
    • Enter your credentials to access your account.
  2. Check Your Answer Copy
    • Download and review the scanned copy of your evaluated answer sheet.
  3. Select Subjects
    • Choose the subject(s) you want to apply for under challenge evaluation.
  4. Pay the Fees
    • Pay ₹2500 per subject online.
  5. Submit Bank Details
    • Enter correct bank details (Account Number, IFSC Code, Bank Name).
    • Double-check these details, as incorrect information can cause refund issues.
  6. Final Submission
    • Submit the application before the last date (22 September 2025).

AKTU Challenge Evaluation 2025 Fees and Refund Policy

The fee is ₹2500 per subject. Refund is available if the re-evaluated marks differ from the original marks by more than 20% of total marks. In such cases, the student will receive ₹1500 refund and ₹1000 will be deducted as processing charges.

Example: If a student originally got 35/100, but after challenge evaluation the marks increase to 60/100, the difference is 25 marks (25%). Since the difference is more than 20%, the student will get a refund of ₹1500.

Rules and Conditions for Students

Here are the most important rules of AKTU Challenge Evaluation 2025:

  1. Applications will only be accepted through the ERP portal.
  2. Students must check their bank details carefully while submitting.
  3. The marks awarded after challenge evaluation are final and binding.
  4. Refund is only possible if the difference is more than 20% of total marks.
  5. No applications will be accepted after 22 September 2025.

Why AKTU Challenge Evaluation 2025 Matters

Many students often feel that their answer copies have not been evaluated properly. The AKTU Challenge Evaluation 2025 system is important because it ensures fairness and transparency, two subject experts cross-check the answer sheet, and any errors in evaluation are corrected. Students gain trust in the exam system through this process.

Official Guidelines Behind the Process

The AKTU Challenge Evaluation 2025 process is based on:

  • Government Order No. 39298/16-1099/17/2020 (11 December 2020).
  • Letter No. E-7443/03-G.S./2019 (26 November 2020).
  • University Examination Committee 68th Meeting (Decision No. 68.13).

These official documents set the rules for challenge evaluation in AKTU.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

Q1. What is the last date for AKTU Challenge Evaluation 2025?
The last date to apply is 22 September 2025.

Q2. What is the fee for applying?
The fee is ₹2500 per subject.

Q3. Can I get a refund?
Yes, if the re-evaluation shows a difference of more than 20%, you will get a refund of ₹1500.

Q4. Where can I apply for challenge evaluation?
Students must apply through the AKTU ERP login portal.

Q5. Can I challenge again if I am not satisfied with the new marks?
No, the marks awarded in AKTU Challenge Evaluation 2025 are final.

READ MORE : AKTU Official Notice: Altair Student Edition Software Free Access for AKTU Students 2025

Conclusion

The AKTU Challenge Evaluation 2025 is a golden opportunity for students who feel their answer copies were not fairly evaluated. With a transparent system, involvement of two subject experts, and a clear refund policy, the process is designed to ensure justice and fairness in the examination system.

Students must carefully check their answer copies, decide wisely, and apply before 22 September 2025 through the ERP portal. By following the rules and deadlines, students can benefit from this evaluation system and secure marks they truly deserve.

title.rendered: AKTU Official Notice: Altair Student Edition Software Free Access for AKTU Students 2025

content.rendered:
Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University (AKTU), Lucknow, has announced a big opportunity for its students in 2025. The university has signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with Altair, a global leader in simulation, design, and data science software solutions.

Through this collaboration, all students studying in AKTU-affiliated colleges are now eligible for free access to Altair Student Edition Software. The initiative aims to help students gain hands-on experience with industry-grade tools, strengthen technical knowledge, and improve employability skills.

In this blog post, we will cover:

  • What is Altair Student Edition Software?
  • How AKTU students can register and download it
  • Step-by-step installation and activation guide
  • Benefits of using Altair for engineering students
  • FAQs about the software

What is Altair Student Edition Software?

Altair Student Edition Software is a comprehensive package of simulation, design, and data science tools offered by Altair. It is widely used by engineers, researchers, and industry professionals across domains like:

  • Mechanical Engineering (design, simulation, structural analysis)
  • Civil Engineering (construction modeling, load testing, optimization)
  • Electrical Engineering (circuit simulation, power system analysis)
  • Computer Science & Data Science (AI, machine learning, big data)
  • Research & Innovation (multi-disciplinary projects, product development)

By providing free access to this software, AKTU ensures that its students get real-world exposure to advanced tools that are highly valued by companies.

Official Announcement by AKTU

On 15th September 2025, AKTU released a notification (Letter No. AKTU/CTPC/2025/1265) to all affiliated colleges. The notification instructed Directors and Principals to inform students about this free software license.

Students must register using their official college email ID or AKTU email ID to activate the software. The circular emphasizes that this initiative will bridge the gap between academic learning and industry skills.

How to Register for Altair Student Edition Software?

Here’s a simple guide for AKTU students to download and activate the software:

Step 1: Create an Altair One Account

  • Visit 👉 https://altairone.com/home
  • Sign up with your official AKTU or college email ID
  • Verify your email address

Step 2: Get Your Altair Student Edition License Key

  • After login, apply for a student license
  • A license key will be generated and shared with you

Step 3: Download & Install the Software

  • Visit the download page
  • Select the software from the Altair Student Edition Bundle (choose as per your domain interest – mechanical, electrical, civil, or data science)
  • Install the software on your system

Step 4: Activate the Software

  • Launch the installed software
  • Enter the Student Edition License Key
  • Your software is now activated and ready to use

👉 Registration Link for Altair Student Edition: https://web.altair.com/altair-student-edition

Benefits of Altair Student Edition for AKTU Students

  1. Industry-Relevant Skills
    Gain practical knowledge of tools used by top companies in engineering and IT sectors.
  2. Free Access
    Normally, simulation and design software costs thousands of rupees. AKTU students are getting it completely free.
  3. Improves Employability
    Hands-on experience with Altair tools adds great value to your resume and job interviews.
  4. Support for Projects & Research
    Useful for final year projects, research papers, and innovative ideas.
  5. Multi-Disciplinary Usage
    Whether you are in Mechanical, Electrical, Civil, or Computer Science, you’ll find relevant tools in the suite.

Why This Initiative Matters?

In today’s competitive job market, companies look for graduates who have practical skills beyond theoretical knowledge. By giving students access to Altair Student Edition Software, AKTU is ensuring that its students are industry-ready even before graduation.

This collaboration is not just about software access—it’s about bridging the gap between academia and industry, promoting innovation, and preparing students for future technologies.

Support & Helpdesk

If you face any issues during registration, installation, or activation, you can reach out to the Training & Placement Cell of AKTU via email:

📧 tpo@aktu.ac.in

FAQs – Altair Student Edition for AKTU Students

Q1: Who is eligible for the free Altair Student Edition Software?
👉 All students studying in AKTU-affiliated and associated colleges.

Q2: Can I register with my personal Gmail or Yahoo account?
👉 No. You must use your official AKTU or college email ID for registration.

Q3: Is the Altair Student Edition completely free?
👉 Yes, it is 100% free under the AKTU–Altair MoU.

Q4: What kind of projects can I use it for?
👉 You can use it for simulations, product design, structural analysis, circuit testing, data science projects, and much more.

Q5: How long is the license valid?
👉 The license is typically valid for one year and can be renewed as long as you are a student.

READ MORE : AKTU Challenge Evaluation 2025 | Stage 1 and Stage 2 Complete Guide

Conclusion

The launch of Altair Student Edition Software Free Access for AKTU Students 2025 is a game-changer for engineering education. With this initiative, students can explore advanced simulation and design tools, improve technical skills, and boost career opportunities.

All AKTU students are strongly encouraged to register immediately, download the software, and start using it for their learning, projects, and research work.

This step by AKTU shows the university’s commitment to student development, innovation, and employability. Don’t miss this opportunity—register today!

title.rendered: AKTU Challenge Evaluation 2025 | Stage 1 and Stage 2 Complete Guide

content.rendered:
Every year thousands of students of Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University (AKTU) appear in semester examinations. After results are declared, not every student feels satisfied with their marks. To ensure transparency, the university has introduced a process called AKTU Challenge Evaluation 2025. This process is divided into two stages – Stage 1 and Stage 2. Both stages allow students to verify whether their answer sheets have been evaluated properly.

Many B.Tech students of semester one and semester three, whose exams were conducted in odd semester phase two, have already received their results. Those who were not happy with the marks opted for Stage 1 evaluation. Now the update has come regarding Stage 2 as well. In this article, we will explain everything about AKTU Challenge Evaluation 2025, including fees, process, ERP login, important points, and FAQs.

What is AKTU Challenge Evaluation 2025?

AKTU Challenge Evaluation 2025 is a re-evaluation mechanism where students can challenge the marks awarded in their semester examination. The purpose is to provide students with an opportunity to review their answer sheets and ensure that the evaluation has been fair.

The process is conducted in two stages:

  1. Stage 1 (Viewing of Answer Sheet) – In this stage, students can view their checked answer sheet on ERP login by paying a nominal fee.
  2. Stage 2 (Final Re-evaluation) – If after reviewing the copy the student is still not satisfied, they can opt for Stage 2 by paying higher fees. The copy will be rechecked by examiners, and the new marks will be considered final.

important Date

Stage 1 Process in AKTU Challenge Evaluation 2025

Stage 1 was the first opportunity for students who were not satisfied with their marks. By paying ₹300 per subject, students could apply for Stage 1. The main features of Stage 1 were:

  • Students could log in to the ERP portal using their university credentials.
  • The scanned copy of their evaluated answer sheet was made available.
  • This gave them a chance to check whether all answers were properly evaluated and marks were correctly totaled.

However, in the beginning, many students faced issues in viewing their copies. Some reported that the answer sheet was not visible in ERP. Over time, AKTU resolved these issues, and students were able to access their answer sheets.

Stage 1 is very important because it gives clarity to students. If after viewing the copy they feel that their marks are justified, they can avoid spending more money on Stage 2. But if the student finds that evaluation is not correct, then Stage 2 becomes a serious option.

Stage 2 Process in AKTU Challenge Evaluation 2025

Stage 2 is the final step of the challenge evaluation process. It allows students to get their answer sheet checked again by a different examiner. But this step involves higher risk and higher fees.

Key details of Stage 2:

  • Fee: ₹2500 per subject.
  • Mode: Application through ERP login after official AKTU circular is released.
  • Re-checking: The answer sheet is checked again, and the marks are updated accordingly.
  • Finality: The marks obtained after Stage 2 are treated as final. They may increase or decrease, but no further challenge is allowed.

Students should think carefully before applying for Stage 2. It is advisable to go for Stage 2 only if you are confident that your marks will improve.

Fees Comparison of Stage 1 and Stage 2

This comparison clearly shows that Stage 1 is only a viewing process while Stage 2 directly impacts the final result.

Why AKTU Challenge Evaluation 2025 is Important

The AKTU Challenge Evaluation 2025 process is important for several reasons:

  • It builds trust and transparency in the examination system.
  • Students get an opportunity to ensure that their efforts are judged fairly.
  • Many times, due to calculation mistakes or unchecked answers, students lose valuable marks. The challenge evaluation helps in correcting such errors.
  • It gives students the confidence that the university values their performance and has provided a systematic way to address grievances.

Important Points to Remember

Before applying for Stage 2 of AKTU Challenge Evaluation 2025, students should keep the following points in mind:

  • Always check your answer sheet carefully in Stage 1 before taking a decision.
  • Stage 2 is costly at ₹2500 per subject, so apply only when you are sure.
  • The marks after Stage 2 are final, even if they decrease.
  • Wait for the official circular from AKTU before making any payment.
  • Keep track of updates on the university ERP and official website.

Student Reactions and Issues

Many students initially reported that their answer sheets were not showing on ERP login. Later, the issue was resolved, and they could access their copies. Some students have already confirmed that their answer sheets were properly checked, while others found errors and are considering Stage 2.

This shows why the AKTU Challenge Evaluation 2025 process is so significant. It ensures fairness and provides a chance to correct mistakes in evaluation.

FAQs on AKTU Challenge Evaluation 2025

Q1. What is the fee for Stage 1?
The fee for Stage 1 is ₹300 per subject.

Q2. What is the fee for Stage 2?
The fee for Stage 2 is ₹2500 per subject.

Q3. Where can students check their answer sheet?
Students can log in to ERP using their credentials and view their answer sheet.

Q4. Can marks decrease after Stage 2?
Yes, marks can either increase or decrease. The marks given after Stage 2 will be treated as final.

Q5. When will Stage 2 applications start?
Stage 2 applications will start after the official circular is released by AKTU.

Q6. Is Stage 1 compulsory for applying to Stage 2?
Yes, students must first go through Stage 1 before applying for Stage 2.

Q7. Can I apply for multiple subjects in Stage 2?
Yes, you can apply for as many subjects as you want, but the fee will be ₹2500 per subject.

Conclusion

The AKTU Challenge Evaluation 2025 is a valuable opportunity for students of odd semester who are not satisfied with their results. Stage 1 allows them to view their evaluated answer sheet at a minimal cost, while Stage 2 provides a final chance for re-evaluation at a higher fee.

Students are strongly advised to make their decision wisely. Since the final marks after Stage 2 can increase or decrease, it is important to apply only when you are confident about errors in evaluation. With this process, AKTU ensures fairness and gives students a chance to secure the marks they truly deserve.

As soon as the official circular for Stage 2 is released, students should keep checking the AKTU ERP portal and apply within the given timeline.

By following the guidelines and carefully checking their answer sheets, students can make the best use of AKTU Challenge Evaluation 2025.

title.rendered: AICTE Placement Data 2025 | B.Tech Branch-wise Job Trends and Career Insights

content.rendered:
AICTE Placement Data 2025 has created a lot of buzz among engineering students across India. The data reveals which B.Tech branches are seeing the highest placements, trends in government and private sector opportunities, and how students can make informed decisions about their careers.

Whether you are a 12th pass student deciding your branch, or a B.Tech student evaluating career options, this article breaks down AICTE Placement Data 2025 for you in a simple and practical way. By the end, you will understand what the data really tells you and how to interpret it for your future.

Key Highlights from AICTE Placement Data 2025

The AICTE Placement Data 2025 covers five academic sessions from 2020-21 to 2024-25. Some of the most important trends are:

  • 15% increase in overall B.Tech placements over the five-year period.
  • Total placements increased from 7.39 lakh to 8.5 lakh students.
  • Growth occurred despite the COVID-19 pandemic, showing strong industry demand for engineers.
  • Training programs and internships have significantly improved students’ placement options.

Branch-wise Placement Statistics

According to AICTE Placement Data 2025, here’s the placement percentage for each major B.Tech branch:

Analysis:

  • Computer Science: Highest placements with strong demand in IT and software companies.
  • Mechanical & Electrical: Moderate placement percentages, but plenty of opportunities in private and government sectors.
  • Civil & Chemical: Lower college placement percentages, but Civil students often pursue government jobs, which are not counted in this data.

It is important to note that this data reflects college placement statistics, not the total career scope of each branch.

Private vs Government Opportunities

Understanding the distinction between private and government sector placements is critical:

Civil Engineering

  • College placement percentage is only 41.88%, but this does not indicate low demand.
  • Many Civil students target AE (Assistant Engineer) roles, railways, and SSC jobs, which are not part of college placements.
  • Government sector offers significant long-term career stability.

Mechanical & Electrical

  • College placements are higher than Civil, primarily in private companies.
  • Both branches also have government job opportunities, including PSUs, railways, and other technical roles.

Computer Science

  • IT and software sector dominates placements.
  • PSU opportunities are limited compared to Mechanical or Civil, but private sector demand remains high.

Conclusion: Do not judge a branch solely by college placement percentage. AICTE Placement Data 2025 provides guidance but does not capture all opportunities, especially in government roles.

Trends Over the Last 5 Years

The AICTE report highlights several positive trends:

  1. Consistent Placement Growth:
    • From 7.39 lakh to 8.5 lakh students, a growth of ~15%.
    • Shows that even during challenges like COVID-19, the engineering sector has bounced back.
  2. Training and Internship Programs:
    • Increased focus on skill development over the last decade.
    • Internship exposure improves students’ employability and increases placement opportunities.
  3. Industry-Aligned Curriculum:
    • Courses have been revised to match global industry requirements.
    • Students are now better prepared for both private and government sector jobs.

Key Insights for Students

Based on AICTE Placement Data 2025, here are some important takeaways:

  1. Branch selection should not be based solely on placement percentages.
    • For example, Civil may show lower placements in college but has strong government job opportunities.
  2. CSE students have high private sector demand.
    • IT and software roles continue to dominate, offering good salary packages and career growth.
  3. Mechanical & Electrical are versatile branches.
    • Balanced opportunities in private sector placements and government roles.
  4. Civil & Chemical offer long-term government career paths.
    • Students aiming for AE, SSC, or railway jobs should not worry about lower college placement percentages.
  5. Focus on skills, internships, and certifications.
    • The placement growth over 5 years shows that students with practical exposure are in higher demand.

How to Interpret AICTE Placement Data 2025

While the data gives a snapshot of trends, it should be interpreted carefully:

  • College placement data vs career opportunities: Not all job opportunities are included in AICTE statistics, especially government sector jobs.
  • Sector-specific focus: Decide whether you want to pursue a private sector career or a government job.
  • Long-term growth: Some branches like Civil may show lower placements now but offer strong career growth over time.

Tip: Use AICTE data as a reference, not a strict guide. Your interests and strengths matter more than raw placement numbers.

Tips for Choosing the Right Branch

If you are a 12th-grade student deciding your B.Tech branch, here’s how AICTE Placement Data 2025 can guide you:

  1. Follow your interest:
    • Choose a branch aligned with your skills and passion.
  2. Consider career path:
    • Government vs private sector opportunities differ by branch.
  3. Look at skill development:
    • Branches with good training and internship programs increase employability.
  4. Check PSU opportunities:
    • Mechanical and Civil students often have more PSU openings.
  5. Don’t be misled by placement percentages:
    • College placements do not reflect the total career potential.

READ MORE : Scholarship for Engineering Students in India 2025 | Top 8 Scholarships with Full Details

Conclusion

AICTE Placement Data 2025 is an insightful resource for engineering students but should not dictate your branch selection entirely. Each B.Tech branch has unique strengths:

  • CSE: Strong private sector growth.
  • Mechanical & Electrical: Balanced private and government opportunities.
  • Civil: Strong government job scope despite lower college placements.
  • Chemical: Moderate placements with niche industry opportunities.

Remember: Placement statistics are only one factor in choosing a branch. Focus on your skills, interests, and long-term career goals for a successful engineering journey.

For students looking for detailed guidance on choosing the right branch, stay tuned for our upcoming video and articles that break down branch selection strategies step by step.

title.rendered: Scholarship for Engineering Students in India 2025 | Top 8 Scholarships with Full Details

content.rendered:
Are you searching for the Scholarship for Engineering Students in India 2025 but confused about eligibility and application process?
Many students believe scholarships are only for toppers, but the truth is different. In India, several government and private scholarships are available that support students from middle-class and low-income families.

These scholarships cover tuition fees, hostel expenses, and even provide laptops in some cases. The eligibility criteria are simple—many require just 60% to 80% marks, and some don’t even need an entrance exam.

In this post, we have listed the Top 8 Scholarship for Engineering Students in India 2025 that you should definitely apply for.

Top 8 Scholarship for Engineering Students in India 2025

We have arranged the scholarships based on scholarship amount from lowest to highest.

1. Central Sector Scheme of Scholarship for College & University Students

  • Provider: Government of India
  • Eligibility:
    • Top 20 percentile in Class 12th (≈ 80–85% marks)
    • Regular course (B.Tech/B.Sc etc.), no distance mode
    • Family income ≤ ₹4.5 lakh/year
    • Cannot avail other scholarships or fee reimbursement
  • Reward:
    • ₹12,000 per year (1st–3rd year)
    • ₹20,000 in 4th year (final year)
  • Apply: scholarships.gov.in
  • Expected Last Date: 31 October 2025

2. LIC Golden Jubilee Scholarship

  • Provider: Life Insurance Corporation of India
  • Eligibility:
    • 60% marks in Class 12th
    • Family income ≤ ₹2.5 lakh/year
    • Applicable for engineering and technical courses
  • Reward: ₹30,000 per year (in two installments)
  • Renewal Condition: Minimum 55% marks in college
  • Apply: licindia.in
  • Expected Last Date: 22 December 2025

3. ONGC Scholarship

  • Provider: Oil & Natural Gas Corporation (ONGC)
  • Eligibility:
    • Courses: Engineering, MBBS, MBA, etc.
    • AICTE/MCI approved colleges only
    • Minimum 60% marks in Class 12th
    • Family income:
      • SC/ST ≤ ₹4.5 lakh/year
      • OBC/General ≤ ₹2 lakh/year
  • Reward: ₹48,000 per year (₹4,000/month)
  • Seats: 300 (Gen/OBC), 500 (SC/ST)
  • Apply: ongcscholar.org
  • Expected Last Date: 30 November 2025

4. HDFC Bank Parivartan’s ECS Scholarship

  • Provider: HDFC Bank
  • Eligibility:
    • Family income ≤ ₹2.5 lakh/year
    • Minimum 55% marks in Class 12th
    • Open for Engineering and Medical students
  • Reward: ₹50,000 per year (renewable case-to-case)
  • Apply: HDFC Scholarship
  • Expected Last Date: 30 October 2025 (multiple cycles: Sept–Oct–Dec)

5. AICTE Pragati Scholarship for Girls

  • Provider: AICTE (All India Council for Technical Education)
  • Eligibility:
    • Only for girl students (1st/2nd year in AICTE-approved college)
    • Maximum 2 girls per family
    • Family income ≤ ₹8 lakh/year
  • Reward: ₹50,000 per year (for entire course duration)
  • Seats: 5000 every year
  • Apply: aicte-pragati-saksham.gov.in
  • Expected Last Date: 31 October 2025

6. Mohan T. Advani Centennial Scholarship (Blue Star Foundation)

  • Eligibility:
    • 80% marks in Class 12th
    • Family income ≤ ₹1 lakh/year
    • Engineering UG 1st or 2nd year students
  • Reward: 50% of annual fees or ₹75,000 (whichever is less)
  • Renewal Condition: 7.5 CGPA or above
  • Apply: bluestarfoundation.in
  • Expected Last Date: 15 October 2025

7. IDFC FIRST Bank Engineering Scholarship

  • Eligibility:
    • First-year B.E/B.Tech student
    • Family income ≤ ₹6 lakh/year
    • Children of IDFC employees not eligible
  • Reward: ₹1,00,000 per year (for 4 years = ₹4,00,000)
  • Seats: 50 scholarships per year
  • Apply: idfcfirstbank.com/scholarship
  • Expected Last Date: November 2025

8. Bharti Airtel Scholarship

  • Eligibility:
    • UG Engineering in top 50 NIRF-ranked colleges (IITs, NITs, etc.)
    • Eligible branches: CSE, IT, ECE, Telecom, AI, ML, Data Science, Robotics, AR/VR, IoT
    • Family income ≤ ₹8.5 lakh/year
  • Reward:
    • 100% tuition fees + hostel & mess fees
    • Free laptop provided
    • Full UG/Integrated course duration (up to 5 years)
  • Apply: airtel.in/scholarship
  • Last Date: To be announced

Scholarship Comparison Table 2025 : Scholarship for Engineering Students in India 2025

FAQs on Scholarship for Engineering Students in India 2025

1. Which is the best scholarship for engineering students in 2025?

The Airtel Scholarship and IDFC FIRST Bank Scholarship offer the highest financial benefits, covering tuition and living costs.

2. Can average students apply for these scholarships?

Yes. Many schemes like LIC Golden Jubilee and HDFC Parivartan require only 55–60% marks.

3. Do these scholarships cover hostel and mess fees?

Some scholarships like Airtel Scholarship cover hostel, mess, and even provide laptops.

4. What is the income limit for these scholarships?

The income limit varies from ₹1 lakh to ₹8.5 lakh depending on the scheme.

5. Where should I apply?

Applications can be submitted on official portals like NSP, AICTE website, or respective bank/foundation websites.

READ MORE : AKTU Spot Counselling 2025 | Special Counselling for Vacant Seats

Conclusion on Scholarship for Engineering Students in India 2025

If you are looking for the Scholarship for Engineering Students in India 2025, these top 8 options are the most rewarding and accessible.

  • Government Scholarships (Central Sector, AICTE Pragati, ONGC) are reliable and widely recognized.
  • Private Scholarships (HDFC, LIC, IDFC, Airtel, Blue Star) offer higher rewards and extra benefits.

👉 Don’t delay. If you are eligible, apply now and reduce the financial burden of your education.

content.rendered:
Introduction

In the 3rd year of B.Tech under AKTU (Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University), students across all branches are required to choose Open Elective-I. These subjects are designed to provide interdisciplinary knowledge, encourage innovation, and allow students to explore diverse domains beyond their core specialization.

Unlike departmental electives that focus on specific engineering branches, Open Electives are common to all B.Tech students and play a crucial role in shaping well-rounded graduates.

This blog will cover:

  • What is Open Elective in AKTU B.Tech
  • Complete list of Open Elective-I subjects for 3rd year
  • Subject highlights and future scope
  • Why Open Electives are important for engineering students

Click Links given below for notes/Imp. Question/PYQs

https://notesgallery.com/aktu-b-tech-3rd-year-free-study-materials/    Third Year

https://notesgallery.com/aktu-b-tech-4th-year-free-study-materials/    Fourth Year

What is an Open Elective in B.Tech?

An Open Elective is a subject that students can choose outside their core engineering curriculum. The main goal is to provide:

  • Flexibility in learning
  • Interdisciplinary exposure to real-world problems
  • Skill diversification useful for higher studies, placements, and entrepreneurship

In 3rd Year B.Tech (5th/6th Semester), AKTU students must select Open Elective-I from the approved list.

Open Elective-I Subjects (AKTU 3rd Year B.Tech)

Here is the complete list of Open Elective-I subjects offered to all branches:

  1. BOE060 – Idea to Business Model
    • Focus: Entrepreneurship, innovation, business planning
    • Skills: Start-up creation, financial modeling, market strategy
    • Career Scope: Entrepreneurship, product management, incubation centers
  2. BOE061 – Quality Control & Reliability
    • Focus: Techniques for ensuring product quality and system reliability
    • Skills: Statistical quality control, Six Sigma, reliability analysis
    • Career Scope: Manufacturing, quality assurance, operations
  3. BOE062 – Embedded System
    • Focus: Hardware-software integration for smart systems
    • Skills: Microcontrollers, IoT devices, system design
    • Career Scope: IoT, robotics, automotive systems, electronics
  4. BOE063 – Introduction to MEMS (Micro-Electro-Mechanical Systems)
    • Focus: Miniaturized mechanical and electrical systems
    • Skills: Microfabrication, sensors, nanotechnology
    • Career Scope: Biomedical devices, sensors, electronics, aerospace
  5. BOE064 – Object Oriented Programming (OOP)
    • Focus: OOP principles with languages like C++/Java
    • Skills: Encapsulation, inheritance, polymorphism
    • Career Scope: Software development, app development, system design
  6. BOE065 – Computer Based Numerical Techniques
    • Focus: Solving mathematical and engineering problems using computation
    • Skills: Numerical methods, algorithm design, simulations
    • Career Scope: Data analysis, simulations, engineering design
  7. BOE066 – GIS & Remote Sensing
    • Focus: Geographic data analysis using satellite and mapping systems
    • Skills: GIS software, spatial analysis, satellite image processing
    • Career Scope: Civil engineering, urban planning, environmental studies
  8. BOE067 – Basics of Database Management System (DBMS)
    • Focus: Fundamentals of database storage, management, and retrieval
    • Skills: SQL, ER modeling, database design
    • Career Scope: Software engineering, data analytics, backend development
  9. BOE068 – Software Project Management
    • Focus: Managing software projects with efficiency
    • Skills: Agile, Scrum, project lifecycle, risk management
    • Career Scope: IT project manager, software engineering teams, consultancy
  10. BOE069 – Understanding the Human Being Comprehensively – Human Aspirations and Its Fulfillment
  • Focus: Human values, ethics, and aspirations in life
  • Skills: Self-development, ethics in technology, sustainable living
  • Career Scope: Personality development, leadership, ethical decision-making

Importance of Open Electives for Engineering Students

  • Interdisciplinary learning – exposure beyond your branch
  • Placement advantage – additional skills like OOP, DBMS, or Embedded Systems are highly demanded
  • Entrepreneurship support – subjects like Idea to Business Model encourage start-up culture
  • Higher studies preparation – electives like MEMS, Embedded Systems, GIS are gateways to research
  • Balanced growth – electives like Human Values ensure ethical and holistic growth

How to Choose the Right Open Elective?

When selecting an open elective, keep these points in mind:

  1. Career Goals – If you want a software career → choose DBMS, OOP, or Software Project Management
  2. Research Interests – If planning for higher studies → MEMS, Embedded Systems, GIS are good choices
  3. Entrepreneurship Path – If interested in startups → Idea to Business Model
  4. Holistic Development – If you want personal growth → Human Aspirations and Fulfillment

Conclusion

The Open Elective-I subjects in 3rd Year B.Tech are designed to provide flexibility and prepare students for the future of engineering and technology. Whether you choose technical electives like DBMS, Embedded Systems, GIS, or value-based subjects like Human Aspirations, each option contributes to your career, knowledge, and personal development.

By making the right choice, you can align your learning with your future career path and gain a competitive edge in the professional world.

title.rendered: AKTU Spot Counselling 2025 | Special Counselling for Vacant Seats

content.rendered:
Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University (AKTU), Lucknow ने सत्र 2025-26 के लिए Spot Counselling (विशेष काउंसलिंग) की आधिकारिक सूचना जारी कर दी है।

👉 जिन निजी संस्थानों में काउंसलिंग के बाद सीटें खाली रह गई हैं, वहाँ प्रवेश के लिए अभ्यर्थी AKTU Spot Counselling 2025 के तहत ऑनलाइन पंजीकरण कर सकते हैं।

  • फार्मेसी कोर्स को छोड़कर सभी कोर्स के लिए यह प्रक्रिया लागू होगी।
  • पंजीकरण 12 सितम्बर 2025 (रात्रि 8 बजे से) शुरू होगा।
  • Counselling पूरी तरह Merit Basis पर होगी, जिसमें JEE Main 2025 / CUET 2025 / NATA 2025 / UCEED 2025 या शैक्षिक योग्यता (10+2) के आधार पर मेरिट बनाई जाएगी।

Overview Of Circular

Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University (AKTU), Lucknow ने सत्र 2025-26 के लिए Spot Counselling (Special Counselling) की सूचना जारी की है।

  • उद्देश्य: काउंसलिंग के बाद Private Colleges में बची हुई सीटों पर प्रवेश देना।
  • कौन Eligible: केवल वही छात्र जो AKTU Website पर Online Pre-Registration करेंगे।
  • Courses: सभी कोर्स (Pharmacy को छोड़कर)।
  • Merit Basis: JEE Main 2025 / CUET 2025 / NATA 2025 / UCEED 2025 या 10+2 Qualification।

AKTU Spot Counselling 2025: महत्वपूर्ण तिथियां

Registration Fees for AKTU Spot Counselling 2025

👉 शुल्क का भुगतान केवल ऑनलाइन मोड से होगा। अगर शुल्क जमा नहीं होगा तो पंजीकरण मान्य नहीं माना जाएगा।

Step-by-Step Registration Process for AKTU Spot Counselling 2025

नीचे दी गई प्रक्रिया से छात्र आसानी से पंजीकरण कर सकते हैं:

  1. सबसे पहले AKTU की आधिकारिक वेबसाइट पर जाएं।
  2. Homepage पर Spot Counselling 2025 के लिए Link/Popup दिखेगा।
  3. उस लिंक पर क्लिक करें और प्राथमिक पंजीकरण फॉर्म भरें।
    • नाम, पिता का नाम, जन्म तिथि, मोबाइल नंबर, ईमेल आईडी, योग्यता और कोर्स की जानकारी भरें।
    • ध्यान रहे यह जानकारी आगे संशोधित नहीं की जा सकेगी।
  4. Mobile Number को OTP Verification से सत्यापित करें।
  5. Verification के बाद आपको Registration Number मिलेगा।
  6. अब Dashboard पर जाकर Online Fees Payment करें।
  7. Educational Documents, Photo और Signature अपलोड करें।
  8. सभी जानकारी सही भरने के बाद Final Submit करें और Print निकालें।
    • Print में QR Code होना जरूरी है।

⚠️ Note: बिना फीस जमा किए गए Registration मान्य नहीं होंगे।

AKTU Spot Counselling 2025: Seat Allotment Process

  1. संस्थान द्वारा पंजीकृत अभ्यर्थियों की Merit List बनाई जाएगी।
  2. यह Merit List 14 सितम्बर 2025 (सायं 5 बजे तक) तैयार होगी।
  3. संस्थान अपनी वेबसाइट पर 15 सितम्बर 2025 सुबह 10 बजे तक मेरिट लिस्ट अपलोड करेंगे।
  4. उसी दिन (15 सितम्बर) Merit Basis पर Spot Counselling होगी और योग्य छात्रों को Vacant Seats आवंटित होंगी।
  5. Counselling के बाद Final List संस्थान की वेबसाइट पर अपलोड होगी।
  6. संस्थान यह सूची 20 सितम्बर 2025 (सायं 5 बजे तक) विश्वविद्यालय को भेजेंगे।

title.rendered: Reliance Foundation UG Scholarship 2025-26 | Apply Now

content.rendered:
Higher education in India is still a challenge for many due to financial barriers. To support talented and deserving students, Reliance Foundation Ug Scholarship 2025-26 has been launched. Every year, Reliance Foundation provides scholarships to 5,000 meritorious UG students across all streams, based on merit-cum-means criteria.

This scholarship not only reduces the financial burden of college fees but also helps students connect with a vibrant alumni network and opportunities for career growth.

About Reliance Foundation Ug Scholarship 2025-26

Reliance Foundation is committed to empowering youth through education. With nearly 600 million Indians under the age of 25, this scholarship aims to nurture young talent.

  • No. of Scholarships: 5,000 (for UG students)
  • Scholarship Amount: Up to ₹2,00,000 over the duration of the degree
  • Eligibility: First-year UG students in any stream, with household income under ₹15 lakh
  • Last Date to Apply: 4 October 2025

By offering both financial aid and non-financial support like alumni networking, the Reliance Foundation Ug Scholarship 2025-26 ensures holistic student development.

Key Features of the Scholarship

  • For first-year undergraduate students of any stream (academic year 2025-26).
  • Selection is merit-cum-means based.
  • Covers up to ₹2 lakh over the degree duration.
  • Open to all Indian citizens meeting eligibility.
  • Encourages applications from girls and specially-abled students.
  • Provides alumni network access for career development.

Scholarship Values

Reliance Foundation emphasizes not just financial help but also personal development. Selected scholars are expected to embody these values:

  1. Excellence – Commitment to high performance in academics and beyond.
  2. Leadership Potential – Ability to become future leaders of India and the world.
  3. Integrity – Honest, accountable, and responsible behavior.
  4. Community Commitment – Dedication to contribute positively to society.
  5. Growth Mindset – Continuous learning and improvement.
  6. Courage – Facing challenges with resilience and determination.

Scholarship Amount & Benefits

Eligibility Criteria

Students applying for the Reliance Foundation UG Scholarship 2025-26 must meet these requirements:

  • Be a resident Indian citizen.
  • Passed Class 12th with minimum 60% marks.
  • Currently enrolled in 1st year UG (2025-26) in a regular full-time degree.
  • Household income under ₹15 lakh (preference to < ₹2.5 lakh).
  • Must appear for the mandatory aptitude test.

Not Eligible:

  • Students in 2nd year or higher (admission before 2025).
  • Students enrolled in online, distance, hybrid modes.
  • Diploma holders (10th + Diploma path).
  • Students in 2-year or 6-year degree courses.
  • Applicants who skip or cheat in the aptitude test.

Application Process

Applications are open till 4 October 2025. Students can apply through the official portal.

Steps to Apply:

  1. Visit the official portal: Reliance Foundation UG Scholarship.
  2. Register and fill in details:
    • Personal & Contact Information
    • Academic Records
    • Achievements and Awards
    • Supporting Documents
  3. Upload income certificate, Aadhaar, and academic documents.
  4. Submit the application form online.
  5. Appear for the Aptitude Test.

Aptitude Test Details

  • Mode: Online
  • Duration: 60 minutes
  • Total Questions: 60 (MCQs)
  • Sections:
    • Verbal Ability
    • Analytical & Logical Reasoning
    • Numerical Ability

👉 A sample question paper is available on the official site to help students prepare.

Selection Process

The selection process of the Reliance Foundation UG Scholarship 2025-26 is transparent and systematic:

  1. Application Screening – Based on documents submitted.
  2. Aptitude Test Performance – Compulsory for all.
  3. First-Level Shortlisting – Combination of academic records + test score.
  4. Final Announcement – Up to 5,000 scholars selected on merit-cum-means.

Important Dates

Contact & Helpline

For queries regarding the Reliance Foundation UG Scholarship 2025-26:

  • WhatsApp: Text “hi” to 7977 100 100
  • Helpline: (011) 4117 1414
  • Email: RF.UGScholarships@reliancefoundation.org

FAQs

Q1. Who can apply for Reliance Foundation UG Scholarship 2025-26?
Students who passed Class 12 with at least 60% marks and enrolled in 1st-year UG in 2025-26.

Q2. What is the scholarship amount?
Up to ₹2 lakh over the course duration.

Q3. Is the aptitude test compulsory?
Yes, every applicant must take the online aptitude test.

Q4. What is the last date to apply?
The last date is 4 October 2025.

Q5. Which streams are eligible?
All undergraduate streams – Arts, Commerce, Science, Engineering, Medical, Law, Architecture, etc.

Conclusion

The Reliance Foundation UG Scholarship 2025-26 is a golden opportunity for first-year students to continue their higher education without financial burden. With up to ₹2 lakh support, transparent selection, and additional networking opportunities, this scholarship can truly shape the future of deserving students across India.
